    (hp : ∀ v ∈ p.support,component v ∈ C) :
    (∑ v ∈ p.support,p v^2) ≤ (((C.sup (id : ℕ → ℕ) : ℕ) : ℝ)+1)*(primalSeminorm p)^2

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.IncomparableModel.primal_le_disjoint
statement: lemma primal_le_disjoint (p : ForestNode →₀ ℝ) : primalSeminorm p ≤ forestSegments.primalSeminorm p

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.IncomparableModel.primal_sq_le
statement:
lemma primal_sq_le (p : ForestNode →₀ ℝ) {M : ℝ} (hM : 0 ≤ M)
    (hF : ∀ F : Family,(∑ i,(∑ j ∈ F.val.seg i,p j)^2) ≤ M) :
    (primalSeminorm p)^2 ≤ M

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.IncomparableModel.singleton_test
statement:
lemma singleton_test (j : ℕ) (p : ForestNode →₀ ℝ) :
    (∑ v ∈ p.support.filter (fun v => v.val.2.length=j),p v^2) ≤ (primalSeminorm p)^2

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.IncomparableModel.test_energy
statement:
lemma test_energy {κ : Type*} [Fintype κ] (S : κ → Finset ForestNode)
    (hS : ∀ i,forestSegments.IsSegment (S i))
    (hi : Pairwise (fun i j => ∀ u ∈ S i,∀ v ∈ S j,¬ ForestAncestor u v ∧ ¬ ForestAncestor v u))
    (p : ForestNode →₀ ℝ) : (∑ i,(∑ j ∈ S i,p j)^2) ≤ (primalSeminorm p)^2

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.IncomparableModel.test_le_primal
statement: lemma test_le_primal (F : Family) (p : ForestNode →₀ ℝ) : ‖F.val.test p‖ ≤ primalSeminorm p

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.RecursiveModel.aggregate_sq
statement:
lemma aggregate_sq {ι : Type*} (f : ι →₀ ℝ) :
    (aggregate 2 f)^2=∑ i ∈ f.support,f i^2

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.RecursiveModel.components_filter
statement:
lemma components_filter (p : ForestVec) (C : Set ℕ) (h : ℕ) :
    components (p.filter (fun i => i.1 ∈ C)) h=if h ∈ C then components p h else 0

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.RecursiveModel.components_zero
statement:
lemma components_zero (p : ForestVec) (h : ℕ) (hh : h ∉ p.support.image Sigma.fst) :
    components p h=0

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.RecursiveModel.energy_components
statement:
lemma energy_components (p : ForestVec) (C : Finset ℕ) (hC : p.support.image Sigma.fst ⊆ C) :
    (∑ i ∈ p.support,p i^2)=∑ h ∈ C,∑ i ∈ (components p h).support,(components p h i)^2

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.RecursiveModel.outer_contractive
statement:
lemma outer_contractive (s : ∀ h,Seminorm ℝ (Vec (h+1))) (p : ForestVec) (C : Set ℕ) :
    outerSeminorm s (p.filter (fun i => i.1 ∈ C)) ≤ outerSeminorm s p

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.RecursiveModel.outer_orthogonal
statement:
lemma outer_orthogonal (s : ∀ h,Seminorm ℝ (Vec (h+1))) (p q : ForestVec)
    (hd : Disjoint (p.support.image Sigma.fst) (q.support.image Sigma.fst)) :
    (outerSeminorm s (p+q))^2 ≤ (outerSeminorm s p)^2+(outerSeminorm s q)^2

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.RecursiveModel.outer_sq
statement:
lemma outer_sq (s : ∀ h,Seminorm ℝ (Vec (h+1))) (p : ForestVec) (C : Finset ℕ)
    (hC : p.support.image Sigma.fst ⊆ C) :
    (outerSeminorm s p)^2=∑ h ∈ C,(s h (components p h))^2

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.RecursiveModel.outer_support
statement:
lemma outer_support (s : ∀ h,Seminorm ℝ (Vec (h+1))) (p : ForestVec) :
    (outerValues s p).support ⊆ p.support.image Sigma.fst

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.Flag.augmented_linearIndependent
statement:
lemma Flag.augmented_linearIndependent {n : ℕ} (F : Flag n) :
    LinearIndependent ℝ (fun k ↦ ((1 : ℝ), F.point k))

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.Flag.combination_bounds
statement:
lemma Flag.combination_bounds {n : ℕ} (F : Flag n)
    (w : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) (hw : ∀ k, 0 ≤ w k) (hs : ∑ k, w k = 1) (i : Fin n) :
    (F.base i : ℝ) ≤ (∑ k, w k • F.point k) i ∧
      (∑ k, w k • F.point k) i ≤ F.base i + 1

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.Flag.combination_strict_bounds
statement:
lemma Flag.combination_strict_bounds {n : ℕ} (F : Flag n)
    (w : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) (hw : ∀ k, 0 < w k) (hs : ∑ k, w k = 1) (i : Fin n) :
    (F.base i : ℝ) < (∑ k, w k • F.point k) i ∧
      (∑ k, w k • F.point k) i < F.base i + 1

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.Flag.cross_cross
statement: lemma Flag.cross_cross {n : ℕ} (F : Flag n) (i : Fin n) : (F.cross i).cross i = F

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.Flag.cross_ne
statement: lemma Flag.cross_ne {n : ℕ} (F : Flag n) (i : Fin n) : F.cross i ≠ F

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.Flag.cross_order
statement: @[simp] lemma Flag.cross_order {n : ℕ} (F : Flag n) (i : Fin n) : (F.cross i).order = F.order

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.Flag.cross_vertex
statement:
lemma Flag.cross_vertex {n : ℕ} (F : Flag n) (i : Fin n) (k : Fin (n + 1))
    (hik : k.val ≤ (F.order.symm i).val) : (F.cross i).vertex k = F.vertex k

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.Flag.depth_antitone
statement:
lemma Flag.depth_antitone {n : ℕ} (F : Flag n)
    (w : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) (hw : ∀ k, 0 ≤ w k) (hs : ∑ k, w k = 1)
    (i j : Fin n) (hij : F.order.symm i ≤ F.order.symm j) :
    F.depth j (∑ k, w k • F.point k) ≤ F.depth i (∑ k, w k • F.point k)

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.Flag.depth_combination
statement:
lemma Flag.depth_combination {n : ℕ} (F : Flag n) (i : Fin n)
    {ι : Type u38} [Fintype ι] (w : ι → ℝ) (x : ι → Fin n → ℝ) (hw : ∑ k, w k = 1) :
    F.depth i (∑ k, w k • x k) = ∑ k, w k * F.depth i (x k)

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.Flag.depth_le_half
statement:
lemma Flag.depth_le_half {n : ℕ} (F : Flag n)
    (w : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) (hw : ∀ k, 0 ≤ w k) (hs : ∑ k, w k = 1) (i : Fin n) :
    F.depth i (∑ k, w k • F.point k) ≤ 1 / 2

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.Flag.depth_lt_half
statement:
lemma Flag.depth_lt_half {n : ℕ} (F : Flag n)
    (w : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) (hw : ∀ k, 0 < w k) (hs : ∑ k, w k = 1) (i : Fin n) :
    F.depth i (∑ k, w k • F.point k) < 1 / 2

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.Flag.depth_lt_half_of_pos_zero
statement:
lemma Flag.depth_lt_half_of_pos_zero {n : ℕ} (F : Flag n)
    (w : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) (hw : ∀ k, 0 ≤ w k) (h₀ : 0 < w 0)
    (hs : ∑ k, w k = 1) (i : Fin n) :
    F.depth i (∑ k, w k • F.point k) < 1 / 2

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.Flag.depth_nonneg
statement:
lemma Flag.depth_nonneg {n : ℕ} (F : Flag n)
    (w : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) (hw : ∀ k, 0 ≤ w k) (hs : ∑ k, w k = 1) (i : Fin n) :
    0 ≤ F.depth i (∑ k, w k • F.point k)

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.Flag.depth_point
statement:
lemma Flag.depth_point {n : ℕ} (F : Flag n) (i : Fin n) (k : Fin (n + 1)) :
    F.depth i (F.point k) = if (F.order.symm i).val < k.val then 1 / 2 else 0

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.Flag.depth_pos
statement:
lemma Flag.depth_pos {n : ℕ} (F : Flag n)
    (w : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) (hw : ∀ k, 0 < w k) (hs : ∑ k, w k = 1) (i : Fin n) :
    0 < F.depth i (∑ k, w k • F.point k)

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.Flag.depth_pos_of_weight
statement:
lemma Flag.depth_pos_of_weight {n : ℕ} (F : Flag n)
    (w : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) (hw : ∀ k, 0 ≤ w k) (hs : ∑ k, w k = 1)
    (i : Fin n) (k : Fin (n + 1)) (hk : (F.order.symm i).val < k.val) (hkw : 0 < w k) :
    0 < F.depth i (∑ k, w k • F.point k)

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.Flag.depth_strictAnti
statement:
lemma Flag.depth_strictAnti {n : ℕ} (F : Flag n)
    (w : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) (hw : ∀ k, 0 < w k) (hs : ∑ k, w k = 1)
    (i j : Fin n) (hij : F.order.symm i < F.order.symm j) :
    F.depth j (∑ k, w k • F.point k) < F.depth i (∑ k, w k • F.point k)

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.Flag.depth_strictAnti_of_weight
statement:
lemma Flag.depth_strictAnti_of_weight {n : ℕ} (F : Flag n)
    (w : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) (hw : ∀ k, 0 ≤ w k) (hs : ∑ k, w k = 1)
    (i j : Fin n) (hij : F.order.symm i < F.order.symm j)
    (hpos : 0 < w (F.order.symm i).succ) :
    F.depth j (∑ k, w k • F.point k) < F.depth i (∑ k, w k • F.point k)

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.Flag.eq_of_facet_combination
statement:
lemma Flag.eq_of_facet_combination {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (F G : Flag n)
    (t : Fin n) (ht : (F.order.symm t).val = n - 1)
    (hbt : F.base t = G.base t) (hct : F.corner t = G.corner t)
    (w z : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) (hw : ∀ k, 0 ≤ w k)
    (hwp : ∀ k, k ≠ Fin.last n → 0 < w k) (hz : ∀ k, 0 ≤ z k)
    (hsw : ∑ k, w k = 1) (hsz : ∑ k, z k = 1)
    (he : ∑ k, w k • F.point k = ∑ k, z k • G.point k) : F = G

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.Flag.eq_of_strict_combination
statement:
lemma Flag.eq_of_strict_combination {n : ℕ} (F G : Flag n)
    (w z : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) (hw : ∀ k, 0 < w k) (hz : ∀ k, 0 ≤ z k)
    (hsw : ∑ k, w k = 1) (hsz : ∑ k, z k = 1)
    (he : ∑ k, w k • F.point k = ∑ k, z k • G.point k) : F = G

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.Flag.flip_base
statement: @[simp] lemma Flag.flip_base {n : ℕ} (F : Flag n) (i : Fin n) : (F.flip i).base = F.base

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.Flag.flip_flip
statement: lemma Flag.flip_flip {n : ℕ} (F : Flag n) (i : Fin n) : (F.flip i).flip i = F

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.Flag.flip_ne
statement: lemma Flag.flip_ne {n : ℕ} (F : Flag n) (i : Fin n) : F.flip i ≠ F

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.Flag.flip_order
statement: @[simp] lemma Flag.flip_order {n : ℕ} (F : Flag n) (i : Fin n) : (F.flip i).order = F.order

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.Flag.flip_vertex
statement:
lemma Flag.flip_vertex {n : ℕ} (F : Flag n) (i : Fin n) (k : Fin (n + 1))
    (hik : (F.order.symm i).val < k.val) : (F.flip i).vertex k = F.vertex k

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.Flag.linearIndependent_steps
statement:
lemma Flag.linearIndependent_steps {n : ℕ} (F : Flag n) :
    LinearIndependent ℝ (fun k : Fin n ↦ F.point k.succ - F.point k.castSucc)

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.Flag.neighbor_ne
statement:
lemma Flag.neighbor_ne {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (F : Flag n) (j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    F.neighbor j ≠ F

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.Flag.neighbor_neighbor
statement:
lemma Flag.neighbor_neighbor {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (F : Flag n) (j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    (F.neighbor j).neighbor j = F

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.Flag.neighbor_vertex
statement:
lemma Flag.neighbor_vertex {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (F : Flag n) (j k : Fin (n + 1))
    (hjk : k ≠ j) : (F.neighbor j).vertex k = F.vertex k

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.Flag.point_bounds
statement:
lemma Flag.point_bounds {n : ℕ} (F : Flag n) (k : Fin (n + 1)) (i : Fin n) :
    (F.base i : ℝ) ≤ F.point k i ∧ F.point k i ≤ F.base i + 1

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.Flag.point_succ_sub
statement:
lemma Flag.point_succ_sub {n : ℕ} (F : Flag n) (k : Fin n) :
    F.point k.succ - F.point k.castSucc = Pi.single (F.order k) (F.step k)

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.Flag.reflect_cross
statement:
lemma Flag.reflect_cross {n : ℕ} (s : Fin n → Bool) (F : Flag n) (i : Fin n) :
    (F.cross i).reflect s = (F.reflect s).cross i

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.Flag.reflect_false
statement: lemma Flag.reflect_false {n : ℕ} (F : Flag n) : F.reflect (fun _ ↦ false) = F

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.Flag.reflect_flip
statement:
lemma Flag.reflect_flip {n : ℕ} (s : Fin n → Bool) (F : Flag n) (i : Fin n) :
    (F.flip i).reflect s = (F.reflect s).flip i

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.Flag.reflect_neighbor
statement:
lemma Flag.reflect_neighbor {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (s : Fin n → Bool)
    (F : Flag n) (j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    (F.neighbor j).reflect s = (F.reflect s).neighbor j

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.Flag.reflect_point
statement:
lemma Flag.reflect_point {n : ℕ} (s : Fin n → Bool) (F : Flag n)
    (k : Fin (n + 1)) (i : Fin n) :
    (F.reflect s).point k i = if s i then -F.point k i else F.point k i

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.Flag.reflect_reflect
statement:
lemma Flag.reflect_reflect {n : ℕ} (s t : Fin n → Bool) (F : Flag n) :
    (F.reflect t).reflect s = F.reflect (fun i ↦ xor (s i) (t i))

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.Flag.reflect_swap
statement:
lemma Flag.reflect_swap {n : ℕ} (s : Fin n → Bool) (F : Flag n) (i j : Fin n) :
    (F.swap i j).reflect s = (F.reflect s).swap i j

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.Flag.reflect_vertex
statement:
lemma Flag.reflect_vertex {n : ℕ} (s : Fin n → Bool) (F : Flag n)
    (k : Fin (n + 1)) (i : Fin n) :
    (F.reflect s).vertex k i = if s i then -F.vertex k i else F.vertex k i

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.Flag.step_ne_zero
statement: lemma Flag.step_ne_zero {n : ℕ} (F : Flag n) (i : Fin n) : F.step i ≠ 0

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.Flag.swap_ne
statement: lemma Flag.swap_ne {n : ℕ} (F : Flag n) (i j : Fin n) (hij : i ≠ j) : F.swap i j ≠ F

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.Flag.swap_swap
statement:
lemma Flag.swap_swap {n : ℕ} (F : Flag n) (i j : Fin n) :
    (F.swap i j).swap i j = F

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.Flag.swap_vertex
statement:
lemma Flag.swap_vertex {n : ℕ} (F : Flag n) (i j : Fin n) (k : Fin (n + 1))
    (hik : i.val < k.val ↔ j.val < k.val) : (F.swap i j).vertex k = F.vertex k

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.Flag.vertex_bounds
statement:
lemma Flag.vertex_bounds {n : ℕ} (F : Flag n) (k : Fin (n + 1)) (i : Fin n) :
    2 * F.base i ≤ F.vertex k i ∧ F.vertex k i ≤ 2 * F.base i + 2

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.Flag.vertex_orbits_distinct
statement:
lemma Flag.vertex_orbits_distinct {n : ℕ} (F : Flag n)
    (j k : Fin (n + 1)) (s : Signs n)
    (he : ∀ i, F.vertex j i = if s.val i then -F.vertex k i else F.vertex k i) : j = k

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.linearIndependent_consecutive_iff
statement:
lemma linearIndependent_consecutive_iff {n : ℕ} (v : Fin (n + 1) → V) :
    LinearIndependent ℝ (Fin.cons (v 0) (fun i ↦ v i.succ - v i.castSucc)) ↔
    LinearIndependent ℝ v

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.span_consecutive
statement:
lemma span_consecutive {n : ℕ} (v : Fin (n + 1) → V) :
    Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range (Fin.cons (v 0) (fun i ↦ v i.succ - v i.castSucc))) =
    Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range v)

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.Flag.center_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma Flag.center_apply {n : ℕ} (F : Flag n) (i : Fin n) :
    F.center i = (F.base i : ℝ) + 1 / 2

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.Flag.dist_combination_center
statement:
lemma Flag.dist_combination_center {n : ℕ} (F : Flag n)
    (w : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) (hw : ∀ k, 0 ≤ w k) (hs : ∑ k, w k = 1) :
    dist (∑ k, w k • F.point k) F.center ≤ 1 / 2

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.Flag.dist_combination_point
statement:
lemma Flag.dist_combination_point {n : ℕ} (F : Flag n)
    (w : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) (hw : ∀ k, 0 ≤ w k) (hs : ∑ k, w k = 1) (k : Fin (n + 1)) :
    dist (∑ l, w l • F.point l) (F.point k) ≤ 1

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.Flag.dist_point_center
statement:
lemma Flag.dist_point_center {n : ℕ} (F : Flag n) (k : Fin (n + 1)) :
    dist (F.point k) F.center ≤ 1 / 2

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.Flag.dist_scaled_point_center
statement:
lemma Flag.dist_scaled_point_center {n : ℕ} (F : Flag n) (h : ℝ) (hh : 0 ≤ h)
    (k : Fin (n + 1)) : dist (h • F.point k) (h • F.center) ≤ h / 2

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.Flag.finite_base_bounds
statement:
lemma Flag.finite_base_bounds {n : ℕ} (L U : ℤ) :
    Set.Finite {F : Flag n | ∀ i, L ≤ F.base i ∧ F.base i ≤ U}

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.Flag.finite_near_centers
OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.Flag.neighbor_base_of_ne_last
statement:
lemma Flag.neighbor_base_of_ne_last {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (F : Flag n) (j : Fin (n + 1))
    (hj : j ≠ Fin.last n) : (F.neighbor j).base = F.base

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.Flag.neighbor_center_dist
statement:
lemma Flag.neighbor_center_dist {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (F : Flag n) (j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    dist (F.neighbor j).center F.center ≤ 1

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.Flag.neighbor_outside_time
statement:
lemma Flag.neighbor_outside_time {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (F : Flag n) (j : Fin (n + 1))
    (t : Fin n) (m : ℤ) (hlo : 0 ≤ F.base t) (hhi : F.base t < m)
    (hout : ¬ (0 ≤ (F.neighbor j).base t ∧ (F.neighbor j).base t < m)) :
    j = Fin.last n ∧ (F.order.symm t).val = n - 1 ∧
      ((F.base t = 0 ∧ F.corner t = false) ∨ (F.base t = m - 1 ∧ F.corner t = true))

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.Flag.point_time_boundary
statement:
lemma Flag.point_time_boundary {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (F : Flag n) (t : Fin n)
    (ht : (F.order.symm t).val = n - 1) (k : Fin (n + 1)) (hk : k ≠ Fin.last n) :
    F.point k t = (F.base t : ℝ) + if F.corner t then 1 else 0

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.dist_scale
statement:
lemma dist_scale {E : Type u39} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (h : ℝ) (hh : 0 ≤ h) (x y : E) : dist (h • x) (h • y) = h * dist x y

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.finite_nearCylinder
statement:
lemma finite_nearCylinder {n : ℕ} {K : Set (Fin n → ℝ)} (hK : Bornology.IsBounded K)
    (h r : ℝ) (hh : 0 < h) (t : Fin n) (m : ℕ) : (nearCylinder K h r t m).Finite

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.gridPoint_injective
statement:
lemma gridPoint_injective {n : ℕ} {h : ℝ} (hh : h ≠ 0) :
    Function.Injective (gridPoint (n := n) h)

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.gridPoint_vertex
statement:
lemma gridPoint_vertex {n : ℕ} (h : ℝ) (F : Flag n) (k : Fin (n + 1)) :
    gridPoint h (F.vertex k) = h • F.point k

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.nearCylinder_combination_time
statement:
lemma nearCylinder_combination_time {n : ℕ} (K : Set (Fin n → ℝ)) (h r : ℝ)
    (hh : 0 ≤ h) (t : Fin n) (m : ℕ) (hm : h * m = 1)
    {F : Flag n} (hF : F ∈ nearCylinder K h r t m)
    (w : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) (hw : ∀ k, 0 ≤ w k) (hs : ∑ k, w k = 1) :
    (h • (∑ k, w k • F.point k)) t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.CubeFlags.nearCylinder_point_cthickening
statement:
lemma nearCylinder_point_cthickening {n : ℕ} (K : Set (Fin n → ℝ)) (h r : ℝ)
    (hh : 0 ≤ h) (t : Fin n) (m : ℕ) {F : Flag n} (hF : F ∈ nearCylinder K h r t m)

lemma exists_mixed_generic
    {Q : Type u91} {W : Type u92} {T₁ : Type u93} {T₂ : Type u94} [Fintype Q] [Fintype W] [Fintype T₁] [Fintype T₂]
    (J₁ : T₁ → Type u191) (J₂ : T₂ → Type u192) [∀ t, Fintype (J₁ t)] [∀ t, Fintype (J₂ t)]
    (P : Q → Prop) (b : Q → V) (e : W → Q) (A : W → V ≃ₗ[ℝ] V)
    (v₁ : ∀ t, J₁ t → W) (v₂ : ∀ t, J₂ t → W)
    (he₁ : ∀ t, Function.Injective (e ∘ v₁ t))
    (he₂ : ∀ t, Function.Injective (e ∘ v₂ t))
    (hf₁ : ∀ t, LinearIndependent ℝ
      (fun i : {i // P (e (v₁ t i))} ↦ A (v₁ t i.val) (b (e (v₁ t i.val)))))
    (hf₂ : ∀ t, LinearIndependent ℝ
      (fun i : {i // P (e (v₂ t i))} ↦ ((1 : ℝ), A (v₂ t i.val) (b (e (v₂ t i.val))))))
    (hc₁ : ∀ t, Fintype.card (J₁ t) ≤ Module.finrank ℝ V)
    (hc₂ : ∀ t, Fintype.card (J₂ t) ≤ Module.finrank ℝ V + 1)
    (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ a : {q // ¬ P q} → V,
      (∀ w, dist (mixedVertexEvaluation P b e A a w) (A w (b (e w))) < ε) ∧
      (∀ t, LinearIndependent ℝ (fun i ↦ mixedVertexEvaluation P b e A a (v₁ t i))) ∧
      (∀ t, LinearIndependent ℝ (fun i ↦ ((1 : ℝ), mixedVertexEvaluation P b e A a (v₂ t i))))

lemma exists_equivariant_generic [Fintype X]
    {T₁ : Type u98} {T₂ : Type u99} [Fintype T₁] [Fintype T₂]
    (J₁ : T₁ → Type u193) (J₂ : T₂ → Type u194) [∀ t, Fintype (J₁ t)] [∀ t, Fintype (J₂ t)]
    (P : X → Prop) (hP : ∀ g : G, ∀ x, P (g • x) ↔ P x)
    (b : X → V) (hb : ∀ g : G, ∀ x, b (g • x) = ρ g (b x))
    (v₁ : ∀ t, J₁ t → X) (v₂ : ∀ t, J₂ t → X)
    (he₁ : ∀ t, Function.Injective (orbitLabel (G := G) ∘ v₁ t))
    (he₂ : ∀ t, Function.Injective (orbitLabel (G := G) ∘ v₂ t))
    (hf₁ : ∀ t, LinearIndependent ℝ (fun i : {i // P (v₁ t i)} ↦ b (v₁ t i.val)))
    (hf₂ : ∀ t, LinearIndependent ℝ (fun i : {i // P (v₂ t i)} ↦ ((1 : ℝ), b (v₂ t i.val))))
    (hc₁ : ∀ t, Fintype.card (J₁ t) ≤ Module.finrank ℝ V)
    (hc₂ : ∀ t, Fintype.card (J₂ t) ≤ Module.finrank ℝ V + 1)
    (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ a : X → V,
      (∀ g : G, ∀ x, a (g • x) = ρ g (a x)) ∧
      (∀ x, dist (a x) (b x) < ε) ∧
      (∀ x, P x → a x = b x) ∧
      (∀ t, LinearIndependent ℝ (fun i ↦ a (v₁ t i))) ∧
      (∀ t, LinearIndependent ℝ (fun i ↦ ((1 : ℝ), a (v₂ t i))))

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixFlow.matching_nonzero_rows
statement:
lemma matching_nonzero_rows {l r ε : ℝ} (hlr : l ≤ r)
    (M : Sym N → Sym N) (L Q : ℝ≥0) (hL : LipschitzWith L M)
    (q : Sym N → ℝ) (hq : ∀ A, |q A| ≤ Q)
    (g : Fin N → ℝ → ℝ) (hg : ∀ i, LocallyLipschitz (g i))
    (k : Fin N → ℝ) (hk : ∀ i, 0 < k i) (hgk : ∀ i, g i (k i) = 0)
    (hc : ∀ i A, (∀ j, i ≠ j → A.val i j = 0) → (M A).val i i = q A * g i (A.val i i))
    (he : ∀ s : Fin N → ℝ, (∀ i, s i = 1 ∨ s i = -1) → ∀ A, M (symConj s A) = symConj s (M A))
    (u : ℝ → Fin N → ℝ) (X : (Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℝ × ℝ) → ℝ → Sym N)
    (hXi : ∀ p, X p l = symDiag k)
    (hXd : ∀ p t, t ∈ Icc l r → HasDerivWithinAt (X p) (flowRhs ε M u p t (X p t)) (Icc l r) t)
    (C : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℝ) (θ : ℝ) (hXf : X (C,θ) r = -symDiag k) :
    ∀ i, ∃ j, C i j ≠ 0

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixFlow.terminal_zero_parameter

lemma terminal_zero_parameter {l r ε : ℝ} (hlr : l ≤ r)
    (M : Sym N → Sym N) (hM : Continuous M) (k : Fin N → ℝ)
    (u : ℝ → Fin N → ℝ) (hu : ContinuousOn u (Icc l r))
    (ho : ∀ i j, (∫ t in l..r, u t i * u t j) = if i=j then 1 else 0)
    (C : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℝ) (X : ℝ → Sym N)
    (hXi : X l = symDiag k)
    (hXd : ∀ t ∈ Icc l r, HasDerivWithinAt X (flowRhs ε M u (C,0) t (X t)) (Icc l r) t) :
    (X r + symDiag k).val = 2 • diagonal k - ε⁻¹ • (C*C.transpose)

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixFlow.vanishing_row_stationary
statement:
lemma vanishing_row_stationary {l r ε : ℝ} (hlr : l ≤ r)
    (M : Sym N → Sym N) (L Q : ℝ≥0) (hL : LipschitzWith L M)
    (q : Sym N → ℝ) (hq : ∀ A, |q A| ≤ Q)
    (g : Fin N → ℝ → ℝ) (hg : ∀ i, LocallyLipschitz (g i))
    (k : Fin N → ℝ) (hgk : ∀ i, g i (k i) = 0)
    (hc : ∀ i A, (∀ j, i ≠ j → A.val i j = 0) → (M A).val i i = q A * g i (A.val i i))
    (he : ∀ s : Fin N → ℝ, (∀ i, s i = 1 ∨ s i = -1) → ∀ A, M (symConj s A) = symConj s (M A))
    (u : ℝ → Fin N → ℝ) (X : (Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℝ × ℝ) → ℝ → Sym N)
    (hXi : ∀ p, X p l = symDiag k)
    (hXd : ∀ p t, t ∈ Icc l r → HasDerivWithinAt (X p) (flowRhs ε M u p t (X p t)) (Icc l r) t)
    (C : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℝ) (θ : ℝ) (i : Fin N) (hi : ∀ j, C i j = 0) :
    ∀ t ∈ Icc l r, (X (C,θ) t).val i i = k i

statement:

    (k : Fin N → ℝ) (A : Sym N)
    (φ : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ →L[ℝ] ℝ)
    (hφ : ∀ A, A.PosSemidef → 0 ≤ φ A) (hφ₁ : φ 1 = 1)

    φ (complexify (sourceField σ δ hσ₁ hδ k A).val) ≤ 0

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.MatrixFlow.source_path_state_barrier
statement:
lemma source_path_state_barrier {σ δ ε l r : ℝ} (hσ₀ : 0 < σ) (hσ₁ : σ < 1) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hε : 0 < ε) (k : Fin N → ℝ) (a : ℝ → Fin N → ℝ)
    (q : Sym N → ℝ) (hq : ∀ A, 0 ≤ q A) (X : ℝ → Sym N)
    (hXi : X l = symDiag k) (hXf : X r = -symDiag k)
    (hXd : ∀ t ∈ Icc l r, HasDerivWithinAt X
      (ε⁻¹ • (q (X t) • sourceField σ δ hσ₁ hδ k (X t) - symOuter (a t))) (Icc l r) t)
    (φ : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ →L[ℝ] ℝ)
    (hφ : ∀ A, A.PosSemidef → 0 ≤ φ A) (hφ₁ : φ 1 = 1) :
    ∀ t ∈ Icc l r, |φ (complexify (X t).val)| ≤ ‖k‖

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.ActionProof.penalized_action_integral
statement:
lemma penalized_action_integral {σ δ ε l r η : ℝ}
    (hσ₀ : 0 < σ) (hσ₁ : σ < 1) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hε : 0 < ε) (hlr : l ≤ r)
    (k : Fin N → ℝ) (a v : ℝ → Fin N → ℝ)
    (ha : ContinuousOn a (Icc l r)) (hv : ContinuousOn v (Icc l r))
    (had : ∀ t ∈ Ioo l r, ∀ i, HasDerivAt (fun t ↦ a t i) (v t i) t)
    (hal : a l = 0) (har : a r = 0) (X : ℝ → Sym N)
    (hXi : X l = symDiag k) (hXf : X r = -symDiag k)
    (hXd : ∀ t ∈ Icc l r, HasDerivWithinAt X
      (ε⁻¹ • (sourceField σ δ hσ₁ hδ k (X t) - symOuter (a t))) (Icc l r) t)
    (hp : ∀ t ∈ Icc l r, actionDefect σ k (X t,a t) - constraintDefect σ δ k (X t,a t)/ε ≤ η) :
    fieldPrimitive σ δ k (-diagonal k) - fieldPrimitive σ δ k (diagonal k) ≤
      (∫ t in l..r, actionDensity σ k (a t) (v t)) + (r-l)*η

statement:

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.ConstantProof.betaAction_eq_beta
statement:

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.ConstantProof.real_beta_symmetric
statement:
lemma real_beta_symmetric {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ) :
    (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, t^σ*(1-t)^σ) =
      Real.Gamma (σ+1)^2 / Real.Gamma (2*(σ+1))

name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.ConstantProof.young_over_beta
statement:
lemma young_over_beta {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ) :
    (σ^σ/(1+σ)^(1+σ))/betaAction σ =
      (σ/(σ+1))^σ*Real.Gamma (σ+3/2)/(Real.sqrt Real.pi*Real.Gamma (σ+2))

statement:
lemma compact_family_radius {ι : Type u179} [Fintype ι] (u : ι → C1L2)

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.bounded_tree_modulus_eq_zero
statement:
theorem bounded_tree_modulus_eq_zero
    (p : (h : ℕ) → Tree h → E) {m M c : ℝ}
    (hm : 0 < m) (hmM : m ≤ M) (hc : 0 < c)
    (hbound : ∀ h, 1 ≤ h → ∀ s : Tree h, m ≤ ‖p h s‖ ∧ ‖p h s‖ ≤ M)
    (hweak : ∀ h, 1 ≤ h → ∀ (s : Tree h) (hs : s.val.length < h),
      WeaklyNull (fun n => p h (child s hs n) - p h s))
    (hinc : ∀ h, 1 ≤ h → ∀ (s : Tree h) (hs : s.val.length < h) (n : ℕ),
      c ≤ ‖p h (child s hs n) - p h s‖) :
    oneSidedModulus E (c / (2 * M)) = 0

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.bounded_tree_renorming_obstruction
statement:
theorem bounded_tree_renorming_obstruction
    {Y : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup Y] [NormedSpace ℝ Y]
    (p : (h : ℕ) → Tree h → E) {m M c α β : ℝ}
    (hm : 0 < m) (hmM : m ≤ M) (hc : 0 < c)
    (hbound : ∀ h, 1 ≤ h → ∀ s : Tree h, m ≤ ‖p h s‖ ∧ ‖p h s‖ ≤ M)
    (hweak : ∀ h, 1 ≤ h → ∀ (s : Tree h) (hs : s.val.length < h),
      WeaklyNull (fun n => p h (child s hs n) - p h s))
    (hinc : ∀ h, 1 ≤ h → ∀ (s : Tree h) (hs : s.val.length < h) (n : ℕ),
      c ≤ ‖p h (child s hs n) - p h s‖)
    (e : E ≃L[ℝ] Y) (hα : 0 < α) (hαβ : α ≤ β)
    (he : ∀ x : E, α * ‖x‖ ≤ ‖e x‖ ∧ ‖e x‖ ≤ β * ‖x‖) :
    oneSidedModulus Y (α * c / (2 * β * M)) = 0

lemma oneSided_growth {t γ c : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) (hγ : 0 < γ) (hc : 0 < c)
    (hδ : (γ : EReal) < oneSidedModulus E t) (p : E) (hp : 0 < ‖p‖)
    (htp : t * ‖p‖ ≤ c/2) (d : ℕ → E) (hd : WeaklyNull d)
    (hdn : ∀ n, c ≤ ‖d n‖) :
    ∃ n, ‖p‖ + γ * ‖p‖ / 2 ≤ ‖p + d n‖

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.oneSided_sphere_tail
statement:
lemma oneSided_sphere_tail {t γ : ℝ} (hγ : (γ : EReal) < oneSidedModulus E t)
    (x : E) (hx : ‖x‖ = 1) :
    ∃ F : ClosedFiniteCodim E, ∀ y : E, y ∈ F.space → ‖y‖ = 1 →
      1 + γ ≤ ‖x + t • y‖

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.oneSided_wide_tail
statement:
lemma oneSided_wide_tail {t γ : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) (hγ : 0 ≤ γ)
    (hδ : (γ : EReal) < oneSidedModulus E t) (p : E) (hp : 0 < ‖p‖) :
    ∃ F : ClosedFiniteCodim E, ∀ w : E, w ∈ F.space → t * ‖p‖ ≤ ‖w‖ →
      (1 + γ) * ‖p‖ ≤ ‖p + w‖

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.weaklyNull_of_hilbert_upper
statement:
lemma weaklyNull_of_hilbert_upper (v : ℕ → E)
    (hv : ∀ (A : Finset ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℝ),
      ‖∑ n ∈ A, a n • v n‖ ≤ Real.sqrt (∑ n ∈ A, (a n)^2)) : WeaklyNull v

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.TreeCalculus.childNode_injective
statement: lemma childNode_injective (s : Node) : Function.Injective (fun n : ℕ => s ++ [n])

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.TreeCalculus.finitePairing_nodeArray
statement:
lemma finitePairing_nodeArray (r : Bool) (f : TreeCoordinate r → ℝ) (s : Node) :
    finitePairing f (nodeArray r s) = liftCoefficients r f s

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.TreeCalculus.finitePairing_pathArray
statement:
lemma finitePairing_pathArray (r : Bool) (f : TreeCoordinate r → ℝ) (s : Node) :
    finitePairing f (pathArray r s) = potential (liftCoefficients r f) s

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.TreeCalculus.pathArray_apply
statement:
lemma pathArray_apply (r : Bool) (s : Node) (i : TreeCoordinate r) :
    pathArray r s i = if i.val <+: s then 1 else 0

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.TreeCalculus.pathArray_child
statement:
lemma pathArray_child (r : Bool) (s : Node) (n : ℕ) :
    pathArray r (s ++ [n]) = pathArray r s + nodeArray r (s ++ [n])

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.TreeCalculus.sibling_quadraticGroup
statement:
lemma sibling_quadraticGroup (k : QuadraticKind) (s : Node) (A : Finset ℕ) :
    QuadraticGroup k (A.image (fun n => s ++ [n]))

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.TreeCalculus.sibling_sq_sum_le
OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.TreeCalculus.testNorm_pathArray
statement:
lemma testNorm_pathArray (r : Bool) (k : QuadraticKind) (s : Node)
    (hs : r = true ∨ s ≠ []) : testNorm (treeTestFamily r k) (pathArray r s) = 1

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.TreeCalculus.testNorm_pathArray_le
statement:
lemma testNorm_pathArray_le (r : Bool) (k : QuadraticKind) (s : Node) :
    testNorm (treeTestFamily r k) (pathArray r s) ≤ 1

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.averaged_tail_bound_pullback
statement:
lemma averaged_tail_bound_pullback (e : E →L[ℝ] Y) (he : ∀ x, ‖e x‖ = ‖x‖)
    {t b : ℝ}
    (h : ∀ x : Y, ‖x‖ = 1 → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ F : ClosedFiniteCodim Y,
      ∀ y : Y, y ∈ F.space → 1 ≤ ‖y‖ →
        b - ε ≤ (‖x + t • y‖ + ‖x - t • y‖)/2 - 1) :
    (b : EReal) ≤ averagedModulus E t

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.continuousEquiv_bounds
statement:
lemma continuousEquiv_bounds (e : E ≃L[ℝ] Y) :
    ∃ α β : ℝ, 0 < α ∧ α ≤ β ∧ ∀ x, α * ‖x‖ ≤ ‖e x‖ ∧ ‖e x‖ ≤ β * ‖x‖

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.finitePairing_embDomain
statement:
lemma finitePairing_embDomain (ι : J ↪ I) (f : I → ℝ) (x : J →₀ ℝ) :
    finitePairing f (Finsupp.embDomain ι x) = finitePairing (f ∘ ι) x

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.mem_pullbackFiniteCodim
statement:
lemma mem_pullbackFiniteCodim (e : E →L[ℝ] Y) (F : ClosedFiniteCodim Y) (x : E) :
    x ∈ (pullbackFiniteCodim e F).space ↔ e x ∈ F.space

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.testNorm_restricted
statement:
lemma testNorm_restricted (K : TestFamily I) (ι : J ↪ I) (x : J →₀ ℝ) :
    testNorm (restrictedTestFamily K ι) x = testNorm K (Finsupp.embDomain ι x)

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.FreeRoot.distinct_bound_le_common
statement:
lemma distinct_bound_le_common (t : ℝ) :
    (Real.sqrt (1+t^2/576)-1)/4 ≤ Real.sqrt (1+t^2/4)-1

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.FreeRoot.includeEdge_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma includeEdge_apply (s : TreeCoordinate false) :
    includeEdge s = (⟨s.val, Or.inl rfl⟩ : TreeCoordinate true)

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.FreeRoot.includeEdge_child
statement:
@[simp] lemma includeEdge_child (s : Node) (n : ℕ) :
    includeEdge (childCoordinate false s n) = childCoordinate true s n

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.FreeRoot.isFreePotential_iff
statement:
lemma isFreePotential_iff (b : Node → ℝ) :
    IsFreePotential b ↔ IsTreeTest true .sibling (increments b)

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.FreeRoot.mem_freeTestFamily_iff
statement:
theorem mem_freeTestFamily_iff (f : TreeCoordinate false → ℝ) :
    f ∈ freeTestFamily.carrier ↔ ∃ b : Node → ℝ, IsFreePotential b ∧
      ∀ s : TreeCoordinate false, f s = b s.val - b s.val.dropLast

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.FreeRoot.rootless_restricted_potential
statement:
lemma rootless_restricted_potential (g : treeTestFamily true .sibling) (s : Node) :
    potential (liftCoefficients false (g.val ∘ includeEdge)) s =
      potential (liftCoefficients true g.val) s - liftCoefficients true g.val []

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.hilbertSum_reflexive
statement:
theorem hilbertSum_reflexive {I : Type*} (E : I → Type*)
    [∀ i, NormedAddCommGroup (E i)] [∀ i, NormedSpace ℝ (E i)]

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.hilbert_reflexive
statement:
lemma hilbert_reflexive {K : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup K]
    [InnerProductSpace ℝ K] [CompleteSpace K] : IsReflexive K

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.linearBlock_reflexive
statement: lemma linearBlock_reflexive (n : ℕ) : IsReflexive (LinearBlock n)

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.linearOuter_reflexive
statement: theorem linearOuter_reflexive : IsReflexive LinearOuter

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.reflexive_equiv
statement: lemma reflexive_equiv (e : E ≃L[ℝ] H) (hH : IsReflexive H) : IsReflexive E

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.coordinate_le_quadraticBlockCost
statement:
lemma coordinate_le_quadraticBlockCost {n : ℕ} (x : TreeHilbert n) (s : Tree n) :
    |x s| ≤ Real.sqrt 2 * quadraticBlockCost n x

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.dot_two_le_sqrt
statement:
lemma dot_two_le_sqrt (a b c d : ℝ) :
    a*c + b*d ≤ Real.sqrt (a^2+b^2) * Real.sqrt (c^2+d^2)

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.norm_QuadraticBlock
statement: @[simp] lemma norm_QuadraticBlock (n : ℕ) (x : QuadraticBlock n) : ‖x‖ = quadraticBlockCost n x

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.norm_le_mul_quadraticCost
OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.pairCost_add_le
statement:
lemma pairCost_add_le (h k : H) (μ ν : M) :
    pairCost (h+k) (μ+ν) ≤ pairCost h μ + pairCost k ν

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.pairCost_eq_norm
statement:
lemma pairCost_eq_norm {H M : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [NormedSpace ℝ H]
    [NormedAddCommGroup M] [NormedSpace ℝ M] (h : H) (μ : M) :
    pairCost h μ = ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (h, μ)‖

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.pairCost_smul
statement:
lemma pairCost_smul (a : ℝ) (h : H) (μ : M) :
    pairCost (a • h) (a • μ) = ‖a‖ * pairCost h μ

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.pairCost_zero_left
statement:
@[simp] lemma pairCost_zero_left {H M : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [NormedSpace ℝ H]
    [NormedAddCommGroup M] [NormedSpace ℝ M] (μ : M) : pairCost (0 : H) μ = ‖μ‖

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.pairCost_zero_right
statement:
@[simp] lemma pairCost_zero_right {H M : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [NormedSpace ℝ H]
    [NormedAddCommGroup M] [NormedSpace ℝ M] (h : H) : pairCost h (0 : M) = ‖h‖

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.pathBound_nonneg
statement: lemma pathBound_nonneg {n : ℕ} (f : TreeHilbert n) : 0 ≤ pathBound f

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.pathBound_single
statement: lemma pathBound_single {n : ℕ} (s : Tree n) : pathBound (lp.single 2 s (1 : ℝ)) = 1

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.path_le_pathBound
statement:
lemma path_le_pathBound {n : ℕ} (f : TreeHilbert n) (s : Tree n) :
    |pathPotential f s| ≤ pathBound f

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.quadraticBlockCost_abs_eval_scaled
statement:
lemma quadraticBlockCost_abs_eval_scaled {n : ℕ} (f x : TreeHilbert n) :
    |inner ℝ f x| ≤ quadraticPolar n f * quadraticBlockCost n x

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.quadraticBlockCost_comparison
statement:
theorem quadraticBlockCost_comparison (n : ℕ) (x : TreeHilbert n) :
    ‖x‖ / Real.sqrt (n+2) ≤ quadraticBlockCost n x ∧ quadraticBlockCost n x ≤ ‖x‖

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.quadraticBlockCost_duality
OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.quadraticBlockCost_norming
statement:
lemma quadraticBlockCost_norming (n : ℕ) (x : TreeHilbert n) :
    ∃ f : TreeHilbert n, quadraticPolar n f ≤ 1 ∧ inner ℝ f x = quadraticBlockCost n x

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.quadraticBlockCost_single_bounds
statement:
lemma quadraticBlockCost_single_bounds {n : ℕ} (s : Tree n) :
    1 / Real.sqrt 2 ≤ quadraticBlockCost n (lp.single 2 s (1 : ℝ)) ∧
    quadraticBlockCost n (lp.single 2 s (1 : ℝ)) ≤ 1

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.quadraticBlock_reflexive
statement: lemma quadraticBlock_reflexive (n : ℕ) : IsReflexive (QuadraticBlock n)

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.quadraticCost_add_le
statement:
lemma quadraticCost_add_le (B : M →L[ℝ] H) (x y : H) :
    quadraticCost B (x+y) ≤ quadraticCost B x + quadraticCost B y

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.quadraticCost_bddBelow
statement:
lemma quadraticCost_bddBelow (B : M →L[ℝ] H) (x : H) :
    BddBelow (range fun μ : M => pairCost (x - B μ) μ)

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.quadraticCost_exists_norming
statement:
lemma quadraticCost_exists_norming (B : M →L[ℝ] H) (x : H) :
    ∃ φ : H →L[ℝ] ℝ, ‖φ‖ ≤ 1 ∧ φ x = quadraticCost B x ∧
      ∀ z : H, |φ z| ≤ quadraticCost B z

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.quadraticCost_le
statement:
lemma quadraticCost_le (B : M →L[ℝ] H) (x : H) (μ : M) :
    quadraticCost B x ≤ pairCost (x - B μ) μ

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.quadraticCost_le_norm
statement: lemma quadraticCost_le_norm (B : M →L[ℝ] H) (x : H) : quadraticCost B x ≤ ‖x‖

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.quadraticCost_nonneg
statement: lemma quadraticCost_nonneg (B : M →L[ℝ] H) (x : H) : 0 ≤ quadraticCost B x

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.quadraticCost_representation_le
statement:
lemma quadraticCost_representation_le (B : M →L[ℝ] H) (h : H) (μ : M) :
    quadraticCost B (h + B μ) ≤ pairCost h μ

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.quadraticCost_smul_le
statement:
lemma quadraticCost_smul_le (B : M →L[ℝ] H) (a : ℝ) (x : H) :
    quadraticCost B (a • x) ≤ ‖a‖ * quadraticCost B x

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.quadraticCost_synthesis_le
statement:
lemma quadraticCost_synthesis_le (B : M →L[ℝ] H) (μ : M) :
    quadraticCost B (B μ) ≤ ‖μ‖

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.quadraticCost_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma quadraticCost_zero (B : M →L[ℝ] H) : quadraticCost B 0 = 0

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.quadraticOuter_reflexive
statement: theorem quadraticOuter_reflexive : IsReflexive QuadraticOuter

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.quadraticPolar_le_iff
statement:
lemma quadraticPolar_le_iff {n : ℕ} (f : TreeHilbert n) {C : ℝ} (hC : 0 ≤ C) :
    quadraticPolar n f ≤ C ↔ ∀ s, ‖f‖^2 + (pathPotential f s)^2 ≤ C^2

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.quadraticPolar_nonneg
statement: lemma quadraticPolar_nonneg {n : ℕ} (f : TreeHilbert n) : 0 ≤ quadraticPolar n f

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.quadraticPolar_single
statement:
lemma quadraticPolar_single {n : ℕ} (s : Tree n) :
    quadraticPolar n (lp.single 2 s (1 : ℝ)) = Real.sqrt 2

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.quadraticPolar_sq
statement:
lemma quadraticPolar_sq {n : ℕ} (f : TreeHilbert n) :
    (quadraticPolar n f)^2 = ‖f‖^2 + (pathBound f)^2

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.bounded_tree_modulus_eq_zero_le
statement:
theorem bounded_tree_modulus_eq_zero_le
    (p : (h : ℕ) → Tree h → E) {m M c t : ℝ}
    (hm : 0 < m) (hmM : m ≤ M) (hc : 0 < c)
    (hbound : ∀ h, 1 ≤ h → ∀ s : Tree h, m ≤ ‖p h s‖ ∧ ‖p h s‖ ≤ M)
    (hweak : ∀ h, 1 ≤ h → ∀ (s : Tree h) (hs : s.val.length < h),
      WeaklyNull (fun n => p h (child s hs n) - p h s))
    (hinc : ∀ h, 1 ≤ h → ∀ (s : Tree h) (hs : s.val.length < h) (n : ℕ),
      c ≤ ‖p h (child s hs n) - p h s‖)
    (ht : 0 < t) (htM : t*M ≤ c) :
    oneSidedModulus E t = 0

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.oneSided_growth_boundary
statement:
lemma oneSided_growth_boundary {t γ c : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) (hγ : 0 < γ)
    (hδ : (γ : EReal) < oneSidedModulus E t) (p : E) (hp : 0 < ‖p‖)
    (htp : t * ‖p‖ ≤ c) (d : ℕ → E) (hd : WeaklyNull d)
    (hdn : ∀ n, c ≤ ‖d n‖) :
    ∃ n, ‖p‖ + γ * ‖p‖ / 2 ≤ ‖p + d n‖

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.prefix_child_iff
statement:
lemma prefix_child_iff (r s : List ℕ) (j : ℕ) :
    r <+: s ++ [j] ↔ r <+: s ∨ r = s ++ [j]

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.raiseTree_child
statement:
lemma raiseTree_child {h : ℕ} (s : Tree h) (hs : s.val.length < h) (j : ℕ) :
    raiseTree (child s hs j) = child (raiseTree s) (by simp only [raiseTree]; omega) j

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.single_sequence_weaklyNull
statement:
lemma single_sequence_weaklyNull {I : Type*} [DecidableEq I] (v : ℕ → I) (hv : Function.Injective v) :
    WeaklyNull (fun j => (lp.single 2 (v j) (1 : ℝ) : lp (fun _ : I => ℝ) 2))

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.subspace_radial_adjustment
statement:
lemma subspace_radial_adjustment (F : Submodule ℝ E) {d w : E} (hw : w ∈ F)
    {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (hrd : r ≤ ‖d‖) (he : ‖d-w‖ < r) :
    ∃ u : E, u ∈ F ∧ r ≤ ‖u‖ ∧ ‖d-u‖ ≤ 2*‖d-w‖

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.BlockCalculus.disk_sup_bound
statement:
lemma disk_sup_bound {A B C : ℝ} (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (h : ∀ a b : ℝ, 0 ≤ a → 0 ≤ b → a^2+b^2 ≤ 1 → a*A+b*B ≤ C) :
    Real.sqrt (A^2+B^2) ≤ C

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.BlockCalculus.dominatedHilbert_norm_le
statement:
lemma dominatedHilbert_norm_le {n : ℕ} (f : TreeHilbert n) (g : Tree n → ℝ)
    (hg : ∀ s, |g s| ≤ |f s|) : ‖dominatedHilbert f g hg‖ ≤ ‖f‖

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.BlockCalculus.ellipse_sup_bound
statement:
lemma ellipse_sup_bound {A B C : ℝ} (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (h : ∀ a b : ℝ, 0 ≤ a → 0 ≤ b → a^2+4*b^2 ≤ 1 → a*A+(b/2)*B ≤ C) :
    Real.sqrt (A^2+B^2/16) ≤ C

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.BlockCalculus.extendCoeff_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma extendCoeff_apply {n : ℕ} (f : TreeHilbert n) (s : Tree n) :
    extendCoeff f s.val = f s

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.BlockCalculus.extendCoeff_head_support
statement:
lemma extendCoeff_head_support {n : ℕ} {D : Set Node} {h : TreeHilbert n}
    (hh : head D h = h) : ∀ s, s ∉ D → extendCoeff h s = 0

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.BlockCalculus.extendCoeff_potential_bound
statement:
lemma extendCoeff_potential_bound {n : ℕ} (f : TreeHilbert n) (s : Node) :
    |potential (extendCoeff f) s| ≤ pathBound f

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.BlockCalculus.head_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma head_apply {n : ℕ} (D : Set Node) (f : TreeHilbert n) (s : Tree n) :
    head D f s = if s.val ∈ D then f s else 0

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.BlockCalculus.head_eq_iff
statement:
lemma head_eq_iff {n : ℕ} (D : Set Node) (f : TreeHilbert n) :
    head D f = f ↔ ∀ s, s.val ∉ D → f s = 0

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.BlockCalculus.head_extendCoeff
statement:
lemma head_extendCoeff {n : ℕ} (D : Set Node) (f : TreeHilbert n) :
    extendCoeff (head D f) = headPart D (extendCoeff f)

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.BlockCalculus.head_idem
statement: lemma head_idem {n : ℕ} (D : Set Node) (f : TreeHilbert n) : head D (head D f) = head D f

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.BlockCalculus.head_inner
statement:
lemma head_inner {n : ℕ} (D : Set Node) (f x : TreeHilbert n) :
    inner ℝ (head D f) x = inner ℝ f (head D x)

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.BlockCalculus.head_linearCost_le
statement:
lemma head_linearCost_le {n : ℕ} {D : Set Node} (hD : Initial D) (x : TreeHilbert n) :
    linearBlockCost n (head D x) ≤ linearBlockCost n x

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.BlockCalculus.head_linearPolar_le
statement:
lemma head_linearPolar_le {n : ℕ} {D : Set Node} (hD : Initial D) (f : TreeHilbert n) :
    linearPolar n (head D f) ≤ linearPolar n f

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.BlockCalculus.head_norm_le
statement: lemma head_norm_le {n : ℕ} (D : Set Node) (f : TreeHilbert n) : ‖head D f‖ ≤ ‖f‖

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.BlockCalculus.head_orthogonal
statement:
lemma head_orthogonal {n : ℕ} {D : Set Node} {h r : TreeHilbert n}
    (hh : head D h = h) (hr : head D r = 0) : inner ℝ h r = 0

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.BlockCalculus.head_pathBound_le
statement:
lemma head_pathBound_le {n : ℕ} {D : Set Node} (hD : Initial D) (f : TreeHilbert n) :
    pathBound (head D f) ≤ pathBound f

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.BlockCalculus.head_quadraticCost_le
statement:
lemma head_quadraticCost_le {n : ℕ} {D : Set Node} (hD : Initial D) (x : TreeHilbert n) :
    quadraticBlockCost n (head D x) ≤ quadraticBlockCost n x

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.BlockCalculus.head_quadraticPolar_le
statement:
lemma head_quadraticPolar_le {n : ℕ} {D : Set Node} (hD : Initial D) (f : TreeHilbert n) :
    quadraticPolar n (head D f) ≤ quadraticPolar n f

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.BlockCalculus.inwardOne_head
statement:
lemma inwardOne_head {n : ℕ} {D : Set Node} (hD : Initial D) (h g : TreeHilbert n)

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.BlockCalculus.inwardOne_norm
statement:
lemma inwardOne_norm {n : ℕ} {D : Set Node} (hD : Initial D) (h g : TreeHilbert n)
    (hh : head D h = h) : ‖inwardOne hD h g hh‖ ≤ ‖g‖

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.BlockCalculus.inwardOne_piece
statement:
lemma inwardOne_piece {n : ℕ} {D : Set Node} (hD : Initial D) (h g : TreeHilbert n)

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.BlockCalculus.inwardOne_potential
statement:
lemma inwardOne_potential {n : ℕ} {D : Set Node} (hD : Initial D) (h g : TreeHilbert n)
    (hh : head D h = h) (s : Tree n) :
    pathPotential (inwardOne hD h g hh) s =
      TreeCalculus.inwardPotentialOne D (extendCoeff h) (extendCoeff g) s.val

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.BlockCalculus.inwardTwo_head
statement:
lemma inwardTwo_head {n : ℕ} {D : Set Node} (hD : Initial D) (h g : TreeHilbert n)
    (hh : head D h = h) : head D (inwardTwo hD h g hh) = 0

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.BlockCalculus.inwardTwo_norm
statement:
lemma inwardTwo_norm {n : ℕ} {D : Set Node} (hD : Initial D) (h g : TreeHilbert n)
    (hh : head D h = h) : ‖inwardTwo hD h g hh‖ ≤ ‖g‖

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.BlockCalculus.inwardTwo_piece
statement:
lemma inwardTwo_piece {n : ℕ} {D : Set Node} (hD : Initial D) (h g : TreeHilbert n)
    (hh : head D h = h) : InwardPiece D h g (inwardTwo hD h g hh)

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.BlockCalculus.inwardTwo_potential
statement:
lemma inwardTwo_potential {n : ℕ} {D : Set Node} (hD : Initial D) (h g : TreeHilbert n)
    (hh : head D h = h) (s : Tree n) :
    pathPotential (inwardTwo hD h g hh) s =
      TreeCalculus.inwardPotentialTwo D (extendCoeff h) (extendCoeff g) s.val

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.BlockCalculus.inward_difference
statement:
lemma inward_difference {n : ℕ} {D : Set Node} (hD : Initial D) (h g : TreeHilbert n)
    (hh : head D h = h) : inwardOne hD h g hh - inwardTwo hD h g hh = g-head D g

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.BlockCalculus.linearBlockCost_norming
statement:
lemma linearBlockCost_norming (n : ℕ) (x : TreeHilbert n) :
    ∃ f : TreeHilbert n, linearPolar n f ≤ 1 ∧ inner ℝ f x = linearBlockCost n x

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.BlockCalculus.linear_midpoint_tail
statement:
theorem linear_midpoint_tail {n : ℕ} {D : Set Node} (hD : Initial D) (x y : TreeHilbert n)
    (hx : head D x = x) :
    Real.sqrt ((linearBlockCost n x)^2+(linearBlockCost n (y-head D y))^2/16) ≤
      (linearBlockCost n (x+y)+linearBlockCost n (x-y))/2

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.BlockCalculus.linear_paired
statement:
theorem linear_paired {n : ℕ} {D : Set Node} (hD : Initial D) (x y : TreeHilbert n)
    (hx : head D x = x) {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hab : a^2+4*b^2 ≤ 1) :
    a*linearBlockCost n x+(b/2)*linearBlockCost n (y-head D y) ≤
      (linearBlockCost n (x+y)+linearBlockCost n (x-y))/2

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.BlockCalculus.linear_paired_unit
statement:
theorem linear_paired_unit {n : ℕ} {D : Set Node} (hD : Initial D) (x y : TreeHilbert n)
    (hx : head D x = x) {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (ha1 : a ≤ 1) (hb : 0 ≤ b)
    (hb1 : b ≤ 1/2) (hab : a^2+b^2 ≤ 1) :
    a*linearBlockCost n x+(b/2)*linearBlockCost n (y-head D y) ≤
      (linearBlockCost n (x+y)+linearBlockCost n (x-y))/2

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.BlockCalculus.pathPotential_child
statement:
lemma pathPotential_child {n : ℕ} (f : TreeHilbert n) (s : Tree n)
    (hs : s.val.length < n) (j : ℕ) :
    pathPotential f (child s hs j) = pathPotential f s + f (child s hs j)

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.BlockCalculus.pathPotential_root
statement: lemma pathPotential_root {n : ℕ} (f : TreeHilbert n) : pathPotential f (root n) = f (root n)

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.BlockCalculus.potential_congr_on_prefix
statement:
lemma potential_congr_on_prefix (f g : Node → ℝ) (s : Node)
    (h : ∀ r, r <+: s → f r = g r) : potential f s = potential g s

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.BlockCalculus.potential_extendCoeff
statement:
lemma potential_extendCoeff {n : ℕ} (f : TreeHilbert n) (s : Tree n) :
    potential (extendCoeff f) s.val = pathPotential f s

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.BlockCalculus.quadratic_eval_le
statement:
lemma quadratic_eval_le {n : ℕ} {f : TreeHilbert n} (hf : quadraticPolar n f ≤ 1)
    (x : TreeHilbert n) : inner ℝ f x ≤ quadraticBlockCost n x

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.BlockCalculus.quadratic_midpoint_tail
statement:
theorem quadratic_midpoint_tail {n : ℕ} {D : Set Node} (hD : Initial D) (x y : TreeHilbert n)
    (hx : head D x = x) :
    Real.sqrt ((quadraticBlockCost n x)^2+(quadraticBlockCost n (y-head D y))^2/16) ≤
      (quadraticBlockCost n (x+y)+quadraticBlockCost n (x-y))/2

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.BlockCalculus.quadratic_paired
statement:
theorem quadratic_paired {n : ℕ} {D : Set Node} (hD : Initial D) (x y : TreeHilbert n)
    (hx : head D x = x) {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hab : a^2+4*b^2 ≤ 1) :
    a*quadraticBlockCost n x+(b/2)*quadraticBlockCost n (y-head D y) ≤
      (quadraticBlockCost n (x+y)+quadraticBlockCost n (x-y))/2

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.lp_hasSum_sq
statement:
lemma lp_hasSum_sq {I : Type*} {E : I → Type*} [∀ i, NormedAddCommGroup (E i)]
    [∀ i, NormedSpace ℝ (E i)] (x : HilbertSum E) :
    HasSum (fun i => ‖x i‖^2) (‖x‖^2)

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.lp_midpoint_sq
statement:
lemma lp_midpoint_sq (x z u v : HilbertSum E)
    (h : ∀ i, ‖x i‖^2+‖z i‖^2/16 ≤ ((‖u i‖+‖v i‖)/2)^2) :
    ‖x‖^2+‖z‖^2/16 ≤ ((‖u‖+‖v‖)/2)^2

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Dyadic.average_add
statement:
lemma average_add (k : ℕ) (f g : List Bool → ℝ) :
    average k (fun w => f w+g w) = average k f+average k g

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Dyadic.average_congr
statement:
lemma average_congr {k : ℕ} {f g : List Bool → ℝ} (h : ∀ w, w.length = k → f w = g w) :
    average k f = average k g

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Dyadic.average_const
statement: lemma average_const (k : ℕ) (c : ℝ) : average k (fun _ => c) = c

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Dyadic.average_mono
statement:
lemma average_mono {k : ℕ} {f g : List Bool → ℝ} (h : ∀ w, w.length = k → f w ≤ g w) :
    average k f ≤ average k g

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Dyadic.average_mul
statement:
lemma average_mul (k : ℕ) (c : ℝ) (f : List Bool → ℝ) :
    average k (fun w => c*f w) = c*average k f

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Dyadic.average_nonneg
statement:
lemma average_nonneg {k : ℕ} {f : List Bool → ℝ} (h : ∀ w, w.length = k → 0 ≤ f w) :
    0 ≤ average k f

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Dyadic.average_sub
statement:
lemma average_sub (k : ℕ) (f g : List Bool → ℝ) :
    average k (fun w => f w-g w) = average k f-average k g

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Dyadic.average_succ
statement:
lemma average_succ (k : ℕ) (f : List Bool → ℝ) :
    average (k+1) f = average k (fun w => (f (false::w)+f (true::w))/2)

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Dyadic.average_zero
statement: lemma average_zero (f : List Bool → ℝ) : average 0 f = f []

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Dyadic.endpoints
statement:
lemma endpoints {E : Type*} [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℝ E]
    {m : ℕ} {W : List Bool → E} (hW : IsMartingale m W) (w : List Bool) (hw : w.length < m) :
    W w+(1/2 : ℝ) • (W (false::w)-W (true::w)) = W (false::w) ∧
    W w-(1/2 : ℝ) • (W (false::w)-W (true::w)) = W (true::w)

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Dyadic.mem_histories
statement: lemma mem_histories {k : ℕ} {w : List Bool} : w ∈ histories k ↔ w.length = k

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Dyadic.telescope
statement:
lemma telescope {m : ℕ} {v e : List Bool → ℝ} (hv : ∀ w, 0 ≤ v w)
    (he : ∀ w, w.length < m → (e (false::w)+e (true::w))/2 ≤
      16*((v (false::w)+v (true::w))/2-v w)) :
    (∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, average (i+1) e) ≤ 16*average m v

OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.BlockCalculus.InwardPiece.linear_le_two

statement:
lemma head_nested {n : ℕ} {A D : Set Node} (hAD : A ⊆ D) (x : TreeHilbert n) :

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.BlockCalculus.linear_leakage_step
statement:
theorem linear_leakage_step {n : ℕ} {D : Set Node} (hD : Initial D)
    (x y : TreeHilbert n) :
    ((linearBlockCost n ((x+y)-head D (x+y)))^2+
      (linearBlockCost n ((x-y)-head D (x-y)))^2)/2 ≤
      50*(linearBlockCost n (x-head D x))^2+
      32*(((linearBlockCost n (x+y))^2+(linearBlockCost n (x-y))^2)/2-
        (linearBlockCost n (head D x))^2)

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.BlockCalculus.linear_paired_leak
statement:
theorem linear_paired_leak {n : ℕ} {D : Set Node} (hD : Initial D)
    (x y : TreeHilbert n) {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hab : a^2+4*b^2 ≤ 1) :
    a*linearBlockCost n (head D x)+(b/2)*linearBlockCost n (y-head D y) ≤
      (linearBlockCost n (x+y)+linearBlockCost n (x-y))/2 +
        2*b*linearBlockCost n (x-head D x)

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.leakage_energy_scalar
statement:
lemma leakage_energy_scalar {r l q c d u v : ℝ}
    (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hl : 0 ≤ l) (hq : 0 ≤ q) (hc : 0 ≤ c) (hd : 0 ≤ d)
    (hu : 0 ≤ u) (hv : 0 ≤ v) (hup : u ≤ l+q) (hvp : v ≤ l+q)
    (h : ∀ a b : ℝ, 0 ≤ a → 0 ≤ b → a^2+4*b^2 ≤ 1 →
      a*r+(b/2)*q ≤ (c+d)/2+2*b*l) :
    (u^2+v^2)/2 ≤ 50*l^2+32*((c^2+d^2)/2-r^2)

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.Atom.coeff_bound

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.Atom.defect
statement:
lemma defect (A : Atom) {g : Node → ℝ} (hg : IsUnitTest g) :
    0 ≤ 1-A.pairing g ∧
    (∑ S ∈ A.family, (A.coeff S-S.eval g)^2) ≤ 2*(1-A.pairing g) ∧
    1-(∑ S ∈ A.family, (S.eval g)^2) ≤ 2*(1-A.pairing g)

    (hopposite : ∀ S ∈ F, S.eval g*c S ≤ 0) :

lemma unit_head {C : Set Node} (hC : Initial C) {g : Node → ℝ} (hg : IsUnitTest g) :
    IsUnitTest (C.indicator g)

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.unit_subsegment_family
statement:
lemma unit_subsegment_family {g : Node → ℝ} (hg : IsUnitTest g)
    {F : Finset Segment} (hF : Incomparable F)
    (R : Segment → Segment) (hR : ∀ S ∈ F, (R S).start ∈ S.nodes) :
    (∑ S ∈ F, ((R S).eval g)^2) ≤ 1

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.unit_tail
statement:
lemma unit_tail {C : Set Node} (hC : Initial C) {g : Node → ℝ} (hg : IsUnitTest g) :
    IsUnitTest (Cᶜ.indicator g)

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.unsigned_energy_bound
statement:
lemma unsigned_energy_bound (p : I → ℝ) (hp : ∀ i, 0 ≤ p i) (hp1 : ∑ i, p i=1)
    (r : I → Q → ℝ) (d : I → ℝ)
    (hc : ∀ i j, (∑ q, oppositeProduct (r i q) (r j q)) ≤ d i+d j) :
    (∑ q, (∑ i, p i*|r i q|)^2) ≤
      (∑ q, (∑ i, p i*r i q)^2)+4*(∑ i, p i*d i)

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.unsigned_energy_identity
statement:
lemma unsigned_energy_identity (p : I → ℝ) (r : I → Q → ℝ) :
    (∑ q, (∑ i, p i*|r i q|)^2)-(∑ q, (∑ i, p i*r i q)^2) =
      2*(∑ i, ∑ j, p i*p j*(∑ q, oppositeProduct (r i q) (r j q)))

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.weighted_sqrt_bound
statement:
lemma weighted_sqrt_bound (p : I → ℝ) (hp : ∀ i, 0 ≤ p i) (hp1 : ∑ i, p i=1)
    (d : I → ℝ) (hd : ∀ i, 0 ≤ d i) :
    (∑ i, p i*Real.sqrt (d i)) ≤ Real.sqrt (∑ i, p i*d i)

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.Atom.cancellation
statement:
theorem cancellation {C : Set Node} (hC : Initial C) {g : Node → ℝ}
    (hg : IsUnitTest g) (hsupp : ∀ v ∉ C, g v=0) (A B : Atom) (Q : Finset Node)
    (hQ : ∀ q ∈ Q, IsExit C q) :
    (∑ q ∈ Q, oppositeProduct (A.exitCoeff g q) (B.exitCoeff g q)) ≤
      (1-A.pairing g)+(1-B.pairing g)

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.Atom.early_cancellation
statement:
lemma early_cancellation {C : Set Node} (hC : Initial C) {g : Node → ℝ}
    (hg : IsUnitTest g) (hsupp : ∀ v ∉ C, g v=0) (A B : Atom) (Q : Finset Node)
    (hQ : ∀ q ∈ Q, IsExit C q)
    (hop : ∀ q ∈ Q, A.exitCoeff g q*B.exitCoeff g q < 0)
    (hearly : ∀ q ∈ Q, Prefix (A.original q).start (B.original q).start ∧
      (A.original q).start ≠ (B.original q).start) :
    2*(∑ q ∈ Q, |A.exitCoeff g q*B.exitCoeff g q|) ≤
      1-(∑ S ∈ A.family, (S.eval g)^2)

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.Atom.exitCoeff_eq
statement:
lemma exitCoeff_eq (A : Atom) (g : Node → ℝ) {S : Segment} (hS : S ∈ A.family) {q : Node}
    (hq : q ∈ S.nodes) : A.exitCoeff g q=S.eval g

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.Atom.exitCoeff_ne_zero
statement:
lemma exitCoeff_ne_zero (A : Atom) {g : Node → ℝ} {q : Node} (hq : A.exitCoeff g q ≠ 0) :
    A.sees q

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.Atom.opposite_starts
statement:
lemma opposite_starts {C : Set Node} (hC : Initial C) {g : Node → ℝ}
    (hsupp : ∀ v ∉ C, g v=0) (A B : Atom) {q : Node} (hq : IsExit C q)
    (hop : A.exitCoeff g q*B.exitCoeff g q < 0) :
    (Prefix (A.original q).start (B.original q).start ∨
      Prefix (B.original q).start (A.original q).start) ∧
    (A.original q).start ≠ (B.original q).start

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.Atom.original_eq
statement:
lemma original_eq (A : Atom) {S : Segment} (hS : S ∈ A.family) {q : Node}
    (hq : q ∈ S.nodes) : A.original q=S

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.Atom.original_injective
OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.Atom.original_spec
statement:
lemma original_spec (A : Atom) {q : Node} (hq : A.sees q) :
    A.original q ∈ A.family ∧ q ∈ (A.original q).nodes

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.finitePairing_filter
statement:
lemma finitePairing_filter (C : Set Node) [DecidablePred (fun v => v ∈ C)] (g : Node → ℝ) (z : Node →₀ ℝ) :
    finitePairing g (Finsupp.filter (fun v => v ∈ C) z) = finitePairing (C.indicator g) z

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.finitePairing_filter_finset
statement:
lemma finitePairing_filter_finset (E : Finset Node) (g : Node → ℝ) (z : Node →₀ ℝ) :
    finitePairing g (Finsupp.filter (fun v => v ∈ E) z)=finitePairing ((E : Set Node).indicator g) z

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.finitePairing_tail
statement:
lemma finitePairing_tail (C : Set Node) [DecidablePred (fun v => v ∈ C)] (g : Node → ℝ) (z : Node →₀ ℝ) :
    finitePairing g (z-Finsupp.filter (fun v => v ∈ C) z) = finitePairing (Cᶜ.indicator g) z

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.finitePairing_tail_finset
statement:
lemma finitePairing_tail_finset (E : Finset Node) (g : Node → ℝ) (z : Node →₀ ℝ) :
    finitePairing g (z-Finsupp.filter (fun v => v ∈ E) z)=finitePairing ((E : Set Node)ᶜ.indicator g) z

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.shortening_injective
statement:
lemma shortening_injective {Q : Type*} (qset : Finset Q)
    {g : Node → ℝ} (hg : IsUnitTest g) {F : Finset Segment} (hF : Incomparable F)
    (D : Q → Segment) (b : Q → ℝ)
    (hD : ∀ q ∈ qset, D q ∈ F) (hinj : Set.InjOn D (qset : Set Q))
    (hsign : ∀ q ∈ qset, (D q).eval g*b q ≤ 0)
    (hshort : ∀ q ∈ qset, ∃ R : Segment, R.start=(D q).start ∧
      R.eval g=(D q).eval g-b q) :
    2*(∑ q ∈ qset, |(D q).eval g*b q|) ≤ 1-(∑ S ∈ F, (S.eval g)^2)

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.norm_weighted_signed_sum
statement:
lemma norm_weighted_signed_sum {V : Type*} [SeminormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V]
    (p σ : I → ℝ) (Z : I → V) (hp : ∀ i, 0 ≤ p i) (hσ : ∀ i, |σ i| ≤ 1) :
    ‖∑ i, (p i*σ i) • Z i‖ ≤ ∑ i, p i*‖Z i‖

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.Atom.component_pairing
statement:
lemma component_pairing (A : Atom) (n : ℕ) (g : Node →₀ ℝ) :
    (A.component n).pairing g=A.pairing (componentPart n g)

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.Atom.pairing_sq_le_energy
statement:
lemma pairing_sq_le_energy (A : Atom) (g : Node → ℝ) :
    (A.pairing g)^2 ≤ ∑ S ∈ A.family,(S.eval g)^2

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.Incomparable.subset
statement: lemma Incomparable.subset {F G : Finset Segment} (hG : Incomparable G) (hFG : F ⊆ G) : Incomparable F

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.Segment.eval_component
statement:
lemma Segment.eval_component (S : Segment) (n : ℕ) (g : Node →₀ ℝ) :
    S.eval (componentPart n g)=if S.start.1=n then S.eval g else 0

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.componentNorm
statement:
lemma componentNorm (n : ℕ) (g : Node →₀ ℝ) :
    testNorm atomTests (componentPart n g)=testNorm (blockTests n) (componentSlice n g)

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.componentPart_apply
statement:
lemma componentPart_apply (n : ℕ) (g : Node →₀ ℝ) (v : Node) :
    componentPart n g v=if v.1=n then g v else 0

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.componentPart_eq
statement:
lemma componentPart_eq (n : ℕ) (g : Node →₀ ℝ) :
    componentPart n g=Finsupp.embDomain (componentEmbedding n) (componentSlice n g)

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.component_atom_pairings_sq
statement:
lemma component_atom_pairings_sq (g : Node →₀ ℝ) (H : Finset ℕ) (A : ℕ → Atom) :
    (∑ n ∈ H, ((A n).pairing (componentPart n g))^2) ≤ (testNorm atomTests g)^2

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.component_families_disjoint
statement:
lemma component_families_disjoint (H : Finset ℕ) (F : ℕ → Finset Segment)
    (hc : ∀ n ∈ H, ∀ S ∈ F n, S.start.1=n) : (H : Set ℕ).PairwiseDisjoint F

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.component_families_incomparable
statement:
lemma component_families_incomparable (H : Finset ℕ) (F : ℕ → Finset Segment)
    (hF : ∀ n ∈ H, Incomparable (F n)) (hc : ∀ n ∈ H, ∀ S ∈ F n, S.start.1=n) :
    Incomparable (H.biUnion F)

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.component_family_energy
statement:
lemma component_family_energy (g : Node →₀ ℝ) (n : ℕ) (F : Finset Segment) (hF : Incomparable F) :
    (∑ S ∈ F.filter (fun S => S.start.1=n), (S.eval g)^2) ≤
      (testNorm atomTests (componentPart n g))^2

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.component_family_energy_sum
statement:
lemma component_family_energy_sum (g : Node →₀ ℝ) (H : Finset ℕ) (F : ℕ → Finset Segment)
    (hF : ∀ n ∈ H, Incomparable (F n)) (hc : ∀ n ∈ H, ∀ S ∈ F n, S.start.1=n) :
    (∑ n ∈ H, ∑ S ∈ F n, (S.eval g)^2) ≤ (testNorm atomTests g)^2

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.components_norm_sq_le_predual
statement:
lemma components_norm_sq_le_predual (g : Node →₀ ℝ) (H : Finset ℕ) :
    (∑ n ∈ H, (testNorm atomTests (componentPart n g))^2) ≤ (testNorm atomTests g)^2

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.eval_zero_outside_components
statement:
lemma eval_zero_outside_components (g : Node →₀ ℝ) (H : Finset ℕ) (hg : ∀ v ∈ g.support, v.1 ∈ H)
    (S : Segment) (hS : S.start.1 ∉ H) : S.eval g=0

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.exists_atom_near_norm
statement:
lemma exists_atom_near_norm (g : Node →₀ ℝ) {e : ℝ} (he : 0 < e) :
    ∃ A : Atom, testNorm atomTests g-e < |A.pairing g|

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.mem_componentSupport
statement: lemma mem_componentSupport (g : Node →₀ ℝ) (v : Node) (hv : v ∈ g.support) : v.1 ∈ componentSupport g

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.predual_components_norm_sq
statement:
theorem predual_components_norm_sq (g : Node →₀ ℝ) (H : Finset ℕ)
    (hg : ∀ v ∈ g.support, v.1 ∈ H) :
    (testNorm atomTests g)^2=∑ n ∈ H, (testNorm (blockTests n) (componentSlice n g))^2

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.predual_family_energy
statement:
lemma predual_family_energy (g : Node →₀ ℝ) (F : Finset Segment) (hF : Incomparable F) :
    (∑ S ∈ F, (S.eval g)^2) ≤ (testNorm atomTests g)^2

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.predual_norm_le_of_energy
statement:
lemma predual_norm_le_of_energy (g : Node →₀ ℝ) {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    (h : ∀ F : Finset Segment, Incomparable F → (∑ S ∈ F,(S.eval g)^2) ≤ R^2) :
    testNorm atomTests g ≤ R

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.predual_norm_sq_le_components
statement:
lemma predual_norm_sq_le_components (g : Node →₀ ℝ) (H : Finset ℕ)
    (hg : ∀ v ∈ g.support, v.1 ∈ H) :
    (testNorm atomTests g)^2 ≤ ∑ n ∈ H, (testNorm atomTests (componentPart n g))^2

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.slice_apply
statement:
lemma slice_apply (n : ℕ) (g : Node →₀ ℝ) (v : BlockNode n) :
    componentSlice n g v=g ⟨n,v⟩

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.slice_zero_outside
statement: lemma slice_zero_outside (g : Node →₀ ℝ) {n : ℕ} (hn : n ∉ componentSupport g) : componentSlice n g=0

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.finitePairing_coeff_smul
statement:
lemma finitePairing_coeff_smul (c : ℝ) (g : Node → ℝ) (z : Node →₀ ℝ) :
    finitePairing (c • g) z=c*finitePairing g z

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.finitelyRestrict_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma finitelyRestrict_apply (E : Finset Node) (g : Node → ℝ) (v : Node) :
    finitelyRestrict E g v = if v ∈ E then g v else 0

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.initial_prefixClosure
statement: lemma initial_prefixClosure (E : Finset Node) : Initial (prefixClosure E : Set Node)

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.pairing_finitelyRestrict
statement:
lemma pairing_finitelyRestrict (E : Finset Node) (g : Node → ℝ) (z : Node →₀ ℝ)
    (hz : z.support ⊆ E) : finitePairing (finitelyRestrict E g) z=finitePairing g z

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.polar_pairing_bound
statement:
lemma polar_pairing_bound (z g : Node →₀ ℝ) :
    |finitePairing g z| ≤ testNorm unitTests z*testNorm atomTests g

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.subset_prefixClosure
statement: lemma subset_prefixClosure (E : Finset Node) : E ⊆ prefixClosure E

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.dual_reflexive
statement:
theorem dual_reflexive {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (hE : IsReflexive E) : IsReflexive (StrongDual ℝ E)

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.rootSegment_mem
statement:
lemma rootSegment_mem (h : ℕ) (s : Tree h) (v : Node) :
    v ∈ (rootSegment h s).nodes ↔ v.1=h ∧ v.2.val <+: s.val

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.segmentVector_root_child
statement:
lemma segmentVector_root_child {h : ℕ} (s : Tree h) (hs : s.val.length < h) (j : ℕ) :
    segmentVector (rootSegment h (child s hs j))=
      segmentVector (rootSegment h s)+Finsupp.single (treeNode h (child s hs j)) 1

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.treeNode_child_injective
statement:
lemma treeNode_child_injective {h : ℕ} (s : Tree h) (hs : s.val.length < h) :
    Function.Injective (fun n => treeNode h (child s hs n))

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.treeNode_child_prefix
statement:
lemma treeNode_child_prefix {h : ℕ} (s : Tree h) (hs : s.val.length < h) {i j : ℕ}
    (hp : Prefix (treeNode h (child s hs i)) (treeNode h (child s hs j))) : i=j

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.antichainMass_child
statement:
lemma antichainMass_child {n : ℕ} {m : List ℕ → ℝ≥0∞} (h : AntichainMass (n+1) m) (j : ℕ) :
    AntichainMass n (fun s => m (j::s))

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.eTwo_add
statement:
lemma eTwo_add {I : Type*} (f g : I → ℝ≥0∞) :
    eTwo (f+g) ≤ eTwo f+eTwo g

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.eTwo_component
statement: lemma eTwo_component {I : Type*} (f : I → ℝ≥0∞) (i : I) : f i ≤ eTwo f

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.eTwo_eq_iSup
statement:
lemma eTwo_eq_iSup {I : Type*} (f : I → ℝ≥0∞) :
    eTwo f=⨆ E : Finset I,(∑ i ∈ E,f i^2)^(1/2:ℝ)

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.eTwo_iSup
statement:
lemma eTwo_iSup {I J : Type*} [Preorder J] [IsDirectedOrder J]
    (f : J → I → ℝ≥0∞) (hf : Monotone f) :
    eTwo (fun i => ⨆ j,f j i)=⨆ j,eTwo (f j)

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.eTwo_inner_le
statement:
lemma eTwo_inner_le {I : Type*} (f g : I → ℝ≥0∞) :
    (∑' i,f i*g i) ≤ eTwo f*eTwo g

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.eTwo_mono
statement: lemma eTwo_mono {I : Type*} {f g : I → ℝ≥0∞} (h : ∀ i,f i ≤ g i) : eTwo f ≤ eTwo g

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.eTwo_mul
statement:
lemma eTwo_mul {I : Type*} (a : ℝ≥0∞) (f : I → ℝ≥0∞) :
    eTwo (fun i => a*f i)=a*eTwo f

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.eTwo_sq
statement: lemma eTwo_sq {I : Type*} (f : I → ℝ≥0∞) : (eTwo f)^2=∑' i,f i^2

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.eTwo_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma eTwo_zero (I : Type*) : eTwo (0 : I → ℝ≥0∞)=0

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.enn_finset_sum_iSup
statement:
lemma enn_finset_sum_iSup {I J : Type*} [Preorder J] [IsDirectedOrder J]
    (E : Finset I) (f : J → I → ℝ≥0∞) (hf : Monotone f) :
    (∑ i ∈ E,⨆ j,f j i)=⨆ j,∑ i ∈ E,f j i

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.enn_positive_energy_scalar
statement:
lemma enn_positive_energy_scalar (a b A B C : ℝ≥0∞)
    (hA : A ≤ C) (hB : B ≤ C) (hs : A^2+B^2 ≤ C^2) :
    (a+A)^2+(b+B)^2 ≤ (a+b+C)^2

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.enn_sq_iSup
statement: lemma enn_sq_iSup {I : Type*} (f : I → ℝ≥0∞) : (⨆ i,f i)^2=⨆ i,(f i)^2

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.enn_sqrt_iSup
statement:
lemma enn_sqrt_iSup {I : Type*} (f : I → ℝ≥0∞) :
    (⨆ i,f i)^(1/2:ℝ)=⨆ i,(f i)^(1/2:ℝ)

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.enn_sum_iSup_le
statement:
lemma enn_sum_iSup_le {I : Type*} {J : I → Type*} [∀ i, Nonempty (J i)]
    (E : Finset I) (f : (i : I) → J i → ℝ≥0∞) {c : ℝ≥0∞}
    (h : ∀ a : (i : I) → J i, (∑ i ∈ E,f i (a i)) ≤ c) :
    (∑ i ∈ E,⨆ j,f i j) ≤ c

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.enn_tsum_iSup
statement:
lemma enn_tsum_iSup {I J : Type*} [Preorder J] [IsDirectedOrder J]
    (f : J → I → ℝ≥0∞) (hf : Monotone f) :
    (∑' i,⨆ j,f j i)=⨆ j,∑' i,f j i

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.forestCost_add
statement: lemma forestCost_add (m r : (n : ℕ) → List ℕ → ℝ≥0∞) : forestCost (m+r) ≤ forestCost m+forestCost r

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.forestCost_antichain_sq
statement:
lemma forestCost_antichain_sq (m : (n : ℕ) → List ℕ → ℝ≥0∞)
    (hm : ∀ n,AntichainMass (n+1) (m n)) :
    (forestCost m)^2=∑' n : ℕ,treeSum (n+1) (fun s => (m n s)^2)

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.forestCost_finset_sum
statement:
lemma forestCost_finset_sum {I : Type*} (E : Finset I) (m : I → (n : ℕ) → List ℕ → ℝ≥0∞) :
    forestCost (∑ i ∈ E,m i) ≤ ∑ i ∈ E,forestCost (m i)

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.forestCost_iSup
statement:
lemma forestCost_iSup {J : Type*} [Preorder J] [IsDirectedOrder J]
    (m : J → (n : ℕ) → List ℕ → ℝ≥0∞) (hm : Monotone m) :
    forestCost (fun n s => ⨆ j,m j n s)=⨆ j,forestCost (m j)

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.forestCost_mono
statement: lemma forestCost_mono {m r : (n : ℕ) → List ℕ → ℝ≥0∞} (h : m ≤ r) : forestCost m ≤ forestCost r

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.forestCost_mul
statement:
lemma forestCost_mul (a : ℝ≥0∞) (m : (n : ℕ) → List ℕ → ℝ≥0∞) :
    forestCost (fun n s => a*m n s)=a*forestCost m

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.forestCost_node_le
statement:
lemma forestCost_node_le (m : (n : ℕ) → List ℕ → ℝ≥0∞) (n : ℕ) (s : List ℕ) (hs : s.length ≤ n+1) :
    m n s ≤ forestCost m

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.forestCost_positive_energy
statement:
lemma forestCost_positive_energy (m r : (n : ℕ) → List ℕ → ℝ≥0∞) :
    (forestCost m)^2+(forestCost r)^2 ≤ (forestCost (m+r))^2

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.forestCost_tsum
statement:
lemma forestCost_tsum {I : Type*} (m : I → (n : ℕ) → List ℕ → ℝ≥0∞) :
    forestCost (fun n s => ∑' i,m i n s) ≤ ∑' i,forestCost (m i)

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.pathMass_le_startCost
statement:
lemma pathMass_le_startCost (n : ℕ) (m : List ℕ → ℝ≥0∞) (s : List ℕ) (hs : s.length ≤ n) :
    pathMass m s ≤ startCost n m

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.startCost_add
statement:
lemma startCost_add (n : ℕ) (m r : List ℕ → ℝ≥0∞) :
    startCost n (m+r) ≤ startCost n m+startCost n r

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.startCost_antichain_sq
statement:
lemma startCost_antichain_sq (n : ℕ) (m : List ℕ → ℝ≥0∞) (hm : AntichainMass n m) :
    (startCost n m)^2=treeSum n (fun s => (m s)^2)

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.startCost_congr
statement:
lemma startCost_congr (n : ℕ) {m r : List ℕ → ℝ≥0∞}
    (h : ∀ s,s.length ≤ n → m s=r s) : startCost n m=startCost n r

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.startCost_iSup
statement:
lemma startCost_iSup {J : Type*} [Preorder J] [IsDirectedOrder J]
    (n : ℕ) (m : J → List ℕ → ℝ≥0∞) (hm : Monotone m) :
    startCost n (fun s => ⨆ j,m j s)=⨆ j,startCost n (m j)

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.startCost_mul
statement:
lemma startCost_mul (n : ℕ) (a : ℝ≥0∞) (m : List ℕ → ℝ≥0∞) :
    startCost n (fun s => a*m s)=a*startCost n m

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.startCost_node_le
statement:
lemma startCost_node_le (n : ℕ) (m : List ℕ → ℝ≥0∞) (s : List ℕ) (hs : s.length ≤ n) :
    m s ≤ startCost n m

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.startCost_positive_energy
statement:
lemma startCost_positive_energy (n : ℕ) (m r : List ℕ → ℝ≥0∞) :
    (startCost n m)^2+(startCost n r)^2 ≤ (startCost n (m+r))^2

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.treeSum_congr
statement:
lemma treeSum_congr (n : ℕ) {m r : List ℕ → ℝ≥0∞}
    (h : ∀ s,s.length ≤ n → m s=r s) : treeSum n m=treeSum n r

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.treeSum_mono
statement: lemma treeSum_mono (n : ℕ) {m r : List ℕ → ℝ≥0∞} (h : ∀ s,m s≤ r s) : treeSum n m≤ treeSum n r

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.treeSum_mul
statement:
lemma treeSum_mul (n : ℕ) (a : ℝ≥0∞) (m : List ℕ → ℝ≥0∞) :
    treeSum n (fun s => a*m s)=a*treeSum n m

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.treeSum_pair_le
statement:
lemma treeSum_pair_le (n : ℕ) (m b : List ℕ → ℝ≥0∞) (hb : IsPotential n b) :
    treeSum n (fun s => m s*b s) ≤ startCost n m*b []

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.treeSum_single
statement:
lemma treeSum_single (n : ℕ) (s : List ℕ) (hs : s.length ≤ n) (a : ℝ≥0∞) :
    treeSum n (fun t => if t=s then a else 0)=a

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.treeSum_sq_le_startCost_sq
statement:
lemma treeSum_sq_le_startCost_sq (n : ℕ) (m : List ℕ → ℝ≥0∞) :
    treeSum n (fun s => (m s)^2) ≤ (startCost n m)^2

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.treeSum_tsum
statement:
lemma treeSum_tsum {I : Type*} (n : ℕ) (m : I → List ℕ → ℝ≥0∞) :
    treeSum n (fun s => ∑' i,m i s)=∑' i,treeSum n (m i)

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.treeSum_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma treeSum_zero (n : ℕ) : treeSum n 0=0

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.branch_index_eq
statement:
lemma branch_index_eq {s u v : List ℕ} {i j : ℕ}
    (hu : s++[i] <+: u) (hv : s++[j] <+: v) (huv : u <+: v) : i=j

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.coneBudget_children
statement:
lemma coneBudget_children (g : Node → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (s : List ℕ) :
    eTwo (fun j : ℕ => coneBudget g n (s++[j])) ≤ coneBudget g n s

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.coneBudget_potential
statement:
lemma coneBudget_potential (g : Node → ℝ) (n h : ℕ) (s : List ℕ) :
    IsPotential h (fun t => coneBudget g n (s++t))

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.coneBudget_roots
statement:
lemma coneBudget_roots (g : Node → ℝ) (hg : IsUnitTest g) :
    eTwo (fun n => coneBudget g n []) ≤ 1

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.coneBudget_sq
statement:
lemma coneBudget_sq (g : Node → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (s : List ℕ) :
    (coneBudget g n s)^2=coneEnergy g n s

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.coneEnergy_children
statement:
lemma coneEnergy_children (g : Node → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (s : List ℕ) :
    (∑' j : ℕ,coneEnergy g n (s++[j])) ≤ coneEnergy g n s

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.coneEnergy_roots
statement:
lemma coneEnergy_roots (g : Node → ℝ) (hg : IsUnitTest g) :
    (∑' n : ℕ,coneEnergy g n []) ≤ 1

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.cone_children_union
statement:
lemma cone_children_union (n : ℕ) (s : List ℕ) (E : Finset ℕ)
    (F : (j : ℕ) → ConeFamily n (s++[j])) :
    Incomparable (E.biUnion (fun j => (F j).val)) ∧
    (∀ S ∈ E.biUnion (fun j => (F j).val), S.start.1=n ∧ s <+: S.start.2.val) ∧
    (E : Set ℕ).PairwiseDisjoint (fun j => (F j).val)

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.enn_sq_sqrt
statement: lemma enn_sq_sqrt (x : ℝ≥0∞) : (x^(1/2:ℝ))^2=x

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.enn_sqrt_sq
statement: lemma enn_sqrt_sq (x : ℝ≥0∞) : (x^2)^(1/2:ℝ)=x

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.forest_pair_budget_le
statement:
lemma forest_pair_budget_le (m : (n : ℕ) → List ℕ → ℝ≥0∞)
    (g : Node → ℝ) (hg : IsUnitTest g) :
    (∑' n : ℕ,treeSum (n+1) (fun s => m n s*coneBudget g n s)) ≤ forestCost m

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.layerCost_eq_norm
statement: lemma layerCost_eq_norm (n d : ℕ) (m : List ℕ → ℝ≥0∞) : startCost n (layerMass d m)=layerNorm n d m

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.layerMass_antichain
statement: lemma layerMass_antichain (n d : ℕ) (m : List ℕ → ℝ≥0∞) : AntichainMass n (layerMass d m)

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.segment_le_coneBudget
statement:
lemma segment_le_coneBudget (g : Node → ℝ) (S : Segment) :
    ENNReal.ofReal |S.eval g| ≤ coneBudget g S.start.1 S.start.2.val

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.startCost_finset_sum
statement:
lemma startCost_finset_sum {I : Type*} (n : ℕ) (E : Finset I) (m : I → List ℕ → ℝ≥0∞) :
    startCost n (∑ i ∈ E,m i)≤∑ i ∈ E,startCost n (m i)

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.startCost_hilbert_comparisons
statement:
lemma startCost_hilbert_comparisons (n : ℕ) (m : List ℕ → ℝ≥0∞) :
    (treeSum n (fun s => (m s)^2))^(1/2:ℝ)≤ startCost n m ∧
    startCost n m≤∑ d : Fin (n+1),layerNorm n d m ∧
    (∑ d : Fin (n+1),layerNorm n d m)≤
      ((n+1 : ℕ):ℝ≥0∞)^(1/2:ℝ)*(treeSum n (fun s => (m s)^2))^(1/2:ℝ)

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.startCost_le_sum_layers
statement:
lemma startCost_le_sum_layers (n : ℕ) (m : List ℕ → ℝ≥0∞) :
    startCost n m≤∑ d : Fin (n+1),layerNorm n d m

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.sum_layerNorm_sq
statement:
lemma sum_layerNorm_sq (n : ℕ) (m : List ℕ → ℝ≥0∞) :
    (∑ d : Fin (n+1),(layerNorm n d m)^2)=treeSum n (fun s => (m s)^2)

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.sum_layers
statement:
lemma sum_layers (n : ℕ) (m : List ℕ → ℝ≥0∞) (s : List ℕ) (hs : s.length≤ n) :
    (∑ d : Fin (n+1),layerMass d m s)=m s

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.sum_layers_le_hilbert
statement:
lemma sum_layers_le_hilbert (n : ℕ) (m : List ℕ → ℝ≥0∞) :
    (∑ d : Fin (n+1),layerNorm n d m)≤
      ((n+1 : ℕ):ℝ≥0∞)^(1/2:ℝ)*(treeSum n (fun s => (m s)^2))^(1/2:ℝ)

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.treeSum_fintype_sum
statement:
lemma treeSum_fintype_sum {I : Type*} [Fintype I] (n : ℕ) (m : I → List ℕ → ℝ≥0∞) :
    treeSum n (fun s => ∑ i,m i s)=∑ i,treeSum n (m i)

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.Atom.mass_antichain
statement:
lemma Atom.mass_antichain (A : Atom) (n : ℕ) :

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.Atom.representation_apply
statement:
lemma Atom.representation_apply (A : Atom) (S : Segment) :

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.Atom.start_injective

statement:
lemma forest_treeSum_startArray (w : Segment → ℝ≥0∞) (b : (n : ℕ) → List ℕ → ℝ≥0∞) :

statement:
lemma real_series_bound {I : Type*} (f : I → ℝ) {C : ℝ≥0∞} (hC : C≠∞)
    (h : (∑' i,ENNReal.ofReal |f i|) ≤ C) : Summable f ∧ |∑' i,f i| ≤ C.toReal

statement:
lemma representationCost_smul (c : ℝ) (a : Segment → ℝ) :

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.representationCost_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma representationCost_zero : representationCost 0=0

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.representation_finite_energy
statement:
lemma representation_finite_energy (a : Segment → ℝ) (g : Node →₀ ℝ) :

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.representation_series_bound
statement:
lemma representation_series_bound (a : Segment → ℝ) (ha : representationCost a≠∞) (g : Node →₀ ℝ) :
    Summable (fun S => a S*S.eval g) ∧
      |∑' S : Segment,a S*S.eval g| ≤ (representationCost a).toReal*testNorm atomTests g

lemma representation_test_energy (a : Segment → ℝ) (g : Node → ℝ) (hg : IsUnitTest g) :

      forestCost (startArray (fun S => ENNReal.ofReal |a S|))

statement:
lemma representationOutput_summable (a : Segment → ℝ) (ha : representationCost a≠∞) (v : Node) :

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.representationOutput_tsum

statement:
theorem linear_block_trimming_242 {n : ℕ} {D : Set Node} (hD : Initial D) (x y : TreeHilbert n)
    (hx : head D x=x) (hy : head D y=0) :
    (linearBlockCost n y)^2≤242*((linearBlockCost n (x+y))^2+
      (linearBlockCost n (x-y))^2-2*(linearBlockCost n x)^2)

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.incomparable_iff_nodewise

theorem incomparable_iff_nodewise (F : Finset Segment) :
    Incomparable F ↔ ∀ S ∈ F, ∀ T ∈ F, S ≠ T →
      ∀ s ∈ S.nodes, ∀ t ∈ T.nodes, ¬Prefix s t ∧ ¬Prefix t s

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.Segments.predual_finite_norm_formula

    testNorm atomTests g=⨆ F : {F : Finset Segment // Incomparable F},
      Real.sqrt (∑ S ∈ F.val,(S.eval g)^2)

OAI.Dixmier.sum_pairwise_sq
statement:
theorem sum_pairwise_sq (S : Finset I) (v : I → H) :
    ∑ i ∈ S, ∑ j ∈ S, ‖v i - v j‖ ^ 2 =
      2 * (S.card : ℝ) * (∑ i ∈ S, ‖v i‖ ^ 2) - 2 * ‖∑ i ∈ S, v i‖ ^ 2

name: OAI.Dixmier.amenable_of_approximate_means
statement:
theorem amenable_of_approximate_means
    (h : ∀ (S : Finset G) (ε : ℝ), 0 < ε →
      ∃ m : (G →ᵇ ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ,
        ‖m‖ ≤ 1 ∧ m (BoundedContinuousFunction.const G (1 : ℂ)) = 1 ∧
        (∀ b : G →ᵇ ℂ, (∀ x, 0 ≤ (b x).re ∧ (b x).im = 0) →
          0 ≤ (m b).re ∧ (m b).im = 0) ∧
        ∀ g ∈ S, ∀ b : G →ᵇ ℂ, ‖m (leftTranslate g b) - m b‖ ≤ ε * ‖b‖) :
    Amenable G
