statement:
lemma common_support (v : Pairing (A ⊕ B)) (u : Pairing (B ⊕ A))
    (huv : compose v u = identity A) (J : Finset B) :
    ∃ K : Finset A, K.card ≤ J.card ∧ ∀ a : Pairing (B ⊕ B), support a ⊆ J →
      support (compose (compose v a) u) ⊆ K

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.Pairing.mem_marked

@[simp] lemma mem_marked (v : Pairing (A ⊕ B)) (u : Pairing (B ⊕ A)) (J : Finset B) (x : A) :

      (glueGraph v u).Reachable (outer (.inl x)) (.inl (.inr i))

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.CellNetwork.ColorData.tour_invariant
statement:
lemma tour_invariant (hl : Flat (C.boundary 0)) (hr : Flat (C.boundary (w.length+2)))
    (d : Edge Q w.length × Bool) :
    C.wholeTip (edgeInc Q w.length ((graphOrder M finish w).tour d)) true =
      C.wholeTip (edgeInc Q w.length d) true

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.CellNetwork.ColorData.wholeTip_join
statement:
lemma wholeTip_join (hl : Flat (C.boundary 0)) (hr : Flat (C.boundary (w.length+2)))
    (x : WholeInc Q w.length) :
    C.wholeTip x false = C.wholeTip ((wholeOrder M finish w).perm x) true

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.CellNetwork.ColorData.wholeTip_lane
statement:
lemma wholeTip_lane (d : Edge Q w.length × Bool) :
    C.wholeTip (edgeInc Q w.length d) true =
      C.wholeTip (edgeInc Q w.length ((graph M finish w).flip d)) false

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.CellNetwork.boundaryColor_left
statement:
lemma boundaryColor_left (finish : Q) (w : List Alpha) (c : Vertex Q w.length → Bool)
    (hc : ∀ e, c ((graph M finish w).src e) = c ((graph M finish w).dst e))
    (i : Fin (w.length+2)) (slot : Slot Q) (lane : Bool) :
    boundaryColor M finish w c i.val (slot,lane) =
      c (wholeVertex M finish w (.inl (i,.inl (false,slot))))

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.CellNetwork.boundaryColor_right
statement:
lemma boundaryColor_right (finish : Q) (w : List Alpha) (c : Vertex Q w.length → Bool)
    (i : Fin (w.length+2)) (slot : Slot Q) (lane : Bool) :
    boundaryColor M finish w c (i.val+1) (slot,lane) =
      c (wholeVertex M finish w (.inl (i,.inl (true,slot))))

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.CellNetwork.boundaryColor_test
statement:
lemma boundaryColor_test (finish : Q) (w : List Alpha) (c : Vertex Q w.length → Bool)
    (hc : ∀ e, c ((graph M finish w).src e) = c ((graph M finish w).dst e)) (s lane : Bool) :
    boundaryColor M finish w c (if s then w.length+2 else 0) (testSlot M finish,lane) =
      c (stateVertex w (outCell w.length s,if s then finish else M.initial))

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.CellNetwork.diagram_recognizes_reach
statement:
lemma diagram_recognizes_reach (finish : Q) (ht : M.transition finish .right = none)
    (w : List Alpha) :
    (¬ ∃ l r, (fullDiagram M finish w).Compatible (Sum.elim l r) ∧ Separated M finish l r) ↔
      Relation.ReflTransGen (M.Step w) (outCell w.length false,M.initial)
        (outCell w.length true,finish)

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.CellNetwork.fullDiagram_compatible
statement:
lemma fullDiagram_compatible (finish : Q) (w : List Alpha) (l r : Port Q → Bool) :
    (fullDiagram M finish w).Compatible (Sum.elim l r) ↔
      ∃ C : ColorData M finish w, C.boundary 0 = l ∧ C.boundary (w.length+2) = r

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.CellNetwork.reach_excludes_separation
statement:
lemma reach_excludes_separation (finish : Q) (ht : M.transition finish .right = none)
    (w : List Alpha)
    (hp : Relation.ReflTransGen (M.Step w) (outCell w.length false,M.initial)
      (outCell w.length true,finish))
    (C : ColorData M finish w) : ¬ Separated M finish (C.boundary 0) (C.boundary (w.length+2))

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.CellNetwork.separation_of_not_reach
statement:
lemma separation_of_not_reach (finish : Q) (ht : M.transition finish .right = none)
    (w : List Alpha)
    (hp : ¬ Relation.ReflTransGen (M.Step w) (outCell w.length false,M.initial)
      (outCell w.length true,finish)) :
    ∃ C : ColorData M finish w, Separated M finish (C.boundary 0) (C.boundary (w.length+2))

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.CellNetwork.vertex_color_adjacent
statement:
lemma vertex_color_adjacent (finish : Q) (w : List Alpha) (c : Vertex Q w.length → Bool)
    (hc : ∀ e, c ((graph M finish w).src e) = c ((graph M finish w).dst e))
    (i : Fin (w.length+1)) (slot : Slot Q) :
    c (wholeVertex M finish w (.inl (i.castSucc,.inl (true,slot)))) =
      c (wholeVertex M finish w (.inl (i.succ,.inl (false,slot))))

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.CellNetwork.vertex_color_flip
statement:
lemma vertex_color_flip (finish : Q) (w : List Alpha) (c : Vertex Q w.length → Bool)
    (hc : ∀ e, c ((graph M finish w).src e) = c ((graph M finish w).dst e))
    (d : Edge Q w.length × Bool) :
    c (wholeVertex M finish w (edgeInc Q w.length d)) =
      c (wholeVertex M finish w (edgeInc Q w.length ((graph M finish w).flip d)))

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.BRel.mul_restrictedId
statement:
lemma mul_restrictedId (F : Set H) (a : BRel H) (x y : H) :
    (a * restrictedId F).holds x y ↔ a.holds x y ∧ y ∈ F

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.BRel.permGraph_holds

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.BRel.restrictedId_holds

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.BRel.restrictedId_idem
statement: lemma restrictedId_idem (F : Set H) : restrictedId F * restrictedId F = restrictedId F

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.BRel.restrictedId_mul
statement:
lemma restrictedId_mul (F : Set H) (a : BRel H) (x y : H) :

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.BRel.restricted_sandwich
statement:
lemma restricted_sandwich {P N : BRel H} (F : Set H)
    (hF : restrictedId F * P * restrictedId F = restrictedId F)
    (hPN : P * N = N) (hNP : N * P = N) :
    let Q := P * restrictedId F * P
    restrictedId F * (Q * N * Q) * restrictedId F = restrictedId F * N * restrictedId F

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.BRel.sandwich_holds_on
statement:
lemma sandwich_holds_on {P N : BRel H} (F : Set H)
    (hF : restrictedId F * P * restrictedId F = restrictedId F)
    (hPN : P * N = N) (hNP : N * P = N) (x y : F) :
    ((P * restrictedId F * P) * N * (P * restrictedId F * P)).holds x.val y.val ↔
      N.holds x.val y.val

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.HasUnitLifts.comp_equiv

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.RectangleFrame.rel_empty

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.RectangleFrame.rel_holds
statement:
@[simp] lemma rel_holds (E : Set (I × J)) (x y : H) :
    (F.rel E).holds x y ↔ (x = y ∧ x ≠ F.hub) ∨ ∃ p ∈ E, x = F.left p.1 ∧ y = F.right p.2

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.RectangleFrame.rel_idem
statement: lemma rel_idem (E : Set (I × J)) : F.rel E * F.rel E = F.rel E

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.RectangleFrame.restricted_new
statement:
lemma restricted_new (E : Set (I × J)) (K : Set H)
    (hK : ∀ x ∈ K, x ≠ F.hub)
    (hE : ∀ p ∈ E, F.left p.1 ∉ K ∨ F.right p.2 ∉ K)
    (i : I) (j : J) (hi : F.left i ∈ K) (hj : F.right j ∈ K) :
    let u : K := ⟨F.left i,hi⟩
    let v : K := ⟨F.right j,hj⟩
    ∀ x y : K, (F.rel (insert (i,j) E)).holds x.val y.val ↔ (BRel.addEdge u v).holds x y

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.RectangleFrame.restricted_old
statement:
lemma restricted_old (E : Set (I × J)) (K : Set H)
    (hK : ∀ x ∈ K, x ≠ F.hub)
    (hE : ∀ p ∈ E, F.left p.1 ∉ K ∨ F.right p.2 ∉ K) :
    BRel.restrictedId K * F.rel E * BRel.restrictedId K = BRel.restrictedId K

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.RectangleFrame.retained_card
statement:
lemma retained_card [Fintype H] (i : I) (j : J) :

    (∀ (positive : Bool) (s : ℕ) (D : DMachine (Alphabet h) s),

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.deterministic_liveness_lower_bound
statement:
theorem deterministic_liveness_lower_bound (n : ℕ) (hn : 131 ≤ n)
    (Q : Type*) [Fintype Q]
    (D : TwoNFA (SetRel (Fin (n - 2)) (Fin (n - 2))) Q)
    (hdet : D.Deterministic) (hD : D.language = sourceLanguage (Fin (n - 2))) :
    (1 / 2 : ℝ) * 2 ^ ((n - 4) / 127) ≤ (Fintype.card Q : ℝ)

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.explicit_complementation_family
statement:
theorem explicit_complementation_family (n : ℕ) (hn : 4 ≤ n) :
    ∃ A : TwoNFA (SetRel (Fin (n - 2)) (Fin (n - 2))) (Fin n),
      A.language = sourceLanguage (Fin (n - 2)) ∧
      (∀ (Q : Type*) [Fintype Q],
        ∀ B : TwoNFA (SetRel (Fin (n - 2)) (Fin (n - 2))) Q,
        B.language = A.languageᶜ →
          (1 / 2 : ℝ) * 2 ^ ((n - 4) / 127) - 1 ≤ (Fintype.card Q : ℝ))

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.explicit_family_main
statement:
theorem explicit_family_main (n : ℕ) (hn : 4 ≤ n) :
    ∃ A : TwoNFA (SetRel (Fin (n - 2)) (Fin (n - 2))) (Fin n),
      A.language = sourceLanguage (Fin (n - 2)) ∧
      (∀ (Q : Type*) [Fintype Q],
        ∀ B : TwoNFA (SetRel (Fin (n - 2)) (Fin (n - 2))) Q,
        B.language = A.languageᶜ →
          (1 / 2 : ℝ) * 2 ^ ((n - 4) / 127) - 1 ≤ (Fintype.card Q : ℝ)) ∧
      (131 ≤ n → ∀ (Q : Type*) [Fintype Q],
        ∀ D : TwoNFA (SetRel (Fin (n - 2)) (Fin (n - 2))) Q,
        D.Deterministic → D.language = A.language →
          (1 / 2 : ℝ) * 2 ^ ((n - 4) / 127) ≤ (Fintype.card Q : ℝ))

    {Aj : ℕ → Space n →L[ℝ] Space n} {A : Space n →L[ℝ] Space n}
    (hA : Tendsto Aj atTop (𝓝 A)) (hAn : LinearMap.range A.toLinearMap≠⊥)

statement:
lemma minimizer_full_comparison [NeZero n] {μ : Measure (Space n)}
    (hμ : Integrable (fun x : Space n => ‖x‖) μ)
    (hq : ∀ x : Space n,x≠0 → 0< cosineSeminorm μ hμ x)
    (A : Space n →L[ℝ] Space n) (hA : LinearMap.range A.toLinearMap≠⊥) (b : Bool)
    (g : RelativeGauge (LinearMap.range A.toLinearMap))
    (hmin : ∀ q : RelativeGauge (LinearMap.range A.toLinearMap),supportFunctional (μ.map A) q.body=1 →
      objective b g.toSeminorm≤ objective b q.toSeminorm)
    (f : RelativeGauge (⊤ : Submodule ℝ (Space n))) :
    ∃ ha : 0< supportFunctional (μ.map A) f.body,
      objective b g.toSeminorm≤ objective b (f.scale _ ha).toSeminorm

    (hAj : ∀ i,LinearMap.range (Aj i).toLinearMap≠⊥) (b : Bool)
    (gj : ∀ i,RelativeGauge (LinearMap.range (Aj i).toLinearMap))
    (hm : ∀ i (q : RelativeGauge (LinearMap.range (Aj i).toLinearMap)),supportFunctional (μ.map (Aj i)) q.body=1 →
      objective b (gj i).toSeminorm≤ objective b q.toSeminorm) :

    (g : Seminorm ℝ (Space n))
    (hg : ∀ x,Tendsto (fun i => gj i x) atTop (𝓝 (g x)))
    {c : ℝ} (hc : 0<c)
    (hl : ∀ x,c*‖(LinearMap.range A.toLinearMap).starProjection x‖≤g x) :

name: OAI.PettyProjection.support_min_tendsto
statement:
lemma support_min_tendsto {V : Submodule ℝ (Space n)}
    {Vj : ℕ → Submodule ℝ (Space n)} (gj : ∀ i,RelativeGauge (Vj i))
    (g : Seminorm ℝ (Space n)) {c : ℝ} (hc : 0<c)
    (hl : ∀ x,c*‖V.starProjection x‖≤g x)
    (hg : ∀ x,Tendsto (fun i => gj i x) atTop (𝓝 (g x)))
    {uj : ℕ → Space n} {u : Space n} (hu : u∈V) (huj : ∀ i,uj i∈Vj i)
    (ht : Tendsto uj atTop (𝓝 u)) :
    Tendsto (fun i => min (support (gj i).body (uj i))
      (support (RelativeGauge.project V g hc hl).body u)) atTop
      (𝓝 (support (RelativeGauge.project V g hc hl).body u))

    {u : V} (hker : LinearMap.ker q = Submodule.span ℝ {u})
    {i j : ι} (hi : 0 < a i u) (hj : 0 < a j u) :
    (q '' boundingFace a b i) ∩ (q '' boundingFace a b j) =
      q '' (boundingFace a b i ∩ boundingFace a b j)

theorem measure_image_halfspaceBody_eq_sum_visible

    {u : V} (hqu : q u = 0) (hu : ∃ i, 0 < a i u)
    (hker : LinearMap.ker q = Submodule.span ℝ {u})
    (hmeas : ∀ i, MeasurableSet (q '' boundingFace a b i))
    (hnull : ∀ i j, i ≠ j →
      μ (q '' (boundingFace a b i ∩ boundingFace a b j)) = 0) :
    μ (q '' halfspaceBody a b) =
      ∑ i : {i : ι // 0 < a i u}, μ (q '' boundingFace a b i.1)

theorem real_measure_image_halfspaceBody
    (a : ι → V →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (b : ι → ℝ) (q : V →ₗ[ℝ] W) (μ : Measure W)
    {u : V} (hqu : q u = 0) (hu : ∃ i, 0 < a i u)
    (hker : LinearMap.ker q = Submodule.span ℝ {u})
    (hmeas : ∀ i, MeasurableSet (q '' boundingFace a b i))
    (hnull : ∀ i j, i ≠ j →
      μ (q '' (boundingFace a b i ∩ boundingFace a b j)) = 0)
    (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 ≤ c) (hbalance : ∑ i, a i u = 0)
    (hfacet : ∀ i, μ (q '' boundingFace a b i) = ENNReal.ofReal (c * |a i u|)) :
    (μ (q '' halfspaceBody a b)).toReal = c * (∑ i, |a i u|) / 2

lemma mem_euclidean_iff (c : ℝ) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) :
    x ∈ euclidean c ↔ WithLp.ofLp x ∈ (fun y : ι → ℝ => c • y) '' centered

name: OAI.DiagonalZonotope.support_smul
statement: lemma support_smul (u : ι → ℝ) (a : ℝ) : support (a • u) = |a| * support u

name: OAI.DiagonalZonotope.support_zero
statement: lemma support_zero : support (0 : ι → ℝ) = 0

name: OAI.DiagonalZonotope.convex_euclideanProduct
statement: lemma convex_euclideanProduct (n m : ℕ) (c : ℝ) : Convex ℝ (euclideanProduct n m c)

name: OAI.DiagonalZonotope.euclideanProduct_eq_halfspaces
statement:
theorem euclideanProduct_eq_halfspaces (n m : ℕ) (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) :
    euclideanProduct n m c =
      {x | ∀ u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + m)), ⟪u, x⟫ ≤ c *
        (support (WithLp.ofLp (EuclideanSpace.finAddEquivProd u).1) +
         support (WithLp.ofLp (EuclideanSpace.finAddEquivProd u).2))}

name: OAI.DiagonalZonotope.euclideanProduct_interior_nonempty
statement:
lemma euclideanProduct_interior_nonempty (n m : ℕ) (c : ℝ) (hc : c ≠ 0) :

name: OAI.DiagonalZonotope.euclideanProduct_support_attained
statement:
theorem euclideanProduct_support_attained (n m : ℕ) (c : ℝ)
    (u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + m))) :
    ∃ x ∈ euclideanProduct n m c, ⟪u, x⟫ = c *
      (support (WithLp.ofLp (EuclideanSpace.finAddEquivProd u).1) +
       support (WithLp.ofLp (EuclideanSpace.finAddEquivProd u).2))

name: OAI.DiagonalZonotope.finAddEquivProd_apply
statement:
lemma finAddEquivProd_apply (n m : ℕ) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + m))) :
    EuclideanSpace.finAddEquivProd x =
      (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i : Fin n => x (Fin.castAdd m i)),
       WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i : Fin m => x (Fin.natAdd n i)))

name: OAI.DiagonalZonotope.inner_finAdd
statement:
lemma inner_finAdd (n m : ℕ) (u x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + m))) :
    ⟪u, x⟫ =
      ⟪(EuclideanSpace.finAddEquivProd u).1, (EuclideanSpace.finAddEquivProd x).1⟫ +
      ⟪(EuclideanSpace.finAddEquivProd u).2, (EuclideanSpace.finAddEquivProd x).2⟫

statement: lemma isCompact_euclideanProduct (n m : ℕ) (c : ℝ) : IsCompact (euclideanProduct n m c)

name: OAI.ProjectionCounterexample.unit_support_halfspaces_eq
statement:
theorem unit_support_halfspaces_eq

        ((normalHyperplane u).orthogonalProjectionOnto x : Euclidean d) a -
      simplexVelocity u a * simplexCoordinates
        ((normalHyperplane u).orthogonalProjectionOnto x : Euclidean d) b =
      simplexVelocity u b * simplexCoordinates x a -
        simplexVelocity u a * simplexCoordinates x b

theorem simplexCoordinateAffine_apply {d : ℕ} (a : Option (Fin d)) (x : Euclidean d) :

name: OAI.Paper092.simplexCoordinates_add_smul

name: OAI.Paper092.simplexCoordinates_vertex

name: OAI.Paper092.simplexFacet_isCompact

name: OAI.Paper092.simplexVelocity_neg_exists

name: OAI.Paper092.diagonalFacetChart_eq

name: OAI.Paper092.facetEmbedding_apply_same
statement:
theorem facetEmbedding_apply_same (n : ℕ) (i : Fin (n + 1)) (c : ℝ) (x : Euclidean n) :

name: OAI.Paper092.facetEmbedding_apply_succAbove

theorem facetEmbedding_apply_succAbove (n : ℕ) (i : Fin (n + 1)) (c : ℝ)

name: OAI.Paper092.facetEmbedding_inner
statement:
theorem facetEmbedding_inner (n : ℕ) (i : Fin (n + 1)) (c : ℝ) (x y : Euclidean n) :

name: OAI.Paper092.facetEmbedding_normDet_neg_one

theorem facetEmbedding_normDet_neg_one (n : ℕ) (i : Fin (n + 1)) :

name: OAI.Paper092.facetEmbedding_normDet_sq
statement:
theorem facetEmbedding_normDet_sq (n : ℕ) (i : Fin (n + 1)) (c : ℝ) :

name: OAI.Paper092.facetEmbedding_normDet_zero

theorem facetEmbedding_normDet_zero (n : ℕ) (i : Fin (n + 1)) :

name: OAI.Paper092.simplexFacet_diagonal_area

name: OAI.Paper092.brightness_product_eq_front_sum

theorem brightness_product_eq_front_sum (u : Euclidean 20) (hu : u ≠ 0) :

name: OAI.Paper092.product_facet_seam_projection_invariant
statement:
theorem product_facet_seam_projection_invariant (u x : Euclidean 20)
    (a b : ProductFacetIndex) :
    productVelocity u b * productCoordinates
        ((normalHyperplane u).orthogonalProjectionOnto x : Euclidean 20) a -
      productVelocity u a * productCoordinates
        ((normalHyperplane u).orthogonalProjectionOnto x : Euclidean 20) b =
      productVelocity u b * productCoordinates x a -
        productVelocity u a * productCoordinates x b

name: OAI.Paper092.product_front_facets_projection_inter_eq
statement:
theorem product_front_facets_projection_inter_eq (u : Euclidean 20)

    ((normalHyperplane u).orthogonalProjectionOnto '' productFacet a) ∩
      ((normalHyperplane u).orthogonalProjectionOnto '' productFacet b) =
        (normalHyperplane u).orthogonalProjectionOnto '' (productFacet a ∩ productFacet b)

name: OAI.Paper092.projected_product_facet_seam_null
statement:
theorem projected_product_facet_seam_null (u : Euclidean 20) (a b : ProductFacetIndex)
    (hab : a ≠ b) (hb : productVelocity u b ≠ 0) :
    volume {y : normalHyperplane u |
      productVelocity u b * productCoordinates y.val a -
        productVelocity u a * productCoordinates y.val b = 0} = 0

name: OAI.Paper092.projected_product_front_facets_aedisjoint
statement:
theorem projected_product_front_facets_aedisjoint (u : Euclidean 20)
    (a b : ProductFacetIndex) (hab : a ≠ b)
    (ha : productVelocity u a < 0) (hb : productVelocity u b < 0) :
    AEDisjoint volume
      ((normalHyperplane u).orthogonalProjectionOnto '' productFacet a)
      ((normalHyperplane u).orthogonalProjectionOnto '' productFacet b)

statement:
theorem projectionVolume_product_eq_front_sum (u : Euclidean 20) (hu : u ≠ 0) :

name: OAI.Paper092.projection_injective_on_product_front
statement:
theorem projection_injective_on_product_front (u x z : Euclidean 20)
    (hx : ∀ a, 0 ≤ productCoordinates x a) (hz : ∀ a, 0 ≤ productCoordinates z a)
    (hxf : ∃ a, productVelocity u a < 0 ∧ productCoordinates x a = 0)
    (hzf : ∃ a, productVelocity u a < 0 ∧ productCoordinates z a = 0)
    (hp : (normalHyperplane u).orthogonalProjectionOnto x =
      (normalHyperplane u).orthogonalProjectionOnto z) : x = z

name: OAI.Paper092.twice_sum_negative_eq_sum_abs
statement:
theorem twice_sum_negative_eq_sum_abs {ι : Type uι} [Fintype ι] (v : ι → ℝ)

    2 * (∑ i : {i // v i < 0}, -v i.val) = ∑ i, |v i|

name: OAI.Paper092.productVelocity_sum

name: OAI.Paper092.product_front_coefficient
statement:
theorem product_front_coefficient (u : Euclidean 20) :
    (∑ a : {a : ProductFacetIndex // productVelocity u a < 0}, -productVelocity u a.val) =
      ((∑ i, |firstBlock u i|) + |∑ i, firstBlock u i| +
        (∑ i, |secondBlock u i|) + |∑ i, secondBlock u i|) / 2

name: OAI.Paper092.simplexProduct_volume
statement:
theorem simplexProduct_volume (r s : ℕ) :

name: OAI.Paper092.splitEuclideanProduct_measurePreserving

name: OAI.Paper092.splitEuclideanProduct_volume
statement:
theorem splitEuclideanProduct_volume (r s : ℕ) (A : Set (Euclidean r))
    (B : Set (Euclidean s)) (hA : MeasurableSet A) (hB : MeasurableSet B) :
    volume (splitEuclideanProduct r s ⁻¹' (A ×ˢ B)) = volume A * volume B

name: OAI.Paper092.euclideanProductMap_apply
statement:
theorem euclideanProductMap_apply {r s t u : ℕ} (f : Euclidean r →ₗ[ℝ] Euclidean t)
    (g : Euclidean s →ₗ[ℝ] Euclidean u) (x : Euclidean (r + s)) :
    euclideanProductMap f g x = (splitEuclideanProduct t u).symm
      (f (splitEuclideanProduct r s x).1, g (splitEuclideanProduct r s x).2)

name: OAI.Paper092.euclideanProductMap_image
statement:
theorem euclideanProductMap_image {r s t u : ℕ} (f : Euclidean r →ₗ[ℝ] Euclidean t)
    (g : Euclidean s →ₗ[ℝ] Euclidean u) (A : Set (Euclidean r)) (B : Set (Euclidean s)) :
    euclideanProductMap f g '' (splitEuclideanProduct r s ⁻¹' (A ×ˢ B)) =
      splitEuclideanProduct t u ⁻¹' ((f '' A) ×ˢ (g '' B))

name: OAI.Paper092.euclideanProductMap_image_area
statement:
theorem euclideanProductMap_image_area {r s t u : ℕ}
    (f : Euclidean r →ₗ[ℝ] Euclidean t) (g : Euclidean s →ₗ[ℝ] Euclidean u)
    (A : Set (Euclidean r)) (B : Set (Euclidean s))
    (hA : MeasurableSet A) (hB : MeasurableSet B) :
    μHE[r + s] (splitEuclideanProduct t u ⁻¹' ((f '' A) ×ˢ (g '' B))) =
      ENNReal.ofReal (f.normDet * g.normDet) * (volume A * volume B)

name: OAI.Paper092.euclideanProductMap_inner
statement:
theorem euclideanProductMap_inner {r s t u : ℕ} (f : Euclidean r →ₗ[ℝ] Euclidean t)
    (g : Euclidean s →ₗ[ℝ] Euclidean u) (x y : Euclidean (r + s)) :
    ⟪euclideanProductMap f g x, euclideanProductMap f g y⟫ =
      ⟪f (splitEuclideanProduct r s x).1, f (splitEuclideanProduct r s y).1⟫ +
      ⟪g (splitEuclideanProduct r s x).2, g (splitEuclideanProduct r s y).2⟫

name: OAI.Paper092.euclideanProductMap_normDet
statement:
theorem euclideanProductMap_normDet {r s t u : ℕ} (f : Euclidean r →ₗ[ℝ] Euclidean t)
    (g : Euclidean s →ₗ[ℝ] Euclidean u) :
    (euclideanProductMap f g).normDet = f.normDet * g.normDet

name: OAI.Paper092.SupportGeometry.eq_of_inner_support_eq

theorem eq_of_inner_support_eq {A B : Set H} (hA : IsCompact A) (hneA : A.Nonempty)

name: OAI.Paper092.SupportGeometry.eq_of_support_eq

name: OAI.Paper092.SupportGeometry.eq_sum_centered_segments_iff
statement:
theorem eq_sum_centered_segments_iff {ι : Type uι} {K : Set E} (hK : IsCompact K)
    (hne : K.Nonempty) (hconv : Convex ℝ K) (s : Finset ι) (v : ι → E) :
    K = ∑ i ∈ s, segment ℝ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ) • v i) ((1 / 2 : ℝ) • v i) ↔
      ∀ f : E →L[ℝ] ℝ, support K f = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ i ∈ s, |f (v i)|

name: OAI.Paper092.SupportGeometry.exists_support

name: OAI.Paper092.SupportGeometry.halfSpaces_eq_of_eq_support

name: OAI.Paper092.SupportGeometry.mem_iff_le_support

name: OAI.Paper092.SupportGeometry.support_add
statement:
theorem support_add {A B : Set E} (hA : IsCompact A) (hneA : A.Nonempty)

name: OAI.Paper092.SupportGeometry.support_le

name: OAI.Paper092.SupportGeometry.support_prod
statement:
theorem support_prod {A : Set E} {B : Set F} (hA : IsCompact A) (hneA : A.Nonempty)
    (hB : IsCompact B) (hneB : B.Nonempty) (f : E →L[ℝ] ℝ) (g : F →L[ℝ] ℝ) :
    support (A ×ˢ B) (f.coprod g) = support A f + support B g

name: OAI.Paper092.SupportGeometry.support_segment
statement:
theorem support_segment (x y : E) (f : E →L[ℝ] ℝ) :

name: OAI.Paper092.SupportGeometry.support_smul

name: OAI.Paper092.SupportGeometry.support_sum
statement:
theorem support_sum {ι : Type uι} (s : Finset ι) (K : ι → Set E)
    (hK : ∀ i ∈ s, IsCompact (K i)) (hne : ∀ i ∈ s, (K i).Nonempty)
    (f : E →L[ℝ] ℝ) : support (∑ i ∈ s, K i) f = ∑ i ∈ s, support (K i) f

name: OAI.Paper092.SupportGeometry.support_sum_centered_segments
statement:
theorem support_sum_centered_segments {ι : Type uι} (s : Finset ι) (v : ι → E)

    support (∑ i ∈ s, segment ℝ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ) • v i) ((1 / 2 : ℝ) • v i)) f =
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ i ∈ s, |f (v i)|

name: OAI.Paper092.centered_segment_eq_vadd
statement:
theorem centered_segment_eq_vadd {E : Type uE} [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℝ E] (v : E) :

      (-(1 / 2 : ℝ) • v) +ᵥ segment ℝ 0 v

      (((d - 1).factorial : ℝ)⁻¹ •
        ((WithLp.toLp 2 '' Icc (0 : Fin d → ℝ) 1) +

name: OAI.Paper092.sum_centered_segments_eq_vadd

name: OAI.Paper092.product_counterexample
statement:
theorem product_counterexample :
    (IsCompact productWitness ∧ Convex ℝ productWitness ∧
      (interior productWitness).Nonempty) ∧
    normalizedProjectionVolume productWitness / simplexConstant 20 =
      (121 * (Nat.choose 20 10 : ℝ)) / (21 * (2 : ℝ) ^ 20) ∧
    normalizedProjectionVolume productWitness / simplexConstant 20 =
      (22355476 : ℝ) / 22020096 ∧
    1 < normalizedProjectionVolume productWitness / simplexConstant 20 ∧
    (volume (projectionBody productWitness)).toReal >
      simplexConstant 20 * (volume productWitness).toReal ^ 19

    [NormedAddCommGroup Y] [NormedSpace ℝ Y]
    [NormedAddCommGroup Z] [NormedSpace ℝ Z]
    {f : X → Y} {g : Y → Z} {x : X}
    (hf : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 f x) (hg : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 g (f x)) (v w : X) :
    fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (g ∘ f)) x v w =

name: OAI.QuadricCounterexample.matrix_completed_square
statement:
lemma matrix_completed_square {n : Type u25} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    {H : Matrix n n ℂ} (hH : H.PosDef) (A T : Matrix n n ℂ) (v w : n → ℂ) :
    star v ⬝ᵥ (T.mulVec v) + star w ⬝ᵥ (A.mulVec v) +
      star v ⬝ᵥ (A.conjTranspose.mulVec w) + star w ⬝ᵥ (H.mulVec w) =
    star v ⬝ᵥ ((T-A.conjTranspose*H⁻¹*A).mulVec v) +
      star (w+H⁻¹.mulVec (A.mulVec v)) ⬝ᵥ (H.mulVec (w+H⁻¹.mulVec (A.mulVec v)))

    (hT : (T-A.conjTranspose*H⁻¹*A).PosSemidef) (v w : n → ℂ) :
    0 ≤ (star v ⬝ᵥ (T.mulVec v) + star w ⬝ᵥ (A.mulVec v) +
      star v ⬝ᵥ (A.conjTranspose.mulVec w) + star w ⬝ᵥ (H.mulVec w)).re

name: OAI.QuadricCounterexample.quadratic_levi_expansion
statement:
lemma quadratic_levi_expansion {ι : Type u27} [Fintype ι]
    (H D E U V : Matrix ι ι ℂ) (hD : D.IsHermitian) (hE : E.IsHermitian)
    (v w : ι → ℂ) :
    (star v ⬝ᵥ U.mulVec v + 2 * (star w ⬝ᵥ D.mulVec v) +
      2 * (star v ⬝ᵥ D.mulVec w) + 2 * (star w ⬝ᵥ H.mulVec w)) +
    (star v ⬝ᵥ V.mulVec v + 2 * (star (Complex.I • w) ⬝ᵥ E.mulVec v) +
      2 * (star v ⬝ᵥ E.mulVec (Complex.I • w)) +
      2 * (star (Complex.I • w) ⬝ᵥ H.mulVec (Complex.I • w))) =
    4 * (star v ⬝ᵥ ((1/4 : ℂ) • (U+V)).mulVec v +
      star w ⬝ᵥ ((1/2 : ℂ) • (D-Complex.I • E)).mulVec v +
      star v ⬝ᵥ (((1/2 : ℂ) • (D-Complex.I • E)).conjTranspose).mulVec w +
      star w ⬝ᵥ H.mulVec w)

    (hH : Integrable H μ) (hHm : ∀ m, Integrable (Hm m) μ)

      (fun p : E × (n → ℂ) ↦ quadraticValue (Hm m p.1) p.2))
    {C : ℝ} {r : ℕ → ℝ} (hr : ∀ k, 0 < r k) (hr0 : Tendsto r atTop (𝓝 0))
    (hb : ∀ k, ∀ a ∈ closedBall (0 : E) (r k), ∀ x ∈ U, x + a ∈ Ω)
    (hbound : ∀ m, ∀ x ∈ Ω, ∀ v, quadraticValue (Hm m x) v ≤ C * ‖v‖ ^ 2)
    (hl : ∀ k, ∀ x ∈ U, ∀ v, Tendsto
      (fun m ↦ ⨍ y in ball x (r k), quadraticValue (Hm m y) v ∂μ)
      atTop (𝓝 (⨍ y in ball x (r k), quadraticValue (H y) v ∂μ)))
    (hmean : ∀ v k, ∀ᵐ x ∂μ.restrict U,

    {Ω U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} (hΩ : IsOpen Ω) (hU : IsOpen U)
    (hf : ∀ m, (fun x ↦ coefficientsToMatrix (f m x)) =ᵐ[volume] Hm m)

    (hposm : ∀ m, ∀ᵐ x ∂volume, (Hm m x).PosSemidef)
    (hc : ∀ m, ContinuousOn (fun p : (ℂ × ℂ) × (n → ℂ) ↦ quadraticValue (Hm m p.1) p.2)
      (Ω ×ˢ univ))
    (hp : ∀ m, DiskPshOn (Ω ×ˢ univ)

    (hb : ∀ k, ∀ x ∈ U, closedBall x (r k) ⊆ Ω)

    (hmeas : ∀ m i, AEStronglyMeasurable (Hm m i))
    (hposm : ∀ m i, ∀ᵐ x ∂volume, (Hm m i x).PosSemidef)
    (hc : ∀ m i, ContinuousOn
      (fun p : (ℂ × ℂ) × (n → ℂ) ↦ quadraticValue (Hm m i p.1) p.2) (Ω i ×ˢ univ))
    (hp : ∀ m i, DiskPshOn (Ω i ×ˢ univ)
      (fun p : (ℂ × ℂ) × (n → ℂ) ↦ quadraticValue (Hm m i p.1) p.2))
    {R C : ι → ℝ} (hR : ∀ i, 0 ≤ R i)
    (hcoef : ∀ m i, ∀ᵐ x ∂volume, ‖matrixToCoefficients (Hm m i x)‖ ≤ R i ∧
      (x ∉ s i → Hm m i x = 0))
    {r : ι → ℕ → ℝ} (hr : ∀ i k, 0 < r i k)
    (hr0 : ∀ i, Tendsto (r i) atTop (𝓝 0))
    (hb : ∀ i k, ∀ x ∈ U i, closedBall x (r i k) ⊆ Ω i)
    (hbound : ∀ m i, ∀ x ∈ Ω i, ∀ v,
      quadraticValue (Hm m i x) v ≤ C i * ‖v‖ ^ 2) :
    ∃ (M : ι → (ℂ × ℂ) → Matrix n n ℂ)
      (f : ℕ → ι → Lp (EuclideanSpace ℂ (n × n)) 2 (volume : Measure (ℂ × ℂ)))
      (w : ι → Lp (EuclideanSpace ℂ (n × n)) 2 (volume : Measure (ℂ × ℂ)))
      (φ : ℕ → ℕ), StrictMono φ ∧
      (∀ m i, (fun x ↦ coefficientsToMatrix (f m i x)) =ᵐ[volume] Hm m i) ∧
      (∀ m i, ∀ᵐ x ∂volume, ‖f m i x‖ ≤ R i ∧ (x ∉ s i → f m i x = 0)) ∧
      ∀ i, (M i =ᵐ[volume.restrict (U i)] fun x ↦ coefficientsToMatrix (w i x)) ∧
        (∀ v, Tendsto (fun m ↦ inner ℂ (f (φ m) i) v) atTop (𝓝 (inner ℂ (w i) v))) ∧
        (∀ x ∈ U i, (M i x).PosSemidef) ∧
        DiskPshOn (U i ×ˢ univ)
          (fun p : (ℂ × ℂ) × (n → ℂ) ↦ quadraticValue (M i p.1) p.2) ∧
        ∀ x ρ v, ball x ρ ⊆ U i →
          Tendsto (fun m ↦ ⨍ y in ball x ρ, quadraticValue (Hm (φ m) i y) v) atTop
            (𝓝 (⨍ y in ball x ρ, quadraticValue (M i y) v))

    {ι : Type u21} {α : Type u22} {n : Type u23} [Countable ι] [MeasurableSpace α] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    {μ : Measure α} [IsSeparable μ]
    {s : ι → Set α} (hs : ∀ i, MeasurableSet (s i)) (hμs : ∀ i, μ (s i) ≠ ∞)
    {u : ℕ → ι → Lp (EuclideanSpace ℂ (n × n)) 2 μ} {R : ι → ℝ}
    (hR : ∀ i, 0 ≤ R i)
    (hu : ∀ k i, ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, (coefficientsToMatrix (u k i x)).PosSemidef ∧
      ‖u k i x‖ ≤ R i ∧ (x ∉ s i → u k i x = 0)) :
    ∃ (w : ι → Lp (EuclideanSpace ℂ (n × n)) 2 μ) (φ : ℕ → ℕ), StrictMono φ ∧
      ∀ i, (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, (coefficientsToMatrix (w i x)).PosSemidef ∧
        ‖w i x‖ ≤ R i ∧ (x ∉ s i → w i x = 0)) ∧
        Integrable (fun x ↦ w i x) μ ∧ ∀ v,
          Tendsto (fun k ↦ inner ℂ (u (φ k) i) v) atTop (𝓝 (inner ℂ (w i) v))

statement:
theorem local_quadratic_compactness {n : Type u18} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    {Hm : ℕ → (ℂ × ℂ) → Matrix n n ℂ} {Ω U s : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}
    (hΩ : IsOpen Ω) (hU : IsOpen U) (hs : MeasurableSet s) (hμs : volume s ≠ ∞)
    (hmeas : ∀ m, AEStronglyMeasurable (Hm m))
    (hposm : ∀ m, ∀ᵐ x ∂volume, (Hm m x).PosSemidef)
    (hc : ∀ m, ContinuousOn (fun p : (ℂ × ℂ) × (n → ℂ) ↦ quadraticValue (Hm m p.1) p.2)
      (Ω ×ˢ univ))
    (hp : ∀ m, DiskPshOn (Ω ×ˢ univ)
      (fun p : (ℂ × ℂ) × (n → ℂ) ↦ quadraticValue (Hm m p.1) p.2))
    {R C : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    (hcoef : ∀ m, ∀ᵐ x ∂volume, ‖matrixToCoefficients (Hm m x)‖ ≤ R ∧
      (x ∉ s → Hm m x = 0))
    {r : ℕ → ℝ} (hr : ∀ k, 0 < r k) (hr0 : Tendsto r atTop (𝓝 0))
    (hb : ∀ k, ∀ x ∈ U, closedBall x (r k) ⊆ Ω)
    (hbound : ∀ m, ∀ x ∈ Ω, ∀ v, quadraticValue (Hm m x) v ≤ C * ‖v‖ ^ 2) :
    ∃ (M : (ℂ × ℂ) → Matrix n n ℂ) (φ : ℕ → ℕ), StrictMono φ ∧
      (∀ x ∈ U, (M x).PosSemidef) ∧
      DiskPshOn (U ×ˢ univ)
        (fun p : (ℂ × ℂ) × (n → ℂ) ↦ quadraticValue (M p.1) p.2) ∧
      ∀ x ρ v, ball x ρ ⊆ U →
        Tendsto (fun m ↦ ⨍ y in ball x ρ, quadraticValue (Hm (φ m) y) v) atTop
          (𝓝 (⨍ y in ball x ρ, quadraticValue (M y) v))

statement:
lemma SmoothHermitianMetric.trace_change {D : EqualizerData} {hm : 0 < m}

    (i j : StandardChart) {z : BaseCoordinates} (hz : z ∈ coordinateOverlap i j)
    (v : FiberCoordinates) :
    quadraticValue (matrixRootTrace m (h.dualMatrix (standardChartIndex i)) z) v =
      traceScalar m i j z *
        quadraticValue (matrixRootTrace m (h.dualMatrix (standardChartIndex j))

    (v : FiberCoordinates) :
    quadraticValue (matrixRootTrace m (h.dualMatrix (standardChartIndex i)) (x.1^m,x.2^m)) v =
      ‖polarizationTransition i j (affineQuadric i x)‖^2*
        quadraticValue (matrixRootTrace m (h.dualMatrix (standardChartIndex j))
          (coordinateChange i j (x.1^m,x.2^m)))

name: OAI.QuadricCounterexample.BinaryForms.adapted_combination_succ
statement:
lemma adapted_combination_succ (h d u v : ℂ) (t : ℕ) (c : Form (R := ℂ) (2*(t+1))) :
    polynomial (2*(t+1)) ((adaptedMatrix h d u v (t+1)).mulVec c)=
      kernelForm h d*X 1*polynomial (2*t) ((adaptedMatrix h d u v t).mulVec
        (fun k ↦ c k.castSucc.castSucc))+
      c (Fin.last (2*t+1)).castSucc • (kernelForm h d*X 0^(2*t+1))+
      c (Fin.last (2*t+2)) • liftForm u v^(2*(t+1))

statement:

statement:
lemma sum_snoc_two {n : ℕ} (a : Fin (n+2) → ℂ) (f : Fin n → Poly (R := ℂ))

    (∑ k, a k • Fin.snoc (Fin.snoc f p) q k)=
      (∑ k : Fin n, a k.castSucc.castSucc • f k)+
        a (Fin.last n).castSucc • p+a (Fin.last (n+1)) • q

lemma eval_transform (d : ℕ × ℕ) (i : Chart) (p : LaurentCoefficients)

name: OAI.QuadricCounterexample.LaurentCech.exists_overlap_laurent
statement:
lemma exists_overlap_laurent (d : ℕ × ℕ) (i j : Chart) (f : BaseCoordinates → ℂ)
    (hf : UniformlyRegularOn (coordinateOverlap i j) f) :
    ∃ p : LaurentCoefficients, (∀ a∈p.support,OverlapAllows d i j a) ∧
      ∀ z : BaseCoordinates, z.1≠0 ∧ z.2≠0 →
        eval p z=masterFrame d i z*f (masterCoordinates i z)

name: OAI.QuadricCounterexample.EqualizerData.kernel_coordinates
statement:
lemma kernel_coordinates (i j : StandardChart) {z : BaseCoordinates}
    (hz : z∈coordinateOverlap i j) :
    baseEval (D.divisor j) (coordinateChange i j z)*topFactor i j z=
      kernelFactor i j z*baseEval (D.divisor i) z ∧
    baseEval (D.divisor j) (coordinateChange i j z)*D.low i j z-
      baseEval (D.lift j) (coordinateChange i j z)*bottomFactor i j z=
        -kernelFactor i j z*baseEval (D.lift i) z

    (hz : z∈coordinateOverlap i j) (x : Fin 2 → ℂ) :
    baseEval (D.lift i) z*((D.coordinateTransition i j z).mulVec x 0)+
      baseEval (D.divisor i) z*((D.coordinateTransition i j z).mulVec x 1)=
    quotientFactor i j z*(baseEval (D.lift j) (coordinateChange i j z)*x 0+
      baseEval (D.divisor j) (coordinateChange i j z)*x 1)

          (baseEval (D.bezoutV j) (coordinateChange i j z))))=quotientFactor i j z

lemma inverseFormula (hn : 0<n) (i : ℕ) (x : QuadricSurface) (hx : x∈V.domain i)
    (v : FiberCoordinates) (q : ι) (hq : sectionVector S.sections i x v (index (V.chart i,q))≠0)
    (b : Fin 2) (hb : v b≠0) (k : Fin 3) :
    (![ (coordQuadric (V.chart i) x).1,(coordQuadric (V.chart i) x).2,v (1-b)/v b] : Fin 3 → ℂ) k=
    MvPolynomial.eval (normalize (index (V.chart i,q)) (sectionVector S.sections i x v))
      (S.inverseNumerator hn i q b k)/
    MvPolynomial.eval (normalize (index (V.chart i,q)) (sectionVector S.sections i x v))

name: OAI.QuadricCounterexample.SegreSectionSystem.local_inverse
statement:
lemma local_inverse (hn : 0<n) (i : ℕ) (x : QuadricSurface) (hx : x∈V.domain i)
    (v : FiberCoordinates) (hv : v≠0) :
    ∃ j : ProjectiveIndex ι,∃ b : Fin 2,v b≠0 ∧ sectionVector S.sections i x v j≠0 ∧
    ∃ p q : Fin 3 → MvPolynomial (ProjectiveIndex ι) ℂ,
      (∀ k,MvPolynomial.eval (normalize j (sectionVector S.sections i x v)) (q k)≠0) ∧
      ∀ i' x',x'∈V.domain i' → ∀ v' : FiberCoordinates,v'≠0 →
        sectionVector S.sections i' x' v' j≠0 →
        (∀ k,MvPolynomial.eval (normalize j (sectionVector S.sections i' x' v')) (q k)≠0) →
        x'∈V.domain i ∧ ((V.dualTransition i i' x').mulVec v') b≠0 ∧
        (∀ k : Fin 3,
          (![ (coordQuadric (V.chart i) x').1,(coordQuadric (V.chart i) x').2,
            ((V.dualTransition i i' x').mulVec v') (1-b)/((V.dualTransition i i' x').mulVec v') b] : Fin 3 → ℂ) k=
          MvPolynomial.eval (normalize j (sectionVector S.sections i' x' v')) (p k)/
          MvPolynomial.eval (normalize j (sectionVector S.sections i' x' v')) (q k))

lemma stableLength_mul_le (hi : ∀ g : G, Isometry (fun x : X => g • x))
    (x : X) {g h : G} (hc : Commute g h) :
    stableLengthAt x (g * h) ≤ stableLengthAt x g + stableLengthAt x h

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.stableLength_nonneg
statement:
lemma stableLength_nonneg (hi : ∀ g : G, Isometry (fun x : X => g • x))
    (x : X) (g : G) : 0 ≤ stableLengthAt x g

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.stableLength_one
statement:
lemma stableLength_one (hi : ∀ g : G, Isometry (fun x : X => g • x)) (x : X) :
    stableLengthAt x (1 : G) = 0

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.stableLength_pow
statement:
lemma stableLength_pow (hi : ∀ g : G, Isometry (fun x : X => g • x))
    (x : X) (g : G) (k : ℕ) : stableLengthAt x (g ^ k) = k * stableLengthAt x g

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.stableLength_product_sq
statement:
lemma stableLength_product_sq (x : X) (g h : G) :
    stableLengthAt x (g * h) ^ 2 =
      stableLengthAt x g ^ 2 + stableLengthAt x h ^ 2 + 2 * lengthPairing x g h

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.stableLength_tendsto
statement:
lemma stableLength_tendsto (hi : ∀ g : G, Isometry (fun x : X => g • x))
    (x : X) (g : G) :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => dist x ((g ^ n) • x) / (n : ℝ)) atTop (𝓝 (stableLengthAt x g))

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.stableLength_zpow
statement:
lemma stableLength_zpow (hi : ∀ g : G, Isometry (fun x : X => g • x))
    (x : X) (g : G) (n : ℤ) : stableLengthAt x (g ^ n) = |(n : ℝ)| * stableLengthAt x g

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.stableLength_zpow_product_sq
statement:
lemma stableLength_zpow_product_sq (hX : CAT0 X)
    (hi : ∀ g : G, Isometry (fun x : X => g • x)) (x : X)
    {g h : G} (hc : Commute g h) (n : ℤ) :
    stableLengthAt x ((g ^ n) * h) ^ 2 =
      (n : ℝ)^2 * stableLengthAt x g ^ 2 + stableLengthAt x h ^ 2 +
        2 * (n : ℝ) * lengthPairing x g h

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.zero_of_int_mul_le
statement: lemma zero_of_int_mul_le {a b : ℝ} (h : ∀ n : ℤ, (n : ℝ) * a ≤ b) : a = 0

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.fourSquares_limit
statement:
lemma fourSquares_limit {A B C E : ℕ → ℝ} {a b c e D : ℝ}
    (hA : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => A n - n * D) atTop (𝓝 a))
    (hB : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => B n - n * D) atTop (𝓝 b))
    (hC : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => C n - n * D) atTop (𝓝 c))
    (hE : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => E n - n * D) atTop (𝓝 e)) :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (A n ^ 2 + B n ^ 2 - C n ^ 2 - E n ^ 2) / (n : ℝ))
      atTop (𝓝 (2 * D * (a + b - c - e)))

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.lengthPairing_centralizer
statement:
lemma lengthPairing_centralizer [ProperSpace X] [Nonempty X]
    (hG : GeometricAction G X) (x : X) {g h k : G}
    (hgh : Commute g h) (hgk : Commute g k) :
    lengthPairing x g (h * k) = lengthPairing x g h + lengthPairing x g k

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.lengthPairing_eq_orbitCharacter
statement:
lemma lengthPairing_eq_orbitCharacter (hX : CAT0 X)
    (hi : ∀ g : G, Isometry (fun x : X => g • x))
    (x : X) (g : G) (D : ℝ) (hD : 0 < D)
    (haxis : ∀ n : ℕ, dist x ((g ^ n) • x) = n * D)
    (hL : stableLengthAt x g = D) {h : G} (hc : Commute g h) :
    lengthPairing x g h = D * orbitCharacter x g D h

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.orbitBusemann_centralizer_difference
statement:
lemma orbitBusemann_centralizer_difference (hX : CAT0 X)
    (hi : ∀ g : G, Isometry (fun x : X => g • x))
    (x : X) (g : G) (D : ℝ) (hD : 0 < D)
    (haxis : ∀ n : ℕ, dist x ((g ^ n) • x) = n * D)
    {h : G} (hc : Commute g h) (z w : X) :
    orbitBusemann x g D (h • z) - orbitBusemann x g D (h • w) =
      orbitBusemann x g D z - orbitBusemann x g D w

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.orbitBusemann_lipschitz
statement:
lemma orbitBusemann_lipschitz (hi : ∀ g : G, Isometry (fun x : X => g • x))
    (x : X) (g : G) (D : ℝ) (haxis : ∀ n : ℕ, dist x ((g ^ n) • x) = n * D)
    (z w : X) : |orbitBusemann x g D z - orbitBusemann x g D w| ≤ dist z w

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.orbitBusemann_self
statement:
lemma orbitBusemann_self (hi : ∀ g : G, Isometry (fun x : X => g • x))
    (x : X) (g : G) (D : ℝ) (haxis : ∀ n : ℕ, dist x ((g ^ n) • x) = n * D) :
    orbitBusemann x g D x = 0

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.orbitBusemann_tendsto
statement:
lemma orbitBusemann_tendsto (hi : ∀ g : G, Isometry (fun x : X => g • x))
    (x : X) (g : G) (D : ℝ) (haxis : ∀ n : ℕ, dist x ((g ^ n) • x) = n * D)
    (z : X) :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => dist z ((g ^ n) • x) - (n : ℝ) * D)
      atTop (𝓝 (orbitBusemann x g D z))

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.orbitCharacter_abs_le
statement:
lemma orbitCharacter_abs_le (hX : CAT0 X)
    (hi : ∀ g : G, Isometry (fun x : X => g • x))
    (x : X) (g : G) (D : ℝ) (hD : 0 < D)
    (haxis : ∀ n : ℕ, dist x ((g ^ n) • x) = n * D)
    {h : G} (hc : Commute g h) : |orbitCharacter x g D h| ≤ stableLengthAt x h

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.orbitCharacter_inv
statement:
lemma orbitCharacter_inv (hX : CAT0 X)
    (hi : ∀ g : G, Isometry (fun x : X => g • x))
    (x : X) (g : G) (D : ℝ) (hD : 0 < D)
    (haxis : ∀ n : ℕ, dist x ((g ^ n) • x) = n * D)
    {h : G} (hc : Commute g h) :
    orbitCharacter x g D h⁻¹ = -orbitCharacter x g D h

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.orbitCharacter_mul
statement:
lemma orbitCharacter_mul (hX : CAT0 X)
    (hi : ∀ g : G, Isometry (fun x : X => g • x))
    (x : X) (g : G) (D : ℝ) (hD : 0 < D)
    (haxis : ∀ n : ℕ, dist x ((g ^ n) • x) = n * D)
    {h k : G} (hc : Commute g h) :
    orbitCharacter x g D (h * k) = orbitCharacter x g D h + orbitCharacter x g D k

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.orbitCharacter_one
statement: lemma orbitCharacter_one (x : X) (g : G) (D : ℝ) : orbitCharacter x g D 1 = 0

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.orbitCharacter_pow
statement:
lemma orbitCharacter_pow (hX : CAT0 X)
    (hi : ∀ g : G, Isometry (fun x : X => g • x))
    (x : X) (g : G) (D : ℝ) (hD : 0 < D)
    (haxis : ∀ n : ℕ, dist x ((g ^ n) • x) = n * D)
    {h : G} (hc : Commute g h) (n : ℕ) :
    orbitCharacter x g D (h ^ n) = n * orbitCharacter x g D h

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.orbitCharacter_self
statement:
lemma orbitCharacter_self (hi : ∀ g : G, Isometry (fun x : X => g • x))
    (x : X) (g : G) (D : ℝ) (haxis : ∀ n : ℕ, dist x ((g ^ n) • x) = n * D) :
    orbitCharacter x g D g = D

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.orbitCharacter_zpow
statement:
lemma orbitCharacter_zpow (hX : CAT0 X)
    (hi : ∀ g : G, Isometry (fun x : X => g • x))
    (x : X) (g : G) (D : ℝ) (hD : 0 < D)
    (haxis : ∀ n : ℕ, dist x ((g ^ n) • x) = n * D)
    {h : G} (hc : Commute g h) (n : ℤ) :
    orbitCharacter x g D (h ^ n) = n * orbitCharacter x g D h

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.quadrilateral_difference
statement:
lemma quadrilateral_difference (hX : CAT0 X) (z w p q : X) :
    |dist z p ^ 2 + dist w q ^ 2 - dist w p ^ 2 - dist z q ^ 2| ≤
      dist z w ^ 2 + dist p q ^ 2

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.braidCenter_commute
statement:
lemma braidCenter_commute {s : ℕ → G} {m : ℕ} (hs : BraidRelations m s)
    {n i : ℕ} (hn : n ≤ m) (hi : i < n) : Commute (s i) (braidCenter s n)

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.braidCenter_congr
statement:
lemma braidCenter_congr {s t : ℕ → G} {n : ℕ} (he : ∀ i < n, s i = t i) :
    braidCenter s n = braidCenter t n

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.braidCenter_length_sq
statement:
lemma braidCenter_length_sq (hG : GeometricAction G X) (x : X)
    {s : ℕ → G} {m n i : ℕ} (hs : BraidRelations m s) (hn : n ≤ m) (hi : i < n) :
    stableLengthAt x (braidCenter s n)^2 =
      (n : ℝ) * (n+1) * lengthPairing x (s i) (braidCenter s n)

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.braidCenter_shift_conjugate
statement:
lemma braidCenter_shift_conjugate {s : ℕ → G} {m : ℕ} (hs : BraidRelations m s)
    {n k : ℕ} (hnk : n+k ≤ m) :
    (braidDelta s m)^k * braidCenter s n * ((braidDelta s m)^k)⁻¹ =
      braidCenter (fun i => s (i+k)) n

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.braidCenter_two
statement:
lemma braidCenter_two {s : ℕ → G} (h : s 0*s 1*s 0 = s 1*s 0*s 1) :
    braidCenter s 2 = (s 0*s 1)^3

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.braidDelta_conjugate
statement:
lemma braidDelta_conjugate {s : ℕ → G} {m : ℕ} (hs : BraidRelations m s)
    {i : ℕ} (hi : i + 1 < m) :
    braidDelta s m * s i * (braidDelta s m)⁻¹ = s (i+1)

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.braidDelta_pow_conjugate
statement:
lemma braidDelta_pow_conjugate {s : ℕ → G} {m : ℕ} (hs : BraidRelations m s)
    {i k : ℕ} (hik : i+k < m) :
    (braidDelta s m)^k * s i * ((braidDelta s m)^k)⁻¹ = s (i+k)

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.braidDelta_shift
statement:
lemma braidDelta_shift {s : ℕ → G} {m : ℕ} (hs : BraidRelations m s)
    {n i : ℕ} (hn : n ≤ m) (hi : i + 1 < n) :
    braidDelta s n * s i = s (i+1) * braidDelta s n

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.braidLoop_commute
statement:
lemma braidLoop_commute {s : ℕ → G} {m : ℕ} (hs : BraidRelations m s)
    {n i : ℕ} (hn : n ≤ m) (hi : i + 1 < n) : Commute (s i) (braidLoop s n)

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.braidLoop_congr
statement:
lemma braidLoop_congr {s t : ℕ → G} {n : ℕ} (he : ∀ i < n, s i = t i) :
    braidLoop s n = braidLoop t n

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.braidLoops_commute
statement:
lemma braidLoops_commute {s : ℕ → G} {m : ℕ} (hs : BraidRelations m s)
    {j k : ℕ} (hjk : j ≤ k) (hk : k ≤ m) : Commute (braidLoop s j) (braidLoop s k)

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.braid_center_character
statement:
lemma braid_center_character (hG : GeometricAction G X) (x : X)
    {s : ℕ → G} {m n : ℕ} (hs : BraidRelations m s) (hn : n+2 ≤ m) :
    lengthPairing x (s 0) (braidCenter s (n+2)) =
      lengthPairing x (s 0) (braidCenter s 2) + (n : ℝ)*lengthPairing x (s 0) (braidLoop s 2) +
        (n : ℝ)*(n+1)*lengthPairing x (s 0) (s 2)

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.braid_center_step
statement:
lemma braid_center_step {s L : G} (hc : Commute L (s*L*s)) :
    Commute s (L*(s*L*s))

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.braid_conjugate
statement: lemma braid_conjugate {a b : G} (h : a*b*a = b*a*b) : (a*b)*a*(a*b)⁻¹ = b

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.braid_forty_ratio
statement:
lemma braid_forty_ratio (hG : GeometricAction G X) (x : X)
    {s : ℕ → G} (hs : BraidRelations 39 s) (hD : 0 < stableLengthAt x ((s 0)^2)) :
    (stableLengthAt x ((s 0*s 1)^3) / (3*stableLengthAt x ((s 0)^2)))^2 ≥ 143/513 ∧
    stableLengthAt x ((s 0*s 1)^3) / (3*stableLengthAt x ((s 0)^2)) > 1/2 ∧
    stableLengthAt x ((s 0*s 1)^3) / (3*stableLengthAt x ((s 0)^2)) =
      stableLengthAt x ((s 0*s 1)^3) / (3*stableLengthAt x ((s 1)^2))

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.braid_forty_squared
statement:
lemma braid_forty_squared (hG : GeometricAction G X) (x : X)
    {s : ℕ → G} (hs : BraidRelations 39 s) :
    143 * stableLengthAt x ((s 0)^2)^2 ≤ 57 * stableLengthAt x ((s 0*s 1)^3)^2

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.braid_generator_length
statement:
lemma braid_generator_length (hG : GeometricAction G X) (x : X)
    {s : ℕ → G} {m i : ℕ} (hs : BraidRelations m s) (hi : i < m) :
    stableLengthAt x (s i) = stableLengthAt x (s 0)

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.braid_loop_character
statement:
lemma braid_loop_character (hG : GeometricAction G X) (x : X)
    {s : ℕ → G} {m n : ℕ} (hs : BraidRelations m s) (hn : n+2 ≤ m) :
    lengthPairing x (s 0) (braidLoop s (n+2)) =
      lengthPairing x (s 0) (braidLoop s 2) + 2*(n : ℝ)*lengthPairing x (s 0) (s 2)

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.braid_loop_step
statement:
lemma braid_loop_step {a b C : G} (hab : a*b*a = b*a*b) (hbC : Commute b C) :
    Commute a (b * (a*C*a) * b)

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.braid_nonadjacent_pairing
statement:
lemma braid_nonadjacent_pairing (hG : GeometricAction G X) (x : X)
    {s : ℕ → G} {m i j : ℕ} (hs : BraidRelations m s)
    (hi : i < m) (hj : j < m) (hij : i+2 ≤ j) :
    lengthPairing x (s i) (s j) = lengthPairing x (s 0) (s 2)

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.card_swapPositions
statement:
@[simp] lemma card_swapPositions (i : ℕ) (s : Finset ℕ) :
    (swapPositions i s).card = s.card

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.commute_braidCenter
statement:
lemma commute_braidCenter {g : G} {s : ℕ → G} {n : ℕ}
    (hc : ∀ i < n, Commute g (s i)) : Commute g (braidCenter s n)

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.commute_braidDelta
statement:
lemma commute_braidDelta {g : G} {s : ℕ → G} {n : ℕ}
    (hc : ∀ i < n, Commute g (s i)) : Commute g (braidDelta s n)

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.commute_braidLoop
statement:
lemma commute_braidLoop {g : G} {s : ℕ → G} {n : ℕ}
    (hc : ∀ i < n, Commute g (s i)) : Commute g (braidLoop s n)

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.equiangular_product_sq
statement:
lemma equiangular_product_sq (hG : GeometricAction G X) (x : X)
    {t : ℕ → G} {n : ℕ} {q v : ℝ}
    (hc : ∀ i j, i < j → j < n → Commute (t i) (t j))
    (hQ : ∀ i < n, stableLengthAt x (t i)^2 = q)
    (hP : ∀ i j, i < j → j < n → lengthPairing x (t i) (t j) = v) :
    stableLengthAt x (braidDelta t n)^2 = (n : ℝ)*q + (n : ℝ)*(n-1)*v

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.lengthPairing_braidCenter
statement:
lemma lengthPairing_braidCenter (hG : GeometricAction G X) (x : X)
    {g : G} {s : ℕ → G} {n : ℕ} {α : ℝ}
    (hc : ∀ i < n, Commute g (s i)) (he : ∀ i < n, lengthPairing x g (s i) = α) :
    lengthPairing x g (braidCenter s n) = (n : ℝ) * (n+1) * α

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.lengthPairing_braidDelta
statement:
lemma lengthPairing_braidDelta (hG : GeometricAction G X) (x : X)
    {g : G} {s : ℕ → G} {n : ℕ} {α : ℝ}
    (hc : ∀ i < n, Commute g (s i)) (he : ∀ i < n, lengthPairing x g (s i) = α) :
    lengthPairing x g (braidDelta s n) = (n : ℝ) * α

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.lengthPairing_braidLoop
statement:
lemma lengthPairing_braidLoop (hG : GeometricAction G X) (x : X)
    {g : G} {s : ℕ → G} {n : ℕ} {α : ℝ}
    (hc : ∀ i < n, Commute g (s i)) (he : ∀ i < n, lengthPairing x g (s i) = α) :
    lengthPairing x g (braidLoop s n) = 2 * (n : ℝ) * α

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.lengthPairing_braid_constant
statement:
lemma lengthPairing_braid_constant (hG : GeometricAction G X) (x : X)
    {g : G} {s : ℕ → G} {m n : ℕ} (hs : BraidRelations m s) (hn : n ≤ m)
    (hc : ∀ i < n, Commute g (s i)) {i : ℕ} (hi : i < n) :
    lengthPairing x g (s i) = lengthPairing x g (s 0)

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.lengthPairing_braid_equal
statement:
lemma lengthPairing_braid_equal (hG : GeometricAction G X) (x : X)
    {g a b : G} (hga : Commute g a) (hgb : Commute g b) (hab : a*b*a = b*a*b) :
    lengthPairing x g a = lengthPairing x g b

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.lengthPairing_disjoint_centers
statement:
lemma lengthPairing_disjoint_centers (hG : GeometricAction G X) (x : X)
    {s t : ℕ → G} {n k : ℕ} {α : ℝ}
    (hc : ∀ i < n, ∀ j < k, Commute (s i) (t j))
    (he : ∀ i < n, ∀ j < k, lengthPairing x (s i) (t j) = α) :
    lengthPairing x (braidCenter s n) (braidCenter t k) =
      (n : ℝ)*(n+1)*((k : ℝ)*(k+1))*α

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.lengthPairing_le_self_of_equal_length
statement:
lemma lengthPairing_le_self_of_equal_length (hG : GeometricAction G X) (x : X)
    {g h : G} (hc : Commute g h) (hL : stableLengthAt x g = stableLengthAt x h) :
    lengthPairing x g h ≤ stableLengthAt x g ^ 2

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.map_braidCenter
statement:
lemma map_braidCenter {H : Type*} [Group H] (f : G →* H) (s : ℕ → G) (n : ℕ) :
    f (braidCenter s n) = braidCenter (fun i => f (s i)) n

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.map_braidLoop
statement:
lemma map_braidLoop {H : Type*} [Group H] (f : G →* H) (s : ℕ → G) (n : ℕ) :
    f (braidLoop s n) = braidLoop (fun i => f (s i)) n

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.mem_swapPositions
statement:
@[simp] lemma mem_swapPositions (i k : ℕ) (s : Finset ℕ) :
    k ∈ swapPositions i s ↔ Equiv.swap i (i+1) k ∈ s

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.selectedPrefix_succ
statement:
lemma selectedPrefix_succ (i : ℕ) (s : Finset ℕ) :
    selectedPrefix (i+1) s = selectedPrefix i s + if i ∈ s then 1 else 0

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.selectedPrefix_swap
statement:
lemma selectedPrefix_swap (i j : ℕ) (s : Finset ℕ) (hij : j ≠ i+1) :
    selectedPrefix j (swapPositions i s) = selectedPrefix j s

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.selectedPrefix_zero_of_three
statement:
lemma selectedPrefix_zero_of_three (s : SelectedPositions) (i : ℕ)
    (h₀ : i ∈ s.val) (h₁ : i+1 ∈ s.val) (h₂ : i+2 ∈ s.val) :
    selectedPrefix i s.val = 0

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.selected_not_four
statement:
lemma selected_not_four (s : SelectedPositions) (i j : ℕ) (hij : i+2 ≤ j)
    (hi : i ∈ s.val) (hi' : i+1 ∈ s.val) (hj : j ∈ s.val) : j+1 ∉ s.val

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.swapPositions_braid
statement:
lemma swapPositions_braid (i : ℕ) (s : Finset ℕ) :
    swapPositions i (swapPositions (i+1) (swapPositions i s)) =
      swapPositions (i+1) (swapPositions i (swapPositions (i+1) s))

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.swapPositions_distant
statement:
lemma swapPositions_distant (i j : ℕ) (s : Finset ℕ) (hij : i+2 ≤ j) :
    swapPositions i (swapPositions j s) = swapPositions j (swapPositions i s)

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.swapPositions_twice
statement:
@[simp] lemma swapPositions_twice (i : ℕ) (s : Finset ℕ) :
    swapPositions i (swapPositions i s) = s

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.tokenPerm_braid
statement:
lemma tokenPerm_braid (u v : H) (h : u*v*u = v*u*v) (i : ℕ) :
    tokenPerm u v i * tokenPerm u v (i+1) * tokenPerm u v i =
      tokenPerm u v (i+1) * tokenPerm u v i * tokenPerm u v (i+1)

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.tokenPerm_distant
statement:
lemma tokenPerm_distant (u v : H) (i j : ℕ) (hij : i+2 ≤ j) :
    Commute (tokenPerm u v i) (tokenPerm u v j)

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.tokenRecord_distant
statement:
lemma tokenRecord_distant (u v : H) (i j : ℕ) (s : Finset ℕ) (hij : i+2 ≤ j) :
    tokenRecord u v i (swapPositions j s) = tokenRecord u v i s ∧
    tokenRecord u v j (swapPositions i s) = tokenRecord u v j s

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.tokenRecord_swap
statement:
@[simp] lemma tokenRecord_swap (u v : H) (i : ℕ) (s : Finset ℕ) :
    tokenRecord u v i (swapPositions i s) = tokenRecord u v i s

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.artinExponent_of
statement:
@[simp] lemma artinExponent_of (M : S → S → Label) (s : S) :
    artinExponent M (PresentedGroup.of s) = Multiplicative.ofAdd (1 : ℤ)

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.artin_generator_infinite_order
statement:
lemma artin_generator_infinite_order (M : S → S → Label) (s : S) :
    ¬ IsOfFinOrder (PresentedGroup.of (rels := artinRelators M) s)

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.braidGroup_commute
statement:
lemma braidGroup_commute (n i j : ℕ) (hij : i+2 ≤ j) (hj : j < n) :
    Commute (braidGen n i) (braidGen n j)

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.braidGroup_relation
statement:
lemma braidGroup_relation (n i : ℕ) (hi : i+1 < n) :
    braidGen n i * braidGen n (i+1) * braidGen n i =
      braidGen n (i+1) * braidGen n i * braidGen n (i+1)

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.braidGroup_relations
statement: lemma braidGroup_relations (n : ℕ) : BraidRelations n (braidGen n)

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.braidLift_gen
statement:
@[simp] lemma braidLift_gen {n : ℕ} (s : Fin n → H) (hb hc) (i : ℕ) (hi : i < n) :
    braidLift s hb hc (braidGen n i) = s ⟨i, hi⟩

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.braidLift_of
statement:
@[simp] lemma braidLift_of {n : ℕ} (s : Fin n → H) (hb hc) (i : Fin n) :
    braidLift s hb hc (PresentedGroup.of i) = s i

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.braidTokenRepresentation_initial
statement:
lemma braidTokenRepresentation_initial (g q : BraidGroup 2) :
    braidTokenRepresentation 2 g (initialSelected, q) = (initialSelected, g*q)

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.braidTokenRepresentation_two_injective
statement: lemma braidTokenRepresentation_two_injective : Function.Injective (braidTokenRepresentation 2)

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.initialBraidInclusion_injective
statement:
lemma initialBraidInclusion_injective (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) :
    Function.Injective (initialBraidInclusion n hn)

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.lift_alternating_constant
statement:
lemma lift_alternating_constant (c : H) (s t : S) (n : ℕ) :
    FreeGroup.lift (fun _ : S => c) (alternating s t n) = c^n

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.linkNeighbors_irrefl
statement: lemma linkNeighbors_irrefl : ∀ p : LinkDirection, p ∉ linkNeighbors p

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.linkNeighbors_symm
statement: lemma linkNeighbors_symm : ∀ p q : LinkDirection, p ∈ linkNeighbors q ↔ q ∈ linkNeighbors p

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.link_closed_walk_length
statement:
lemma link_closed_walk_length (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (v : ℕ → LinkDirection)
    (hadj : ∀ i < n, v (i+1) ∈ linkNeighbors (v i))
    (hnob : ∀ i, i+2 ≤ n → v (i+2) ≠ v i) (hclosed : v n = v 0) : 6 ≤ n

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.link_girth
statement:
lemma link_girth (n : ℕ) (hn : n < 5) (p q : LinkDirection) (h : q ∈ linkNeighbors p) :
    p ∉ linkEnds n p q

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.link_girth0
statement: lemma link_girth0 : ∀ p q : LinkDirection, q ∈ linkNeighbors p → p ∉ linkEnds 0 p q

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.link_girth1
statement: lemma link_girth1 : ∀ p q : LinkDirection, q ∈ linkNeighbors p → p ∉ linkEnds 1 p q

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.link_girth2
statement: lemma link_girth2 : ∀ p q : LinkDirection, q ∈ linkNeighbors p → p ∉ linkEnds 2 p q

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.link_girth3
statement: lemma link_girth3 : ∀ p q : LinkDirection, q ∈ linkNeighbors p → p ∉ linkEnds 3 p q

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.link_girth4
statement: lemma link_girth4 : ∀ p q : LinkDirection, q ∈ linkNeighbors p → p ∉ linkEnds 4 p q

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.mem_linkEnds_of_path
statement:
lemma mem_linkEnds_of_path (n : ℕ) (v : ℕ → LinkDirection)
    (hadj : ∀ i < n+1, v (i+1) ∈ linkNeighbors (v i))
    (hnob : ∀ i < n, v (i+2) ≠ v i) :
    v (n+1) ∈ linkEnds n (v 0) (v 1)

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.tokenPerm_initial
statement:
lemma tokenPerm_initial (i : Fin 2) (q : BraidGroup 2) :
    tokenPerm (braidGen 2 0) (braidGen 2 1) i.val (initialSelected, q) =
      (initialSelected, PresentedGroup.of i * q)

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.triangleExponent_H
statement:
@[simp] lemma triangleExponent_H (b : Fin 3) :
    triangleExponent (triangleH b) = Multiplicative.ofAdd (2 : ℤ)

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.triangleExponent_X
statement:
@[simp] lemma triangleExponent_X (b i : Fin 3) :
    triangleExponent (triangleX b i) = Multiplicative.ofAdd (1 : ℤ)

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.triangleExponent_gen
statement:
@[simp] lemma triangleExponent_gen (i : Fin 3) :
    triangleExponent (triangleGen i) = Multiplicative.ofAdd (1 : ℤ)

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.triangleLift_gen
statement:
@[simp] lemma triangleLift_gen {H : Type*} [Group H] (s : Fin 3 → H) (hb) (i : Fin 3) :
    triangleLift s hb (triangleGen i) = s i

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.trianglePair_injective
statement: lemma trianglePair_injective (i : Fin 3) : Function.Injective (trianglePair i)

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.trianglePair_leftInverse
statement:
lemma trianglePair_leftInverse (i : Fin 3) :
    (trianglePairRetraction i).comp (trianglePair i) = MonoidHom.id _

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.triangle_braid
statement:
lemma triangle_braid (i : Fin 3) :
    triangleGen i * triangleGen (i+1) * triangleGen i =
      triangleGen (i+1) * triangleGen i * triangleGen (i+1)

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.triangle_generator_infinite_order
statement: lemma triangle_generator_infinite_order (i : Fin 3) : ¬ IsOfFinOrder (triangleGen i)

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.triangular_relation
statement: lemma triangular_relation (b i : Fin 3) : triangleX b i * triangleX b (i+1) = triangleH b

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.TriangleMesh.boundarySum_coboundary
statement: lemma boundarySum_coboundary (p : V → ℝ) : M.boundarySum (M.coboundary p) = 0

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.TriangleMesh.degree_at_least_six
statement:
lemma degree_at_least_six [Fintype F] [Fintype V]
    (hs : Function.Surjective M.tail)
    (direction : Dart (F := F) → LinkDirection)
    (hadj : ∀ d, direction (M.turn d) ∈ linkNeighbors (direction d))
    (hnob : ∀ d, direction (M.turn (M.turn d)) ≠ direction d) :
    6 * Fintype.card V ≤ 3 * Fintype.card F

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.TriangleMesh.edgeRep_edge
statement: @[simp] lemma edgeRep_edge (e : M.Edge) : M.edgeRep e.val = e

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.TriangleMesh.edgeRep_mate
statement: lemma edgeRep_mate (d : Dart (F := F)) : M.edgeRep (M.mate d) = M.edgeRep d

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.TriangleMesh.edge_card
statement: lemma edge_card [Fintype F] [Fintype M.Edge] : 2 * Fintype.card M.Edge = 3 * Fintype.card F

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.TriangleMesh.exact_euler_inequality
statement:
lemma exact_euler_inequality [Fintype F] [Fintype V] [Nonempty F] (he : M.Exact) :
    3 * Fintype.card F < 2 * (Fintype.card V + Fintype.card F)

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.TriangleMesh.exact_iff
statement: lemma exact_iff : M.Exact ↔ M.boundarySum.ker = M.coboundary.range

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.TriangleMesh.exists_link_backtrack
statement:
theorem exists_link_backtrack [Fintype F] [Fintype V] [Nonempty F]
    (he : M.Exact) (hs : Function.Surjective M.tail)
    (direction : Dart (F := F) → LinkDirection)
    (hadj : ∀ d, direction (M.turn d) ∈ linkNeighbors (direction d)) :
    ∃ d, direction (M.turn (M.turn d)) = direction d

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.TriangleMesh.extend_coboundary
statement:
lemma extend_coboundary (p : V → ℝ) (d : Dart (F := F)) :
    M.extend (M.coboundary p) d = p (M.tail (rotate d)) - p (M.tail d)

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.TriangleMesh.extend_edge
statement: @[simp] lemma extend_edge (w : M.Edge → ℝ) (e : M.Edge) : M.extend w e.val = w e

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.TriangleMesh.extend_mate
statement: lemma extend_mate (w : M.Edge → ℝ) (d : Dart (F := F)) : M.extend w (M.mate d) = -M.extend w d

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.TriangleMesh.extend_of_antisymmetric
statement:
lemma extend_of_antisymmetric (w : Dart (F := F) → ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ d, w (M.mate d) = -w d) (d : Dart (F := F)) :
    M.extend (fun e => w e.val) d = w d

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.TriangleMesh.mate_mate
statement: @[simp] lemma mate_mate (d : Dart (F := F)) : M.mate (M.mate d) = d

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.TriangleMesh.rotate_apply
statement: @[simp] lemma rotate_apply (d : Dart (F := F)) : rotate d = (d.1,d.2+1)

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.TriangleMesh.rotate_symm_apply
statement: @[simp] lemma rotate_symm_apply (d : Dart (F := F)) : rotate.symm d = (d.1,d.2-1)

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.TriangleMesh.six_turns_injective
statement:
lemma six_turns_injective (direction : Dart (F := F) → LinkDirection)
    (hadj : ∀ d, direction (M.turn d) ∈ linkNeighbors (direction d))
    (hnob : ∀ d, direction (M.turn (M.turn d)) ≠ direction d)
    (d : Dart (F := F)) :
    Function.Injective (fun i : Fin 6 => M.turn^[i.val] d)

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.TriangleMesh.sum_boundarySum
statement: lemma sum_boundarySum [Fintype F] (w : M.Edge → ℝ) : ∑ f, M.boundarySum w f = 0

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.TriangleMesh.tail_iterate_turn
statement:
lemma tail_iterate_turn (d : Dart (F := F)) (n : ℕ) :
    M.tail (M.turn^[n] d) = M.tail d

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.TriangleMesh.tail_rotate_mate
statement: lemma tail_rotate_mate (d : Dart (F := F)) : M.tail (rotate (M.mate d)) = M.tail d

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.TriangleMesh.tail_turn
statement: @[simp] lemma tail_turn (d : Dart (F := F)) : M.tail (M.turn d) = M.tail d

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.TriangleMesh.turn_apply
statement: @[simp] lemma turn_apply (d : Dart (F := F)) : M.turn d = M.mate (rotate.symm d)

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.CAT0_subtype
statement: lemma CAT0_subtype (hX : CAT0 X) {C : Set X} (hC : GeodesicallyConvex C) : CAT0 C

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.displacementSublevel_closed
statement:
lemma displacementSublevel_closed (hi : ∀ g : G, Isometry (fun x : X => g • x))
    (q : ι → G) (A : ℝ) : IsClosed (displacementSublevel (X := X) q A)

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.displacementSublevel_convex
statement:
lemma displacementSublevel_convex (hX : CAT0 X)
    (hi : ∀ g : G, Isometry (fun x : X => g • x)) (q : ι → G) (A : ℝ) :
    GeodesicallyConvex (displacementSublevel (X := X) q A)

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.displacementSublevel_smul
statement:
lemma displacementSublevel_smul (hi : ∀ g : G, Isometry (fun x : X => g • x))
    (q : ι → G) (A : ℝ) (g : tupleCentralizer q)
    {x : X} (hx : x ∈ displacementSublevel q A) :
    g.val • x ∈ displacementSublevel q A

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.exists_sublevel_nonempty
statement:
lemma exists_sublevel_nonempty [Finite ι] [Nonempty X] (q : ι → G) :
    ∃ A : ℝ, 0 ≤ A ∧ Nonempty (displacementSublevel (X := X) q A)

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.sublevel_properSpace
statement:
lemma sublevel_properSpace [ProperSpace X]
    (hi : ∀ g : G, Isometry (fun x : X => g • x)) (q : ι → G) (A : ℝ) :
    ProperSpace (displacementSublevel (X := X) q A)

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.TargetTriangle.vertex_injective
statement: lemma TargetTriangle.vertex_injective (c : TargetTriangle) : Function.Injective c.vertex

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.TriangleMesh.Fold.extension_f_zero
statement:
@[simp] lemma extension_f_zero (w : C.Kept × Fin 3 → ℝ) :
    C.extension w (C.f,0) = -(C.sideValue w (C.f,1) + C.sideValue w (C.f,2))

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.TriangleMesh.Fold.extension_face
statement:
lemma extension_face (w : C.Kept × Fin 3 → ℝ)
    (ha : ∀ d, w (C.newMate d) = -w d)
    (hc : ∀ f, ∑ i : Fin 3, w (f,i) = 0) (f : F) :
    ∑ i : Fin 3, C.extension w (f,i) = 0

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.TriangleMesh.Fold.extension_g_zero
statement:
@[simp] lemma extension_g_zero (w : C.Kept × Fin 3 → ℝ) :
    C.extension w (C.g,0) = C.sideValue w (C.f,1) + C.sideValue w (C.f,2)

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.TriangleMesh.Fold.extension_mate
statement:
lemma extension_mate (w : C.Kept × Fin 3 → ℝ)
    (ha : ∀ d, w (C.newMate d) = -w d) (d : F × Fin 3) :
    C.extension w (M.mate d) = -C.extension w d

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.TriangleMesh.Fold.extension_outside
statement:
lemma extension_outside (w : C.Kept × Fin 3 → ℝ) (d : F × Fin 3) (hd : ¬ C.Removed d) :
    C.extension w d = w (C.toNewDart d hd)

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.TriangleMesh.Fold.extension_removed_nonzero
statement:
lemma extension_removed_nonzero (w : C.Kept × Fin 3 → ℝ) (d : F × Fin 3)
    (hd : C.Removed d) (hf : d ≠ (C.f,0)) (hg : d ≠ (C.g,0)) :
    C.extension w d = C.sideValue w d

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.TriangleMesh.Fold.mate_partner_outside
statement:
lemma mate_partner_outside (d : F × Fin 3) (hd : C.Removed d)
    (hm : ¬ C.Removed (M.mate d)) : ¬ C.Removed (M.mate (C.partner d))

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.TriangleMesh.Fold.mate_seam_reverse
statement: @[simp] lemma mate_seam_reverse : M.mate (C.g,0) = (C.f,0)

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.TriangleMesh.Fold.merge_opposite
statement: lemma merge_opposite : C.merge (M.tail (C.g,2)) = C.merge (M.tail (C.f,2))

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.TriangleMesh.Fold.merge_tail_partner
statement:
lemma merge_tail_partner (d : F × Fin 3) (hd : C.Removed d) :
    C.merge (M.tail (rotate (C.partner d))) = C.merge (M.tail d)

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.TriangleMesh.Fold.mesh_exact
statement: theorem mesh_exact (he : M.Exact) : C.mesh.Exact

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.TriangleMesh.Fold.newMate_involutive
statement: lemma newMate_involutive : Function.Involutive C.newMate

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.TriangleMesh.Fold.oldDart_injective
statement: lemma oldDart_injective : Function.Injective C.oldDart

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.TriangleMesh.Fold.oldDart_kept
statement: lemma oldDart_kept (d : C.Kept × Fin 3) : ¬ C.Removed (C.oldDart d)

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.TriangleMesh.Fold.oldDart_newMate
statement:
@[simp] lemma oldDart_newMate (d : C.Kept × Fin 3) :
    C.oldDart (C.newMate d) = C.splice (C.oldDart d)

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.TriangleMesh.Fold.oldDart_toNewDart
statement:
@[simp] lemma oldDart_toNewDart (d : F × Fin 3) (hd : ¬ C.Removed d) :
    C.oldDart (C.toNewDart d hd) = d

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.TriangleMesh.Fold.partner_f
statement: @[simp] lemma partner_f (i : Fin 3) : C.partner (C.f,i) = (C.g,-i)

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.TriangleMesh.Fold.partner_g
statement: @[simp] lemma partner_g (i : Fin 3) : C.partner (C.g,i) = (C.f,-i)

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.TriangleMesh.Fold.partner_ne
statement: lemma partner_ne (d : F × Fin 3) (hd : C.Removed d) : C.partner d ≠ d

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.TriangleMesh.Fold.partner_outside
statement: lemma partner_outside (d : F × Fin 3) (hd : ¬ C.Removed d) : C.partner d = d

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.TriangleMesh.Fold.partner_partner
statement: @[simp] lemma partner_partner (d : F × Fin 3) : C.partner (C.partner d) = d

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.TriangleMesh.Fold.partner_removed
statement: lemma partner_removed (d : F × Fin 3) (hd : C.Removed d) : C.Removed (C.partner d)

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.TriangleMesh.Fold.sideValue_g_one
statement:
lemma sideValue_g_one (w : C.Kept × Fin 3 → ℝ)
    (ha : ∀ d, w (C.newMate d) = -w d) :
    C.sideValue w (C.g,1) = -C.sideValue w (C.f,2)

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.TriangleMesh.Fold.sideValue_g_two
statement:
lemma sideValue_g_two (w : C.Kept × Fin 3 → ℝ)
    (ha : ∀ d, w (C.newMate d) = -w d) :
    C.sideValue w (C.g,2) = -C.sideValue w (C.f,1)

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.TriangleMesh.Fold.sideValue_partner
statement:
lemma sideValue_partner (w : C.Kept × Fin 3 → ℝ)
    (ha : ∀ d, w (C.newMate d) = -w d) (d : F × Fin 3) (hd : C.Removed d) :
    C.sideValue w (C.partner d) = -C.sideValue w d

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.TriangleMesh.Fold.splice_inside
statement:
lemma splice_inside (d : F × Fin 3) (h : C.Removed (M.mate d)) :
    C.splice d = M.mate (C.partner (M.mate d))

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.TriangleMesh.Fold.splice_kept
statement: lemma splice_kept (d : F × Fin 3) (hd : ¬ C.Removed d) : ¬ C.Removed (C.splice d)

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.TriangleMesh.Fold.splice_ne
statement: lemma splice_ne (d : F × Fin 3) (_hd : ¬ C.Removed d) : C.splice d ≠ d

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.TriangleMesh.Fold.splice_outside
statement:
lemma splice_outside (d : F × Fin 3) (h : ¬ C.Removed (M.mate d)) :
    C.splice d = M.mate d

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.TriangleMesh.Fold.splice_splice
statement: lemma splice_splice (d : F × Fin 3) (hd : ¬ C.Removed d) : C.splice (C.splice d) = d

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.TriangleMesh.Fold.tail_seam
statement: lemma tail_seam : M.tail (C.g,0) = M.tail (C.f,1)

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.TriangleMesh.Fold.tail_seam_reverse
statement: lemma tail_seam_reverse : M.tail (C.g,1) = M.tail (C.f,0)

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.TriangleMesh.Fold.toNewDart_oldDart
statement:
@[simp] lemma toNewDart_oldDart (d : C.Kept × Fin 3) :
    C.toNewDart (C.oldDart d) (C.oldDart_kept d) = d

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.TriangleMesh.Labeling.backtrack_cell
statement:
lemma backtrack_cell (d : F × Fin 3)
    (hb : L.direction (M.turn (M.turn d)) = L.direction d) :
    L.cell (M.turn d).1 = L.cell d.1 ∧
    L.cornerAt (M.turn d) = reverseCorner (L.cornerAt d)

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.TriangleMesh.Labeling.cellFlag_reverse
statement:
lemma cellFlag_reverse (b i : Fin 3) (p : CornerOrder) :
    cellFlag b i (reverseCorner p) = (cellFlag b i p).swap

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.TriangleMesh.Labeling.cornerShift_apply
statement: @[simp] lemma cornerShift_apply (i j : Fin 3) : cornerShift i j = i+j

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.TriangleMesh.Labeling.cornerSign_shift
statement:
lemma cornerSign_shift : ∀ (p : CornerOrder) (i : Fin 3),
    cornerSign (p * cornerShift i) = cornerSign p

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.TriangleMesh.Labeling.direction_mate
statement:
@[simp] lemma direction_mate (d : F × Fin 3) :
    L.direction (M.mate d) = reverseDirection (L.direction d)

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.TriangleMesh.Labeling.direction_partner
statement:
lemma direction_partner (C : M.Fold) (he : L.cell C.g = L.cell C.f)
    (d : F × Fin 3) (hd : C.Removed d) :
    L.direction (C.partner d) = reverseDirection (L.direction d)

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.TriangleMesh.Labeling.direction_turn
statement:
lemma direction_turn (d : F × Fin 3) :
    L.direction (M.turn d) = (L.cell d.1).direction (L.order d.1 d.2) (L.order d.1 (d.2+2))

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.TriangleMesh.Labeling.exists_equal_mates
statement:
lemma exists_equal_mates [Fintype F] [Nonempty F] (he : M.Exact) :
    ∃ d, L.cell (M.mate d).1 = L.cell d.1

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.TriangleMesh.Labeling.exists_phased_seam
statement:
lemma exists_phased_seam [Fintype F] [Nonempty F] (he : M.Exact) :
    ∃ (c : F → Fin 3) (f g : F),
      (M.rephase c).mate (f,0) = (g,0) ∧ L.cell g = L.cell f

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.TriangleMesh.Labeling.flag_cornerAt
statement:
lemma flag_cornerAt (d : F × Fin 3) :
    cellFlag (L.cell d.1).block (L.cell d.1).rel (L.cornerAt d) =
      (L.direction d, L.direction (M.turn d))

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.TriangleMesh.Labeling.link_adjacent
statement:
lemma link_adjacent (d : F × Fin 3) :
    L.direction (M.turn d) ∈ linkNeighbors (L.direction d)

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.TriangleMesh.Labeling.mate_face_ne
statement: lemma mate_face_ne (d : F × Fin 3) : (M.mate d).1 ≠ d.1

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.TriangleMesh.Labeling.order_seam_mate
statement:
lemma order_seam_mate : ∀ (b k : Fin 3) (p q : CornerOrder),
    q 0 = p 1 → q 1 = p 0 → ∀ i j : Fin 3,
    cellDirection b k (q j) (q (j+1)) =
      reverseDirection (cellDirection b k (p i) (p (i+1))) → j = -i

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.TriangleMesh.Labeling.order_seam_remaining
statement:
lemma order_seam_remaining : ∀ p q : CornerOrder,
    q 0 = p 1 → q 1 = p 0 → q 2 = p 2

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.TriangleMesh.Labeling.order_seam_sign
statement:
lemma order_seam_sign : ∀ p q : CornerOrder,
    q 0 = p 1 → q 1 = p 0 → cornerSign q = -cornerSign p

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.TriangleMesh.Labeling.orders_of_seam
statement:
lemma orders_of_seam {f g : F} (he : L.cell g = L.cell f)
    (hs : M.mate (f,0) = (g,0)) :
    L.order g 0 = L.order f 1 ∧ L.order g 1 = L.order f 0

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.TriangleMesh.Labeling.signedSum_active
statement:
@[simp] lemma signedSum_active [Fintype F] (w : TargetTriangle → ℤ) :
    L.active.signedSum w = L.signedSum w

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.TriangleMesh.Labeling.signedSum_folded
statement:
lemma signedSum_folded [Fintype F] (C : M.Fold) [Fintype C.Kept] (he : L.cell C.g = L.cell C.f)

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.mirrorVector_inv

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.orbit_chain_control
statement:
lemma orbit_chain_control (hG : GeometricAction G X) (y : X)
    {R C : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hdense : ∀ p : X, ∃ s : G, dist p (s • y) ≤ R)
    (f : G → ℝ)
    (hlocal : ∀ s t : G, dist (s • y) (t • y) ≤ 2*R+1 → |f t-f s| ≤ C)
    (s t : G) : |f t-f s| ≤ 2*C*(1+dist (s • y) (t • y))

statement:
lemma orbit_uniformly_dense (hG : GeometricAction G X) (y : X) :

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.GridDisk.boundary_iff

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.GridDisk.cocycle_relations
statement:
lemma cocycle_relations (w : Face H N × Fin 3 → ℝ)
    (ha : ∀ d, ¬ (patch H N).Boundary d → w ((patch H N).mate d) = -w d) :
    (∀ r i, w (A H N r i,1) = -w (B H N r (i+1),2)) ∧
    (∀ r i, w (A H N r i,2) = -w (B H N r i,0)) ∧
    (∀ r i, w (B H N r i,1) = -upper H N w r i) ∧
    (∀ i, w (C H N i,1) = -w (C H N (i+1),2))
