statement:
lemma triangleBoundary_length (g : TriangleGroup) (u v w : Word) (K : ℕ)
    (hu : u.toList.length+1 ≤ K) (hv : v.toList.length+1 ≤ K) (hw : w.toList.length+1 ≤ K) :
    (triangleBoundary g u v w K).length = 3*K

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.WordDiagram.triangle_strip_nat
statement:
lemma triangle_strip_nat (l r : List TriangleGroup) (a b c g : TriangleGroup)
    (h : Legal a b c)
    (hp : ∀ n, Edge ((l++[a,b,c]++r).getD n g) ((l++[a,b,c]++r).getD (n+1) g)) (n : ℕ) :
    Legal ((l++[a,c]++r).getD n g) ((l++[a,c]++r).getD (n+1) g) ((l++[a,b,c]++r).getD (n+1) g) ∧
    Legal ((l++[a,c]++r).getD n g) ((l++[a,b,c]++r).getD (n+1) g) ((l++[a,b,c]++r).getD n g)

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.WordDiagram.walk_append
statement:
lemma walk_append (g : TriangleGroup) (u v : List Letter) :
    walk g (u++v) = (walk g u).dropLast ++ walk (g*eval (FreeMonoid.ofList u)) v

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.WordDiagram.walk_append_chain
statement:
lemma walk_append_chain (g : TriangleGroup) (w : List Letter) :
    List.IsChain Edge (walk g w ++ [g*eval (FreeMonoid.ofList w)])

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.WordDiagram.walk_append_one
statement:
lemma walk_append_one (g : TriangleGroup) (l : List Letter) (s : Letter) :
    walk g (l++[s]) = walk g l ++ [g*eval (FreeMonoid.ofList l)*signed s]

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.WordDiagram.walk_concat
statement:
lemma walk_concat (g : TriangleGroup) (u v : List Letter) :
    PathHomotopy (walk g (u++v)) (walk g u ++ walk (g*eval (FreeMonoid.ofList u)) v)

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.WordDiagram.walk_context
statement:
lemma walk_context {u v : Word} (he : eval u = eval v)
    (h : ∀ g, PathHomotopy (walk g u.toList) (walk g v.toList))
    (l r : Word) (g : TriangleGroup) :
    PathHomotopy (walk g (l*u*r).toList) (walk g (l*v*r).toList)

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.WordDiagram.walk_good
statement: lemma walk_good (g : TriangleGroup) (w : Word) (h : eval w = 1) : GoodPath g (walk g w.toList)

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.WordDiagram.walk_head
statement: lemma walk_head (g : TriangleGroup) (w : List Letter) : (walk g w).head (walk_ne_nil g w) = g

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.WordDiagram.walk_join
statement:
lemma walk_join (g : TriangleGroup) (u v : List Letter) :
    ReflTransGen PathStep (walk g u ++ walk (g*eval (FreeMonoid.ofList u)) v) (walk g (u++v))

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.WordDiagram.walk_last_append
statement:
lemma walk_last_append (g : TriangleGroup) (l : List Letter) :
    (walk g l).dropLast ++ [g*eval (FreeMonoid.ofList l)] = walk g l

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.WordDiagram.walk_length
statement: lemma walk_length (g : TriangleGroup) (w : List Letter) : (walk g w).length = w.length+1

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.WordDiagram.walk_ne_nil
statement: lemma walk_ne_nil (g : TriangleGroup) (w : List Letter) : walk g w ≠ []

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.WordDiagram.walk_pad_contract
statement:
lemma walk_pad_contract (g : TriangleGroup) (w : List Letter) (k : ℕ) :
    ReflTransGen PathStep (walk g w ++ List.replicate k (g*eval (FreeMonoid.ofList w))) (walk g w)

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.WordDiagram.walk_reverse
statement:
lemma walk_reverse (g : TriangleGroup) (l : List Letter) :
    (walk g l).reverse = walk (g*eval (FreeMonoid.ofList l)) (inverseLetters l)

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.commuting_minimizer
OAI.ArtinCAT0.commuting_minimizer_product
statement:
lemma commuting_minimizer_product (hG : GeometricAction G X) (x : X) {g h : G}
    (hc : Commute g h)
    (hg : dist x (g • x) = stableLengthAt x g)
    (hh : dist x (h • x) = stableLengthAt x h) :
    dist x ((g*h) • x) = stableLengthAt x (g*h)

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.commuting_orbit_uniform
OAI.ArtinCAT0.directionSignature_injective
statement: lemma directionSignature_injective : Function.Injective directionSignature

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.directionValue_degree
statement:
lemma directionValue_degree (d : LinkDirection) :
    (triangleExponent (directionValue d)).toAdd = directionDegree d

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.directionValue_injective
statement: lemma directionValue_injective : Function.Injective directionValue

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.directionValue_linear
statement:
lemma directionValue_linear (d : LinkDirection) :
    mirrorLinear (directionValue d) = directionPerm d

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.directionValue_negative
statement: @[simp] lemma directionValue_negative (q : Fin 9) : directionValue (negativeDirection q) = (positiveValue q)⁻¹

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.directionValue_positive
statement: @[simp] lemma directionValue_positive (q : Fin 9) : directionValue (positiveDirection q) = positiveValue q

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.minimizer_of_length_eq
statement:
lemma minimizer_of_length_eq (hi : ∀ g : G, Isometry (fun x : X => g • x))
    (x y : X) (g : G) (hx : dist x (g • x) = stableLengthAt y g) :
    ∀ z : X, dist x (g • x) ≤ dist z (g • z)

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.minimizer_zpow
statement:
lemma minimizer_zpow (hG : GeometricAction G X) (x : X) (g : G)
    (hx : ∀ z : X, dist x (g • x) ≤ dist z (g • z)) (i : ℤ) :
    dist x ((g^i) • x) = stableLengthAt x (g^i)

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.positiveValue_degree
statement:
lemma positiveValue_degree (q : Fin 9) :
    (triangleExponent (positiveValue q)).toAdd = positiveDegree q

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.positiveValue_hLetter
statement: @[simp] lemma positiveValue_hLetter (b : Fin 3) : positiveValue (hLetter b) = triangleH b

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.positiveValue_linear
statement: lemma positiveValue_linear (q : Fin 9) : mirrorLinear (positiveValue q) = positivePerm q

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.positiveValue_xLetter
statement: @[simp] lemma positiveValue_xLetter (b i : Fin 3) : positiveValue (xLetter b i) = triangleX b i

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.SectorMetric.chord_axis1
statement:
lemma chord_axis1 {c t r : ℝ} (hc : 1/2 ≤ c) (hc' : c ≤ 1)
    (ht : t ∈ Set.Icc 0 1) (hr : 0 ≤ r) :
    ‖vec c ((unit c t).1-r,(unit c t).2)‖^2 ≤ 1+r^2-2*c*r

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.SectorMetric.chord_axis2
statement:
lemma chord_axis2 {c t r : ℝ} (hc : 1/2 ≤ c) (hc' : c ≤ 1)
    (ht : t ∈ Set.Icc 0 1) (hr : 0 ≤ r) :
    ‖vec c ((unit c t).1,(unit c t).2-r)‖^2 ≤ 1+r^2-2*c*r

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.SectorMetric.detour_gap
statement:
lemma detour_gap {c : ℝ} (hc : 1/2 < c) (hc' : c ≤ 1) :
    ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ r < 1 ∧ 0 < 1+r^2-2*c*r ∧
      2*Real.sqrt (1+r^2-2*c*r)+r < 2

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.SectorMetric.floor_error
statement:
lemma floor_error {L : ℝ} (hL : 0<L) (x : ℝ) :
    |(⌊x/L⌋ : ℝ)*L-x| ≤ L

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.SectorMetric.lattice_length
statement:
lemma lattice_length (hG : GeometricAction G X) (y : X) {g h : G}
    (hcomm : Commute g h) {c : ℝ} (hc : |c| ≤ 1)
    (hp : lengthPairing y g h = c*stableLengthAt y g*stableLengthAt y h) (i j : ℤ) :
    stableLengthAt y (g^i*h^j) =
      ‖vec c ((i:ℝ)*stableLengthAt y g,(j:ℝ)*stableLengthAt y h)‖

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.SectorMetric.lattice_metric
statement:
theorem lattice_metric (hG : GeometricAction G X) (y : X) {g h : G}
    (hg : 0<stableLengthAt y g) (hh : 0<stableLengthAt y h) (hcomm : Commute g h)
    {c : ℝ} (hc : |c|≤1)
    (hp : lengthPairing y g h = c*stableLengthAt y g*stableLengthAt y h) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ p q : Point,
      |dist (lattice g h (stableLengthAt y g) (stableLengthAt y h) p • y)
          (lattice g h (stableLengthAt y g) (stableLengthAt y h) q • y) -
        ‖vec c (q.1-p.1,q.2-p.2)‖| ≤ C

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.SectorMetric.lattice_origin
statement: lemma lattice_origin (g h : G) (L M : ℝ) : lattice g h L M (0,0) = 1

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.SectorMetric.mixNorm_bounds
statement:
lemma mixNorm_bounds {c t : ℝ} (hc : 1/2 ≤ c) (hc' : c ≤ 1) (ht : t ∈ Set.Icc 0 1) :
    1/2 ≤ mixNorm c t ∧ mixNorm c t ≤ 1

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.SectorMetric.mixNorm_lipschitz
statement:
lemma mixNorm_lipschitz {c : ℝ} (hc : |c| ≤ 1) (s t : ℝ) :
    |mixNorm c s-mixNorm c t| ≤ 2*|s-t|

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.SectorMetric.powers_difference
statement:
lemma powers_difference {g h : G} (hc : Commute g h) (i j k l : ℤ) :
    (g^i*h^j)⁻¹*(g^k*h^l) = g^(k-i)*h^(l-j)

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.SectorMetric.quotient_lipschitz
statement:
lemma quotient_lipschitz {a b u v : ℝ} (_ha : |a| ≤ 1) (hb : |b| ≤ 1)
    (hu : 1/2 ≤ u) (hv : 1/2 ≤ v) :
    |a/u-b/v| ≤ 2*|a-b|+4*|u-v|

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.SectorMetric.unit_lipschitz
statement:
lemma unit_lipschitz {c s t : ℝ} (hc : 1/2 ≤ c) (hc' : c ≤ 1)
    (hs : s ∈ Set.Icc 0 1) (ht : t ∈ Set.Icc 0 1) :
    |(unit c s).1-(unit c t).1| ≤ 10*|s-t| ∧
    |(unit c s).2-(unit c t).2| ≤ 10*|s-t|

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.SectorMetric.unit_nonneg
statement:
lemma unit_nonneg {c t : ℝ} (hc : 1/2 ≤ c) (hc' : c ≤ 1) (ht : t ∈ Set.Icc 0 1) :
    0 ≤ (unit c t).1 ∧ 0 ≤ (unit c t).2

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.SectorMetric.unit_one
statement: @[simp] lemma unit_one (c : ℝ) (hc : |c| ≤ 1) : unit c 1 = (0,1)

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.SectorMetric.unit_pairing1
statement:
lemma unit_pairing1 {c t : ℝ} (hc : 1/2 ≤ c) (hc' : c ≤ 1) (ht : t ∈ Set.Icc 0 1) :
    c ≤ (unit c t).1+c*(unit c t).2

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.SectorMetric.unit_pairing2
statement:
lemma unit_pairing2 {c t : ℝ} (hc : 1/2 ≤ c) (hc' : c ≤ 1) (ht : t ∈ Set.Icc 0 1) :
    c ≤ c*(unit c t).1+(unit c t).2

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.SectorMetric.unit_sum
statement:
lemma unit_sum {c t : ℝ} (hc : 1/2 ≤ c) (hc' : c ≤ 1) (ht : t ∈ Set.Icc 0 1) :
    1 ≤ (unit c t).1+(unit c t).2 ∧ (unit c t).1+(unit c t).2 ≤ 2

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.SectorMetric.unit_vec
statement:
lemma unit_vec {c t : ℝ} (hc : 1/2 ≤ c) (hc' : c ≤ 1) (ht : t ∈ Set.Icc 0 1) :
    ‖vec c (unit c t)‖ = 1

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.SectorMetric.unit_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma unit_zero (c : ℝ) : unit c 0 = (1,0)

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.SectorMetric.vec_add
statement: lemma vec_add (c : ℝ) (p q : Point) : vec c (p.1+q.1,p.2+q.2) = vec c p + vec c q

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.SectorMetric.vec_basis1
statement: lemma vec_basis1 (c : ℝ) : ‖vec c (1,0)‖ = 1

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.SectorMetric.vec_basis2
statement: lemma vec_basis2 (c : ℝ) (hc : |c| ≤ 1) : ‖vec c (0,1)‖ = 1

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.SectorMetric.vec_bound
statement: lemma vec_bound (c : ℝ) (hc : |c| ≤ 1) (p : Point) : ‖vec c p‖ ≤ |p.1|+|p.2|

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.SectorMetric.vec_lipschitz
statement:
lemma vec_lipschitz (c : ℝ) (hc : |c| ≤ 1) (p q : Point) :
    |‖vec c p‖-‖vec c q‖| ≤ |p.1-q.1|+|p.2-q.2|

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.SectorMetric.vec_mul
statement: lemma vec_mul (c a : ℝ) (p : Point) : vec c (a*p.1,a*p.2) = (a : ℂ)*vec c p

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.SectorMetric.vec_sq
statement:
lemma vec_sq (c : ℝ) (hc : |c| ≤ 1) (p : Point) :
    ‖vec c p‖^2 = p.1^2+p.2^2+2*c*p.1*p.2

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.SectorMetric.vec_sub
statement: lemma vec_sub (c : ℝ) (p q : Point) : vec c (p.1-q.1,p.2-q.2) = vec c p - vec c q

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.SectorMetric.vec_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma vec_zero (c : ℝ) : vec c (0,0) = 0

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.SixSector.adjacent_square_length
statement:
lemma adjacent_square_length (hG : GeometricAction TriangleGroup X) (y : X) (i : Fin 3) :
    stableLengthAt y (triangleGen (i+1)^2) = stableLengthAt y (triangleGen i^2)

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.SixSector.cosine_le_one
statement:
lemma cosine_le_one (hG : GeometricAction TriangleGroup X) (y : X) (hR : StrictRatios y) (i : Fin 6) :
    cosine y i ≤ 1

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.SixSector.cosine_lower
statement:
lemma cosine_lower (hG : GeometricAction TriangleGroup X) (y : X) (hR : StrictRatios y) (i : Fin 6) :
    1/2 < cosine y i

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.SixSector.generator_square_length_pos
statement:
lemma generator_square_length_pos (hG : GeometricAction TriangleGroup X) (y : X) (i : Fin 3) :
    0 < stableLengthAt y (triangleGen i ^ 2)

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.SixSector.ray_commute
statement: lemma ray_commute (i : Fin 6) : Commute (ray i) (ray (i+1))

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.SixSector.ray_even
statement: lemma ray_even (i : Fin 3) : ray ⟨2*i.val,by omega⟩ = triangleGen i ^ 2

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.SixSector.ray_length_pos
statement:
lemma ray_length_pos (hG : GeometricAction TriangleGroup X) (y : X) (hR : StrictRatios y) (i : Fin 6) :
    0 < stableLengthAt y (ray i)

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.SixSector.ray_odd
statement: lemma ray_odd (i : Fin 3) : ray ⟨2*i.val+1,by omega⟩ = triangleH i ^ 3

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.braid_three_commute
statement: lemma braid_three_commute (h : a*b*a = b*a*b) : Commute a ((a*b)^3) ∧ Commute b ((a*b)^3)

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.braid_three_pairing
statement:
lemma braid_three_pairing (hG : GeometricAction G X) (y : X) (h : a*b*a = b*a*b) :
    lengthPairing y (a^2) ((a*b)^3) = stableLengthAt y ((a*b)^3)^2/3 ∧
    lengthPairing y (b^2) ((a*b)^3) = stableLengthAt y ((a*b)^3)^2/3

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.lengthPairing_abs_le
statement:
lemma lengthPairing_abs_le (hG : GeometricAction G X) (y : X) {g h : G} (hc : Commute g h) :
    |lengthPairing y g h| ≤ stableLengthAt y g * stableLengthAt y h

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.twoBraid_relations
statement: lemma twoBraid_relations (h : a*b*a = b*a*b) : BraidRelations 2 (twoBraid a b)

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.SixSector.lattice_plane
statement:
lemma lattice_plane (i : Fin 6) (L M : ℝ) (p : ℝ × ℝ) :
    mirrorPlane (SectorMetric.lattice (ray i) (ray (i+1)) L M p) =
      ((⌊p.1/L⌋:ℝ)*(planeRay i).1+(⌊p.2/M⌋:ℝ)*(planeRay (i+1)).1,
       (⌊p.1/L⌋:ℝ)*(planeRay i).2+(⌊p.2/M⌋:ℝ)*(planeRay (i+1)).2)

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.SixSector.ray_plane
statement: lemma ray_plane (i : Fin 6) : mirrorPlane (ray i) = planeRay i

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.SixSector.ray_pure
statement: lemma ray_pure (i : Fin 6) : mirrorLinear (ray i) = 1

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.SixSector.ray_rep_even
statement:
lemma ray_rep_even (i : Fin 3) :
    mirrorRepresentation (triangleGen i^2) =
      ⟨Multiplicative.ofAdd (2 • mirrorBasis (sideMirror i)),1⟩

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.SixSector.ray_rep_odd
statement:
lemma ray_rep_odd (i : Fin 3) :
    mirrorRepresentation (triangleH i^3) =
      ⟨Multiplicative.ofAdd (2 • (mirrorBasis (sideMirror i)+mirrorBasis (extraMirror i)+
        mirrorBasis (sideMirror (i+1)))),1⟩

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.WordDiagram.TargetLegal_translate
OAI.ArtinCAT0.WordDiagram.eval_inverseWord
statement: @[simp] lemma eval_inverseWord (w : Word) : eval (inverseWord w) = (eval w)⁻¹

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.WordDiagram.eval_sideFlip
statement: @[simp] lemma eval_sideFlip (s : Side) : eval (sideWord (sideFlip s)) = (eval (sideWord s))⁻¹

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.WordDiagram.finite_template_fillers
statement:
theorem finite_template_fillers {I : Type*} [Fintype I] (s : I → Fin 3 → Side)
    (hs : ∀ i, closedSides (s i)) :
    ∃ K H : ℕ, ∃ hK : 0 < K, letI : NeZero (3*K)

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.WordDiagram.fullSide_head
statement:
lemma fullSide_head (g : TriangleGroup) (w : Word) (K : ℕ) :
    (fullSide g w K).head? = some g

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.WordDiagram.fullSide_last
statement:
lemma fullSide_last (g : TriangleGroup) (w : Word) (K : ℕ) (h : w.toList.length+2 ≤ K) :
    (fullSide g w K).getLast? = some (g*eval w)

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.WordDiagram.fullSide_translate
statement:
lemma fullSide_translate (a g : TriangleGroup) (w : Word) (K : ℕ) :
    fullSide (a*g) w K = (fullSide g w K).map (a*·)

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.WordDiagram.getD_dropLast
statement:
lemma getD_dropLast {α : Type*} (l : List α) (d : α) (n : ℕ) (h : n < l.length-1) :
    l.dropLast.getD n d = l.getD n d

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.WordDiagram.path_grid_pos
statement:
lemma path_grid_pos {p q : List TriangleGroup} (h : PathHomotopy p q) (g : TriangleGroup) :
    ∃ B : ℕ, ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N], B < N → GoodPath g p →
      ReflTransGen Strip (padded g p : Row N) (padded g q)

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.WordDiagram.sideBoundary_contract
statement:
lemma sideBoundary_contract (s : Fin 3 → Side) (K : ℕ) (h : ∀ i, (s i).1.toList.length+2 ≤ K) :
    ReflTransGen PathStep (sideBoundary s K)
      (walk 1 (sideWord (s 0)*sideWord (s 1)*sideWord (s 2)).toList)

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.WordDiagram.sideBoundary_get
statement:
lemma sideBoundary_get (s : Fin 3 → Side) (hs : closedSides s)
    (K : ℕ) [NeZero K] (h : ∀ i, (s i).1.toList.length+2 ≤ K)
    (i : Fin 3) (j : Fin (K+1)) :
    (sideBoundary s K).getD (GridDisk.sideIndex K i j).val 1 =
      (sideFull (startLabel s i) (s i) K).getD j.val 1

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.WordDiagram.sideBoundary_get_interior
statement:
lemma sideBoundary_get_interior (s : Fin 3 → Side)
    (K : ℕ) [NeZero K] (h : ∀ i, (s i).1.toList.length+2 ≤ K)
    (i : Fin 3) (j : ℕ) (hj : j<K) :
    (sideBoundary s K).getD (i.val*K+j) 1 =
      (sideFull (startLabel s i) (s i) K).getD j 1

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.WordDiagram.sideBoundary_length
statement:
lemma sideBoundary_length (s : Fin 3 → Side) (K : ℕ) (h : ∀ i, (s i).1.toList.length+1 ≤ K) :
    (sideBoundary s K).length = 3*K

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.WordDiagram.sideFull_contract
statement:
lemma sideFull_contract (g : TriangleGroup) (s : Side) (K : ℕ) (h : s.1.toList.length+2 ≤ K) :
    ReflTransGen PathStep (sideFull g s K).dropLast (walk g (sideWord s).toList)

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.WordDiagram.sideFull_getReverse
statement:
lemma sideFull_getReverse (g : TriangleGroup) (s : Side) (K : ℕ)
    (h : s.1.toList.length+1 ≤ K) (j : Fin (K+1)) :
    (sideFull (g*eval (sideWord s)) (sideFlip s) K).getD j.rev.val 1 =
      (sideFull g s K).getD j.val 1

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.WordDiagram.sideFull_getTranslate
statement:
lemma sideFull_getTranslate (a g : TriangleGroup) (s : Side) (K : ℕ)
    (h : s.1.toList.length+1 ≤ K) (j : Fin (K+1)) :
    (sideFull (a*g) s K).getD j.val 1 = a*(sideFull g s K).getD j.val 1

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.WordDiagram.sideFull_head
statement:
lemma sideFull_head (g : TriangleGroup) (s : Side) (K : ℕ) (h : s.1.toList.length+2 ≤ K) :
    (sideFull g s K).head? = some g

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.WordDiagram.sideFull_last
statement:
lemma sideFull_last (g : TriangleGroup) (s : Side) (K : ℕ) (h : s.1.toList.length+2 ≤ K) :
    (sideFull g s K).getLast? = some (g*eval (sideWord s))

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.WordDiagram.sideFull_length
statement:
lemma sideFull_length (g : TriangleGroup) (s : Side) (K : ℕ) (h : s.1.toList.length+1 ≤ K) :
    (sideFull g s K).length = K+1

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.WordDiagram.sideFull_reverse
statement:
lemma sideFull_reverse (g : TriangleGroup) (s : Side) (K : ℕ) :
    (sideFull g s K).reverse = sideFull (g*eval (sideWord s)) (sideFlip s) K

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.WordDiagram.sideFull_translate
statement:
lemma sideFull_translate (a g : TriangleGroup) (s : Side) (K : ℕ) :
    sideFull (a*g) s K = (sideFull g s K).map (a*·)

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.WordDiagram.startLabel_next
statement:
lemma startLabel_next (s : Fin 3 → Side) (h : closedSides s) (i : Fin 3) :
    startLabel s i * eval (sideWord (s i)) = startLabel s (i+1)

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.WordDiagram.walk_translate
statement:
lemma walk_translate (a g : TriangleGroup) (w : List Letter) :
    walk (a*g) w = (walk g w).map (a*·)

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.mirrorLinear_inv
statement: @[simp] lemma mirrorLinear_inv (g : TriangleGroup) : mirrorLinear g⁻¹ = (mirrorLinear g)⁻¹

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.mirrorLinear_one
statement: @[simp] lemma mirrorLinear_one : mirrorLinear 1 = 1

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.mirrorLinear_zpow
statement:
@[simp] lemma mirrorLinear_zpow (g : TriangleGroup) (n : ℤ) :
    mirrorLinear (g^n) = mirrorLinear g ^ n

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.mirrorPlane_mul_bound
statement:
lemma mirrorPlane_mul_bound (g h : TriangleGroup) {D : ℝ}
    (hh : ∀ d, |mirrorVector h d| ≤ D) :
    |(mirrorPlane (g*h)).1-(mirrorPlane g).1| ≤ D ∧
    |(mirrorPlane (g*h)).2-(mirrorPlane g).2| ≤ D

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.mirrorPlane_one
statement: @[simp] lemma mirrorPlane_one : mirrorPlane 1 = (0,0)

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.mirrorPlane_pure_mul
statement:
lemma mirrorPlane_pure_mul {g : TriangleGroup} (hg : mirrorLinear g = 1) (h : TriangleGroup) :
    mirrorPlane (g*h) = ( (mirrorPlane g).1+(mirrorPlane h).1,
      (mirrorPlane g).2+(mirrorPlane h).2)

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.mirrorPlane_pure_zpow
statement:
lemma mirrorPlane_pure_zpow {g : TriangleGroup} (hg : mirrorLinear g = 1) (n : ℤ) :
    mirrorPlane (g^n) = ((n:ℝ)*(mirrorPlane g).1,(n:ℝ)*(mirrorPlane g).2)

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.mirrorVector_pure_mul
statement:
lemma mirrorVector_pure_mul {g : TriangleGroup} (hg : mirrorLinear g = 1)
    (h : TriangleGroup) (d : Mirror) :
    mirrorVector (g*h) d = mirrorVector g d + mirrorVector h d

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.mirrorVector_pure_pow
statement:
lemma mirrorVector_pure_pow {g : TriangleGroup} (hg : mirrorLinear g = 1)
    (n : ℕ) (d : Mirror) : mirrorVector (g^n) d = (n:ℝ)*mirrorVector g d

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.mirrorVector_pure_zpow
statement:
lemma mirrorVector_pure_zpow {g : TriangleGroup} (hg : mirrorLinear g = 1)
    (n : ℤ) (d : Mirror) : mirrorVector (g^n) d = (n:ℝ)*mirrorVector g d

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.SixSector.angular_parameter
statement: lemma angular_parameter {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (j : Fin N) : (j.val/(N:ℝ)) ∈ Set.Icc 0 1

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.SixSector.axis_adjacent
statement:
lemma axis_adjacent {R : ℝ} (hR0 : 0≤R) (i : Fin 6) :
    dist (axis y i R • y) (axis y (i+1) R • y) ≤ R+C

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.SixSector.axis_radius
statement:
lemma axis_radius {R : ℝ} (hR0 : 0≤R) (i : Fin 6) :
    |dist y (axis y i R • y)-R| ≤ C

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.SixSector.chart_axis1
statement: @[simp] lemma chart_axis1 (y : X) (i : Fin 6) (R : ℝ) : chart y i (R,0) = axis y i R

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.SixSector.chart_axis2
statement: @[simp] lemma chart_axis2 (y : X) (i : Fin 6) (R : ℝ) : chart y i (0,R) = axis y (i+1) R

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.SixSector.chart_uniform
statement:
theorem chart_uniform (hG : GeometricAction TriangleGroup X) (y : X) (hR : StrictRatios y) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0≤C ∧ ∀ i p q,
      |dist (chart y i p • y) (chart y i q • y)-‖vec (cosine y i) (q.1-p.1,q.2-p.2)‖| ≤ C

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.SixSector.chart_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma chart_zero (y : X) (i : Fin 6) : chart y i (0,0) = 1

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.SixSector.circle_axis_chord
statement:
lemma circle_axis_chord {c r R : ℝ} (hc : ∀ i, c≤cosine y i) (hr : 0≤r) (hR0 : 0≤R)
    (i : Fin 6) {t : ℝ} (ht : t∈Set.Icc 0 1) :
    dist (axis y i (r*R) • y) (circle y R i t • y) ≤ R*Real.sqrt (1+r^2-2*c*r)+C ∧
    dist (axis y (i+1) (r*R) • y) (circle y R i t • y) ≤ R*Real.sqrt (1+r^2-2*c*r)+C

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.SixSector.circle_detour
statement:
lemma circle_detour (hG : GeometricAction TriangleGroup X) (y : X) (hR : StrictRatios y)
    {C : ℝ} (hC : 0≤C)
    (hchart : ∀ i p q, |dist (chart y i p • y) (chart y i q • y)-
      ‖vec (cosine y i) (q.1-p.1,q.2-p.2)‖| ≤ C)
    {c r R : ℝ} (hc : ∀ i, c≤cosine y i) (hr : 0≤r) (hR0 : 0≤R)
    (i : Fin 6) {t : ℝ} (ht : t∈Set.Icc 0 1) :
    dist (axis y 0 R • y) (circle y R i t • y) ≤
      (2*Real.sqrt (1+r^2-2*c*r)+r)*R+3*C

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.SixSector.circle_lipschitz
OAI.ArtinCAT0.SixSector.circle_one
statement:
lemma circle_one (hG : GeometricAction TriangleGroup X) (y : X) (hR : StrictRatios y)
    (R : ℝ) (i : Fin 6) : circle y R i 1 = axis y (i+1) R

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.SixSector.circle_radial
statement:
lemma circle_radial (i : Fin 6) {t : ℝ} (ht : t∈Set.Icc 0 1) (R S : ℝ) :
    dist (circle y R i t •y) (circle y S i t •y) ≤ |R-S|+C

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.SixSector.circle_radius
statement:
lemma circle_radius {R : ℝ} (hR0 : 0≤R) (i : Fin 6) {t : ℝ} (ht : t∈Set.Icc 0 1) :
    |dist y (circle y R i t • y)-R| ≤ C

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.SixSector.circle_zero
statement: lemma circle_zero (y : X) (R : ℝ) (i : Fin 6) : circle y R i 0 = axis y i R

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.SixSector.common_cosine
statement:
lemma common_cosine (hG : GeometricAction TriangleGroup X) (y : X) (hR : StrictRatios y) :
    ∃ c : ℝ, 1/2<c ∧ c≤1 ∧ ∀ i, c≤cosine y i

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.SixSector.cosine_abs
statement:
lemma cosine_abs (hG : GeometricAction TriangleGroup X) (y : X) (hR : StrictRatios y) (i : Fin 6) :
    |cosine y i| ≤ 1

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.SixSector.product_next
OAI.ArtinCAT0.SixSector.ringCircle_product
statement:
lemma ringCircle_product (y : X) (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (R : ℝ) (a : Fin 6) (j : Fin N) :
    ringCircle y N R (finProdFinEquiv (a,j)) = circle y R a (j.val/N)

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.SixSector.ringCircle_radial
statement:
lemma ringCircle_radial (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (R S : ℝ) (j : Fin (6*N)) :
    dist (ringCircle y N R j •y) (ringCircle y N S j •y) ≤ |R-S|+C

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.SixSector.ringCircle_radius
statement:
lemma ringCircle_radius (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] {R : ℝ} (hR0 : 0≤R) (j : Fin (6*N)) :
    |dist y (ringCircle y N R j •y)-R| ≤ C

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.SixSector.ringCircle_step
statement:
lemma ringCircle_step (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] {R : ℝ} (hR0 : 0≤R) (j : Fin (6*N)) :
    dist (ringCircle y N R j •y) (ringCircle y N R (j+1) •y) ≤ 20*R/N+C

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.WordDiagram.action_displacement
statement:
lemma action_displacement (g h : TriangleGroup) :
    dist y ((g⁻¹*h)•y) = dist (g•y) (h•y)

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.WordDiagram.chooseForward_mate
statement: lemma chooseForward_mate (d : F × Fin 3) : chooseForward M (M.mate d) = !chooseForward M d

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.WordDiagram.eval_representative
statement: @[simp] lemma eval_representative (g : TriangleGroup) : eval (representative g) = g

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.WordDiagram.eval_surjective
statement: lemma eval_surjective : Function.Surjective eval

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.WordDiagram.faceLoop_mate
statement:
lemma faceLoop_mate (f : F) (i : Fin 3) :
    loopSides _ (faceLoop hG y B M z hz (M.mate (f,i)).1) (M.mate (f,i)).2 =
      sideFlip (loopSides _ (faceLoop hG y B M z hz f) i)

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.WordDiagram.faceLoop_start
statement:
lemma faceLoop_start (f : F) (i : Fin 3) :
    z (M.tail (f,0))*startLabel (loopSides _ (faceLoop hG y B M z hz f)) i = z (M.tail (f,i))

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.WordDiagram.finite_short_elements
statement:
lemma finite_short_elements (hG : GeometricAction TriangleGroup X) (y : X)
    (B : ℝ) (hB : 0≤B) : {g : TriangleGroup | dist y (g•y) ≤ B}.Finite

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.WordDiagram.loops_closed
statement: lemma loops_closed (s : SmallLoop e) : closedSides (loopSides e s)

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.WordDiagram.orientedSide_mate
statement:
lemma orientedSide_mate (d : F × Fin 3) :
    orientedSide hG y B M z hz (M.mate d) = smallFlip (orientedSide hG y B M z hz d)

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.WordDiagram.orientedSide_value
statement:
lemma orientedSide_value (d : F × Fin 3) :
    eval (sideWord (smallSide (Subtype.val : ShortElement y B → TriangleGroup)
      (orientedSide hG y B M z hz d))) = (z (M.tail d))⁻¹*z (M.tail (d.1,d.2+1))

name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.WordDiagram.smallSide_flip
statement:
@[simp] lemma smallSide_flip (s : SmallSide (E:=E)) :
    smallSide e (smallFlip s) = sideFlip (smallSide e s)

name: OAI.Release075.CartesianBlock.Relations.map
OAI.Release075.CartesianBlock.quotient_rank_le
statement:
theorem CartesianBlock.quotient_rank_le {I F K : Type*} {r : ℕ}
    [Group F] [Fintype F] [DecidableEq F] [Field K]
    (b : CartesianBlock I r) (g : I → Fin r → Fin r → F)
    (L : Fin r → ZMod b.s → F) (R : Fin r → ZMod b.t → F)
    (hrel : ∀ (i : b.labels) u v,
      g i u v = (L u ((b.coordinates i).1 + (v.val : ZMod b.s)))⁻¹ *
        R v ((b.coordinates i).2 + (u.val : ZMod b.t))) :
    (∑ i ∈ b.labels, quotientMatrix (R := K) (g i)).rank ≤ Fintype.card F

name: OAI.Release075.affineLineMap_injective
statement:
theorem affineLineMap_injective {T K : Type*} [Field K] (a v : T → K)
    (hv : v ≠ 0) : Function.Injective (affineLineMap a v)

name: OAI.Release075.det_abs_le_prod_row_norm
statement:
theorem det_abs_le_prod_row_norm {n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) :
    |A.det| ≤ ∏ i, ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 (A i) : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))‖

name: OAI.Release075.exists_finite_preserving_rectangles
statement:
theorem exists_finite_preserving_rectangles {I : Type u} {G : Type v} [Fintype I] [Group G]
    [Group.ResiduallyFinite G] {r : ℕ} (g : I → Fin r → Fin r → G)
    (hg : ∀ i, RectanglesSurvive (g i)) :
    ∃ (Q : Type (max u v)) (_ : Group Q) (_ : Fintype Q) (φ : G →* Q),
      ∀ i, RectanglesSurvive (fun u v => φ (g i u v))

name: OAI.Release075.exists_finite_separating_family
statement:
theorem exists_finite_separating_family {G : Type u} {ι : Type v} [Group G] [Fintype ι]
    [Group.ResiduallyFinite G] (w : ι → G) (hw : ∀ i, w i ≠ 1) :
    ∃ (Q : Type (max u v)) (_ : Group Q) (_ : Fintype Q) (φ : G →* Q), ∀ i, φ (w i) ≠ 1

name: OAI.Release075.exists_full_rank_minor
statement:
theorem exists_full_rank_minor {ι κ K : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ] [Field K]
    (M : Matrix ι κ K) :
    ∃ (f : Fin M.rank → ι) (g : Fin M.rank → κ),
      Function.Injective f ∧ Function.Injective g ∧ (M.submatrix f g).det ≠ 0

name: OAI.Release075.exists_row_basis
statement:
theorem exists_row_basis {ι κ K : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ] [Field K]
    (M : Matrix ι κ K) :
    ∃ S : Finset ι, S.card = M.rank ∧
      LinearIndependent K (fun i : S => M i.val) ∧
      ∀ i, ∃ c : S → K, M i = ∑ j : S, c j • M j.val

name: OAI.Release075.exists_two_cartesian_blocks
statement:
theorem exists_two_cartesian_blocks {I : Type*} [DecidableEq I] (r : ℕ) (hr : 0 < r)
    (A : Finset I) (hA : 4 * r ^ 2 ≤ A.card) :
    ∃ b₀ b₁ : CartesianBlock I r,
      Disjoint b₀.labels b₁.labels ∧ b₀.labels ∪ b₁.labels = A

name: OAI.Release075.flattenMatrix_apply
OAI.Release075.flattenMatrix_mul
statement:
theorem flattenMatrix_mul {ι κ τ F R : Type*} [Fintype κ] [Fintype F]
    [DecidableEq F] [Semiring R] (A : Matrix ι κ (Matrix F F R))
    (B : Matrix κ τ (Matrix F F R)) :
    flattenMatrix (A * B) = flattenMatrix A * flattenMatrix B

name: OAI.Release075.flattenMatrix_trace
statement:
theorem flattenMatrix_trace {ι F R : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype F]
    [AddCommMonoid R] (A : Matrix ι ι (Matrix F F R)) :
    (flattenMatrix A).trace = ∑ i, (A i i).trace

name: OAI.Release075.flattenMatrix_transpose
OAI.Release075.gridLagrangeLine_eval
statement:
@[simp] theorem gridLagrangeLine_eval {T K : Type*} [Fintype T] [Field K]
    [DecidableEq K] (S : Finset K) (a b v : T → K) (x : K) :
    (gridLagrangeLine S a b v).eval x = gridLagrange S a (fun t => b t + x * v t)

name: OAI.Release075.gridLagrangeLine_natDegree_le
statement:
theorem gridLagrangeLine_natDegree_le {T K : Type*} [Fintype T] [Field K]
    [DecidableEq K] (S : Finset K) (a b v : T → K) (ha : ∀ t, a t ∈ S) :
    (gridLagrangeLine S a b v).natDegree ≤ Fintype.card T * (S.card - 1)

name: OAI.Release075.gridLagrange_other
statement:
theorem gridLagrange_other {T K : Type*} [Fintype T] [Field K]
    [DecidableEq K] (S : Finset K) (a x : T → K) (hx : ∀ t, x t ∈ S)
    (hax : a ≠ x) : gridLagrange S a x = 0

name: OAI.Release075.gridLagrange_self
statement:
@[simp] theorem gridLagrange_self {T K : Type*} [Fintype T] [Field K]
    [DecidableEq K] (S : Finset K) (a : T → K) : gridLagrange S a a = 1

name: OAI.Release075.grid_line_certificate
statement:
theorem grid_line_certificate {T I K : Type*} [Fintype T] [Fintype I]
    [DecidableEq T] [DecidableEq I] [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
    (S : Finset K) (a v : I → T → K) (ha : ∀ i t, a i t ∈ S)
    (hinj : Function.Injective a) (hv : ∀ i, v i ≠ 0)
    (hdeg : 2 * (Fintype.card T * (S.card - 1)) < Fintype.card K - 1) :
    ∀ i j k, (∑ z, if i ∈ lineIncidence a v z then
      gridLagrange S (a j) z * gridLagrange S (a k) z else 0) =
      -(if j = i ∧ k = i then 1 else 0)

name: OAI.Release075.polygon_weight_line_sum
statement:
theorem polygon_weight_line_sum {T K : Type*} [Fintype T] [Field K] [Fintype K]
    [DecidableEq K] (S : Finset K) (a a' b v : T → K)
    (ha : ∀ t, a t ∈ S) (ha' : ∀ t, a' t ∈ S)
    (hdeg : 2 * (Fintype.card T * (S.card - 1)) < Fintype.card K - 1) :
    (∑ x : K, gridLagrange S a (fun t => b t + x * v t) *
      gridLagrange S a' (fun t => b t + x * v t)) = 0

name: OAI.Release075.polynomial_sum_eq_zero
statement:
theorem polynomial_sum_eq_zero {K : Type*} [Field K] [Fintype K]
    (p : Polynomial K) (hdeg : p.natDegree < Fintype.card K - 1) :
    ∑ x, p.eval x = 0

name: OAI.Release075.pow_card_sub_rank_dvd_det
statement:
theorem pow_card_sub_rank_dvd_det {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (A : Matrix ι ι ℤ) (q : ℕ) [Fact q.Prime] :
    (q : ℤ) ^ (Fintype.card ι - (A.map (Int.cast : ℤ → ZMod q)).rank) ∣ A.det

name: OAI.Release075.pow_sub_card_dvd_det
statement:
theorem pow_sub_card_dvd_det {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (A : Matrix ι ι ℤ) (S : Finset ι) (q : ℤ)
    (h : ∀ i, i ∉ S → ∀ j, q ∣ A i j) :
    q ^ (Fintype.card ι - S.card) ∣ A.det

name: OAI.Release075.puncturedLine_sum
statement:
theorem puncturedLine_sum {T K R : Type*} [Fintype T] [Field K] [Fintype K]
    [AddCommGroup R] (a v : T → K) (hv : v ≠ 0) (w : (T → K) → R) :
    (∑ z ∈ puncturedLine a v, w z) = (∑ x, w (affineLineMap a v x)) - w a

name: OAI.Release075.quotientMatrix_gram
statement:
theorem quotientMatrix_gram {ι F R : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Group F]
    [Fintype F] [DecidableEq F] [Semiring R] (g : ι → ι → F) :
    quotientMatrix (R := R) g * (quotientMatrix g).transpose =
      flattenMatrix (Matrix.of fun u u' => ∑ v, regularMatrix (g u v * (g u' v)⁻¹))

name: OAI.Release075.quotientMatrix_gram_sq_trace
statement:
theorem quotientMatrix_gram_sq_trace {ι F R : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Group F]
    [Fintype F] [DecidableEq F] [Semiring R] (g : ι → ι → F) :
    ((quotientMatrix (R := R) g * (quotientMatrix g).transpose) *
      (quotientMatrix g * (quotientMatrix g).transpose)).trace =
        ∑ u, ∑ u', ∑ v, ∑ v', (regularMatrix (R := R)
          (g u v * (g u' v)⁻¹ * g u' v' * (g u v')⁻¹)).trace

name: OAI.Release075.quotientMatrix_gram_sq_trace_of_rectangles
statement:
theorem quotientMatrix_gram_sq_trace_of_rectangles {ι F R : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    [Group F] [Fintype F] [DecidableEq F] [CommRing R]
    (g : ι → ι → F) (hg : RectanglesSurvive g) :
    ((quotientMatrix (R := R) g * (quotientMatrix g).transpose) *
      (quotientMatrix g * (quotientMatrix g).transpose)).trace =
      (2 * (Fintype.card ι : R) ^ 3 - (Fintype.card ι : R) ^ 2) * Fintype.card F

name: OAI.Release075.quotientMatrix_gram_trace
statement:
theorem quotientMatrix_gram_trace {ι F R : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Group F]
    [Fintype F] [DecidableEq F] [Semiring R] (g : ι → ι → F) :
    (quotientMatrix (R := R) g * (quotientMatrix g).transpose).trace =
      (Fintype.card ι : R) ^ 2 * Fintype.card F

name: OAI.Release075.quotientMatrix_map
statement:
theorem quotientMatrix_map {ι F R : Type*} [Group F] [Fintype F]
    [DecidableEq F] [Ring R] (g : ι → ι → F) :
    (quotientMatrix (R := ℤ) g).map (Int.cast : ℤ → R) = quotientMatrix (R := R) g

name: OAI.Release075.quotientMatrix_rank_real_lower
statement:
theorem quotientMatrix_rank_real_lower {ι F : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Group F]
    [Fintype F] [DecidableEq F] (g : ι → ι → F) (hg : RectanglesSurvive g) :
    Fintype.card ι * Fintype.card F ≤ 2 * (quotientMatrix (R := ℝ) g).rank

name: OAI.Release075.quotientMatrix_row_sq
statement:
theorem quotientMatrix_row_sq {ι F : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Group F]
    [Fintype F] [DecidableEq F] (g : ι → ι → F) (i : ι × F) :
    ∑ j, ((quotientMatrix (R := ℤ) g i j : ℤ) : ℝ) ^ 2 = Fintype.card ι

name: OAI.Release075.quotientMatrix_sum_rank_le
statement:
theorem quotientMatrix_sum_rank_le {ι s t F K : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    [Fintype s] [Fintype t] [Group F] [Fintype F] [DecidableEq F] [Field K]
    (L : ι → s → F) (R : ι → t → F) :
    (∑ j : s, ∑ k : t, quotientMatrix (R := K) (fun u v => (L u j)⁻¹ * R v k)).rank ≤
      Fintype.card F

name: OAI.Release075.quotientMatrix_sum_reindex
statement:
theorem quotientMatrix_sum_reindex {ι B s t F K : Type*} [Fintype B]
    [Fintype s] [Fintype t] [Group F] [Fintype F] [DecidableEq F] [Semiring K]
    (g : B → ι → ι → F) (L : ι → s → F) (R : ι → t → F)
    (e : ι → ι → B ≃ s × t)
    (h : ∀ i u v, g i u v = (L u (e u v i).1)⁻¹ * R v (e u v i).2) :
    (∑ i, quotientMatrix (R := K) (g i)) =
      ∑ j : s, ∑ k : t, quotientMatrix (R := K) (fun u v => (L u j)⁻¹ * R v k)

name: OAI.Release075.rank_add_le
statement:
theorem rank_add_le {ι κ K : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ] [Field K]
    (A B : Matrix ι κ K) : (A + B).rank ≤ A.rank + B.rank

name: OAI.Release075.rank_budget_of_line_certificate
statement:
theorem rank_budget_of_line_certificate {P I ι κ K : Type*} [Fintype P]
    [Fintype I] [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq I] [Field K]
    (inc : P → Finset I) (f : P → I → K) (Y : I → Matrix ι κ K)
    (hline : ∀ i j k, (∑ z, if i ∈ inc z then f z j * f z k else 0) =
      -(if j = i ∧ k = i then 1 else 0)) :
    (∑ i, (Y i).rank) ≤ ∑ z, (∑ i ∈ inc z, Y i).rank

name: OAI.Release075.rank_neg
statement:
theorem rank_neg {ι κ K : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ] [Field K]
    (A : Matrix ι κ K) : (-A).rank = A.rank

name: OAI.Release075.rank_sum_le
statement:
theorem rank_sum_le {ι κ τ K : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ] [Field K]
    (s : Finset τ) (A : τ → Matrix ι κ K) : (∑ t ∈ s, A t).rank ≤ ∑ t ∈ s, (A t).rank

name: OAI.Release075.regularMatrix_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem regularMatrix_apply {F R : Type*} [Group F] [Fintype F]
    [DecidableEq F] [Semiring R] (g a b : F) :
    regularMatrix (R := R) g a b = if a = g * b then 1 else 0

name: OAI.Release075.regularMatrix_trace
statement:
@[simp] theorem regularMatrix_trace {F R : Type*} [Group F] [Fintype F]
    [DecidableEq F] [Semiring R] (g : F) :
    (regularMatrix (R := R) g).trace = if g = 1 then (Fintype.card F : R) else 0

name: OAI.Release075.regularMatrix_transpose
statement:
@[simp] theorem regularMatrix_transpose {F R : Type*} [Group F] [Fintype F]
    [DecidableEq F] [Semiring R] (g : F) :
    (regularMatrix (R := R) g).transpose = regularMatrix g⁻¹

name: OAI.Release075.sum_rank_le_rank_diagonalBlocks
statement:
theorem sum_rank_le_rank_diagonalBlocks {I ι κ K : Type*} [Fintype I]
    [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq I] [Field K]
    (Y : I → Matrix ι κ K) : (∑ i, (Y i).rank) ≤ (diagonalBlocks Y).rank

name: OAI.Release075.tensor_certificate
statement:
theorem tensor_certificate {P I ι κ K : Type*} [Fintype P] [Fintype I]
    [DecidableEq I] [Field K] (inc : P → Finset I) (f : P → I → K)
    (Y : I → Matrix ι κ K)
    (hline : ∀ i j k, (∑ z, if i ∈ inc z then f z j * f z k else 0) =
      -(if j = i ∧ k = i then 1 else 0)) :
    (∑ z, weightedMatrix (f z) (∑ i ∈ inc z, Y i)) = -diagonalBlocks Y

name: OAI.Release075.trace_sq_le_rank_mul_trace_sq
statement:
theorem trace_sq_le_rank_mul_trace_sq {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (hA : A.IsHermitian) :
    A.trace ^ 2 ≤ (A.rank : ℝ) * (A * A).trace

name: OAI.Release075.two_block_quotient_rank_le
statement:
theorem two_block_quotient_rank_le {I F K : Type*} [DecidableEq I]
    [Group F] [Fintype F] [DecidableEq F] [Field K] {r : ℕ}
    (A : Finset I) (g : I → Fin r → Fin r → F)
    (b₀ b₁ : CartesianBlock I r)
    (hdis : Disjoint b₀.labels b₁.labels) (hunion : b₀.labels ∪ b₁.labels = A)
    (h₀ : b₀.Relations g) (h₁ : b₁.Relations g) :
    (∑ i ∈ A, quotientMatrix (R := K) (g i)).rank ≤ 2 * Fintype.card F

name: OAI.Release075.two_block_sizes
statement:
theorem two_block_sizes (r d : ℕ) (hr : 0 < r) (hd : 4 * r ^ 2 ≤ d) :
    ∃ n₁ n₂ : ℕ, r ≤ n₁ ∧ r ≤ n₂ ∧ n₂ < 2 * r ∧
      d = r * n₁ + (r + 1) * n₂

name: OAI.Release075.weightedMatrix_rank_le
statement:
theorem weightedMatrix_rank_le {I ι κ K : Type*} [Fintype I] [Fintype ι]
    [Fintype κ] [Field K] (f : I → K) (Z : Matrix ι κ K) :
    (weightedMatrix f Z).rank ≤ Z.rank

name: OAI.Release075.CycleCandidate.expect_occurs
statement:
theorem expect_occurs [Fintype A] [Fintype (Projectivization K V)] [Nontrivial V]
    (c : CycleCandidate (K := K) S σ) :
    (𝔼 ω : S → Projectivization K V, if c.Occurs ω then (1 : ℝ) else 0) =
      (1 / Fintype.card (Projectivization K V) : ℝ) ^ Fintype.card A

theorem chosenLinePoints_card (a : V) (d : Projectivization K V) :

name: OAI.Release075.cycleCandidate_of_incidence
statement:
theorem cycleCandidate_of_incidence {S : Finset V} (ω : S → Projectivization K V)
    {s : ℕ} (hs : 2 ≤ s) (p : Fin s → V) (l : Fin s → S)
    (hp : Function.Injective p) (hl : Function.Injective l)
    (h : ∀ i, PuncturedIncidence (l i).val (p i) (ω (l i)) ∧
      PuncturedIncidence (l i).val (p (finRotate s i)) (ω (l i))) :
    ∃ c : CycleCandidate (K := K) S (finRotate s), c.Occurs ω ∧ ∀ i, c.marks i = l i

name: OAI.Release075.cycle_numeric_bound
statement:
theorem cycle_numeric_bound {q J : ℝ} (hq : 1 ≤ q) (hJ : q^19 ≤ J)
    {s : ℕ} (hs : s ≤ 6) : (q^20)^s * q^s * (1/J)^s ≤ q^12

name: OAI.Release075.deletedMarks_card_le
statement:
theorem deletedMarks_card_le (S : Finset V) (ω : S → Projectivization K V) :
    (deletedMarks S ω).card ≤ 6 * ∑ s ∈ Finset.Icc 2 6, (badCycles S (finRotate s) ω).card

name: OAI.Release075.deletedPoints_card_le
statement:
theorem deletedPoints_card_le (S : Finset V) (ω : S → Projectivization K V) :
    (deletedPoints S ω).card ≤ Fintype.card K * (deletedMarks S ω).card

name: OAI.Release075.directions_twenty_card
statement:
theorem directions_twenty_card [Fintype (Projectivization (ZMod q) (Fin 20 → ZMod q))] :
    Fintype.card (Projectivization (ZMod q) (Fin 20 → ZMod q)) =
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range 20, q^i

name: OAI.Release075.exceptionalPoints_card_le
statement:
theorem exceptionalPoints_card_le (S : Finset V) (ω : S → Projectivization K V) (T : ℕ) :
    (exceptionalPoints S ω T).card ≤
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun z => pointDegree S ω z < T)).card +
        Fintype.card K * (deletedMarks S ω).card

name: OAI.Release075.exists_of_expect_lt
statement:
theorem exists_of_expect_lt {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω] [Nonempty Ω]
    (X : Ω → ℝ) (a : ℝ) (h : (𝔼 ω, X ω) < a) : ∃ ω, X ω < a

name: OAI.Release075.expect_badCycles_le
statement:
theorem expect_badCycles_le [Fintype A] [Fintype K] [Fintype V]
    [Fintype (Projectivization K V)] [Nontrivial V]
    (S : Finset V) (σ : A → A) :
    (𝔼 ω : S → Projectivization K V, ((badCycles S σ ω).card : ℝ)) ≤
      (Fintype.card V : ℝ)^Fintype.card A * (Fintype.card K : ℝ)^Fintype.card A *
        (1 / Fintype.card (Projectivization K V) : ℝ)^Fintype.card A

name: OAI.Release075.expect_bernoulli_sum_sq_le
statement:
theorem expect_bernoulli_sum_sq_le {I D : Type*} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
    [Fintype D] [Nonempty D] (b : I → D → ℝ) (p : I → ℝ)
    (hb : ∀ i d, b i d = 0 ∨ b i d = 1)
    (hp : ∀ i, (𝔼 d, b i d) = p i) :
    (𝔼 ω : I → D, ((∑ i, b i (ω i)) - ∑ i, p i)^2) ≤ ∑ i, p i

name: OAI.Release075.expect_centered_sum_sq
statement:
theorem expect_centered_sum_sq {I D : Type*} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
    [Fintype D] [Nonempty D] (b : I → D → ℝ) (p : I → ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ i, (𝔼 d, b i d) = p i) :
    (𝔼 ω : I → D, ((∑ i, b i (ω i)) - ∑ i, p i)^2) =
      ∑ i, (𝔼 d, (b i d - p i)^2)

name: OAI.Release075.expect_coordinate
statement:
theorem expect_coordinate {I D : Type*} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I] [Fintype D] [Nonempty D]
    (i : I) (f : D → ℝ) : (𝔼 ω : I → D, f (ω i)) = 𝔼 d, f d

name: OAI.Release075.expect_deletedMarks_le
statement:
theorem expect_deletedMarks_le (S : Finset V) (q : ℝ)
    (hcycle : ∀ s ∈ Finset.Icc 2 6,
      (Fintype.card V : ℝ)^s * (Fintype.card K : ℝ)^s *
        (1 / Fintype.card (Projectivization K V) : ℝ)^s ≤ q^12) :
    (𝔼 ω : S → Projectivization K V, ((deletedMarks S ω).card : ℝ)) ≤ 30*q^12

name: OAI.Release075.expect_lowDegree_le
statement:
theorem expect_lowDegree_le [Fintype V] (S : Finset V) (T : ℕ) (μ : ℝ)
    (hμ : 0 < μ) (hT : 2 * (T : ℝ) ≤ μ)
    (hlower : ∀ z : V, μ ≤ pointMean (K := K) S z) :
    (𝔼 ω : S → Projectivization K V,
      ((Finset.univ.filter (fun z : V => pointDegree S ω z < T)).card : ℝ)) ≤
        4 * (Fintype.card V : ℝ) / μ

name: OAI.Release075.expect_low_indicator_le
statement:
theorem expect_low_indicator_le {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω]
    (X : Ω → ℝ) (μ t : ℝ) (ht : t < μ) :
    (𝔼 ω, if X ω < t then (1 : ℝ) else 0) ≤
      (𝔼 ω, (X ω - μ)^2) / (μ-t)^2

name: OAI.Release075.expect_pi_product
statement:
theorem expect_pi_product {I D : Type*} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I] [Fintype D]

name: OAI.Release075.expect_puncturedIncidence

name: OAI.Release075.expect_selected_product
statement:
theorem expect_selected_product {A I D : Type*} [Fintype A] [Fintype I]

    (𝔼 ω : I → D, ∏ a, f a (ω (e a))) = ∏ a, 𝔼 d, f a d

name: OAI.Release075.expect_two_coordinates

theorem expect_two_coordinates {I D : Type*} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I] [Fintype D] [Nonempty D]

statement:
theorem line_two_points (a z z' : V) (d : Projectivization K V) (hzz : z' ≠ z)

name: OAI.Release075.puncturedIncidence_iff

name: OAI.Release075.relationGraph_any_cycle_encoding
statement:
theorem relationGraph_any_cycle_encoding {A B : Type*} (R : A → B → Prop)
    {a : A ⊕ B} (w : (relationGraph R).Walk a a) (hw : w.IsCycle) :
    ∃ (s : ℕ) (_ : 2 ≤ s) (p : Fin s → A) (l : Fin s → B),
      w.length = 2*s ∧ Function.Injective p ∧ Function.Injective l ∧
      ∀ i, R (p i) (l i) ∧ R (p (finRotate s i)) (l i)

name: OAI.Release075.relationGraph_cycle_encoding

    ∃ (s : ℕ) (_ : 2 ≤ s) (p : Fin s → A) (l : Fin s → B),
      w.length = 2*s ∧ Function.Injective p ∧ Function.Injective l ∧
      ∀ i, R (p i) (l i) ∧ R (p (finRotate s i)) (l i)

name: OAI.Release075.PermCycles.cancel_dipole
statement:
theorem cancel_dipole {C : Type*} (r f : Perm A)
    (hi : Function.Involutive r) (hn : ∀ z, r z ≠ z)
    (color : A → C) (hc : ∀ z, color ((r*f) z) = color z)
    (e : Fin 6 ↪ A) (hf : ∀ j, f (e j) = e (dipoleFace j))
    (he : r (e 0) = e 3)
    (h10 : color (e 1) ≠ color (e 0)) (h21 : color (e 2) ≠ color (e 1))
    (h14 : color (e 1) = color (e 4)) (hp : PlanarMap r f) :
    ∃ (r' : Perm A) (hr : ∀ a, (r' a ∉ Set.range e) ↔ (a ∉ Set.range e)),
      Function.Involutive (r'.subtypePerm (p := fun a => a ∉ Set.range e) hr) ∧
      (∀ z, r'.subtypePerm (p := fun a => a ∉ Set.range e) hr z ≠ z) ∧
      PlanarMap (r'.subtypePerm (p := fun a => a ∉ Set.range e) hr)
        (f.subtypePerm (p := fun a => a ∉ Set.range e)
          (fun a => not_congr (range_invariant f dipoleFace e hf a))) ∧
      cycleCount (f.subtypePerm (p := fun a => a ∉ Set.range e)
        (fun a => not_congr (range_invariant f dipoleFace e hf a))) + 2 = cycleCount f

name: OAI.Release075.PermCycles.fold_pair
statement:
theorem fold_pair {C E : Type*} (r f : Perm A)
    (hi : Function.Involutive r) (hn : ∀ a, r a ≠ a)
    (label : A → E) (flip : E → E) (hflip : Function.Involutive flip)
    (color : E → C) (hedge : ∀ e, color e ≠ color (flip e))
    (hl : ∀ a, label (r a) = flip (label a))
    (hc : ∀ a, color (label ((r*f) a)) = color (label a))
    (hp : PlanarMap r f) {a b : A} (hab : a ≠ b)
    (hf : f b = a) (he : label a = flip (label b)) :
    ∃ r' f' : Perm A,
      Function.Involutive r' ∧ (∀ z, r' z ≠ z) ∧ PlanarMap r' f' ∧
      (∀ z, label (r' z) = flip (label z)) ∧
      (∀ z, color (label ((r'*f') z)) = color (label z)) ∧
      r' a = b ∧ r' b = a ∧ f' a = b ∧ f' b = a ∧
      components r' f' ≤ components r f ∧
      (∀ z, f z ≠ b → f z ≠ f a → f' z = f z) ∧
      f' = Equiv.swap b (f a) * f

name: OAI.Release075.PermCycles.isolate_dipole
statement:
theorem isolate_dipole {C : Type*} (r f : Perm A)
    (hi : Function.Involutive r) (hn : ∀ z, r z ≠ z)
    (color : A → C) (hc : ∀ z, color ((r*f) z) = color z)
    (e : Fin 6 ↪ A) (hf : ∀ j, f (e j) = e (dipoleFace j))
    (he : r (e 0) = e 3)
    (h10 : color (e 1) ≠ color (e 0)) (h21 : color (e 2) ≠ color (e 1))
    (h14 : color (e 1) = color (e 4)) (hp : PlanarMap r f) :
    ∃ r' : Perm A, Function.Involutive r' ∧ (∀ z, r' z ≠ z) ∧
      PlanarMap r' f ∧ (∀ z, color ((r'*f) z) = color z) ∧
      (∀ j, r' (e j) = e (dipoleReverse j)) ∧
      r' = rePair (rePair r (e 1) (e 5)) (e 2) (e 4) ∧
      components r' f ≤ components r f

name: OAI.Release075.PermCycles.planar_rePair_allow

    (hl : color (r a) = color b) (hr : color a = color (r b))
    (hcy : (r*f).SameCycle (r a) b) (hp : PlanarMap r f) :
    PlanarMap (rePair r a b) f

name: OAI.Release075.PermCycles.trianglePairEmbedding_values
statement:
theorem trianglePairEmbedding_values (f : Perm A) (a b : A)
    (hpa : (f^3) a = a) (hna : f a ≠ a) (hpb : (f^3) b = b) (hnb : f b ≠ b)
    (hab : ¬ f.SameCycle a b) :
    let e := trianglePairEmbedding f a b hpa hna hpb hnb hab
    e 0 = a ∧ e 1 = f a ∧ e 2 = (f^2) a ∧
    e 3 = b ∧ e 4 = f b ∧ e 5 = (f^2) b

name: OAI.Release075.FreeChain.chainCosetEquiv_norm

name: OAI.Release075.FreeChain.cyclic_chain_obstruction
statement:
theorem cyclic_chain_obstruction {A₀ A₁ A₂ : Type} (H : Subgroup G)
    [Fintype H] [IsCyclic H] (g : H) (hg : ∀ x, x ∈ Subgroup.zpowers g)
    (b₁ : FreeChain A₁ G →ₗ[ℤ] FreeChain A₀ G)
    (b₂ : FreeChain A₂ G →ₗ[ℤ] FreeChain A₁ G)
    (h₁ : ∀ (h : H) c, b₁ (chainShift (h:G) c) = chainShift (h:G) (b₁ c))
    (h₂ : ∀ (h : H) c, b₂ (chainShift (h:G) c) = chainShift (h:G) (b₂ c))
    (hbb : ∀ c, b₁ (b₂ c) = 0)
    (haug : ∀ c, augmentation (b₁ c) = 0)
    (v : FreeChain A₀ G) (hv : augmentation v = 1)
    (c : FreeChain A₁ G) (hc : b₁ c = chainShift (g:G) v - v)
    (D : FreeChain A₂ G) (hD : b₂ D = subgroupNorm H c)
    (hDi : chainShift (g:G) D = D) : (g:G) = 1

name: OAI.Release075.FreeChain.invariant_is_norm
statement:

lemma evaluate_relation (j : ι ⊕ ι) :
    evaluate i hi r q (relation (i.comp p₀) (i.comp p₁) j) = 1

name: OAI.Higman.RopeTrick.finitelyPresented
statement:
theorem finitelyPresented [Finite ι] [Group.IsFinitelyPresented K]
    (α β : FreeGroup ι →* K) : Group.IsFinitelyPresented (Container α β)

name: OAI.Higman.RopeTrick.generator_one
statement:
lemma generator_one (α β : FreeGroup ι →* K) (j : ι) :
    stable α β * kMap α β (β (FreeGroup.of j)) =
      kMap α β (β (FreeGroup.of j)) * fMap α β (FreeGroup.of j) * stable α β

name: OAI.Higman.RopeTrick.generator_zero
statement:
lemma generator_zero (α β : FreeGroup ι →* K) (j : ι) :
    stable α β * kMap α β (α (FreeGroup.of j)) =
      kMap α β (α (FreeGroup.of j)) * stable α β

name: OAI.Higman.RopeTrick.kills_relation
statement:
lemma kills_relation (α β : FreeGroup ι →* K) (w : FreeGroup ι) (hw : α w = β w) :
    fMap α β w = 1

name: OAI.Higman.RopeTrick.left_injective
statement: lemma left_injective : Function.Injective (left i (G := G))

name: OAI.Higman.RopeTrick.model_relation
statement:
lemma model_relation (a : A) :
    (HNNExtension.t : Model i hi r) * HNNExtension.of (i a,1) =
      HNNExtension.of (i a,r a) * HNNExtension.t

name: OAI.Higman.RopeTrick.pair_eq
statement:
lemma pair_eq (α β : FreeGroup ι →* K) (k : K) (w : FreeGroup ι) :
    proj α β (Coprod.inl (k,w)) = kMap α β k * fMap α β w

name: OAI.Higman.RopeTrick.relation_zero
statement:
lemma relation_zero (α β : FreeGroup ι →* K) (j : ι ⊕ ι) :
    proj α β (relation α β j) = 1

name: OAI.Higman.RopeTrick.right_injective
statement: lemma right_injective : Function.Injective (right i r)

name: OAI.Higman.commute_of_free_generators
statement:
lemma commute_of_free_generators {ι : Type u} {κ : Type v}
    {G : Type w} {H : Type x} {K : Type*} [Group G] [Group H] [Group K]
    (p : FreeGroup ι →* G) (hp : Function.Surjective p)
    (q : FreeGroup κ →* H) (hq : Function.Surjective q)
    (f : G →* K) (g : H →* K)
    (hc : ∀ i j, Commute (f (p (FreeGroup.of i))) (g (q (FreeGroup.of j)))) :
    ∀ a b, Commute (f a) (g b)

name: OAI.Higman.embeds_of_benign_kernel
statement:
theorem embeds_of_benign_kernel {ι : Type u} [Finite ι]
    {D : Type v} [Group D] (q : FreeGroup ι →* D) (hq : Function.Surjective q)

name: OAI.Higman.finitelyPresented_prod

theorem finitelyPresented_prod {G : Type u} {H : Type v} [Group G] [Group H]

    Group.IsFinitelyPresented (G × H)

name: OAI.Higman.CentralExtension.rawMap_surjective
statement:
theorem rawMap_surjective (f : G →* H) (hf : Function.Surjective f) :

name: OAI.Higman.CentralExtension.rawProjection_ker
statement:
theorem rawProjection_ker : (rawProjection A).ker =
    Subgroup.normalClosure (relation '' (A : Set G))

name: OAI.Higman.CentralExtension.rawProjection_ker_map
statement:
theorem rawProjection_ker_map (f : G →* H) (hf : Function.Surjective f) :
    (rawProjection A).ker.map (Coprod.map f (MonoidHom.id (Multiplicative ℤ))) =
      (rawProjection (A.map f)).ker

name: OAI.Higman.HNN.commute_t_iff
statement:
theorem commute_t_iff (g : G) :
    Commute (t : HNNExtension G A A (MulEquiv.refl A)) (of g) ↔ g ∈ A

name: OAI.Higman.HNN.conj_mem_range_iff
statement:
theorem conj_mem_range_iff (g : G) :
    (t * of g * t⁻¹ : HNNExtension G A B φ) ∈ of.range ↔ g ∈ A

name: OAI.Higman.HNNSubgroup.closure_comap_of
statement:
theorem closure_comap_of :
    (Subgroup.closure (HNNExtension.of '' (S : Set G) ∪
      {(HNNExtension.t : HNNExtension G A B φ)})).comap HNNExtension.of = S

name: OAI.Higman.HNNSubgroup.inclusion_of
statement:
@[simp] theorem inclusion_of (s : S) :
    inclusion φ S hS (HNNExtension.of s) = HNNExtension.of (s : G)

name: OAI.Higman.HNNSubgroup.inclusion_t
statement: @[simp] theorem inclusion_t : inclusion φ S hS HNNExtension.t = HNNExtension.t

name: OAI.Higman.HNNSubgroup.range_comap_of
statement: theorem range_comap_of : (inclusion φ S hS).range.comap HNNExtension.of = S

name: OAI.Higman.HNNTransport.mapWord_prod
statement:
@[simp] theorem mapWord_prod (r : NormalWord.ReducedWord G A B) :
    (mapWord i hA hB r).prod ψ = map φ ψ i hA hφ (r.prod φ)

name: OAI.Higman.HNNTransport.map_injective
statement: theorem map_injective (hi : Function.Injective i) : Function.Injective (map φ ψ i hA hφ)

name: OAI.Higman.HNNTransport.map_of
statement:
@[simp] theorem map_of (g : G) : map φ ψ i hA hφ (HNNExtension.of g) =

name: OAI.Higman.HNNTransport.map_t
statement: @[simp] theorem map_t : map φ ψ i hA hφ HNNExtension.t = HNNExtension.t

name: OAI.Higman.HNNTransport.mem_base_of_map_mem_base
statement:
theorem mem_base_of_map_mem_base (x : HNNExtension G A B φ)
    (hx : map φ ψ i hA hφ x ∈ (HNNExtension.of : K →* HNNExtension K C D ψ).range) :

name: OAI.Higman.HNNTransport.range_comap_of
statement: theorem range_comap_of : (map φ ψ i hA hφ).range.comap HNNExtension.of = i.range

name: OAI.Higman.IsBenign.map_surjective
statement:
theorem map_surjective (hA : IsBenign A) (f : G →* H) (hf : Function.Surjective f) :
    IsBenign (A.map f)

name: OAI.Higman.benign_iff_centralExtension_embeds
statement:
theorem benign_iff_centralExtension_embeds : IsBenign A ↔
    ∃ (K : Type u) (_ : Group K) (_ : Group.IsFinitelyPresented K)
      (j : CentralExtension G A →* K), Function.Injective j

name: OAI.Higman.embeds_of_benign_kernel_fp
statement:
theorem embeds_of_benign_kernel_fp {D : Type v} [Group D]
    [Group.IsFinitelyPresented G] (q : G →* D) (hq : Function.Surjective q)
    (hben : IsBenign q.ker) :
    ∃ (K : Type u) (_ : Group K) (_ : Group.IsFinitelyPresented K)
      (i : D →* K), Function.Injective i

name: OAI.Higman.FiniteHNN.realization
statement:
theorem realization (ps : List (PartialIso G))
    (hfg : ∀ p ∈ ps, p.source.FG) (R : Subgroup G)
    (hinv : ∀ p ∈ ps, p.Invariant R) :
    ∃ (K : Type u) (_ : Group K) (_ : Group.IsFinitelyPresented K)
      (i : G →* K), Function.Injective i ∧
      ∃ T : Set K, T.Finite ∧
        (Subgroup.closure (i '' (R : Set G) ∪ T)).comap i = R ∧
        ∀ p ∈ ps, ∃ t ∈ T, ∀ a : p.source,
          i (p.equiv a) = t * i a * t⁻¹

name: OAI.Higman.HNN.con_finitelyNormallyGenerated
statement:
theorem con_finitelyNormallyGenerated (hA : A.FG) :
    (HNNExtension.con G A B φ).subgroup.IsFinitelyNormallyGenerated

name: OAI.Higman.HNN.finitelyPresented
statement:
theorem finitelyPresented [Group.IsFinitelyPresented G] (hA : A.FG) :
    Group.IsFinitelyPresented (HNNExtension G A B φ)

name: OAI.Higman.Orbit.benign
statement:
theorem benign [Group.IsFinitelyPresented G] (ps : List (PartialIso G))
    (hfg : ∀ p ∈ ps, p.source.FG) (S : Set G) (hS : S.Finite) :
    IsBenign (subgroup ps S)

name: OAI.Higman.Orbit.invariant
statement:
theorem invariant (ps : List (PartialIso G)) (S : Set G) (p : PartialIso G)
    (hp : p ∈ ps) : p.Invariant (subgroup ps S)

name: OAI.Higman.Orbit.minimal
statement:
theorem minimal (ps : List (PartialIso G)) (S : Set G) (R : Subgroup G)
    (hS : S ⊆ R) (hR : ∀ p ∈ ps, p.Invariant R) : subgroup ps S ≤ R

name: OAI.Higman.Orbit.subset
statement:
theorem subset (ps : List (PartialIso G)) (S : Set G) :
    S ⊆ subgroup ps S

name: OAI.Higman.PartialIso.invariant_map
statement:
theorem invariant_map (p : PartialIso G) (i : G →* K) (hi : Function.Injective i)
    (R : Subgroup G) (S : Subgroup K) (he : S.comap i = R) (h : p.Invariant R) :
    (p.map i hi).Invariant S

name: OAI.Higman.PartialIso.invariant_sInf
statement:
theorem invariant_sInf (p : PartialIso G) (C : Set (Subgroup G))
    (hC : ∀ S ∈ C, p.Invariant S) : p.Invariant (sInf C)

name: OAI.Higman.PartialIso.map_equiv
statement:
@[simp] theorem map_equiv (p : PartialIso G) (i : G →* K) (hi : Function.Injective i)
    (a : p.source) :
    ((p.map i hi).equiv (p.source.equivMapOfInjective i hi a) : K) = i (p.equiv a)

name: OAI.Higman.DecoratedFreeBasis.inclusion_injective
statement: theorem inclusion_injective (w : X → G) : Function.Injective (inclusion w)

name: OAI.Higman.DecoratedFreeBasis.inclusion_of
statement:
@[simp] theorem inclusion_of (w : X → G) (x : X) :
    inclusion w (FreeGroup.of x) = inl (w x) * inr (FreeGroup.of x)

name: OAI.Higman.DecoratedFreeBasis.projection_comp
statement:
@[simp] theorem projection_comp (w : X → G) :
    (Coprod.snd : G ∗ FreeGroup X →* FreeGroup X).comp (inclusion w) = MonoidHom.id _

name: OAI.Higman.DecoratedFreeBasis.twist_inl
statement: @[simp] theorem twist_inl (w : X → G) (g : G) : twist w (inl g) = inl g

name: OAI.Higman.DecoratedFreeBasis.twist_inr_of
statement:
@[simp] theorem twist_inr_of (w : X → G) (x : X) : twist w (inr (FreeGroup.of x)) =
    inl (w x) * inr (FreeGroup.of x)

name: OAI.Higman.DecoratedMarker.commute_coefficient_translation
statement:
lemma commute_coefficient_translation (g : G) (t : T) :
    Commute (coefficient g : Base G T Q) (translation t)

name: OAI.Higman.DecoratedMarker.inclusion_injective
statement: theorem inclusion_injective : Function.Injective (inclusion (G := G) (T := T) (Q := Q))

name: OAI.Higman.DecoratedMarker.inclusion_inl
statement: @[simp] theorem inclusion_inl (g : G) : inclusion (inl g : Kernel G T Q) = coefficient g

name: OAI.Higman.DecoratedMarker.inclusion_inr_of
statement:
@[simp] theorem inclusion_inr_of (t : T) (q : Q) :
    inclusion (inr (FreeGroup.of (t,q)) : Kernel G T Q) = marker t q

name: OAI.Higman.DecoratedMarker.inclusion_shift
statement:
lemma inclusion_shift (t : T) :
    (inclusion (G := G) (Q := Q)).comp (shifts t).toMonoidHom =
      (MulAut.conj (translation t)).toMonoidHom.comp inclusion

name: OAI.Higman.DecoratedMarker.inverse_comp_test
statement:
@[simp] theorem inverse_comp_test : (inverse (G := G) (T := T) (Q := Q)).comp test =
    MonoidHom.id _

name: OAI.Higman.DecoratedMarker.inverse_inl
statement:
@[simp] theorem inverse_inl (x : Kernel G T Q) :
    inverse (SemidirectProduct.inl x) = inclusion x

name: OAI.Higman.DecoratedMarker.inverse_inr
statement:
@[simp] theorem inverse_inr (t : T) :
    inverse (SemidirectProduct.inr t : ShiftGroup G T Q) = translation t

name: OAI.Higman.DecoratedMarker.shift_inl
statement: @[simp] theorem shift_inl (t : T) (g : G) : shift t (inl g : Kernel G T Q) = inl g

name: OAI.Higman.DecoratedMarker.shift_inr_of
statement:
@[simp] theorem shift_inr_of (t s : T) (q : Q) :
    shift t (inr (FreeGroup.of (s,q)) : Kernel G T Q) = inr (FreeGroup.of (t*s,q))

name: OAI.Higman.DecoratedMarker.test_coefficient
statement:
@[simp] theorem test_coefficient (g : G) : test (coefficient g : Base G T Q) =
    SemidirectProduct.inl (inl g)

name: OAI.Higman.DecoratedMarker.test_commute
statement:
lemma test_commute (g : G) (t : T) :
    Commute (SemidirectProduct.inl (inl g) : ShiftGroup G T Q)
      (SemidirectProduct.inr t)

name: OAI.Higman.DecoratedMarker.test_comp
statement:
@[simp] theorem test_comp : (test (G := G) (T := T) (Q := Q)).comp inclusion =
    SemidirectProduct.inl

name: OAI.Higman.DecoratedMarker.test_comp_inverse
statement:
@[simp] theorem test_comp_inverse : (test (G := G) (T := T) (Q := Q)).comp inverse =
    MonoidHom.id _

name: OAI.Higman.DecoratedMarker.test_inr_of
statement:
@[simp] theorem test_inr_of (q : Q) : test (inr (FreeGroup.of q) : Base G T Q) =
    SemidirectProduct.inl (inr (FreeGroup.of (1,q)))

name: OAI.Higman.DecoratedMarker.test_marker
statement:
@[simp] theorem test_marker (t : T) (q : Q) : test (marker t q : Base G T Q) =
    SemidirectProduct.inl (inr (FreeGroup.of (t,q)))

name: OAI.Higman.DecoratedMarker.test_translation
statement:
@[simp] theorem test_translation (t : T) : test (translation t : Base G T Q) =
    SemidirectProduct.inr t

name: OAI.Higman.MarkerEmbedding.embedding_coefficient
statement:
@[simp] theorem embedding_coefficient (f : D →* T) (o : P → T) (q : P → Q) (w : P → G)
    (g : G) : embedding f o q w (coefficient g) = coefficient g

name: OAI.Higman.MarkerEmbedding.embedding_injective
statement:
theorem embedding_injective [Nonempty P] (f : D →* T) (hf : Function.Injective f)
    (o : P → T) (q : P → Q) (w : P → G) (hi : Function.Injective (index f o q)) :
    Function.Injective (embedding f o q w)

name: OAI.Higman.MarkerEmbedding.embedding_inr_of
statement:
@[simp] theorem embedding_inr_of (f : D →* T) (o : P → T) (q : P → Q) (w : P → G)
    (p : P) : embedding f o q w (inr (FreeGroup.of p)) = coefficient (w p) * marker (o p) (q p)

name: OAI.Higman.MarkerEmbedding.embedding_marker
statement:
@[simp] theorem embedding_marker (f : D →* T) (o : P → T) (q : P → Q) (w : P → G)
    (d : D) (p : P) : embedding f o q w (marker d p) =
      coefficient (w p) * marker (f d * o p) (q p)

name: OAI.Higman.MarkerEmbedding.embedding_translation
statement:
@[simp] theorem embedding_translation (f : D →* T) (o : P → T) (q : P → Q) (w : P → G)
    (d : D) : embedding f o q w (translation d) = translation (f d)

name: OAI.Higman.MarkerEmbedding.index_injective
statement:
theorem index_injective (f : D →* T) (hf : Function.Injective f) (o : P → T)
    (q : P → Q) (hq : Function.Injective q) : Function.Injective (index f o q)

name: OAI.Higman.MarkerEmbedding.kernelMap_injective
statement:
theorem kernelMap_injective [Nonempty P] (f : D →* T) (o : P → T) (q : P → Q)
    (w : P → G) (hi : Function.Injective (index f o q)) :
    Function.Injective (kernelMap f o q w)

name: OAI.Higman.MarkerEmbedding.kernelMap_inl
statement:
@[simp] theorem kernelMap_inl (f : D →* T) (o : P → T) (q : P → Q) (w : P → G) (g : G) :
    kernelMap f o q w (inl g) = inl g

name: OAI.Higman.MarkerEmbedding.kernelMap_inr_of
statement:
@[simp] theorem kernelMap_inr_of (f : D →* T) (o : P → T) (q : P → Q) (w : P → G) (x : D × P) :
    kernelMap f o q w (inr (FreeGroup.of x)) =
      inl (w x.2) * inr (FreeGroup.of (index f o q x))

name: OAI.Higman.MarkerEmbedding.kernelMap_shift
statement:
lemma kernelMap_shift (f : D →* T) (o : P → T) (q : P → Q) (w : P → G) (d : D) :
    (kernelMap f o q w).comp (shifts d).toMonoidHom =
      (shifts (f d)).toMonoidHom.comp (kernelMap f o q w)

name: OAI.Higman.DecoratedMarker.eq_inclusion_of_right_eq_one
statement:
theorem eq_inclusion_of_right_eq_one (x : Base G T Q) (hx : (test x).right = 1) :
    x = inclusion (test x).left

name: OAI.Higman.FreeBasis.erase_comp
statement: theorem erase_comp (S T : Set X) : (erase S).comp (erase T) = erase (S ∩ T)

name: OAI.Higman.FreeBasis.erase_eq_self_iff
statement: theorem erase_eq_self_iff (S : Set X) (g : FreeGroup X) : erase S g = g ↔ g ∈ span S

name: OAI.Higman.FreeBasis.erase_of
statement:
@[simp] theorem erase_of (S : Set X) (x : X) : erase S (FreeGroup.of x) =
    if x ∈ S then FreeGroup.of x else 1

name: OAI.Higman.FreeBasis.map_span_inf
statement:
theorem map_span_inf (d : FreeGroup X →* G) (r : G →* FreeGroup X)
    (hr : r.comp d = MonoidHom.id _) (U V : Set X) (A : Subgroup G)
    (hsupport : A.map r ≤ span U)
    (hletters : ∀ x ∈ U, d (FreeGroup.of x) ∈ A) :
    (span V).map d ⊓ A = (span (V ∩ U)).map d

name: OAI.Higman.FreeBasis.of_mem_span_iff
statement: theorem of_mem_span_iff (S : Set X) (x : X) : FreeGroup.of x ∈ span S ↔ x ∈ S

name: OAI.Higman.FreeBasis.span_inter
statement: theorem span_inter (S T : Set X) : span S ⊓ span T = span (S ∩ T)

name: OAI.Higman.MarkerEmbedding.comap_decoratedSubgroup
statement:
theorem comap_decoratedSubgroup [Nonempty P] (f : D →* T) (hf : Function.Injective f)
    (o : P → T) (q : P → Q) (w : P → G) (hi : Function.Injective (index f o q))
    (v : T × Q → G) (V : Set (T × Q)) :
    (decoratedSubgroup v V).comap (embedding f o q w) =
      decoratedSubgroup (pullDecoration f o q w v) (index f o q ⁻¹' V)

name: OAI.Higman.MarkerEmbedding.decoratedSubgroup_congr
statement:
lemma decoratedSubgroup_congr {v w : T × Q → G} {V : Set (T × Q)}
    (h : ∀ x ∈ V, v x = w x) : decoratedSubgroup v V = decoratedSubgroup w V

name: OAI.Higman.MarkerEmbedding.decoratedSubgroup_eq_closure
statement:
theorem decoratedSubgroup_eq_closure (v : T × Q → G) (V : Set (T × Q)) :
    decoratedSubgroup v V =
      Subgroup.closure ((fun x : T × Q ↦ coefficient (v x) * marker x.1 x.2) '' V)

name: OAI.Higman.MarkerEmbedding.decorated_intersection
statement:
theorem decorated_intersection (f : D →* T) (hf : Function.Injective f)
    (o : P → T) (q : P → Q) (w : P → G) (v : T × Q → G) (V : Set (T × Q)) :
    decoratedSubgroup v V ⊓ (embedding f o q w).range =
      decoratedSubgroup v (V ∩ Set.range (index f o q))

name: OAI.Higman.MarkerEmbedding.decorated_kernel_intersection
statement:
theorem decorated_kernel_intersection (f : D →* T) (o : P → T) (q : P → Q)
    (w : P → G) (v : T × Q → G) (V : Set (T × Q)) :
    (FreeBasis.span V).map (DecoratedFreeBasis.inclusion v) ⊓ (kernelMap f o q w).range =
      (FreeBasis.span (V ∩ Set.range (index f o q))).map (DecoratedFreeBasis.inclusion v)

name: OAI.Higman.MarkerEmbedding.decorated_letter_mem_range
statement:
lemma decorated_letter_mem_range (f : D →* T) (o : P → T) (q : P → Q) (w : P → G)
    (v : T × Q → G) (x : T × Q) (hx : x ∈ Set.range (index f o q)) :
    DecoratedFreeBasis.inclusion v (FreeGroup.of x) ∈ (kernelMap f o q w).range

name: OAI.Higman.MarkerEmbedding.embedding_decorated
statement:
@[simp] lemma embedding_decorated (f : D →* T) (o : P → T) (q : P → Q) (w : P → G)
    (v : T × Q → G) (x : D × P) :
    embedding f o q w (coefficient (pullDecoration f o q w v x) * marker x.1 x.2) =
      coefficient (v (index f o q x)) * marker (index f o q x).1 (index f o q x).2

name: OAI.Higman.MarkerEmbedding.embedding_inclusion
statement:
@[simp] theorem embedding_inclusion (f : D →* T) (o : P → T) (q : P → Q)
    (w : P → G) (x : Kernel G D P) :
    embedding f o q w (inclusion x) = inclusion (kernelMap f o q w x)

name: OAI.Higman.MarkerEmbedding.kernel_intersection
statement:
theorem kernel_intersection (f : D →* T) (hf : Function.Injective f)
    (o : P → T) (q : P → Q) (w : P → G) (R : Subgroup (Kernel G T Q)) :
    R.map inclusion ⊓ (embedding f o q w).range =
      (R ⊓ (kernelMap f o q w).range).map inclusion

name: OAI.Higman.MarkerEmbedding.map_decoratedSubgroup
statement:
lemma map_decoratedSubgroup (f : D →* T) (o : P → T) (q : P → Q) (w : P → G)
    (v : T × Q → G) (W : Set (D × P)) :
    (decoratedSubgroup (pullDecoration f o q w v) W).map (embedding f o q w) =
      decoratedSubgroup v (index f o q '' W)

name: OAI.Higman.MarkerEmbedding.projection_kernelMap
statement:
lemma projection_kernelMap (f : D →* T) (o : P → T) (q : P → Q) (w : P → G) :
    (Coprod.snd : Kernel G T Q →* FreeGroup (T × Q)).comp (kernelMap f o q w) =
      (FreeGroup.map (index f o q)).comp (Coprod.snd : Kernel G D P →* _)

name: OAI.Higman.MarkerEmbedding.range_projection_support
statement:
lemma range_projection_support (f : D →* T) (o : P → T) (q : P → Q) (w : P → G) :
    (kernelMap f o q w).range.map Coprod.snd ≤ FreeBasis.span (Set.range (index f o q))

name: OAI.Higman.MarkerEmbedding.test_embedding
statement:
@[simp] theorem test_embedding (f : D →* T) (o : P → T) (q : P → Q)
    (w : P → G) (x : Base G D P) :
    test (embedding f o q w x) =
      SemidirectProduct.map (kernelMap f o q w) f (kernelMap_shift f o q w) (test x)

name: OAI.Higman.MarkerMachine.Edge.inputMap_decorated
statement:
lemma inputMap_decorated (v : G) (d : e.Domain) :
    e.inputMap (coefficient v * marker d ()) =
      coefficient v * marker (e.input d).1 (e.input d).2

name: OAI.Higman.MarkerMachine.Edge.invariant

theorem invariant (v : T × Q → G) (V : Set (T × Q))
    (hV : ∀ d, e.input d ∈ V ↔ e.output d ∈ V)
    (hv : ∀ d, e.input d ∈ V → v (e.output d) = v (e.input d) * e.weight) :

name: OAI.Higman.MarkerMachine.Edge.invariant_decorated_iff

    (a : G) (d : e.Domain) :
    coefficient (a * e.weight) * marker (e.output d).1 (e.output d).2 ∈ R ↔
      coefficient a * marker (e.input d).1 (e.input d).2 ∈ R

lemma outputMap_decorated (v : G) (d : e.Domain) :

name: OAI.Higman.MarkerMachine.benign
statement:
theorem benign [Group.IsFinitelyPresented G] [Group.IsFinitelyPresented T] [Finite Q]

    (seed : T × Q) (v : T × Q → G)
    (hv : ∀ e ∈ es, ∀ d, Reach es seed (e.input d) →
      v (e.output d) = v (e.input d) * e.weight) :

name: OAI.Higman.MarkerMachine.orbit_eq

lemma relayerRightPure (x : Simplicial.Space (orbitSpan S)) (g : G) (hx : x.1 = Finsupp.single (0,g) 1) :

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Milnor.relayerRightValid
statement:
lemma relayerRightValid (φ : G →* H) (S : Finset (Finset (ℕ × G)))

    faceImage φ β s.1 ∪ faceImage φ (relayerFresh S α β) s.1 ∈ orbitSpan (relayerTarget φ S α β)

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Milnor.translate_mul
statement: lemma translate_mul (g h : G) (s : Finset (ℕ × G)) : translate g (translate h s) = translate (g*h) s

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Milnor.translate_one
statement: lemma translate_one (s : Finset (ℕ × G)) : translate 1 s = s

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Milnor.translate_union

name: OAI.GAD.sequential_union_bound
statement:
theorem sequential_union_bound {E : Type u_1} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    (P : ℕ → E → E) (hP : ∀ i x y, ⟪P i x, y-P i y⟫_ℝ = 0)
    (u : ℕ → E) (hu : ∀ i, u (i+1)=P i (u i)) (n : ℕ) :
    ‖u 0‖^2-‖u n‖^2 ≤ 4 * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, ‖u 0-P i (u 0)‖^2

name: OAI.GAD.applyKraus_posSemidef

name: OAI.GAD.applyKraus_trace

theorem applyKraus_trace {ι : Type u_10} {κ : Type u_11} {ρ : Type u_12} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ] [Fintype ρ]

name: OAI.GAD.channel_posSemidef

name: OAI.GAD.channel_trace

name: OAI.GAD.columns_mul_conjTranspose
statement:
theorem columns_mul_conjTranspose {ι : Type u_18} {κ : Type u_19} {ρ : Type u_20} [Fintype κ] [Fintype ρ]
    (L : ρ → Matrix ι κ ℂ) (ψ φ : κ → ℂ) :
    columns L ψ * (columns L φ).conjTranspose =
      ∑ r, L r * Matrix.vecMulVec ψ (star φ) * (L r).conjTranspose

name: OAI.GAD.columns_pure
statement:
theorem columns_pure {ι : Type u_21} {κ : Type u_22} {ρ : Type u_23} [Fintype κ] [Fintype ρ]
    (L : ρ → Matrix ι κ ℂ) (ψ : κ → ℂ) :
    columns L ψ * (columns L ψ).conjTranspose = applyKraus L (pure ψ)

name: OAI.GAD.kraus_complete
statement:
theorem kraus_complete (γ ν : ℝ) (hγ : γ ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1)
    (hν : ν ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) :
    ∑ r, (kraus γ ν r).conjTranspose * kraus γ ν r = 1

name: OAI.GAD.kraus_one
statement: @[simp] theorem kraus_one (γ ν : ℝ) : kraus γ ν 1 = !![0, (Real.sqrt (γ * (1 - ν)) : ℂ); 0, 0]

name: OAI.GAD.kraus_three
statement: @[simp] theorem kraus_three (γ ν : ℝ) : kraus γ ν 3 = !![0, 0; (Real.sqrt (γ * ν) : ℂ), 0]

name: OAI.GAD.kraus_two
statement: @[simp] theorem kraus_two (γ ν : ℝ) : kraus γ ν 2 = !![(Real.sqrt ν * Real.sqrt (1 - γ) : ℂ), 0; 0, (Real.sqrt ν : ℂ)]

name: OAI.GAD.kraus_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem kraus_zero (γ ν : ℝ) : kraus γ ν 0 = !![(Real.sqrt (1 - ν) : ℂ), 0; 0, (Real.sqrt (1 - ν) * Real.sqrt (1 - γ) : ℂ)]

name: OAI.GAD.local_channel
statement:
theorem local_channel (γ ν : ℝ) (hγ : γ ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1)
    (hν : ν ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) (P : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) :
    applyKraus (kraus γ ν) P =
      !![((1-γ*ν:ℝ):ℂ)*P 0 0+((γ*(1-ν):ℝ):ℂ)*P 1 1,
         (Real.sqrt (1-γ):ℂ)*P 0 1;
         (Real.sqrt (1-γ):ℂ)*P 1 0,
         ((γ*ν:ℝ):ℂ)*P 0 0+((1-γ*(1-ν):ℝ):ℂ)*P 1 1]

name: OAI.GAD.det_linearDeriv

name: OAI.GAD.skew_resolvent_trace_bound
statement:
theorem skew_resolvent_trace_bound (K L : Matrix ι ι ℂ)
    (hK : K.conjTranspose = -K) (hL : L.IsHermitian) :
    (Matrix.trace (((1 + K)⁻¹ * L) * ((1 + K)⁻¹ * L))).re ≤

name: OAI.GAD.skew_shift_trace_bound
statement:
theorem skew_shift_trace_bound (D Z H : Matrix ι ι ℂ)
    (hD : D.PosDef) (hZ : Z.conjTranspose = -Z) (hH : H.IsHermitian) :
    IsUnit (D + Z) ∧
      (Matrix.trace (((D + Z)⁻¹ * H) * ((D + Z)⁻¹ * H))).re ≤
        (Matrix.trace ((D⁻¹ * H) * (D⁻¹ * H))).re

name: OAI.GAD.trace_square_re_le
statement:
theorem trace_square_re_le (B : Matrix ι ι ℂ) :
    (Matrix.trace (B * B)).re ≤ (Matrix.trace (B.conjTranspose * B)).re

name: OAI.GAD.skewLogDet_fromBlocks
statement:
theorem skewLogDet_fromBlocks (Z : Matrix ι κ ℂ)
    {D : Matrix ι ι ℂ} {E : Matrix κ κ ℂ} (hD : D.PosDef) (hE : E.PosDef) :
    skewLogDet (Matrix.fromBlocks 0 Z (-Zᴴ) 0) (Matrix.fromBlocks D 0 0 E) =

statement:
theorem diag_eq_spectral_mix {A : Matrix ι ι ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (i : ι) :
    (A i i).re = ∑ j, Complex.normSq (hA.eigenvectorUnitary i j) * hA.eigenvalues j

name: OAI.GAD.entropy_eq_sum
statement:
theorem entropy_eq_sum {A : Matrix ι ι ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) :
    entropy A = ∑ i, Real.negMulLog (hA.eigenvalues i)

name: OAI.GAD.entropy_le_diagonal
statement:
theorem entropy_le_diagonal {A : Matrix ι ι ℂ} (hA : A.PosSemidef) :

statement:
theorem trace_cfc_eq {A : Matrix ι ι ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (f : ℝ → ℝ) :

name: OAI.GAD.trace_unitary_conj
statement:
theorem trace_unitary_conj (U : Matrix.unitaryGroup ι ℂ) (A : Matrix ι ι ℂ) :

theorem unitary_col_sq_sum (U : Matrix.unitaryGroup ι ℂ) (j : ι) :

name: OAI.GAD.unitary_row_sq_sum
statement:
theorem unitary_row_sq_sum (U : Matrix.unitaryGroup ι ℂ) (i : ι) :

name: OAI.GAD.entropy_eq_of_logDetShift_eq
statement:
theorem entropy_eq_of_logDetShift_eq {κ : Type u_4} [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ]
    {A : Matrix ι ι ℂ} {B : Matrix κ κ ℂ} (hA : A.PosSemidef) (hB : B.PosSemidef)
    (htrace : A.trace.re = B.trace.re)
    (hlog : ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → logDetShift r A = logDetShift r B) :
    entropy A = entropy B

name: OAI.GAD.entropy_le_of_logDetShift_le
statement:
theorem entropy_le_of_logDetShift_le {κ : Type u_3} [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ]
    {A : Matrix ι ι ℂ} {B : Matrix κ κ ℂ} (hA : A.PosSemidef) (hB : B.PosSemidef)
    (htrace : A.trace.re = B.trace.re)
    (hlog : ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → logDetShift r A ≤ logDetShift r B) :

    (A : Matrix ι κ ℂ) : entropy (A * Aᴴ) = entropy (Aᴴ * A)

name: OAI.GAD.entropy_sum_le_of_log_sum_le
statement:
theorem entropy_sum_le_of_log_sum_le {ι : Type u_1} [Fintype ι]
    (c a : ι → ℝ) (ha : ∀ i, 0 ≤ a i) (htrace : ∑ i, c i * a i = 0)
    (hlog : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → ∑ i, c i * Real.log (1 + a i / t) ≤ 0) :
    ∑ i, c i * Real.negMulLog (a i) ≤ 0

name: OAI.GAD.logDetShift_eq_sum
statement:
theorem logDetShift_eq_sum {A : Matrix ι ι ℂ} (hA : A.PosSemidef)
    {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) :
    logDetShift r A = ∑ i, Real.log (1 + r * hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues i)

name: OAI.GAD.logEntropyPrimitive_zero
statement:
theorem logEntropyPrimitive_zero (a : ℝ) :
    logEntropyPrimitive a 0 = - Real.negMulLog a

theorem tendsto_logEntropyPrimitive (a : ℝ) :
