name: OAI.GAD.blockLogDet_diagonal_le
statement:
theorem blockLogDet_diagonal_le (z : ι → ℂ) {D E : Matrix ι ι ℂ}
    (hD : D.PosDef) (hE : E.PosDef) :
    blockLogDet (Matrix.diagonal z) (Matrix.diagonal (fun i ↦ D i i))
      (Matrix.diagonal (fun i ↦ E i i)) ≤ blockLogDet (Matrix.diagonal z) D E

name: OAI.GAD.blockLogDet_partialPinch_le
statement:
theorem blockLogDet_partialPinch_le (z : ι → ℂ) {D E : Matrix ι ι ℂ}
    (hD : D.PosDef) (hE : E.PosDef) (s : Finset ι) :
    blockLogDet (Matrix.diagonal z) (partialPinch s D) (partialPinch s E) ≤
      blockLogDet (Matrix.diagonal z) D E

name: OAI.GAD.blockLogDet_unitary
statement:
theorem blockLogDet_unitary (U V : Matrix.unitaryGroup ι ℂ) (Z D E : Matrix ι ι ℂ) :
    blockLogDet ((U : Matrix ι ι ℂ)*Z*(star V : Matrix ι ι ℂ))
      ((U : Matrix ι ι ℂ)*D*(star U : Matrix ι ι ℂ))
      ((V : Matrix ι ι ℂ)*E*(star V : Matrix ι ι ℂ)) = blockLogDet Z D E

name: OAI.GAD.flipSign_conj_apply
statement:
theorem flipSign_conj_apply (k i j : ι) (A : Matrix ι ι ℂ) :
    ((flipSign k : Matrix ι ι ℂ) * A * (star (flipSign k) : Matrix ι ι ℂ)) i j =
      (if i = k then (-1 : ℂ) else 1) * A i j * (if j = k then (-1 : ℂ) else 1)

name: OAI.GAD.flipSign_diagonal
statement:
theorem flipSign_diagonal (k : ι) (z : ι → ℂ) :
    (flipSign k : Matrix ι ι ℂ) * Matrix.diagonal z *
      (star (flipSign k) : Matrix ι ι ℂ) = Matrix.diagonal z

name: OAI.GAD.inv_unitary_conj
statement:
theorem inv_unitary_conj (U : Matrix.unitaryGroup ι ℂ) (A : Matrix ι ι ℂ) :
    ((U : Matrix ι ι ℂ) * A * (star U : Matrix ι ι ℂ))⁻¹ =
      (U : Matrix ι ι ℂ) * A⁻¹ * (star U : Matrix ι ι ℂ)

name: OAI.GAD.partialPinch_empty
statement: theorem partialPinch_empty (A : Matrix ι ι ℂ) : partialPinch ∅ A = A

name: OAI.GAD.partialPinch_insert
statement:
theorem partialPinch_insert (s : Finset ι) (k : ι) (A : Matrix ι ι ℂ) :
    partialPinch (insert k s) A = (1/2 : ℝ) • partialPinch s A +
      (1/2 : ℝ) • ((flipSign k : Matrix ι ι ℂ) * partialPinch s A *
        (star (flipSign k) : Matrix ι ι ℂ))

name: OAI.GAD.partialPinch_posDef
statement:
theorem partialPinch_posDef {D : Matrix ι ι ℂ} (hD : D.PosDef) (s : Finset ι) :
    (partialPinch s D).PosDef

name: OAI.GAD.partialPinch_univ
statement:
theorem partialPinch_univ (A : Matrix ι ι ℂ) :
    partialPinch Finset.univ A = Matrix.diagonal (fun i ↦ A i i)

name: OAI.GAD.blockLogDet_diagonal_real
statement:
theorem blockLogDet_diagonal_real (z d e : ι → ℝ) (hd : ∀ i, 0 < d i) (he : ∀ i, 0 < e i) :
    blockLogDet (Matrix.diagonal (fun i ↦ (z i : ℂ)))
      (Matrix.diagonal (fun i ↦ (d i : ℂ))) (Matrix.diagonal (fun i ↦ (e i : ℂ))) =
      ∑ i, Real.log (1+(z i)^2/(d i*e i))

name: OAI.GAD.det_one_add_gram_zeroBlock
statement:
theorem det_one_add_gram_zeroBlock (A : Matrix ι κ ℂ) (B : Matrix ι μ ℂ)
    (C : Matrix ν κ ℂ) :
    (1+gram (zeroBlock A B C)).det = (1+gram C).det *
      (1+gram B+A*(1+Cᴴ*C)⁻¹*Aᴴ).det

name: OAI.GAD.gram_sqrt_smul
statement:
theorem gram_sqrt_smul {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) (A : Matrix ι κ ℂ) :
    gram (Real.sqrt r • A) = r • gram A

name: OAI.GAD.gram_zeroBlock
statement:
theorem gram_zeroBlock (A : Matrix ι κ ℂ) (B : Matrix ι μ ℂ) (C : Matrix ν κ ℂ) :
    gram (zeroBlock A B C) = Matrix.fromBlocks (gram A + gram B) (A*Cᴴ) (C*Aᴴ) (gram C)

name: OAI.GAD.logDetShift_diagonal_real
statement:
theorem logDetShift_diagonal_real (r : ℝ) (d : ι → ℝ) (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hd : ∀ i, 0 ≤ d i) :
    logDetShift r (Matrix.diagonal (fun i ↦ (d i : ℂ))) = ∑ i, Real.log (1+r*d i)

name: OAI.GAD.logDetShift_eq_logGram
statement:
theorem logDetShift_eq_logGram {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) (A : Matrix ι κ ℂ) :
    logDetShift r (gram A) = logGram (Real.sqrt r • A)

name: OAI.GAD.logDetShift_zeroBlock
statement:
theorem logDetShift_zeroBlock {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) (A : Matrix ι κ ℂ)
    (B : Matrix ι μ ℂ) (C : Matrix ν κ ℂ) :
    logDetShift r (gram (zeroBlock A B C)) = logDetShift r (gram B) +
      logDetShift r (gram C) + blockLogDet (Real.sqrt r • A) (1+r • gram B) (1+r • (Cᴴ*C))

name: OAI.GAD.logGram_zeroBlock
statement:
theorem logGram_zeroBlock (A : Matrix ι κ ℂ) (B : Matrix ι μ ℂ)
    (C : Matrix ν κ ℂ) :
    logGram (zeroBlock A B C) = logGram B + logGram C +
      blockLogDet A (1+gram B) (1+Cᴴ*C)

name: OAI.GAD.log_norm_det_diagonal_real
statement:
theorem log_norm_det_diagonal_real (d : ι → ℝ) (hd : ∀ i, 0 < d i) :
    Real.log ‖(Matrix.diagonal (fun i ↦ (d i : ℂ))).det‖ = ∑ i, Real.log (d i)

name: OAI.GAD.mass_nonneg
statement: theorem mass_nonneg (A : Matrix ι κ ℂ) : 0 ≤ mass A

name: OAI.GAD.mass_zeroBlock
statement:
theorem mass_zeroBlock (A : Matrix ι κ ℂ) (B : Matrix ι μ ℂ) (C : Matrix ν κ ℂ) :
    mass (zeroBlock A B C) = mass A + mass B + mass C

name: OAI.GAD.one_add_gram_posDef
statement: theorem one_add_gram_posDef (A : Matrix ι κ ℂ) : (1 + gram A).PosDef

name: OAI.GAD.resolvent_complement
statement:
theorem resolvent_complement (C : Matrix ν κ ℂ) :
    1 - Cᴴ * (1 + C*Cᴴ)⁻¹ * C = (1+Cᴴ*C)⁻¹

name: OAI.GAD.blockLambda_properties
statement:
theorem blockLambda_properties {x y z : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hy : 0 ≤ y) (hz : 0 ≤ z) :
    0 ≤ blockLambdaPlus x y z ∧ 0 ≤ blockLambdaMinus x y z ∧
    blockLambdaPlus x y z + blockLambdaMinus x y z = x + y + z ∧
    blockLambdaPlus x y z * blockLambdaMinus x y z = y*z

name: OAI.GAD.blockLogDet_scalar
statement:
theorem blockLogDet_scalar {q d e : ℝ} (hq : 0 ≤ q) (hd : 0 < d) (he : 0 < e) :
    blockLogDet (Matrix.diagonal (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ (Real.sqrt q : ℂ)))
      (Matrix.diagonal (fun _ ↦ (d : ℂ))) (Matrix.diagonal (fun _ ↦ (e : ℂ))) =
      Real.log (1 + q/(d*e))

name: OAI.GAD.deficitSpectrum_entropy
statement:
theorem deficitSpectrum_entropy (x y z : ℝ) :
    ∑ i, deficitSigns i * Real.negMulLog (deficitSpectrum x y z i) = scalarDeficit x y z

name: OAI.GAD.deficitSpectrum_log
statement:
theorem deficitSpectrum_log {x y z t : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hy : 0 ≤ y) (hz : 0 ≤ z)
    (ht : 0 < t) :
    ∑ i, deficitSigns i * Real.log (1 + deficitSpectrum x y z i / t) = deficitLog x y z t

name: OAI.GAD.deficitSpectrum_nonneg
statement:
theorem deficitSpectrum_nonneg {x y z : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hy : 0 ≤ y) (hz : 0 ≤ z)
    (i : Fin 5) : 0 ≤ deficitSpectrum x y z i

name: OAI.GAD.deficitSpectrum_trace
statement:
theorem deficitSpectrum_trace {x y z : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hy : 0 ≤ y) (hz : 0 ≤ z) :
    ∑ i, deficitSigns i * deficitSpectrum x y z i = 0

name: OAI.GAD.scalarDeficit_homogeneous
statement:
theorem scalarDeficit_homogeneous {a x y z : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a)
    (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hy : 0 ≤ y) (hz : 0 ≤ z) :
    scalarDeficit (a*x) (a*y) (a*z) = a * scalarDeficit x y z

name: OAI.GAD.scalarDeficit_mono
statement:
theorem scalarDeficit_mono {x y z y' z' : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hy : 0 ≤ y) (hz : 0 ≤ z)
    (hyy : y ≤ y') (hzz : z ≤ z') : scalarDeficit x y z ≤ scalarDeficit x y' z'

name: OAI.GAD.scalarDeficit_perspective
statement:
theorem scalarDeficit_perspective {x y z : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (hy : 0 ≤ y) (hz : 0 ≤ z) :
    scalarDeficit x y z = x * scalarDeficit 1 (y/x) (z/x)

name: OAI.GAD.scalarDeficit_weighted_le_of_log_le
statement:
theorem scalarDeficit_weighted_le_of_log_le {α : Type u_1} [Fintype α]
    (c x y z : α → ℝ) (hx : ∀ i, 0 ≤ x i) (hy : ∀ i, 0 ≤ y i) (hz : ∀ i, 0 ≤ z i)
    (hlog : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → ∑ i, c i * deficitLog (x i) (y i) (z i) t ≤ 0) :
    ∑ i, c i * scalarDeficit (x i) (y i) (z i) ≤ 0

name: OAI.GAD.scalarDeficit_zero
statement:
theorem scalarDeficit_zero {y z : ℝ} (hy : 0 ≤ y) (hz : 0 ≤ z) :
    scalarDeficit 0 y z = 0

name: OAI.GAD.coisometry_fromBlocks
statement:
theorem coisometry_fromBlocks (R : Matrix μ ι ℂ) (Q : Matrix ν κ ℂ)
    (hR : R*Rᴴ = 1) (hQ : Q*Qᴴ = 1) :
    Matrix.fromBlocks R 0 0 Q * (Matrix.fromBlocks R 0 0 Q)ᴴ = 1

name: OAI.GAD.deficitLog_inv
statement:
theorem deficitLog_inv {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (x : ℝ) {y z : ℝ} (hy : 0 ≤ y) (hz : 0 ≤ z) :
    deficitLog x y z r⁻¹ = Real.log (1+r*x) -
      Real.log (1+r*x/((1+r*y)*(1+r*z)))

name: OAI.GAD.entropy_gram_biisometry
statement:
theorem entropy_gram_biisometry (R : Matrix μ ι ℂ) (A : Matrix ι κ ℂ) (T : Matrix κ ν ℂ)
    (hR : Rᴴ*R = 1) (hT : T*Tᴴ = 1) : entropy (gram (R*A*T)) = entropy (gram A)

name: OAI.GAD.entropy_smul
statement:
theorem entropy_smul (a : ℝ) {P : Matrix ι ι ℂ} (hP : P.IsHermitian) :
    entropy (a • P) = a * entropy P + Real.negMulLog a * P.trace.re

name: OAI.GAD.entropy_sqrt_smul
statement:
theorem entropy_sqrt_smul {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (X : Matrix ι κ ℂ) (hX : mass X = 1) :
    entropy (gram (Real.sqrt a • X)) = a * entropy (gram X) + Real.negMulLog a

name: OAI.GAD.entropy_three_sub_le_deficits
statement:
theorem entropy_three_sub_le_deficits {ι : Type u_3} {κ : Type u_4} {μ : Type u_5} {ν : Type u_6} {τ : Type u_7}
    [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ] [Fintype μ] [Fintype ν] [Fintype τ]
    [DecidableEq ι] [DecidableEq κ] [DecidableEq μ] [DecidableEq ν]
    {A : Matrix ι ι ℂ} {B : Matrix κ κ ℂ} {C : Matrix μ μ ℂ} {D : Matrix ν ν ℂ}
    (hA : A.PosSemidef) (hB : B.PosSemidef) (hC : C.PosSemidef) (hD : D.PosSemidef)
    (x y z : τ → ℝ) (hx : ∀ i, 0 ≤ x i) (hy : ∀ i, 0 ≤ y i) (hz : ∀ i, 0 ≤ z i)
    (htrace : A.trace.re+B.trace.re+C.trace.re-D.trace.re = 0)
    (hlog : ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → logDetShift r A+logDetShift r B+logDetShift r C-logDetShift r D ≤
      ∑ i, deficitLog (x i) (y i) (z i) r⁻¹) :
    entropy A+entropy B+entropy C-entropy D ≤ ∑ i, scalarDeficit (x i) (y i) (z i)

name: OAI.GAD.exists_unitary_singular_decomposition
statement:
theorem exists_unitary_singular_decomposition (A : Matrix ι ι ℂ) :
    ∃ (U V : Matrix.unitaryGroup ι ℂ) (s : ι → ℝ),
      (∀ i, 0 ≤ s i) ∧ A = (U : Matrix ι ι ℂ) * Matrix.diagonal (fun i ↦ (s i : ℂ)) * star V

name: OAI.GAD.gram_biisometry
statement:
theorem gram_biisometry (R : Matrix μ ι ℂ) (A : Matrix ι κ ℂ) (T : Matrix κ ν ℂ)
    (hT : T*Tᴴ = 1) : gram (R*A*T) = R*gram A*Rᴴ

name: OAI.GAD.gram_diagonal_real
statement:
theorem gram_diagonal_real (s : ι → ℝ) :
    gram (Matrix.diagonal (fun i ↦ (s i : ℂ))) = Matrix.diagonal (fun i ↦ (((s i)^2 : ℝ) : ℂ))

name: OAI.GAD.isometry_fromBlocks
statement:
theorem isometry_fromBlocks (R : Matrix μ ι ℂ) (Q : Matrix ν κ ℂ)
    (hR : Rᴴ*R = 1) (hQ : Qᴴ*Q = 1) :
    (Matrix.fromBlocks R 0 0 Q)ᴴ * Matrix.fromBlocks R 0 0 Q = 1

name: OAI.GAD.logDetShift_inv_eq_sum
statement:
theorem logDetShift_inv_eq_sum {ω : Type u_2} [Fintype ω] [DecidableEq ω]
    {T : Matrix ω ω ℂ} (hT : T.PosSemidef) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) :
    logDetShift t⁻¹ T = ∑ i, Real.log (1+hT.isHermitian.eigenvalues i/t)

name: OAI.GAD.mass_biisometry
statement:
theorem mass_biisometry (R : Matrix μ ι ℂ) (A : Matrix ι κ ℂ) (T : Matrix κ ν ℂ)
    (hR : Rᴴ*R = 1) (hT : T*Tᴴ = 1) : mass (R*A*T) = mass A

name: OAI.GAD.mass_sqrt_smul
statement:
theorem mass_sqrt_smul {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (X : Matrix ι κ ℂ) :
    mass (Real.sqrt a • X) = a * mass X

name: OAI.GAD.posSemidef_diag_re
statement:
theorem posSemidef_diag_re {P : Matrix ι ι ℂ} (hP : P.PosSemidef) (i : ι) :
    ((P i i).re : ℂ) = P i i

name: OAI.GAD.scalarDeficit_normalized
statement:
theorem scalarDeficit_normalized {a b c : ℝ} (h : a+b+c=1) :
    scalarDeficit a b c = Real.negMulLog a + Real.negMulLog b + Real.negMulLog c - g (b*c)

name: OAI.GAD.trace_re_eq_sum_eigenvalues
statement:
theorem trace_re_eq_sum_eigenvalues {ω : Type u_1} [Fintype ω] [DecidableEq ω]
    {T : Matrix ω ω ℂ} (hT : T.PosSemidef) :
    T.trace.re = ∑ i, hT.isHermitian.eigenvalues i

name: OAI.GAD.zeroBlock_bimultiply
statement:
theorem zeroBlock_bimultiply {ι' : Type u_15} {κ' : Type u_16} {μ' : Type u_17} {ν' : Type u_18}
    [Fintype ι'] [Fintype κ'] [Fintype μ'] [Fintype ν']
    (R : Matrix ι' ι ℂ) (Q : Matrix ν' ν ℂ) (S : Matrix κ κ' ℂ) (T : Matrix μ μ' ℂ)
    (A : Matrix ι κ ℂ) (B : Matrix ι μ ℂ) (C : Matrix ν κ ℂ) :
    zeroBlock (R*A*S) (R*B*T) (Q*C*S) =
      Matrix.fromBlocks R 0 0 Q * zeroBlock A B C * Matrix.fromBlocks S 0 0 T

name: OAI.GAD.zeroBlock_diagonal_log_bound
statement:
theorem zeroBlock_diagonal_log_bound (s : ι → ℝ) (B : Matrix ι μ ℂ) (C : Matrix ν ι ℂ)
    {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) :
    let A := Matrix.diagonal (fun i ↦ (s i : ℂ))
    logDetShift r (gram A)+logDetShift r (gram B)+logDetShift r (gram C)-
      logDetShift r (gram (zeroBlock A B C)) ≤
    ∑ i, deficitLog ((s i)^2) ((gram B i i).re) ((Cᴴ*C) i i).re r⁻¹

name: OAI.GAD.blockSwap_conj
statement:
theorem blockSwap_conj (A B C D : Matrix ι ι ℂ) :
    Unitary.conjStarAlgAut ℂ _ (blockSwap (ι := ι)) (Matrix.fromBlocks A B C D) =
    Matrix.fromBlocks D C B A

name: OAI.GAD.isState_of_posSemidef_trace_re
statement:
theorem isState_of_posSemidef_trace_re {P : Matrix ι ι ℂ}
    (hP : P.PosSemidef) (ht : P.trace.re = 1) : IsState P

name: OAI.GAD.thermal_mix
statement:
theorem thermal_mix (X Y : Matrix ι κ ℂ) (a b c d a' b' c' d' K w w' : ℝ)
    (hw : w+w'=1) :
    w • thermal X Y a b c d K + w' • thermal X Y a' b' c' d' K =
      thermal X Y (w*a+w'*a') (w*b+w'*b') (w*c+w'*c') (w*d+w'*d') K

name: OAI.GAD.thermal_trace
statement:
theorem thermal_trace (X Y : Matrix ι κ ℂ) (hX : mass X = 1) (hY : mass Y = 1)
    (a b c d K : ℝ) : (thermal X Y a b c d K).trace.re = a+b+c+d

name: OAI.GAD.thermal_zeroEta_gram
statement:
theorem thermal_zeroEta_gram (X Y : Matrix ι κ ℂ) {a b d K : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hd : 0 ≤ d) (hK : 0 ≤ K) (had : a*d = K^2) :
    thermal X Y a b 0 d K =
      gram (zeroBlock (Real.sqrt a • X) (Real.sqrt b • Y) (Real.sqrt d • Y))

name: OAI.GAD.binEntropy_derivative_radius
statement:
theorem binEntropy_derivative_radius {s : ℝ} (hs : s ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) (1 / 2)) :
    Real.log (1 - (1 + radius s) / 2) - Real.log ((1 + radius s) / 2) =
      -logRatio (radius s)

name: OAI.GAD.continuous_g
statement: theorem continuous_g : Continuous g

name: OAI.GAD.continuous_objective
statement: theorem continuous_objective (γ ν : ℝ) : Continuous (objective γ ν)

name: OAI.GAD.continuous_wootters
statement: theorem continuous_wootters : Continuous wootters

statement:
theorem convexOn_output_entropy {γ ν : ℝ} (hγ : γ ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (hν : ν ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    ConvexOn ℝ (Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (fun p ↦ g (v γ ν p))

name: OAI.GAD.convexOn_sqrt_v
statement:
theorem convexOn_sqrt_v {γ ν : ℝ} (hγ : γ ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)

statement: theorem convexOn_wootters : ConvexOn ℝ (Icc (0 : ℝ) (1 / 2)) wootters

name: OAI.GAD.deriv2_wootters
statement:
theorem deriv2_wootters {s : ℝ} (hs : s ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) (1 / 2)) :
    deriv^[2] wootters s =
      2 * (logRatio (radius s) - 2 * radius s) / radius s ^ 3

name: OAI.GAD.deriv_wootters
statement:
theorem deriv_wootters {s : ℝ} (hs : s ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) (1 / 2)) :
    deriv wootters s = woottersSlope s

name: OAI.GAD.exists_maximizer
statement:
theorem exists_maximizer (γ ν : ℝ) :
    ∃ p ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ q ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, objective γ ν q ≤ objective γ ν p

name: OAI.GAD.logRatio_lower
statement:
theorem logRatio_lower {t : ℝ} (ht0 : 0 ≤ t) (ht1 : t < 1) :
    2 * t ≤ logRatio t

name: OAI.GAD.monotoneOn_wootters
statement: theorem monotoneOn_wootters : MonotoneOn wootters (Icc (0 : ℝ) (1 / 2))

name: OAI.GAD.radius_pos_lt_one
statement:
theorem radius_pos_lt_one {s : ℝ} (hs : s ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) (1 / 2)) :
    0 < radius s ∧ radius s < 1

name: OAI.GAD.radius_sq
statement:
theorem radius_sq {s : ℝ} (hs : s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) (1 / 2)) :
    radius s ^ 2 = 1 - 4 * s ^ 2

name: OAI.GAD.sqrt_v_mem
statement:
theorem sqrt_v_mem {γ ν : ℝ} (hγ : γ ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (hν : ν ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) {p : ℝ} (hp : p ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    Real.sqrt (v γ ν p) ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) (1 / 2)

name: OAI.GAD.v_le_quarter
statement:
theorem v_le_quarter {γ ν : ℝ} (hγ : γ ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (_hν : ν ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) {p : ℝ} (hp : p ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    v γ ν p ≤ 1 / 4

name: OAI.GAD.v_nonneg
statement:
theorem v_nonneg {γ ν : ℝ} (hγ : γ ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (hν : ν ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (p : ℝ) : 0 ≤ v γ ν p

name: OAI.GAD.v_population_form
statement:
theorem v_population_form (γ ν p : ℝ) :
    v γ ν p = ((1 - γ) * p + γ * ν) * (1 - ((1 - γ) * p + γ * ν)) -
      (1 - γ) * p * (1 - p)

name: OAI.GAD.wootters_sqrt
statement: theorem wootters_sqrt {u : ℝ} (hu : 0 ≤ u) : wootters (Real.sqrt u) = g u

name: OAI.GAD.entropy_diagonal
statement:
theorem entropy_diagonal (p : ι → ℝ) :
    entropy (Matrix.diagonal (fun i ↦ (p i : ℂ))) = ∑ i, Real.negMulLog (p i)

name: OAI.GAD.entropy_kronecker
OAI.GAD.entropy_kronecker_state
statement:
theorem entropy_kronecker_state {A : Matrix ι ι ℂ} {B : Matrix κ κ ℂ}
    (hA : IsState A) (hB : IsState B) : entropy (A ⊗ₖ B) = entropy A + entropy B

name: OAI.GAD.entropy_reindex
statement:
theorem entropy_reindex (e : ι ≃ κ) {A : Matrix ι ι ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) :
    entropy (Matrix.reindex e e A) = entropy A

name: OAI.GAD.trace_reindex
statement:
theorem trace_reindex (e : ι ≃ κ) (A : Matrix ι ι ℂ) :
    (Matrix.reindex e e A).trace = A.trace

name: OAI.GAD.basisSplit_inl
statement: @[simp] theorem basisSplit_inl {n : ℕ} (i : Basis n) : basisSplit n (Sum.inl i) = Fin.cons 0 i

name: OAI.GAD.basisSplit_inr
statement: @[simp] theorem basisSplit_inr {n : ℕ} (i : Basis n) : basisSplit n (Sum.inr i) = Fin.cons 1 i

name: OAI.GAD.channel_branch_blocks
statement:
theorem channel_branch_blocks (γ ν : ℝ) (hγ : γ ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1)
    (hν : ν ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) {n : ℕ} (ψ : Basis (n+1) → ℂ) :
    Matrix.reindex (basisSplit n).symm (basisSplit n).symm (channel γ ν (n+1) (pure ψ)) =
      thermal (columns (tensorKraus γ ν n) (branch ψ 0))
        (columns (tensorKraus γ ν n) (branch ψ 1))
        (1-γ*ν) (γ*(1-ν)) (γ*ν) (1-γ*(1-ν)) (Real.sqrt (1-γ))

name: OAI.GAD.channel_first_site_entry
statement:
theorem channel_first_site_entry (γ ν : ℝ) {n : ℕ} (ψ : Basis (n+1) → ℂ)
    (b c : Fin 2) (i j : Basis n) :
    channel γ ν (n+1) (pure ψ) (Fin.cons b i) (Fin.cons c j) =
      applyKraus (kraus γ ν)
        (fun a d ↦ (columns (tensorKraus γ ν n) (branch ψ a) *
          (columns (tensorKraus γ ν n) (branch ψ d)).conjTranspose) i j) b c

name: OAI.GAD.channel_pure_apply
statement:
theorem channel_pure_apply (γ ν : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (ψ : Basis n → ℂ) (i j : Basis n) :
    channel γ ν n (pure ψ) i j =
      ∑ r, (tensorKraus γ ν n r *ᵥ ψ) i * star ((tensorKraus γ ν n r *ᵥ ψ) j)

name: OAI.GAD.channel_state
statement:
theorem channel_state (γ ν : ℝ) (hγ : γ ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1)
    (hν : ν ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) (n : ℕ) {P : QMatrix n} (hP : IsState P) :
    IsState (channel γ ν n P)

name: OAI.GAD.columns_normalize
statement:
theorem columns_normalize [Inhabited κ] (L : ρ → Matrix ι κ ℂ) (ψ : κ → ℂ) :
    columns L ψ = Real.sqrt (vecMass ψ) • columns L (normalize ψ)

name: OAI.GAD.columns_smul
statement:
theorem columns_smul (L : ρ → Matrix ι κ ℂ) (ψ : κ → ℂ) (z : ℂ) :
    columns L (z • ψ) = z • columns L ψ

name: OAI.GAD.gram_columns
statement:
theorem gram_columns (L : ρ → Matrix ι κ ℂ) (ψ : κ → ℂ) :
    gram (columns L ψ) = applyKraus L (pure ψ)

name: OAI.GAD.mass_channel_columns
statement:
theorem mass_channel_columns (γ ν : ℝ) (hγ : γ ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1)
    (hν : ν ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) (n : ℕ) (ψ : Basis n → ℂ) :
    mass (columns (tensorKraus γ ν n) ψ) = vecMass ψ

name: OAI.GAD.normSq_normalize
statement:
theorem normSq_normalize [Inhabited ι] (ψ : ι → ℂ) (i : ι) :
    Complex.normSq (ψ i) = vecMass ψ * Complex.normSq (normalize ψ i)

name: OAI.GAD.normalize_mass
statement: theorem normalize_mass [Inhabited ι] (ψ : ι → ℂ) : vecMass (normalize ψ) = 1

name: OAI.GAD.population_le_mass
statement:
theorem population_le_mass {n : ℕ} (ψ : Basis n → ℂ) (j : Fin n) :

name: OAI.GAD.population_mem
statement:
theorem population_mem {n : ℕ} {ψ : Basis n → ℂ} (hψ : vecMass ψ = 1) (j : Fin n) :
    population ψ j ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1

name: OAI.GAD.population_nonneg
statement:
theorem population_nonneg {n : ℕ} (ψ : Basis n → ℂ) (j : Fin n) :
    0 ≤ population ψ j

name: OAI.GAD.population_normalize
statement:
theorem population_normalize {n : ℕ} (ψ : Basis n → ℂ) (j : Fin n) :

name: OAI.GAD.population_succ
statement:
theorem population_succ {n : ℕ} (ψ : Basis (n+1) → ℂ) (j : Fin n) :
    population ψ j.succ = population (branch ψ 0) j + population (branch ψ 1) j

name: OAI.GAD.population_zero
statement:
theorem population_zero {n : ℕ} (ψ : Basis (n+1) → ℂ) :
    population ψ 0 = vecMass (branch ψ 1)

name: OAI.GAD.pure_posSemidef
statement: theorem pure_posSemidef (ψ : ι → ℂ) : (pure ψ).PosSemidef

name: OAI.GAD.pure_state
statement: theorem pure_state [DecidableEq ι] {ψ : ι → ℂ} (hψ : vecMass ψ = 1) : IsState (pure ψ)

name: OAI.GAD.pure_trace
statement: theorem pure_trace (ψ : ι → ℂ) : (pure ψ).trace = (vecMass ψ : ℂ)

name: OAI.GAD.sqrt_mass_normalize
statement:
theorem sqrt_mass_normalize [Inhabited ι] (ψ : ι → ℂ) :
    (Real.sqrt (vecMass ψ) : ℂ) • normalize ψ = ψ

name: OAI.GAD.tensorKraus_mulVec_cons
statement:
theorem tensorKraus_mulVec_cons (γ ν : ℝ) {n : ℕ} (r : Fin 4) (R : Fin n → Fin 4)
    (ψ : Basis (n+1) → ℂ) (b : Fin 2) (i : Basis n) :
    (tensorKraus γ ν (n+1) (Fin.cons r R) *ᵥ ψ) (Fin.cons b i) =
      ∑ a : Fin 2, kraus γ ν r b a * (tensorKraus γ ν n R *ᵥ branch ψ a) i

name: OAI.GAD.thermal_sqrt_smul
statement:
theorem thermal_sqrt_smul (X Y : Matrix ι κ ℂ) (a b c d K : ℝ)
    {x y : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hy : 0 ≤ y) :
    thermal (Real.sqrt x • X) (Real.sqrt y • Y) a b c d K =
      thermal X Y (a*x) (b*y) (c*x) (d*y) (K*Real.sqrt x*Real.sqrt y)

name: OAI.GAD.vecMass_branches
statement:
theorem vecMass_branches {n : ℕ} (ψ : Basis (n+1) → ℂ) :
    vecMass ψ = vecMass (branch ψ 0) + vecMass (branch ψ 1)

name: OAI.GAD.vecMass_eq_zero
statement: theorem vecMass_eq_zero {ψ : ι → ℂ} : vecMass ψ = 0 ↔ ψ = 0

name: OAI.GAD.vecMass_nonneg
statement: theorem vecMass_nonneg (ψ : ι → ℂ) : 0 ≤ vecMass ψ

name: OAI.GAD.vecMass_smul
statement:
theorem vecMass_smul (z : ℂ) (ψ : ι → ℂ) :
    vecMass (z • ψ) = Complex.normSq z * vecMass ψ

name: OAI.GAD.vecMass_unitVec
statement: @[simp] theorem vecMass_unitVec [Inhabited ι] : vecMass (unitVec (ι := ι)) = 1

name: OAI.GAD.channel_mixture
statement:
theorem channel_mixture (γ ν : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (w : α → ℝ) (P : α → QMatrix n) :
    channel γ ν n (∑ a, w a • P a) = ∑ a, w a • channel γ ν n (P a)

name: OAI.GAD.entropy_mixture_upper
statement:
theorem entropy_mixture_upper (w : α → ℝ) (A : α → Matrix ι ι ℂ)
    (hw : ∀ a, 0 ≤ w a) (hA : ∀ a, IsState (A a)) :
    entropy (∑ a, w a • A a) ≤ ∑ a, (w a*entropy (A a)+Real.negMulLog (w a))

theorem matrixPopulation_mem {n : ℕ} {P : QMatrix n} (hP : IsState P) (j : Fin n) :

name: OAI.GAD.matrixPopulation_mixture

name: OAI.GAD.matrixPopulation_nonneg

theorem matrixPopulation_nonneg {n : ℕ} {P : QMatrix n} (hP : P.PosSemidef) (j : Fin n) :

name: OAI.GAD.spectral_weights_sum

name: OAI.GAD.state_mixture
statement:
theorem state_mixture (w : α → ℝ) (P : α → Matrix ι ι ℂ)

name: OAI.LeanBlast.CourtadeKumar.cubeAverage_nonneg

theorem cubeAverage_smul (c : ℝ) (g : Cube n → ℝ) :

name: OAI.LeanBlast.CourtadeKumar.cubeAverage_strict_mono

theorem cubeAverage_strict_mono {g h : Cube n → ℝ} (hgh : ∀ x, g x ≤ h x)

theorem cubeAverage_zeroDim (g : Cube 0 → ℝ) :

theorem noiseKernel_nonneg {u : ℝ} (hu0 : 0 ≤ u) (hu1 : u ≤ 1)

name: OAI.LeanBlast.CourtadeKumar.noiseKernel_one
statement:
@[simp] theorem noiseKernel_one (x y : Cube n) :
    noiseKernel 1 x y = if x = y then 1 else 0

name: OAI.LeanBlast.CourtadeKumar.noiseKernel_pos
statement:
theorem noiseKernel_pos {u : ℝ} (hu0 : 0 ≤ u) (hu1 : u < 1)
    (x y : Cube n) : 0 < noiseKernel u x y

name: OAI.LeanBlast.CourtadeKumar.noiseKernel_row_sum
statement:
theorem noiseKernel_row_sum (u : ℝ) (x : Cube n) :

name: OAI.LeanBlast.CourtadeKumar.noiseKernel_split_coord
statement:
theorem noiseKernel_split_coord (u : ℝ) (x y : Cube n) (i : Fin n) :
    noiseKernel u x y =
      (if x i = y i then (1 + u) / 2 else (1 - u) / 2) *
        ∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, if x j = y j then (1 + u) / 2 else (1 - u) / 2

name: OAI.LeanBlast.CourtadeKumar.noiseKernel_symm
statement:
theorem noiseKernel_symm (u : ℝ) (x y : Cube n) :
    noiseKernel u x y = noiseKernel u y x

name: OAI.LeanBlast.CourtadeKumar.noiseKernel_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem noiseKernel_zero (x y : Cube n) :

name: OAI.LeanBlast.CourtadeKumar.noiseOperator_add
statement:
theorem noiseOperator_add (u : ℝ) (g h : Cube n → ℝ) (x : Cube n) :

name: OAI.LeanBlast.CourtadeKumar.noiseOperator_bounds
statement:
theorem noiseOperator_bounds {u : ℝ} (hu0 : 0 ≤ u) (hu1 : u ≤ 1)

    -1 ≤ noiseOperator u g x ∧ noiseOperator u g x ≤ 1

name: OAI.LeanBlast.CourtadeKumar.noiseOperator_const
statement:
@[simp] theorem noiseOperator_const (u c : ℝ) (x : Cube n) :

name: OAI.LeanBlast.CourtadeKumar.noiseOperator_isInterior
statement:
theorem noiseOperator_isInterior {u : ℝ} (hu0 : 0 ≤ u) (hu1 : u < 1)

name: OAI.LeanBlast.CourtadeKumar.noiseOperator_isInterior_of_exists_signs
statement:
theorem noiseOperator_isInterior_of_exists_signs {u : ℝ} (hu0 : 0 ≤ u) (hu1 : u < 1)
    {g : Cube n → ℝ} (hg : IsSignValued g)
    (hpos : ∃ x, g x = 1) (hneg : ∃ y, g y = -1) :

name: OAI.LeanBlast.CourtadeKumar.noiseOperator_mono
statement:
theorem noiseOperator_mono {u : ℝ} (hu0 : 0 ≤ u) (hu1 : u ≤ 1)
    {g h : Cube n → ℝ} (hgh : ∀ y, g y ≤ h y) (x : Cube n) :
    noiseOperator u g x ≤ noiseOperator u h x

name: OAI.LeanBlast.CourtadeKumar.noiseOperator_neg
statement:
theorem noiseOperator_neg (u : ℝ) (g : Cube n → ℝ) (x : Cube n) :
    noiseOperator u (fun y => -g y) x = -noiseOperator u g x

name: OAI.LeanBlast.CourtadeKumar.noiseOperator_one
statement:
@[simp] theorem noiseOperator_one (g : Cube n → ℝ) (x : Cube n) :
    noiseOperator 1 g x = g x

name: OAI.LeanBlast.CourtadeKumar.noiseOperator_prod
statement:
theorem noiseOperator_prod (u : ℝ) (f : Fin n → Bool → ℝ) (x : Cube n) :
    noiseOperator u (fun y => ∏ i, f i (y i)) x =
      ∏ i, ∑ b : Bool, (if x i = b then (1 + u) / 2 else (1 - u) / 2) * f i b

name: OAI.LeanBlast.CourtadeKumar.noiseOperator_smul
statement:
theorem noiseOperator_smul (u c : ℝ) (g : Cube n → ℝ) (x : Cube n) :
    noiseOperator u (fun y => c * g y) x = c * noiseOperator u g x

name: OAI.LeanBlast.CourtadeKumar.noiseOperator_strict_mono
statement:
theorem noiseOperator_strict_mono {u : ℝ} (hu0 : 0 ≤ u) (hu1 : u < 1)
    {g h : Cube n → ℝ} (hgh : ∀ y, g y ≤ h y) (hlt : ∃ y, g y < h y) (x : Cube n) :
    noiseOperator u g x < noiseOperator u h x

name: OAI.LeanBlast.CourtadeKumar.noiseOperator_sub
statement:
theorem noiseOperator_sub (u : ℝ) (g h : Cube n → ℝ) (x : Cube n) :
    noiseOperator u (fun y => g y - h y) x = noiseOperator u g x - noiseOperator u h x

name: OAI.LeanBlast.CourtadeKumar.noiseOperator_zero_correlation
statement:
@[simp] theorem noiseOperator_zero_correlation (g : Cube n → ℝ) (x : Cube n) :
    noiseOperator 0 g x = cubeAverage g

statement:
theorem IsInterior.pairDomain {g : Cube (n + 1) → ℝ} (hg : IsInterior g) :

name: OAI.LeanBlast.CourtadeKumar.IsInterior.pairMean
statement:
theorem IsInterior.pairMean {g : Cube (n + 1) → ℝ} (hg : IsInterior g) :

statement:
theorem IsInterior.restrict {g : Cube (n + 1) → ℝ} (hg : IsInterior g) (b : Bool) :

statement:

name: OAI.LeanBlast.CourtadeKumar.cubeAverage_dim_zero
statement:
theorem cubeAverage_dim_zero (g : Cube 0 → ℝ) :

name: OAI.LeanBlast.CourtadeKumar.cubeAverage_div
statement:
theorem cubeAverage_div (g : Cube n → ℝ) (c : ℝ) :
    cubeAverage (fun x => g x / c) = cubeAverage g / c

name: OAI.LeanBlast.CourtadeKumar.cubeAverage_first_coordinate_energy
statement:
theorem cubeAverage_first_coordinate_energy (g : Cube (n + 1) → ℝ) :
    cubeAverage (fun x => Real.artanh (g x) * cubeDerivative 0 g x) =
      cubeAverage (fun x => pairDissipation (pairMean g x) (pairHalfDifference g x))

name: OAI.LeanBlast.CourtadeKumar.cubeAverage_half_sum
statement:
theorem cubeAverage_half_sum (g h : Cube n → ℝ) :
    cubeAverage (fun x => (g x + h x) / 2) = (cubeAverage g + cubeAverage h) / 2

name: OAI.LeanBlast.CourtadeKumar.cubeAverage_pairEntropyGap
statement:
theorem cubeAverage_pairEntropyGap (g : Cube (n + 1) → ℝ) :
    cubeAverage (fun x => pairEntropyGap (pairMean g x) (pairHalfDifference g x)) =
      entropyAverage (pairMean g) - entropyAverage g

name: OAI.LeanBlast.CourtadeKumar.cubeAverage_pairHalfDifference
statement:
theorem cubeAverage_pairHalfDifference (g : Cube (n + 1) → ℝ) :
    cubeAverage (pairHalfDifference g) =
      (cubeAverage (restrict g true) - cubeAverage (restrict g false)) / 2

name: OAI.LeanBlast.CourtadeKumar.cubeAverage_pairMean
statement:
@[simp] theorem cubeAverage_pairMean (g : Cube (n + 1) → ℝ) :
    cubeAverage (pairMean g) = cubeAverage g

name: OAI.LeanBlast.CourtadeKumar.cubeAverage_pairMean_add_halfDifference
statement:
theorem cubeAverage_pairMean_add_halfDifference (g : Cube (n + 1) → ℝ) :
    cubeAverage (pairMean g) + cubeAverage (pairHalfDifference g) =
      cubeAverage (restrict g true)

name: OAI.LeanBlast.CourtadeKumar.cubeAverage_pairMean_sub_halfDifference
statement:
theorem cubeAverage_pairMean_sub_halfDifference (g : Cube (n + 1) → ℝ) :
    cubeAverage (pairMean g) - cubeAverage (pairHalfDifference g) =
      cubeAverage (restrict g false)

name: OAI.LeanBlast.CourtadeKumar.cubeAverage_split
statement:
theorem cubeAverage_split (g : Cube (n + 1) → ℝ) :
    cubeAverage g = (cubeAverage (restrict g true) + cubeAverage (restrict g false)) / 2

name: OAI.LeanBlast.CourtadeKumar.cubeAverage_split_pair
statement:
theorem cubeAverage_split_pair (g : Cube (n + 1) → ℝ) :
    cubeAverage g = cubeAverage (fun x => (restrict g true x + restrict g false x) / 2)

name: OAI.LeanBlast.CourtadeKumar.cubeAverage_succ_coordinate_energy
statement:
theorem cubeAverage_succ_coordinate_energy (g : Cube (n + 1) → ℝ) (i : Fin n) :
    cubeAverage (fun x => Real.artanh (g x) * cubeDerivative i.succ g x) =
      (cubeAverage (fun x => Real.artanh (restrict g true x) * cubeDerivative i (restrict g true) x) +
        cubeAverage (fun x => Real.artanh (restrict g false x) * cubeDerivative i (restrict g false) x)) / 2

name: OAI.LeanBlast.CourtadeKumar.cubeVariance_eq
statement:
theorem cubeVariance_eq (g : Cube n → ℝ) :
    cubeVariance g = cubeAverage (fun x => (g x) ^ 2) - (cubeAverage g) ^ 2

name: OAI.LeanBlast.CourtadeKumar.cubeVariance_nonneg
statement: theorem cubeVariance_nonneg (g : Cube n → ℝ) : 0 ≤ cubeVariance g

name: OAI.LeanBlast.CourtadeKumar.dissipation_dim_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem dissipation_dim_zero (g : Cube 0 → ℝ) : dissipation g = 0

name: OAI.LeanBlast.CourtadeKumar.dissipation_split
statement:
theorem dissipation_split (g : Cube (n + 1) → ℝ) :
    dissipation g = (dissipation (restrict g true) + dissipation (restrict g false)) / 2 +
      cubeAverage (fun x => pairDissipation (pairMean g x) (pairHalfDifference g x))

name: OAI.LeanBlast.CourtadeKumar.entropyAverage_split
statement:
theorem entropyAverage_split (g : Cube (n + 1) → ℝ) :

name: OAI.LeanBlast.CourtadeKumar.flip_succ_cases

theorem flip_succ_cases (i : Fin n) (b : Bool) (x : Cube n) :

name: OAI.LeanBlast.CourtadeKumar.flip_zero_cases
statement:
theorem flip_zero_cases (b : Bool) (x : Cube n) :

name: OAI.LeanBlast.CourtadeKumar.informationDeficit_dim_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem informationDeficit_dim_zero (g : Cube 0 → ℝ) : informationDeficit g = 0

name: OAI.LeanBlast.CourtadeKumar.informationDeficit_eq_pairMean_add
statement:
theorem informationDeficit_eq_pairMean_add (g : Cube (n + 1) → ℝ) :
    informationDeficit g = informationDeficit (pairMean g) +
      cubeAverage (fun x => pairEntropyGap (pairMean g x) (pairHalfDifference g x))

name: OAI.LeanBlast.CourtadeKumar.informationDeficit_split
statement:
theorem informationDeficit_split (g : Cube (n + 1) → ℝ) :
    (informationDeficit (restrict g true) + informationDeficit (restrict g false)) / 2 =
      informationDeficit g - pairEntropyGap (cubeAverage (pairMean g))
        (cubeAverage (pairHalfDifference g))

name: OAI.LeanBlast.CourtadeKumar.meanVariance_split
statement:
theorem meanVariance_split (g : Cube (n + 1) → ℝ) :
    (meanVariance (restrict g true) + meanVariance (restrict g false)) / 2 =
      meanVariance g - (cubeAverage (pairHalfDifference g)) ^ 2

name: OAI.LeanBlast.CourtadeKumar.pairMean_add_halfDifference
statement:
@[simp] theorem pairMean_add_halfDifference (g : Cube (n + 1) → ℝ) (x : Cube n) :

name: OAI.LeanBlast.CourtadeKumar.pairMean_sub_halfDifference
statement:
@[simp] theorem pairMean_sub_halfDifference (g : Cube (n + 1) → ℝ) (x : Cube n) :

name: OAI.LeanBlast.CourtadeKumar.restrict_cubeDerivative_succ
statement:
theorem restrict_cubeDerivative_succ (g : Cube (n + 1) → ℝ) (i : Fin n) (b : Bool) :

statement:
theorem sum_cube_split (g : Cube (n + 1) → ℝ) :

name: OAI.LeanBlast.CourtadeKumar.conditionalProbability_eq_signProbability
statement:
theorem conditionalProbability_eq_signProbability (ε : ℝ) (f : Cube n → Bool)

    jointProbability ε f b y / observationMarginal ε f y =
      signProbability (noiseOperator (1 - 2 * ε) (signEncoding f) y) b

name: OAI.LeanBlast.CourtadeKumar.finite_kl_eq_entropy_sums
statement:
theorem finite_kl_eq_entropy_sums {A : Type u} {B : Type v} [Fintype A] [Fintype B]
    (j : A → B → ℝ) (hj : ∀ a b, 0 ≤ j a b) :
    (∑ a : A, ∑ b : B,
      if 0 < j a b then j a b * Real.log
        (j a b / ((∑ z : B, j a z) * (∑ z : A, j z b))) else 0) =
      (∑ a : A, ∑ b : B, xlogx (j a b)) -
        (∑ a : A, xlogx (∑ b : B, j a b)) -
        (∑ b : B, xlogx (∑ a : A, j a b))

name: OAI.LeanBlast.CourtadeKumar.xlogx_mul

name: OAI.LeanBlast.CourtadeKumar.cubeAverage_perspective_jensen
statement:
theorem cubeAverage_perspective_jensen {n : ℕ}
    (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hf : ConvexOn ℝ (Ioi 0) f)
    (A H : Cube n → ℝ) (hA : ∀ i, 0 < A i) (hH : ∀ i, 0 < H i) :
    cubeAverage A * f (cubeAverage H / cubeAverage A) ≤
      cubeAverage (fun i => A i * f (H i / A i))

name: OAI.LeanBlast.CourtadeKumar.weighted_perspective_jensen
statement:
theorem weighted_perspective_jensen {ι : Type u} [Fintype ι]
    (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hf : ConvexOn ℝ (Ioi 0) f)
    (p A H : ι → ℝ) (hp : ∀ i, 0 ≤ p i) (hA : ∀ i, 0 < A i)
    (hH : ∀ i, 0 < H i) (hS : 0 < ∑ i, p i * A i) :
    (∑ i, p i * A i) * f ((∑ i, p i * H i) / (∑ i, p i * A i)) ≤
      ∑ i, p i * A i * f (H i / A i)

name: OAI.LeanBlast.CourtadeKumar.perspective_log_trapezoid
statement:
theorem perspective_log_trapezoid (q w : ℝ)
    (hq0 : 0 ≤ q) (hqw : q < w) (hw1 : w ≤ 1) :
    2 * ((w - q) * Real.log (w - q) - (1 - q) * Real.log (1 - q) -
      w * Real.log w) ≤
      (1 - w) * (-Real.log (1 - q / w) - Real.log (1 - q))

name: OAI.QAC.orthogonal_sum_mul
statement:
lemma orthogonal_sum_mul (s : Finset ι) (p : ι → A)

    (horth : ∀ i ∈ s, ∀ j ∈ s, i ≠ j → p i * p j = 0) (c d : ι → ℝ) :
    (∑ i ∈ s, c i • p i) * (∑ i ∈ s, d i • p i) = ∑ i ∈ s, (c i * d i) • p i

name: OAI.QAC.Count.operator_norm_le
statement: lemma Count.operator_norm_le {N : ℕ} (M : Count N) : ‖M.operator‖ ≤ N

name: OAI.QAC.Count.operator_pow_spectral
statement:
lemma Count.operator_pow_spectral {N : ℕ} (M : Count N) (k : ℕ) :
    M.operator^k = M.spectral (fun j => (j:ℝ)^k)

name: OAI.QAC.Count.operator_spectral
statement:
lemma Count.operator_spectral {N : ℕ} (M : Count N) :
    M.operator = M.spectral (fun k => k)

name: OAI.QAC.Count.polynomial_error_low
statement:
lemma Count.polynomial_error_low {N : ℕ} (M : Count N) (p : Polynomial ℝ)
    {r δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) (hp0 : p.eval 0 = 1)
    (hp : ∀ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k → (k:ℝ) < r → |p.eval (k:ℝ)| ≤ δ) :
    ‖(M.zero - M.polynomial p) * M.low r‖ ≤ δ

name: OAI.QAC.Count.selectionSets_sum
statement:
lemma Count.selectionSets_sum {N : ℕ} (M : Count N) (S : Finset (Fin N)) (k : ℕ) :
    ((selectionSets S k).map (fun F => (M.restrict F).zero)).sum =
      (∑ i ∈ S, (M.restrict {i}).zero)^k

name: OAI.QAC.Count.spectral_mul
statement:
lemma Count.spectral_mul {N : ℕ} (M : Count N) (f g : ℕ → ℝ) :
    M.spectral f * M.spectral g = M.spectral (fun k => f k * g k)

name: OAI.QAC.Count.spectral_sub
statement:
lemma Count.spectral_sub {N : ℕ} (M : Count N) (f g : ℕ → ℝ) :
    M.spectral f - M.spectral g = M.spectral (fun k => f k - g k)

name: OAI.QAC.Count.zero_spectral
statement:
lemma Count.zero_spectral {N : ℕ} (M : Count N) :
    M.zero = M.spectral (fun k => if k = 0 then 1 else 0)

name: OAI.QAC.card_le_add_symmDiff
statement:
lemma card_le_add_symmDiff {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] (F G : Finset α) :
    G.card ≤ F.card + (F ∆ G).card

name: OAI.QAC.list_norm_sum_le
statement:
lemma list_norm_sum_le {A : Type*} [SeminormedAddCommGroup A] (l : List A) :
    ‖l.sum‖ ≤ (l.map norm).sum

name: OAI.QAC.list_sum_flatMap
statement:
lemma list_sum_flatMap {ι κ A : Type*} [AddMonoid A] (l : List ι) (f : ι → List κ) (g : κ → A) :
    ((l.flatMap f).map g).sum = (l.map (fun i => ((f i).map g).sum)).sum

name: OAI.QAC.norm_mul_le_left
statement:
lemma norm_mul_le_left {A : Type*} [NormedRing A] (x y : A) (hy : ‖y‖ ≤ 1) :
    ‖x*y‖ ≤ ‖x‖

name: OAI.QAC.norm_mul_le_right
statement:
lemma norm_mul_le_right {A : Type*} [NormedRing A] (x y : A) (hx : ‖x‖ ≤ 1) :
    ‖x*y‖ ≤ ‖y‖

name: OAI.QAC.selectionSets_card
statement:
lemma selectionSets_card {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] (S : Finset ι) (k : ℕ) :
    ∀ F ∈ selectionSets S k, F.card ≤ k

name: OAI.QAC.selectionSets_length
statement:
lemma selectionSets_length {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] (S : Finset ι) (k : ℕ) :
    (selectionSets S k).length = S.card^k

name: OAI.QAC.symmDiff_subset_of_subset
statement:
lemma symmDiff_subset_of_subset {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] {F G S : Finset α}
    (hF : F ⊆ S) (hG : G ⊆ S) : F ∆ G ⊆ S

name: OAI.QAC.Count.low_propagation_bound
statement:
lemma Count.low_propagation_bound {N : ℕ} (M : Count N) (B : Operator N)
    {r q R δ : ℝ} (hN : 1 ≤ N) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) (hrq : q + r ≤ R)
    (hB : ∀ K : Count N, ‖K.high q * B * K.zero‖ ≤ δ) :
    ‖M.high R * B * M.low r‖ ≤ (N+1:ℝ)^(⌈r⌉₊+1) * δ

name: OAI.QAC.conjugate_comp
statement: lemma conjugate_comp (U V B : A) : conjugate (U*V) B = conjugate U (conjugate V B)

name: OAI.QAC.conjugate_fixed
statement:
lemma conjugate_fixed {U B : A} (hU : U ∈ unitary A) (h : Commute U B) :
    conjugate U B = B

name: OAI.QAC.conjugate_list_sum
statement:
lemma conjugate_list_sum {ι : Type*} (U : A) (l : List ι) (f : ι → A) :
    conjugate U (l.map f).sum = (l.map (fun i => conjugate U (f i))).sum

name: OAI.QAC.conjugate_mul
statement:
lemma conjugate_mul {U : A} (hU : U ∈ unitary A) (B C : A) :
    conjugate U (B*C) = conjugate U B * conjugate U C

name: OAI.QAC.conjugate_one
statement: lemma conjugate_one {U : A} (hU : U ∈ unitary A) : conjugate U 1 = 1

name: OAI.QAC.conjugate_projection
statement:
lemma conjugate_projection {U B : A} (hU : U ∈ unitary A) (hB : IsStarProjection B) :
    IsStarProjection (U * B * star U)

name: OAI.QAC.conjugate_smul
statement: lemma conjugate_smul (U B : A) (r : ℝ) : conjugate U (r • B) = r • conjugate U B

name: OAI.QAC.conjugate_star
statement: lemma conjugate_star (U B : A) : conjugate U (star B) = star (conjugate U B)

name: OAI.QAC.conjugate_sub
statement: lemma conjugate_sub (U B C : A) : conjugate U (B-C) = conjugate U B - conjugate U C

name: OAI.QAC.list_conjugate_filter
statement:
lemma list_conjugate_filter {ι : Type*} (f : ι → A) (l : List ι) (p : ι → Bool) (B : A)
    (hl : l.Pairwise (fun a b => Commute (f a) (f b)))
    (hu : ∀ a ∈ l, f a ∈ unitary A)
    (hd : ∀ a ∈ l, p a = false → Commute (f a) B) :
    conjugate (l.map f).prod B = conjugate ((l.filter p).map f).prod B

name: OAI.QAC.list_disjoint_hits_length
statement:
lemma list_disjoint_hits_length {ι κ : Type*} [DecidableEq κ]
    (f : ι → Finset κ) (l : List ι) (hl : l.Pairwise (fun a b => Disjoint (f a) (f b)))
    (S : Finset κ) (hS : ∀ a ∈ l, (f a ∩ S).Nonempty) : l.length ≤ S.card

name: OAI.QAC.low_patterns_card
statement:
lemma low_patterns_card {N : ℕ} (S : Finset (Fin N)) {r : ℝ} (hN : 1 ≤ N) :
    (S.powerset.filter (fun F => (F.card:ℝ) < r)).card ≤ (N+1)^(⌈r⌉₊+1)

name: OAI.QAC.norm_list_smul_sum
statement:
lemma norm_list_smul_sum {ι A : Type*} [SeminormedAddCommGroup A] [NormedSpace ℝ A]
    (l : List ι) (c : ι → ℝ) (f : ι → A) (δ : ℝ) (hf : ∀ i ∈ l, ‖f i‖ ≤ δ) :
    ‖(l.map (fun i => c i • f i)).sum‖ ≤ (l.map (fun i => |c i|)).sum * δ

name: OAI.QAC.norm_mul_le_one
statement:
lemma norm_mul_le_one {A : Type*} [NormedRing A] {x y : A}
    (hx : ‖x‖ ≤ 1) (hy : ‖y‖ ≤ 1) : ‖x*y‖ ≤ 1

name: OAI.QAC.norm_split_bound
statement:
lemma norm_split_bound (E W P Q : A) (hP : ‖P‖ ≤ 1) (hQ : ‖Q‖ ≤ 1) :
    ‖E*P*Q‖ ≤ ‖E*(1-W)‖ + ‖E‖*‖W*P*Q‖

name: OAI.QAC.norm_unitary_conjugate
statement:
lemma norm_unitary_conjugate {U : A} (hU : U ∈ unitary A) (B : A) :
    ‖U * B * star U‖ = ‖B‖

name: OAI.QAC.projection_transition_square
statement:
lemma projection_transition_square (H P Q X : A)
    (hH : IsStarProjection H) (hP : IsStarProjection P) (hQ : IsStarProjection Q) :
    ‖H * Q * P‖^2 ≤ ‖H * X * P‖ + ‖(Q-X) * P * Q‖

name: OAI.QAC.sum_powers_bound
statement:
lemma sum_powers_bound (N K : ℕ) (hN : 1 ≤ N) :
    ∑ k ∈ Finset.range K, N^k ≤ (N+1)^K

name: OAI.QAC.three_factor_transition
statement:
lemma three_factor_transition (H P H₁ H₂ B₁ B₂ B₃ : A) {δ : ℝ}
    (hH : ‖H‖ ≤ 1) (hP : ‖P‖ ≤ 1)
    (hE₁ : ‖1-H₁‖ ≤ 1)
    (hB₁ : ‖B₁‖ ≤ 1) (hB₂ : ‖B₂‖ ≤ 1) (hB₃ : ‖B₃‖ ≤ 1)
    (h₁ : ‖H₁*B₃*P‖ ≤ δ) (h₂ : ‖H₂*B₂*(1-H₁)‖ ≤ δ)
    (h₃ : ‖H*B₁*(1-H₂)‖ ≤ δ) : ‖H*B₁*B₂*B₃*P‖ ≤ 3*δ

name: OAI.QAC.ReflectionLayer.active_conjugate
statement:
lemma ReflectionLayer.active_conjugate {N : ℕ} (R : ReflectionLayer N) (A : Count N) :
    conjugate (reflectionMatrix R) A.zero = conjugate (reflectionMatrix (R.active A)) A.zero

name: OAI.QAC.ReflectionLayer.active_length
statement:
lemma ReflectionLayer.active_length {N : ℕ} (R : ReflectionLayer N) (A : Count N) :
    (R.active A).gates.length ≤ A.support.card

name: OAI.QAC.bilinear_list_bound
statement:
lemma bilinear_list_bound {ι : Type*} (l : List ι) (c : ι → ℝ) (f : ι → A)
    (H B P : A) (δ : ℝ)
    (h : ∀ i ∈ l, ∀ j ∈ l, ‖H*f i*B*f j*P‖ ≤ δ) :
    ‖H * (l.map (fun i => c i • f i)).sum * B *
      (l.map (fun i => c i • f i)).sum * P‖ ≤ (l.map (fun i => |c i|)).sum^2 * δ

name: OAI.QAC.list_sum_sandwich
statement:
lemma list_sum_sandwich {ι : Type*} (l : List ι) (c : ι → ℝ) (f : ι → A) (L R : A) :
    L * (l.map (fun i => c i • f i)).sum * R =
      (l.map (fun i => c i • (L*f i*R))).sum

name: OAI.QAC.reflectList_selfAdjoint
statement:
lemma reflectList_selfAdjoint {N : ℕ} (l : List (Count N))
    (hl : l.Pairwise (fun A B => Disjoint A.support B.support)) :
    star (reflectList l) = reflectList l

name: OAI.QAC.reflect_disjoint_commute
statement:
lemma reflect_disjoint_commute {N : ℕ} (A B : Count N) (h : Disjoint A.support B.support) :
    Commute (reflect A) (reflect B)

name: OAI.QAC.reflect_disjoint_zero_commute
statement:
lemma reflect_disjoint_zero_commute {N : ℕ} (A B : Count N) (h : Disjoint A.support B.support) :
    Commute (reflect A) B.zero

name: OAI.QAC.reflect_unitary
statement: lemma reflect_unitary {N : ℕ} (D : Count N) : reflect D ∈ unitary (Operator N)

name: OAI.QAC.reflectionMatrix_eq
statement: lemma reflectionMatrix_eq {N : ℕ} (R : ReflectionLayer N) : reflectionMatrix R = reflectList R.gates

name: OAI.QAC.reflectionTerms_disjoint
statement:
lemma reflectionTerms_disjoint {N : ℕ} (A : Count N) (l : List (Count N))
    (h : ∀ B ∈ l, Disjoint A.support B.support) (p : ℝ × Count N) (hp : p ∈ reflectionTerms l) :
    Disjoint A.support p.2.support

name: OAI.QAC.reflectionTerms_sum
statement:
lemma reflectionTerms_sum {N : ℕ} (l : List (Count N))
    (hl : l.Pairwise (fun A B => Disjoint A.support B.support)) :
    ((reflectionTerms l).map (fun p => p.1 • p.2.zero)).sum = reflectList l

name: OAI.QAC.reflectionTerms_support
statement:
lemma reflectionTerms_support {N : ℕ} (l : List (Count N)) :
    ∀ p ∈ reflectionTerms l, ∀ i ∈ p.2.support, ∃ A ∈ l, i ∈ A.support

name: OAI.QAC.reflectionTerms_weight
statement:
lemma reflectionTerms_weight {N : ℕ} (l : List (Count N)) :
    ((reflectionTerms l).map (fun p => |p.1|)).sum = (3:ℝ)^l.length

name: OAI.QAC.reflection_conjugate_expansion
statement:
lemma reflection_conjugate_expansion {N : ℕ} (l : List (Count N))
    (hl : l.Pairwise (fun A B => Disjoint A.support B.support)) (V : Operator N) :
    conjugate V (reflectList l) =
      ((reflectionTerms l).map (fun p => p.1 • conjugate V p.2.zero)).sum

name: OAI.QAC.reflection_transition_bound
statement:
lemma reflection_transition_bound {N : ℕ} (R : ReflectionLayer N) (V H P : Operator N)
    (A : Count N) (hV : V ∈ unitary (Operator N)) (δ : ℝ)
    (h : ∀ X Y : Count N, ‖H*conjugate V X.zero*conjugate V A.zero*conjugate V Y.zero*P‖ ≤ δ) :
    ‖H*conjugate V (conjugate (reflectionMatrix R) A.zero)*P‖ ≤ (9:ℝ)^R.gates.length*δ

name: OAI.QAC.small_support_layer_bound
statement:
lemma small_support_layer_bound {N : ℕ} (V : Operator N) (hV : V ∈ unitary (Operator N))
    (R : ReflectionLayer N) (L : LocalLayer N) (M A : Count N) {r r₁ r₂ δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 ≤ δ)
    (h₁ : ∀ D : Count N, ‖M.high r₁*conjugate V D.zero*M.zero‖ ≤ δ)
    (h₂ : ∀ D : Count N, ‖M.high r₂*conjugate V D.zero*M.low r₁‖ ≤ δ)
    (h₃ : ∀ D : Count N, ‖M.high r*conjugate V D.zero*M.low r₂‖ ≤ δ) :
    ‖M.high r*conjugate (V*reflectionMatrix R*localMatrix L) A.zero*M.zero‖ ≤
      (9:ℝ)^A.support.card*(3*δ)

name: OAI.QAC.star_list_sum
statement:
lemma star_list_sum {A ι : Type*} [AddMonoid A] [StarAddMonoid A] (l : List ι) (f : ι → A) :
    star (l.map f).sum = (l.map (fun i => star (f i))).sum

name: OAI.QAC.basisVector_normalized
statement: lemma basisVector_normalized (b : Bit) : ∑ x, Complex.normSq (basisVector b x) = 1

name: OAI.QAC.halfScale_nonneg
statement: lemma halfScale_nonneg : 0 ≤ halfScale

name: OAI.QAC.halfScale_sq
statement: lemma halfScale_sq : halfScale^2 = 1/2

name: OAI.QAC.minusVector_normalized
statement: lemma minusVector_normalized : ∑ b, Complex.normSq (minusVector b) = 1

name: OAI.QAC.rankOne_basis
statement:
lemma rankOne_basis (b : Bit) (x y : Bit) :
    rankOne (basisVector b) x y = if x=b ∧ y=b then 1 else 0

name: OAI.QAC.rankOne_minus
statement:
lemma rankOne_minus (x y : Bit) :
    rankOne minusVector x y = if x=y then (1/2:ℂ) else -(1/2:ℂ)

name: OAI.QAC.toffoliCount_entry
statement:
lemma toffoliCount_entry {N : ℕ} (c : Finset (Fin N)) (t : Fin N) (ht : t ∉ c)
    (x y : Word N) :
    (toffoliCount c t).zero x y =
      if (∀ i, i ≠ t → x i=y i) ∧ (∀ i ∈ c, y i=1) then
        rankOne minusVector (x t) (y t) else 0

name: OAI.QAC.toffoli_reflection
statement:
lemma toffoli_reflection {N : ℕ} (c : Finset (Fin N)) (t : Fin N) (ht : t ∉ c) :
    Gate.matrix (.toffoli c t ht) = reflect (toffoliCount c t)

name: OAI.QAC.basisProjection_mul_entry
statement:
lemma basisProjection_mul_entry {N : ℕ} (z : Word N) (A : Operator N) (y : Word N) :
    (basisProjection z*A) z y = A z y

name: OAI.QAC.bitH_X_H
statement: lemma bitH_X_H : bitH*bitX*bitH=bitZ

name: OAI.QAC.bitH_sq
statement: lemma bitH_sq : bitH*bitH=1

name: OAI.QAC.bitH_star
statement: lemma bitH_star : star bitH=bitH

name: OAI.QAC.bitH_unitary
statement: lemma bitH_unitary : bitH ∈ unitary QubitOperator

name: OAI.QAC.computationalCount_pattern
statement:
lemma computationalCount_pattern {N : ℕ} (z : Word N) (F : Finset (Fin N)) :
    (computationalCount z).pattern F = basisProjection (flipWord F z)

name: OAI.QAC.computationalCount_zero
statement: lemma computationalCount_zero {N : ℕ} (z : Word N) : (computationalCount z).zero=basisProjection z

name: OAI.QAC.flipWord_involutive
statement: lemma flipWord_involutive {N : ℕ} (F : Finset (Fin N)) : Function.Involutive (flipWord F)

name: OAI.QAC.halfScale_complex_sq
statement: lemma halfScale_complex_sq : (halfScale:ℂ)^2=1/2

name: OAI.QAC.high_entry_bound
statement:
lemma high_entry_bound {N : ℕ} (B : Operator N) (z : Word N) (F : Finset (Fin N))
    {r : ℝ} (hr : r ≤ (F.card:ℝ)) :
    ‖B (flipWord F z) z‖ ≤ ‖(computationalCount z).high r*B*(computationalCount z).zero‖

name: OAI.QAC.inputHadamard_flip
statement:
lemma inputHadamard_flip (n N : ℕ) :
    localMatrix (inputHadamard n N)*inputFlip n N*localMatrix (inputHadamard n N) = inputPhase n N

name: OAI.QAC.inputHadamard_star
statement:
lemma inputHadamard_star (n N : ℕ) : star (localMatrix (inputHadamard n N)) =
    localMatrix (inputHadamard n N)

name: OAI.QAC.inputSet_card
statement: lemma inputSet_card {n N : ℕ} (hnN : n ≤ N) : (inputSet n N).card=n

name: OAI.QAC.matrix_entry_norm_le
statement:
lemma matrix_entry_norm_le {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (A : Matrix ι ι ℂ) (i j : ι) :
    ‖A i j‖ ≤ ‖A‖

name: OAI.QAC.mul_basisProjection_entry
statement:
lemma mul_basisProjection_entry {N : ℕ} (z : Word N) (A : Operator N) (y : Word N) :
    (A*basisProjection z) y z = A y z

name: OAI.QAC.one_sub_rankOne_basis
statement:
lemma one_sub_rankOne_basis (b : Bit) :
    1-rankOne (basisVector b) = rankOne (basisVector (1-b))

name: OAI.QAC.rankOne_basis_diagonal
statement:
lemma rankOne_basis_diagonal (b : Bit) :
    rankOne (basisVector b) = Matrix.diagonal (fun x => if x=b then 1 else 0)

name: OAI.QAC.tensorMatrix_diagonal
statement:
lemma tensorMatrix_diagonal {N : ℕ} (f : Fin N → Bit → ℂ) :
    tensorMatrix (fun i => Matrix.diagonal (f i)) = Matrix.diagonal (fun x => ∏ i, f i (x i))

name: OAI.QAC.ancillaProjection_diagonal
statement:
lemma ancillaProjection_diagonal (n N : ℕ) :
    ancillaProjection n N = Matrix.diagonal (fun z => if ancillaValid n z then 1 else 0)

name: OAI.QAC.ancillaValid_flip
statement:
lemma ancillaValid_flip {n N : ℕ} (z : Word N) :
    ancillaValid n (flipWord (inputSet n N) z) ↔ ancillaValid n z

name: OAI.QAC.bitX_entry
statement: lemma bitX_entry (a b : Bit) : bitX a b = if a=1-b then 1 else 0

name: OAI.QAC.inputFlip_entry
statement:
lemma inputFlip_entry (n N : ℕ) (x y : Word N) :
    inputFlip n N x y = if x=flipWord (inputSet n N) y then 1 else 0

name: OAI.QAC.inputFlip_mul_ancilla_entry
statement:
lemma inputFlip_mul_ancilla_entry {n N : ℕ} (B : Operator N) (z : Word N) :
    (inputFlip n N*ancillaProjection n N*B) z z =
      if ancillaValid n z then B (flipWord (inputSet n N) z) z else 0

name: OAI.QAC.inputHadamard_ancilla_flip
statement:
lemma inputHadamard_ancilla_flip (n N : ℕ) :
    localMatrix (inputHadamard n N)*(inputFlip n N*ancillaProjection n N)*
      localMatrix (inputHadamard n N) = inputPhase n N*ancillaProjection n N

name: OAI.QAC.inputWord_injective
statement:
lemma inputWord_injective {n N : ℕ} (hnN : n ≤ N) :
    Function.Injective (@inputWord n N)

name: OAI.QAC.inputWord_valid
statement: lemma inputWord_valid {n N : ℕ} (x : Word n) : ancillaValid n (@inputWord n N x)

name: OAI.QAC.input_restrictWord
statement:
lemma input_restrictWord {n N : ℕ} (hnN : n ≤ N) (z : Word N) (hz : ancillaValid n z) :
    inputWord (restrictWord hnN z)=z

name: OAI.QAC.restrict_inputWord
statement:
lemma restrict_inputWord {n N : ℕ} (hnN : n ≤ N) (x : Word n) :
    restrictWord hnN (inputWord x)=x

name: OAI.QAC.sum_ancillaValid
statement:
lemma sum_ancillaValid {n N : ℕ} (hnN : n ≤ N) {α : Type*} [AddCommMonoid α]
    (f : Word N → α) :
    (∑ z : Word N, if ancillaValid n z then f z else 0) = ∑ x : Word n, f (inputWord x)

name: OAI.QAC.trace_flip_ancilla
statement:
lemma trace_flip_ancilla {n N : ℕ} (hnN : n ≤ N) (B : Operator N) :
    Matrix.trace (inputFlip n N*ancillaProjection n N*B) =
      ∑ x : Word n, B (flipWord (inputSet n N) (inputWord x)) (inputWord x)

name: OAI.QAC.chebyshev_abs_le_one
statement:
lemma chebyshev_abs_le_one (k : ℕ) {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ Set.Icc (-1) 1) :
    |(Polynomial.Chebyshev.T ℝ k).eval x| ≤ 1

name: OAI.QAC.chebyshev_denominator
statement:
lemma chebyshev_denominator (k : ℕ) {m r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (hm : r < m) :
    1 ≤ (Polynomial.Chebyshev.T ℝ k).eval ((m + r) / (m - r)) ∧
    Real.exp ((k : ℝ) * Real.sqrt (r / m)) / 2 ≤
      (Polynomial.Chebyshev.T ℝ k).eval ((m + r) / (m - r))

name: OAI.QAC.rootPoly_degree
statement: lemma rootPoly_degree (r : ℕ) : (rootPoly r).natDegree ≤ r

name: OAI.QAC.rootPoly_eval_nat
statement:
lemma rootPoly_eval_nat {r x : ℕ} (hx0 : 1 ≤ x) (hxr : x ≤ r) :
    (rootPoly r).eval (x : ℝ) = 0

name: OAI.QAC.rootPoly_eval_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma rootPoly_eval_zero (r : ℕ) : (rootPoly r).eval 0 = 1

name: OAI.QAC.scalePoly_degree
statement: lemma scalePoly_degree (r m : ℝ) : (scalePoly r m).natDegree ≤ 1

name: OAI.QAC.scalePoly_eval
statement:
lemma scalePoly_eval (r m x : ℝ) :
    (scalePoly r m).eval x = (m + r - 2 * x) / (m - r)

name: OAI.QAC.scalePoly_interval
statement:
lemma scalePoly_interval {r m x : ℝ} (hrm : r < m) (hrx : r ≤ x) (hxm : x ≤ m) :
    (scalePoly r m).eval x ∈ Set.Icc (-1) 1

name: OAI.QAC.scalePoly_weight
statement:
lemma scalePoly_weight {R r m : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hr : 1 ≤ r) (hm : 2 * r ≤ m) :
    weight R (scalePoly r m) ≤ 3 + 2 * R

name: OAI.QAC.scalePoly_zero
statement:
lemma scalePoly_zero (r m : ℝ) :
    (scalePoly r m).eval 0 = (m + r) / (m - r)

name: OAI.QAC.weight_C
statement: @[simp] lemma weight_C (R c : ℝ) : weight R (C c) = |c|

name: OAI.QAC.weight_X
statement: @[simp] lemma weight_X (R : ℝ) : weight R X = R

name: OAI.QAC.weight_add_le
statement:
lemma weight_add_le {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (p q : ℝ[X]) :
    weight R (p + q) ≤ weight R p + weight R q

name: OAI.QAC.weight_chebyshev
statement:
lemma weight_chebyshev {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (z : ℝ[X]) (k : ℕ) :
    weight R ((Polynomial.Chebyshev.T ℝ k).comp z) ≤ (2 * weight R z + 1) ^ k

name: OAI.QAC.weight_monomial
statement:
@[simp] lemma weight_monomial (R c : ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    weight R (monomial k c) = |c| * R ^ k

name: OAI.QAC.weight_mul_le
statement:
lemma weight_mul_le {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (p q : ℝ[X]) :
    weight R (p * q) ≤ weight R p * weight R q

name: OAI.QAC.weight_neg
statement: @[simp] lemma weight_neg (R : ℝ) (p : ℝ[X]) : weight R (-p) = weight R p

name: OAI.QAC.weight_nonneg
statement: lemma weight_nonneg {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (p : ℝ[X]) : 0 ≤ weight R p

name: OAI.QAC.weight_one
statement: @[simp] lemma weight_one (R : ℝ) : weight R 1 = 1

name: OAI.QAC.weight_prod_le
statement:
lemma weight_prod_le {ι : Type*} {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (s : Finset ι) (p : ι → ℝ[X]) :
    weight R (∏ i ∈ s, p i) ≤ ∏ i ∈ s, weight R (p i)

name: OAI.QAC.weight_sub_le
statement:
lemma weight_sub_le {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (p q : ℝ[X]) :
    weight R (p - q) ≤ weight R p + weight R q

name: OAI.QAC.weight_sum_le
statement:
lemma weight_sum_le {ι : Type*} {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (s : Finset ι) (p : ι → ℝ[X]) :
    weight R (∑ i ∈ s, p i) ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, weight R (p i)

name: OAI.QAC.weight_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma weight_zero (R : ℝ) : weight R 0 = 0

name: OAI.QAC.approx_decay_exp
statement:
lemma approx_decay_exp {r : ℕ} {m z : ℝ} (hr : 1 ≤ r) (hm : 1 ≤ Real.log m)
    (hz : z ≤ r) : 2 * Real.exp (-(3 * (r : ℝ) * Real.log m)) ≤ Real.exp (-z)

name: OAI.QAC.approx_weight_exp
statement:
lemma approx_weight_exp {N r k : ℕ} {v u : ℝ} (hN : 6 ≤ N)
    (hsum : (r : ℝ) + k ≤ 4 * (N : ℝ) ^ v)
    (hcostN : 8 * (N : ℝ) ^ v * Real.log N ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ u) :
    (1 + (N : ℝ)) ^ r * (7 + 4 * (N : ℝ)) ^ k ≤ Real.exp ((N : ℝ) ^ u)

name: OAI.QAC.ceil_approx_condition
statement:
lemma ceil_approx_condition {N : ℕ} {a b v : ℝ} (hN : 2 ≤ N)
    (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hv : 0 ≤ v)
    (hkN : (8 * (b + 1)) * (N : ℝ) ^ ((a + b) / 2) * Real.log N ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ v) :
    4 * (⌈(N : ℝ) ^ a⌉₊ : ℝ) * Real.log (⌈(N : ℝ) ^ b⌉₊ : ℝ) ≤
      (⌈(N : ℝ) ^ v⌉₊ : ℝ) *
        Real.sqrt ((⌈(N : ℝ) ^ a⌉₊ : ℝ) / (⌈(N : ℝ) ^ b⌉₊ : ℝ))

name: OAI.QAC.ceil_power_log_bound
statement:
lemma ceil_power_log_bound {N : ℕ} {a : ℝ} (hN : 2 ≤ N) (ha : 0 ≤ a) :
    ((⌈(N:ℝ)^a⌉₊:ℝ)+1)*Real.log (N+1) ≤ 6*(N:ℝ)^a*Real.log N

name: OAI.QAC.ceil_rpow_bounds
statement:
lemma ceil_rpow_bounds {N : ℕ} {a : ℝ} (hN : 1 ≤ N) (ha : 0 ≤ a) :
    (N : ℝ) ^ a ≤ (⌈(N : ℝ) ^ a⌉₊ : ℝ) ∧
    (⌈(N : ℝ) ^ a⌉₊ : ℝ) ≤ 2 * (N : ℝ) ^ a

name: OAI.QAC.ceil_rpow_log
statement:
lemma ceil_rpow_log {N : ℕ} {b : ℝ} (hN : 2 ≤ N) (hb : 0 ≤ b) :
    Real.log (⌈(N : ℝ) ^ b⌉₊ : ℝ) ≤ (b + 1) * Real.log N

name: OAI.QAC.eventually_backward_cost
statement:
lemma eventually_backward_cost {s a u w t : ℝ} (hs : 0 ≤ s) (hsa : s < a)
    (hau : a < u) (huw : u < w) (hwt : w < t) :
    ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in atTop,
      Real.exp ((N:ℝ)^u-(N:ℝ)^w) + Real.exp (-((N:ℝ)^a)) +
        (1+Real.exp ((N:ℝ)^u))*Real.exp (-((N:ℝ)^t)) ≤ Real.exp (-2*(N:ℝ)^s)

name: OAI.QAC.eventually_exp_power_gap
statement:
lemma eventually_exp_power_gap {s u v : ℝ} (hs : s < v) (hu : u < v) (hv : 0 < v)
    (C ε D K : ℝ) (hC : 0 < C) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in atTop, C * Real.exp (K*(N:ℝ)^u - (N:ℝ)^v) ≤
      ε * Real.exp (-(D*(N:ℝ)^s))

name: OAI.QAC.eventually_pattern_cost
statement:
lemma eventually_pattern_cost {a s v : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hav : a < v) (hsv : s < v) :
    ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in atTop,
      (N+1:ℝ)^(⌈(N:ℝ)^a⌉₊+1) * Real.exp (-((N:ℝ)^v)) ≤ Real.exp (-((N:ℝ)^s))

name: OAI.QAC.eventually_power_le
statement:
lemma eventually_power_le {s t : ℝ} (hst : s < t) (C : ℝ) :
    ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in atTop, C * (N : ℝ) ^ s ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ t

name: OAI.QAC.eventually_power_log_le
statement:
lemma eventually_power_log_le {s t : ℝ} (hst : s < t) (C : ℝ) :
    ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in atTop, C * (N : ℝ) ^ s * Real.log N ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ t

name: OAI.QAC.eventually_two_powers_le
statement:
lemma eventually_two_powers_le {a b t : ℝ} (ha : a < t) (hb : b < t) :
    ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in atTop, (N:ℝ)^a + (N:ℝ)^b ≤ (N:ℝ)^t

name: OAI.QAC.Count.backward_finite
statement:
lemma Count.backward_finite {N : ℕ} (M D : Count N) (U : Operator N) (hU : U ∈ unitary (Operator N))
    (p : Polynomial ℝ) (r b A B E T : ℝ)
    (hx : ‖M.high r*conjugate U (D.polynomial p)*M.zero‖ ≤ A)
    (hp : ‖D.polynomial p‖ ≤ B)
    (he : ‖(D.zero-D.polynomial p)*D.low b‖ ≤ E)
    (ht : ‖D.high b*star U*M.zero*U*D.zero‖ ≤ T) :
    ‖M.high r*conjugate U D.zero*M.zero‖^2 ≤ A+E+(1+B)*T

name: OAI.QAC.Count.polynomial_norm_le
statement:
lemma Count.polynomial_norm_le {N : ℕ} (D : Count N) (p : Polynomial ℝ) :
    ‖D.polynomial p‖ ≤ weight N p

name: OAI.QAC.conjugate_finset_sum
statement:
lemma conjugate_finset_sum {A ι : Type*} [CStarAlgebra A] (U : A) (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → A) :
    conjugate U (∑ i ∈ s, f i) = ∑ i ∈ s, conjugate U (f i)

name: OAI.QAC.Count.depth_zero_bound
statement:
lemma Count.depth_zero_bound {N : ℕ} (M D : Count N) (r : ℝ) :
    ‖M.high r * D.zero * M.zero‖ ≤ Real.exp (-(Real.log 2 / 2) * r)

name: OAI.QAC.Count.depth_zero_square
statement:
lemma Count.depth_zero_square {N : ℕ} (M D : Count N) (r : ℝ) :
    ‖M.high r * D.zero * M.zero‖^2 ≤ (2 : ℝ)^(-r)

name: OAI.QAC.Count.generating_eq_sites
statement:
lemma Count.generating_eq_sites {N : ℕ} (M : Count N) :
    (∑ F ∈ M.support.powerset, (2 : ℝ)^F.card • M.pattern F) =
      tensorMatrix (fun i => (2:ℝ) • (1-M.site i)+M.site i)

name: OAI.QAC.Count.high_le_generating
statement:
lemma Count.high_le_generating {N : ℕ} (M : Count N) (r : ℝ) :
    M.high r ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (-r) •
      (∑ F ∈ M.support.powerset, (2 : ℝ)^F.card • M.pattern F)

name: OAI.QAC.Count.markov_sandwich_le
statement:
lemma Count.markov_sandwich_le {N : ℕ} (M D : Count N) :
    M.zero * D.zero * (∑ F ∈ M.support.powerset, (2 : ℝ)^F.card • M.pattern F) *
      D.zero * M.zero ≤ 1

name: OAI.QAC.Count.markov_site_le
statement:
lemma Count.markov_site_le {N : ℕ} (M D : Count N) (i : Fin N) :
    M.site i * D.site i * ((2:ℝ) • (1-M.site i)+M.site i) * D.site i * M.site i ≤ 1

name: OAI.QAC.Count.site_projection
statement: lemma Count.site_projection {N : ℕ} (M : Count N) (i : Fin N) : IsStarProjection (M.site i)

name: OAI.QAC.Count.spectral_power_tensor
statement:
lemma Count.spectral_power_tensor {N : ℕ} (M : Count N) (z : ℝ) :
    (∑ F ∈ M.support.powerset, z ^ F.card • M.pattern F) =
      tensorMatrix (fun i => if i ∈ M.support then
        z • (1 - rankOne (M.vector i)) + rankOne (M.vector i) else 1)

name: OAI.QAC.projection_markov_nonneg
statement:
lemma projection_markov_nonneg {A : Type*} [Ring A] [StarRing A] [PartialOrder A]
    [StarOrderedRing A] [Algebra ℝ A] [IsOrderedModule ℝ A]
    (P Q : A) (hP : IsStarProjection P) (hQ : IsStarProjection Q) :
    0 ≤ P * Q * ((2:ℝ) • (1-P)+P) * Q * P

name: OAI.QAC.projection_markov_self
statement:
lemma projection_markov_self {A : Type*} [Ring A] [Module ℝ A] [SMulCommClass ℝ A A]
    {P : A} (hP : IsIdempotentElem P) : P * ((2:ℝ) • (1-P)+P) * P = P

name: OAI.QAC.rankOne_markov_le
statement:
lemma rankOne_markov_le (v w : Bit → ℂ)
    (hv : ∑ b, Complex.normSq (v b) = 1)
    (hw : ∑ b, Complex.normSq (w b) = 1) :
    rankOne v * rankOne w * ((2:ℝ) • (1 - rankOne v) + rankOne v) * rankOne w * rankOne v ≤ 1

name: OAI.QAC.rankOne_sandwich
statement:
lemma rankOne_sandwich (v w : Bit → ℂ) :
    rankOne v * rankOne w * rankOne v =
      Complex.normSq (star w ⬝ᵥ v) • rankOne v

name: OAI.QAC.tensorMatrix_pattern_scale
statement:
lemma tensorMatrix_pattern_scale {N : ℕ} (M : Count N) (F : Finset (Fin N))
    (hF : F ⊆ M.support) (z : ℝ) :
    tensorMatrix (fun i => if i ∈ M.support then
      (if i ∈ F then z • (1 - rankOne (M.vector i)) else rankOne (M.vector i)) else 1) =
      z ^ F.card • M.pattern F

name: OAI.QAC.finite_scale_induction
statement:
theorem finite_scale_induction (B : ℝ → ℝ → Prop)
    (large : ∀ s t, 0 ≤ s → s < t → 1 < t → B s t)
    (backstep : ∀ s t a b u w, 0 ≤ s → s < a → a < u → u < w → w < t → t < b →
      (a + b) / 2 < u → B t b → B s t) :
    ∀ s t, 0 ≤ s → s < t → B s t

name: OAI.QAC.uniform_large
statement: lemma uniform_large (d : ℕ) {s t : ℝ} (ht : 1 < t) : UniformLocalization d s t

name: OAI.QAC.uniform_low_propagation
statement:
lemma uniform_low_propagation {d : ℕ}
    (ih : ∀ s t : ℝ, 0 ≤ s → s < t → UniformLocalization d s t)
    {a s t : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (_hs : 0 ≤ s) (hat : a < t) (hst : s < t) :
    ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in Filter.atTop, ∀ U : Operator N, IsCircuit d U → ∀ M D : Count N,
      ‖M.high ((N:ℝ)^t)*conjugate U D.zero*M.low ((N:ℝ)^a)‖ ≤ Real.exp (-((N:ℝ)^s))

name: OAI.QAC.uniform_small_support
statement:
lemma uniform_small_support {d : ℕ}
    (ih : ∀ s t : ℝ, 0 ≤ s → s < t → UniformLocalization d s t)
    {u w t : ℝ} (hu : 0 ≤ u) (_hw : 0 ≤ w) (hut : u < t) (hwt : w < t) :
    ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in Filter.atTop, ∀ U : Operator N, IsCircuit (d+1) U → ∀ M A : Count N,
      (A.support.card:ℝ) ≤ (N:ℝ)^u →
      ‖M.high ((N:ℝ)^t)*conjugate U A.zero*M.zero‖ ≤ Real.exp (-((N:ℝ)^w))

name: OAI.QAC.uniform_zero
statement: lemma uniform_zero {s t : ℝ} (hst : s < t) : UniformLocalization 0 s t

name: OAI.QAC.bitSign_add
statement: lemma bitSign_add (a b : Bit) : bitSign (a+b)=bitSign a*bitSign b

name: OAI.QAC.bitSign_finset_sum
statement:
lemma bitSign_finset_sum {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → Bit) :
    bitSign (∑ i ∈ s, f i)=∏ i ∈ s, bitSign (f i)

name: OAI.QAC.bitSign_parity
statement: lemma bitSign_parity {n : ℕ} (x : Word n) : bitSign (parity x)=∏ i, bitSign (x i)

name: OAI.QAC.inputPhase_diagonal
statement:
lemma inputPhase_diagonal (n N : ℕ) :
    inputPhase n N = Matrix.diagonal (fun z => (inputSign n z:ℂ))

name: OAI.QAC.inputSign_inputWord
statement:
lemma inputSign_inputWord {n N : ℕ} (hnN : n ≤ N) (x : Word n) :
    inputSign n (@inputWord n N x)=bitSign (parity x)

name: OAI.QAC.parity_trace_identity
statement:
lemma parity_trace_identity {n N : ℕ} (hnN : n ≤ N) (B : Operator N) :
    (∑ x : Word n, (localMatrix (inputHadamard n N)*B*localMatrix (inputHadamard n N))
      (flipWord (inputSet n N) (inputWord x)) (inputWord x)) =
    ∑ x : Word n, (bitSign (parity x):ℂ)*B (inputWord x) (inputWord x)

name: OAI.QAC.sum_bitSign_parity
statement: lemma sum_bitSign_parity {n : ℕ} (hn : 0<n) : (∑ x : Word n, bitSign (parity x))=0

name: OAI.QAC.trace_phase_ancilla
statement:
lemma trace_phase_ancilla {n N : ℕ} (hnN : n ≤ N) (B : Operator N) :
    Matrix.trace (inputPhase n N*ancillaProjection n N*B) =
      ∑ x : Word n, (bitSign (parity x):ℂ)*B (inputWord x) (inputWord x)

name: OAI.QAC.born_zero_diagonal
statement:
lemma born_zero_diagonal {N : ℕ} (W : Operator N) (out : Fin N) (z : Word N) :
    (star W*(outputZeroCount out).zero*W) z z = (outputProbability W out 0 z:ℂ)

name: OAI.QAC.outputProbability_complement
statement:
lemma outputProbability_complement {N : ℕ} (W : Operator N) (hW : W ∈ unitary (Operator N))
    (out : Fin N) (z : Word N) :
    outputProbability W out 0 z+outputProbability W out 1 z=1

name: OAI.QAC.outputZeroCount_diagonal
statement:
lemma outputZeroCount_diagonal {N : ℕ} (out : Fin N) :
    (outputZeroCount out).zero = Matrix.diagonal (fun z => if z out=0 then 1 else 0)

name: OAI.QAC.parity_advantage_from_entries
statement:
lemma parity_advantage_from_entries {n N : ℕ} (hn : 0<n) (hnN : n ≤ N)
    (W : Operator N) (hW : W ∈ unitary (Operator N)) (out : Fin N) {ε δ : ℝ}
    (hsuccess : ∀ x : Word n, 1/2+ε ≤ successProbability W out x)
    (hentry : ∀ x : Word n,
      ‖(localMatrix (inputHadamard n N)*(star W*(outputZeroCount out).zero*W)*
        localMatrix (inputHadamard n N)) (flipWord (inputSet n N) (inputWord x)) (inputWord x)‖ ≤ δ) :
    ε ≤ δ

name: OAI.QAC.success_character_lower
statement:
lemma success_character_lower {n N : ℕ} (W : Operator N) (hW : W ∈ unitary (Operator N))
    (out : Fin N) (x : Word n) {ε : ℝ} (hsuccess : 1/2+ε ≤ successProbability W out x) :
    ε+bitSign (parity x)/2 ≤
      ((bitSign (parity x):ℂ)*(star W*(outputZeroCount out).zero*W) (inputWord x) (inputWord x)).re

name: OAI.QAC.total_born_probability
statement:
lemma total_born_probability {N : ℕ} (W : Operator N) (hW : W ∈ unitary (Operator N))
    (z : Word N) : (∑ y, Complex.normSq (W y z))=1

name: OAI.QAC.IsCircuit.local_mul
statement:
lemma IsCircuit.local_mul {N d : ℕ} {U : Operator N} (hU : IsCircuit d U) (L : LocalLayer N) :
    IsCircuit d (localMatrix L*U)

name: OAI.QAC.IsCircuit.mono
statement:
lemma IsCircuit.mono {N d e : ℕ} {U : Operator N} (hU : IsCircuit d U) (hde : d ≤ e) :
    IsCircuit e U

name: OAI.QAC.IsCircuit.succ
statement: lemma IsCircuit.succ {N d : ℕ} {U : Operator N} (hU : IsCircuit d U) : IsCircuit (d+1) U

name: OAI.QAC.gateList_normal
statement:
lemma gateList_normal {N : ℕ} (l : List (Gate N)) :
    (l.map Gate.matrix).prod = reflectList (normalCounts l)*localMatrix (normalLocal l)

name: OAI.QAC.local_gate_matrix
statement:
lemma local_gate_matrix {N : ℕ} (q : Fin N) (u : Matrix.unitaryGroup Bit ℂ) :
    Gate.matrix (.local q u) = localMatrix (singleLocal q u)

name: OAI.QAC.normalCounts_disjoint
statement:
lemma normalCounts_disjoint {N : ℕ} (l : List (Gate N))
    (hl : l.Pairwise (fun A B => Disjoint A.support B.support)) :
    (normalCounts l).Pairwise (fun A B => Disjoint A.support B.support)

name: OAI.QAC.normalCounts_support
statement:
lemma normalCounts_support {N : ℕ} (l : List (Gate N)) :
    ∀ A ∈ normalCounts l, ∃ g ∈ l, A.support=g.support

name: OAI.QAC.physicalCircuit_isCircuit
statement:
lemma physicalCircuit_isCircuit {N : ℕ} (l : List (PhysicalLayer N)) :
    IsCircuit l.length (physicalCircuitMatrix l)

name: OAI.QAC.physicalLayer_isCircuit
statement:
lemma physicalLayer_isCircuit {N : ℕ} (P : PhysicalLayer N) :
    IsCircuit 1 (physicalLayerMatrix P)

name: OAI.QAC.reflectList_rotate
statement:
lemma reflectList_rotate {N : ℕ} (l : List (Count N)) (L : LocalLayer N) :
    reflectList (l.map (fun A => A.rotate L)) = conjugate (localMatrix L) (reflectList l)

name: OAI.QAC.reflectList_rotate_commute
statement:
lemma reflectList_rotate_commute {N : ℕ} (l : List (Count N)) (L : LocalLayer N) :
    localMatrix L*reflectList l = reflectList (l.map (fun A => A.rotate L))*localMatrix L

name: OAI.QAC.eventually_exp_neg_power_lt
statement:
lemma eventually_exp_neg_power_lt {s ε : ℝ} (hs : 0<s) (hε : 0<ε) :
    ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in atTop, Real.exp (-(N:ℝ)^s)<ε

name: OAI.QAC.hadamard_high_entry_bound
statement:
lemma hadamard_high_entry_bound {n N : ℕ} (hnN : n≤N) (W : Operator N)
    (out : Fin N) (x : Word n) {r : ℝ} (hr : r≤(n:ℝ)) :
    ‖(localMatrix (inputHadamard n N)*(star W*(outputZeroCount out).zero*W)*
      localMatrix (inputHadamard n N))
      (flipWord (inputSet n N) (inputWord x)) (inputWord x)‖ ≤
    ‖(computationalCount (inputWord x)).high r*(localMatrix (inputHadamard n N)*star W)*
      (outputZeroCount out).zero*star (localMatrix (inputHadamard n N)*star W)*
      (computationalCount (inputWord x)).zero‖

name: OAI.QAC.polynomial_qubit_threshold
statement:
lemma polynomial_qubit_threshold {n N : ℕ} {c t : ℝ} (hn : 1≤n)
    (ht : 0≤t) (hct : c*t≤1) (hN : (N:ℝ)≤(n:ℝ)^c) : (N:ℝ)^t≤(n:ℝ)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.coshMixture_centered_integrable_bound
statement:
lemma coshMixture_centered_integrable_bound (v : ℝ≥0) {p : κ → ℝ} (hp : ∀ x, 0 ≤ p x)
    (hpsum : ∑ x, p x = 1) (a : κ → ι → ℝ) {s : ℝ} (hs : ∀ x, ∑ i, a x i^2 = s)
    (hc : ∀ x y, |(v:ℝ)*∑ i, a x i*a y i| ≤ 1) :
    Integrable (fun z => (coshMixture p a z-Real.exp ((v:ℝ)*s/2))^2) (gaussianScalarPi v) ∧
    (∫ z, (coshMixture p a z-Real.exp ((v:ℝ)*s/2))^2 ∂gaussianScalarPi v) ≤
      Real.exp ((v:ℝ)*s)*(Real.exp 1-1)*(∑ x, ∑ y, p x*p y*((v:ℝ)*∑ i, a x i*a y i)^2)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.coshMixture_continuous
statement: lemma coshMixture_continuous (p : κ → ℝ) (a : κ → ι → ℝ) : Continuous (coshMixture p a)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.coshMixture_integrable
statement:
lemma coshMixture_integrable (v : ℝ≥0) (p : κ → ℝ) (a : κ → ι → ℝ) :
    Integrable (coshMixture p a) (gaussianScalarPi v)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.coshMixture_integral
statement:
lemma coshMixture_integral (v : ℝ≥0) {p : κ → ℝ} (hpsum : ∑ x, p x = 1)
    (a : κ → ι → ℝ) {s : ℝ} (hs : ∀ x, ∑ i, a x i^2 = s) :
    (∫ z, coshMixture p a z ∂gaussianScalarPi v) = Real.exp ((v:ℝ)*s/2)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.coshMixture_nonneg
statement: lemma coshMixture_nonneg {p : κ → ℝ} (hp : ∀ x, 0 ≤ p x) (a : κ → ι → ℝ) (z : ι → ℝ) : 0 ≤ coshMixture p a z

name: OAI.CriticalSK.coshMixture_pow_integrable_bound
statement:
lemma coshMixture_pow_integrable_bound (v : ℝ≥0) {p : κ → ℝ} (hp : ∀ x, 0 ≤ p x)
    (hpsum : ∑ x, p x = 1) (a : κ → ι → ℝ) {s : ℝ} (hs : ∀ x, ∑ i, a x i^2 = s) (m : ℕ) :
    Integrable (fun z => coshMixture p a z^m) (gaussianScalarPi v) ∧
    (∫ z, coshMixture p a z^m ∂gaussianScalarPi v) ≤ 2*Real.exp ((m:ℝ)^2*(v:ℝ)*s/2)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.coshMixture_square_integral

    (∫ z, coshMixture p a z^2 ∂gaussianScalarPi v) =
      Real.exp ((v:ℝ)*s)*(∑ x, ∑ y, p x*p y*Real.cosh ((v:ℝ)*∑ i, a x i*a y i))

name: OAI.CriticalSK.block_prefix_dyadic_tail
statement:
lemma block_prefix_dyadic_tail {X : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} {c : ℝ≥0}
    (hX : ∀ i, StronglyMeasurable (X i)) (hind : iIndepFun X μ)
    (hmgf : ∀ i, HasSubgaussianMGF (X i) c μ)
    (hmean : ∀ i, ∫ ω, X i ω ∂μ = 0) (hc : 0 < c)
    (start m j r : ℕ) (h : ℝ) :
    μ.real {ω | ∃ k ≤ m, blockThreshold c m j r h ≤
      |∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), X (start + i) ω|} ≤
      2 * Real.exp (-h ^ 2) * (1 / 16 : ℝ) ^ (j + r)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.block_prefix_tail
statement:
lemma block_prefix_tail {X : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} {c : ℝ≥0}
    (hX : ∀ i, StronglyMeasurable (X i)) (hind : iIndepFun X μ)
    (hmgf : ∀ i, HasSubgaussianMGF (X i) c μ)
    (hmean : ∀ i, ∫ ω, X i ω ∂μ = 0) (hc : 0 < c)
    (start m : ℕ) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) :
    μ.real {ω | ∃ k ≤ m, a ≤ |∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), X (start + i) ω|} ≤
      2 * Real.exp (-a ^ 2 / (2 * (m + 1) * (c : ℝ)))

name: OAI.CriticalSK.block_prefix_weight_bound
statement:
lemma block_prefix_weight_bound (ξ w : ℕ → ℝ) (m : ℕ) {B : ℝ} (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    (hpref : ∀ k ≤ m, |∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), ξ i| ≤ B) :
    |∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), ξ i * w i| ≤
      B / (m + 1) * (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), |w i|) +
        2 * B * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, |w (i + 1) - w i|

name: OAI.CriticalSK.block_summation_by_parts
statement:
lemma block_summation_by_parts (ξ w : ℕ → ℝ) (m : ℕ) :
    ∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, ξ i * w i =
      (∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, ξ i) * w m +
        ∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (i + 1), ξ j) * (w i - w (i + 1))

name: OAI.CriticalSK.block_zero_sum_bound
statement:
lemma block_zero_sum_bound (ξ w : ℕ → ℝ) (m : ℕ) {B : ℝ}
    (htotal : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), ξ i = 0)
    (hpref : ∀ k ≤ m, |∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), ξ i| ≤ B) :
    |∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), ξ i * w i| ≤
      B * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, |w (i + 1) - w i|
