name: OAI.CriticalSK.one_add_linear_mul_exp_le
statement:
lemma one_add_linear_mul_exp_le (a b r : ℝ) (_ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hr : 0 ≤ r) :
    1 + a * r * Real.exp (b * r) ≤ Real.exp ((a + b) * r)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.partial_sum_abs_maximal_tail
statement:
lemma partial_sum_abs_maximal_tail {X : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} {c : ℝ≥0}
    (hX : ∀ i, StronglyMeasurable (X i)) (hind : iIndepFun X μ)
    (hmgf : ∀ i, HasSubgaussianMGF (X i) c μ)
    (hmean : ∀ i, ∫ ω, X i ω ∂μ = 0) (hc : 0 < c)
    (m : ℕ) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) :
    μ.real {ω | ∃ k ≤ m, a ≤ |∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), X i ω|} ≤
      2 * Real.exp (-a ^ 2 / (2 * (m + 1) * (c : ℝ)))

name: OAI.CriticalSK.partial_sum_maximal_exponential
statement:
lemma partial_sum_maximal_exponential {X : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} {c : ℝ≥0}
    (hX : ∀ i, StronglyMeasurable (X i)) (hind : iIndepFun X μ)
    (hmgf : ∀ i, HasSubgaussianMGF (X i) c μ)
    (hmean : ∀ i, ∫ ω, X i ω ∂μ = 0)
    (m : ℕ) {a t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    μ.real {ω | ∃ k ≤ m, a ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), X i ω} ≤
      Real.exp (-t * a + (m + 1) * (c : ℝ) * t ^ 2 / 2)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.partial_sum_maximal_tail
statement:
lemma partial_sum_maximal_tail {X : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} {c : ℝ≥0}
    (hX : ∀ i, StronglyMeasurable (X i)) (hind : iIndepFun X μ)
    (hmgf : ∀ i, HasSubgaussianMGF (X i) c μ)
    (hmean : ∀ i, ∫ ω, X i ω ∂μ = 0) (hc : 0 < c)
    (m : ℕ) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) :
    μ.real {ω | ∃ k ≤ m, a ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), X i ω} ≤
      Real.exp (-a ^ 2 / (2 * (m + 1) * (c : ℝ)))

name: OAI.CriticalSK.scaledChiRow_mean
statement: lemma scaledChiRow_mean (n i : ℕ) : (∫ ω, scaledChiRow n i ω ∂chiRowLaw n) = 0

name: OAI.CriticalSK.scaledChiRow_measurable
statement: lemma scaledChiRow_measurable (n i : ℕ) : Measurable (scaledChiRow n i)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.scaledChiRows_independent
statement: lemma scaledChiRows_independent (n : ℕ) : iIndepFun (scaledChiRow n) (chiRowLaw n)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.edgeCoeff_last
statement: lemma edgeCoeff_last (n : ℕ) : edgeCoeff n n = 0

name: OAI.CriticalSK.edgeCoeff_le_one
statement: lemma edgeCoeff_le_one (n i : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ n) : edgeCoeff n i ≤ 1

name: OAI.CriticalSK.edgeCoeff_lower_half
statement:
lemma edgeCoeff_lower_half (n i : ℕ) (hi : 2 * (i + 1) ≤ n + 1) :
    1 / 2 ≤ edgeCoeff n i

name: OAI.CriticalSK.edgeCoeff_nonneg
statement: lemma edgeCoeff_nonneg (n i : ℕ) : 0 ≤ edgeCoeff n i

name: OAI.CriticalSK.edgeCoeff_upper
statement:
lemma edgeCoeff_upper (n i : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ n) :
    edgeCoeff n i ≤ 1 - (i + 1 : ℝ) / (2 * (n + 1))

name: OAI.CriticalSK.edge_deficit
statement:
lemma edge_deficit (n i : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ n) :
    (i + 1 : ℝ) / (2 * (n + 1)) ≤
      2 - edgeCoeff n i - if i = 0 then 0 else edgeCoeff n (i - 1)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.edge_gradient_control
statement:
lemma edge_gradient_control (n i : ℕ) (u : ℕ → ℝ) :
    (u (i + 1) - u i) ^ 2 ≤
      2 * edgeCoeff n i * (u (i + 1) - u i) ^ 2 +
      4 * ((i + 1 : ℝ) / (n + 1) * u i ^ 2 +
        (i + 2 : ℝ) / (n + 1) * u (i + 1) ^ 2)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.pathEnergy_controls
statement:
lemma pathEnergy_controls (n : ℕ) (u : ℕ → ℝ) :
    (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, edgeCoeff n i * (u (i + 1) - u i) ^ 2) +
      (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (i + 1 : ℝ) / (2 * (n + 1)) * u i ^ 2) ≤
      pathEnergy n u

name: OAI.CriticalSK.pathEnergy_expansion
statement:
lemma pathEnergy_expansion (n : ℕ) (u : ℕ → ℝ) :
    pathEnergy n u =
      (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, edgeCoeff n i * (u (i + 1) - u i) ^ 2) +
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
        (2 - edgeCoeff n i - if i = 0 then 0 else edgeCoeff n (i - 1)) * u i ^ 2

name: OAI.CriticalSK.pathEnergy_gradient
statement:
lemma pathEnergy_gradient (n : ℕ) (u : ℕ → ℝ) :
    (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (u (i + 1) - u i) ^ 2) ≤ 18 * pathEnergy n u

name: OAI.CriticalSK.pathEnergy_le_four_mass
statement:
lemma pathEnergy_le_four_mass (n : ℕ) (u : ℕ → ℝ) :
    pathEnergy n u ≤ 4 * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), u i ^ 2

name: OAI.CriticalSK.pathEnergy_nonneg
statement: lemma pathEnergy_nonneg (n : ℕ) (u : ℕ → ℝ) : 0 ≤ pathEnergy n u

name: OAI.CriticalSK.pathEnergy_tail
statement:
lemma pathEnergy_tail (n : ℕ) (u : ℕ → ℝ) (s : Finset ℕ)
    (hs : s ⊆ Finset.range (n + 1)) (r : ℝ)
    (hr : ∀ i ∈ s, r ≤ (i + 1 : ℝ) / (n + 1)) :
    r * (∑ i ∈ s, u i ^ 2) ≤ 2 * pathEnergy n u

name: OAI.CriticalSK.pathEnergy_weighted_gradient
statement:
lemma pathEnergy_weighted_gradient (n : ℕ) (u : ℕ → ℝ) :
    (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, edgeCoeff n i * (u (i + 1) - u i) ^ 2) ≤
      pathEnergy n u

name: OAI.CriticalSK.pathEnergy_weighted_mass
statement:
lemma pathEnergy_weighted_mass (n : ℕ) (u : ℕ → ℝ) :
    (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (i + 1 : ℝ) / (n + 1) * u i ^ 2) ≤
      2 * pathEnergy n u

name: OAI.CriticalSK.path_energy_identity
statement:
lemma path_energy_identity (n : ℕ) (c u : ℕ → ℝ) (hc : c n = 0) :
    2 * (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), u i ^ 2) -
      2 * (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, c i * u i * u (i + 1)) =
    (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, c i * (u (i + 1) - u i) ^ 2) +
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
        (2 - c i - if i = 0 then 0 else c (i - 1)) * u i ^ 2

name: OAI.CriticalSK.product_weight_variation
statement:
lemma product_weight_variation (s : Finset ℕ) (u : ℕ → ℝ) :
    (∑ i ∈ s, |u (i + 1) * u (i + 2) - u i * u (i + 1)|) ^ 2 ≤
      (2 * ∑ i ∈ s, ((u (i + 1) - u i) ^ 2 + (u (i + 2) - u (i + 1)) ^ 2)) *
        (∑ i ∈ s, u (i + 1) ^ 2)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.square_weight_variation
statement:
lemma square_weight_variation (s : Finset ℕ) (u : ℕ → ℝ) :
    (∑ i ∈ s, |u (i + 1) ^ 2 - u i ^ 2|) ^ 2 ≤
      (∑ i ∈ s, (u (i + 1) - u i) ^ 2) *
        (2 * ∑ i ∈ s, (u i ^ 2 + u (i + 1) ^ 2))

name: OAI.CriticalSK.blockIndices_lower
statement:
lemma blockIndices_lower (d l a : ℕ) (B : Finset ℕ) (hB : ∀ b ∈ B, a ≤ b * d) :
    ∀ i ∈ blockIndices d l B, a ≤ i

name: OAI.CriticalSK.blockIndices_sum
statement:
lemma blockIndices_sum (d l : ℕ) (B : Finset ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) (hl : l ≤ d) (f : ℕ → ℝ) :
    (∑ b ∈ B, ∑ i ∈ Finset.range l, f (b * d + i)) =
      ∑ i ∈ blockIndices d l B, f i

name: OAI.CriticalSK.blockThreshold_length_bound
statement:
lemma blockThreshold_length_bound (c : ℝ≥0) (d j r : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 ≤ h) :
    blockThreshold c (d - 1) j r h ≤
      Real.sqrt (32 * (c : ℝ)) * Real.sqrt d * (h + j + r + 1)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.blockThreshold_linear_bound
statement:
lemma blockThreshold_linear_bound (c : ℝ≥0) (m j r : ℕ) {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 ≤ h) :
    blockThreshold c m j r h ≤
      Real.sqrt (32 * (c : ℝ)) * Real.sqrt (m + 1) * (h + j + r + 1)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.block_index_injective
statement:
lemma block_index_injective (d l : ℕ) (B : Finset ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) (hl : l ≤ d) :
    Set.InjOn (fun p : ℕ × ℕ => p.1 * d + p.2) (B ×ˢ Finset.range l : Finset _ )

name: OAI.CriticalSK.half_pow_le_three_quarters_sq
statement:
lemma half_pow_le_three_quarters_sq (r : ℕ) :
    (1 / 2 : ℝ)^r ≤ ((3 / 4 : ℝ)^r)^2

name: OAI.CriticalSK.localized_product_mass
OAI.CriticalSK.localized_product_variation
statement:
lemma localized_product_variation (n : ℕ) (u : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hu : ∀ i, n + 1 ≤ i → u i = 0) (s : Finset ℕ) {M : ℝ} (hM : 0 ≤ M)
    (h1 : (∑ i ∈ s, u (i + 1) ^ 2) ≤ M) :
    (∑ i ∈ s, |u (i + 1) * u (i + 2) - u i * u (i + 1)|) ≤
      Real.sqrt (80 * pathEnergy n u * M)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.localized_square_variation
statement:
lemma localized_square_variation (n : ℕ) (u : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hu : ∀ i, n + 1 ≤ i → u i = 0) (s : Finset ℕ) {M : ℝ} (hM : 0 ≤ M)
    (h0 : (∑ i ∈ s, u i ^ 2) ≤ M) (h1 : (∑ i ∈ s, u (i + 1) ^ 2) ≤ M) :
    (∑ i ∈ s, |u (i + 1) ^ 2 - u i ^ 2|) ≤
      Real.sqrt (80 * pathEnergy n u * M)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.many_block_prefix_abs_bound
statement:
lemma many_block_prefix_abs_bound (ξ w : ℕ → ℝ) (d : ℕ) (B : Finset ℕ)
    (hd : 0 < d) {bnd : ℝ} (hbnd : 0 ≤ bnd)
    (hpref : ∀ b ∈ B, ∀ k < d,
      |∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), ξ (b * d + i)| ≤ bnd) :
    (∑ b ∈ B, |∑ i ∈ Finset.range d, ξ (b * d + i) * w (b * d + i)|) ≤
      bnd / d * (∑ i ∈ blockIndices d d B, |w i|) +
        2 * bnd * ∑ i ∈ blockIndices d (d - 1) B, |w (i + 1) - w i|

name: OAI.CriticalSK.product_multiscale_prefix
statement:
lemma product_multiscale_prefix (ξ : ℕ → ℝ) (n j d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) (u : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hu : ∀ i, n + 1 ≤ i → u i = 0)
    (hnorm : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), u i ^ 2) = 1)
    {σ h K : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ) (hh : 0 ≤ h) (hK : 0 ≤ K)
    (he : pathEnergy n u ≤ σ) (hsize : (n + 1 : ℝ) * σ ≤ (8 : ℝ)^j * d)
    (hpref : ∀ r < n + 1, ∀ b < n + 1, b ∈ blockShell j r → ∀ k < d,
      |∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), ξ (b * d + i)| ≤ K * (h + j + r + 1)) :
    |∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ξ i * (u i * u (i + 1))| ≤
      32 * K * (h + j + 1) * (1 / d + 13 * Real.sqrt (pathEnergy n u))

name: OAI.CriticalSK.shell_indices_mass
statement:
lemma shell_indices_mass (n j r d l k : ℕ) (u : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hu : ∀ i, n + 1 ≤ i → u i = 0)
    (hnorm : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), u i ^ 2) = 1)
    (B : Finset ℕ) (hB : ∀ b ∈ B, b ∈ blockShell j r)
    {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ) (he : pathEnergy n u ≤ σ)
    (hsize : (n + 1 : ℝ) * σ ≤ (8 : ℝ)^j * d) :
    (∑ i ∈ blockIndices d l B, u (i + k) ^ 2) ≤ 2 * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ r

name: OAI.CriticalSK.shell_product_mass_variation
statement:
lemma shell_product_mass_variation (n j r d : ℕ) (u : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hu : ∀ i, n + 1 ≤ i → u i = 0)
    (hnorm : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), u i ^ 2) = 1)
    (B : Finset ℕ) (hB : ∀ b ∈ B, b ∈ blockShell j r)
    {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ) (he : pathEnergy n u ≤ σ)
    (hsize : (n + 1 : ℝ) * σ ≤ (8 : ℝ)^j * d) :
    (∑ i ∈ blockIndices d d B, |u i * u (i + 1)|) ≤ 2 * (3 / 4 : ℝ)^r ∧
    (∑ i ∈ blockIndices d (d - 1) B, |u (i + 1) * u (i + 2) - u i * u (i + 1)|) ≤
      13 * Real.sqrt (pathEnergy n u) * (3 / 4 : ℝ)^r

name: OAI.CriticalSK.shell_square_mass_variation
statement:
lemma shell_square_mass_variation (n j r d : ℕ) (u : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hu : ∀ i, n + 1 ≤ i → u i = 0)
    (hnorm : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), u i ^ 2) = 1)
    (B : Finset ℕ) (hB : ∀ b ∈ B, b ∈ blockShell j r)
    {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ) (he : pathEnergy n u ≤ σ)
    (hsize : (n + 1 : ℝ) * σ ≤ (8 : ℝ)^j * d) :
    (∑ i ∈ blockIndices d d B, |u i ^ 2|) ≤ 2 * (3 / 4 : ℝ)^r ∧
    (∑ i ∈ blockIndices d (d - 1) B, |u (i + 1)^2 - u i^2|) ≤
      13 * Real.sqrt (pathEnergy n u) * (3 / 4 : ℝ)^r

name: OAI.CriticalSK.shifted_weighted_geometric
statement:
lemma shifted_weighted_geometric {a : ℝ} (ha : 1 ≤ a) (N : ℕ) :
    (∑ r ∈ Finset.range N, (a + r) * (3 / 4 : ℝ)^r) ≤ 16 * a

name: OAI.CriticalSK.sqrt_shell_energy_bound
statement:
lemma sqrt_shell_energy_bound {e : ℝ} (he : 0 ≤ e) (r : ℕ) :
    Real.sqrt (80 * e * (2 * (1 / 2 : ℝ)^r)) ≤
      13 * Real.sqrt e * (3 / 4 : ℝ)^r

name: OAI.CriticalSK.square_multiscale_prefix
statement:
lemma square_multiscale_prefix (ξ : ℕ → ℝ) (n j d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) (u : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hu : ∀ i, n + 1 ≤ i → u i = 0)
    (hnorm : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), u i ^ 2) = 1)
    {σ h K : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ) (hh : 0 ≤ h) (hK : 0 ≤ K)
    (he : pathEnergy n u ≤ σ) (hsize : (n + 1 : ℝ) * σ ≤ (8 : ℝ)^j * d)
    (hpref : ∀ r < n + 1, ∀ b < n + 1, b ∈ blockShell j r → ∀ k < d,
      |∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), ξ (b * d + i)| ≤ K * (h + j + r + 1)) :
    |∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ξ i * u i^2| ≤
      32 * K * (h + j + 1) * (1 / d + 13 * Real.sqrt (pathEnergy n u))

name: OAI.CriticalSK.sum_consecutive_blocks
statement:
lemma sum_consecutive_blocks (K d : ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℝ) :
    (∑ b ∈ Finset.range K, ∑ i ∈ Finset.range d, f (b * d + i)) =
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (K * d), f i

name: OAI.CriticalSK.sum_covered_by_shells
statement:
lemma sum_covered_by_shells (B R : Finset ℕ) (S : ℕ → Finset ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ b, 0 ≤ f b) (hcover : ∀ b ∈ B, ∃ r ∈ R, b ∈ S r) :
    (∑ b ∈ B, f b) ≤ ∑ r ∈ R, ∑ b ∈ B.filter (fun b => b ∈ S r), f b

name: OAI.CriticalSK.sum_range_eq_of_supported
statement:
lemma sum_range_eq_of_supported (f : ℕ → ℝ) (N M : ℕ) (hNM : N ≤ M)
    (hf : ∀ i, N ≤ i → f i = 0) :
    (∑ i ∈ Finset.range M, f i) = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range N, f i

name: OAI.CriticalSK.sum_supported_le
statement:
lemma sum_supported_le (N : ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℝ) (hf : ∀ i, 0 ≤ f i)
    (hzero : ∀ i, N ≤ i → f i = 0) (s : Finset ℕ) :
    (∑ i ∈ s, f i) ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range N, f i

name: OAI.CriticalSK.supported_energy_gradient
statement:
lemma supported_energy_gradient (n : ℕ) (u : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hu : ∀ i, n + 1 ≤ i → u i = 0) (s : Finset ℕ) :
    (∑ i ∈ s, (u (i + 1) - u i) ^ 2) ≤ 20 * pathEnergy n u

name: OAI.CriticalSK.supported_energy_tail
statement:
lemma supported_energy_tail (n : ℕ) (u : ℕ → ℝ) (hu : ∀ i, n + 1 ≤ i → u i = 0)
    (s : Finset ℕ) (r : ℝ) (hr : ∀ i ∈ s, r ≤ (i + 1 : ℝ) / (n + 1)) :
    r * (∑ i ∈ s, u i ^ 2) ≤ 2 * pathEnergy n u

name: OAI.CriticalSK.supported_mass
statement:
lemma supported_mass (n : ℕ) (u : ℕ → ℝ) (hu : ∀ i, n + 1 ≤ i → u i = 0)
    (s : Finset ℕ) :
    (∑ i ∈ s, u i ^ 2) ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), u i ^ 2

name: OAI.CriticalSK.supported_shift_energy_gradient
statement:
lemma supported_shift_energy_gradient (n k : ℕ) (u : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hu : ∀ i, n + 1 ≤ i → u i = 0) (s : Finset ℕ) :
    (∑ i ∈ s, (u (i + k + 1) - u (i + k)) ^ 2) ≤ 20 * pathEnergy n u

name: OAI.CriticalSK.supported_shift_energy_tail
statement:
lemma supported_shift_energy_tail (n k : ℕ) (u : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hu : ∀ i, n + 1 ≤ i → u i = 0) (s : Finset ℕ) (r : ℝ)
    (hr : ∀ i ∈ s, r ≤ (i + k + 1 : ℕ) / (n + 1 : ℝ)) :
    r * (∑ i ∈ s, u (i + k) ^ 2) ≤ 2 * pathEnergy n u

name: OAI.CriticalSK.supported_shift_mass
statement:
lemma supported_shift_mass (n k : ℕ) (u : ℕ → ℝ) (hu : ∀ i, n + 1 ≤ i → u i = 0)
    (s : Finset ℕ) :
    (∑ i ∈ s, u (i + k) ^ 2) ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), u i ^ 2

name: OAI.CriticalSK.weighted_geometric_three_quarters
statement:
lemma weighted_geometric_three_quarters (N : ℕ) :
    (∑ r ∈ Finset.range N, (r + 1 : ℝ) * (3 / 4 : ℝ)^r) ≤ 16

name: OAI.CriticalSK.weighted_multiscale_prefix
statement:
lemma weighted_multiscale_prefix (ξ w : ℕ → ℝ) (N j d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d)
    (hw : ∀ i, N ≤ i → w i = 0) {h K e : ℝ} (hh : 0 ≤ h) (hK : 0 ≤ K) (_he : 0 ≤ e)
    (hpref : ∀ r < N, ∀ b < N, b ∈ blockShell j r → ∀ k < d,
      |∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), ξ (b * d + i)| ≤ K * (h + j + r + 1))
    (hmass : ∀ r < N, (∑ i ∈ blockIndices d d
      ((Finset.range N).filter (fun b => b ∈ blockShell j r)), |w i|) ≤ 2 * (3 / 4 : ℝ)^r)
    (hvar : ∀ r < N, (∑ i ∈ blockIndices d (d - 1)
      ((Finset.range N).filter (fun b => b ∈ blockShell j r)), |w (i + 1) - w i|) ≤
        13 * Real.sqrt e * (3 / 4 : ℝ)^r) :
    |∑ i ∈ Finset.range N, ξ i * w i| ≤
      32 * K * (h + j + 1) * (1 / d + 13 * Real.sqrt e)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.spinValue_sq
statement: @[simp] lemma spinValue_sq (b : Bool) : spinValue b ^ 2 = 1

name: OAI.CriticalSK.covariance_diag
statement: @[simp] lemma covariance_diag (i : Fin n) : covariance W i i = 1

name: OAI.CriticalSK.covariance_eq
statement:
lemma covariance_eq (i j : Fin n) :
    covariance W i j = mean W (fun x => spinValue (x i) * spinValue (x j))

name: OAI.CriticalSK.dirichlet_generator
statement:
lemma dirichlet_generator (f : Spin n → ℝ) :
    dirichlet W f = -mean W (fun x => f x * (generator W).mulVec f x)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.dirichlet_linear_le
statement:
theorem dirichlet_linear_le (a : Fin n → ℝ) :
    dirichlet W (linearObservable a) ≤ ∑ i : Fin n, a i ^ 2

name: OAI.CriticalSK.dirichlet_nonneg
statement: lemma dirichlet_nonneg (f : Spin n → ℝ) : 0 ≤ dirichlet W f

name: OAI.CriticalSK.fiberMass_eq
statement:
lemma fiberMass_eq {i : Fin n} {x y : Spin n} (h : sameExcept i x y) :
    fiberMass W i x = fiberMass W i y

name: OAI.CriticalSK.fiberMass_pos
statement: lemma fiberMass_pos (i : Fin n) (x : Spin n) : 0 < fiberMass W i x

name: OAI.CriticalSK.gibbs_le_one
statement: lemma gibbs_le_one (x : Spin n) : gibbs W x ≤ 1

name: OAI.CriticalSK.gibbs_nonneg
statement: lemma gibbs_nonneg (x : Spin n) : 0 ≤ gibbs W x

name: OAI.CriticalSK.gibbs_pos
statement: lemma gibbs_pos (x : Spin n) : 0 < gibbs W x

name: OAI.CriticalSK.gibbs_spinFlip
statement: @[simp] lemma gibbs_spinFlip (x : Spin n) : gibbs W (spinFlip x) = gibbs W x

name: OAI.CriticalSK.gibbs_sum
statement: lemma gibbs_sum : ∑ x : Spin n, gibbs W x = 1

name: OAI.CriticalSK.hamiltonian_spinFlip
statement:
@[simp] lemma hamiltonian_spinFlip (x : Spin n) :
    hamiltonian W (spinFlip x) = hamiltonian W x

name: OAI.CriticalSK.linearObservable_spinFlip
statement:
@[simp] lemma linearObservable_spinFlip (a : Fin n → ℝ) (x : Spin n) :
    linearObservable a (spinFlip x) = -linearObservable a x

name: OAI.CriticalSK.linearObservable_split
statement:
lemma linearObservable_split (a : Fin n → ℝ) (i : Fin n) (x : Spin n) :
    linearObservable a x = a i * spinValue (x i) + linearRest a i x

name: OAI.CriticalSK.linearRest_fiber_constant
statement:
lemma linearRest_fiber_constant (a : Fin n → ℝ) (i : Fin n) (x y : Spin n)
    (h : sameExcept i x y) : linearRest a i y = linearRest a i x

name: OAI.CriticalSK.mean_add
statement:
lemma mean_add (f g : Spin n → ℝ) :
    mean W (fun x => f x + g x) = mean W f + mean W g

name: OAI.CriticalSK.mean_const
statement: @[simp] lemma mean_const (c : ℝ) : mean W (fun _ => c) = c

name: OAI.CriticalSK.mean_const_mul
statement:
lemma mean_const_mul (f : Spin n → ℝ) (c : ℝ) :
    mean W (fun x => c * f x) = c * mean W f

name: OAI.CriticalSK.mean_linearObservable
statement:
@[simp] lemma mean_linearObservable (a : Fin n → ℝ) :
    mean W (linearObservable a) = 0

name: OAI.CriticalSK.mean_mono
statement: lemma mean_mono {f g : Spin n → ℝ} (h : ∀ x, f x ≤ g x) : mean W f ≤ mean W g

name: OAI.CriticalSK.mean_mul_const
statement:
lemma mean_mul_const (f : Spin n → ℝ) (c : ℝ) :
    mean W (fun x => f x * c) = mean W f * c

name: OAI.CriticalSK.mean_neg
statement: lemma mean_neg (f : Spin n → ℝ) : mean W (fun x => -f x) = -mean W f

name: OAI.CriticalSK.mean_nonneg
statement: lemma mean_nonneg {f : Spin n → ℝ} (hf : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x) : 0 ≤ mean W f

name: OAI.CriticalSK.mean_odd_eq_zero
statement:
lemma mean_odd_eq_zero (f : Spin n → ℝ) (hf : ∀ x, f (spinFlip x) = -f x) :
    mean W f = 0

name: OAI.CriticalSK.mean_spin
statement: @[simp] lemma mean_spin (i : Fin n) : mean W (fun x => spinValue (x i)) = 0

name: OAI.CriticalSK.mean_sub
statement:
lemma mean_sub (f g : Spin n → ℝ) :
    mean W (fun x => f x - g x) = mean W f - mean W g

name: OAI.CriticalSK.mean_sum
statement:
lemma mean_sum {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → Spin n → ℝ) :
    mean W (fun x => ∑ i ∈ s, f i x) = ∑ i ∈ s, mean W (f i)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.partition_pos
statement: lemma partition_pos : 0 < partition W

name: OAI.CriticalSK.sameExcept_classes
statement:
lemma sameExcept_classes {i : Fin n} {x y : Spin n} (h : sameExcept i x y)
    (z : Spin n) : sameExcept i x z ↔ sameExcept i y z

name: OAI.CriticalSK.sameExcept_refl
statement: lemma sameExcept_refl (i : Fin n) (x : Spin n) : sameExcept i x x

name: OAI.CriticalSK.sameExcept_symm
statement:
lemma sameExcept_symm {i : Fin n} {x y : Spin n} (h : sameExcept i x y) :
    sameExcept i y x

name: OAI.CriticalSK.sameExcept_trans
statement:
lemma sameExcept_trans {i : Fin n} {x y z : Spin n}
    (hxy : sameExcept i x y) (hyz : sameExcept i y z) : sameExcept i x z

name: OAI.CriticalSK.siteAverage_add
statement:
lemma siteAverage_add (i : Fin n) (f g : Spin n → ℝ) :
    siteAverage W i (fun x => f x + g x) =
      fun x => siteAverage W i f x + siteAverage W i g x

name: OAI.CriticalSK.siteAverage_eq
statement:
lemma siteAverage_eq (i : Fin n) (f : Spin n → ℝ) (x : Spin n) :
    siteAverage W i f x = ∑ y, siteKernel W i x y * f y

name: OAI.CriticalSK.siteAverage_fiber_constant
statement:
lemma siteAverage_fiber_constant (i : Fin n) (f : Spin n → ℝ)
    {x y : Spin n} (h : sameExcept i x y) :
    siteAverage W i f x = siteAverage W i f y

name: OAI.CriticalSK.siteAverage_form_identity
statement:
lemma siteAverage_form_identity (i : Fin n) (f : Spin n → ℝ) :
    mean W (fun x => (f x - siteAverage W i f x) ^ 2) =
      mean W (fun x => f x * (f x - siteAverage W i f x))

name: OAI.CriticalSK.siteAverage_idempotent
statement:
lemma siteAverage_idempotent (i : Fin n) (f : Spin n → ℝ) :
    siteAverage W i (siteAverage W i f) = siteAverage W i f

name: OAI.CriticalSK.siteAverage_least_squares
statement:
theorem siteAverage_least_squares (i : Fin n) (f g : Spin n → ℝ)
    (hg : ∀ x y, sameExcept i x y → g y = g x) :
    mean W (fun x => (f x - siteAverage W i f x) ^ 2) ≤
      mean W (fun x => (f x - g x) ^ 2)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.siteAverage_of_fiber_constant
statement:
lemma siteAverage_of_fiber_constant (i : Fin n) (f : Spin n → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ x y, sameExcept i x y → f y = f x) : siteAverage W i f = f

name: OAI.CriticalSK.siteAverage_orthogonal
statement:
lemma siteAverage_orthogonal (i : Fin n) (f g : Spin n → ℝ)
    (hg : siteAverage W i g = g) :
    mean W (fun x => (f x - siteAverage W i f x) * g x) = 0

name: OAI.CriticalSK.siteAverage_selfadjoint
statement:
lemma siteAverage_selfadjoint (i : Fin n) (f g : Spin n → ℝ) :
    mean W (fun x => f x * siteAverage W i g x) =
      mean W (fun x => siteAverage W i f x * g x)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.siteAverage_sub
statement:
lemma siteAverage_sub (i : Fin n) (f g : Spin n → ℝ) :
    siteAverage W i (fun x => f x - g x) =
      fun x => siteAverage W i f x - siteAverage W i g x

name: OAI.CriticalSK.siteKernel_nonneg
statement: lemma siteKernel_nonneg (i : Fin n) (x y : Spin n) : 0 ≤ siteKernel W i x y

name: OAI.CriticalSK.siteKernel_projection
statement: lemma siteKernel_projection (i : Fin n) : siteKernel W i * siteKernel W i = siteKernel W i

name: OAI.CriticalSK.siteKernel_reversible
statement:
lemma siteKernel_reversible (i : Fin n) (x y : Spin n) :
    gibbs W x * siteKernel W i x y = gibbs W y * siteKernel W i y x

name: OAI.CriticalSK.siteKernel_same_row
statement:
lemma siteKernel_same_row {i : Fin n} {x y : Spin n} (h : sameExcept i x y) :
    siteKernel W i x = siteKernel W i y

name: OAI.CriticalSK.siteKernel_stationary
statement:
lemma siteKernel_stationary (i : Fin n) (y : Spin n) :
    ∑ x, gibbs W x * siteKernel W i x y = gibbs W y

name: OAI.CriticalSK.siteKernel_sum
statement: lemma siteKernel_sum (i : Fin n) (x : Spin n) : ∑ y, siteKernel W i x y = 1

name: OAI.CriticalSK.spinFlipEquiv_apply
statement: @[simp] lemma spinFlipEquiv_apply (x : Spin n) : spinFlipEquiv x = spinFlip x

name: OAI.CriticalSK.spinFlip_spinFlip
statement: @[simp] lemma spinFlip_spinFlip (x : Spin n) : spinFlip (spinFlip x) = x

name: OAI.CriticalSK.spinValue_not
statement: @[simp] lemma spinValue_not (b : Bool) : spinValue (!b) = -spinValue b

name: OAI.CriticalSK.continuousKernel_nonneg
statement:
lemma continuousKernel_nonneg (hn : 0 < n) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) (x y : Spin n) :
    0 ≤ continuousKernel W t x y

name: OAI.CriticalSK.continuousKernel_poisson
statement:
lemma continuousKernel_poisson (hn : 0 < n) (t : ℝ) :
    continuousKernel W t = NormedSpace.exp (((n : ℝ) * t) • (discreteKernel W - 1))

name: OAI.CriticalSK.continuousKernel_stationary
statement:
lemma continuousKernel_stationary (hn : 0 < n) (t : ℝ) (y : Spin n) :
    ∑ x, gibbs W x * continuousKernel W t x y = gibbs W y

name: OAI.CriticalSK.continuousKernel_sum
statement:
lemma continuousKernel_sum (hn : 0 < n) (t : ℝ) (x : Spin n) :
    ∑ y, continuousKernel W t x y = 1

name: OAI.CriticalSK.continuous_good_mass_bound
statement:
theorem continuous_good_mass_bound (hn : 0 < n) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t)
    (a : Fin n → ℝ) (b : ℝ) (hb : 0 < b) :
    1 - continuousGoodMass W t ≤
      4 * ((∑ x, if |linearObservable a x| ≤ b then gibbs W x else 0) +
        (2 * t * ∑ i, a i ^ 2) / b ^ 2)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.dirichlet_discrete
statement:
lemma dirichlet_discrete (hn : 0 < n) (f : Spin n → ℝ) :
    mean W (fun x => f x * (f x - (discreteKernel W).mulVec f x)) =
      dirichlet W f / n

name: OAI.CriticalSK.discreteKernel_average
statement:
lemma discreteKernel_average (f : Spin n → ℝ) (x : Spin n) :
    (discreteKernel W).mulVec f x = (n : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ i : Fin n, siteAverage W i f x

name: OAI.CriticalSK.discreteKernel_eigenvalues
statement:
lemma discreteKernel_eigenvalues (hn : 0 < n) (i : Spin n) :
    (kernelConjugate_isHermitian W (discreteKernel W)
      (discreteKernel_reversible W)).eigenvalues i ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1

name: OAI.CriticalSK.discreteKernel_nonneg
statement: lemma discreteKernel_nonneg (x y : Spin n) : 0 ≤ discreteKernel W x y

name: OAI.CriticalSK.discreteKernel_quadratic_nonneg
statement:
lemma discreteKernel_quadratic_nonneg (f : Spin n → ℝ) :
    0 ≤ mean W (fun x => f x * (discreteKernel W).mulVec f x)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.discreteKernel_reversible
statement:
lemma discreteKernel_reversible (x y : Spin n) :
    gibbs W x * discreteKernel W x y = gibbs W y * discreteKernel W y x

name: OAI.CriticalSK.discreteKernel_stationary
statement:
lemma discreteKernel_stationary (hn : 0 < n) (y : Spin n) :
    ∑ x, gibbs W x * discreteKernel W x y = gibbs W y

name: OAI.CriticalSK.discreteKernel_sum
statement: lemma discreteKernel_sum (hn : 0 < n) (x : Spin n) : ∑ y, discreteKernel W x y = 1

name: OAI.CriticalSK.discrete_good_mass_bound
statement:
theorem discrete_good_mass_bound (hn : 0 < n) (k : ℕ)
    (a : Fin n → ℝ) (b : ℝ) (hb : 0 < b) :
    1 - discreteGoodMass W k ≤
      4 * ((∑ x, if |linearObservable a x| ≤ b then gibbs W x else 0) +
        ((2 * k : ℝ) / n * ∑ i, a i ^ 2) / b ^ 2)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.discrete_inner_increment_le
statement:
theorem discrete_inner_increment_le (hn : 0 < n) (k : ℕ) (f : Spin n → ℝ) :
    mean W (fun x => f x * (f x - (discreteKernel W ^ k).mulVec f x)) ≤
      (k : ℝ) / n * dirichlet W f

name: OAI.CriticalSK.finite_event_test
statement:
lemma finite_event_test {p μ : ι → ℝ} (hmass : ∑ y, p y = ∑ y, μ y)
    (s : ι → Prop) [DecidablePred s] :
    (∑ y, if s y then p y else 0) - (∑ y, if s y then μ y else 0) ≤
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ y, |p y - μ y|

name: OAI.CriticalSK.generator_discreteKernel
statement:
lemma generator_discreteKernel (hn : 0 < n) :
    generator W = (n : ℝ) • (discreteKernel W - 1)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.gibbsEuclideanEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma gibbsEuclideanEquiv_apply (f : Spin n → ℝ) (x : Spin n) :
    gibbsEuclideanEquiv W f x = Real.sqrt (gibbs W x) * f x

name: OAI.CriticalSK.gibbsEuclideanEquiv_inner
statement:
lemma gibbsEuclideanEquiv_inner (f g : Spin n → ℝ) :
    ⟪gibbsEuclideanEquiv W f, gibbsEuclideanEquiv W g⟫_ℝ =
      mean W (fun x => f x * g x)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.gibbsEuclideanEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma gibbsEuclideanEquiv_symm_apply (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Spin n)) (x : Spin n) :
    (gibbsEuclideanEquiv W).symm v x = v x / Real.sqrt (gibbs W x)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.gibbs_sqrt_pos
statement: lemma gibbs_sqrt_pos (x : Spin n) : 0 < Real.sqrt (gibbs W x)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.good_mass_complement
statement:
lemma good_mass_complement {μ : ι → ℝ} (hμsum : ∑ x, μ x = 1) (d : ι → ℝ) (c : ℝ) :
    1 - (∑ x, if c < d x then μ x else 0) = ∑ x, if d x ≤ c then μ x else 0

name: OAI.CriticalSK.hermitian_eigenbasis_apply
statement:
lemma hermitian_eigenbasis_apply (i : ι) :
    A.toEuclideanLin (hA.eigenvectorBasis i) =
      hA.eigenvalues i • hA.eigenvectorBasis i

name: OAI.CriticalSK.hermitian_inner_sub_pow
statement:
lemma hermitian_inner_sub_pow (k : ℕ) (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) :
    ⟪v, v - (A ^ k).toEuclideanLin v⟫_ℝ =
      ∑ i, (hA.eigenvectorBasis.repr v i) ^ 2 * (1 - hA.eigenvalues i ^ k)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.hermitian_power_increment_le
statement:
lemma hermitian_power_increment_le (hθ : ∀ i, hA.eigenvalues i ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (k : ℕ) (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) :
    ⟪v, v - (A ^ k).toEuclideanLin v⟫_ℝ ≤
      (k : ℝ) * ⟪v, v - A.toEuclideanLin v⟫_ℝ

name: OAI.CriticalSK.hermitian_repr_apply
statement:
lemma hermitian_repr_apply (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (i : ι) :
    hA.eigenvectorBasis.repr (A.toEuclideanLin v) i =
      hA.eigenvalues i * hA.eigenvectorBasis.repr v i

name: OAI.CriticalSK.hermitian_repr_pow
statement:
lemma hermitian_repr_pow (k : ℕ) (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (i : ι) :
    hA.eigenvectorBasis.repr ((A ^ k).toEuclideanLin v) i =
      hA.eigenvalues i ^ k * hA.eigenvectorBasis.repr v i

name: OAI.CriticalSK.kernelConjugate_apply
statement:
lemma kernelConjugate_apply (K : Matrix (Spin n) (Spin n) ℝ) (f : Spin n → ℝ) :
    (kernelConjugate W K).toEuclideanLin (gibbsEuclideanEquiv W f) =
      gibbsEuclideanEquiv W (K.mulVec f)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.kernelConjugate_isHermitian
statement:
lemma kernelConjugate_isHermitian (K : Matrix (Spin n) (Spin n) ℝ)
    (hK : ∀ x y, gibbs W x * K x y = gibbs W y * K y x) :
    (kernelConjugate W K).IsHermitian

name: OAI.CriticalSK.kernelConjugate_pow_apply
statement:
lemma kernelConjugate_pow_apply (K : Matrix (Spin n) (Spin n) ℝ)
    (k : ℕ) (f : Spin n → ℝ) :
    (kernelConjugate W K ^ k).toEuclideanLin (gibbsEuclideanEquiv W f) =
      gibbsEuclideanEquiv W ((K ^ k).mulVec f)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.kernel_mul_nonneg
OAI.CriticalSK.kernel_mul_stationary
statement:
lemma kernel_mul_stationary {K L : Matrix ι ι ℝ} {μ : ι → ℝ}
    (hK : ∀ y, ∑ x, μ x * K x y = μ y)
    (hL : ∀ y, ∑ x, μ x * L x y = μ y) (y : ι) :
    ∑ x, μ x * (K * L) x y = μ y

name: OAI.CriticalSK.kernel_mul_sum
OAI.CriticalSK.kernel_pow_nonneg
statement:
lemma kernel_pow_nonneg {K : Matrix ι ι ℝ}
    (hK : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ K x y) (k : ℕ) (x y : ι) : 0 ≤ (K ^ k) x y

name: OAI.CriticalSK.kernel_pow_stationary
OAI.CriticalSK.kernel_pow_sum
statement:
lemma kernel_pow_sum {K : Matrix ι ι ℝ}
    (hK : ∀ x, ∑ y, K x y = 1) (k : ℕ) (x : ι) : ∑ y, (K ^ k) x y = 1

name: OAI.CriticalSK.matrix_exp_entry_hasSum
statement:
lemma matrix_exp_entry_hasSum (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (x y : ι) :
    HasSum (fun k : ℕ => ((k.factorial : ℝ)⁻¹) * (A ^ k) x y) (NormedSpace.exp A x y)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.matrix_exp_hasSum
statement:
lemma matrix_exp_hasSum (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) :
    HasSum (fun k : ℕ => ((k.factorial : ℝ)⁻¹) • A ^ k) (NormedSpace.exp A)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.matrix_exp_scalar
statement:
lemma matrix_exp_scalar (a : ℝ) :
    NormedSpace.exp (a • (1 : Matrix ι ι ℝ)) = Real.exp a • (1 : Matrix ι ι ℝ)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.matrix_poisson_exp
statement:
lemma matrix_poisson_exp (P : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (a : ℝ) :
    NormedSpace.exp (a • (P - 1)) = Real.exp (-a) • NormedSpace.exp (a • P)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.matrix_poisson_hasSum
statement:
lemma matrix_poisson_hasSum (P : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (a : ℝ) (x y : ι) :
    HasSum (fun k : ℕ => (Real.exp (-a) * a ^ k / k.factorial) * (P ^ k) x y)
      (NormedSpace.exp (a • (P - 1)) x y)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.odd_halfspace_mass_le
statement:
lemma odd_halfspace_mass_le {μ : ι → ℝ} (hμ : ∀ x, 0 ≤ μ x) (hμsum : ∑ x, μ x = 1)
    (flip : Equiv.Perm ι) (hflip : ∀ x, μ (flip x) = μ x)
    (f : ι → ℝ) (hodd : ∀ x, f (flip x) = -f x) (c : ℝ) :
    (∑ y, if 0 < c * f y then μ y else 0) ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.one_sub_pow_le_mul
statement:
lemma one_sub_pow_le_mul (θ : ℝ) (hθ0 : 0 ≤ θ) (hθ1 : θ ≤ 1) (k : ℕ) :
    1 - θ ^ k ≤ (k : ℝ) * (1 - θ)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.poisson_coeff_hasSum
statement:
lemma poisson_coeff_hasSum (a : ℝ) :
    HasSum (fun k : ℕ => Real.exp (-a) * a ^ k / k.factorial) 1

name: OAI.CriticalSK.poisson_coeff_moment_hasSum
statement:
lemma poisson_coeff_moment_hasSum (a : ℝ) :
    HasSum (fun k : ℕ => (Real.exp (-a) * a ^ k / k.factorial) * k) a

name: OAI.CriticalSK.poisson_coeff_nonneg
statement:
lemma poisson_coeff_nonneg (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (k : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ Real.exp (-a) * a ^ k / k.factorial

name: OAI.CriticalSK.poisson_kernel_nonneg
statement:
lemma poisson_kernel_nonneg {P : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hP : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ P x y)
    (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (x y : ι) :
    0 ≤ NormedSpace.exp (a • (P - 1)) x y

name: OAI.CriticalSK.poisson_kernel_stationary
OAI.CriticalSK.poisson_kernel_sum
statement:
lemma poisson_kernel_sum {P : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hP : ∀ x, ∑ y, P x y = 1)
    (a : ℝ) (x : ι) : ∑ y, NormedSpace.exp (a • (P - 1)) x y = 1

name: OAI.CriticalSK.poisson_stationary_increment_le
statement:
lemma poisson_stationary_increment_le {P : Matrix ι ι ℝ} {μ : ι → ℝ}
    (f : ι → ℝ) (D : ℝ)
    (hincrement : ∀ k : ℕ, (∑ x, ∑ y, μ x * (P ^ k) x y * (f y - f x) ^ 2) ≤ (k : ℝ) * D)
    (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) :
    (∑ x, ∑ y, μ x * NormedSpace.exp (a • (P - 1)) x y * (f y - f x) ^ 2) ≤ a * D

name: OAI.CriticalSK.sign_failure_average
statement:
lemma sign_failure_average {μ : ι → ℝ} (hμ : ∀ x, 0 ≤ μ x)
    {K : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hK : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ K x y) (hrow : ∀ x, ∑ y, K x y = 1)
    (f : ι → ℝ) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) :
    (∑ x, μ x * ∑ y, if f x * f y ≤ 0 then K x y else 0) ≤
      (∑ x, if |f x| ≤ a then μ x else 0) +
      (∑ x, ∑ y, μ x * K x y * (f y - f x) ^ 2) / a ^ 2

name: OAI.CriticalSK.sign_failure_pointwise
statement:
lemma sign_failure_pointwise (u v a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) :
    (if u * v ≤ 0 then (1 : ℝ) else 0) ≤
      (if |u| ≤ a then (1 : ℝ) else 0) + (v - u) ^ 2 / a ^ 2

name: OAI.CriticalSK.sign_good_mass_bound
statement:
lemma sign_good_mass_bound {μ : ι → ℝ} (hμ : ∀ x, 0 ≤ μ x) (hμsum : ∑ x, μ x = 1)
    (flip : Equiv.Perm ι) (hflip : ∀ x, μ (flip x) = μ x)
    {K : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hK : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ K x y) (hrow : ∀ x, ∑ y, K x y = 1)
    (f : ι → ℝ) (hodd : ∀ x, f (flip x) = -f x) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) :
    1 - (∑ x, if (1 / 4 : ℝ) < (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ y, |K x y - μ y| then μ x else 0) ≤
      4 * ((∑ x, if |f x| ≤ a then μ x else 0) +
        (∑ x, ∑ y, μ x * K x y * (f y - f x) ^ 2) / a ^ 2)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.sign_row_test
statement:
lemma sign_row_test {p μ : ι → ℝ} (hpsum : ∑ y, p y = 1) (hμsum : ∑ y, μ y = 1)
    (f : ι → ℝ) (c : ℝ)
    (hhalf : (∑ y, if 0 < c * f y then μ y else 0) ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ)) :
    (1 / 2 : ℝ) - (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ y, |p y - μ y| ≤
      ∑ y, if c * f y ≤ 0 then p y else 0

name: OAI.CriticalSK.siteAverage_self_square
statement:
lemma siteAverage_self_square (i : Fin n) (f : Spin n → ℝ) :
    mean W (fun x => f x * siteAverage W i f x) =
      mean W (fun x => (siteAverage W i f x) ^ 2)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.stationary_increment_continuous
statement:
theorem stationary_increment_continuous (hn : 0 < n) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) (f : Spin n → ℝ) :
    (∑ x, ∑ y, gibbs W x * continuousKernel W t x y * (f y - f x) ^ 2) ≤
      2 * t * dirichlet W f

name: OAI.CriticalSK.stationary_increment_discrete
statement:
theorem stationary_increment_discrete (hn : 0 < n) (k : ℕ) (f : Spin n → ℝ) :
    (∑ x, ∑ y, gibbs W x * (discreteKernel W ^ k) x y * (f y - f x) ^ 2) ≤
      (2 * k : ℝ) / n * dirichlet W f

name: OAI.CriticalSK.stationary_increment_identity
statement:
lemma stationary_increment_identity {K : Matrix ι ι ℝ} {μ : ι → ℝ}
    (hrow : ∀ x, ∑ y, K x y = 1)
    (hstationary : ∀ y, ∑ x, μ x * K x y = μ y) (f : ι → ℝ) :
    (∑ x, ∑ y, μ x * K x y * (f y - f x) ^ 2) =
      2 * ∑ x, μ x * (f x * (f x - K.mulVec f x))

name: OAI.CriticalSK.continuous_pair_first
statement:
lemma continuous_pair_first {A B C D : Type*} [TopologicalSpace A] [TopologicalSpace B]
    [TopologicalSpace C] [TopologicalSpace D] {f : A × B → D} (hf : Continuous f) :
    Continuous (fun z : A × (B × C) => f (z.1, z.2.1))

name: OAI.CriticalSK.cubeOverlap_abs_le_one
statement: lemma cubeOverlap_abs_le_one {n : ℕ} (x y : Spin n) : |cubeOverlap x y| ≤ 1

name: OAI.CriticalSK.cubeOverlap_average
statement:
lemma cubeOverlap_average {n : ℕ} (f : ℝ → ℝ) :
    (Fintype.card (Spin n) : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ 2 * ∑ x : Spin n, ∑ y : Spin n, f (cubeOverlap x y) =
      (Fintype.card (Spin n) : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ y : Spin n, f (signMean y)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.cubeOverlap_binomial_sum
statement:
lemma cubeOverlap_binomial_sum {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (f : ℝ → ℝ) :
    (Fintype.card (Spin n) : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ 2 * ∑ x : Spin n, ∑ y : Spin n, f (cubeOverlap x y) =
      (2 : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ n * ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n+1),
        (Nat.choose n k : ℝ) * f (-1 + 2 * (k : ℝ) / n)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.cubeOverlap_gram
statement:
lemma cubeOverlap_gram {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (x y : Spin n) :
    inner ℝ (cubeVector x) (cubeVector y) = cubeOverlap x y * (Real.sqrt n)^2

name: OAI.CriticalSK.cubeOverlap_signMean
statement:
lemma cubeOverlap_signMean {n : ℕ} (x y : Spin n) :
    cubeOverlap x y = signMean (spinProduct x y)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.cubeOverlap_sum
statement:
lemma cubeOverlap_sum {n : ℕ} (x : Spin n) (f : ℝ → ℝ) :
    (∑ y : Spin n, f (cubeOverlap x y)) = ∑ y : Spin n, f (signMean y)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.cubeVector_norm
statement: lemma cubeVector_norm {n : ℕ} (x : Spin n) : ‖cubeVector x‖ = Real.sqrt n

name: OAI.CriticalSK.cube_pair_energy_continuous
statement:
lemma cube_pair_energy_continuous {n : ℕ} (lam : Fin n → ℝ) (x y : Spin n) :
    Continuous (fun U : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ =>
      Real.exp ((diagonalEnergy lam (orthogonalIsometry U (cubeVector x)) +
        diagonalEnergy lam (orthogonalIsometry U (cubeVector y)))/2))

name: OAI.CriticalSK.cylinderKernel_measurable
statement:
lemma cylinderKernel_measurable {f : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞} (hf : Measurable f) :
    Measurable (Function.uncurry (cylinderKernel f))

name: OAI.CriticalSK.cylinderKernel_scaled
statement:
lemma cylinderKernel_scaled {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (t : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞) :
    cylinderKernel f (r*t) r =
      ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-(Real.sqrt (1+t^2)*r)^2)) * f (sphereRatio t)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.cylinder_radius_integral
statement:
lemma cylinder_radius_integral (k : ℕ) {f : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞} (hf : Measurable f) :
    (∫⁻ r : ℝ in Ioi 0, ENNReal.ofReal (r^k) * ∫⁻ s : ℝ, cylinderKernel f s r) =
      radialGaussian (k+2) * ∫⁻ t : ℝ,
        ENNReal.ofReal ((Real.sqrt (1+t^2))⁻¹^(k+2)) * f (sphereRatio t)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.cylinder_scalar_scale
statement:
lemma cylinder_scalar_scale {f : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞} {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) :
    (∫⁻ s : ℝ, cylinderKernel f s r) =
      ENNReal.ofReal r * ∫⁻ t : ℝ,
        ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-(Real.sqrt (1+t^2)*r)^2)) * f (sphereRatio t)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.diagonalEnergy_continuous
statement: lemma diagonalEnergy_continuous (lam : ι → ℝ) : Continuous (diagonalEnergy lam)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.diagonalEnergy_overlap
statement:
lemma diagonalEnergy_overlap (lam : ι → ℝ) (u v : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) {q : ℝ}
    (hq : |q| ≤ 1) :
    diagonalEnergy lam (overlapPlus u v q) + diagonalEnergy lam (overlapMinus u v q) =
      (1+q)*diagonalEnergy lam u + (1-q)*diagonalEnergy lam v

name: OAI.CriticalSK.euclidSplit_integral
statement:
lemma euclidSplit_integral (n : ℕ) {f : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞} (hf : Measurable f) :
    (∫⁻ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n+1)),
      ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-‖x‖^2)) * f (x 0 / ‖x‖)) =
    ∫⁻ p : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n),
      ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-(p.1^2 + ‖p.2‖^2))) *
        f (p.1 / Real.sqrt (p.1^2 + ‖p.2‖^2)) ∂volume.prod volume

name: OAI.CriticalSK.euclidSplit_norm
statement:
lemma euclidSplit_norm (n : ℕ) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n+1))) :
    ‖x‖ = Real.sqrt ((euclidSplit n x).1^2 + ‖(euclidSplit n x).2‖^2)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.euclidSplit_norm_sq
statement:
lemma euclidSplit_norm_sq (n : ℕ) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n+1))) :
    ‖x‖^2 = (euclidSplit n x).1^2 + ‖(euclidSplit n x).2‖^2

name: OAI.CriticalSK.euclidSplit_preserving

name: OAI.CriticalSK.exp_pair_cosh
statement:
lemma exp_pair_cosh (A D q : ℝ) :
    Real.exp ((A+D)/2) * Real.cosh (q*(A-D)/2) =
      (Real.exp (((1+q)*A+(1-q)*D)/2) + Real.exp (((1-q)*A+(1+q)*D)/2))/2

name: OAI.CriticalSK.finset_card_sum
statement:
lemma finset_card_sum (n : ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℝ) :
    (∑ s : Finset (Fin n), f s.card) =
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n+1), (Nat.choose n k : ℝ) * f k

name: OAI.CriticalSK.gaussian_coordinate_polar
statement:
lemma gaussian_coordinate_polar (n : ℕ) {f : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞} (hf : Measurable f) :
    (∫⁻ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n+3)),
      ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-‖x‖^2)) * f (x 0 / ‖x‖)) =
    (∫⁻ u : sphere (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n+3))) 1,
      f (u.val 0) ∂(volume : Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n+3)))).toSphere) *
        radialGaussian (n+3)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.gaussian_cylinder_volume
statement:
lemma gaussian_cylinder_volume (n : ℕ) {f : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞} (hf : Measurable f) :
    (∫⁻ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n+3)),
      ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-‖x‖^2)) * f (x 0 / ‖x‖)) =
    (volume : Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n+2)))).toSphere Set.univ *
      radialGaussian (n+3) * ∫⁻ t : ℝ,
        ENNReal.ofReal ((Real.sqrt (1+t^2))⁻¹^(n+3)) * f (sphereRatio t)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.integral_polar
statement:
lemma integral_polar (μ : Measure E) [μ.IsAddHaarMeasure] (f : E → ℝ) :
    (∫ x, f x ∂μ) = ∫ p : sphere (0 : E) 1 × Ioi (0 : ℝ),
      f (p.2.val • p.1.val) ∂μ.toSphere.prod (volumeIoiPow (Module.finrank ℝ E - 1))

lemma lintegral_polar (μ : Measure E) [μ.IsAddHaarMeasure] {f : E → ℝ≥0∞}

    (∫⁻ x, f x ∂μ) = ∫⁻ p : sphere (0 : E) 1 × Ioi (0 : ℝ),
      f (p.2.val • p.1.val) ∂μ.toSphere.prod (volumeIoiPow (Module.finrank ℝ E - 1))

name: OAI.CriticalSK.lintegral_radial_norm
statement:
lemma lintegral_radial_norm (μ : Measure E) [μ.IsAddHaarMeasure] {f : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞}

    (∫⁻ x, f ‖x‖ ∂μ) = μ.toSphere Set.univ *
      ∫⁻ r : ℝ in Ioi 0, ENNReal.ofReal (r^(Module.finrank ℝ E-1)) * f r

name: OAI.CriticalSK.lintegral_scale_pos

name: OAI.CriticalSK.overlapPair_gram
statement:
lemma overlapPair_gram {u v : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι} {r q : ℝ}

    ‖overlapPlus u v q‖ = r ∧ ‖overlapMinus u v q‖ = r ∧
      inner ℝ (overlapPlus u v q) (overlapMinus u v q) = q * r^2

statement: lemma sphereRatio_left_inverse (t : ℝ) : sphereRatioInv (sphereRatio t) = t

name: OAI.CriticalSK.sphereRatio_mem
statement: lemma sphereRatio_mem (t : ℝ) : sphereRatio t ∈ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1

name: OAI.CriticalSK.sphereRatio_right_inverse
statement:
lemma sphereRatio_right_inverse {q : ℝ} (hq : q ∈ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1) :
    sphereRatio (sphereRatioInv q) = q

name: OAI.CriticalSK.sphereRatio_sq
statement: lemma sphereRatio_sq (t : ℝ) : sphereRatio t ^ 2 = t^2/(1+t^2)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.sphereUniform_coordinate_lintegral
statement:
lemma sphereUniform_coordinate_lintegral (n : ℕ) {f : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞} (hf : Measurable f) :
    (∫⁻ u : unitSphere (Fin (n+3)), f (u.val 0) ∂sphereUniform) =
      ∫⁻ q, f q ∂normalizedOverlapShape (n+3)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.sphereUniform_integral
statement:
lemma sphereUniform_integral (f : unitSphere ι → ℝ) :
    (∫ u, f u ∂sphereUniform) = sphereAverage f

name: OAI.CriticalSK.sphereUniform_rotation_preserving
statement:
lemma sphereUniform_rotation_preserving (U : Matrix.orthogonalGroup ι ℝ) :
    MeasurePreserving (orthogonalSphere U) (sphereUniform (ι := ι)) sphereUniform

name: OAI.CriticalSK.sphere_coordinate_lintegral
statement:
lemma sphere_coordinate_lintegral (n : ℕ) {f : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞} (hf : Measurable f) :
    (∫⁻ u : sphere (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n+3))) 1,
      f (u.val 0) ∂(volume : Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n+3)))).toSphere) =
    (volume : Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n+2)))).toSphere Set.univ *
      ∫⁻ q in Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1, ENNReal.ofReal (sphereOverlapShape (n+3) q) * f q

name: OAI.CriticalSK.sphere_energy_continuous
statement:
lemma sphere_energy_continuous (lam : ι → ℝ) (a r : ℝ) :
    Continuous (fun u : unitSphere ι => Real.exp (a / 2 * diagonalEnergy lam (r • u.val)))

name: OAI.CriticalSK.sphere_inner_abs_le_one
statement: lemma sphere_inner_abs_le_one (x y : unitSphere ι) : |inner ℝ x.val y.val| ≤ 1

name: OAI.CriticalSK.sphere_inner_coordinate_lintegral
statement:
lemma sphere_inner_coordinate_lintegral (n : ℕ) {f : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞} (hf : Measurable f)
    (u : unitSphere (Fin (n+1))) :
    (∫⁻ v : unitSphere (Fin (n+1)), f (inner ℝ u.val v.val) ∂sphereUniform) =
      ∫⁻ v : unitSphere (Fin (n+1)), f (v.val 0) ∂sphereUniform

name: OAI.CriticalSK.spinProduct_involution
statement: lemma spinProduct_involution {n : ℕ} (x : Spin n) : Function.Involutive (spinProduct x)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.spinValue_beq
statement: lemma spinValue_beq (a b : Bool) : spinValue (a == b) = spinValue a * spinValue b

name: OAI.CriticalSK.volumeIoiPow_lintegral
statement:
lemma volumeIoiPow_lintegral (k : ℕ) {f : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞} (hf : Measurable f) :
    (∫⁻ r : Ioi (0 : ℝ), f r.val ∂volumeIoiPow k) =
      ∫⁻ r : ℝ in Ioi 0, ENNReal.ofReal (r^k) * f r

name: OAI.CriticalSK.alphaSite_cavity
statement:
lemma alphaSite_cavity (i : Fin n) :
    alphaSite W i = mean (deleteDisorder W i) (fun x => (Real.cosh (localField W i x))⁻¹)/cavityNormalization W i

name: OAI.CriticalSK.alphaSite_normalization
statement: lemma alphaSite_normalization (i : Fin n) : 1 ≤ alphaSite W i*cavityNormalization W i^2

name: OAI.CriticalSK.alphaSite_pos
statement: lemma alphaSite_pos (W : Disorder n) (i : Fin n) : 0 < alphaSite W i

name: OAI.CriticalSK.cavityJoin_apply_incident
statement:
lemma cavityJoin_apply_incident (i : Fin n) (u : Incident i → ℝ) (v : Nonincident i → ℝ) (e : Incident i) :
    (cavitySplit i).symm (u,v) e.val = u e

name: OAI.CriticalSK.cavityJoin_apply_nonincident
statement:
lemma cavityJoin_apply_nonincident (i : Fin n) (u : Incident i → ℝ) (v : Nonincident i → ℝ) (e : Nonincident i) :
    (cavitySplit i).symm (u,v) e.val = v e

name: OAI.CriticalSK.cavityNormalization_ge_one
statement: lemma cavityNormalization_ge_one (W : Disorder n) (i : Fin n) : 1 ≤ cavityNormalization W i

name: OAI.CriticalSK.cavityOverlapCoord_comm
statement: lemma cavityOverlapCoord_comm (i : Fin n) (x y : Spin n) : cavityOverlapCoord i x y = cavityOverlapCoord i y x

name: OAI.CriticalSK.cavityOverlapCoord_eq
statement:
lemma cavityOverlapCoord_eq (i : Fin n) (x y : Spin n) :
    cavityOverlapCoord i x y = cubeOverlap x y-spinValue (x i)*spinValue (y i)/(n:ℝ)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.cavityOverlapCoord_fiber_left
statement:
lemma cavityOverlapCoord_fiber_left {i : Fin n} {x x' : Spin n} (h : sameExcept i x x') (y : Spin n) :
    cavityOverlapCoord i x' y = cavityOverlapCoord i x y

name: OAI.CriticalSK.cavityOverlap_compare
statement:
lemma cavityOverlap_compare (i : Fin n) :
    cavityOverlap W i ≤ 2*cavityNormalization W i^2*(gibbsOverlap W+(n:ℝ)⁻¹^2)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.cavityOverlap_nonneg
statement: lemma cavityOverlap_nonneg (i : Fin n) : 0 ≤ cavityOverlap W i

name: OAI.CriticalSK.cavitySplit_preserving
statement:
lemma cavitySplit_preserving (i : Fin n) :
    MeasurePreserving (cavitySplit i) (disorderLaw n) ((incidentLaw i).prod (nonincidentLaw i))

name: OAI.CriticalSK.cavity_exp_pair
statement:
lemma cavity_exp_pair (W : Disorder n) (i : Fin n) (x : Spin n) :
    (Real.exp (hamiltonian W x)+Real.exp (hamiltonian W (flipSite i x)))/2 =
      Real.exp (hamiltonian (deleteDisorder W i) x)*Real.cosh (localField W i x)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.delete_cavityJoin
statement:
lemma delete_cavityJoin (i : Fin n) (u : Incident i → ℝ) (v : Nonincident i → ℝ) :
    deleteDisorder ((cavitySplit i).symm (u,v)) i = (cavitySplit i).symm (0,v)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.delete_hamiltonian_fiber
statement:
lemma delete_hamiltonian_fiber (W : Disorder n) {i : Fin n} {x y : Spin n} (h : sameExcept i x y) :
    hamiltonian (deleteDisorder W i) y = hamiltonian (deleteDisorder W i) x

name: OAI.CriticalSK.dirichlet_linear_eq
statement:
lemma dirichlet_linear_eq (a : Fin n → ℝ) :
    dirichlet W (linearObservable a) = ∑ i, alphaSite W i*a i^2

name: OAI.CriticalSK.dirichlet_linear_pos
statement:
lemma dirichlet_linear_pos {a : Fin n → ℝ} (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    0 < dirichlet W (linearObservable a)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.edgeOfOther_touches
statement: lemma edgeOfOther_touches (i j : Fin n) (h : j ≠ i) : touches i (edgeOfOther i j h)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.flipSite_apply_ne
statement: @[simp] lemma flipSite_apply_ne (i : Fin n) (x : Spin n) {j : Fin n} (h : j ≠ i) : flipSite i x j = x j

name: OAI.CriticalSK.flipSite_apply_self
statement: @[simp] lemma flipSite_apply_self (i : Fin n) (x : Spin n) : flipSite i x i = !(x i)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.flipSite_involutive
statement: @[simp] lemma flipSite_involutive (i : Fin n) (x : Spin n) : flipSite i (flipSite i x) = x

name: OAI.CriticalSK.flipSite_ne
statement: lemma flipSite_ne (i : Fin n) (x : Spin n) : flipSite i x ≠ x

name: OAI.CriticalSK.gibbs_cavity
statement:
lemma gibbs_cavity (W : Disorder n) (i : Fin n) (x : Spin n) :
    gibbs W x = gibbs (deleteDisorder W i) x*Real.exp (spinValue (x i)*localField W i x)/cavityNormalization W i

name: OAI.CriticalSK.gibbs_cavity_pair
statement:
lemma gibbs_cavity_pair (W : Disorder n) (i : Fin n) (x : Spin n) :
    (gibbs W x+gibbs W (flipSite i x))/2 =
      gibbs (deleteDisorder W i) x*Real.cosh (localField W i x)/cavityNormalization W i

name: OAI.CriticalSK.gibbs_delete_fiber
statement:
lemma gibbs_delete_fiber (W : Disorder n) {i : Fin n} {x y : Spin n} (h : sameExcept i x y) :
    gibbs (deleteDisorder W i) y = gibbs (deleteDisorder W i) x

name: OAI.CriticalSK.hamiltonian_cavity
statement:
lemma hamiltonian_cavity (W : Disorder n) (i : Fin n) (x : Spin n) :
    hamiltonian W x = hamiltonian (deleteDisorder W i) x+spinValue (x i)*localField W i x

name: OAI.CriticalSK.incidentCoeff_fiber
statement:
lemma incidentCoeff_fiber {i : Fin n} {x y : Spin n} (h : sameExcept i x y) (e : Edge n) :
    incidentCoeff i y e = incidentCoeff i x e

name: OAI.CriticalSK.incidentCoeff_other
statement:
lemma incidentCoeff_other (i : Fin n) (x : Spin n) (e : Incident i) :
    incidentCoeff i x e.val = spinValue (x ((incidentOtherEquiv i) e).val)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.incident_coeff_product
statement:
lemma incident_coeff_product (i : Fin n) (x y : Spin n) :
    (∑ e : Incident i, incidentCoeff i x e.val*incidentCoeff i y e.val) =
      (n:ℝ)*cavityOverlapCoord i x y

name: OAI.CriticalSK.incident_coeff_square
statement:
lemma incident_coeff_square (i : Fin n) (x : Spin n) :
    (∑ e : Incident i, incidentCoeff i x e.val^2) = (n:ℝ)-1

name: OAI.CriticalSK.localField_cavityJoin
statement:
lemma localField_cavityJoin (i : Fin n) (u : Incident i → ℝ) (v : Nonincident i → ℝ) (x : Spin n) :
    localField ((cavitySplit i).symm (u,v)) i x = ∑ e : Incident i, incidentCoeff i x e.val*u e

name: OAI.CriticalSK.localField_fiber
statement:
lemma localField_fiber (W : Disorder n) {i : Fin n} {x y : Spin n} (h : sameExcept i x y) :
    localField W i y = localField W i x

name: OAI.CriticalSK.mean_cavity_even
statement:
lemma mean_cavity_even (W : Disorder n) (i : Fin n) (f : Spin n → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ x, f (flipSite i x)=f x) :
    mean W f = mean (deleteDisorder W i) (fun x => Real.cosh (localField W i x)*f x)/cavityNormalization W i

name: OAI.CriticalSK.mean_delete_le
statement:
lemma mean_delete_le (i : Fin n) (f : Spin n → ℝ) (hf : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x)
    (hflip : ∀ x, f (flipSite i x)=f x) :
    mean (deleteDisorder W i) f ≤ cavityNormalization W i*mean W f

name: OAI.CriticalSK.mean_mul_mean_inv
statement:
lemma mean_mul_mean_inv {f : Spin n → ℝ} (hf : ∀ x, 0 < f x) :
    1 ≤ mean W f*mean W (fun x => (f x)⁻¹)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.one_sub_tanh_sq
statement: lemma one_sub_tanh_sq (z : ℝ) : 1-(Real.sinh z/Real.cosh z)^2 = (Real.cosh z)⁻¹^2

name: OAI.CriticalSK.otherEnd_ne
statement: lemma otherEnd_ne (i : Fin n) (e : Incident i) : otherEnd i e ≠ i

name: OAI.CriticalSK.partition_cavity
statement:
lemma partition_cavity (W : Disorder n) (i : Fin n) :
    partition W = partition (deleteDisorder W i)*cavityNormalization W i

name: OAI.CriticalSK.sameExcept_flipSite
statement: lemma sameExcept_flipSite (i : Fin n) (x : Spin n) : sameExcept i x (flipSite i x)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.sameExcept_two
statement:
lemma sameExcept_two (i : Fin n) (x y : Spin n) :
    sameExcept i x y ↔ y=x ∨ y=flipSite i x

name: OAI.CriticalSK.siteAverage_const_mul
statement:
lemma siteAverage_const_mul (i : Fin n) (c : ℝ) (f : Spin n → ℝ) :
    siteAverage W i (fun x => c*f x) = fun x => c*siteAverage W i f x

name: OAI.CriticalSK.siteAverage_linear_residual
statement:
lemma siteAverage_linear_residual (i : Fin n) (a : Fin n → ℝ) (x : Spin n) :
    linearObservable a x-siteAverage W i (linearObservable a) x =
      a i*(spinValue (x i)-siteAverage W i (fun y => spinValue (y i)) x)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.siteAverage_spin
statement:
lemma siteAverage_spin (W : Disorder n) (i : Fin n) (x : Spin n) :
    siteAverage W i (fun y => spinValue (y i)) x = Real.sinh (localField W i x)/Real.cosh (localField W i x)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.siteAverage_two
statement:
lemma siteAverage_two (W : Disorder n) (i : Fin n) (f : Spin n → ℝ) (x : Spin n) :
    siteAverage W i f x = (gibbs W x*f x+gibbs W (flipSite i x)*f (flipSite i x))/(gibbs W x+gibbs W (flipSite i x))

name: OAI.CriticalSK.site_spin_variance
statement:
lemma site_spin_variance (i : Fin n) :
    mean W (fun x => (spinValue (x i)-siteAverage W i (fun y => spinValue (y i)) x)^2) = alphaSite W i

name: OAI.CriticalSK.sum_incident_other
statement:
lemma sum_incident_other (i : Fin n) (f : Fin n → ℝ) :
    (∑ e : Incident i, f (otherEnd i e)) = ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, f j

name: OAI.CriticalSK.sum_sameExcept
statement:
lemma sum_sameExcept (i : Fin n) (x : Spin n) (f : Spin n → ℝ) :
    (∑ y : Spin n, if sameExcept i x y then f y else 0) = f x+f (flipSite i x)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.binaryEntropyRate_taylor
statement:
lemma binaryEntropyRate_taylor {q : ℝ} (hq : |q| ≤ 1/2) :
    |binaryEntropyRate q-q^2/2| ≤ 4*q^4

name: OAI.CriticalSK.binomial_exp_term
statement:
lemma binomial_exp_term {n j : ℕ} (hj : j ≤ n) (t : ℝ) :
    Real.exp (t * (2 * (j : ℝ) - n)) = Real.exp t ^ j * Real.exp (-t) ^ (n-j)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.central_overlap_sum_bound
statement:
lemma central_overlap_sum_bound {n : ℕ} (hn : 4 ≤ n) {h : ℝ → ℝ} (hc : Continuous h)
    (h0 : ∀ r, 0 ≤ h r) (hm : ∀ q r, |q| ≤ |r| → h q ≤ h r)
    {a e : ℝ} (ha : a ≤ 1/2) (he : 0 ≤ e) (t : Finset ℕ)
    (ht : ∀ j ∈ t, |latticeOverlap n j|+2/(n:ℝ) ≤ a)
    (hp : ∀ j ∈ t, cubeOverlapMass n j ≤ (1+e)*(2/(n:ℝ))*sphereOverlapDensity n (latticeOverlap n j)) :
    (∑ j ∈ t, cubeOverlapMass n j*h (latticeOverlap n j)) ≤
      (1+e)*Real.exp (2*(n:ℝ)*a^4+4*a^2+2*a) * ∫ r : ℝ, h r*sphereOverlapDensity n r

name: OAI.CriticalSK.central_overlap_uniform_bound
statement:
lemma central_overlap_uniform_bound {c : ℕ → ℝ} (hc : Tendsto c atTop (𝓝 0))
    (hc4 : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (n:ℝ)*c n^4) atTop (𝓝 0))
    (hcmin : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, 1/(n:ℝ) ≤ c n) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, ∀ h : ℝ → ℝ, Continuous h → (∀ q, 0 ≤ h q) →
      (∀ q r, |q| ≤ |r| → h q ≤ h r) →
      (∑ j ∈ (Finset.range (n+1)).filter (fun j => |latticeOverlap n j| ≤ c n),
        cubeOverlapMass n j*h (latticeOverlap n j)) ≤
          (1+ε)*∫ r : ℝ, h r*sphereOverlapDensity n r

name: OAI.CriticalSK.cubeOverlapMass_chernoff
statement:
lemma cubeOverlapMass_chernoff {n j : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hj : j ≤ n) :
    cubeOverlapMass n j ≤ Real.exp (-(n : ℝ) * latticeOverlap n j ^ 2 / 2)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.cubeOverlapMass_exp_bound
statement:
lemma cubeOverlapMass_exp_bound {n j : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hj : j ≤ n) (t : ℝ) :
    cubeOverlapMass n j * Real.exp (t * n * latticeOverlap n j) ≤ Real.cosh t ^ n

name: OAI.CriticalSK.cubeOverlapMass_local_limit
statement:
lemma cubeOverlapMass_local_limit {j : ℕ → ℕ}
    (hj : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, j n ≤ n)
    (hq : Tendsto (fun n => latticeOverlap n (j n)) atTop (𝓝 0))
    (hfour : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (n:ℝ)*latticeOverlap n (j n)^4) atTop (𝓝 0)) :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => cubeOverlapMass n (j n) * Real.sqrt n *
      Real.exp ((n:ℝ)*latticeOverlap n (j n)^2/2)) atTop
      (𝓝 (Real.exp (Real.log 2-Real.log (2*Real.pi)/2)))

name: OAI.CriticalSK.cubeOverlapMass_nonneg
statement: lemma cubeOverlapMass_nonneg (n j : ℕ) : 0 ≤ cubeOverlapMass n j

name: OAI.CriticalSK.cubeOverlapMass_pos
statement: lemma cubeOverlapMass_pos {n j : ℕ} (hj : j ≤ n) : 0 < cubeOverlapMass n j

name: OAI.CriticalSK.cube_sphere_overlap_local_ratio
statement:
lemma cube_sphere_overlap_local_ratio {j : ℕ → ℕ}
    (hj : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, j n ≤ n)
    (hq : Tendsto (fun n => latticeOverlap n (j n)) atTop (𝓝 0))
    (hfour : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (n:ℝ)*latticeOverlap n (j n)^4) atTop (𝓝 0)) :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => cubeOverlapMass n (j n) /
      ((2/(n:ℝ))*sphereOverlapDensity n (latticeOverlap n (j n)))) atTop (𝓝 1)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.cube_sphere_overlap_uniform
statement:
lemma cube_sphere_overlap_uniform {c : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hc : Tendsto c atTop (𝓝 0))
    (hc4 : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (n:ℝ)*c n^4) atTop (𝓝 0))
    (hcmin : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, 1/(n:ℝ) ≤ c n) :
    ∀ ε > 0, ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, ∀ j ≤ n, |latticeOverlap n j| ≤ c n →
      |cubeOverlapMass n j / ((2/(n:ℝ))*sphereOverlapDensity n (latticeOverlap n j))-1| < ε

name: OAI.CriticalSK.entropy_error_tendsto
statement:
lemma entropy_error_tendsto {q : ℕ → ℝ} (hq : Tendsto q atTop (𝓝 0))
    (hfour : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (n:ℝ)*q n^4) atTop (𝓝 0)) :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (n:ℝ)*(binaryEntropyRate (q n)-q n^2/2)) atTop (𝓝 0)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.integral_shape_on_Ioo
statement:
lemma integral_shape_on_Ioo {n : ℕ} (hn : 4 ≤ n) (h : ℝ → ℝ) :
    (∫ q in Ioo (-1:ℝ) 1, h q*sphereOverlapShape n q) = ∫ q, h q*sphereOverlapShape n q

name: OAI.CriticalSK.latticeOverlap_center_bound
statement:
lemma latticeOverlap_center_bound {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) :
    |latticeOverlap n (n/2)| ≤ 1/(n:ℝ)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.latticeOverlap_halves
statement:
lemma latticeOverlap_halves {n j : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hj : j ≤ n) :
    (j:ℝ) = n*(1+latticeOverlap n j)/2 ∧
    ((n-j:ℕ):ℝ) = n*(1-latticeOverlap n j)/2

name: OAI.CriticalSK.latticeOverlap_interior
statement:
lemma latticeOverlap_interior {n j : ℕ} (hj : 0 < j) (hjn : j < n) :
    -1 < latticeOverlap n j ∧ latticeOverlap n j < 1

name: OAI.CriticalSK.latticeOverlap_mul
statement:
lemma latticeOverlap_mul {n j : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) :
    n * latticeOverlap n j = 2 * (j : ℝ) - n

name: OAI.CriticalSK.latticeOverlap_spacing
statement:
lemma latticeOverlap_spacing {n j k : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hjk : j < k) :
    latticeOverlap n j+2/(n:ℝ) ≤ latticeOverlap n k

name: OAI.CriticalSK.local_overlap_const_pos
statement: lemma local_overlap_const_pos : 0 < Real.sqrt (2*Real.pi)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.local_overlap_constant
statement:
lemma local_overlap_constant : Real.exp (Real.log 2-Real.log (2*Real.pi)/2) *
    Real.sqrt (2*Real.pi) / 2 = 1

name: OAI.CriticalSK.log_cubeOverlapMass_exact
statement:
lemma log_cubeOverlapMass_exact {n j : ℕ} (hj : 0 < j) (hjn : j < n) :
    Real.log (cubeOverlapMass n j) + Real.log n/2 +
      n*binaryEntropyRate (latticeOverlap n j) + Real.log (1-latticeOverlap n j^2)/2 =
    Real.log 2-Real.log (2*Real.pi)/2 +
      stirlingLogError n-stirlingLogError j-stirlingLogError (n-j)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.log_cubic_error
statement:
lemma log_cubic_error {q : ℝ} (hq : |q| ≤ 1/2) :
    |Real.log (1-q) + q + q^2/2 + q^3/3| ≤ 2*q^4

name: OAI.CriticalSK.log_factorial_stirling_exact
statement:
lemma log_factorial_stirling_exact {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) :
    Real.log (n.factorial : ℝ) = (n:ℝ)*Real.log n-n+Real.log n/2+
      Real.log (2*Real.pi)/2+stirlingLogError n

name: OAI.CriticalSK.log_square_error
statement:
lemma log_square_error {q : ℝ} (hq : |q| ≤ 1/2) :
    |Real.log (1-q^2)+q^2| ≤ 2*q^4

name: OAI.CriticalSK.normalizedOverlapShape_integral
statement:
lemma normalizedOverlapShape_integral {n : ℕ} (hn : 4 ≤ n) (h : ℝ → ℝ) :
    (∫ q, h q ∂normalizedOverlapShape n) = ∫ q, h q*sphereOverlapDensity n q

name: OAI.CriticalSK.normalized_integral_square
statement:
lemma normalized_integral_square {Ω : Type*} [TopologicalSpace Ω] [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [BorelSpace Ω] [CompactSpace Ω] [T2Space Ω] {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {f : Ω → ℝ} (hf : Continuous f) {S : ℝ} (hS : S ≠ 0) (hm : ∫ x, f x ∂μ = S) :
    (∫ x, (f x/S-1)^2 ∂μ) = (∫ x, f x^2 ∂μ)/S^2-1

name: OAI.CriticalSK.outwardBin_disjoint
statement:
lemma outwardBin_disjoint {δ q r : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (hqr : q+δ ≤ r) :
    Disjoint (outwardBin δ q) (outwardBin δ r)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.outwardBin_distance
statement:
lemma outwardBin_distance {δ q r : ℝ} (_hδ : 0 ≤ δ) (hr : r ∈ outwardBin δ q) :
    |r-q| ≤ δ ∧ |q| ≤ |r|

name: OAI.CriticalSK.outwardBin_integral_const
statement:
lemma outwardBin_integral_const (δ q c : ℝ) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) :
    (∫ _ : ℝ in outwardBin δ q, c) = δ*c

name: OAI.CriticalSK.outwardBin_integral_lower
statement:
lemma outwardBin_integral_lower {n : ℕ} (hn : 4 ≤ n) {h : ℝ → ℝ} (hc : Continuous h)
    (h0 : ∀ r, 0 ≤ h r) (hm : ∀ q r, |q| ≤ |r| → h q ≤ h r)

        |u.val (0 : Fin (n+1)).succ.succ| ≤ b}) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (Real.pi * δ * gaussianPairPrefactor (v 0) (v 1) *

    (hvar : 128 * (∑ i : Fin n, (v i.succ.succ : ℝ)^2) ≤ d^2) :

lemma integral_polar_iterated (μ : Measure E) [μ.IsAddHaarMeasure] {f : E → ℝ}
    (hf : Integrable f μ) :
    (∫ x, f x ∂μ) = ∫ r : Ioi (0 : ℝ), ∫ u : sphere (0 : E) 1,
      f (r.val • u.val) ∂μ.toSphere ∂volumeIoiPow (Module.finrank ℝ E - 1)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.integral_polar_real
statement:
lemma integral_polar_real (μ : Measure E) [μ.IsAddHaarMeasure] {f : E → ℝ}
    (hf : Integrable f μ) :
    (∫ x, f x ∂μ) = ∫ r in Ioi (0 : ℝ), r ^ (Module.finrank ℝ E - 1) *
      ∫ u : sphere (0 : E) 1, f (r • u.val) ∂μ.toSphere

name: OAI.CriticalSK.map_density_of_preserving
statement:
lemma map_density_of_preserving {X Y : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableSpace Y]
    {μ : Measure X} {ν : Measure Y} {T : X → Y} (hT : MeasurePreserving T μ ν)
    (w : Y → ℝ≥0∞) (hw : Measurable w) :
    (μ.withDensity (fun x => w (T x))).map T = ν.withDensity w

name: OAI.CriticalSK.normShell_cone_density_real
OAI.CriticalSK.normShell_density
statement:
lemma normShell_density (μ : Measure E) [μ.IsAddHaarMeasure] {f : E → ℝ}
    (hf : Integrable f μ) (hfn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x) {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) :
    μ.withDensity (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (f x)) (normShell a b) =
      ENNReal.ofReal (∫ r in Ioc a b, radialDensity μ f r)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.normShell_density_limit
statement:
lemma normShell_density_limit (μ : Measure E) [μ.IsAddHaarMeasure] [ProperSpace E]
    {f : E → ℝ} (hf : Integrable f μ) (hfc : Continuous f) (hfn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x)
    {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) :
    Filter.Tendsto (fun δ : ℝ =>
      (μ.withDensity (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (f x)) (normShell r (r+δ))).toReal / δ)
      (nhdsWithin 0 (Ioi 0)) (𝓝 (radialDensity μ f r))

name: OAI.CriticalSK.normShell_density_real
statement:
lemma normShell_density_real (μ : Measure E) [μ.IsAddHaarMeasure] {f : E → ℝ}
    (hf : Integrable f μ) (hfn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x) {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) :
    (μ.withDensity (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (f x)) (normShell a b)).toReal =
      ∫ r in Ioc a b, radialDensity μ f r

name: OAI.CriticalSK.normShell_integral
statement:
lemma normShell_integral (μ : Measure E) [μ.IsAddHaarMeasure] {f : E → ℝ}
    (hf : Integrable f μ) {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) :
    (∫ x in normShell a b, f x ∂μ) = ∫ r in Ioc a b,

name: OAI.CriticalSK.piSquareSum_bulk_mass
statement:
lemma piSquareSum_bulk_mass (v : ι → ℝ≥0) {s d : ℝ} (hd : 0 < d)
    (hmean : (∑ i, (v i : ℝ)) = s-d)
    (hvar : 128 * (∑ i, (v i : ℝ)^2) ≤ d^2) :
    (1/2 : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ (Measure.pi (fun i => gaussianReal 0 (v i)))
      {x | s-2*d ≤ piSquareSum x ∧ piSquareSum x ≤ s}

name: OAI.CriticalSK.radialDensity_spherePartition
statement:
lemma radialDensity_spherePartition {lam : ι → ℝ} {v : ι → ℝ≥0} {z a : ℝ}
    (hq : ∀ i, (v i : ℝ)⁻¹ = z - a * lam i) (r : ℝ) :
    radialDensity volume (fun x : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι => gaussianPiPDF v x) r =
      r ^ (Fintype.card ι - 1) * gaussianPiPrefactor v * Real.exp (-z*r^2/2) *
      sphereArea (ι := ι) * spherePartition lam a r

name: OAI.CriticalSK.radialDensity_standard
statement:
lemma radialDensity_standard (r : ℝ) :
    radialDensity volume (fun x : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι => gaussianPiPDF (fun _ => 1) x) r =
      r ^ (Fintype.card ι - 1) * gaussianPiPrefactor (fun _ : ι => 1) * Real.exp (-r^2/2) *
      sphereArea (ι := ι)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.radialDensity_standard_pos

lemma radialDensity_standard_pos {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) :

name: OAI.CriticalSK.sphereGaussianPDF
statement:
lemma sphereGaussianPDF {lam : ι → ℝ} {v : ι → ℝ≥0} {z a : ℝ}
    (hq : ∀ i, (v i : ℝ)⁻¹ = z - a * lam i) (r : ℝ) (u : unitSphere ι) :
    gaussianPiPDF v (WithLp.ofLp (r • u.val)) = gaussianPiPrefactor v * Real.exp (-z*r^2/2) *
      Real.exp (a/2 * diagonalEnergy lam (r • u.val))

name: OAI.CriticalSK.sphereTilted_apply_real
statement:
lemma sphereTilted_apply_real (lam : ι → ℝ) (a r : ℝ) {A : Set (unitSphere ι)} (hA : MeasurableSet A) :
    (sphereTilted lam a r A).toReal =
      (∫ u in A, Real.exp (a/2 * diagonalEnergy lam (r • u.val))
        ∂(volume : Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)).toSphere) /
      (∫ u : unitSphere ι, Real.exp (a/2 * diagonalEnergy lam (r • u.val))
        ∂(volume : Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)).toSphere)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.sphereTilted_coordinate_sq
statement:
lemma sphereTilted_coordinate_sq {lam : ι → ℝ} {v : ι → ℝ≥0} {z a s : ℝ}
    (hv : ∀ i, v i ≠ 0) (hq : ∀ i, (v i:ℝ)⁻¹ = z-a*lam i) (hs : 0 < s) (i : ι) :
    (∫ u : unitSphere ι, ((Real.sqrt s • u.val) i)^2 ∂sphereTilted lam a (Real.sqrt s)) =
      gaussianSquareCoordinateDensity v i s / diagonalSquareDensity v s

name: OAI.CriticalSK.sphereTilted_density_ratio
statement:
lemma sphereTilted_density_ratio {lam : ι → ℝ} {v : ι → ℝ≥0} {z a s : ℝ}
    (hv : ∀ i, v i ≠ 0) (hq : ∀ i, (v i : ℝ)⁻¹ = z - a * lam i) (hs : 0 < s)
    {A : Set (unitSphere ι)} (hA : MeasurableSet A) :
    (sphereTilted lam a (Real.sqrt s) A).toReal =
      diagonalSquareDensityOn v A s / diagonalSquareDensity v s

name: OAI.CriticalSK.sphereTilted_gaussian_integral
statement:
lemma sphereTilted_gaussian_integral {lam : ι → ℝ} {v : ι → ℝ≥0} {z a : ℝ}
    (hv : ∀ i, v i ≠ 0) (hq : ∀ i, (v i : ℝ)⁻¹ = z-a*lam i)
    (r : ℝ) (F : unitSphere ι → ℝ) :
    (∫ u, F u ∂sphereTilted lam a r) =
      (∫ u : unitSphere ι, gaussianPiPDF v (r • u.val) * F u
        ∂(volume : Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)).toSphere) /
      (∫ u : unitSphere ι, gaussianPiPDF v (r • u.val)
        ∂(volume : Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)).toSphere)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.sphereTilted_integral
statement:
lemma sphereTilted_integral (lam : ι → ℝ) (a r : ℝ) (F : unitSphere ι → ℝ) :

        ∂(volume : Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)).toSphere) /

        ∂(volume : Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)).toSphere)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.spherical_radial_ratio
statement:
lemma spherical_radial_ratio {lam : ι → ℝ} {v : ι → ℝ≥0} {z a r : ℝ}
    (hq : ∀ i, (v i : ℝ)⁻¹ = z - a * lam i) (hr : 0 < r) :
    radialDensity volume (fun x : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι => gaussianPiPDF v x) r /
      radialDensity volume (fun x : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι => gaussianPiPDF (fun _ => 1) x) r =
      gaussianPiPrefactor v / gaussianPiPrefactor (fun _ : ι => 1) *
        Real.exp (-(z-1)*r^2/2) * spherePartition lam a r

lemma squareNormShell_cone_density_limit (μ : Measure E) [μ.IsAddHaarMeasure] [ProperSpace E]

name: OAI.CriticalSK.sphereTilted_overlap_bound
statement:

    (∫ p : unitSphere ι × unitSphere ι,
      (inner ℝ (r • p.1.val) (r • p.2.val))^2
      ∂((sphereTilted lam a r).prod (sphereTilted lam a r))) ≤ C^2*(∑ i, v i^2)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.sphereTilted_pair_integral

lemma sphereTilted_pair_integral (lam : ι → ℝ) (r : ℝ)

    (∫ p, F p ∂((sphereTilted lam 1 r).prod (sphereTilted lam 1 r))) =

      4*((∫ U, rotatedCubePair lam (fun q => q^2) U ∂orthogonalHaar (Fin n))/spherePartition lam 1 (Real.sqrt n)^2)/K

name: OAI.CriticalSK.sphereRestricted_as_tilted
statement:
lemma sphereRestricted_as_tilted (lam : ι → ℝ) (a r b : ℝ) (i : ι) :
    sphereAverage (fun u => if |(r • u.val) i| ≤ b then
      Real.exp (a/2*diagonalEnergy lam (r • u.val)) else 0) =
      spherePartition lam a r * (sphereTilted lam a r).real
        {u : unitSphere ι | |(r • u.val) i| ≤ b}

name: OAI.CriticalSK.alignIsometry_align

name: OAI.CriticalSK.alignIsometry_apply
statement:
lemma alignIsometry_apply (e v x : E) :
    alignIsometry e v x = x -
      (2 * (inner ℝ (v - ‖v‖ • e) x / ‖v - ‖v‖ • e‖ ^ 2)) • (v - ‖v‖ • e)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.alignIsometry_measurable

name: OAI.CriticalSK.columnNorm_preserving

name: OAI.CriticalSK.conjugateGaussianMatrix_apply
statement:
lemma conjugateGaussianMatrix_apply
    (U : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)
    (A : GaussianMatrix ι) (i j : ι) :
    conjugateGaussianMatrix U A i j =
      ∑ k, ∑ l, U (EuclideanSpace.basisFun ι ℝ k) i * A k l *
        U (EuclideanSpace.basisFun ι ℝ l) j

name: OAI.CriticalSK.conjugateGaussianMatrix_preserves
statement:
lemma conjugateGaussianMatrix_preserves (U : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) :
    (stdGaussian (GaussianMatrix ι)).map (conjugateGaussianMatrix U) =
      stdGaussian (GaussianMatrix ι)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.conjugateGaussianMatrix_trans
statement:
lemma conjugateGaussianMatrix_trans (U V : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)
    (A : GaussianMatrix ι) :
    conjugateGaussianMatrix (U.trans V) A =
      conjugateGaussianMatrix V (conjugateGaussianMatrix U A)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.conjugateGaussianMatrix_transpose
statement:
lemma conjugateGaussianMatrix_transpose
    (U : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (A : GaussianMatrix ι) :
    conjugateGaussianMatrix U (transposeGaussianMatrix A) =
      transposeGaussianMatrix (conjugateGaussianMatrix U A)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.conjugate_symmetric
statement:
lemma conjugate_symmetric (U : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)
    (A : GaussianMatrix ι) (hA : ∀ i j, A i j = A j i) :
    ∀ i j, conjugateGaussianMatrix U A i j = conjugateGaussianMatrix U A j i

name: OAI.CriticalSK.conjugate_symmetrize
statement:
lemma conjugate_symmetrize (s : ℝ)
    (U : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (A : GaussianMatrix ι) :
    conjugateGaussianMatrix U (symmetrizeGaussianMatrix s A) =
      symmetrizeGaussianMatrix s (conjugateGaussianMatrix U A)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.covariance_inner_stdGaussian
statement:
lemma covariance_inner_stdGaussian (v w : E) :
    cov[fun x => inner ℝ v x, fun x => inner ℝ w x; stdGaussian E] = inner ℝ v w

name: OAI.CriticalSK.euclidean_isometry_apply_eq_sum
statement:
lemma euclidean_isometry_apply_eq_sum
    (U : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)
    (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (i : ι) :
    U v i = ∑ j, v j * U (EuclideanSpace.basisFun ι ℝ j) i

name: OAI.CriticalSK.extendTailIsometry_basis_succ

    extendTailIsometry U (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin (n + 1)) ℝ k.succ) =

name: OAI.CriticalSK.extendTailIsometry_basis_zero

@[simp] lemma extendTailIsometry_basis_zero {n : ℕ}

    extendTailIsometry U (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin (n + 1)) ℝ 0) =
      EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin (n + 1)) ℝ 0

name: OAI.CriticalSK.extendTailIsometry_border

statement:
lemma first_step_conjugate {n : ℕ} (A : GaussianMatrix (Fin (n+1)))

    conjugateGaussianMatrix (extendTailIsometry (alignIsometry (firstAxis n) (firstColumn A))) A =

statement:
lemma goeEntryVector_inner (s : ℝ) (i j : ι) (A : GaussianMatrix ι) :

statement:
lemma goeEntryVector_orthogonal (s : ℝ) :

name: OAI.CriticalSK.goeLaw_conjugate
statement:
lemma goeLaw_conjugate (s : ℝ)
    (U : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) :
    (goeLaw ι s).map (conjugateGaussianMatrix U) = goeLaw ι s

name: OAI.CriticalSK.goe_entries_independent
statement:
lemma goe_entries_independent (s : ℝ) :

name: OAI.CriticalSK.goe_entry_law
statement:
lemma goe_entry_law [DecidableEq ι] (s : ℝ) (i j : ι) :
    (goeLaw ι s).map (fun A => A i j) =
      gaussianReal 0 (if i = j then (4 * s ^ 2).toNNReal else (2 * s ^ 2).toNNReal)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.goe_entry_variance
statement:
lemma goe_entry_variance [DecidableEq ι] (s : ℝ) (i j : ι) :
    ‖goeEntryVector s i j‖ ^ 2 = if i = j then 4 * s ^ 2 else 2 * s ^ 2

name: OAI.CriticalSK.goe_step_conjugate
statement:
lemma goe_step_conjugate {n : ℕ} (e : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) (he : ‖e‖ = 1)
    (A : GaussianMatrix (Fin (n+1))) (hA : ∀ i j, A i j = A j i) :
    conjugateGaussianMatrix
      (extendTailIsometry (alignIsometry e (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => A 0 i.succ)))) A =
      borderMatrix (A 0 0) (‖(WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => A 0 i.succ) : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))‖ • e)
        (conjugateGaussianMatrix (alignIsometry e (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => A 0 i.succ)))
          (matrixTail A))

name: OAI.CriticalSK.orthoMatrix_trans
statement:
lemma orthoMatrix_trans (U V : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) :

name: OAI.CriticalSK.random_isometry_gaussian_preserving

name: OAI.CriticalSK.triReduce_conjugate

name: OAI.CriticalSK.basisQuadratic_le

lemma basisSpan_finrank {n : ℕ} (b : OrthonormalBasis (Fin n) ℝ E) (s : Finset (Fin n)) :

name: OAI.CriticalSK.basisSpan_intersection_unit
statement:

name: OAI.CriticalSK.basisSpan_repr_zero
statement:
lemma basisSpan_repr_zero {n : ℕ} (b : OrthonormalBasis (Fin n) ℝ E)
    (s : Finset (Fin n)) {x : E} (hx : x ∈ basisSpan b s)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.basis_minmax_lower
statement:
lemma basis_minmax_lower {n : ℕ} (a b : OrthonormalBasis (Fin n) ℝ E)
    (α β : Fin n → ℝ) (hα : Antitone α) (hβ : Antitone β)
    {S : Set ℝ} {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : MonotoneOn f S)
    (hβS : ∀ i, β i ∈ S)
    (hqS : ∀ x : E, ‖x‖ = 1 → basisQuadratic b β x ∈ S)
    (hform : ∀ x : E, ‖x‖ = 1 → f (basisQuadratic b β x) ≤ basisQuadratic a α x)
    (i : Fin n) : f (β i) ≤ α i

name: OAI.CriticalSK.basis_minmax_upper
statement:
lemma basis_minmax_upper {n : ℕ} (a b : OrthonormalBasis (Fin n) ℝ E)
    (α β : Fin n → ℝ) (hα : Antitone α) (hβ : Antitone β)
    {S : Set ℝ} {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : MonotoneOn f S)
    (hβS : ∀ i, β i ∈ S)
    (hqS : ∀ x : E, ‖x‖ = 1 → basisQuadratic b β x ∈ S)
    (hform : ∀ x : E, ‖x‖ = 1 → basisQuadratic a α x ≤ f (basisQuadratic b β x))
    (i : Fin n) : α i ≤ f (β i)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.basis_sum_squares

lemma basis_sum_squares {n : ℕ} (b : OrthonormalBasis (Fin n) ℝ E) (x : E) :

name: OAI.CriticalSK.eigenbasisQuadratic_eq
statement:
lemma eigenbasisQuadratic_eq {T : E →ₗ[ℝ] E} (hT : T.IsSymmetric)
    {n : ℕ} (hn : finrank ℝ E = n) (x : E) :
    basisQuadratic (hT.eigenvectorBasis hn) (hT.eigenvalues hn) x = inner ℝ x (T x)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.eigenvalue_form_comparison
statement:
lemma eigenvalue_form_comparison {A B : E →ₗ[ℝ] E}
    (hA : A.IsSymmetric) (hB : B.IsSymmetric)
    {n : ℕ} (hn : finrank ℝ E = n) {S : Set ℝ} {Φ : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hplus : MonotoneOn (fun e => e + Φ e) S)
    (hminus : MonotoneOn (fun e => e - Φ e) S)
    (hBS : ∀ i, hB.eigenvalues hn i ∈ S)
    (hqS : ∀ x : E, ‖x‖ = 1 → inner ℝ x (B x) ∈ S)
    (hform : ∀ x : E, ‖x‖ = 1 →
      |inner ℝ x (A x) - inner ℝ x (B x)| ≤ Φ (inner ℝ x (B x)))
    (i : Fin n) : |hA.eigenvalues hn i - hB.eigenvalues hn i| ≤ Φ (hB.eigenvalues hn i)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.charmatrix_jacobi_tail
statement:
lemma charmatrix_jacobi_tail (a : ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    ((jacobi a (k + 1)).charmatrix).submatrix Fin.succ Fin.succ =

name: OAI.CriticalSK.derivative_scaledHermite_succ
statement:
lemma derivative_scaledHermite_succ (a : ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
