name: OAI.CriticalSK.det_tridiagonal_step
statement:
lemma det_tridiagonal_step {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (k : ℕ)
    (A : Matrix (Fin (k + 2)) (Fin (k + 2)) R)
    (hrow : ∀ j : Fin k, A 0 j.succ.succ = 0)
    (hcol : ∀ i : Fin k, A i.succ.succ 0 = 0) :
    A.det = A 0 0 * (A.submatrix Fin.succ Fin.succ).det -
      A 0 1 * A 1 0 * (A.submatrix (Fin.succ ∘ Fin.succ) (Fin.succ ∘ Fin.succ)).det

name: OAI.CriticalSK.directed_neighbor_sum
statement:
lemma directed_neighbor_sum (n : ℕ) (u : ℕ → ℝ) :
    (∑ i : Fin (n+1), ∑ j : Fin (n+1),
      (if i.val+1=j.val then edgeCoeff n i.val else 0) * u i.val * u j.val) =
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, edgeCoeff n i * u i * u (i+1)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.edgeCoeff_lower
statement:
lemma edgeCoeff_lower (n i : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ n) :
    1 - (i+1 : ℝ)/(n+1) ≤ edgeCoeff n i

name: OAI.CriticalSK.edgeTent_adj_mul_zero
statement:
lemma edgeTent_adj_mul_zero {m b d i : ℕ} (hgap : b+4*m ≤ d) :
    edgeTent m b i * edgeTent m d (i+1) = 0

name: OAI.CriticalSK.edgeTent_adj_mul_zero'
statement:
lemma edgeTent_adj_mul_zero' {m b d i : ℕ} (hgap : b+4*m ≤ d) :
    edgeTent m d i * edgeTent m b (i+1) = 0

name: OAI.CriticalSK.edgeTent_energy
statement:
lemma edgeTent_energy {m b n : ℕ} (_hfit : b+4*m ≤ n) :
    pathEnergy n (edgeTent m b) ≤ 4*m + (2*(b+4*m+1 : ℝ)/(n+1)) *
      (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n+1), edgeTent m b i ^ 2)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.edgeTent_gradient
statement:
lemma edgeTent_gradient (m b n : ℕ) :
    (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (edgeTent m b (i+1) - edgeTent m b i)^2) ≤ 4 * m

name: OAI.CriticalSK.edgeTent_gradient_support
statement:
lemma edgeTent_gradient_support {m b i : ℕ} (hi : i ∉ Finset.Ico b (b+4*m)) :
    edgeTent m b (i+1) - edgeTent m b i = 0

name: OAI.CriticalSK.edgeTent_le
statement: lemma edgeTent_le (m b i : ℕ) : edgeTent m b i ≤ m

name: OAI.CriticalSK.edgeTent_lipschitz
statement: lemma edgeTent_lipschitz (m b i : ℕ) : |edgeTent m b (i+1) - edgeTent m b i| ≤ 1

name: OAI.CriticalSK.edgeTent_mass
statement:
lemma edgeTent_mass {m b n : ℕ} (hfit : b+2*m ≤ n+1) :
    (m : ℝ)^3 ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n+1), edgeTent m b i ^ 2

name: OAI.CriticalSK.edgeTent_mul_zero
statement:
lemma edgeTent_mul_zero {m b d i : ℕ} (hgap : b+4*m ≤ d) :
    edgeTent m b i * edgeTent m d i = 0

name: OAI.CriticalSK.edgeTent_nonneg
statement: lemma edgeTent_nonneg (m b i : ℕ) : 0 ≤ edgeTent m b i

name: OAI.CriticalSK.edgeTent_plateau
statement:
lemma edgeTent_plateau {m b i : ℕ} (hlo : b+m ≤ i) (hhi : i ≤ b+3*m) :
    edgeTent m b i = m

name: OAI.CriticalSK.edgeTent_rayleigh
statement:
lemma edgeTent_rayleigh {m b n : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (hfit : b+4*m ≤ n) :
    pathEnergy n (edgeTent m b) ≤
      (4/(m : ℝ)^2 + 2*(b+4*m+1 : ℝ)/(n+1)) *
        ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n+1), edgeTent m b i ^ 2

name: OAI.CriticalSK.edgeTent_zero_left
statement: lemma edgeTent_zero_left {m b i : ℕ} (hi : i ≤ b) : edgeTent m b i = 0

name: OAI.CriticalSK.edgeTent_zero_right
statement: lemma edgeTent_zero_right {m b i : ℕ} (hi : b + 4*m ≤ i) : edgeTent m b i = 0

name: OAI.CriticalSK.edge_potential_upper
statement:
lemma edge_potential_upper {n i : ℕ} (hi : i ≤ n) (hi0 : i ≠ 0) :
    2 - edgeCoeff n i - edgeCoeff n (i-1) ≤ 2*(i+1 : ℝ)/(n+1)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.eigenvalue_lower_of_subspace
statement:
lemma eigenvalue_lower_of_subspace {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    {T : E →ₗ[ℝ] E} (hT : T.IsSymmetric) {n : ℕ} (hn : finrank ℝ E = n)
    (S : Submodule ℝ E) (i : Fin n) {a : ℝ}
    (hdim : i.val < finrank ℝ S)
    (hquad : ∀ x : E, x ∈ S → ‖x‖ = 1 → a ≤ inner ℝ x (T x)) :
    a ≤ hT.eigenvalues hn i

name: OAI.CriticalSK.empiricalResolventSquare_bound
statement:
lemma empiricalResolventSquare_bound
    (hR : ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s →
      (empiricalResolvent e s) ^ 2 - (2 + s) * empiricalResolvent e s + 1 =
        empiricalResolventSquare e s / Fintype.card ι)
    {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s)
    (hscale : 4 ≤ (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) * s * Real.sqrt (s * (4 + s))) :
    empiricalResolventSquare e s ≤ 4 / Real.sqrt s

name: OAI.CriticalSK.empiricalResolventSquare_pos
statement: lemma empiricalResolventSquare_pos {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) : 0 < empiricalResolventSquare e s

name: OAI.CriticalSK.empiricalResolvent_continuousOn
statement: lemma empiricalResolvent_continuousOn : ContinuousOn (empiricalResolvent e) (Set.Ioi 0)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.empiricalResolvent_counting
statement:
lemma empiricalResolvent_counting {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) :
    ((Finset.univ.filter (fun i => e i ≤ s)).card : ℝ) ≤
      4 * (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) * s ^ 2 * empiricalResolventSquare e s

name: OAI.CriticalSK.empiricalResolvent_error_bound
statement:
lemma empiricalResolvent_error_bound
    (hR : ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s →
      (empiricalResolvent e s) ^ 2 - (2 + s) * empiricalResolvent e s + 1 =
        empiricalResolventSquare e s / Fintype.card ι)
    {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s)
    (hscale : 4 ≤ (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) * s * Real.sqrt (s * (4 + s))) :
    0 ≤ semicircleResolvent s - empiricalResolvent e s ∧
      semicircleResolvent s - empiricalResolvent e s ≤ 2 / ((Fintype.card ι : ℝ) * s)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.empiricalResolvent_le_inv
statement: lemma empiricalResolvent_le_inv {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) : empiricalResolvent e s ≤ s⁻¹

name: OAI.CriticalSK.empiricalResolvent_lt_midpoint
statement:
lemma empiricalResolvent_lt_midpoint
    (hR : ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s →
      (empiricalResolvent e s) ^ 2 - (2 + s) * empiricalResolvent e s + 1 =
        empiricalResolventSquare e s / Fintype.card ι)
    {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) : empiricalResolvent e s < (2 + s) / 2

name: OAI.CriticalSK.empiricalResolvent_lt_semicircle
statement:
lemma empiricalResolvent_lt_semicircle
    (hR : ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s →
      (empiricalResolvent e s) ^ 2 - (2 + s) * empiricalResolvent e s + 1 =
        empiricalResolventSquare e s / Fintype.card ι)
    {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) : empiricalResolvent e s < semicircleResolvent s

name: OAI.CriticalSK.empiricalResolvent_pos
statement: lemma empiricalResolvent_pos {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) : 0 < empiricalResolvent e s

name: OAI.CriticalSK.empiricalResolvent_root_difference
statement:
lemma empiricalResolvent_root_difference
    (hR : ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s →
      (empiricalResolvent e s) ^ 2 - (2 + s) * empiricalResolvent e s + 1 =
        empiricalResolventSquare e s / Fintype.card ι)
    {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) :
    0 ≤ semicircleResolvent s - empiricalResolvent e s ∧
      semicircleResolvent s - empiricalResolvent e s ≤
        empiricalResolventSquare e s /
          ((Fintype.card ι : ℝ) * Real.sqrt (s * (4 + s)))

name: OAI.CriticalSK.empiricalResolvent_square_difference
statement:
lemma empiricalResolvent_square_difference {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) :
    empiricalResolventSquare e s ≤ 2 / s *
      (empiricalResolvent e (s / 2) - empiricalResolvent e s)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.finset_sum_indicator_le_one
statement:
lemma finset_sum_indicator_le_one {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (p : ι → Prop)
    [DecidablePred p] (hp : ∀ i j, p i → p j → i = j) :
    (∑ i, if p i then (1 : ℝ) else 0) ≤ 1

name: OAI.CriticalSK.hermitian_charpoly_derivative_ratio
statement:
lemma hermitian_charpoly_derivative_ratio {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (hA : A.IsHermitian) {z : ℝ} (hz : A.charpoly.eval z ≠ 0) :
    A.charpoly.derivative.eval z / A.charpoly.eval z = ∑ i, (z - hA.eigenvalues i)⁻¹

name: OAI.CriticalSK.jacobiGaps_nonneg
statement: lemma jacobiGaps_nonneg (n : ℕ) (i : Fin n) : 0 ≤ jacobiGaps n i

name: OAI.CriticalSK.jacobi_charpoly
statement:
lemma jacobi_charpoly {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (k : ℕ) :
    (jacobi a k).charpoly = scaledHermite a k

name: OAI.CriticalSK.jacobi_charpoly_nonzero
statement:
lemma jacobi_charpoly_nonzero {n : ℕ} {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) :
    (jacobi (n : ℝ)⁻¹ n).charpoly.eval (2 + s) ≠ 0

name: OAI.CriticalSK.jacobi_charpoly_step
statement:
lemma jacobi_charpoly_step {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (k : ℕ) :
    (jacobi a (k + 2)).charpoly = X * (jacobi a (k + 1)).charpoly -
      C (a * (k + 1)) * (jacobi a k).charpoly

name: OAI.CriticalSK.jacobi_col_zero
statement: lemma jacobi_col_zero (a : ℝ) (k : ℕ) (i : Fin k) : jacobi a (k + 2) i.succ.succ 0 = 0

name: OAI.CriticalSK.jacobi_diagonal
statement: lemma jacobi_diagonal (a : ℝ) (k : ℕ) (i : Fin k) : jacobi a k i i = 0

name: OAI.CriticalSK.jacobi_edgeCoeff
statement:
lemma jacobi_edgeCoeff (n : ℕ) (i j : Fin (n+1)) :
    jacobi (n+1 : ℝ)⁻¹ (n+1) i j =
      (if i.val+1=j.val then edgeCoeff n i.val else 0) +
      (if j.val+1=i.val then edgeCoeff n j.val else 0)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.jacobi_eigenvalue_bound
statement:
lemma jacobi_eigenvalue_bound (n : ℕ) (i : Fin n) :
    |(jacobi_hermitian (n : ℝ)⁻¹ n).eigenvalues i| ≤ 2

name: OAI.CriticalSK.jacobi_first_sub
statement:
lemma jacobi_first_sub (a : ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    jacobi a (k + 2) 1 0 = Real.sqrt (a * (k + 1))

name: OAI.CriticalSK.jacobi_first_super
statement:
lemma jacobi_first_super (a : ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    jacobi a (k + 2) 0 1 = Real.sqrt (a * (k + 1))

name: OAI.CriticalSK.jacobi_gap_counting
statement:
lemma jacobi_gap_counting {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s)
    (hscale : 2 ≤ (n : ℝ) * s * Real.sqrt s) :
    ((Finset.univ.filter (fun i => jacobiGaps n i ≤ s)).card : ℝ) ≤
      16 * (n : ℝ) * s * Real.sqrt s

name: OAI.CriticalSK.jacobi_hermitian
statement: lemma jacobi_hermitian (a : ℝ) (n : ℕ) : (jacobi a n).IsHermitian

name: OAI.CriticalSK.jacobi_logarithmic_ratio
statement:
lemma jacobi_logarithmic_ratio {n : ℕ} {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) :
    (jacobi (n : ℝ)⁻¹ n).charpoly.derivative.eval (2 + s) /
      (jacobi (n : ℝ)⁻¹ n).charpoly.eval (2 + s) =
        (n : ℝ) * empiricalResolvent (jacobiGaps n) s

name: OAI.CriticalSK.jacobi_resolvent_estimates
statement:
lemma jacobi_resolvent_estimates {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s)
    (hscale : 2 ≤ (n : ℝ) * s * Real.sqrt s) :
    empiricalResolventSquare (jacobiGaps n) s ≤ 4 / Real.sqrt s ∧
      0 ≤ semicircleResolvent s - empiricalResolvent (jacobiGaps n) s ∧
      semicircleResolvent s - empiricalResolvent (jacobiGaps n) s ≤ 2 / (n * s)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.jacobi_riccati
statement:
lemma jacobi_riccati {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) :
    (empiricalResolvent (jacobiGaps n) s) ^ 2 -
      (2 + s) * empiricalResolvent (jacobiGaps n) s + 1 =
        empiricalResolventSquare (jacobiGaps n) s / n

name: OAI.CriticalSK.jacobi_row_norm_bound
statement:
lemma jacobi_row_norm_bound (n : ℕ) (i : Fin n) :
    ∑ j : Fin n, ‖jacobi (n : ℝ)⁻¹ n i j‖ ≤ 2

name: OAI.CriticalSK.jacobi_row_zero
statement: lemma jacobi_row_zero (a : ℝ) (k : ℕ) (j : Fin k) : jacobi a (k + 2) 0 j.succ.succ = 0

name: OAI.CriticalSK.jacobi_symmetric
statement: lemma jacobi_symmetric (a : ℝ) (k : ℕ) : (jacobi a k).IsSymm

name: OAI.CriticalSK.jacobi_tail
statement:
lemma jacobi_tail (a : ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    (jacobi a (k + 1)).submatrix Fin.succ Fin.succ = jacobi a k

name: OAI.CriticalSK.pathOperator_eigenvalue_lower
statement:
lemma pathOperator_eigenvalue_lower {m n r : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (hfit : 4*m*r ≤ n)
    (i : Fin (n+1)) (hi : i.val < r) :
    2-(4/(m : ℝ)^2 + 2*(4*m*r+1 : ℝ)/(n+1)) ≤
      (pathOperator_symmetric n).eigenvalues (by simp) i

name: OAI.CriticalSK.pathOperator_inner
statement:
lemma pathOperator_inner (n : ℕ) (u : ℕ → ℝ) :
    inner ℝ (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i : Fin (n+1) => u i.val))
      (pathOperator n (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i : Fin (n+1) => u i.val))) =
      2 * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, edgeCoeff n i * u i * u (i+1)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.pathOperator_symmetric
statement: lemma pathOperator_symmetric (n : ℕ) : (pathOperator n).IsSymmetric

name: OAI.CriticalSK.pathOperator_tent_rayleigh
statement:
lemma pathOperator_tent_rayleigh {m n r : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (hfit : 4*m*r ≤ n)
    (c : Fin r → ℝ) :
    (2-(4/(m : ℝ)^2 + 2*(4*m*r+1 : ℝ)/(n+1))) * ‖tentMap m n r c‖^2 ≤
      inner ℝ (tentMap m n r c) (pathOperator n (tentMap m n r c))

name: OAI.CriticalSK.scaledHermite_degree
statement: lemma scaledHermite_degree (a : ℝ) (k : ℕ) : (scaledHermite a k).degree = k

name: OAI.CriticalSK.scaledHermite_degree_gap
statement:
lemma scaledHermite_degree_gap (a : ℝ) (p : Polynomial ℝ) (hp : p ≠ 0) :
    (C a * derivative p).degree < (X * p).degree

name: OAI.CriticalSK.scaledHermite_differential
statement:
lemma scaledHermite_differential (a : ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    C a * derivative (derivative (scaledHermite a k)) -
      X * derivative (scaledHermite a k) + C (k : ℝ) * scaledHermite a k = 0

name: OAI.CriticalSK.scaledHermite_monic
statement: lemma scaledHermite_monic (a : ℝ) (k : ℕ) : (scaledHermite a k).Monic

name: OAI.CriticalSK.scaledHermite_succ
statement:
lemma scaledHermite_succ (a : ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    scaledHermite a (k + 1) = X * scaledHermite a k - C a * derivative (scaledHermite a k)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.scaledHermite_three_term
statement:
lemma scaledHermite_three_term (a : ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    scaledHermite a (k + 2) = X * scaledHermite a (k + 1) -
      C (a * (k + 1)) * scaledHermite a k

name: OAI.CriticalSK.scaledHermite_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma scaledHermite_zero (a : ℝ) : scaledHermite a 0 = 1

name: OAI.CriticalSK.semicircleResolvent_deficit
statement:
lemma semicircleResolvent_deficit {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 ≤ s) :
    1 - semicircleResolvent s ≤ Real.sqrt s

name: OAI.CriticalSK.semicircleResolvent_difference
statement:
lemma semicircleResolvent_difference {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 ≤ s) :
    semicircleResolvent (s / 2) - semicircleResolvent s ≤ Real.sqrt s

name: OAI.CriticalSK.semicircleResolvent_le_one
statement: lemma semicircleResolvent_le_one {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 ≤ s) : semicircleResolvent s ≤ 1

name: OAI.CriticalSK.semicircleResolvent_pos
statement: lemma semicircleResolvent_pos {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) : 0 < semicircleResolvent s

name: OAI.CriticalSK.semicircle_discriminant_lower
statement:
lemma semicircle_discriminant_lower {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 ≤ s) :
    2 * Real.sqrt s ≤ Real.sqrt (s * (4 + s))

name: OAI.CriticalSK.semicircle_discriminant_pos
statement: lemma semicircle_discriminant_pos {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) : 0 < s * (4 + s)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.separated_tents
statement:
lemma separated_tents {m k l i : ℕ} (hkl : k ≠ l) :
    edgeTent m (4*m*k) i * edgeTent m (4*m*l) i = 0

name: OAI.CriticalSK.separated_tents_adj
statement:
lemma separated_tents_adj {m k l i : ℕ} (hkl : k ≠ l) :
    edgeTent m (4*m*k) i * edgeTent m (4*m*l) (i+1) = 0

name: OAI.CriticalSK.sum_mul_diagonal
statement:
lemma sum_mul_diagonal {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (u v c : ι → ℝ)
    (huv : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → u i * v j = 0) :
    (∑ i, c i * u i) * (∑ i, c i * v i) = ∑ i, c i ^ 2 * u i * v i

name: OAI.CriticalSK.tentCombination_adj
statement:
lemma tentCombination_adj {r : ℕ} (m : ℕ) (c : Fin r → ℝ) (i : ℕ) :
    tentCombination m c i * tentCombination m c (i+1) =
      ∑ k, c k ^ 2 * edgeTent m (4*m*k.val) i * edgeTent m (4*m*k.val) (i+1)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.tentCombination_energy
statement:
lemma tentCombination_energy {r : ℕ} (m n : ℕ) (c : Fin r → ℝ) :
    pathEnergy n (tentCombination m c) =
      ∑ k, c k ^ 2 * pathEnergy n (edgeTent m (4*m*k.val))

name: OAI.CriticalSK.tentCombination_mass
statement:
lemma tentCombination_mass {r : ℕ} (m n : ℕ) (c : Fin r → ℝ) :
    (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n+1), tentCombination m c i ^ 2) =
      ∑ k, c k ^ 2 * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n+1), edgeTent m (4*m*k.val) i ^ 2

name: OAI.CriticalSK.tentCombination_probe
statement:
lemma tentCombination_probe {m r : ℕ} (c : Fin r → ℝ) (k : Fin r) :
    tentCombination m c (4*m*k.val+m) = c k * m

name: OAI.CriticalSK.tentCombination_rayleigh
statement:
lemma tentCombination_rayleigh {m n r : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (hfit : 4*m*r ≤ n)
    (c : Fin r → ℝ) :
    pathEnergy n (tentCombination m c) ≤
      (4/(m : ℝ)^2 + 2*(4*m*r+1 : ℝ)/(n+1)) *
        ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n+1), tentCombination m c i ^ 2

name: OAI.CriticalSK.tentCombination_sq
statement:
lemma tentCombination_sq {r : ℕ} (m : ℕ) (c : Fin r → ℝ) (i : ℕ) :
    tentCombination m c i ^ 2 = ∑ k, c k ^ 2 * edgeTent m (4*m*k.val) i ^ 2

name: OAI.CriticalSK.tentMap_injective
statement:
lemma tentMap_injective {m n r : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (hfit : 4*m*r ≤ n) :
    Function.Injective (tentMap m n r)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.tentMap_mass
statement:
lemma tentMap_mass (m n r : ℕ) (c : Fin r → ℝ) :
    (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n+1), tentCombination m c i ^ 2) = ‖tentMap m n r c‖ ^ 2

name: OAI.CriticalSK.tentMap_rank
statement:
lemma tentMap_rank {m n r : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (hfit : 4*m*r ≤ n) :
    finrank ℝ (LinearMap.range (tentMap m n r)) = r

name: OAI.CriticalSK.ceil_rpow_ratio_tendsto_zero
statement:
lemma ceil_rpow_ratio_tendsto_zero {a ε : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (⌈(n:ℝ)^(a-ε)⌉₊:ℝ)/(n:ℝ)^a) atTop (𝓝 0)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.edgeError_eigenvalue_comparison_mono
statement:
lemma edgeError_eigenvalue_comparison_mono {A B C s : ℝ}
    (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hs : 0 < s)
    (hsmall : A * (3 / 8 : ℝ) * s ^ (-5 / 8 : ℝ) + C ≤ 1) :
    MonotoneOn (fun v => v + edgeError A B C s (2 - v)) (Set.Iic 2) ∧
    MonotoneOn (fun v => v - edgeError A B C s (2 - v)) (Set.Iic 2)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.edgeError_gap_comparison_mono
statement:
lemma edgeError_gap_comparison_mono {A B C s : ℝ}
    (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hs : 0 < s)
    (hsmall : A * (3 / 8 : ℝ) * s ^ (-5 / 8 : ℝ) + C ≤ 1) :
    MonotoneOn (fun e => e + edgeError A B C s e) (Set.Ici 0) ∧
    MonotoneOn (fun e => e - edgeError A B C s e) (Set.Ici 0)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.edgeError_increment
statement:
lemma edgeError_increment {A B C s x y : ℝ} (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hs : 0 < s)
    (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hxy : x ≤ y) :
    edgeError A B C s y - edgeError A B C s x ≤
      (A * (3 / 8 : ℝ) * s ^ (-5 / 8 : ℝ) + C) * (y - x)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.edgeError_mono
statement:
lemma edgeError_mono {A B C s : ℝ} (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hs : 0 < s) :
    MonotoneOn (edgeError A B C s) (Set.Ici 0)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.edgeError_relative
statement:
lemma edgeError_relative {A B C s t e : ℝ} (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hs : 0 < s) (hst : s ≤ t) (he : 0 ≤ e) :
    edgeError A B C s e ≤ (A * s ^ (-5 / 8 : ℝ) + B / s + C) * (t + e)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.fifth_third_power
statement: lemma fifth_third_power {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) : x^(5/3:ℝ) = x*x^(2/3:ℝ)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.rpow_ratio_tendsto_zero
statement:
lemma rpow_ratio_tendsto_zero {a ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (n:ℝ)^(a-ε)/(n:ℝ)^a) atTop (𝓝 0)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.rpow_three_eighth_mono
statement:
lemma rpow_three_eighth_mono {x y : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hxy : x ≤ y) :
    x ^ (3 / 8 : ℝ) ≤ y ^ (3 / 8 : ℝ)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.rpow_three_eighth_sub_le
statement:
lemma rpow_three_eighth_sub_le {s x y : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) (hsx : s ≤ x) (hxy : x ≤ y) :
    y ^ (3 / 8 : ℝ) - x ^ (3 / 8 : ℝ) ≤
      (3 / 8 : ℝ) * s ^ (-5 / 8 : ℝ) * (y - x)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.block_scale_factor

name: OAI.CriticalSK.centered_product_form_good
statement:
lemma centered_product_form_good {X : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} {c : ℝ≥0} (n : ℕ) {h s : ℝ} {ω : Ω}
    (hh : 0 ≤ h) (hs : scaleEnergy (Nat.clog 8 (n + 1)) 0 ≤ s)
    (hω : ω ∉ multiscaleBad X c (fun j => scaleLength (Nat.clog 8 (n + 1)) j - 1)
      (Nat.clog 8 (n + 1) + 2) (n + 1) h)
    (u : ℕ → ℝ) (hu : ∀ i, n + 1 ≤ i → u i = 0)
    (hnorm : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), u i^2) = 1) :
    |∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), X i ω * (u i * u (i + 1))| ≤
      13824 * Real.sqrt (32 * (c : ℝ)) * (h + 1) *
        ((2 : ℝ)^(Nat.clog 8 (n + 1))) ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ) *
        (pathEnergy n u + s) ^ (3 / 8 : ℝ)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.centered_square_form_good
statement:
lemma centered_square_form_good {X : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} {c : ℝ≥0} (n : ℕ) {h s : ℝ} {ω : Ω}
    (hh : 0 ≤ h) (hs : scaleEnergy (Nat.clog 8 (n + 1)) 0 ≤ s)
    (hω : ω ∉ multiscaleBad X c (fun j => scaleLength (Nat.clog 8 (n + 1)) j - 1)
      (Nat.clog 8 (n + 1) + 2) (n + 1) h)
    (u : ℕ → ℝ) (hu : ∀ i, n + 1 ≤ i → u i = 0)
    (hnorm : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), u i^2) = 1) :
    |∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), X i ω * u i^2| ≤
      13824 * Real.sqrt (32 * (c : ℝ)) * (h + 1) *
        ((2 : ℝ)^(Nat.clog 8 (n + 1))) ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ) *
        (pathEnergy n u + s) ^ (3 / 8 : ℝ)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.chi_mean_form_bias
statement:
lemma chi_mean_form_bias (n : ℕ) (u : ℕ → ℝ) :
    2 * |∑ i ∈ Finset.range n,
      (((∫ x, chi (n - i) x ∂standardGaussianProduct (n - i)) / Real.sqrt (n + 1 : ℝ)) -
        edgeCoeff n i) * u i * u (i + 1)| ≤
      8 / (n + 1) * (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), u i ^ 2) +
        16 / Real.sqrt (n + 1 : ℝ) * pathEnergy n u

name: OAI.CriticalSK.chi_scaled_bias_bound
statement:
lemma chi_scaled_bias_bound (n i : ℕ) (hi : i < n) :

      Real.sqrt (n + 1 : ℝ) ≤
      4 / (n + 1) + (4 / Real.sqrt (n + 1 : ℝ)) * ((i + 1 : ℝ) / (n + 1))

name: OAI.CriticalSK.dyadic_cube_scale

name: OAI.CriticalSK.edgeCoeff_sqrt_div

name: OAI.CriticalSK.good_scale_prefix
statement:
lemma good_scale_prefix {X : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} {c : ℝ≥0} {J N : ℕ} {h : ℝ} {ω : Ω}
    (hh : 0 ≤ h)
    (hω : ω ∉ multiscaleBad X c (fun j => scaleLength J j - 1) (J + 2) N h)
    {j r b k : ℕ} (hj : j ≤ J + 1) (hr : r < N) (hb : b ∈ blockShell j r)
    (hk : k < scaleLength J j) :
    |∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), X (b * scaleLength J j + i) ω| ≤
      (Real.sqrt (32 * (c : ℝ)) * Real.sqrt (scaleLength J j)) * (h + j + r + 1)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.natural_le_exponential_quarter
statement:
lemma natural_le_exponential_quarter (j : ℕ) :

name: OAI.CriticalSK.scaleEnergy_step

    Real.sqrt (scaleLength J j) * (1 / scaleLength J j + 13 * Real.sqrt e) ≤

name: OAI.CriticalSK.scale_last
statement: lemma scale_last (J : ℕ) : scaleRoot J (J + 1) = 2

name: OAI.CriticalSK.scale_length_root

lemma scale_length_root {J j : ℕ} (hj : j ≤ J + 1) :

name: OAI.CriticalSK.scale_length_root_eq_one
statement:
lemma scale_length_root_eq_one {J j : ℕ} (hj : j ≤ J) :

name: OAI.CriticalSK.scale_shell_geometry

name: OAI.CriticalSK.scale_weight_absorption
statement:
lemma scale_weight_absorption (J j : ℕ) {e s h : ℝ} (hh : 0 ≤ h) (hes : 0 ≤ e + s)
    (hscale : scaleEnergy J j ≤ 4 * (e + s)) :
    (h + j + 1) * Real.sqrt (scaleRoot J j) ≤
      16 * (h + 1) * ((2 : ℝ)^J) ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ) * (e + s) ^ (3 / 8 : ℝ)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.selected_scale_form_bound
statement:
lemma selected_scale_form_bound {J j : ℕ} {e s h c a : ℝ}
    (hj : j ≤ J + 1) (he : 0 ≤ e) (hs : 0 ≤ s) (hh : 0 ≤ h) (_hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (heσ : e ≤ scaleEnergy J j) (hσ : scaleEnergy J j ≤ 4 * (e + s))
    (ha : a ≤ 32 * (Real.sqrt (32 * c) * Real.sqrt (scaleLength J j)) *
      (h + j + 1) * (1 / scaleLength J j + 13 * Real.sqrt e)) :
    a ≤ 13824 * Real.sqrt (32 * c) * (h + 1) * ((2 : ℝ)^J) ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ) *
      (e + s) ^ (3 / 8 : ℝ)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.triForm_decomposition
statement:
lemma triForm_decomposition (n : ℕ) (ω : TriSample n) (u : ℕ → ℝ) :
    triForm n ω u - (2 * (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), u i ^ 2) - pathEnergy n u) =
    (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ω.1 i * u i ^ 2) +
    2 * (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, scaledChiRow n i ω.2 * (u i * u (i + 1))) +
    2 * (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n,
      (((∫ x, chi (n - i) x ∂standardGaussianProduct (n - i)) / Real.sqrt (n + 1 : ℝ)) -
        edgeCoeff n i) * u i * u (i + 1))

name: OAI.CriticalSK.triForm_good
statement:
lemma triForm_good (n : ℕ) {h s : ℝ} {ω : TriSample n}
    (hh : 0 ≤ h) (hs : scaleEnergy (Nat.clog 8 (n + 1)) 0 ≤ s)
    (hω : ω ∉ triBad n h) (u : ℕ → ℝ) (hu : ∀ i, n + 1 ≤ i → u i = 0)
    (hnorm : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), u i ^ 2) = 1) :
    |triForm n ω u - (2 - pathEnergy n u)| ≤ formError n h s (pathEnergy n u)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.weighted_edge_form
statement:
lemma weighted_edge_form (n : ℕ) (u a : ℕ → ℝ) {B C : ℝ}
    (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (ha : ∀ i < n, |a i| ≤ B + C * ((i + 1 : ℝ) / (n + 1))) :
    2 * |∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, a i * u i * u (i + 1)| ≤
      2 * B * (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), u i ^ 2) + 4 * C * pathEnergy n u

name: OAI.CriticalSK.weighted_neighbor_sum
statement:
lemma weighted_neighbor_sum (n : ℕ) (u w : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hw0 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) (hw : ∀ i, w i ≤ w (i + 1)) :
    (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, w i * (u i ^ 2 + u (i + 1) ^ 2)) ≤
      2 * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), w i * u i ^ 2

name: OAI.CriticalSK.directed_neighbor_sum_general
statement:
lemma directed_neighbor_sum_general (n : ℕ) (b u : ℕ → ℝ) :

      (if i.val+1=j.val then b i.val else 0)*u i.val*u j.val) =
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, b i*u i*u (i+1)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.fractional_trace_bound
statement:
lemma fractional_trace_bound {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (e : ι → ℝ) (he : ∀ i, 0 ≤ e i)
    {s C : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s)
    (htrace : ∀ t : ℝ, s ≤ t → (∑ i, (t+e i)⁻¹^2) ≤ C / Real.sqrt t) :
    (∑ i, (s+e i)^(-13/8:ℝ)) ≤ 52*C*s^(-1/8:ℝ)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.generic_tridiagonal_quadratic
statement:
lemma generic_tridiagonal_quadratic (n : ℕ) (d b u : ℕ → ℝ) :
    (∑ i : Fin (n+1), ∑ j : Fin (n+1),
      ((if i=j then d i.val else 0)+(if i.val+1=j.val then b i.val else 0)+
        (if j.val+1=i.val then b j.val else 0))*u j.val*u i.val) =
      (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n+1), d i*u i^2)+2*(∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, b i*u i*u (i+1))

    (∑ i, (s+orderedJacobiGaps n i)⁻¹^2) ≤ 4*(n+1:ℝ)/Real.sqrt s ∧
    |(∑ i, (s+orderedJacobiGaps n i)⁻¹)/(n+1)-semicircleResolvent s| ≤ 2/((n+1:ℝ)*s) ∧
    (∑ i, (s+orderedJacobiGaps n i)⁻¹) ≤ n+1

name: OAI.CriticalSK.resolvent_trace_transfer
statement:
lemma resolvent_trace_transfer {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (e lam : ι → ℝ)
    {A B C s₀ s D : ℝ} (he : ∀ i, 0 ≤ e i) (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hs₀ : 0 < s₀) (hs : s₀ ≤ s)
    (hclose : ∀ i, |lam i-(2-e i)| ≤ edgeError A B C s₀ (e i))
    (hsmall : A*s₀^(-5/8:ℝ)+B/s₀+C ≤ 1/2)
    (htrace : ∀ t : ℝ, s ≤ t → (∑ i, (t+e i)⁻¹^2) ≤ D / Real.sqrt t) :
    (∀ i, 0 < 2+s-lam i) ∧
    (∑ i, (2+s-lam i)⁻¹^2) ≤ 4*D/Real.sqrt s ∧
    |(∑ i, (2+s-lam i)⁻¹)-(∑ i, (s+e i)⁻¹)| ≤
      104*A*D*s^(-1/8:ℝ)+2*B*(D/Real.sqrt s)+2*C*(∑ i, (s+e i)⁻¹)

statement:

    (hh : 0 ≤ h) (hs : scaleEnergy (Nat.clog 8 (n+1)) 0 ≤ s) (hω : ω ∉ triBad n h)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.triSample_eigenvalue_good
statement:
lemma triSample_eigenvalue_good (n : ℕ) {ω : TriSample n} {h s : ℝ}
    (hh : 0 ≤ h) (hs : 0 < s) (hscale : scaleEnergy (Nat.clog 8 (n+1)) 0 ≤ s)
    (hsmall : formA n h*(3/8:ℝ)*s^(-5/8:ℝ)+formC n ≤ 1)
    (hω : ω ∉ triBad n h) (i : Fin (n+1)) :
    |sampleEigenvalues n ω i-(2-orderedJacobiGaps n i)| ≤
      edgeError (formA n h) (formB n) (formC n) s (orderedJacobiGaps n i)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.triSample_resolvent_good
statement:
lemma triSample_resolvent_good (n : ℕ) {ω : TriSample n} {h s₀ s : ℝ}
    (hh : 0 ≤ h) (hs₀ : 0 < s₀) (hs : s₀ ≤ s)
    (hscale : scaleEnergy (Nat.clog 8 (n+1)) 0 ≤ s₀)
    (hsmall : formA n h*s₀^(-5/8:ℝ)+formB n/s₀+formC n ≤ 1/2)
    (hspace : 2 ≤ (n+1:ℝ)*s₀*Real.sqrt s₀)
    (hω : ω ∉ triBad n h) :
    (∀ i, 0 < 2+s-sampleEigenvalues n ω i) ∧
    (∑ i, (2+s-sampleEigenvalues n ω i)⁻¹^2)/(n+1) ≤ 16/Real.sqrt s ∧
    |(∑ i, (2+s-sampleEigenvalues n ω i)⁻¹)/(n+1)-semicircleResolvent s| ≤
      416*formA n h*s^(-1/8:ℝ)+8*formB n/Real.sqrt s+2*formC n+2/((n+1:ℝ)*s)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.gaussian_div_sqrt_preserving

    (hV : ∀ x, diagonalEnergy (matrixOrderedEigenvalues A) (V x) = inner ℝ x (gaussianMatrixCLM A x))
    (U : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ) (x : Spin n) :
    hamiltonian (matrixDisorder (matrixOfGaussian (haarConjugate U A))) x =
      (1/2:ℝ)*diagonalEnergy (matrixOrderedEigenvalues A)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.spectralGood_relative_trace

    (∑ i, (2+s-lam i)⁻¹^2)/(n+1) ≤ 16/Real.sqrt s ∧
    |(∑ i, (2+s-lam i)⁻¹)/(n+1)-semicircleResolvent s| ≤

lemma cavity_max_tail_zero : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (disorderLaw (n+4)).real
    {W | ∃ i, (n+4:ℝ)^(1/100:ℝ) ≤ cavityNormalization W i}) atTop (𝓝 0)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.cavity_overlap_rate_eventually
statement:
lemma cavity_overlap_rate_eventually : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop,
    2*((n+4:ℝ)^(1/100:ℝ))^2*((n+4:ℝ)^(-3/5:ℝ)+(n+4:ℝ)⁻¹^2) ≤ (n+4:ℝ)^(-1/2:ℝ)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.cavity_tail
statement:
lemma cavity_tail (i : Fin n) {b : ℝ} (hb : 0 < b) (m : ℕ) :
    (disorderLaw n).real {W | b ≤ cavityNormalization W i} ≤ 2*Real.exp ((m:ℝ)^2/2)/b^m

name: OAI.CriticalSK.deleteDisorder_continuous
statement: lemma deleteDisorder_continuous (i : Fin n) : Continuous (fun W : Disorder n => deleteDisorder W i)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.dirichlet_linear_continuous
statement: lemma dirichlet_linear_continuous (a : Fin n → ℝ) : Continuous (fun W : Disorder n => dirichlet W (linearObservable a))

name: OAI.CriticalSK.incident_scaled_product
statement:
lemma incident_scaled_product (i : Fin n) (x y : Spin n) :
    (n:ℝ)⁻¹*(∑ e : Incident i, incidentCoeff i x e.val*incidentCoeff i y e.val) = cavityOverlapCoord i x y

name: OAI.CriticalSK.incident_variance_bound
statement: lemma incident_variance_bound (i : Fin n) : (n:ℝ)⁻¹*((n:ℝ)-1) ≤ 1

name: OAI.CriticalSK.linearRayleigh_eq_iSup
statement:
lemma linearRayleigh_eq_iSup (W : Disorder n) : linearRayleigh W =
    ⨆ a : {a : Fin n → ℝ // a ≠ 0}, variance W (linearObservable a.val)/dirichlet W (linearObservable a.val)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.linearRayleigh_measurable
statement: lemma linearRayleigh_measurable (n : ℕ) : Measurable (linearRayleigh (n := n))

name: OAI.CriticalSK.linearRayleigh_smallBall
statement:
lemma linearRayleigh_smallBall (a : Fin n → ℝ) (ha : ∑ i, a i^2 = 1) {b : ℝ} (hb : 0 ≤ b) :
    b^2*(1-linearSmallBall W a b) ≤ linearRayleigh W

name: OAI.CriticalSK.linearRayleigh_split_bound
statement:
lemma linearRayleigh_split_bound (hn : 0 < n) (A : Finset (Fin n)) {B K : ℝ}
    (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hK : 0 ≤ K) (hzG : ∀ i ∈ A, cavityNormalization W i ≤ B)
    (hzB : ∀ i ∈ Aᶜ, cavityNormalization W i ≤ K) :
    linearRayleigh W ≤ 2*B^2*covarianceNorm W+2*(Aᶜ.card:ℝ)*K^2

name: OAI.CriticalSK.linear_dirichlet_coeff_bound
statement:
lemma linear_dirichlet_coeff_bound (A : Finset (Fin n)) (a : Fin n → ℝ) {B : ℝ} (_hB : 0 ≤ B)
    (hz : ∀ i ∈ A, cavityNormalization W i ≤ B) :
    (∑ i ∈ A, a i^2) ≤ B^2*dirichlet W (linearObservable a)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.linear_ratio_continuous
statement:
lemma linear_ratio_continuous (a : Fin n → ℝ) (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    Continuous (fun W : Disorder n => variance W (linearObservable a)/dirichlet W (linearObservable a))

name: OAI.CriticalSK.linear_ratio_global_bound
statement:
lemma linear_ratio_global_bound (a : Fin n → ℝ) (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    variance W (linearObservable a)/dirichlet W (linearObservable a) ≤
      covarianceNorm W*(∑ i : Fin n, cavityNormalization W i)^2

name: OAI.CriticalSK.linear_ratio_le
statement:
lemma linear_ratio_le (a : Fin n → ℝ) (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    variance W (linearObservable a)/dirichlet W (linearObservable a) ≤ linearRayleigh W

name: OAI.CriticalSK.linear_ratios_nonempty
statement: lemma linear_ratios_nonempty (hn : 0 < n) : Set.Nonempty {r : ℝ | ∃ a : Fin n → ℝ, a ≠ 0 ∧ r = variance W (linearObservable a)/dirichlet W (linearObservable a)}

name: OAI.CriticalSK.localField_continuous
statement: lemma localField_continuous (i : Fin n) (x : Spin n) : Continuous (fun W : Disorder n => localField W i x)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.probability_intersection_tendsto_one
statement:
lemma probability_intersection_tendsto_one {X : ℕ → Type*} [∀ n, MeasurableSpace (X n)]
    (μ : ∀ n, Measure (X n)) [∀ n, IsProbabilityMeasure (μ n)]
    (A B : ∀ n, Set (X n)) (_hA : ∀ n, MeasurableSet (A n)) (hB : ∀ n, MeasurableSet (B n))
    (hpA : Tendsto (fun n => (μ n).real (A n)) atTop (𝓝 1))
    (hpB : Tendsto (fun n => (μ n).real (B n)) atTop (𝓝 1)) :
    Tendsto (fun n => (μ n).real (A n ∩ B n)) atTop (𝓝 1)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.rayleigh_cavity_good_bound
statement:
lemma rayleigh_cavity_good_bound (n : ℕ) (W : Disorder (n+4))
    (hrate : 2*((n+4:ℝ)^(1/100:ℝ))^2*((n+4:ℝ)^(-3/5:ℝ)+(n+4:ℝ)⁻¹^2) ≤ (n+4:ℝ)^(-1/2:ℝ))
    (herr : (n+4:ℝ)^(3/5:ℝ)*((n+4:ℝ)^(1/100:ℝ))^2 ≤ (n+4:ℝ)^(2/3:ℝ))
    (hZ : ∀ i, cavityNormalization W i < (n+4:ℝ)^(1/100:ℝ))
    (hQ : gibbsOverlap W < (n+4:ℝ)^(-3/5:ℝ))
    (hC : cavityClippedCount W ((n+4:ℝ)^(-1/2:ℝ)) < (n+4:ℝ)^(3/5:ℝ)) :
    linearRayleigh W ≤ 2*(Real.exp 1+1)^2*covarianceNorm W+2*(n+4:ℝ)^(2/3:ℝ)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.rayleigh_error_rate_eventually
statement:
lemma rayleigh_error_rate_eventually : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop,
    (n+4:ℝ)^(3/5:ℝ)*((n+4:ℝ)^(1/100:ℝ))^2 ≤ (n+4:ℝ)^(2/3:ℝ)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.rayleigh_error_rate_identity
statement:
lemma rayleigh_error_rate_identity {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) :
    (x^(3/5:ℝ)*(x^(1/100:ℝ))^2)/x^(2/3:ℝ) = x^(-7/150:ℝ)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.restrictCoeff_linear
statement:
lemma restrictCoeff_linear (A : Finset (Fin n)) (a : Fin n → ℝ) (x : Spin n) :

name: OAI.CriticalSK.restrictCoeff_sum_sq
statement:
lemma restrictCoeff_sum_sq (A : Finset (Fin n)) (a : Fin n → ℝ) :
    (∑ i : Fin n, restrictCoeff A a i^2) = ∑ i ∈ A, a i^2

name: OAI.CriticalSK.shift_rpow_neg_tendsto

name: OAI.CriticalSK.variance_linear_nonneg

name: OAI.CriticalSK.variance_linear_norm_bound
statement: lemma variance_linear_norm_bound (a : Fin n → ℝ) : variance W (linearObservable a) ≤ covarianceNorm W*(∑ i, a i^2)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.variance_linear_split_bound
statement:
lemma variance_linear_split_bound (A : Finset (Fin n)) (a : Fin n → ℝ) {B K : ℝ}
    (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hK : 0 ≤ K) (hzG : ∀ i ∈ A, cavityNormalization W i ≤ B)

    (a-b)^2/2 ≤ Real.binEntropy ((a+b)/2)-

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FiniteEntropy.binEntropy_bits_le_three_sqrt
statement:
theorem binEntropy_bits_le_three_sqrt {q : ℝ} (hq : 0 ≤ q) (hq1 : q ≤ 1) :
    Real.binEntropy q / Real.log 2 ≤ 3 * Real.sqrt q

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FiniteEntropy.conditionalEntropy_chain
statement:
theorem conditionalEntropy_chain {α : Type uα} {β : Type uβ} {γ : Type uγ} {δ : Type uδ}
    [DecidableEq β] [DecidableEq γ] [DecidableEq δ]
    (s : Finset α) (p : α → ℝ) (f : α → β) (g : α → γ) (h : α → δ)
    (hp : ∀ a ∈ s, 0 ≤ p a) :
    conditionalEntropy s p (fun a => (f a, g a)) h =
      conditionalEntropy s p g h + conditionalEntropy s p f (fun a => (g a, h a))

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FiniteEntropy.conditionalEntropy_condition_le
statement:
theorem conditionalEntropy_condition_le {α : Type uα} {β : Type uβ} {γ : Type uγ} {δ : Type uδ}
    [DecidableEq β] [DecidableEq γ] [DecidableEq δ]
    (s : Finset α) (p : α → ℝ) (f : α → β) (g : α → γ) (h : α → δ)
    (hp : ∀ x ∈ s, 0 ≤ p x) :
    conditionalEntropy s p f (fun x => (h x,g x)) ≤ conditionalEntropy s p f g

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FiniteEntropy.conditionalEntropy_condition_swap
statement:
theorem conditionalEntropy_condition_swap {α : Type uα} {β : Type uβ} {γ : Type uγ} {δ : Type uδ}
    [DecidableEq β] [DecidableEq γ] [DecidableEq δ]
    [Nonempty β] [Nonempty γ] [Nonempty δ]
    (s : Finset α) (p : α → ℝ) (f : α → β) (g : α → γ) (h : α → δ)
    (hp : ∀ x ∈ s, 0 ≤ p x) :
    conditionalEntropy s p f (fun x => (g x,h x)) =
      conditionalEntropy s p f (fun x => (h x,g x))

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FiniteEntropy.conditionalEntropy_disintegrate
statement:
theorem conditionalEntropy_disintegrate {α : Type uα} {β : Type uβ} {γ : Type uγ} {δ : Type uδ}
    [DecidableEq β] [DecidableEq γ] [DecidableEq δ]
    (s : Finset α) (p : α → ℝ) (f : α → β) (g : α → γ) (h : α → δ)
    (hp : ∀ x ∈ s, 0 ≤ p x) :
    conditionalEntropy s p f (fun x => (h x,g x)) =
      ∑ c ∈ s.image g, mass s p g c * conditionalEntropy
        (s.filter (fun x => g x = c)) (fun x => p x / mass s p g c) f h

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FiniteEntropy.conditionalEntropy_eq_of_fibers
statement:
theorem conditionalEntropy_eq_of_fibers {α : Type uα} {β : Type uβ} {γ : Type uγ} {δ : Type uδ}
    [DecidableEq β] [DecidableEq γ] [DecidableEq δ]
    [Nonempty β] [Nonempty γ] [Nonempty δ]
    (s : Finset α) (p : α → ℝ) (f : α → β) (g : α → γ) (h : α → δ)
    (hp : ∀ x ∈ s, 0 ≤ p x)
    (hfg : ∀ x ∈ s, ∀ y ∈ s, f x = f y ↔ g x = g y) :
    conditionalEntropy s p f h = conditionalEntropy s p g h

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FiniteEntropy.conditionalEntropy_eq_sum
statement:
theorem conditionalEntropy_eq_sum {α : Type uα} {β : Type uβ} {γ : Type uγ} [DecidableEq β] [DecidableEq γ]
    (s : Finset α) (p : α → ℝ) (f : α → β) (g : α → γ)
    (hp : ∀ a ∈ s, 0 ≤ p a) :
    conditionalEntropy s p f g = ∑ c ∈ s.image g, mass s p g c *
      observableEntropy (s.filter (fun a => g a = c)) (fun a => p a / mass s p g c) f

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FiniteEntropy.conditionalEntropy_id
statement:
theorem conditionalEntropy_id {α : Type uα} {β : Type uβ} [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β]
    (s : Finset α) (p : α → ℝ) (g : α → β) (hp : ∀ a ∈ s, 0 ≤ p a) :
    conditionalEntropy s p id g = entropy s p-observableEntropy s p g

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FiniteEntropy.conditionalEntropy_le
statement:
theorem conditionalEntropy_le {α : Type uα} {β : Type uβ} {γ : Type uγ} [DecidableEq β] [DecidableEq γ]
    (s : Finset α) (p : α → ℝ) (f : α → β) (g : α → γ)
    (hp : ∀ a ∈ s, 0 ≤ p a) (hp1 : ∑ a ∈ s, p a = 1) :
    conditionalEntropy s p f g ≤ observableEntropy s p f

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FiniteEntropy.conditionalEntropy_le_bad_mass
statement:
theorem conditionalEntropy_le_bad_mass {α : Type uα} {β : Type uβ} {γ : Type uγ}
    [DecidableEq β] [DecidableEq γ]
    (s : Finset α) (p : α → ℝ) (f : α → β) (g : α → γ)
    (bad : γ → Prop) [DecidablePred bad] (hp : ∀ a ∈ s, 0 ≤ p a)
    (hgood : ∀ a ∈ s, ∀ b ∈ s, g a = g b → ¬bad (g a) → f a = f b) :
    conditionalEntropy s p f g ≤
      (∑ a ∈ s, if bad (g a) then p a else 0) * Real.log (s.image f).card

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FiniteEntropy.conditionalEntropy_midpoint
statement:
theorem conditionalEntropy_midpoint {α : Type uα} {β : Type uβ} {γ : Type uγ} [DecidableEq β] [DecidableEq γ]
    (s : Finset α) (p q : α → ℝ) (hp : ∀ a∈s, 0 ≤ p a) (hq : ∀ a∈s, 0 ≤ q a)
    (hp1 : ∑a∈s, p a=1) (hq1 : ∑a∈s, q a=1) (f : α → β) (g : α → γ) :
    (conditionalEntropy s p f g+conditionalEntropy s q f g)/2 ≤
      conditionalEntropy s (fun a => (p a+q a)/2) f g

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FiniteEntropy.conditionalEntropy_mixture
statement:
theorem conditionalEntropy_mixture {ι : Type uι} {α : Type uα} {β : Type uβ} {γ : Type uγ}
    [DecidableEq ι] [DecidableEq β] [DecidableEq γ]
    (t : Finset ι) (s : Finset α) (w : ι → ℝ) (p : ι → α → ℝ) (f : α → β) (g : α → γ)
    (hw : ∀ i ∈ t, 0 ≤ w i) (hp : ∀ i ∈ t, ∀ a ∈ s, 0 ≤ p i a)
    (hp1 : ∀ i ∈ t, ∑ a ∈ s, p i a = 1) :
    (∑ i ∈ t, w i*conditionalEntropy s (p i) f g) ≤
      conditionalEntropy s (fun a => ∑ i ∈ t, w i*p i a) f g

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FiniteEntropy.conditionalEntropy_mixture_general
statement:
theorem conditionalEntropy_mixture_general {ι : Type uι} {α : Type uα} {β : Type uβ} {γ : Type uγ}
    [DecidableEq ι] [DecidableEq β] [DecidableEq γ]
    (t : Finset ι) (s : Finset α) (w : ι → ℝ) (p : ι → α → ℝ) (f : α → β) (g : α → γ)
    (hw : ∀ i ∈ t, 0 ≤ w i) (hp : ∀ i ∈ t, ∀ a ∈ s, 0 ≤ p i a)
    :
    (∑ i ∈ t, w i*conditionalEntropy s (p i) f g) ≤
      conditionalEntropy s (fun a => ∑ i ∈ t, w i*p i a) f g

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FiniteEntropy.conditionalEntropy_mono
statement:
theorem conditionalEntropy_mono {α : Type uα} {β : Type uβ} {γ : Type uγ} [DecidableEq β] [DecidableEq γ]
    (s : Finset α) (p q : α → ℝ) (f : α → β) (g : α → γ)
    (hp : ∀ a ∈ s, 0 ≤ p a) (hpq : ∀ a ∈ s, p a ≤ q a) :
    conditionalEntropy s p f g ≤ conditionalEntropy s q f g

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FiniteEntropy.conditionalEntropy_nonneg
statement:
theorem conditionalEntropy_nonneg {α : Type uα} {β : Type uβ} {γ : Type uγ} [DecidableEq β] [DecidableEq γ]
    (s : Finset α) (p : α → ℝ) (f : α → β) (g : α → γ)
    (hp : ∀ a ∈ s, 0 ≤ p a) : 0 ≤ conditionalEntropy s p f g

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FiniteEntropy.conditionalEntropy_rare_flag
statement:
theorem conditionalEntropy_rare_flag {α : Type uα} {β : Type uβ} {γ : Type uγ}
    [DecidableEq β] [DecidableEq γ]
    (s : Finset α) (p : α → ℝ) (C : α → β) (Y : α → γ) (E : α → Bool)
    (B : γ → Prop) [DecidablePred B] (c₀ : β)
    (hp : ∀ a ∈ s, 0 ≤ p a) (hp1 : ∑ a ∈ s, p a = 1)
    (hgood : ∀ a ∈ s, E a = false → ¬B (Y a) → C a = c₀) :
    conditionalEntropy s p C Y ≤ Real.binEntropy (mass s p E true) +
      (mass s p E true + ∑ a ∈ s.filter (fun a => B (Y a)), p a) *
        Real.log (s.image C).card

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FiniteEntropy.conditionalEntropy_reveal_le
statement:
theorem conditionalEntropy_reveal_le {α : Type uα} {β : Type uβ} {γ : Type uγ} {δ : Type uδ}
    [DecidableEq β] [DecidableEq γ] [DecidableEq δ]
    (s : Finset α) (p : α → ℝ) (f : α → β) (g : α → γ) (h : α → δ)
    (hp : ∀ a ∈ s, 0 ≤ p a) (hp1 : ∑ a ∈ s, p a = 1) :
    conditionalEntropy s p f h ≤ observableEntropy s p g +
      conditionalEntropy s p f (fun a => (g a, h a))

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FiniteEntropy.entropy_chain
statement:
theorem entropy_chain {α : Type uα} {β : Type uβ} [DecidableEq β] (s : Finset α) (p : α → ℝ)
    (f : α → β) (hp : ∀ a ∈ s, 0 ≤ p a) :
    entropy s p = observableEntropy s p f +
      ∑ b ∈ s.image f, mass s p f b *
        entropy (s.filter (fun a => f a = b)) (fun a => p a / mass s p f b)

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FiniteEntropy.entropy_joint_le
statement:
theorem entropy_joint_le {α : Type uα} {β : Type uβ} (s : Finset α) (t : Finset β)
    (p : α → β → ℝ) (hp : ∀ a ∈ s, ∀ b ∈ t, 0 ≤ p a b)
    (hp1 : ∑ a ∈ s, ∑ b ∈ t, p a b = 1) :
    entropy (s ×ˢ t) (fun ab => p ab.1 ab.2) ≤
      entropy s (fun a => ∑ b ∈ t, p a b) + entropy t (fun b => ∑ a ∈ s, p a b)

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FiniteEntropy.entropy_le_log_card
statement:
theorem entropy_le_log_card {α : Type uα} (s : Finset α) (p : α → ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ a ∈ s, 0 ≤ p a) (hs : ∑ a ∈ s, p a = 1) :
    entropy s p ≤ Real.log s.card

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FiniteEntropy.entropy_mixture
statement:
theorem entropy_mixture {α : Type uα} {β : Type uβ} (s : Finset α) (t : Finset β)
    (w : β → ℝ) (p : β → α → ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ b ∈ t, 0 ≤ w b) (hw1 : ∑ b ∈ t, w b = 1)
    (hp : ∀ b ∈ t, ∀ a ∈ s, 0 ≤ p b a) :
    ∑ b ∈ t, w b * entropy s (p b) ≤
      entropy s (fun a => ∑ b ∈ t, w b * p b a)

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FiniteEntropy.entropy_nonneg
statement:
theorem entropy_nonneg {α : Type uα} (s : Finset α) (p : α → ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ a ∈ s, 0 ≤ p a) (hp1 : ∀ a ∈ s, p a ≤ 1) : 0 ≤ entropy s p

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FiniteEntropy.entropy_normalize
statement:
theorem entropy_normalize {α : Type uα} (s : Finset α) (p : α → ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ a ∈ s, 0 ≤ p a) :
    entropy s p = Real.negMulLog (∑ a ∈ s, p a) +
      (∑ a ∈ s, p a) * entropy s (fun a => p a / ∑ b ∈ s, p b)

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FiniteEntropy.entropy_product
statement:
theorem entropy_product {α : Type uα} {β : Type uβ} (s : Finset α) (t : Finset β)
    (p : α → ℝ) (q : β → ℝ) (hp : ∑ a ∈ s, p a = 1) (hq : ∑ b ∈ t, q b = 1) :
    entropy (s ×ˢ t) (fun ab => p ab.1 * q ab.2) = entropy s p + entropy t q

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FiniteEntropy.entropy_scale
statement:
theorem entropy_scale {α : Type uα} (s : Finset α) (p : α → ℝ) (c : ℝ) :
    entropy s (fun a => c * p a) =
      (∑ a ∈ s, p a) * Real.negMulLog c + c * entropy s p

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FiniteEntropy.entropy_table_chain
statement:
theorem entropy_table_chain {α : Type uα} {β : Type uβ} (s : Finset α) (t : Finset β)
    (p : α → β → ℝ) (hp : ∀ a ∈ s, ∀ b ∈ t, 0 ≤ p a b) :
    entropy (s ×ˢ t) (fun ab => p ab.1 ab.2) =
      entropy s (fun a => ∑ b ∈ t, p a b) +
      ∑ a ∈ s, (∑ b ∈ t, p a b) * entropy t (fun b => p a b / ∑ c ∈ t, p a c)

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FiniteEntropy.event_sq_le_two_js
statement:
theorem event_sq_le_two_js {α : Type uα} [DecidableEq α]
    (s : Finset α) (p q : α → ℝ) (hp : ∀ a∈s, 0 ≤ p a) (hq : ∀ a∈s, 0 ≤ q a)
    (hp1 : ∑a∈s, p a=1) (hq1 : ∑a∈s, q a=1) (f : α → Bool) :
    (mass s p f true-mass s q f true)^2 ≤ 2*js s p q

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FiniteEntropy.event_union_bound
statement:
theorem event_union_bound {α : Type uα} {ι : Type uι} [Fintype ι]
    (s : Finset α) (p : α → ℝ) (E : ι → α → Prop)
    [∀ i, DecidablePred (E i)] (hp : ∀ a ∈ s, 0 ≤ p a) :
    (∑ a ∈ s, if ∃ i, E i a then p a else 0) ≤
      ∑ i, ∑ a ∈ s, if E i a then p a else 0

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FiniteEntropy.js_le_tv
statement:
theorem js_le_tv {α : Type uα} [DecidableEq α]
    (s : Finset α) (p q : α → ℝ) (hp : ∀ a∈s, 0 ≤ p a) (hq : ∀ a∈s, 0 ≤ q a)
    (hp1 : ∑a∈s, p a=1) (hq1 : ∑a∈s, q a=1) :
    js s p q ≤ totalVariation s p q*Real.log 2

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FiniteEntropy.js_nonneg
statement:
theorem js_nonneg {α : Type uα} [DecidableEq α]
    (s : Finset α) (p q : α → ℝ) (hp : ∀ a∈s, 0 ≤ p a) (hq : ∀ a∈s, 0 ≤ q a)
    (hp1 : ∑a∈s, p a=1) (hq1 : ∑a∈s, q a=1) : 0 ≤ js s p q

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FiniteEntropy.js_observable_le
statement:
theorem js_observable_le {α : Type uα} {β : Type uβ} [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β]
    (s : Finset α) (p q : α → ℝ) (hp : ∀ a∈s, 0 ≤ p a) (hq : ∀ a∈s, 0 ≤ q a)
    (hp1 : ∑a∈s, p a=1) (hq1 : ∑a∈s, q a=1) (g : α → β) :
    observableEntropy s (fun a => (p a+q a)/2) g-
      (observableEntropy s p g+observableEntropy s q g)/2 ≤ js s p q

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FiniteEntropy.mass_comp
statement:
theorem mass_comp {α : Type uα} {β : Type uβ} {γ : Type uγ} [DecidableEq β] [DecidableEq γ]
    (s : Finset α) (p : α → ℝ) (f : α → β) (g : β → γ) (c : γ) :
    mass (s.image f) (mass s p f) g c = mass s p (g ∘ f) c

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FiniteEntropy.mass_eq_zero_of_not_mem
statement:
theorem mass_eq_zero_of_not_mem {α : Type uα} {β : Type uβ} [DecidableEq β] (s : Finset α)
    (p : α → ℝ) (f : α → β) {b : β} (hb : b ∉ s.image f) : mass s p f b = 0

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FiniteEntropy.mass_filter_div
statement:
theorem mass_filter_div {α : Type uα} {β : Type uβ} {γ : Type uγ} [DecidableEq β] [DecidableEq γ]
    (s : Finset α) (p : α → ℝ) (f : α → β) (g : α → γ) (c : γ) (b : β) (P : ℝ) :
    mass (s.filter (fun a => g a = c)) (fun a => p a / P) f b =
      mass s p (fun a => (g a, f a)) (c, b) / P

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FiniteEntropy.mass_nonneg
statement:
theorem mass_nonneg {α : Type uα} {β : Type uβ} [DecidableEq β] (s : Finset α) (p : α → ℝ)
    (f : α → β) (hp : ∀ a ∈ s, 0 ≤ p a) (b : β) : 0 ≤ mass s p f b

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FiniteEntropy.mass_pair_fst
statement:
theorem mass_pair_fst {α : Type uα} {β : Type uβ} {γ : Type uγ} [DecidableEq β] [DecidableEq γ]
    (s : Finset α) (p : α → ℝ) (f : α → β) (g : α → γ) (b : β) :
    ∑ c ∈ s.image g, mass s p (fun a => (f a, g a)) (b, c) = mass s p f b

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FiniteEntropy.mass_pair_snd
statement:
theorem mass_pair_snd {α : Type uα} {β : Type uβ} {γ : Type uγ} [DecidableEq β] [DecidableEq γ]
    (s : Finset α) (p : α → ℝ) (f : α → β) (g : α → γ) (c : γ) :
    ∑ b ∈ s.image f, mass s p (fun a => (f a, g a)) (b, c) = mass s p g c

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FiniteEntropy.mass_subset
OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FiniteEntropy.mass_sum
statement:
theorem mass_sum {α : Type uα} {β : Type uβ} [DecidableEq β] (s : Finset α) (p : α → ℝ) (f : α → β) :
    ∑ b ∈ s.image f, mass s p f b = ∑ a ∈ s, p a

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FiniteEntropy.mixture_information_common
statement:
theorem mixture_information_common {ι : Type uι} {α : Type uα} [DecidableEq ι] [DecidableEq α]
    (t : Finset ι) (s : Finset α) (w : ι → ℝ) (p : ι → α → ℝ) (r : α → ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ i ∈ t, 0 ≤ w i) (hw1 : ∑ i ∈ t, w i=1)
    (hp1 : ∀ i ∈ t, ∑ a ∈ s, p i a=1)
    (hr : ∀ a ∈ s, 0 ≤ r a) (hrp : ∀ i ∈ t, ∀ a ∈ s, r a ≤ p i a) :
    entropy s (fun a => ∑ i ∈ t, w i*p i a) - (∑ i ∈ t, w i*entropy s (p i)) ≤
      (1-∑ a ∈ s, r a)*entropy t w

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FiniteEntropy.negMulLog_sum_le
statement:
theorem negMulLog_sum_le {α : Type uα} (s : Finset α) (p : α → ℝ)

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FiniteEntropy.no_large_coordinate
statement:
theorem no_large_coordinate {ι : Type uι} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FiniteEntropy.observableEntropy_bool
statement:
theorem observableEntropy_bool {α : Type uα} (s : Finset α) (p : α → ℝ)

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FiniteEntropy.observableEntropy_comp
statement:
theorem observableEntropy_comp {α : Type uα} {β : Type uβ} {γ : Type uγ} [DecidableEq β] [DecidableEq γ]

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FiniteEntropy.observableEntropy_comp_le
statement:
theorem observableEntropy_comp_le {α : Type uα} {β : Type uβ} {γ : Type uγ} [DecidableEq β] [DecidableEq γ]

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FiniteEntropy.observableEntropy_congr
statement:
theorem observableEntropy_congr {α : Type uα} {β : Type uβ} [DecidableEq β]

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FiniteEntropy.observableEntropy_const_of
statement:
theorem observableEntropy_const_of {α : Type uα} {β : Type uβ} [DecidableEq β]

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FiniteEntropy.observableEntropy_eq_of_fibers
statement:
theorem observableEntropy_eq_of_fibers {α : Type uα} {β : Type uβ} {γ : Type uγ}

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FiniteEntropy.observableEntropy_equiv
statement:
theorem observableEntropy_equiv {α : Type uα} {β : Type uβ} {γ : Type uγ} [DecidableEq β] [DecidableEq γ]

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FiniteEntropy.observableEntropy_fst_le
statement:
theorem observableEntropy_fst_le {α : Type uα} {β : Type uβ} {γ : Type uγ} [DecidableEq β] [DecidableEq γ]

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FiniteEntropy.observableEntropy_id
statement:
theorem observableEntropy_id {α : Type uα} [DecidableEq α]

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FiniteEntropy.observableEntropy_le
statement:
theorem observableEntropy_le {α : Type uα} {β : Type uβ} [DecidableEq β] (s : Finset α) (p : α → ℝ)

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FiniteEntropy.observableEntropy_le_log_on_superset
statement:
theorem observableEntropy_le_log_on_superset {α : Type uα} {β : Type uβ} [DecidableEq β]

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FiniteEntropy.observableEntropy_le_of_fibers
statement:
theorem observableEntropy_le_of_fibers {α : Type uα} {β : Type uβ} {γ : Type uγ}

    (s : Finset α) (p : α → ℝ) (f : α → β) (g : α → γ)

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FiniteEntropy.observableEntropy_mixture_joint
statement:
theorem observableEntropy_mixture_joint {ι : Type uι} {α : Type uα} {β : Type uβ} [DecidableEq ι] [DecidableEq β]
    (t : Finset ι) (s : Finset α) (w : ι → ℝ) (p : ι → α → ℝ) (f : α → β)
    (hp : ∀ i ∈ t, ∑ a ∈ s, p i a = 1) :
    observableEntropy (t ×ˢ s) (fun ia => w ia.1*p ia.1 ia.2) (fun ia => (ia.1,f ia.2)) =
      entropy t w + ∑ i ∈ t, w i*observableEntropy s (p i) f

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FiniteEntropy.observableEntropy_mixture_joint_general
statement:
theorem observableEntropy_mixture_joint_general {ι : Type uι} {α : Type uα} {β : Type uβ} [DecidableEq ι] [DecidableEq β]
    (t : Finset ι) (s : Finset α) (w : ι → ℝ) (p : ι → α → ℝ) (f : α → β) :
    observableEntropy (t ×ˢ s) (fun ia => w ia.1*p ia.1 ia.2) (fun ia => (ia.1,f ia.2)) =
      ∑ i ∈ t, ((∑ a ∈ s, p i a)*Real.negMulLog (w i)+
        w i*observableEntropy s (p i) f)

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FiniteEntropy.observableEntropy_mixture_marginal
statement:
theorem observableEntropy_mixture_marginal {ι : Type uι} {α : Type uα} {β : Type uβ} [DecidableEq β]
    (t : Finset ι) (s : Finset α) (w : ι → ℝ) (p : ι → α → ℝ) (f : α → β) :
    observableEntropy (t ×ˢ s) (fun ia => w ia.1*p ia.1 ia.2) (fun ia => f ia.2) =
      observableEntropy s (fun a => ∑ i ∈ t, w i*p i a) f

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FiniteEntropy.observableEntropy_of_injective
statement:
theorem observableEntropy_of_injective {α : Type uα} {β : Type uβ} [DecidableEq β] [Nonempty β]

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FiniteEntropy.observableEntropy_on_superset
statement:
theorem observableEntropy_on_superset {α : Type uα} {β : Type uβ} [DecidableEq β]

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FiniteEntropy.observableEntropy_pair_le
statement:
theorem observableEntropy_pair_le {α : Type uα} {β : Type uβ} {γ : Type uγ} [DecidableEq β] [DecidableEq γ]
    (s : Finset α) (p : α → ℝ) (f : α → β) (g : α → γ)
    (hp : ∀ a ∈ s, 0 ≤ p a) (hp1 : ∑ a ∈ s, p a = 1) :
    observableEntropy s p (fun a => (f a, g a)) ≤
      observableEntropy s p f + observableEntropy s p g

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FiniteEntropy.observableEntropy_subset
statement:
theorem observableEntropy_subset {α : Type uα} {β : Type uβ} [DecidableEq β] {s t : Finset α}

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FiniteEntropy.observableEntropy_swap
statement:
theorem observableEntropy_swap {α : Type uα} {β : Type uβ} {γ : Type uγ} [DecidableEq β] [DecidableEq γ]

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FiniteEntropy.pair_flag_cost
statement:
theorem pair_flag_cost {q t b : ℝ} (k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k)
    (hq : 0 ≤ q) (hq1 : q ≤ 1) (ht : 0 ≤ t)
    (hqt : q ≤ t) (hqt2 : q ≤ t ^ 2) (hbt : b ≤ t) :
    Real.binEntropy q / Real.log 2 + 3 * k * (q + b) ≤ 9 * k * t

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FiniteEntropy.sum_mass_mul
statement:
theorem sum_mass_mul {α : Type uα} {β : Type uβ} [DecidableEq β] (s : Finset α) (t : Finset β)

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FiniteEntropy.sum_min_eq_one_sub_tv
statement:
theorem sum_min_eq_one_sub_tv {α : Type uα} (s : Finset α) (p q : α → ℝ)

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FiniteEntropy.totalVariation_eq_event
statement:
theorem totalVariation_eq_event {α : Type uα} (s : Finset α) (p q : α → ℝ)
    (hp1 : ∑ a ∈ s, p a=1) (hq1 : ∑ a ∈ s, q a=1) :
    totalVariation s p q = mass s p (fun a => decide (q a ≤ p a)) true-
      mass s q (fun a => decide (q a ≤ p a)) true

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FiniteEntropy.totalVariation_sq_le_two_js
statement:
theorem totalVariation_sq_le_two_js {α : Type uα} [DecidableEq α]
    (s : Finset α) (p q : α → ℝ) (hp : ∀ a∈s, 0 ≤ p a) (hq : ∀ a∈s, 0 ≤ q a)
    (hp1 : ∑a∈s, p a=1) (hq1 : ∑a∈s, q a=1) :
    (totalVariation s p q)^2 ≤ 2*js s p q

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FiniteEntropy.totalVariation_triangle
statement:
theorem totalVariation_triangle {α : Type uα} (s : Finset α) (p q r : α → ℝ) :

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FiniteEntropy.two_exceptions_bound
statement:
theorem two_exceptions_bound {α : Type uα} {ι : Type uι} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (s : Finset α) (p : α → ℝ) (E : ι → α → Prop)
    [∀ i, DecidablePred (E i)] (hp : ∀ a ∈ s, 0 ≤ p a)
    (hind : ∀ i j, i ≠ j →
      (∑ a ∈ s, if E i a ∧ E j a then p a else 0) =
        (∑ a ∈ s, if E i a then p a else 0) *
        (∑ a ∈ s, if E j a then p a else 0)) :
    let t := ∑ i, ∑ a ∈ s, if E i a then p a else 0
    let q := ∑ a ∈ s, if ∃ i j, i ≠ j ∧ E i a ∧ E j a then p a else 0
    q ≤ t ^ 2 ∧ q ≤ t

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FiniteDistribution.js_map_le
statement:
theorem js_map_le {α : Type uα} {β : Type uβ} (p q : FiniteDistribution α) (f : α → β) :
    (p.map f).js (q.map f) ≤ p.js q

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FiniteDistribution.js_nonneg
statement: theorem js_nonneg {α : Type uα} (p q : FiniteDistribution α) : 0 ≤ p.js q

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FiniteDistribution.js_on
statement:
theorem js_on {α : Type uα} (p q : FiniteDistribution α) (s : Finset α)
    (hp : p.support ⊆ s) (hq : q.support ⊆ s) : p.js q=FiniteEntropy.js s p.weight q.weight

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FiniteDistribution.js_two_step_coarsen
statement:
theorem js_two_step_coarsen (p : FiniteDistribution ℤ) (f : ℤ → ℤ) :
    ((p.map f).js ((p.translate 2).map f))^2 ≤
      8*(Real.log 2)^2*p.js (p.translate 1)

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FiniteDistribution.map_translate_div_two
statement:
theorem map_translate_div_two (p : FiniteDistribution ℤ) :
    ((p.translate 2).map (fun n => n/2)).weight=
      ((p.map (fun n => n/2)).translate 1).weight

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FiniteDistribution.map_weight_comp
statement:
theorem map_weight_comp {α : Type uα} {β : Type uβ} {γ : Type uγ} (p : FiniteDistribution α) (f : α → β) (g : β → γ) :
    ((p.map f).map g).weight=(p.map (g ∘ f)).weight

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FiniteDistribution.map_weight_id
statement: theorem map_weight_id {α : Type uα} (p : FiniteDistribution α) : (p.map id).weight=p.weight

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FiniteDistribution.map_weight_of_injective
statement:
theorem map_weight_of_injective {α : Type uα} {β : Type uβ} (p : FiniteDistribution α)
    (f : α → β) (hf : Function.Injective f) (a : α) :
    (p.map f).weight (f a)=p.weight a

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FiniteDistribution.map_weight_on
statement:
theorem map_weight_on {α : Type uα} {β : Type uβ} (p : FiniteDistribution α) (f : α → β)
    (s : Finset α) (hs : p.support ⊆ s) (b : β) :
    (p.map f).weight b=FiniteEntropy.mass s p.weight f b

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FiniteDistribution.mix_map_entropy
statement:
theorem mix_map_entropy {α : Type uα} {β : Type uβ} (p q : FiniteDistribution α) (f : α → β)
    (s : Finset α) (hp : p.support ⊆ s) (hq : q.support ⊆ s) :
    ((p.map f).mix (q.map f)).entropy=
      FiniteEntropy.observableEntropy s (fun a => (p.weight a+q.weight a)/2) f

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FiniteDistribution.sum_on
statement:
theorem sum_on {α : Type uα} (p : FiniteDistribution α) (s : Finset α)
    (hs : p.support ⊆ s) : ∑ a ∈ s, p.weight a=1

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FiniteDistribution.translate_add
statement:
theorem translate_add (p : FiniteDistribution ℤ) (i j : ℤ) :
    ((p.translate i).translate j).weight=(p.translate (i+j)).weight

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FiniteDistribution.translate_weight
statement:
theorem translate_weight (p : FiniteDistribution ℤ) (j a : ℤ) :
    (p.translate j).weight a=p.weight (a-j)

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FiniteDistribution.tv_congr
statement:
theorem tv_congr {α : Type uα} (p q p' q' : FiniteDistribution α)
    (hp : p.weight=p'.weight) (hq : q.weight=q'.weight) : p.tv q=p'.tv q'

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FiniteDistribution.tv_le_one
statement: theorem tv_le_one {α : Type uα} (p q : FiniteDistribution α) : p.tv q ≤ 1

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FiniteDistribution.tv_map_injective
statement:
theorem tv_map_injective {α : Type uα} {β : Type uβ} (p q : FiniteDistribution α)
    (f : α → β) (hf : Function.Injective f) : (p.map f).tv (q.map f)=p.tv q

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FiniteDistribution.tv_map_le
statement:
theorem tv_map_le {α : Type uα} {β : Type uβ} (p q : FiniteDistribution α) (f : α → β) :

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FiniteDistribution.tv_nonneg
statement: theorem tv_nonneg {α : Type uα} (p q : FiniteDistribution α) : 0 ≤ p.tv q

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FiniteDistribution.tv_on
statement:
theorem tv_on {α : Type uα} (p q : FiniteDistribution α) (s : Finset α)
    (hp : p.support ⊆ s) (hq : q.support ⊆ s) : p.tv q=FiniteEntropy.totalVariation s p.weight q.weight

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FiniteDistribution.tv_sq_le_two_js
statement: theorem tv_sq_le_two_js {α : Type uα} (p q : FiniteDistribution α) : (p.tv q)^2 ≤ 2*p.js q

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FiniteDistribution.tv_translate
statement:
theorem tv_translate (p q : FiniteDistribution ℤ) (j : ℤ) :
    (p.translate j).tv (q.translate j)=p.tv q

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FiniteDistribution.tv_translate_two
statement:
theorem tv_translate_two (p : FiniteDistribution ℤ) :
    p.tv (p.translate 2) ≤ 2*p.tv (p.translate 1)

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FiniteDistribution.tv_triangle
statement: theorem tv_triangle {α : Type uα} (p q r : FiniteDistribution α) : p.tv r ≤ p.tv q+q.tv r

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.MeasureEntropy.CompactlyCarried.fairShift

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.MeasureEntropy.CompactlyCarried.mixture
statement:
theorem CompactlyCarried.mixture {ι : Type uι} [Fintype ι]
    (ν : ι → Measure ℝ) (hν : ∀ i, CompactlyCarried (ν i)) (w : ι → ℝ) :

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.MeasureEntropy.ae_label_reflect
statement:

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.MeasureEntropy.averaged_affine
statement:
theorem averaged_affine (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (hμ : CompactlyCarried μ) {s a : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) (ha : a ≠ 0) (b : ℝ) :

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.MeasureEntropy.averaged_eq_intervalIntegral
statement:
theorem averaged_eq_intervalIntegral (μ : Measure ℝ) (s : ℝ) :

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.MeasureEntropy.averaged_fairShift
statement:
theorem averaged_fairShift (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.MeasureEntropy.averaged_grid_nsmul
statement:
theorem averaged_grid_nsmul (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (hμ : CompactlyCarried μ) {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) :
    (∫ u in (0 : ℝ)..1, grid μ s ((N : ℝ)*u)) = averaged μ s

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.MeasureEntropy.averaged_le_averaged_add_log_ratio
statement:
theorem averaged_le_averaged_add_log_ratio (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (hμ : CompactlyCarried μ) {s t : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) (ht : 0 < t) :
    averaged μ s ≤ averaged μ t + Real.log (t/s+2)

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.MeasureEntropy.averaged_le_averaged_add_log_two
statement:
theorem averaged_le_averaged_add_log_two (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (hμ : CompactlyCarried μ) {s t : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) (ht : 0 < t) (hts : t ≤ s) :
    averaged μ s ≤ averaged μ t + Real.log 2

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.MeasureEntropy.averaged_nested_bounds
statement:
theorem averaged_nested_bounds (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (hμ : CompactlyCarried μ) {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) :
    0 ≤ averaged μ s-averaged μ ((N : ℝ)*s) ∧
      averaged μ s-averaged μ ((N : ℝ)*s) ≤ Real.log N

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.MeasureEntropy.averaged_nested_mixture
statement:
theorem averaged_nested_mixture {ι : Type uι} [Fintype ι]
    (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (hμ : CompactlyCarried μ)
    (ν : ι → Measure ℝ) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    (hν : ∀ i, CompactlyCarried (ν i)) (w : ι → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i)
    (hm : μ = ∑ i, ENNReal.ofReal (w i) • ν i)
    {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) :
    (∑ i, w i*(averaged (ν i) s-averaged (ν i) ((N : ℝ)*s))) ≤
      averaged μ s-averaged μ ((N : ℝ)*s)

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.MeasureEntropy.averaged_nested_translate_mixture
statement:
theorem averaged_nested_translate_mixture {ι : Type uι} [Fintype ι]
    (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (hμ : CompactlyCarried μ)
    (w : ι → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) (hw1 : ∑ i, w i=1) (b : ι → ℝ)
    {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) :
    averaged μ s-averaged μ ((N : ℝ)*s) ≤
      averaged (∑ i, ENNReal.ofReal (w i) • μ.map (fun x => x+b i)) s-
      averaged (∑ i, ENNReal.ofReal (w i) • μ.map (fun x => x+b i)) ((N : ℝ)*s)

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.MeasureEntropy.averaged_nonneg
statement:
theorem averaged_nonneg (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (s : ℝ) :

statement:
theorem averaged_reflect (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.MeasureEntropy.averaged_scale
statement:
theorem averaged_scale (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (hμ : CompactlyCarried μ) {s a : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) (ha : a ≠ 0) :

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.MeasureEntropy.averaged_scale_pos
statement:
theorem averaged_scale_pos (μ : Measure ℝ) {a s : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) :

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.MeasureEntropy.averaged_translate
statement:
theorem averaged_translate (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]

statement:
theorem deficit_bounds (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (hμ : CompactlyCarried μ) {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) :
    0 ≤ deficit μ s ∧ deficit μ s ≤ Real.log 2

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.MeasureEntropy.deficit_double_sq
statement:
theorem deficit_double_sq (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (hμ : CompactlyCarried μ) {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) :
    (deficit μ (2*s))^2 ≤ 8*(Real.log 2)^2*deficit μ s

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.MeasureEntropy.deficit_dyadic_tendsto_zero
statement:
theorem deficit_dyadic_tendsto_zero (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (hμ : CompactlyCarried μ) (v : ℕ → ℝ) (hv : ∀ n, 0 < v n)
    (h : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => deficit μ (v n)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)) (j : ℕ) :
    Filter.Tendsto (fun n => deficit μ ((2 : ℝ)^j*v n)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.MeasureEntropy.entropy_coarsening_mixture
statement:
theorem entropy_coarsening_mixture {ι : Type uι} {α : Type uα} {β : Type uβ} {γ : Type uγ} [Fintype ι]
    [MeasurableSpace α] [MeasurableSpace β] [MeasurableSingletonClass β]
    [DecidableEq β] [DecidableEq γ]
    (μ : Measure α) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (ν : ι → Measure α)
    [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)] (w : ι → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i)
    (hm : μ = ∑ i, ENNReal.ofReal (w i) • ν i)
    (f : α → β) (hf : Measurable f) (s : Finset β)
    (hs : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, f x ∈ s) (hsi : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ x ∂ν i, f x ∈ s) (g : β → γ) :
    (∑ i, w i*(entropy (ν i) f-entropy (ν i) (g ∘ f))) ≤
      entropy μ f-entropy μ (g ∘ f)

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.MeasureEntropy.entropy_comp
statement:
theorem entropy_comp {α : Type uα} {β : Type uβ} {γ : Type uγ} [MeasurableSpace α] [MeasurableSpace β]
    [MeasurableSingletonClass β] [DecidableEq γ]
    (μ : Measure α) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (f : α → β) (hf : Measurable f)
    (s : Finset β) (hs : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, f x ∈ s) (g : β → γ) :
    entropy μ (g ∘ f) = FiniteEntropy.observableEntropy s (mass μ f) g

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.MeasureEntropy.entropy_comp_injective
statement:
theorem entropy_comp_injective {α : Type uα} {β : Type uβ} {γ : Type uγ} [MeasurableSpace α] [MeasurableSpace β]
    [MeasurableSingletonClass β] [DecidableEq γ] [Nonempty β] [Nonempty γ]
    (μ : Measure α) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (f : α → β) (hf : Measurable f)
    (s : Finset β) (hs : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, f x ∈ s) (g : β → γ) (hg : Function.Injective g) :
    entropy μ (g ∘ f) = entropy μ f

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.MeasureEntropy.entropy_comp_le
statement:
theorem entropy_comp_le {α : Type uα} {β : Type uβ} {γ : Type uγ} [MeasurableSpace α] [MeasurableSpace β]
    [MeasurableSingletonClass β] [DecidableEq γ]
    (μ : Measure α) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (f : α → β) (hf : Measurable f)
    (s : Finset β) (hs : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, f x ∈ s) (g : β → γ) :
    entropy μ (g ∘ f) ≤ entropy μ f

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.MeasureEntropy.entropy_congr_ae
statement:
theorem entropy_congr_ae {α : Type uα} {β : Type uβ} [MeasurableSpace α]
    (μ : Measure α) {f g : α → β} (h : f =ᵐ[μ] g) : entropy μ f = entropy μ g

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.MeasureEntropy.entropy_eq_sum
statement:
theorem entropy_eq_sum {α : Type uα} {β : Type uβ} [MeasurableSpace α] (μ : Measure α)
    (f : α → β) (s : Finset β) (hs : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, f x ∈ s) :
    entropy μ f = ∑ b ∈ s, Real.negMulLog (mass μ f b)

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.MeasureEntropy.entropy_half_mass
statement:
theorem entropy_half_mass {α : Type uα} {β : Type uβ} [MeasurableSpace α] [MeasurableSpace β]
    [MeasurableSingletonClass β] (μ : Measure α) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (f : α → β) (hf : Measurable f) (a : Finset β) (ha : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, f x ∈ a) :
    (∑' b, Real.negMulLog (mass μ f b/2)) = entropy μ f/2+Real.log 2/2

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.MeasureEntropy.entropy_le_add_of_reconstruct
statement:
theorem entropy_le_add_of_reconstruct {α : Type uα} {β : Type uβ} {γ : Type uγ} {δ : Type uδ} [MeasurableSpace α]
    [MeasurableSpace β] [MeasurableSpace γ] [MeasurableSingletonClass β]
    [MeasurableSingletonClass γ] [DecidableEq β] [DecidableEq γ] [DecidableEq δ]
    (μ : Measure α) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (f : α → δ) (g : α → β) (h : α → γ)
    (hg : Measurable g) (hh : Measurable h) (s : Finset β) (t : Finset γ)
    (hs : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, g x ∈ s) (ht : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, h x ∈ t)
    (q : β × γ → δ) (hq : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, f x = q (g x,h x)) :
    entropy μ f ≤ entropy μ g + entropy μ h

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.MeasureEntropy.entropy_le_log_card
statement:
theorem entropy_le_log_card {α : Type uα} {β : Type uβ} [MeasurableSpace α] [MeasurableSpace β]
    [MeasurableSingletonClass β] (μ : Measure α) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (f : α → β) (hf : Measurable f) (s : Finset β) (hs : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, f x ∈ s) :
    entropy μ f ≤ Real.log s.card

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.MeasureEntropy.entropy_map
statement:
theorem entropy_map {α : Type uα} {β : Type uβ} {γ : Type uγ} [MeasurableSpace α] [MeasurableSpace β]
    [MeasurableSpace γ] [MeasurableSingletonClass γ]
    (μ : Measure α) (f : α → β) (hf : Measurable f) (g : β → γ) (hg : Measurable g) :
    entropy (μ.map f) g = entropy μ (g ∘ f)

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.MeasureEntropy.entropy_nonneg
statement:
theorem entropy_nonneg {α : Type uα} {β : Type uβ} [MeasurableSpace α] (μ : Measure α)
    [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (f : α → β) : 0 ≤ entropy μ f

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.MeasureEntropy.entropy_pair_le
statement:
theorem entropy_pair_le {α : Type uα} {β : Type uβ} {γ : Type uγ} [MeasurableSpace α] [MeasurableSpace β]
    [MeasurableSpace γ] [MeasurableSingletonClass β] [MeasurableSingletonClass γ]
    [DecidableEq β] [DecidableEq γ]
    (μ : Measure α) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (f : α → β) (hf : Measurable f)
    (g : α → γ) (hg : Measurable g) (s : Finset β) (t : Finset γ)
    (hs : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, f x ∈ s) (ht : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, g x ∈ t) :
    entropy μ (fun x => (f x,g x)) ≤ entropy μ f + entropy μ g

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.MeasureEntropy.entropy_summable
statement:
theorem entropy_summable {α : Type uα} {β : Type uβ} [MeasurableSpace α] (μ : Measure α)
    (f : α → β) (a : Finset β) (ha : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, f x ∈ a) :

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.MeasureEntropy.fairShift_probability

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.MeasureEntropy.gridDeficit_bounds
statement:
theorem gridDeficit_bounds (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.MeasureEntropy.gridDeficit_double_sq

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.MeasureEntropy.grid_fairShift

theorem grid_le_grid_add_log (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.MeasureEntropy.grid_le_grid_add_log_two
statement:
theorem grid_le_grid_add_log_two (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.MeasureEntropy.grid_nonneg

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.MeasureEntropy.grid_nsmul_intervalIntegrable
statement:
theorem grid_nsmul_intervalIntegrable (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (hμ : CompactlyCarried μ) {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) :
    IntervalIntegrable (fun u => grid μ s ((N : ℝ)*u)) volume 0 1

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.MeasureEntropy.grid_periodic
statement:
theorem grid_periodic (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (hμ : CompactlyCarried μ) {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) : Function.Periodic (grid μ s) 1

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.MeasureEntropy.grid_reflect_ae
statement:
theorem grid_reflect_ae (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (hμ : CompactlyCarried μ) {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) :
    (fun u => grid (μ.map Neg.neg) s (-u)) =ᵐ[volume] grid μ s

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.MeasureEntropy.grid_scale_pos
statement:
theorem grid_scale_pos (μ : Measure ℝ) {a s : ℝ} (_ha : 0 < a) (u : ℝ) :
    grid (μ.map (fun x => a*x)) s u = grid μ (s/a) u

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.MeasureEntropy.grid_translate
statement:
theorem grid_translate (μ : Measure ℝ) (s u b : ℝ) :
    grid (μ.map (fun x => x+b)) s u = grid μ s (u+b/s)

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.MeasureEntropy.integral_gridDeficit
statement:
theorem integral_gridDeficit (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (hμ : CompactlyCarried μ) {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) :
    (∫ u in Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, gridDeficit μ s u)=
      Real.log 2-(averaged μ s-averaged μ (2*s))

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.MeasureEntropy.integral_gridDeficit_double_shift
statement:
theorem integral_gridDeficit_double_shift (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (hμ : CompactlyCarried μ) {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) :
    (∫ u in Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, gridDeficit μ s (2*u))=deficit μ s

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.MeasureEntropy.label_add_scale
statement:
theorem label_add_scale {s : ℝ} (hs : s ≠ 0) (u x : ℝ) :
    label s u (x+s) = label s u x+1

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.MeasureEntropy.label_joint_measurable
statement: theorem label_joint_measurable (s : ℝ) : Measurable (fun ux : ℝ × ℝ => label s ux.1 ux.2)

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.MeasureEntropy.label_measurable
statement: theorem label_measurable (s u : ℝ) : Measurable (label s u)

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.MeasureEntropy.label_nested
statement:
theorem label_nested (s u x : ℝ) {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) :
    label ((N : ℝ)*s) u x = label s ((N : ℝ)*u) x / (N : ℤ)

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.MeasureEntropy.mass_comp
statement:
theorem mass_comp {α : Type uα} {β : Type uβ} {γ : Type uγ} [MeasurableSpace α] [MeasurableSpace β]
    [MeasurableSingletonClass β] [DecidableEq γ]
    (μ : Measure α) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (f : α → β) (hf : Measurable f)
    (s : Finset β) (hs : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, f x ∈ s) (g : β → γ) (c : γ) :
    mass μ (g ∘ f) c = FiniteEntropy.mass s (mass μ f) g c

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.MeasureEntropy.mass_eq_zero_of_ae
statement:
theorem mass_eq_zero_of_ae {α : Type uα} {β : Type uβ} [MeasurableSpace α] (μ : Measure α)
    (f : α → β) (s : Finset β) (hs : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, f x ∈ s) {b : β} (hb : b ∉ s) :
    mass μ f b = 0

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.MeasureEntropy.mass_fairShift
statement:
theorem mass_fairShift (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) (u : ℝ) (j : ℤ) :
    mass (fairShift μ s) (label s u) j =
      (mass μ (label s u) j+mass μ (label s u) (j-1))/2

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.MeasureEntropy.mass_fairShift_even
statement:
theorem mass_fairShift_even (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) (u : ℝ) (k : ℤ) :
    mass (fairShift μ s) (label s u) (2*k) =
      mass μ (label (2*s) ((u+1)/2)) k/2

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.MeasureEntropy.mass_fairShift_odd
statement:
theorem mass_fairShift_odd (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) (u : ℝ) (k : ℤ) :
    mass (fairShift μ s) (label s u) (2*k+1) =
      mass μ (label (2*s) (u/2)) k/2

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.MeasureEntropy.mass_int_div_two
statement:
theorem mass_int_div_two {α : Type uα} [MeasurableSpace α] (μ : Measure α)
    [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (f : α → ℤ) (hf : Measurable f) (k : ℤ) :
    mass μ (fun x => f x/2) k = mass μ f (2*k)+mass μ f (2*k+1)

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.MeasureEntropy.mass_le_one
statement:
theorem mass_le_one {α : Type uα} {β : Type uβ} [MeasurableSpace α] (μ : Measure α)
    [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (f : α → β) (b : β) : mass μ f b ≤ 1

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.MeasureEntropy.mass_map
statement:
theorem mass_map {α : Type uα} {β : Type uβ} {γ : Type uγ} [MeasurableSpace α] [MeasurableSpace β]
    [MeasurableSpace γ] [MeasurableSingletonClass γ]
    (μ : Measure α) (f : α → β) (hf : Measurable f) (g : β → γ) (hg : Measurable g) (c : γ) :
    mass (μ.map f) g c = mass μ (g ∘ f) c

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.MeasureEntropy.mass_mixture
statement:
theorem mass_mixture {ι : Type uι} {α : Type uα} {β : Type uβ} [Fintype ι] [MeasurableSpace α]
    (μ : Measure α) (ν : ι → Measure α) [∀ i, IsFiniteMeasure (ν i)] (w : ι → ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) (hm : μ = ∑ i, ENNReal.ofReal (w i) • ν i) (f : α → β) (b : β) :
    mass μ f b = ∑ i, w i*mass (ν i) f b

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.MeasureEntropy.mass_nested_two
statement:
theorem mass_nested_two (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (s u : ℝ) (k : ℤ) :
    mass μ (label (2*s) (u/2)) k =
      mass μ (label s u) (2*k)+mass μ (label s u) (2*k+1)

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.MeasureEntropy.mass_nonneg
statement:
theorem mass_nonneg {α : Type uα} {β : Type uβ} [MeasurableSpace α] (μ : Measure α)
    (f : α → β) (b : β) : 0 ≤ mass μ f b

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.MeasureEntropy.mass_sum
statement:
theorem mass_sum {α : Type uα} {β : Type uβ} [MeasurableSpace α] [MeasurableSpace β]
    [MeasurableSingletonClass β] (μ : Measure α) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (f : α → β) (hf : Measurable f) (s : Finset β) (hs : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, f x ∈ s) :
    ∑ b ∈ s, mass μ f b = 1

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.MeasureEntropy.mass_summable
statement:
theorem mass_summable {α : Type uα} {β : Type uβ} [MeasurableSpace α] (μ : Measure α)
    (f : α → β) (a : Finset β) (ha : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, f x ∈ a) :
    Summable (mass μ f)

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.MeasureEntropy.mass_tsum
statement:
theorem mass_tsum {α : Type uα} {β : Type uβ} [MeasurableSpace α] [MeasurableSpace β]
    [MeasurableSingletonClass β] (μ : Measure α) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (f : α → β) (hf : Measurable f) (a : Finset β) (ha : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, f x ∈ a) :
    ∑' b, mass μ f b = 1

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.MeasureEntropy.measurable_grid
statement:
theorem measurable_grid (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (s : ℝ) :
    Measurable (grid μ s)

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.MeasureEntropy.measurable_mass_label
statement:
theorem measurable_mass_label (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (s : ℝ) (b : ℤ) :
