name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.MeasureEntropy.mixture_probability
statement:
theorem mixture_probability {ι : Type uι} {α : Type uα} [Fintype ι] [MeasurableSpace α]
    (ν : ι → Measure α) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)] (w : ι → ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) (hw1 : ∑ i, w i=1) :
    IsProbabilityMeasure (∑ i, ENNReal.ofReal (w i) • ν i)

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.MeasureEntropy.nested_grid_bounds
statement:
theorem nested_grid_bounds (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (hμ : CompactlyCarried μ) {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) (u : ℝ) :
    0 ≤ grid μ s ((N : ℝ)*u)-grid μ ((N : ℝ)*s) u ∧
      grid μ s ((N : ℝ)*u)-grid μ ((N : ℝ)*s) u ≤ Real.log N

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.MeasureEntropy.nested_grid_mixture
statement:
theorem nested_grid_mixture {ι : Type uι} [Fintype ι]
    (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (hμ : CompactlyCarried μ)
    (ν : ι → Measure ℝ) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    (hν : ∀ i, CompactlyCarried (ν i)) (w : ι → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i)
    (hm : μ = ∑ i, ENNReal.ofReal (w i) • ν i)
    {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) (u : ℝ) :
    (∑ i, w i*(grid (ν i) s ((N : ℝ)*u)-grid (ν i) ((N : ℝ)*s) u)) ≤
      grid μ s ((N : ℝ)*u)-grid μ ((N : ℝ)*s) u

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.MeasureEntropy.relativeLabel_measurable
statement: theorem relativeLabel_measurable (s t u v : ℝ) : Measurable (relativeLabel s t u v)

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.MeasureEntropy.sum_dyadic_deficit
statement:
theorem sum_dyadic_deficit (μ : Measure ℝ) (s : ℝ) (K : ℕ) :
    (∑j ∈ Finset.range K, deficit μ ((2 : ℝ)^j*s))=
      K*Real.log 2-(averaged μ s-averaged μ ((2 : ℝ)^K*s))

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.MeasureEntropy.wide_window_saturation
statement:
theorem wide_window_saturation (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (hμ : CompactlyCarried μ) (v : ℕ → ℝ) (hv : ∀ n, 0 < v n)
    (h : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => deficit μ (v n)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)) (K : ℕ) :
    Filter.Tendsto (fun n => averaged μ (v n)-averaged μ ((2 : ℝ)^K*v n))
      Filter.atTop (nhds (K*Real.log 2))

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.MeasureEntropy.geometric_gain_bound
statement:
theorem geometric_gain_bound (F : ℝ → ℝ) {v K B d C : ℝ} (hv : 0 < v) (hK : 1 < K)
    (hu : ∀ s, 0 < s → s < 1 → F s ≤ d*Real.log (1/s)+C)
    (hg : ∀ s, 0 < s → s < v → B ≤ F s-F (K*s)) : B ≤ d*Real.log K

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.MeasureEntropy.geometric_gain_lower
statement:
theorem geometric_gain_lower (F : ℝ → ℝ) {v K B : ℝ} (hv : 0 < v) (hK : 1 < K)
    (hg : ∀ s, 0 < s → s < v → B ≤ F s-F (K*s)) (m : ℕ) :
    F v+(m : ℝ)*B ≤ F (v*(1/K)^m)

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.System.stopped_lower
statement:
theorem stopped_lower (S : System ι) (F : ℝ → ℝ) {a v B : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 < a) (hai : ∀ i, a ≤ |S.ratio i|) (hv : 0 < v)
    (hstep : ∀ s, 0 < s → (∑ i, S.weight i*F (s/|S.ratio i|)) ≤ F s)
    (hbase : ∀ z, v ≤ z → z ≤ v/a → B ≤ F z) :
    ∀ s, 0 < s → s < v → B ≤ F s

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.System.stopped_window_transfer
statement:
theorem stopped_window_transfer (S : System ι) (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (hμ : S.SelfSimilar μ) {a v : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a)
    (hai : ∀ i, a ≤ |S.ratio i|) (hv : 0 < v) {K : ℕ} (hK : 0 < K)
    {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) (hsv : s < v) :
    averaged μ v-averaged μ ((K : ℝ)*v)-(Real.log (1/a+2)+Real.log 2) ≤
      averaged μ s-averaged μ ((K : ℝ)*s)

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.System.uniform_nonsaturation_of_entropy_bound
statement:
theorem uniform_nonsaturation_of_entropy_bound (S : System ι) (μ : Measure ℝ)
    [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (hμ : S.SelfSimilar μ) {d C : ℝ} (hd : d < 1)
    (hu : ∀ s, 0 < s → s < 1 → averaged μ s ≤ d*Real.log (1/s)+C) :
    ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ v : ℝ, 0 < v → δ ≤ deficit μ v

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.System.window_selfSimilar
statement:
theorem window_selfSimilar (S : System ι) (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (hμ : S.SelfSimilar μ) {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) {K : ℕ} (hK : 0 < K) :
    (∑i, S.weight i*(averaged μ (s/|S.ratio i|)-
      averaged μ ((K : ℝ)*(s/|S.ratio i|)))) ≤
      averaged μ s-averaged μ ((K : ℝ)*s)

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FiniteDistribution.entropy_map_le
statement:
theorem entropy_map_le {α : Type uα} {β : Type uβ} (p : FiniteDistribution α) (f : α → β) :
    (p.map f).entropy ≤ p.entropy

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FiniteDistribution.js_le_map_add
statement:
theorem js_le_map_add {α : Type uα} {β : Type uβ} (p q : FiniteDistribution α) (f : α → β) :
    p.js q ≤ (p.map f).js (q.map f)+(p.mix q).entropy-((p.mix q).map f).entropy

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FiniteDistribution.tv_maps_le_disagreement
statement:
theorem tv_maps_le_disagreement {α : Type uα} {β : Type uβ} (p : FiniteDistribution α) (f g : α → β) :
    (p.map f).tv (p.map g) ≤ ∑ a ∈ p.support, if f a = g a then 0 else p.weight a

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.MeasureEntropy.integral_finite_observation
statement:
theorem integral_finite_observation {α : Type uα} {β : Type uβ} [MeasurableSpace α] [MeasurableSpace β]
    [MeasurableSingletonClass β] (μ : Measure α) [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    (f : α → β) (hf : Measurable f) (s : Finset β) (hs : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, f x ∈ s)
    (F : β → ℝ) : ∫ x, F (f x) ∂μ = ∑ b ∈ s, mass μ f b*F b

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.MeasureEntropy.observationLaw_map_weight
statement:
theorem observationLaw_map_weight {α : Type uα} {β : Type uβ} {γ : Type uγ} [MeasurableSpace α] [MeasurableSpace β]
    [MeasurableSingletonClass β] (μ : Measure α) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (f : α → β) (hf : Measurable f) (s : Finset β) (hs : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, f x ∈ s)
    (g : β → γ) (c : γ) :
    ((observationLaw μ f hf s hs).map g).weight c = mass μ (g ∘ f) c

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.RandomGrid.circle_norm_le_of_floor_ne
statement:
theorem circle_norm_le_of_floor_ne {x y : ℝ} (h : ⌊x⌋ ≠ ⌊y⌋) :

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.RandomGrid.hit_eq_indicator
statement:
theorem hit_eq_indicator (c : AddCircle (1 : ℝ)) (r : ℝ) :

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.RandomGrid.hit_integrable

statement:
theorem integral_hit (c : AddCircle (1 : ℝ)) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) :

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.Boundary.increment_bounds
statement:
theorem increment_bounds {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (ha1 : a ≤ 1) (u : ℝ) :
    0 ≤ increment a u ∧ increment a u ≤ 1

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.Boundary.increment_eq_indicator
statement:
theorem increment_eq_indicator {a u : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (ha1 : a ≤ 1)
    (hu : u ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    increment a u = (Icc (1-a) 1).indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) u

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.Boundary.increment_eq_ite
statement:
theorem increment_eq_ite {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (ha1 : a ≤ 1) (u : ℝ) :
    increment a u = if ⌊u+a⌋=⌊u⌋ then 0 else 1

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.Boundary.increment_integrable
statement:
theorem increment_integrable {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (ha1 : a ≤ 1) (b c : ℝ) :
    IntervalIntegrable (increment a) volume b c

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.Boundary.increment_measurable
statement: theorem increment_measurable (a : ℝ) : Measurable (increment a)

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.Boundary.increment_measure_intervalIntegrable
statement:
theorem increment_measure_intervalIntegrable {α : Type uα} [MeasurableSpace α]
    (μ : Measure α) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (ha1 : a ≤ 1)
    (b : α → ℝ) (hb : Measurable b) :
    IntervalIntegrable (fun u => ∫ x, increment a (u+b x) ∂μ) volume 0 1

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.Boundary.increment_periodic
statement: theorem increment_periodic (a : ℝ) : Function.Periodic (increment a) 1

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.Boundary.increment_prod_integrable
statement:
theorem increment_prod_integrable {α : Type uα} [MeasurableSpace α]

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.Boundary.integral_increment
statement:
theorem integral_increment {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (ha1 : a ≤ 1) :
    (∫ u in (0 : ℝ)..1, increment a u) = a

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.Boundary.integral_increment_measure
statement:
theorem integral_increment_measure {α : Type uα} [MeasurableSpace α]

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.Boundary.integral_increment_shift
statement:
theorem integral_increment_shift {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (ha1 : a ≤ 1) (b : ℝ) :
    (∫ u in (0 : ℝ)..1, increment a (u+b)) = a

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.MeasureEntropy.averaged_fairShift_gain_compare
statement:
theorem averaged_fairShift_gain_compare (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (hμ : CompactlyCarried μ) (v : ℝ) {s t : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) (ht : 0 < t) (hst : s ≤ t) :
    averaged (fairShift μ v) t-averaged μ t ≤
      averaged (fairShift μ v) s-averaged μ s+(s/t)*Real.log 2

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.MeasureEntropy.averaged_fairShift_gain_le
statement:
theorem averaged_fairShift_gain_le (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (hμ : CompactlyCarried μ) {v t : ℝ} (hv : 0 < v) (ht : 0 < t) (hvt : v ≤ t) :
    averaged (fairShift μ v) t-averaged μ t ≤ (v/t)*Real.log 2

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.MeasureEntropy.fairShift_eq_halfMix
statement:
theorem fairShift_eq_halfMix (μ : Measure ℝ) (v : ℝ) :
    fairShift μ v = (1/2 : ℝ≥0∞) • μ+(1/2 : ℝ≥0∞) • μ.map (fun x => x+v)

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.MeasureEntropy.gridInformation_eq
statement:
theorem gridInformation_eq (μ : Measure ℝ) (v s u : ℝ) :
    gridInformation μ v s u = grid (fairShift μ v) s u-
      (grid μ s u+grid (μ.map (fun x => x+v)) s u)/2

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.MeasureEntropy.gridInformation_intervalIntegrable
statement:
theorem gridInformation_intervalIntegrable (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (hμ : CompactlyCarried μ) (v : ℝ) {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) :
    IntervalIntegrable (gridInformation μ v s) volume 0 1

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.MeasureEntropy.gridInformation_le_boundary
statement:
theorem gridInformation_le_boundary (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (hμ : CompactlyCarried μ) {v t : ℝ} (hv : 0 < v) (ht : 0 < t) (hvt : v ≤ t) (u : ℝ) :
    gridInformation μ v t u ≤ (∫ x, Boundary.increment (v/t) (u+x/t) ∂μ)*Real.log 2

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.MeasureEntropy.gridInformation_le_fine_add_boundary
statement:
theorem gridInformation_le_fine_add_boundary (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (hμ : CompactlyCarried μ) (v : ℝ) {s t : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) (ht : 0 < t)
    (hst : s ≤ t) (u w : ℝ) :
    gridInformation μ v t u ≤ gridInformation μ v s w+
      (∫ x, Boundary.increment (s/t) (u+((s/t)*(label s w x : ℝ)-(s/t)*w)) ∂fairShift μ v)*Real.log 2

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.MeasureEntropy.information_le_map_add
statement:
theorem information_le_map_add {α : Type uα} {β : Type uβ} {γ : Type uγ} {δ : Type uδ} [MeasurableSpace α]
    [MeasurableSpace β] [MeasurableSingletonClass β]
    (μ ν : Measure α) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    (F : α → β) (hF : Measurable F) (s t : Finset β)
    (hs : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, F x ∈ s) (ht : ∀ᵐ x ∂ν, F x ∈ t)
    (f : β → γ) (g : β → δ) :
    information μ ν (g ∘ F) ≤ information μ ν (f ∘ F)+
      entropy ((1/2 : ℝ≥0∞) • μ+(1/2 : ℝ≥0∞) • ν) F-
      entropy ((1/2 : ℝ≥0∞) • μ+(1/2 : ℝ≥0∞) • ν) (f ∘ F)

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.MeasureEntropy.information_map_le_disagreement
statement:
theorem information_map_le_disagreement {α : Type uα} {β : Type uβ} [MeasurableSpace α]
    [MeasurableSpace β] [MeasurableSingletonClass β]
    (μ : Measure α) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (T : α → α) (hT : Measurable T)
    (f : α → β) (hf : Measurable f) (s t : Finset β)
    (hs : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, f x ∈ s) (ht : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, f (T x) ∈ t) :
    information μ (μ.map T) f ≤ (∫ x, if f x=f (T x) then (0 : ℝ) else 1 ∂μ)*Real.log 2

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.MeasureEntropy.integral_gridInformation
statement:
theorem integral_gridInformation (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (hμ : CompactlyCarried μ) (v : ℝ) {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) :
    (∫ u in (0 : ℝ)..1, gridInformation μ v s u) = averaged (fairShift μ v) s-averaged μ s

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.MeasureEntropy.js_observationLaw
statement:
theorem js_observationLaw {α : Type uα} {β : Type uβ} [MeasurableSpace α] [MeasurableSpace β]
    [MeasurableSingletonClass β] (μ ν : Measure α)
    [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    (f : α → β) (hf : Measurable f) (s t : Finset β)
    (hs : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, f x ∈ s) (ht : ∀ᵐ x ∂ν, f x ∈ t) :
    (observationLaw μ f hf s hs).js (observationLaw ν f hf t ht) = information μ ν f

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.MeasureEntropy.js_observationLaw_map
statement:
theorem js_observationLaw_map {α : Type uα} {β : Type uβ} {γ : Type uγ} [MeasurableSpace α] [MeasurableSpace β]
    [MeasurableSingletonClass β] (μ ν : Measure α)
    [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    (f : α → β) (hf : Measurable f) (s t : Finset β)
    (hs : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, f x ∈ s) (ht : ∀ᵐ x ∂ν, f x ∈ t) (g : β → γ) :
    ((observationLaw μ f hf s hs).map g).js ((observationLaw ν f hf t ht).map g) =
      information μ ν (g ∘ f)

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.MeasureEntropy.mass_halfMix
statement:
theorem mass_halfMix {α : Type uα} {β : Type uβ} [MeasurableSpace α]
    (μ ν : Measure α) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] [IsFiniteMeasure ν] (f : α → β) (b : β) :
    mass ((1/2 : ℝ≥0∞) • μ+(1/2 : ℝ≥0∞) • ν) f b = (mass μ f b+mass ν f b)/2

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.MeasureEntropy.mix_observationLaw_map_entropy
statement:
theorem mix_observationLaw_map_entropy {α : Type uα} {β : Type uβ} {γ : Type uγ} [MeasurableSpace α]
    [MeasurableSpace β] [MeasurableSingletonClass β]
    (μ ν : Measure α) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    (f : α → β) (hf : Measurable f) (s t : Finset β)
    (hs : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, f x ∈ s) (ht : ∀ᵐ x ∂ν, f x ∈ t) (g : β → γ) :
    (((observationLaw μ f hf s hs).map g).mix
      ((observationLaw ν f hf t ht).map g)).entropy =
      entropy ((1/2 : ℝ≥0∞) • μ+(1/2 : ℝ≥0∞) • ν) (g ∘ f)

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.MeasureEntropy.observationLaw_map_entropy
statement:
theorem observationLaw_map_entropy {α : Type uα} {β : Type uβ} {γ : Type uγ} [MeasurableSpace α] [MeasurableSpace β]
    [MeasurableSingletonClass β] (μ : Measure α) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (f : α → β) (hf : Measurable f) (s : Finset β) (hs : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, f x ∈ s)
    (g : β → γ) :
    ((observationLaw μ f hf s hs).map g).entropy = entropy μ (g ∘ f)

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FairPairs.coupling_band_le_capacity
statement:
theorem coupling_band_le_capacity {ν : Law} (ℓ : ℤ) (π : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ)
    (hπ : ∀ x ∈ ν.support, ∀ y ∈ ν.support, 0 ≤ π x y)
    (hsym : ∀ x ∈ ν.support, ∀ y ∈ ν.support, π x y = π y x)
    (hrow : ∀ x ∈ ν.support, ∑ y ∈ ν.support, π x y ≤ ν.prob x) :
    (∑ x ∈ ν.support, ∑ y ∈ ν.support,
      if (2 : ℝ) ^ (-ℓ) ≤ |y - x| ∧ |y - x| < (2 : ℝ) ^ (1 - ℓ)
      then π x y else 0) ≤ capacity ν ℓ

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FairPairs.coupling_distance_le
statement:
theorem coupling_distance_le {ν : Law} (π : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (R : ℝ)
    (hπ : ∀ x ∈ ν.support, ∀ y ∈ ν.support, 0 ≤ π x y)
    (hsym : ∀ x ∈ ν.support, ∀ y ∈ ν.support, π x y = π y x)
    (hrow : ∀ x ∈ ν.support, ∑ y ∈ ν.support, π x y ≤ ν.prob x)
    (hdiam : ∀ x ∈ ν.support, ∀ y ∈ ν.support, R < |y - x| → π x y = 0) :
    (∑ x ∈ ν.support, ∑ y ∈ ν.support, π x y * |y - x|) ≤
      ∑ ℓ ∈ ((ν.support ×ˢ ν.support).image (fun e => bandIndex |e.2 - e.1|)).filter
        (fun ℓ => (2 : ℝ) ^ (-ℓ) ≤ R), (2 : ℝ) ^ (1 - ℓ) * capacity ν ℓ

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FairPairs.coupling_incident
statement:
theorem coupling_incident {ν : Law} (ℓ : ℤ) (π : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ)
    (hsym : ∀ x ∈ ν.support, ∀ y ∈ ν.support, π x y = π y x)
    {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ ν.support) :
    incident (ν := ν) (ℓ := ℓ) (fun e => 2 * π e.val.1 e.val.2) x =
      ∑ y ∈ ν.support, if (2 : ℝ) ^ (-ℓ) ≤ |y - x| ∧
        |y - x| < (2 : ℝ) ^ (1 - ℓ) then π x y else 0

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FairPairs.deviation_le_pair_distance

      ∑ a ∈ s, ∑ b ∈ s, p a * p b * |X a - X b|

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.ProductLaw.conditional_event
statement:
theorem conditional_event (p : ι → α → ℝ) (g : ι → α → β) (c : ι → β)
    (E : (ι → α) → Prop) [DecidablePred E] :
    (∑ x ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun x => (fun i => g i (x i)) = c),
      if E x then weight p x / FiniteEntropy.mass Finset.univ (weight p) (fun x i => g i (x i)) c else 0) =
    ∑ x, if E x then weight (conditional p g c) x else 0

statement:

    ∑ a, conditional p g c i a = 1

statement:

    (∑ x, if E i (x i) then weight p x else 0) = ∑ a, if E i a then p i a else 0

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.ProductLaw.entropy
statement:

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.ProductLaw.mass_cells
statement:

      ∏ i, cellMass p g c i

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.ProductLaw.moment
statement:
theorem moment (p f : ι → α → ℝ) (s : Finset ι)
    (hp : ∀ i, ∑ a, p i a = 1) :
    (∑ x, weight p x * ∏ i ∈ s, f i (x i)) = ∏ i ∈ s, ∑ a, p i a * f i a

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.ProductLaw.observableEntropy_conditional
statement:
theorem observableEntropy_conditional {γ : Type uγ} [DecidableEq γ]
    (p : ι → α → ℝ) (g : ι → α → β) (c : ι → β) (f : (ι → α) → γ) :
    FiniteEntropy.observableEntropy
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun x => (fun i => g i (x i)) = c))
      (fun x => weight p x / FiniteEntropy.mass Finset.univ (weight p) (fun x i => g i (x i)) c) f =
      FiniteEntropy.observableEntropy Finset.univ (weight (conditional p g c)) f

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.ProductLaw.observable_entropy
statement:
theorem observable_entropy [Nonempty α] [Nonempty β]
    (p : α → ℝ) (g : α → β) (hp : ∀ a, 0 ≤ p a) (hp1 : ∑ a, p a = 1) :
    FiniteEntropy.observableEntropy Finset.univ (weight (fun _ : ι => p)) (fun x i => g (x i)) =
      Fintype.card ι * FiniteEntropy.observableEntropy Finset.univ p g

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.ProductLaw.two_coordinate_events
statement:
theorem two_coordinate_events (p : ι → α → ℝ) (E : ι → α → Prop)
    [∀ i, DecidablePred (E i)] (hp : ∀ i, ∑ a, p i a = 1)
    (i j : ι) (hij : i ≠ j) :
    (∑ x, if E i (x i) ∧ E j (x j) then weight p x else 0) =
      (∑ x, if E i (x i) then weight p x else 0) *
      (∑ x, if E j (x j) then weight p x else 0)

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.ProductLaw.weight_conditional
statement:
theorem weight_conditional (p : ι → α → ℝ) (g : ι → α → β) (c : ι → β) (x : ι → α) :
    weight (conditional p g c) x =
      if (fun i => g i (x i)) = c then weight p x /
        FiniteEntropy.mass Finset.univ (weight p) (fun x i => g i (x i)) c else 0

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.RandomGrid.exists_shift_cost_le
statement:
theorem exists_shift_cost_le {α : Type uα} (s : Finset α) (w : α → ℝ)
    (c : α → AddCircle (1 : ℝ)) (r : α → ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ a ∈ s, 0 ≤ w a) (hr : ∀ a ∈ s, 0 ≤ r a) :
    ∃ u : AddCircle (1 : ℝ),
      (∑ a ∈ s, w a * hit (c a) (r a) u) ≤ ∑ a ∈ s, w a * (2 * r a)

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.RandomGrid.exists_shift_variation_bound
statement:
theorem exists_shift_variation_bound {α : Type uα} (s : Finset α) (p : α → ℝ)
    (k : ℕ) (v m : α → Fin k → ℝ) (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hp : ∀ x ∈ s, 0 ≤ p x) :
    ∃ u : AddCircle (1 : ℝ),
      (∑ x ∈ s, p x * ∑ i, ∑ j,
        hit (-(m x j/δ : ℝ) : AddCircle (1 : ℝ)) (4*k*|v x i-m x i|/δ) u) ≤
      (8*k^2/δ)*(∑ x ∈ s, p x * ∑ i, |v x i-m x i|)

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.RandomGrid.grid_alphabet_bound
statement:
theorem grid_alphabet_bound {α : Type uα} (s : Finset α) (k : ℕ)
    (v : α → Fin k → ℝ) (m : Fin k → ℝ) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (u : AddCircle (1 : ℝ)) (hs : s.Nonempty)
    (hv : ∀ x ∈ s, ∀ i, |v x i-m i| ≤ 4*δ) :
    Real.log (s.image (fun x i => cell δ u (v x i))).card ≤
      4*k*Real.log 2

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.RandomGrid.refinement_entropy_bound
statement:
theorem refinement_entropy_bound {α : Type uα} (s : Finset α) (p : α → ℝ)
    (k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) (v : α → Fin k → ℝ) (m : Fin k → ℝ)
    (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (u : AddCircle (1 : ℝ)) (a : ℝ)
    (hmargin : ∀ i, a ≤ δ * dist u (-(m i/δ : ℝ) : AddCircle (1 : ℝ)))
    (hp : ∀ x ∈ s, 0 ≤ p x) (hp1 : ∑ x ∈ s, p x = 1)
    (hv : ∀ x ∈ s, ∀ i, |v x i-m i| ≤ 4*δ)
    (hind : ∀ i j : Fin k, i ≠ j →
      (∑ x ∈ s, if a/(4*k) ≤ |v x i-m i| ∧ a/(4*k) ≤ |v x j-m j| then p x else 0) =
      (∑ x ∈ s, if a/(4*k) ≤ |v x i-m i| then p x else 0) *
      (∑ x ∈ s, if a/(4*k) ≤ |v x j-m j| then p x else 0)) :
    FiniteEntropy.conditionalEntropy s p (fun x i => cell δ u (v x i)) (fun x => ∑ i, v x i) ≤
      11*k*(∑ i, ∑ x ∈ s, if a/(4*k) ≤ |v x i-m i| then p x else 0)*Real.log 2

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.RandomGrid.refinement_entropy_hit_bound
statement:
theorem refinement_entropy_hit_bound {α : Type uα} (s : Finset α) (p : α → ℝ)
    (k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) (v : α → Fin k → ℝ) (m : Fin k → ℝ)
    (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (u : AddCircle (1 : ℝ))
    (hp : ∀ x ∈ s, 0 ≤ p x) (hp1 : ∑ x ∈ s, p x = 1)
    (hv : ∀ x ∈ s, ∀ i, |v x i-m i| ≤ 4*δ)
    (hind : ∀ a : ℝ, ∀ i j : Fin k, i ≠ j →
      (∑ x ∈ s, if a/(4*k) ≤ |v x i-m i| ∧ a/(4*k) ≤ |v x j-m j| then p x else 0) =
      (∑ x ∈ s, if a/(4*k) ≤ |v x i-m i| then p x else 0) *
      (∑ x ∈ s, if a/(4*k) ≤ |v x j-m j| then p x else 0)) :
    FiniteEntropy.conditionalEntropy s p (fun x i => cell δ u (v x i)) (fun x => ∑ i, v x i) ≤
      11*k*(∑ x ∈ s, p x * ∑ i, ∑ j,
        hit (-(m j/δ : ℝ) : AddCircle (1 : ℝ)) (4*k*|v x i-m i|/δ) u)*Real.log 2

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.RandomGrid.shift_zero
statement: theorem shift_zero : shift 0 = 0

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FiniteRefinement.cellMass_eq
statement:
theorem cellMass_eq (p : α → ℝ) (g : α → β) {k : ℕ} (c : Fin k → β) (i : Fin k) :
    ProductLaw.cellMass (fun _ : Fin k => p) (fun _ => g) c i = mass Finset.univ p g (c i)

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FiniteRefinement.conditional_mean_distance_le
statement:
theorem conditional_mean_distance_le (p : α → ℝ) (v : α → ℝ) (g : α → β)
    (hp : ∀ a, 0 ≤ p a) {k : ℕ} (c : Fin k → β) (i : Fin k)
    (hc : mass Finset.univ (ProductLaw.weight (fun _ : Fin k => p))
      (fun x i => g (x i)) c ≠ 0) (x : α) (hx : g x = c i) (R : ℝ)
    (hd : ∀ a b, g a = g b → |v a-v b| ≤ R) :
    |v x-cellMean p v g (c i)| ≤ R

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FiniteRefinement.conditional_mean_eq
statement:
theorem conditional_mean_eq (p : α → ℝ) (v : α → ℝ) (g : α → β)
    {k : ℕ} (c : Fin k → β) (i : Fin k) :
    (∑ a, ProductLaw.conditional (fun _ : Fin k => p) (fun _ => g) c i a * v a) =
      cellMean p v g (c i)

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FiniteRefinement.distance_mean_le
statement:
theorem distance_mean_le (p : α → ℝ) (v : α → ℝ) (z R : ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ a, 0 ≤ p a) (hp1 : ∑ a, p a = 1)
    (hR : ∀ a, p a ≠ 0 → |z-v a| ≤ R) : |z - ∑ a, p a * v a| ≤ R

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FiniteRefinement.entropy_step_hit_bound
statement:
theorem entropy_step_hit_bound (p : α → ℝ) (v : α → ℝ) (g : α → β)
    (hp : ∀ a, 0 < p a)
    (k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hd : ∀ a b, g a = g b → |v a-v b| ≤ 4*δ)
    (u : AddCircle (1 : ℝ)) :
    conditionalEntropy Finset.univ (ProductLaw.weight (fun _ : Fin k => p))
      (fun x i => RandomGrid.cell δ u (v (x i)))
      (fun x => (∑ i, v (x i), fun i => g (x i))) ≤
    11*k*(∑ x : Fin k → α, ProductLaw.weight (fun _ : Fin k => p) x * ∑ i, ∑ j,
      RandomGrid.hit (-(cellMean p v g (g (x j))/δ : ℝ) : AddCircle (1 : ℝ))
        (4*k*|v (x i)-cellMean p v g (g (x i))|/δ) u)*Real.log 2

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FiniteRefinement.exists_entropy_step
statement:
theorem exists_entropy_step (p : α → ℝ) (v : α → ℝ) (g : α → β)
    (hp : ∀ a, 0 < p a) (hp1 : ∑ a, p a = 1)
    (k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hd : ∀ a b, g a = g b → |v a-v b| ≤ 4*δ) :
    ∃ u : AddCircle (1 : ℝ),
    conditionalEntropy Finset.univ (ProductLaw.weight (fun _ : Fin k => p))
      (fun x i => RandomGrid.cell δ u (v (x i)))
      (fun x => (∑ i, v (x i), fun i => g (x i))) ≤
    (88*k^4/δ)*(∑ a, p a*|v a-cellMean p v g (g a)|)*Real.log 2

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FiniteRefinement.fiber_entropy_hit_bound
statement:
theorem fiber_entropy_hit_bound (p : α → ℝ) (v : α → ℝ) (g : α → β)
    (hp : ∀ a, 0 < p a) (k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hd : ∀ a b, g a = g b → |v a-v b| ≤ 4*δ) (u : AddCircle (1 : ℝ))
    (c : Fin k → β)
    (hc : c ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin k → α)).image (fun x i => g (x i))) :
    conditionalEntropy (Finset.univ.filter (fun x : Fin k → α => (fun i => g (x i)) = c))
      (fun x => ProductLaw.weight (fun _ : Fin k => p) x /
        mass Finset.univ (ProductLaw.weight (fun _ : Fin k => p)) (fun x i => g (x i)) c)
      (fun x i => RandomGrid.cell δ u (v (x i))) (fun x => ∑ i, v (x i)) ≤
    11*k*(∑ x ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun x : Fin k → α => (fun i => g (x i)) = c),
      (ProductLaw.weight (fun _ : Fin k => p) x /
        mass Finset.univ (ProductLaw.weight (fun _ : Fin k => p)) (fun x i => g (x i)) c) *
      ∑ i, ∑ j, RandomGrid.hit (-(cellMean p v g (c j)/δ : ℝ) : AddCircle (1 : ℝ))
        (4*k*|v (x i)-cellMean p v g (c i)|/δ) u)*Real.log 2

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FiniteRefinement.mass_pos
statement:
theorem mass_pos {γ : Type uγ} [DecidableEq γ] (s : Finset α) (p : α → ℝ)
    (g : α → γ) (hp : ∀ a ∈ s, 0 < p a) {b : γ} (hb : b ∈ s.image g) :
    0 < mass s p g b

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FiniteRefinement.mean_deviation_le_coupling
statement:
theorem mean_deviation_le_coupling (p : α → ℝ) (v : α → ℝ) (g : α → β)
    (hp : ∀ a, 0 < p a) :
    (∑ a, p a * |v a-cellMean p v g (g a)|) ≤
      ∑ a, ∑ b, (if g a = g b then p a*p b/mass Finset.univ p g (g a) else 0) *
        |v a-v b|

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FiniteRefinement.product_mean_deviation
statement:
theorem product_mean_deviation (p : α → ℝ) (v : α → ℝ) (g : α → β)
    (hp1 : ∑ a, p a = 1) (k : ℕ) :
    (∑ x : Fin k → α, ProductLaw.weight (fun _ : Fin k => p) x *
      ∑ i, |v (x i)-cellMean p v g (g (x i))|) =
      k * ∑ a, p a*|v a-cellMean p v g (g a)|

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FiniteRefinement.refinement_increment
statement:
theorem refinement_increment (p : α → ℝ) (v : α → ℝ) (g : α → List ℤ)
    (hp : ∀ a, 0 ≤ p a) (k : ℕ) (δ : ℝ) (u : AddCircle (1 : ℝ)) :
    conditionalEntropy Finset.univ (ProductLaw.weight (fun _ : Fin k => p))
      (fun x i => RandomGrid.cell δ u (v (x i)) :: g (x i)) (fun x => ∑ i, v (x i)) =
    conditionalEntropy Finset.univ (ProductLaw.weight (fun _ : Fin k => p))
      (fun x i => g (x i)) (fun x => ∑ i, v (x i)) +
    conditionalEntropy Finset.univ (ProductLaw.weight (fun _ : Fin k => p))
      (fun x i => RandomGrid.cell δ u (v (x i)))
      (fun x => (∑ i, v (x i), fun i => g (x i)))

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FairPairs.Law.subtype_sum
statement: theorem Law.subtype_sum (ν : Law) : ∑ a : ν.support, ν.prob a = 1

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FairPairs.Law.support_nonempty
statement: theorem Law.support_nonempty (ν : Law) : ν.support.Nonempty

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FairPairs.band_scale_sum
statement:
theorem band_scale_sum (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (ℓ : ℤ) (J : ℕ) :
    (∑ h ∈ (Finset.range J).filter (fun h => (2 : ℝ)^(-ℓ) ≤ ρ/4^h),
      (2 : ℝ)^(1-ℓ)/(ρ/4^h)) ≤ if (2 : ℝ)^(-ℓ) ≤ ρ then 8/3 else 0

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FairPairs.dyadic_upper_eq
statement: theorem dyadic_upper_eq (ℓ : ℤ) : (2 : ℝ)^(1-ℓ) = 2*(2 : ℝ)^(-ℓ)

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FairPairs.exists_capacity_refinement
statement:
theorem exists_capacity_refinement (ν : Law) (g : ℝ → List ℤ)
    (k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R)
    (hd : ∀ a ∈ ν.support, ∀ b ∈ ν.support, g a = g b → |a-b| ≤ R) :
    ∃ g' : ℝ → List ℤ,
      (∀ a ∈ ν.support, ∀ b ∈ ν.support, g' a = g' b → |a-b| ≤ R/4) ∧
      conditionalEntropy Finset.univ (ProductLaw.weight (fun _ : Fin k => fun a : ν.support => ν.prob a))
        (fun x i => g' (x i)) (fun x => ∑ i, (x i : ℝ)) ≤
      conditionalEntropy Finset.univ (ProductLaw.weight (fun _ : Fin k => fun a : ν.support => ν.prob a))
        (fun x i => g (x i)) (fun x => ∑ i, (x i : ℝ)) +
      (352*k^4/R)*ν.bandCost R*Real.log 2

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FairPairs.exists_fine_partition
statement:
theorem exists_fine_partition (ν : Law) (k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (J : ℕ) :
    ∃ g : ℝ → List ℤ,
      (∀ a ∈ ν.support, ∀ b ∈ ν.support, g a = g b → |a-b| ≤ ρ/4^J) ∧
      ν.partitionEntropy k g ≤ ν.partitionEntropy k (fun x => [⌊x/ρ⌋]) +
        ∑ h ∈ Finset.range J, ν.refinementCost k (ρ/4^h)

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FairPairs.exists_separating_depth
statement:
theorem exists_separating_depth (ν : Law) (ρ : ℝ) :
    ∃ J : ℕ, ∀ a ∈ ν.support, ∀ b ∈ ν.support, a ≠ b → ρ/4^J < |a-b|

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FairPairs.mass_support
statement:
theorem mass_support {β : Type uβ} [DecidableEq β] (ν : Law) (g : ℝ → β) (b : β) :
    mass Finset.univ (fun a : ν.support => ν.prob a) (fun a => g a) b =
      mass ν.support ν.prob g b

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FairPairs.mean_deviation_le_bandCost
statement:
theorem mean_deviation_le_bandCost {β : Type uβ} [DecidableEq β]
    (ν : Law) (g : ℝ → β) (R : ℝ)
    (hd : ∀ a ∈ ν.support, ∀ b ∈ ν.support, g a = g b → |a-b| ≤ R) :
    (∑ a : ν.support, ν.prob a * |(a : ℝ)-FiniteRefinement.cellMean
      (fun b : ν.support => ν.prob b) (fun b => (b : ℝ)) (fun b => g b) (g a)|) ≤
      ν.bandCost R

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FairPairs.observableEntropy_support
statement:
theorem observableEntropy_support {β : Type uβ} [DecidableEq β]
    (ν : Law) (g : ℝ → β) :
    observableEntropy Finset.univ (fun a : ν.support => ν.prob a) (fun a => g a) =
      observableEntropy ν.support ν.prob g

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FairPairs.pair_bound
statement:
theorem pair_bound (ν : Law) (k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) :
    k*(ν.shannonEntropy-ν.gridEntropy ρ) ≤ Real.log (ν.sumset k).card / Real.log 2 +
      60000*k^4 * ∑ ℓ ∈ ν.bandSupport.filter (fun ℓ => (2 : ℝ)^(-ℓ) ≤ 2*ρ), capacity ν ℓ

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FairPairs.pair_bound_natural
statement:
theorem pair_bound_natural (ν : Law) (k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) :
    k * (entropy ν.support ν.prob - observableEntropy ν.support ν.prob (fun x => ⌊x/ρ⌋)) ≤
      Real.log (ν.sumset k).card + 60000*k^4*Real.log 2 *
        ∑ ℓ ∈ ν.bandSupport.filter (fun ℓ => (2 : ℝ)^(-ℓ) ≤ 2*ρ), capacity ν ℓ

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FairPairs.sum_refinementCost_le
statement:
theorem sum_refinementCost_le (ν : Law) (k : ℕ) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (J : ℕ) :
    (∑ h ∈ Finset.range J, ν.refinementCost k (ρ/4^h)) ≤
      60000*k^4*Real.log 2 * ∑ ℓ ∈ ν.bandSupport.filter (fun ℓ => (2 : ℝ)^(-ℓ) ≤ 2*ρ),
        capacity ν ℓ

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FairPairs.sum_support₂
statement:
theorem sum_support₂ (ν : Law) (f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) :
    (∑ a : ν.support, ∑ b : ν.support, f a b) = ∑ a ∈ ν.support, ∑ b ∈ ν.support, f a b

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.Windows.ceiling_increment
statement:
theorem ceiling_increment (x y : ℝ) :
    (⌈y⌉ : ℝ) - (⌈x⌉ : ℝ) ≤ y - x + 1

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.Windows.finer_window_before
statement:
theorem finer_window_before {σ : ℕ → ℝ} (hσ : Monotone σ)
    {j k n : ℕ} {L a B : ℤ} {d : ℝ}
    (hadvance : σ (j + n) - σ j ≤ d)
    (hstart : a ≤ L - ⌈σ j⌉) (hcoarse : L - ⌈σ k⌉ ≤ B)
    (hgap : (B : ℝ) < (a : ℝ) - d - 1) : j + n < k

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.Windows.multiples_disjoint
statement:
theorem multiples_disjoint {n j k : ℕ} (hjk : j ≠ k) :
    Disjoint (Finset.Ico (j * n) (j * n + n)) (Finset.Ico (k * n) (k * n + n))

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.Windows.sum_disjoint_drops_le
statement:
theorem sum_disjoint_drops_le {α : Type uα} (s : Finset α) (u v : α → ℕ)
    (huv : ∀ i ∈ s, u i ≤ v i)
    (hd : (↑s : Set α).PairwiseDisjoint (fun i => Finset.Ico (u i) (v i)))
    (g : ℕ → ℝ) (hg : Antitone g) (hgn : ∀ i, 0 ≤ g i) :
    ∑ i ∈ s, (g (u i) - g (v i)) ≤ g 0

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.System.blockType_entropy_le
statement:
theorem blockType_entropy_le (S : System ι) (b n : ℕ) :
    FiniteEntropy.observableEntropy Finset.univ (S.wordWeight (n := n*b)) blockType ≤
      (n : ℝ)*Fintype.card ι*Real.log (b+1)

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.System.block_product_eq
statement:
theorem block_product_eq (S : System ι) {b n : ℕ} (w : Fin (n*b) → ι) (j : Fin n) :
    ∏ k : Fin b, S.ratio (w (finProdFinEquiv (j,k))) =
      ∏ i, S.ratio i ^ (blockType w j i).val

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.System.completeMap_slope
statement:
theorem completeMap_slope (S : System ι) {n : ℕ} (w : Fin n → ι) :
    (S.completeMap w).1 = ∏ j, S.ratio (w j)

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.System.completeMap_slope_blockType
statement:
theorem completeMap_slope_blockType (S : System ι) {b n : ℕ} (w : Fin (n*b) → ι) :
    (S.completeMap w).1 = ∏ j, ∏ i, S.ratio i ^ (blockType w j i).val

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.System.completeMap_slope_ne_zero
statement:
theorem completeMap_slope_ne_zero (S : System ι) {n : ℕ} (w : Fin n → ι) :
    (S.completeMap w).1 ≠ 0

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.System.conditional_translation_entropy_lower
statement:
theorem conditional_translation_entropy_lower (S : System ι) (b n : ℕ) :
    S.walkEntropy (n*b)*Real.log 2-(n : ℝ)*Fintype.card ι*Real.log (b+1) ≤
      FiniteEntropy.conditionalEntropy Finset.univ (S.wordWeight (n := n*b))
        (fun w => (S.completeMap w).2) blockType

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.System.conditional_translation_entropy_rate_lower
statement:
theorem conditional_translation_entropy_rate_lower (S : System ι) {b n : ℕ}
    (hb : 0 < b) (hn : 0 < n) :
    (n : ℝ)*((b : ℝ)*S.entropyRate*Real.log 2-Fintype.card ι*Real.log (b+1)) ≤
      FiniteEntropy.conditionalEntropy Finset.univ (S.wordWeight (n := n*b))
        (fun w => (S.completeMap w).2) blockType

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.System.map_entropy_as_observation
statement:
theorem map_entropy_as_observation (S : System ι) (n : ℕ) :
    FiniteEntropy.observableEntropy Finset.univ (S.wordWeight (n := n)) S.completeMap =
      S.walkEntropy n*Real.log 2

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.System.wordAffine_append
statement:
theorem wordAffine_append (S : System ι) (v w : List ι) :
    S.wordAffine (v++w) = ((S.wordAffine v).1*(S.wordAffine w).1,
      (S.wordAffine v).1*(S.wordAffine w).2+(S.wordAffine v).2)

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.System.wordAffine_slope
statement:
theorem wordAffine_slope (S : System ι) (w : List ι) :
    (S.wordAffine w).1 = (w.map S.ratio).prod

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.DigitSumset.card_sumset_le
statement:
theorem card_sumset_le {α : Type uα} {β : Type uβ} [Fintype α] [Fintype β]
    (S : Finset ℝ) (v : β → α → ℝ)
    (hS : ∀ x ∈ S, ∃ w : β → α, x=∑ j, v j (w j)) (k : ℕ) :
    (sumset S k).card ≤ (k+1)^(Fintype.card β*Fintype.card α)

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.DigitSumset.counts_expand
OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FiniteEntropy.entropy_le_mass_log_card
statement:
theorem entropy_le_mass_log_card {α : Type uα} (s : Finset α) (p : α → ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ a ∈ s, 0 ≤ p a) :
    entropy s p ≤ Real.negMulLog (∑ a ∈ s, p a)+
      (∑ a ∈ s, p a)*Real.log (max 1 (s.card : ℝ))

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FiniteEntropy.entropy_split_bound
statement:
theorem entropy_split_bound {α : Type uα} [DecidableEq α] (s a : Finset α)
    (p : α → ℝ) (ha : a ⊆ s) (hp : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ p i) (hp1 : ∑ i ∈ s, p i=1) :
    entropy s p ≤ Real.log 2+Real.log (max 1 (a.card : ℝ))+
      (∑ i ∈ s\a, p i)*Real.log (max 1 (s.card : ℝ))

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.MeasureEntropy.card_mul_mass_le_one
statement:
theorem card_mul_mass_le_one {α : Type uα} (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (s : Finset α) (x : α → ℝ) {r q : ℝ}
    (hd : (↑s : Set α).PairwiseDisjoint (fun i => Metric.ball (x i) r))
    (hq : ∀ i ∈ s, q ≤ μ.real (Metric.ball (x i) r)) :
    (s.card : ℝ)*q ≤ 1

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.MeasureEntropy.good_labels_card_bound
statement:
theorem good_labels_card_bound (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {s u q : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) (a : Finset ℤ) (x : ℤ → ℝ)
    (hx : ∀ i ∈ a, label s u (x i)=i)
    (hq : ∀ i ∈ a, q ≤ μ.real (Metric.ball (x i) (s/2))) :
    (a.card : ℝ)*q ≤ 3

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.MeasureEntropy.label_ball_disjoint
statement:
theorem label_ball_disjoint {s u x y : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s)
    (hne : label s u x ≠ label s u y) (hmod : label s u x % 3=label s u y % 3) :
    Disjoint (Metric.ball x (s/2)) (Metric.ball y (s/2))

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.LocalMass.eventual_lower_of_limit
statement:
theorem eventual_lower_of_limit (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] {x e d : ℝ}
    (hx : x ∈ μ.support) (hde : d < e)
    (hlim : Tendsto (fun r => -Real.log (μ.real (closedBall x r)) / -Real.log r)
      (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 d)) :
    ∃ R : ℝ, 0 < R ∧ ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → r < R →
      r^e ≤ μ.real (closedBall x r)

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.LocalMass.eventual_upper_of_limit
statement:
theorem eventual_upper_of_limit (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] {x a d : ℝ}
    (hx : x ∈ μ.support) (had : a < d)
    (hlim : Tendsto (fun r => -Real.log (μ.real (closedBall x r)) / -Real.log r)
      (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 d)) :
    ∃ R : ℝ, 0 < R ∧ ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → r < R →
      μ (closedBall x r) ≤ (ENNReal.ofReal r)^a

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.LocalMass.large_uniform_mass_set
statement:
theorem large_uniform_mass_set (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {e η : ℝ} (he : 0 ≤ e) (hη : 0 < η)
    (hlocal : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∃ R : ℝ, 0 < R ∧ ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → r < R →
      r^e ≤ μ.real (closedBall x r)) :
    ∃ E : Set ℝ, MeasurableSet E ∧ μ.real Eᶜ ≤ η ∧
      ∃ R : ℝ, 0 < R ∧ ∀ x ∈ E, ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → r < R →
        (r/2)^e ≤ μ.real (ball x r)

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.LocalMass.lower_dim_ge_of_limit
statement:
theorem lower_dim_ge_of_limit (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {d : ℝ}
    (hlim : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, Tendsto
      (fun r => -Real.log (μ.real (closedBall x r)) / -Real.log r) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 d)) :
    ENNReal.ofReal d ≤ lowerHausdorffDimension μ

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.LocalMass.positive_set_dim_ge
statement:
theorem positive_set_dim_ge (μ : Measure ℝ) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a)
    (hlocal : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∃ R : ℝ, 0 < R ∧ ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → r < R →
      μ (closedBall x r) ≤ (ENNReal.ofReal r)^a)

    ENNReal.ofReal a ≤ dimH B

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.LocalMass.restrict_le_hausdorff

    (hball : ∀ x ∈ E, ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → r < R →
      μ (closedBall x r) ≤ (ENNReal.ofReal r)^a) :

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.LocalMass.dim_le_of_uniform_lower_mass

    (hE : E ⊆ Icc (-B) B)

name: OAI.CHObstruction.EndHomogeneous.active
statement:
theorem active (x : X) (α : J) (h : ∀ β < α, rep wJ wX c x β < x) :
    (∀ β < α, rep wJ wX c x β < rep wJ wX c x α) ∧
    (∀ a : Finset {β : J // β < α},
      c (insert (rep wJ wX c x α) (a.image (fun β => rep wJ wX c x β.val))) =
        c (insert x (a.image (fun β => rep wJ wX c x β.val)))) ∧
    rep wJ wX c x α ≤ x

    (hy : ∀ β < α, rep wJ wX c y β < y)
    (hp : profile wJ wX c x = profile wJ wX c y) :
    rep wJ wX c x α = rep wJ wX c y α

      (∀ α, r α < x) ∧
      ∀ α (a : Finset {β : J // β < α}),
        c (insert (r α) (a.image (fun β => r β.val))) =
          c (insert x (a.image (fun β => r β.val)))

    (he : ∀ α (a : Finset {β : J // β < α}),
      c (insert (r α) (a.image (fun β => r β.val))) =
        c (insert x (a.image (fun β => r β.val))))
    {m : ℕ} {Y : Set J}
    (hh : Homogeneous (fun a => c (insert x (a.image r))) m Y) :
    Homogeneous c (m + 1) (r '' Y)

theorem estimate {Λ ξ : Cardinal.{u}} (hΛ : Λ.IsStrongLimit)
    (hξinf : ℵ₀ ≤ ξ) (hξ : ξ < Λ) (m : ℕ) :
    ∀ χ, ℵ₀ ≤ χ → χ < Λ →
    ∃ μ, ℵ₀ ≤ μ ∧ μ < Λ ∧
      ∀ (X C : Type u) [LinearOrder X],
        WellFounded ((· < ·) : X → X → Prop) → #X = μ → #C ≤ ξ →
        ∀ c : Finset X → C, ∃ Y : Set X, χ ≤ #Y ∧ Homogeneous c m Y

    (hχinf : ℵ₀ ≤ χ) (hχ : χ < Λ) :
    ∃ μ < Λ, ∀ (X C : Type u), #C ≤ ξ → ∀ (Y : Set X), μ ≤ #Y →
      ∀ c : Finset X → C, ∃ Z ⊆ Y, χ ≤ #Z ∧ Homogeneous c m Z

    (fullSeed (sub t e)).val ⊆ (fullSeed t).val

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Hereditary.mem_mk
statement: @[simp] theorem mem_mk (a l : Lists A) : mk a ∈ mk l ↔ a ∈ l

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Hereditary.mem_rawElements
statement: theorem mem_rawElements (a l : Lists A) : mk a ∈ rawElements l ↔ a ∈ l

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Hereditary.mk_eq_mk
statement: @[simp] theorem mk_eq_mk {l r : Lists A} : mk l = mk r ↔ Lists.Equiv l r

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Hereditary.rank_lt_of_mem
statement: theorem rank_lt_of_mem {x y : HF A} (h : x ∈ y) : rank x < rank y

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Hereditary.rawElements_congr
statement:
theorem rawElements_congr {l r : Lists A} (h : Lists.Equiv l r) :
    rawElements l = rawElements r

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Hereditary.rawRank_congr
statement: theorem rawRank_congr {l r : Lists A} (h : Lists.Equiv l r) : rawRank l = rawRank r

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Hereditary.rawRank_lt_of_mem
statement:
theorem rawRank_lt_of_mem {b : Bool} (l : Lists' A b) (a : Lists A)
    (ha : a ∈ l.toList) : rawRank a < rawRank' l

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Hereditary.raw_mem_congr_right
statement:
theorem raw_mem_congr_right {l r : Lists A} (h : Lists.Equiv l r) (a : Lists A) :
    a ∈ l ↔ a ∈ r

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.boundary_cycle
statement: @[simp] theorem boundary_cycle (f : Face n) : boundary (cycle f) = 0

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.boundary_single
statement:
@[simp] theorem boundary_single (e : Edge n) (z : Scalar) :
    boundary (Pi.single e z) = Pi.single (head e) z - Pi.single (tail e) z

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.card_le_product_of_witness
statement:
theorem card_le_product_of_witness {α β γ : Type*} [DecidableEq α] [Fintype β]
    (s : Finset α) (t : Finset γ) (f : β → γ → α)
    (h : ∀ x ∈ s, ∃ b c, c ∈ t ∧ f b c = x) :
    s.card ≤ Fintype.card β * t.card

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.card_le_two_products_of_witness
statement:
theorem card_le_two_products_of_witness {α β γ δ ε : Type*} [DecidableEq α]
    [Fintype β] [Fintype δ] (s : Finset α) (t : Finset γ) (u : Finset ε)
    (f : β → γ → α) (g : δ → ε → α)
    (h : ∀ x ∈ s, (∃ b c, c ∈ t ∧ f b c = x) ∨ (∃ d e, e ∈ u ∧ g d e = x)) :
    s.card ≤ Fintype.card β * t.card + Fintype.card δ * u.card

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.count_curl
statement:
theorem count_curl (l : Edge n → Scalar) :
    (nonzeroSet (curl l)).card = (badXY l).card + (badXZ l).card + (badYZ l).card

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.count_residual
statement:
theorem count_residual (l : Edge n → Scalar) (i0 : Fin (n+1)) :
    (nonzeroSet (residual l i0)).card ≤
      (n+1) * ((badXY l).card + (badXZ l).card) + (n+1)^2 * (badSlice l i0).card

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.count_residual_y
statement:
theorem count_residual_y (l : Edge n → Scalar) (i0 : Fin (n+1)) :
    (nonzeroSet (fun p : EdgeY n => residual l i0 (ey p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2))).card ≤
      (n+1) * (badXY l).card

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.count_residual_z
statement:
theorem count_residual_z (l : Edge n → Scalar) (i0 : Fin (n+1)) :
    (nonzeroSet (fun p : EdgeZ n => residual l i0 (ez p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2))).card ≤
      (n+1) * (badXZ l).card + (n+1)^2 * (badSlice l i0).card

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.curl_gradient
statement:
@[simp] theorem curl_gradient (φ : Vertex n → Scalar) (f : Face n) :
    curl (gradient φ) f = 0

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.curl_residual
statement:
@[simp] theorem curl_residual (l : Edge n → Scalar) (i0 : Fin (n+1)) (f : Face n) :
    curl (residual l i0) f = curl l f

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.curl_sub
statement:
@[simp] theorem curl_sub (l r : Edge n → Scalar) (f : Face n) :
    curl (l-r) f = curl l f - curl r f

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.curl_xy
statement:
@[simp] theorem curl_xy (l : Edge n → Scalar) (i j : Fin n) (k : Fin (n+1)) :
    curl l (.inl (i,j,k)) = l (ex i j.castSucc k) + l (ey i.succ j k) -
      l (ex i j.succ k) - l (ey i.castSucc j k)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.curl_xz
statement:
@[simp] theorem curl_xz (l : Edge n → Scalar) (i k : Fin n) (j : Fin (n+1)) :
    curl l (.inr (.inl (i,j,k))) = l (ex i j k.castSucc) + l (ez i.succ j k) -
      l (ex i j k.succ) - l (ez i.castSucc j k)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.curl_yz
statement:
@[simp] theorem curl_yz (l : Edge n → Scalar) (j k : Fin n) (i : Fin (n+1)) :
    curl l (.inr (.inr (i,j,k))) = l (ey i j k.castSucc) + l (ez i j.succ k) -
      l (ey i j k.succ) - l (ez i j.castSucc k)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.exists_sparse_slice
statement:
theorem exists_sparse_slice (l : Edge n → Scalar) :
    ∃ i0 : Fin (n+1), (n+1) * (badSlice l i0).card ≤ (badYZ l).card

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.line_constant
statement:
theorem line_constant {g : Fin (n+1) → Scalar}
    (h : ∀ a : Fin n, g a.succ = g a.castSucc) (i j : Fin (n+1)) : g i = g j

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.mem_nonzeroSet
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_nonzeroSet {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (f : ι → Scalar) (i : ι) :
    i ∈ nonzeroSet f ↔ f i ≠ 0

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.prefix_step
statement:
theorem prefix_step (l : Fin n → Scalar) (i : Fin n) :
    prefixSum l i.succ - prefixSum l i.castSucc = l i

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.prefix_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem prefix_zero (l : Fin n → Scalar) : prefixSum l 0 = 0

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.residual1_x
statement:
@[simp] theorem residual1_x (l : Edge n → Scalar) (i : Fin n) (j k : Fin (n+1)) :
    residual1 l (ex i j k) = 0

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.residual2_x
statement:
@[simp] theorem residual2_x (l : Edge n → Scalar) (i0 : Fin (n+1))
    (i : Fin n) (j k : Fin (n+1)) : residual2 l i0 (ex i j k) = 0

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.residual2_y
statement:
@[simp] theorem residual2_y (l : Edge n → Scalar) (i0 : Fin (n+1))
    (j : Fin n) (k : Fin (n+1)) : residual2 l i0 (ey i0 j k) = 0

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.residual_as_gradient
statement:
theorem residual_as_gradient (l : Edge n → Scalar) (i0 : Fin (n+1)) :
    residual l i0 = l - gradient (phi1 l + phi2 l i0 + phi3 l i0)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.residual_x
statement:
@[simp] theorem residual_x (l : Edge n → Scalar) (i0 : Fin (n+1))
    (i : Fin n) (j k : Fin (n+1)) : residual l i0 (ex i j k) = 0

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.residual_y
statement:
@[simp] theorem residual_y (l : Edge n → Scalar) (i0 : Fin (n+1))
    (j : Fin n) (k : Fin (n+1)) : residual l i0 (ey i0 j k) = 0

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.residual_y_witness
statement:
theorem residual_y_witness (l : Edge n → Scalar) (i0 i : Fin (n+1))
    (j : Fin n) (k : Fin (n+1)) (h : residual l i0 (ey i j k) ≠ 0) :
    ∃ a : Fin n, curl l (.inl (a,j,k)) ≠ 0

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.residual_z
statement:
@[simp] theorem residual_z (l : Edge n → Scalar) (i0 : Fin (n+1))
    (k : Fin n) : residual l i0 (ez i0 0 k) = 0

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.residual_z_witness
statement:
theorem residual_z_witness (l : Edge n → Scalar) (i0 i j : Fin (n+1))
    (k : Fin n) (h : residual l i0 (ez i j k) ≠ 0) :
    (∃ a : Fin n, curl l (.inr (.inl (a,j,k))) ≠ 0) ∨
    (∃ b : Fin n, curl l (.inr (.inr (i0,b,k))) ≠ 0)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.single_mul_sum
statement:
theorem single_mul_sum {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (i : ι) (z : Scalar) (l : ι → Scalar) :
    (∑ j, (Pi.single i z : ι → Scalar) j * l j) = z * l i

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.sparse_cochain
statement:
theorem sparse_cochain (l : Edge n → Scalar) :
    ∃ φ : Vertex n → Scalar,
      (nonzeroSet (l - gradient φ)).card ≤ (n+1) * (nonzeroSet (curl l)).card

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.sum_badSlice
statement:
theorem sum_badSlice (l : Edge n → Scalar) :
    (∑ i : Fin (n+1), (badSlice l i).card) = (badYZ l).card

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Support.H.ambient_card
statement:
theorem ambient_card [FiniteDimensional Scalar K] :
    Nat.card (H cycle) = 3 ^ (Module.finrank Scalar (F → Plane) + Module.finrank Scalar K)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Support.H.central_commute
statement:
theorem central_commute (x : H cycle) (k : K) :
    x * central cycle k = central cycle k * x

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Support.H.central_mul
statement: @[simp] theorem central_mul (k l : K) : central cycle k * central cycle l = central cycle (k+l)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Support.H.central_neg
statement:
@[simp] theorem central_neg
    {F : Type}
    {K : Type}
    [Fintype F]
    [AddCommGroup K]
    [_root_.Module Support.Scalar K]
    (cycle : F → K) (k : K) : central cycle (-k) = (central cycle k)⁻¹

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Support.H.central_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem central_zero
    {F : Type}
    {K : Type}
    [Fintype F]
    [AddCommGroup K]
    [_root_.Module Support.Scalar K]
    (cycle : F → K) : central cycle (0 : K) = 1

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Support.H.commutator
statement:
theorem commutator (x y : H cycle) :
    x * y * x⁻¹ * y⁻¹ = central cycle (∑ f, omega (x.face f) (y.face f) • cycle f)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Support.H.commutator_mem_centralPart
statement:
theorem commutator_mem_centralPart (S : Subgroup (H cycle))
    {a b : F → Plane} (ha : a ∈ projected cycle S) (hb : b ∈ projected cycle S) :
    (∑ f, omega (a f) (b f) • cycle f) ∈ centralPart cycle S

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Support.H.inv_face
statement:
@[simp] theorem inv_face
    {F : Type}
    {K : Type}
    [Fintype F]
    [AddCommGroup K]
    [_root_.Module Support.Scalar K]
    (cycle : F → K) (x : H cycle) : x⁻¹.face = -x.face

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Support.H.inv_flow
statement:
@[simp] theorem inv_flow
    {F : Type}
    {K : Type}
    [Fintype F]
    [AddCommGroup K]
    [_root_.Module Support.Scalar K]
    (cycle : F → K) (x : H cycle) : x⁻¹.flow = -x.flow

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Support.H.mem_centralPart
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_centralPart (S : Subgroup (H cycle)) (k : K) :
    k ∈ centralPart cycle S ↔ central cycle k ∈ S

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Support.H.mem_projected
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_projected (S : Subgroup (H cycle)) (a : F → Plane) :
    a ∈ projected cycle S ↔ ∃ h ∈ S, h.face = a

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Support.H.mul_face
statement: @[simp] theorem mul_face (x y : H cycle) : (x * y).face = x.face + y.face

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Support.H.mul_flow
statement:
@[simp] theorem mul_flow (x y : H cycle) :
    (x * y).flow = x.flow + y.flow + correction cycle x.face y.face

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Support.H.mul_inv_of_face_eq
statement:
theorem mul_inv_of_face_eq (x y : H cycle) (h : x.face = y.face) :
    x * y⁻¹ = central cycle (x.flow - y.flow)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Support.H.one_face
statement:
@[simp] theorem one_face
    {F : Type}
    {K : Type}
    [Fintype F]
    [AddCommGroup K]
    [_root_.Module Support.Scalar K]
    (cycle : F → K) : (1 : H cycle).face = 0

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Support.H.one_flow
statement:
@[simp] theorem one_flow
    {F : Type}
    {K : Type}
    [Fintype F]
    [AddCommGroup K]
    [_root_.Module Support.Scalar K]
    (cycle : F → K) : (1 : H cycle).flow = 0

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Support.H.projectedLift_face
statement:
@[simp] theorem projectedLift_face (S : Subgroup (H cycle)) (a : projected cycle S) :
    (projectedLift cycle S a).face = a.val

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Support.H.projectedLift_mem
statement:
theorem projectedLift_mem (S : Subgroup (H cycle)) (a : projected cycle S) :
    projectedLift cycle S a ∈ S

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Support.H.stabilizer_isotropic
statement:
theorem stabilizer_isotropic (S : Subgroup (H cycle)) (lambda : K →ₗ[Scalar] Scalar)
    (hlambda : ∀ k ∈ centralPart cycle S, lambda k = 0)
    {a b : F → Plane} (ha : a ∈ projected cycle S) (hb : b ∈ projected cycle S) :
    (∑ f, lambda (cycle f) * omega (a f) (b f)) = 0

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Support.H.subgroup_card
statement:
theorem subgroup_card [FiniteDimensional Scalar K] (S : Subgroup (H cycle)) :
    Nat.card S = 3 ^ (Module.finrank Scalar (projected cycle S) +
      Module.finrank Scalar (centralPart cycle S))

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Support.H.subgroup_index
statement:
theorem subgroup_index [FiniteDimensional Scalar K] (S : Subgroup (H cycle)) :
    S.index = 3 ^ ((Module.finrank Scalar (F → Plane) - Module.finrank Scalar (projected cycle S)) +
      (Module.finrank Scalar K - Module.finrank Scalar (centralPart cycle S)))

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Support.correction_add_left
statement:
@[simp] theorem correction_add_left (cycle : F → K) (a b c : F → Plane) :
    correction cycle (a + b) c = correction cycle a c + correction cycle b c

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Support.correction_add_right
statement:
@[simp] theorem correction_add_right (cycle : F → K) (a b c : F → Plane) :
    correction cycle a (b + c) = correction cycle a b + correction cycle a c

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Support.correction_neg_left
statement:
@[simp] theorem correction_neg_left (cycle : F → K) (a b : F → Plane) :
    correction cycle (-a) b = -correction cycle a b

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Support.correction_neg_right
statement:
@[simp] theorem correction_neg_right (cycle : F → K) (a b : F → Plane) :
    correction cycle a (-b) = -correction cycle a b

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Support.correction_self
statement:
@[simp] theorem correction_self (cycle : F → K) (a : F → Plane) :
    correction cycle a a = 0

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Support.correction_swap
statement:
theorem correction_swap (cycle : F → K) (a b : F → Plane) :
    correction cycle b a = -correction cycle a b

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Support.correction_zero_left
statement:
@[simp] theorem correction_zero_left (cycle : F → K) (a : F → Plane) :
    correction cycle 0 a = 0

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Support.correction_zero_right
statement:
@[simp] theorem correction_zero_right (cycle : F → K) (a : F → Plane) :
    correction cycle a 0 = 0

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Support.diagonalForm_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem diagonalForm_apply (weight : F → Scalar) (a b : F → Plane) :
    diagonalForm weight a b = ∑ f, weight f * omega (a f) (b f)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Support.diagonalForm_finrank_ker
OAI.CPTSeparation.Support.mem_diagonalForm_ker
statement:
theorem mem_diagonalForm_ker (weight : F → Scalar) (a : F → Plane) :
    a ∈ (diagonalForm weight).ker ↔ ∀ f, weight f ≠ 0 → a f = 0

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Support.nonzero_blocks_le_codim
statement:
theorem nonzero_blocks_le_codim (weight : F → Scalar)
    (U : Submodule Scalar (F → Plane))
    (hisotropic : ∀ a ∈ U, ∀ b ∈ U, diagonalForm weight a b = 0) :
    Fintype.card {f : F // weight f ≠ 0} ≤
      Module.finrank Scalar (F → Plane) - Module.finrank Scalar U

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Support.omega_add_left
statement:
@[simp] theorem omega_add_left (u v w : Plane) :
    omega (u + v) w = omega u w + omega v w

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Support.omega_add_right
statement:
@[simp] theorem omega_add_right (u v w : Plane) :
    omega u (v + w) = omega u v + omega u w

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Support.omega_neg_left
statement: @[simp] theorem omega_neg_left (u v : Plane) : omega (-u) v = -omega u v

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Support.omega_neg_right
statement: @[simp] theorem omega_neg_right (u v : Plane) : omega u (-v) = -omega u v

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Support.omega_self
statement: @[simp] theorem omega_self (u : Plane) : omega u u = 0

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Support.omega_smul_left
statement:
@[simp] theorem omega_smul_left (a : Scalar) (u v : Plane) :
    omega (a • u) v = a * omega u v

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Support.omega_smul_right
statement:
@[simp] theorem omega_smul_right (a : Scalar) (u v : Plane) :
    omega u (a • v) = a * omega u v

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Support.omega_swap
statement: theorem omega_swap (u v : Plane) : omega v u = -omega u v

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Support.omega_zero_left
statement: @[simp] theorem omega_zero_left (u : Plane) : omega 0 u = 0

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Support.omega_zero_right
statement: @[simp] theorem omega_zero_right (u : Plane) : omega u 0 = 0

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.AtomRelation.map
statement:
theorem AtomRelation.map (g : BoxGroup n) {r : Symbol} {x y : Atom b}
    (h : AtomRelation b r x y) : AtomRelation b r (g • x) (g • y)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.AtomRelation.map_iff
statement:
theorem AtomRelation.map_iff (g : BoxGroup n) (r : Symbol) (x y : Atom b) :
    AtomRelation b r (g • x) (g • y) ↔ AtomRelation b r x y

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.AtomShift.equal_iff
statement:
theorem AtomShift.equal_iff {t : Edge n → Scalar} {x x' : Atom b} {y y' : Atom b'}
    (h : AtomShift t x y) (h' : AtomShift t x' y') : x = x' ↔ y = y'

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.AtomShift.functional
statement:
theorem AtomShift.functional {t : Edge n → Scalar} {x : Atom b} {y z : Atom b'}
    (hy : AtomShift t x y) (hz : AtomShift t x z) : y = z

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.AtomShift.relation
OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.AtomShift.relation_iff
OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.AtomShift.symm
statement:
theorem AtomShift.symm {t : Edge n → Scalar} {x : Atom b} {y : Atom b'}
    (h : AtomShift t x y) : AtomShift (-t) y x

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.Configuration.ext
statement:
@[ext] theorem Configuration.ext {b : Vertex n → Scalar} {v : Vertex n}
    {s t : Configuration b v} (h : ∀ e, s.state e = t.state e) : s = t

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.Configuration.shift_state
statement:
@[simp] theorem Configuration.shift_state {v : Vertex n} (s : Configuration b v)
    (t : Edge n → Scalar) (h : boundary t v = b' v - b v) (e : IncidentEdges v) :
    (s.shift t h).state e = shiftLocal e.val (t e.val) (s.state e)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.actState_compatible
statement:
theorem actState_compatible {v : Vertex n} (g : BoxGroup n) (s : LocalStates v)
    (hs : Compatible s) : Compatible (actState g s)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.actState_divergence
statement:
theorem actState_divergence {v : Vertex n} (g : BoxGroup n) (s : LocalStates v)
    (hs : Compatible s) : divergence (actState g s) = divergence s

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.atomInput_rel_true
statement:
@[simp] theorem atomInput_rel_true (r : Symbol) (x y : Atom b) :
    (atomInput b).rel r x y = true ↔ AtomRelation b r x y

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.blockShiftEquiv_config
statement:
theorem blockShiftEquiv_config (te : Edge n → Edge n → Scalar) (tv : Vertex n → Edge n → Scalar)
    (hv : ∀ v, boundary (tv v) v = b' v - b v) (v : Vertex n) (s : Configuration b v) :
    blockShiftEquiv te tv hv (.inr ⟨v,s⟩) = .inr ⟨v,s.shift (tv v) (hv v)⟩

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.blockShiftEquiv_edge
statement:
theorem blockShiftEquiv_edge (te : Edge n → Edge n → Scalar) (tv : Vertex n → Edge n → Scalar)
    (hv : ∀ v, boundary (tv v) v = b' v - b v) (e : Edge n) (s : LocalGroup e) :
    blockShiftEquiv te tv hv (.inl ⟨e,s⟩) = .inl ⟨e,shiftLocal e (te e e) s⟩

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.block_normalized
statement:
theorem block_normalized (hn : 1 ≤ n) (lambda : (atomInput b).Config → Scalar)
    (hl : (atomInput b).normalized lambda) (v : Vertex n) :
    (∑ t : Configuration b v, lambda (queryConfig v t)) = 1

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.boundary_eval
statement:
theorem boundary_eval (z : Edge n → Scalar) (v : Vertex n) :
    boundary z v = ∑ e, epsilon v e * z e

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.box_subgroup_index
statement:
theorem box_subgroup_index (S : Subgroup (BoxGroup n)) :
    S.index = 3 ^ (faceCodim S + flowCodim S)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.central_fix_zeroEdgeAtom_iff
statement:
@[simp] theorem central_fix_zeroEdgeAtom_iff (k : FlowSpace n) (e : Edge n) :
    Support.H.central flowCycle k • zeroEdgeAtom b e = zeroEdgeAtom b e ↔ k.val e = 0

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.central_smul_atom
statement:
@[simp] theorem central_smul_atom (k : CentralGroup n) (x : Atom b) :
    k • x = Support.H.central flowCycle k.toAdd • x

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.coefficient_incident
statement:
theorem coefficient_incident (v : Vertex n) (s : Configuration b v)
    (e : Edge n) (g : LocalGroup e) (he : incident v e) :
    (atomInput b).coefficient (queryEdge e g) (queryConfig v s) =
      (g⁻¹ * s.state ⟨e,he⟩).flow

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.compatible_iff_extend
statement:
theorem compatible_iff_extend {v : Vertex n} (s : LocalStates v) :
    Compatible s ↔ ∃ u : Face n → Plane,
      ∀ (e : IncidentEdges v) (f : EdgeFaces e.val), (s e).face f = u f.val

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.curl_count_le_codim
statement:
theorem curl_count_le_codim (S : Subgroup (BoxGroup n))
    (lambda : FlowSpace n →ₗ[Scalar] Scalar)
    (hlambda : lambda ∈ (Support.H.centralPart flowCycle S).dualAnnihilator)
    (l : Edge n → Scalar) (hl : ∀ k : FlowSpace n, pairing l k.val = lambda k) :
    (nonzeroSet (curl l)).card ≤ faceCodim S

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.curl_representative
statement:
theorem curl_representative (lambda : FlowSpace n →ₗ[Scalar] Scalar) (l : Edge n → Scalar)
    (hl : ∀ k : FlowSpace n, pairing l k.val = lambda k) (f : Face n) :
    curl l f = lambda (flowCycle f)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.degree_le_six
statement:
theorem degree_le_six (v : Vertex n) :
    Fintype.card {e : Edge n // head e = v ∨ tail e = v} ≤ 6

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.edge_support_tuple
statement:
theorem edge_support_tuple {X : Type*} [MulAction (BoxGroup n) X]
    (T : Finset (Edge n)) (x : X)
    (hx : ∀ k : FlowSpace n, (∀ e ∈ T, k.val e = 0) →
      Support.H.central flowCycle k • x = x) :
    ∃ alpha : Fin T.card → Atom b, ∀ k : CentralGroup n,
      (∀ i, k • alpha i = alpha i) → centralHom k • x = x

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.epsilon_eq_zero
statement:
theorem epsilon_eq_zero (v : Vertex n) (e : Edge n) (h : ¬ incident v e) :
    epsilon v e = 0

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.epsilon_head
statement: @[simp] theorem epsilon_head (e : Edge n) : epsilon (head e) e = 1

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.epsilon_sq
statement: theorem epsilon_sq (v : Vertex n) (e : IncidentEdges v) : epsilon v e.val ^ 2 = 1

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.epsilon_tail
statement: @[simp] theorem epsilon_tail (e : Edge n) : epsilon (tail e) e = -1

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.exists_head_or_tail
statement:
theorem exists_head_or_tail (hn : 1 ≤ n) (v : Vertex n) :
    ∃ e : Edge n, head e = v ∨ tail e = v

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.exists_queryConfig
statement:
theorem exists_queryConfig (a : (atomInput b).Config) :
    ∃ (v : Vertex n) (s : Configuration b v), a = queryConfig v s

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.exists_queryEdge
statement:
theorem exists_queryEdge (y : (atomInput b).Edge) :
    ∃ (e : Edge n) (g : LocalGroup e), y = queryEdge e g

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.exists_representative
statement:
theorem exists_representative (lambda : FlowSpace n →ₗ[Scalar] Scalar) :
    ∃ l : Edge n → Scalar, ∀ k : FlowSpace n, pairing l k.val = lambda k

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.flow_query_eq
statement:
theorem flow_query_eq (hn : 1 ≤ n) (lambda : (atomInput b).Config → Scalar)
    (mu : (atomInput b).Edge → Scalar) (h : (atomInput b).consistent lambda mu)
    (v : Vertex n) (e : IncidentEdges v) :
    mu (queryEdge e.val 1) = ∑ t : Configuration b v, lambda (queryConfig v t) * (t.state e).flow

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.head_injective_on_axis
statement:
theorem head_injective_on_axis {e e' : Edge n}
    (ha : edgeAxis e = edgeAxis e') (hh : head e = head e') : e = e'

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.head_ne_tail
statement: theorem head_ne_tail (e : Edge n) : head e ≠ tail e

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.opposite_answers
statement:
theorem opposite_answers (hn : 1 ≤ n) (vstar : Vertex n) :
    (atomInput (0 : Vertex n → Scalar)).query ∧
      ¬ (atomInput (Pi.single vstar (1 : Scalar))).query

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.orbit_card_eq_power
statement:
theorem orbit_card_eq_power {X : Type*} [MulAction (BoxGroup n) X] (x : X) :
    Nat.card (MulAction.orbit (BoxGroup n) x) =
      3 ^ (faceCodim (MulAction.stabilizer (BoxGroup n) x) +
        flowCodim (MulAction.stabilizer (BoxGroup n) x))

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.pairing_boundary
statement:
theorem pairing_boundary (φ : Vertex n → Scalar) (z : Edge n → Scalar) :
    pairing φ (boundary z) = pairing (gradient φ) z

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.pairing_gradient_flow
statement:
@[simp] theorem pairing_gradient_flow (φ : Vertex n → Scalar) (k : FlowSpace n) :
    pairing (gradient φ) k.val = 0

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.pairing_single
statement:
@[simp] theorem pairing_single {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (l : ι → Scalar) (e : ι) (z : Scalar) : pairing l (Pi.single e z) = l e * z

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.pairing_sub
statement:
theorem pairing_sub {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (l r z : ι → Scalar) :
    pairing (l-r) z = pairing l z - pairing r z

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.queryConfig_eq
OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.queryEdge_eq
statement:
@[simp] theorem queryEdge_eq {e e' : Edge n} {g : LocalGroup e} {g' : LocalGroup e'} :
    queryEdge (b := b) e g = queryEdge e' g' ↔ (⟨e,g⟩ : Σ e, LocalGroup e) = ⟨e',g'⟩

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.query_implies_total_charge_zero
statement:
theorem query_implies_total_charge_zero (hn : 1 ≤ n) (hq : (atomInput b).query) :
    (∑ v, b v) = 0

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.query_incident_iff
statement:
theorem query_incident_iff (v : Vertex n) (s : Configuration b v)
    (e : Edge n) (g : LocalGroup e) :
    (atomInput b).incident (queryConfig v s) (queryEdge e g) ↔ incident v e

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.query_zero_charge
statement: theorem query_zero_charge : (atomInput (0 : Vertex n → Scalar)).query

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.rel_eb
statement:
@[simp] theorem rel_eb (e f : Edge n) (g : LocalGroup e) (h : LocalGroup f) :
    (atomInput b).rel .EB (queryEdge (b := b) e g) (queryEdge (b := b) f h) = true ↔ e = f

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.rel_inc
statement:
@[simp] theorem rel_inc (v : Vertex n) (s : Configuration b v) (e : Edge n)
    (g : LocalGroup e) :
    (atomInput b).rel .I (queryConfig v s) (queryEdge (b := b) e g) = true ↔
      ∃ h : incident v e, s.state ⟨e,h⟩ = g

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.rel_vb
statement:
@[simp] theorem rel_vb (v w : Vertex n) (s : Configuration b v) (t : Configuration b w) :
    (atomInput b).rel .VB (queryConfig v s) (queryConfig w t) = true ↔ v = w

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.rel_z_edge
statement:
theorem rel_z_edge (e f : Edge n) (g : LocalGroup e) (h : LocalGroup f) (d : Scalar)
    (hz : (atomInput b).rel (.Z d) (queryEdge (b := b) e g) (queryEdge (b := b) f h) = true) : e = f

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.rel_z_same
statement:
@[simp] theorem rel_z_same (e : Edge n) (g h : LocalGroup e) (d : Scalar) :
    (atomInput b).rel (.Z d) (queryEdge (b := b) e g) (queryEdge (b := b) e h) = true ↔ (g⁻¹*h).flow = d

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.restrictGroup_face
statement:
@[simp] theorem restrictGroup_face (g : BoxGroup n) (e : Edge n) (f : EdgeFaces e) :
    (restrictGroup e g).face f = g.face f.val

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.restrictGroup_flow
statement:
@[simp] theorem restrictGroup_flow (g : BoxGroup n) (e : Edge n) :
    (restrictGroup e g).flow = g.flow.val e

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.shiftLocal_add
statement:
@[simp] theorem shiftLocal_add (e : Edge n) (z w : Scalar) (s : LocalGroup e) :
    shiftLocal e z (shiftLocal e w s) = shiftLocal e (z+w) s

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.shiftLocal_face
statement:
@[simp] theorem shiftLocal_face (e : Edge n) (z : Scalar) (s : LocalGroup e) :
    (shiftLocal e z s).face = s.face

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.shiftLocal_flow
statement:
@[simp] theorem shiftLocal_flow (e : Edge n) (z : Scalar) (s : LocalGroup e) :
    (shiftLocal e z s).flow = z+s.flow

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.shiftLocal_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem shiftLocal_zero (e : Edge n) (s : LocalGroup e) : shiftLocal e 0 s = s

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.shiftStates_compatible
statement:
theorem shiftStates_compatible {v : Vertex n} (t : Edge n → Scalar) (s : LocalStates v)
    (hs : Compatible s) : Compatible (shiftStates t s)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.shiftStates_divergence
statement:
theorem shiftStates_divergence {v : Vertex n} (t : Edge n → Scalar) (s : LocalStates v) :
    divergence (shiftStates t s) = boundary t v + divergence s

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.small_orbit_support_edges
statement:
theorem small_orbit_support_edges {X : Type*} [MulAction (BoxGroup n) X]
    (x : X) (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (q : ℝ) (_hq : 0 ≤ q)
    (horbit : (Nat.card (MulAction.orbit (BoxGroup n) x) : ℝ) ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ q) :
    ∃ T : Finset (Edge n),
      (T.card : ℝ) ≤ 2 * (n+1 : ℝ) * (q * Real.logb 3 N)^2 ∧
      ∀ k : FlowSpace n, (∀ e ∈ T, k.val e = 0) →
        Support.H.central flowCycle k • x = x

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.sparse_annihilator
statement:
theorem sparse_annihilator (S : Subgroup (BoxGroup n))
    (lambda : FlowSpace n →ₗ[Scalar] Scalar)
    (hlambda : lambda ∈ (Support.H.centralPart flowCycle S).dualAnnihilator) :
    ∃ r : Edge n → Scalar,
      (∀ k : FlowSpace n, pairing r k.val = lambda k) ∧
      (nonzeroSet r).card ≤ (n+1) * faceCodim S

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.subgroup_support_edges
statement:
theorem subgroup_support_edges (S : Subgroup (BoxGroup n)) :
    ∃ T : Finset (Edge n),
      T.card ≤ (n+1) * faceCodim S * flowCodim S ∧
      ∀ k : FlowSpace n, (∀ e ∈ T, k.val e = 0) →
        Support.H.central flowCycle k ∈ S

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.sum_block
statement:
theorem sum_block (v : Vertex n) (s : Configuration b v) (f : (atomInput b).Config → Scalar) :
    (∑ a : (atomInput b).Config, if (atomInput b).rel .VB (queryConfig v s) a then f a else 0) =
      ∑ t : Configuration b v, f (queryConfig v t)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.sum_boundary
statement: theorem sum_boundary (z : Edge n → Scalar) : ∑ v, boundary z v = 0

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.sum_incident
statement:
theorem sum_incident (z : Edge n → Scalar) (v : Vertex n) :
    (∑ e : IncidentEdges v, epsilon v e.val * z e.val) = boundary z v

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.sum_queryConfigs
statement:
theorem sum_queryConfigs {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] (f : (atomInput b).Config → M) :
    (∑ a, f a) = ∑ v, ∑ t, f (queryConfig v t)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.sum_queryEdges
statement:
theorem sum_queryEdges {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] (f : (atomInput b).Edge → M) :
    (∑ y, f y) = ∑ e, ∑ g, f (queryEdge e g)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.sum_subtype_zero
statement:
theorem sum_subtype_zero {ι M : Type*} [Fintype ι] [AddCommMonoid M]
    (p : ι → Prop) [DecidablePred p] (f : ι → M) (h : ∀ i, ¬ p i → f i = 0) :
    (∑ i : {x // p x}, f i.val) = ∑ i, f i

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.tail_injective_on_axis
statement:
theorem tail_injective_on_axis {e e' : Edge n}
    (ha : edgeAxis e = edgeAxis e') (hh : tail e = tail e') : e = e'

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.zsum_ne
statement:
theorem zsum_ne (e f : Edge n) (g : LocalGroup e) (h : LocalGroup f) (hne : e ≠ f) :
    (∑ d : Scalar, if (atomInput b).rel (.Z d)
      (queryEdge (b := b) e g) (queryEdge (b := b) f h) then d else 0) = 0

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.zsum_same
statement:
theorem zsum_same (e : Edge n) (g h : LocalGroup e) :
    (∑ d : Scalar, if (atomInput b).rel (.Z d)
      (queryEdge (b := b) e g) (queryEdge (b := b) e h) then d else 0) = (g⁻¹*h).flow

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Input.Iso.coefficient_eq
statement:
@[simp] theorem coefficient_eq (y : S.Edge) (a : S.Config) :
    T.coefficient (e.edgeEquiv y) (e.configEquiv a) = S.coefficient y a

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Input.Iso.configEquiv_val
OAI.CPTSeparation.Input.Iso.edgeEquiv_val
OAI.CPTSeparation.Input.Iso.incident_eq
OAI.CPTSeparation.Input.Iso.query_map
statement: theorem query_map : S.query → T.query

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Input.query_invariant
statement:
theorem query_invariant {S : Input A} {T : Input B} (e : S.Iso T) :
    S.query ↔ T.query

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Counting.Formula.eval_congr
statement:
theorem eval_congr (S : Structure R A) (φ : Formula R I) {v w : I → A}
    (h : ∀ i ∈ φ.free, v i = w i) : φ.eval S v ↔ φ.eval S w

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Counting.Formula.eval_conjoin
statement:
@[simp] theorem eval_conjoin (S : Structure R A) (l : List (Formula R I)) (v : I → A) :
    (conjoin l).eval S v ↔ ∀ φ ∈ l, φ.eval S v

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Counting.Formula.eval_of_bijectionSystem
statement:
theorem eval_of_bijectionSystem (S : Structure R A) (T : Structure R B)
    (E : (I → A) → (I → B) → Prop)
    (hequal : ∀ v w, E v w → ∀ i j, (v i = v j ↔ w i = w j))
    (hrel : ∀ v w, E v w → ∀ r i j, S.rel r (v i) (v j) ↔ T.rel r (w i) (w j))
    (hext : ∀ v w, E v w → ∀ i, ∃ e : A ≃ B,
      ∀ a, E (Function.update v i a) (Function.update w i (e a)))
    (φ : Formula R I) : ∀ v w, E v w → (φ.eval S v ↔ φ.eval T w)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Counting.Formula.eval_rename
statement:
@[simp] theorem eval_rename (S : Structure R A) (e : I ≃ I) (φ : Formula R I)
    (v : I → A) : (φ.rename e).eval S v ↔ φ.eval S (v ∘ e)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Counting.Formula.free_conjoin_subset
statement:
theorem free_conjoin_subset (l : List (Formula R I)) (S : Finset I)
    (h : ∀ φ ∈ l, φ.free ⊆ S) : (conjoin l).free ⊆ S

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Counting.Formula.free_rename
statement:
@[simp] theorem free_rename (e : I ≃ I) (φ : Formula R I) :
    (φ.rename e).free = φ.free.map e.toEmbedding

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Counting.eval_iso
statement:
theorem eval_iso (S : Structure R A) (T : Structure R B) (e : A ≃ B)
    (he : ∀ r a b, S.rel r a b ↔ T.rel r (e a) (e b))
    (φ : Formula R I) (v : I → A) : φ.eval S v ↔ φ.eval T (e ∘ v)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Counting.extend_type
statement:
theorem extend_type [Fintype I] [Fintype A] [Fintype B]
    (S : Structure R A) (T : Structure R B) (names extra : Finset I)
    (v : I → A) (w : I → B) (h : typeOf S names v = typeOf T names w) :
    ∃ w' : I → B, typeOf S (names ∪ extra) v = typeOf T (names ∪ extra) w' ∧
      ∀ i ∈ names, w' i = w i

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Counting.extension_bijection
statement:
theorem extension_bijection [Fintype I] [Fintype A] [Fintype B]
    (S : Structure R A) (T : Structure R B) (names : Finset I) (i : I)
    (hi : i ∉ names) (v : I → A) (w : I → B)
    (h : typeOf S names v = typeOf T names w) :
    ∃ e : A ≃ B, ∀ a, typeOf S (insert i names) (Function.update v i a) =
      typeOf T (insert i names) (Function.update w i (e a))

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Counting.extension_equiv
statement:
theorem extension_equiv [Fintype I] [Fintype A] [Fintype B]
    (S : Structure R A) (T : Structure R B) (names : Finset I) (i : I)
    (_ : i ∉ names) (v v₀ : I → A) (w : I → B)
    (htype : typeOf S names v = typeOf T names w) :
    Nonempty ({a : A // typeOf S (insert i names) (Function.update v i a) =
          typeOf S (insert i names) v₀} ≃
        {b : B // typeOf T (insert i names) (Function.update w i b) =
          typeOf S (insert i names) v₀})

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Counting.isolate_type
statement:
theorem isolate_type [Fintype I] [Fintype A] [Fintype B]
    (S : Structure R A) (T : Structure R B) (names : Finset I) (v₀ : I → A) :
    ∃ θ : Formula R I, θ.free ⊆ names ∧
      (∀ v, θ.eval S v ↔ typeOf S names v = typeOf S names v₀) ∧
      (∀ w, θ.eval T w ↔ typeOf T names w = typeOf S names v₀)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Counting.tupleAssignment_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem tupleAssignment_apply [Nonempty A] (e : J ↪ I) (a : J → A) (j : J) :
    tupleAssignment e a (e j) = a j

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Counting.tupleType_append
statement:
theorem tupleType_append (S : Structure R A) (T : Structure R B)
    (e : J ↪ I) (e' : J ⊕ D ↪ I) (a : J → A) (b : J → B) (c : D → A)
    (h : tupleType S e a = tupleType T e b) :
    ∃ d : D → B, tupleType S e' (Sum.elim a c) = tupleType T e' (Sum.elim b d)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Counting.tupleType_assignment
statement:
theorem tupleType_assignment [Nonempty A] (S : Structure R A) (e : J ↪ I)
    (a : J → A) (v : I → A) (h : ∀ j, v (e j) = a j) :
    tupleType S e a = typeOf S (tupleNames e) v

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Counting.tupleType_extend
statement:
theorem tupleType_extend [Fintype I] [Fintype A] [Fintype B]
    [Nonempty A] [Nonempty B]
    (S : Structure R A) (T : Structure R B) (e : J ↪ I) (e' : J' ↪ I)
    (u : J ↪ J') (a : J' → A) (b : J → B)
    (h : tupleType S e (a ∘ u) = tupleType T e b) :
    ∃ b' : J' → B, b' ∘ u = b ∧ tupleType S e' a = tupleType T e' b'

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Counting.tupleType_iso
statement:
theorem tupleType_iso {J : Type*} [Fintype J] [Nonempty A] [Nonempty B]
    (S : Structure R A) (T : Structure R B) (names : J ↪ I) (e : A ≃ B)
    (he : ∀ r a b, S.rel r a b ↔ T.rel r (e a) (e b)) (a : J → A) :
    tupleType S names a = tupleType T names (e ∘ a)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Counting.tupleType_project
statement:
theorem tupleType_project [Nonempty A] [Nonempty B]
    (S : Structure R A) (T : Structure R B) (e : J ↪ I) (e' : J' ↪ I)
    (u : J' ↪ J) (a : J → A) (b : J → B)
    (h : tupleType S e a = tupleType T e b) :
    tupleType S e' (a ∘ u) = tupleType T e' (b ∘ u)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Counting.typeOf_congr
statement:
theorem typeOf_congr (S : Structure R A) (names : Finset I) {v w : I → A}
    (h : ∀ i ∈ names, v i = w i) : typeOf S names v = typeOf S names w

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Counting.typeOf_eq_iff
statement:
theorem typeOf_eq_iff (S : Structure R A) (T : Structure R B) (names : Finset I)
    (v : I → A) (w : I → B) : typeOf S names v = typeOf T names w ↔
      ∀ φ : Formula R I, φ.free ⊆ names → (φ.eval S v ↔ φ.eval T w)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Counting.typeOf_permute
statement:
theorem typeOf_permute (S : Structure R A) (T : Structure R B)
    (names : Finset I) (e : I ≃ I) {v : I → A} {w : I → B}
    (h : typeOf S names v = typeOf T names w) :
    typeOf S (names.map e.symm.toEmbedding) (v ∘ e) =
      typeOf T (names.map e.symm.toEmbedding) (w ∘ e)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Counting.typeOf_project
statement:
theorem typeOf_project (S : Structure R A) (T : Structure R B)
    {names small : Finset I} (hsub : small ⊆ names) {v : I → A} {w : I → B}
    (h : typeOf S names v = typeOf T names w) :
    typeOf S small v = typeOf T small w

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Counting.type_separator
statement:
theorem type_separator (S : Structure R A) (T : Structure R B) (names : Finset I)
    (v : I → A) (w : I → B) (hne : typeOf S names v ≠ typeOf T names w) :
    ∃ φ : Formula R I, φ.free ⊆ names ∧ φ.eval S v ∧ ¬ φ.eval T w

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.AtomShift.analysisRelation
OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.AtomShift.classLabel
statement:
theorem AtomShift.classLabel {t : Edge n → Scalar} {x : Atom b} {y : Atom b'}
    (h : AtomShift t x y) : Grid.classLabel x = Grid.classLabel y

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.AtomShift.congr
statement:
theorem AtomShift.congr {t t' : Edge n → Scalar} {x : Atom b} {y : Atom b'}
    (h : AtomShift t x y) (he : ∀ e ∈ touch x, t e = t' e) : AtomShift t' x y

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.AtomShift.stateAt_flow
statement:
theorem AtomShift.stateAt_flow {t : Edge n → Scalar} {x y : Atom b}
    (h : AtomShift t x y) (e : Edge n) (he : e ∈ touch x) :
    (stateAt y e (by rw [←touch_shift h]; exact he)).flow =
      t e + (stateAt x e he).flow

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.AtomShift.unique_on_touch
OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.atomShift_of_states
statement:
theorem atomShift_of_states (x y : Atom b) (t : Edge n → Scalar)
    (hc : classLabel x = classLabel y)
    (hs : ∀ e (he : e ∈ touch x), HasState y e (shiftLocal e (t e) (stateAt x e he))) :
    AtomShift t x y

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.augment_card

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.blockEdges_card
statement: theorem blockEdges_card (J : Block n) : (blockEdges J).card ≤ 6

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.classLabel_edge_iff

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.classLabel_shiftConfig

@[simp] theorem classLabel_shiftConfig (v : Vertex n) (s : Configuration b v)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.classLabel_shiftLocal

@[simp] theorem classLabel_shiftLocal (e : Edge n) (s : LocalGroup e) (t : Scalar) :
    classLabel (b := b') (.inl ⟨e,shiftLocal e t s⟩) = classLabel (b := b) (.inl ⟨e,s⟩)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.eval_classFormula
OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.free_classFormula
statement:
theorem free_classFormula {I : Type*} [DecidableEq I] (i j : I) (h : ℕ) :

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.hasState_config
statement:
@[simp] theorem hasState_config (v : Vertex n) (s : Configuration b v)
    (e : Edge n) (t : LocalGroup e) :

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.hasState_edge

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.hasState_stateAt

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.namesBelow_spare
statement:
theorem namesBelow_spare {P : Type*} [Fintype P] {M : ℕ} (h : Fintype.card P < M) :
    (⟨Fintype.card P,h⟩ : Fin M) ∉ Counting.tupleNames (namesBelow h)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.occurrences_card
statement: theorem occurrences_card (a : J → Atom b) : Fintype.card (Occurrences a) ≤ 6*Fintype.card J

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.predecessors_recovers_class

theorem predecessors_recovers_class {x y : Atom b}

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.stateAt_config
