@[simp] theorem stateAt_config (v : Vertex n) (s : Configuration b v) (e : IncidentEdges v)
    (he : e.val ∈ touch (.inr ⟨v,s⟩)) : stateAt (.inr ⟨v,s⟩) e.val he = s.state e

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.stateAt_edge
statement:
@[simp] theorem stateAt_edge (e : Edge n) (s : LocalGroup e)
    (he : e ∈ touch (b := b) (.inl ⟨e,s⟩)) : stateAt (.inl ⟨e,s⟩) e he = s

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.touch_card
statement: theorem touch_card (x : Atom b) : (touch x).card ≤ 6

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.touch_shift
statement:
theorem touch_shift {t : Edge n → Scalar} {x : Atom b} {y : Atom b'}
    (h : AtomShift t x y) : touch x = touch y

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.touch_subset_touches
statement:
theorem touch_subset_touches {I : Type*} [DecidableEq I] (names : Finset I)
    (v : I → Atom b) {i : I} (hi : i ∈ names) : touch (v i) ⊆ touches names v

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.touches_card
statement:
theorem touches_card {I : Type*} [DecidableEq I] (names : Finset I) (v : I → Atom b) :
    (touches names v).card ≤ 6*names.card

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.touches_insert_update
statement:
theorem touches_insert_update {I : Type*} [DecidableEq I] (names : Finset I)
    (v : I → Atom b) (i : I) (a : Atom b) :
    touches (insert i (names.erase i)) (Function.update v i a) =
      touches (names.erase i) v ∪ touch a

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.touches_mono
statement:
theorem touches_mono {I : Type*} [DecidableEq I] {s t : Finset I} (hst : s ⊆ t)
    (v : I → Atom b) : touches s v ⊆ touches t v

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.tuple_partial_shift
statement:
theorem tuple_partial_shift {M : ℕ} [Nonempty (Atom b)] (names : J ↪ Fin M)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.type_recovers_classes
statement:
theorem type_recovers_classes {I : Type*} [DecidableEq I] (names : Finset I)
    {v w : I → Atom b} (ht : Counting.typeOf (analysisStructure b) names v =
      Counting.typeOf (analysisStructure b) names w) {i j : I} (hi : i ∈ names) (hne : i ≠ j) :
    classLabel (v i) = classLabel (w i)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.BoxLines.line_count
statement:
theorem line_count (R : Finset (Fin (n+1) × J)) :
    (n+1) * (projection R).card ≤ (n+1) * (edgeBoundary R).card + R.card

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.BoxLines.partial_line_boundary
OAI.CPTSeparation.Counting.Formula.eval_of_partialBijectionSystem
statement:
theorem eval_of_partialBijectionSystem (S : Structure R A) (T : Structure R B)
    (E : Finset I → (I → A) → (I → B) → Prop)
    (heq : ∀ names v w, E names v w → ∀ i ∈ names, ∀ j ∈ names, (v i = v j ↔ w i = w j))
    (hrel : ∀ names v w, E names v w → ∀ r i, i ∈ names → ∀ j, j ∈ names →
      (S.rel r (v i) (v j) ↔ T.rel r (w i) (w j)))
    (hext : ∀ names v w, E names v w → ∀ i, ∃ e : A ≃ B,
      ∀ a, E (insert i (names.erase i)) (Function.update v i a) (Function.update w i (e a)))
    (φ : Formula R I) : ∀ names v w, E names v w → φ.free ⊆ names →
      (φ.eval S v ↔ φ.eval T w)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Flows.boundary_cell_subset
statement:
theorem boundary_cell_subset (c : Component tail head T) :
    edgeBoundary tail head (cell tail head T c) ⊆ T

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Flows.partial_flow_iff
statement:
theorem partial_flow_iff (σ : E → Scalar) :
    (∃ k : E → Scalar, incidence tail head k = 0 ∧ ∀ e ∈ T, k e = σ e) ↔
      ∀ v, ∑ w ∈ component tail head T v,
        incidence tail head (fun e => if e ∈ T then σ e else 0) w = 0

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Flows.solvable_iff
statement:
theorem solvable_iff (b : V → Scalar) :
    (∃ t : E → Scalar, (∀ e ∈ T, t e = 0) ∧ incidence tail head t = b) ↔
      ∀ v, ∑ w ∈ component tail head T v, b w = 0

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Flows.sum_boundary_cells
statement:
theorem sum_boundary_cells :
    ∑ c : Component tail head T, (edgeBoundary tail head (cell tail head T c)).card ≤ 2*T.card

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Flows.sum_incidence_component
statement:
theorem sum_incidence_component (t : E → Scalar) (ht : ∀ e ∈ T, t e = 0) (v : V) :
    ∑ w ∈ component tail head T v, incidence tail head t w = 0

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.AtomShift.config_boundary
OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.CompatibleAssignment.extend
statement:
theorem CompatibleAssignment.extend (hn : 1 ≤ n) (hbound : GiantBound n M)
    (names : Finset (Fin M)) (a : Fin M → Atom b) (a' : Fin M → Atom b')
    (h : CompatibleAssignment names a a') (i : Fin M) :
    ∃ e : Atom b ≃ Atom b', ∀ x,
      CompatibleAssignment (insert i (names.erase i)) (Function.update a i x) (Function.update a' i (e x))

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.CompatibleAssignment.mono
OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.base_equivalence_numeric
statement:
theorem base_equivalence_numeric (hn : 1 ≤ n) (hbound : GiantBound n M) (vstar : Vertex n)
    (φ : Counting.Formula AnalysisSymbol (Fin M)) (hφ : φ.free = ∅)
    (a : Fin M → Atom (0 : Vertex n → Scalar))
    (a' : Fin M → Atom (Pi.single vstar 1)) :
    φ.eval (analysisStructure (0 : Vertex n → Scalar)) a ↔
      φ.eval (analysisStructure (Pi.single vstar 1)) a'

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.boundary_eq_incidence
statement:
theorem boundary_eq_incidence : (boundary : (Edge n → Scalar) →ₗ[Scalar] (Vertex n → Scalar)) =

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.boxConstant_pos
statement: theorem boxConstant_pos : 0 < boxConstant

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.box_boundary
statement:
theorem box_boundary {n : ℕ} (R : Finset (Vertex n)) (hne : R.Nonempty)
    (hhalf : 2*R.card ≤ (n+1)^3) :
    boxConstant * (R.card:ℝ)^((2:ℝ)/3) ≤ (edgeBoundary R).card

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.central_atomShift
statement:
theorem central_atomShift (k : CentralGroup n) (x : Atom b) :

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.defect_transport
statement:
theorem defect_transport (hbound : GiantBound n M) (T U : Finset (Edge n)) (hTU : T ⊆ U)
    (hU : U.card ≤ 6*M) (t : Edge n → Scalar) (w : Vertex n)
    (hw : Flows.IsGiant tail head T w) (ht : boundary t = b'-b-Pi.single w 1) :
    ∃ t' : Edge n → Scalar, ∃ w' : Vertex n,
      Flows.IsGiant tail head U w' ∧ boundary t' = b'-b-Pi.single w' 1 ∧ ∀ e ∈ T, t' e = t e

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.empty_homogeneity
statement:
theorem empty_homogeneity {J : Type*} [IsEmpty J] (a a' : J → Atom b) :
    ∃ k : CentralGroup n, ∀ j, k • a j = a' j

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.exists_giant
statement:
theorem exists_giant (T : Finset (Edge n))
    (hnum : ((2*T.card:ℝ)/boxConstant)^((3:ℝ)/2) < ((n+1)^3:ℕ)) :
    ∃ c : Flows.Component tail head T, (n+1)^3 < 2*(Flows.cell tail head T c).card

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.giant_exists_of_bound
statement:
theorem giant_exists_of_bound (hbound : GiantBound n M) (T : Finset (Edge n)) (hT : T.card ≤ 6*M) :

statement: theorem grid_connected (v w : Vertex n) : (Flows.connected tail head ∅).r v w

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.moveZ_injective
statement: theorem moveZ_injective : Function.Injective (@moveZ n)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.partial_flow_small_obstruction
statement:
theorem partial_flow_small_obstruction (T : Finset (Edge n)) (σ : Edge n → Scalar)
    (hfail : ¬ ∃ k : Edge n → Scalar, Flows.incidence tail head k = 0 ∧
      ∀ e ∈ T, k e = σ e) :
    ∃ c : Flows.Component tail head T,
      (∑ v ∈ Flows.cell tail head T c,
        Flows.incidence tail head (fun e => if e ∈ T then σ e else 0) v) ≠ 0 ∧
      2*(Flows.cell tail head T c).card ≤ (n+1)^3 ∧
      ((Flows.cell tail head T c).card:ℝ) ≤
        (T.card/boxConstant)^((3:ℝ)/2)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.projection_line_bounds
statement:
theorem projection_line_bounds (R : Finset (Vertex n)) :
    let A := (R.image fun v => (v.1,v.2.1)).card
    let B := (R.image fun v => (v.1,v.2.2)).card
    let D := (R.image fun v => (v.2.1,v.2.2)).card
    (n+1)*A ≤ (n+1)*(edgeBoundary R).card + R.card ∧
    (n+1)*B ≤ (n+1)*(edgeBoundary R).card + R.card ∧
    (n+1)*D ≤ (n+1)*(edgeBoundary R).card + R.card

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.quantitative_homogeneity
statement:
theorem quantitative_homogeneity (hn : 1 ≤ n) {J : Type*} [Fintype J] [Nonempty (Atom b)]
    (names : J ↪ Fin M) (a a' : J → Atom b)
    (hw : (7*Fintype.card J:ℝ) + 7*((6*Fintype.card J:ℝ)/boxConstant)^((3:ℝ)/2)+1 ≤ M)
    (ht : Counting.tupleType (analysisStructure b) names a =
      Counting.tupleType (analysisStructure b) names a') :
    ∃ k : CentralGroup n, ∀ j, k • a j = a' j

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.quantitative_homogeneity_shift
statement:
theorem quantitative_homogeneity_shift (hn : 1 ≤ n) {J : Type*} [Fintype J] [Nonempty (Atom b)]
    (names : J ↪ Fin M) (a a' : J → Atom b)
    (hw : (7*Fintype.card J:ℝ) + 7*((6*Fintype.card J:ℝ)/boxConstant)^((3:ℝ)/2)+1 ≤ M)
    (ht : Counting.tupleType (analysisStructure b) names a =
      Counting.tupleType (analysisStructure b) names a') :
    ∃ k : Edge n → Scalar, boundary k = 0 ∧ ∀ j, AtomShift k (a j) (a' j)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.small_cell_bound

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.small_components_bound

    (∑ c ∈ S, ((Flows.cell tail head T c).card:ℝ)) ≤

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Counting.snocTuple_castSucc

@[simp] theorem snocTuple_castSucc {n : ℕ} (a : Fin n → A) (x : A) (i : Fin n) :

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Counting.tupleType_append_bijection
statement:
theorem tupleType_append_bijection {D : Type*} [Fintype D]
    (S : Structure R A) (T : Structure R B)
    (e : J ↪ I) (E : J ⊕ D ↪ I) (a : J → A) (b : J → B)
    (ht : tupleType S e a = tupleType T e b) :
    ∃ f : (D → A) ≃ (D → B), ∀ c,
      tupleType S E (Sum.elim a c) = tupleType T E (Sum.elim b (f c))

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Counting.tupleType_append_fin_bijection
statement:
theorem tupleType_append_fin_bijection (S : Structure R A) (T : Structure R B)
    (e : J ↪ I) (n : ℕ) (E : J ⊕ Fin n ↪ I) (a : J → A) (b : J → B)
    (ht : tupleType S e a = tupleType T e b) :
    ∃ f : (Fin n → A) ≃ (Fin n → B), ∀ c,
      tupleType S E (Sum.elim a c) = tupleType T E (Sum.elim b (f c))

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Counting.tupleType_append_one_bijection
statement:
theorem tupleType_append_one_bijection (S : Structure R A) (T : Structure R B)
    (e : J ↪ I) (E : J ⊕ Unit ↪ I) (a : J → A) (b : J → B)
    (ht : tupleType S e a = tupleType T e b) :
    ∃ f : A ≃ B, ∀ x, tupleType S E (Sum.elim a (fun _ => x)) =
      tupleType T E (Sum.elim b (fun _ => f x))

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Counting.tupleType_extension_equiv
statement:
theorem tupleType_extension_equiv {D : Type*} [Fintype D]
    (S : Structure R A) (T : Structure R B)
    (e : J ↪ I) (E : J ⊕ D ↪ I) (a : J → A) (b : J → B)
    (ht : tupleType S e a = tupleType T e b) (τ : Set (Formula R I)) :
    Nonempty ({c : D → A // tupleType S E (Sum.elim a c) = τ} ≃
      {d : D → B // tupleType T E (Sum.elim b d) = τ})

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Forms.elim_comp_cross31

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Forms.membership_transfer

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Hereditary.not_mem_atom
statement: @[simp] theorem not_mem_atom (x : HF A) (a : A) : ¬ x ∈ atom a

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Hereditary.ofFinset_elements
statement: theorem ofFinset_elements {x : HF A} (hx : isSet x = true) : ofFinset (elements x) = x

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Hereditary.rank_atom
statement: @[simp] theorem rank_atom (a : A) : rank (atom a) = 0

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Hereditary.rank_mk
statement: @[simp] theorem rank_mk (l : Lists A) : rank (mk l) = rawRank l

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Hereditary.rawMap_comp
statement:
theorem rawMap_comp {C : Type*} (g : B → C) (f : A → B) (l : Lists A) :
    rawMap g (rawMap f l) = rawMap (g ∘ f) l

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Hereditary.rawMap_congr
statement:
theorem rawMap_congr (f : A → B) {l r : Lists A} (h : Lists.Equiv l r) :

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Hereditary.rawMap_id
statement: @[simp] theorem rawMap_id : ∀ l : Lists A, rawMap id l = l

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Hereditary.smul_atom
statement:
@[simp] theorem smul_atom {G : Type*} [Group G] [MulAction G A] (g : G) (a : A) :
    g • atom a = atom (g • a)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Hereditary.smul_ofFinset
statement:
@[simp] theorem smul_ofFinset {G : Type*} [Group G] [MulAction G A] (g : G) (s : Finset (HF A)) :
    g • ofFinset s = ofFinset (s.image (fun x => g • x))

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Hereditary.toList_rawMap'
statement:
theorem toList_rawMap' (f : A → B) {b : Bool} (l : Lists' A b) :
    (rawMap' f l).toList = l.toList.map (rawMap f)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Forms.hf_transfer
statement:
theorem hf_transfer {m M : ℕ} (hs : 0 < s) (_ : 0 < m) (hM : 0 < M)
    (hwidth : max 4 (m+1) * s ≤ M)
    (hAutA : ∀ (g : G) r a b, S.rel r (g • a) (g • b) ↔ S.rel r a b)
    (hAutB : ∀ (g : H) r a b, T.rel r (g • a) (g • b) ↔ T.rel r a b)
    (hHomA : HomogeneousThrough S G M (max 2 m * s))
    (hHomB : HomogeneousThrough T H M (max 2 m * s))
    (hbase : tupleType S (Function.Embedding.ofIsEmpty : Empty ↪ Fin M) Empty.elim =
      tupleType T (Function.Embedding.ofIsEmpty : Empty ↪ Fin M) Empty.elim)
    (φ : Formula (HFRelation R) (Fin m)) (hφ : φ.free = ∅)
    (v : Fin m → Domain (A := A) G s) (w : Fin m → Domain (A := B) H s) :
    φ.eval (hfStructure S) v ↔ φ.eval (hfStructure T) w

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Forms.label_overlap_transfer
statement:
theorem label_overlap_transfer (e0 : P ↪ I) (p : P → A) (q : P → B)
    (hp : tupleType S e0 p = tupleType T e0 q)
    (φ ψ : Form (Fin s) (Set (Formula R I))) (τ σ : Set (Formula R I))
    (hx : ∃ x, x ∈ labelValues S ep e2 p τ φ ∧ x ∈ labelValues S ep e2 p σ ψ) :
    ∃ y, y ∈ labelValues T ep e2 q τ φ ∧ y ∈ labelValues T ep e2 q σ ψ

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Forms.label_partition
statement:
theorem label_partition
    (hHom : ∀ a b : P ⊕ Fin s → A,
      tupleType S ep a = tupleType S ep b → ∃ g : G, ∀ i, g • a i = b i)
    (φ ψ : Form (Fin s) (Set (Formula R I))) (σ : Set (Formula R I)) (x : HF A)
    (hx : x ∈ labelValues S ep e2 p τ φ) (hx' : x ∈ labelValues S ep e2 p σ ψ) :
    labelValues S ep e2 p τ φ = labelValues S ep e2 p σ ψ

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Forms.label_values_card
statement:
theorem label_values_card
    {G H : Type*} [Group G] [MulAction G A] [Group H] [MulAction H B]
    (hAutA : ∀ (g : G) r a b, S.rel r (g • a) (g • b) ↔ S.rel r a b)
    (hAutB : ∀ (g : H) r a b, T.rel r (g • a) (g • b) ↔ T.rel r a b)
    (hHomA : ∀ a b : P ⊕ Fin s → A,
      tupleType S ep a = tupleType S ep b → ∃ g : G, ∀ i, g • a i = b i)
    (hHomB : ∀ a b : P ⊕ Fin s → B,
      tupleType T ep a = tupleType T ep b → ∃ g : H, ∀ i, g • a i = b i)
    (p : P → A) (q : P → B) (τ : Set (Formula R I))
    (φ : Form (Fin s) (Set (Formula R I)))
    (a : Molecules S ep p τ) (a' : Molecules T ep q τ) :
    Nat.card (labelValues S ep e2 p τ φ) = Nat.card (labelValues T ep e2 q τ φ)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Forms.represented_equal
statement:
theorem represented_equal (v : V → Domain (A := A) G s) (w : V → Domain (A := B) H s)
    (h : Represented S T ef e2 v w) (i j : V) : v i = v j ↔ w i = w j

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Forms.represented_extension
statement:
theorem represented_extension (hs : 0 < s)
    (hHomA2 : ∀ a b : Fin s ⊕ Fin s → A,
      tupleType S e2 a = tupleType S e2 b → ∃ g : G, ∀ i, g • a i = b i)
    (hHomB2 : ∀ a b : Fin s ⊕ Fin s → B,
      tupleType T e2 a = tupleType T e2 b → ∃ g : H, ∀ i, g • a i = b i)
    (hHomA : ∀ a b : V × Fin s → A,
      tupleType S ef a = tupleType S ef b → ∃ g : G, ∀ i, g • a i = b i)
    (hHomB : ∀ a b : V × Fin s → B,
      tupleType T ef a = tupleType T ef b → ∃ g : H, ∀ i, g • a i = b i)
    (v : V → Domain (A := A) G s) (w : V → Domain (A := B) H s)
    (h : Represented S T ef e2 v w) (i : V) :
    ∃ f : Domain (A := A) G s ≃ Domain (A := B) H s,
      ∀ x, Represented S T ef e2 (Function.update v i x) (Function.update w i (f x))

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Forms.represented_mem
statement:
theorem represented_mem (v : V → Domain (A := A) G s) (w : V → Domain (A := B) H s)
    (h : Represented S T ef e2 v w) (i j : V) : (v i).1 ∈ (v j).1 ↔ (w i).1 ∈ (w j).1

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Forms.supported_domain_bijection
statement:
theorem supported_domain_bijection (hs : 0 < s) (e0 : P ↪ I)
    (hHomA2 : ∀ a b : Fin s ⊕ Fin s → A,
      tupleType S e2 a = tupleType S e2 b → ∃ g : G, ∀ i, g • a i = b i)
    (hHomB2 : ∀ a b : Fin s ⊕ Fin s → B,
      tupleType T e2 a = tupleType T e2 b → ∃ g : H, ∀ i, g • a i = b i)
    (hHomA : ∀ a b : P ⊕ Fin s → A,
      tupleType S ep a = tupleType S ep b → ∃ g : G, ∀ i, g • a i = b i)
    (hHomB : ∀ a b : P ⊕ Fin s → B,
      tupleType T ep a = tupleType T ep b → ∃ g : H, ∀ i, g • a i = b i)
    (p : P → A) (q : P → B) (hp : tupleType S e0 p = tupleType T e0 q) :
    ∃ f : Domain (A := A) G s ≃ Domain (A := B) H s,
      ∀ x, ∃ φ : Form (Fin s) (Set (Formula R I)), ∃ a : Fin s → A, ∃ b : Fin s → B,
        Form.value S e2 φ a = x.1 ∧ Form.value T e2 φ b = (f x).1 ∧
        tupleType S ep (Sum.elim p a) = tupleType T ep (Sum.elim q b)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Forms.supported_eval_transfer
statement:
theorem supported_eval_transfer (hs : 0 < s)
    (hHomA2 : ∀ a b : Fin s ⊕ Fin s → A,
      tupleType S e2 a = tupleType S e2 b → ∃ g : G, ∀ i, g • a i = b i)
    (hHomB2 : ∀ a b : Fin s ⊕ Fin s → B,
      tupleType T e2 a = tupleType T e2 b → ∃ g : H, ∀ i, g • a i = b i)
    (hHomA : ∀ a b : V × Fin s → A,
      tupleType S ef a = tupleType S ef b → ∃ g : G, ∀ i, g • a i = b i)
    (hHomB : ∀ a b : V × Fin s → B,
      tupleType T ef a = tupleType T ef b → ∃ g : H, ∀ i, g • a i = b i)
    (φ : Formula (HFRelation R) V)
    (v : V → Domain (A := A) G s) (w : V → Domain (A := B) H s)
    (h : Represented S T ef e2 v w) :
    φ.eval (hfStructure S) v ↔ φ.eval (hfStructure T) w

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Forms.supported_sentences_transfer
statement:
theorem supported_sentences_transfer (hs : 0 < s)
    (hHomA2 : ∀ a b : Fin s ⊕ Fin s → A,

    (hHomB2 : ∀ a b : Fin s ⊕ Fin s → B,

    (hHomA : ∀ a b : V × Fin s → A,
      tupleType S ef a = tupleType S ef b → ∃ g : G, ∀ i, g • a i = b i)
    (hHomB : ∀ a b : V × Fin s → B,
      tupleType T ef a = tupleType T ef b → ∃ g : H, ∀ i, g • a i = b i)
    (hbase : tupleType S (Function.Embedding.ofIsEmpty : Empty ↪ I) Empty.elim =
      tupleType T (Function.Embedding.ofIsEmpty : Empty ↪ I) Empty.elim)
    (φ : Formula (HFRelation R) V) (hφ : φ.free = ∅)

    φ.eval (hfStructure S) v ↔ φ.eval (hfStructure T) w

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Forms.value_fiber_equiv
statement:
theorem value_fiber_equiv (p : P → A) (q : P → B) (τ : Set (Formula R I))
    (φ : Form (Fin s) (Set (Formula R I)))
    (a : Molecules S ep p τ) (a' : Molecules T ep q τ) :
    Nonempty ({b : Molecules S ep p τ // Form.value S e2 φ b.1 = Form.value S e2 φ a.1} ≃
    {b : Molecules T ep q τ // Form.value T e2 φ b.1 = Form.value T e2 φ a'.1})

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.grid_hf_transfer
statement:
theorem grid_hf_transfer (hn : 1 ≤ n) (hs : 0 < s) (hm : 0 < m)
    (vstar : Vertex n) [Nonempty (Atom (0 : Vertex n → Scalar))]
    [Nonempty (Atom (Pi.single vstar 1))]
    (hwidth : max 4 (m+1)*s ≤ M)
    (hhom : (7*(max 2 m*s):ℝ)+7*((6*(max 2 m*s):ℝ)/boxConstant)^((3:ℝ)/2)+1 ≤ M)
    (hgiant : GiantBound n M)
    (φ : Counting.Formula (Forms.HFRelation AnalysisSymbol) (Fin m)) (hφ : φ.free = ∅)

    (w : Fin m → Forms.Domain (A := Atom (Pi.single vstar 1)) (CentralGroup n) s) :

    (hsize : (F.card : ℝ) ≤ (N : ℝ)^q) :
    ∀ x ∈ F, HereditarilySupported (G := CentralGroup n)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.glue_finite_cells
statement:
theorem glue_finite_cells {L X Y : Type*} (C : L → Set X) (D : L → Set Y)
    (coverC : ∀ x, ∃ l, x ∈ C l) (coverD : ∀ y, ∃ l, y ∈ D l)
    (partC : ∀ l k x, x ∈ C l → x ∈ C k → C l = C k)
    (partD : ∀ l k y, y ∈ D l → y ∈ D k → D l = D k)
    (same : ∀ l k, C l = C k ↔ D l = D k)
    (finC : ∀ l, (C l).Finite) (finD : ∀ l, (D l).Finite)
    (card : ∀ l, Nat.card (C l) = Nat.card (D l)) :
    ∃ f : X ≃ Y, ∀ x, ∃ l, x ∈ C l ∧ f x ∈ D l

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.exists_numeric_box
statement:
theorem exists_numeric_box (q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) (m : ℕ) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n ∧
      let N : ℕ := atomSizeConstant*(n+1)^3
      let s : ℕ := ⌈2*(n+1:ℝ)*((q:ℝ)*Real.logb 3 N)^2⌉₊
      let M : ℕ := palette (n+1:ℝ)
      2 ≤ N ∧ 0 < s ∧ max 4 (m+1)*s ≤ M ∧
      (7:ℝ)*((max 2 m*s:ℕ):ℝ)+7*((6*((max 2 m*s:ℕ):ℝ))/boxConstant)^((3:ℝ)/2)+1 ≤ M ∧
      GiantBound n M

    (hs : 0 < ⌈2*(n+1:ℝ)*(q*Real.logb 3 N)^2⌉₊)
    (hwidth : max 4 (m+1)*⌈2*(n+1:ℝ)*(q*Real.logb 3 N)^2⌉₊ ≤ M)
    (hhom : (7*(max 2 m*⌈2*(n+1:ℝ)*(q*Real.logb 3 N)^2⌉₊):ℝ)+
      7*((6*(max 2 m*⌈2*(n+1:ℝ)*(q*Real.logb 3 N)^2⌉₊):ℝ)/boxConstant)^((3:ℝ)/2)+1 ≤ M)
    (hgiant : GiantBound n M)
    {j : ℕ} (hj : j < K) (ψ : Interpretations.Formula P.StateSymbols 0) (hw : ψ.scopedWidth < m) :
    ψ.holds (P.state (programInput (0 : Vertex n → Scalar)) j) ↔
      ψ.holds (P.state (programInput (Pi.single vstar 1)) j)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.trace_supported
statement:
theorem trace_supported (hn : 1 ≤ n) (B K N : ℕ) (hB : 2 ≤ B) (hK : K ≤ B)
    (hN : Nat.card (Atom b) ≤ B) (hNpos : 0 < N)
    (hsize : ∀ j < K, Nat.card (P.state (programInput b) j).Carrier ≤ B)
    (q : ℝ) (hq : 0 ≤ q) (hpoly : (9*B^3 : ℝ) ≤ (N : ℝ)^q) :
    ∀ x ∈ P.family (programInput b) B K,
      HereditarilySupported (G := CentralGroup n) ⌈2*(n+1:ℝ)*(q*Real.logb 3 N)^2⌉₊ x

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Hereditary.hereditary_iff
statement:
theorem hereditary_iff {x : HF A} : HereditarilySupported (G := G) s x ↔
    Supported (G := G) s x ∧ ∀ y, y ∈ x → HereditarilySupported (G := G) s y

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Hereditary.hereditary_transitive
statement:
theorem hereditary_transitive {x y : HF A} (hx : HereditarilySupported (G := G) s x) (hy : y ∈ x) :
    HereditarilySupported (G := G) s y

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Hereditary.ordinal_hereditary

theorem ordinal_hereditary [Nonempty A] (s j : ℕ) :

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Interpretations.Program.size_le_cost
statement:
lemma size_le_cost (A : Structure R) {j k : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ j) :

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Interpretations.Program.stage_le_cost
statement: lemma stage_le_cost (A : Structure R) (j : ℕ) : j+1 ≤ P.cost A j

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Quantitative.ceil_little
OAI.CPTSeparation.Quantitative.const_little_rpow

lemma const_little_rpow (c : ℝ) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) :

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Quantitative.eventual_bounds
statement:
theorem eventual_bounds (C q c : ℝ) (hC : 0 < C) (hc : 0 < c) (m : ℕ) :
    ∀ᶠ L : ℝ in atTop,
      (max 4 (m+1):ℝ)*(radius C q L:ℝ) ≤ (palette L:ℝ) ∧
      7*((max 2 m:ℝ)*(radius C q L:ℝ))+
        7*((6*((max 2 m:ℝ)*(radius C q L:ℝ)))/c)^((3:ℝ)/2)+1 ≤ (palette L:ℝ) ∧
      ((12*(palette L:ℝ))/c)^((3:ℝ)/2) < L^3

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Quantitative.floor_big

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Quantitative.giant_little
statement:
lemma giant_little (c : ℝ) :
    (fun L : ℝ => ((12*(palette L:ℝ))/c)^((3:ℝ)/2)) =o[atTop] (fun L => L^3)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Quantitative.homogeneity_little
statement:
lemma homogeneity_little (C q m c : ℝ) (hC : 0 < C) :
    (fun L : ℝ => 7*(m*(radius C q L:ℝ))+7*((6*(m*(radius C q L:ℝ)))/c)^((3:ℝ)/2)+1)
      =o[atTop] (fun L => L^((7:ℝ)/4))

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Quantitative.log_volume_little

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Quantitative.polynomial_bounds

lemma polynomial_bounds (c d N : ℕ) (hN : 2 ≤ N) :
    2 ≤ N^timeExponent c d ∧ N ≤ N^timeExponent c d ∧
    c*(N+1)^d ≤ N^timeExponent c d ∧
    9*(N^timeExponent c d)^3 ≤ N^traceExponent c d

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Quantitative.power_little_power
statement:
lemma power_little_power {a b : ℝ} (hab : a < b) :

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Quantitative.radius_little

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Quantitative.radius_little_palette

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Quantitative.real_trace_bound

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Quantitative.timeExponent_ge_two

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Hereditary.card_closure_ordinal

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Hereditary.closure_atom
statement: lemma closure_atom (a : A) : closure (atom a) = {atom a}

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Hereditary.closure_double_subset

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Hereditary.closure_map

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Hereditary.closure_ofFinset

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Hereditary.closure_ordinal
statement: lemma closure_ordinal (n : ℕ) : closure (ordinal (A := A) n) = (range (n+1)).image ordinal

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Hereditary.closure_subset_of_transitive
statement:
lemma closure_subset_of_transitive {s : Finset (HF A)}
    (hs : ∀ x ∈ s, ∀ y, y ∈ x → y ∈ s) {x : HF A} (hx : x ∈ s) : closure x ⊆ s

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Hereditary.closure_transitive
statement:
lemma closure_transitive {x y z : HF A} (hxy : y ∈ closure x) (hyz : z ∈ y) :

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Hereditary.elements_subset_closure
statement: lemma elements_subset_closure (x : HF A) : elements x ⊆ closure x

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Hereditary.familyClosure_contains
statement:
lemma familyClosure_contains {f : Finset (HF A)} {x : HF A} (hx : x ∈ f) :

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Hereditary.familyClosure_transitive
statement:
lemma familyClosure_transitive {f : Finset (HF A)} {x y : HF A}
    (hx : x ∈ familyClosure f) (hy : y ∈ x) : y ∈ familyClosure f

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Hereditary.mem_closure_iff
statement:
lemma mem_closure_iff (x y : HF A) : x ∈ closure y ↔

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Hereditary.mem_closure_self
statement: @[simp] lemma mem_closure_self (x : HF A) : x ∈ closure x

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Hereditary.mem_familyClosure
statement:
lemma mem_familyClosure {f : Finset (HF A)} {x : HF A} :
    x ∈ familyClosure f ↔ ∃ y ∈ f, x ∈ closure y

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Hereditary.mem_mapEquiv
statement: lemma mem_mapEquiv (e : A ≃ B) (x y : HF A) : map e x ∈ map e y ↔ x ∈ y

OAI.CPTSeparation.Operational.Machine.runActive_card_le
statement:
lemma runActive_card_le (rel : R → A → A → Bool) (h K : ℕ)
    (hb : ∀ j ≤ h, ∀ s, P.run rel j = some s → s.active.card ≤ K) :
    (P.runActive rel h).card ≤ (h+1)*K

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Operational.Machine.runActive_transitive
statement:
lemma runActive_transitive (rel : R → A → A → Bool) (h : ℕ) {x y : HF A}
    (hx : x ∈ P.runActive rel h) (hy : y ∈ x) : y ∈ P.runActive rel h

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Operational.Machine.runActive_transport
statement:
lemma runActive_transport (e : A ≃ B) (rel : R → A → A → Bool) (rel' : R → B → B → Bool)
    (hrel : ∀ r a b, rel' r (e a) (e b) = rel r a b) (h : ℕ) :
    P.runActive rel' h = (P.runActive rel h).image (lift e)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Operational.Machine.run_transport
statement:
lemma run_transport (e : A ≃ B) (rel : R → A → A → Bool) (rel' : R → B → B → Bool)
    (hrel : ∀ r a b, rel' r (e a) (e b) = rel r a b) (j : ℕ) :
    P.run rel' j = (P.run rel j).map (State.transport e)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Operational.Machine.state_active_subset
statement:
lemma state_active_subset (rel : R → A → A → Bool) {h j : ℕ} {s : P.Store (A := A)}
    (hj : j ≤ h) (hs : P.run rel j = some s) : s.active ⊆ P.runActive rel h

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Operational.Machine.step_transport
statement:
lemma step_transport (e : A ≃ B) (rel : R → A → A → Bool) (rel' : R → B → B → Bool)
    (hrel : ∀ r a b, rel' r (e a) (e b) = rel r a b) (s : P.Store (A := A)) :
    P.step rel' (s.transport e) = (P.step rel s).map (State.transport e)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Operational.Rule.updates_transport
statement:
lemma updates_transport (e : A ≃ B) (rel : R → A → A → Bool) (rel' : R → B → B → Bool)

    {k : ℕ} (r : Rule R F arity k) (v : Fin k → HF A) :
    r.updates rel' (s.transport e) (fun j => lift e (v j)) =
      (r.updates rel s v).image (updateEquiv e)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Operational.State.active_transitive

lemma active_transitive [Fintype A] (s : State F arity A) {x y : HF A}

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Operational.State.active_transport
statement:
lemma active_transport [Fintype A] [Fintype B] (e : A ≃ B) (s : State F arity A) :

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Operational.State.applyUpdates_transport
statement:
lemma applyUpdates_transport (e : A ≃ B) (s : State F arity A)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Operational.State.argument_mem_critical

lemma argument_mem_critical (s : State F arity A) {l : Location F arity A}

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Operational.State.atoms_mem_active

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Operational.State.closure_atoms_subset_active
statement: lemma closure_atoms_subset_active (s : State F arity A) : Hereditary.closure allAtoms ⊆ s.active

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Operational.State.closure_value_subset_active

lemma closure_value_subset_active (s : State F arity A) (l : Location F arity A) :

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Operational.State.consistent_transport
statement:
lemma consistent_transport (e : A ≃ B) (u : Finset (Update F arity A)) :

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Operational.State.critical_transport
statement:
lemma critical_transport (e : A ≃ B) (s : State F arity A) :
    (s.transport e).critical = s.critical.image (lift e)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Operational.State.empty_mem_active
statement: lemma empty_mem_active (s : State F arity A) : empty ∈ s.active

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Operational.State.ext_value
statement: @[ext] lemma ext_value (s t : State F arity A) (h : ∀ l, s.value l = t.value l) : s = t

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Operational.State.mem_support
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_support (s : State F arity A) (l : Location F arity A) :
    l ∈ s.support ↔ s.value l ≠ empty

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Operational.State.support_transport
statement:
lemma support_transport (e : A ≃ B) (s : State F arity A) :
    (s.transport e).support = s.support.image (locationEquiv e)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Operational.State.transport_initial
statement: @[simp] lemma transport_initial (e : A ≃ B) : (initial : State F arity A).transport e = initial

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Operational.State.transport_value
statement:
@[simp] lemma transport_value (e : A ≃ B) (s : State F arity A) (l : Location F arity A) :
    (s.transport e).value (locationEquiv e l) = lift e (s.value l)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Operational.State.updatedValue_default
statement:
lemma updatedValue_default (s : State F arity A) (u : Finset (Update F arity A))

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Operational.State.updatedValue_eq
statement:
lemma updatedValue_eq (s : State F arity A) (u : Finset (Update F arity A))

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Operational.State.value_mem_critical
statement:
lemma value_mem_critical (s : State F arity A) {l : Location F arity A}

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Operational.Term.card_trace_le
statement:
lemma card_trace_le (rel : R → A → A → Bool) (s : State F arity A)
    {k : ℕ} (t : Term R F arity k) (v : Fin k → HF A) (K : ℕ) (hK : potential s v ≤ K) :
    (t.trace rel s v).card ≤ t.bound.eval K

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Operational.Term.closure_eval_subset_trace
statement:
lemma closure_eval_subset_trace (rel : R → A → A → Bool) (s : State F arity A)
    {k : ℕ} (t : Term R F arity k) (v : Fin k → HF A) :
    closure (t.eval rel s v) ⊆ t.trace rel s v

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Operational.Term.eval_transport
statement:
lemma eval_transport (e : A ≃ B) (rel : R → A → A → Bool) (rel' : R → B → B → Bool)
    (hrel : ∀ r a b, rel' r (e a) (e b) = rel r a b) (s : State F arity A)
    {k : ℕ} (t : Term R F arity k) (v : Fin k → HF A) :
    t.eval rel' (s.transport e) (fun j => lift e (v j)) = lift e (t.eval rel s v)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Operational.Term.potential_active
statement:
lemma potential_active {k : ℕ} (s : State F arity A) (v : Fin k → HF A) :
    s.active.card ≤ potential s v

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Operational.Term.potential_cons
statement:
lemma potential_cons {k : ℕ} (s : State F arity A) (v : Fin k → HF A) (x : HF A) :
    potential s (Fin.cons x v) = potential s v + (closure x).card

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Operational.Term.potential_var
statement:
lemma potential_var {k : ℕ} (s : State F arity A) (v : Fin k → HF A) (j : Fin k) :

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Operational.boolean_truth
statement: @[simp] theorem boolean_truth (p : Prop) : boolean (A := A) p = truth ↔ p

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Operational.card_closure_boolean

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Operational.card_closure_card

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Operational.closure_union_subset

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Operational.closure_unique_subset

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Operational.lift_allAtoms
statement: lemma lift_allAtoms [Fintype A] [Fintype B] (e : A ≃ B) : lift e allAtoms = allAtoms

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Operational.lift_boolean
statement: @[simp] lemma lift_boolean (e : A ≃ B) (p : Prop) : lift e (boolean p) = boolean p

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Operational.lift_card
statement: lemma lift_card (e : A ≃ B) (x : HF A) : lift e (cardinalityHF x) = cardinalityHF (lift e x)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Operational.lift_double
statement: @[simp] lemma lift_double (e : A ≃ B) (x y : HF A) : lift e (double x y) = double (lift e x) (lift e y)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Operational.lift_elements
statement: lemma lift_elements (e : A ≃ B) (x : HF A) : elements (lift e x) = (elements x).image (lift e)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Operational.lift_empty
statement: @[simp] lemma lift_empty (e : A ≃ B) : lift e empty = empty

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Operational.lift_empty_iff
statement: @[simp] lemma lift_empty_iff (e : A ≃ B) (x : HF A) : lift e x = empty ↔ x = empty

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Operational.lift_input
statement:
lemma lift_input (e : A ≃ B) (rel : R → A → A → Bool) (rel' : R → B → B → Bool)
    (hrel : ∀ r a b, rel' r (e a) (e b) = rel r a b) (r : R) (x y : HF A) :

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Operational.lift_isSet
statement: @[simp] lemma lift_isSet (e : A ≃ B) (x : HF A) : isSet (lift e x) = isSet x

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Operational.lift_mem_iff
statement: @[simp] lemma lift_mem_iff (e : A ≃ B) (x y : HF A) : lift e x ∈ lift e y ↔ x ∈ y

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Operational.lift_ofFinset
statement: lemma lift_ofFinset (e : A ≃ B) (s : Finset (HF A)) : lift e (ofFinset s) = ofFinset (s.image (lift e))

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Operational.lift_ordinal
statement: @[simp] lemma lift_ordinal (e : A ≃ B) (n : ℕ) : lift e (ordinal n) = ordinal n

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Operational.lift_truth
statement: @[simp] lemma lift_truth (e : A ≃ B) : lift e truth = truth

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Operational.lift_truth_iff
statement: @[simp] lemma lift_truth_iff (e : A ≃ B) (x : HF A) : lift e x = truth ↔ x = truth

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Operational.lift_union
statement: lemma lift_union (e : A ≃ B) (x : HF A) : lift e (unionHF x) = unionHF (lift e x)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Operational.lift_unique
statement: lemma lift_unique (e : A ≃ B) (x : HF A) : lift e (uniqueHF x) = uniqueHF (lift e x)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Operational.locationEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma locationEquiv_apply (e : A ≃ B) (f : F) (v : Fin (arity f) → HF A) :

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Operational.locationEquiv_symm_apply

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Operational.mem_update_image
statement:
lemma mem_update_image (e : A ≃ B) (u : Finset (Update F arity A))

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Operational.truth_ne_empty
statement: @[simp] theorem truth_ne_empty : (truth : HF A) ≠ empty

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Operational.uniqueHF_spec

OAI.CPTSeparation.Counting.UniformDefinable.compose_unary

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Operational.Rule.graph_complete
statement:
lemma graph_complete {k : ℕ} (r : Rule R F arity k) (f : F) (z : Domain d)
    (a : Fin (arity f) → Domain d) (v : Fin k → Domain d)
    (ht : ∀ x ∈ r.trace rel s (fun j => (v j).val), x ∈ d ∧ (elements x).card ≤ K)
    (hu : (⟨f,fun j => (a j).val⟩,z.val) ∈ r.updates rel s (fun j => (v j).val)) :
    Graph d K rel s r f z a v

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Operational.Rule.graph_sound
statement:
lemma graph_sound {k : ℕ} (r : Rule R F arity k) (f : F) (z : Domain d)

statement:
lemma uniform_comprehension
    {P : ∀ i, Domain (d i) → (Fin k → Domain (d i)) → Prop}
    {Q T : ∀ i, Domain (d i) → (Fin (k+1) → Domain (d i)) → Prop}
    (hP : UniformDefinable S m (k+1) (fun i v => P i (v 0) (Fin.tail v)))
    (hQ : UniformDefinable S m (k+2) (fun i v => Q i (v 0) (Fin.tail v)))
    (hT : UniformDefinable S m (k+2) (fun i v => T i (v 0) (Fin.tail v)))
    (hm : k+5 ≤ m) : UniformDefinable S m (k+1) (fun i v => ∃ b,
      P i b (Fin.tail v) ∧
      (∀ x : Domain (d i), x.val ∈ b.val → ∃ g y,
        Q i g (Fin.cons x (Fin.tail v)) ∧ T i y (Fin.cons x (Fin.tail v))) ∧
      isSet (v 0).val = true ∧ ∀ y : Domain (d i), y.val ∈ (v 0).val ↔ ∃ x : Domain (d i),
        x.val ∈ b.val ∧ (∃ g, Q i g (Fin.cons x (Fin.tail v)) ∧ g.val = truth) ∧
        T i y (Fin.cons x (Fin.tail v)))

statement:
lemma consistency_satisfies (S : Data N) (t y : Fin N) (v : Fin (N+N) → Scalar) :
    (consistencyRow S t y).satisfies v ↔
      ∀ (ht : S.rel .Cf t t = true) (hy : S.rel .Ed y y = true),
        S.incident ⟨t,ht⟩ ⟨y,hy⟩ →
        right v y = ∑ a : S.Config, if S.rel .VB t a then left v a*S.coefficient ⟨y,hy⟩ a else 0

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.OrderedQuery.incident_eq
statement:
lemma incident_eq (S : Data N) (t : S.Config) (y : S.Edge) :
    incident S t y = true ↔ S.incident t y

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.OrderedQuery.indexSymbol_symbolIndex
statement: @[simp] theorem indexSymbol_symbolIndex (r : Symbol) : indexSymbol (symbolIndex r) = r

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.OrderedQuery.norm_mem
statement: lemma norm_mem (S : Data N) (t : Fin N) : normalizationRow S t ∈ rows S

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.OrderedQuery.normalization_satisfies
statement:
lemma normalization_satisfies (S : Data N) (t : Fin N) (v : Fin (N+N) → Scalar) :
    (normalizationRow S t).satisfies v ↔
      S.rel .Cf t t = true →
        (∑ a : S.Config, if S.rel .VB t a then left v a else 0) = 1

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.OrderedQuery.row_zero
statement:
lemma row_zero (v : Fin (N+N) → Scalar) :

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.OrderedQuery.rows_length

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.OrderedQuery.rows_solvable_iff
statement: theorem rows_solvable_iff (S : Data N) : Gaussian.Solvable (rows S) ↔ S.query

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.OrderedQuery.sum_subtype
statement:
lemma sum_subtype {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (p : A → Prop) [DecidablePred p]
    (f : A → Scalar) : (∑ a, if p a then f a else 0) = ∑ a : {a // p a}, f a

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.OrderedQuery.symbolIndex_indexSymbol

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.OrderedQuery.tableBits_length

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.OrderedQuery.tableDecode_tableBits
statement: @[simp] theorem tableDecode_tableBits (S : Data N) : tableDecode N (tableBits S) = S

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.SerialGaussian.queryRows_correct

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.SerialGaussian.reduce_payload_size

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.SerialGaussian.solve_decode
statement:
theorem solve_decode {n} (rows : List (Row n)) :

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.SerialGaussian.tail_payload_size

theorem tail_payload_size {n} (rows : List (Row (n+1))) :

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.StackLang.Action.stmt_run
statement:
lemma stmt_run {Λ : Type} (exit : TM2.Stmt Γ Λ σ) (a : Action Γ σ) (s : Store Γ σ) :
    TM2.stepAux (a.stmt exit) s.control s.stk =
      TM2.stepAux exit (a.run s).control (a.run s).stk

OAI.CPTSeparation.StackLang.Macros.copy_runs
statement:
lemma copy_runs (i j k : K) (hij : i ≠ j) (hik : i ≠ k) (hjk : j ≠ k)
    (v : σ) (buf : Option α) (w : K → List α) (xs ys : List α) :
    Runs (copy i j k)
      (state v buf (Function.update (Function.update (Function.update w k []) i xs) j ys))
      (state v none (Function.update (Function.update (Function.update w k []) i xs) j (xs ++ ys)))
      (4*xs.length+7)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.StackLang.Macros.dupeLoop_runs
statement:
lemma dupeLoop_runs (i j k : K) (hij : i ≠ j) (hik : i ≠ k) (hjk : j ≠ k)
    (v : σ) (w : K → List α) (xs ys zs : List α) :
    Runs (dupeLoop i j k)
      (state v xs.head? (Function.update (Function.update (Function.update w i xs) j ys) k zs))
      (state v none (Function.update (Function.update (Function.update w i []) j (xs.reverse ++ ys))
        k (xs.reverse ++ zs))) (2*xs.length+1)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.StackLang.Macros.dupeRev_runs
statement:
lemma dupeRev_runs (i j k : K) (hij : i ≠ j) (hik : i ≠ k) (hjk : j ≠ k)
    (v : σ) (buf : Option α) (w : K → List α) (xs ys zs : List α) :
    Runs (dupeRev i j k)
      (state v buf (Function.update (Function.update (Function.update w i xs) j ys) k zs))
      (state v none (Function.update (Function.update (Function.update w i []) j (xs.reverse ++ ys))
        k (xs.reverse ++ zs))) (2*xs.length+3)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.StackLang.Macros.moveLoop_runs
statement:
lemma moveLoop_runs (i j : K) (hij : i ≠ j) (f : σ → α → α) (v : σ)
    (w : K → List α) (xs ys : List α) :
    Runs (moveLoop i j f)
      (state v xs.head? (Function.update (Function.update w i xs) j ys))
      (state v none (Function.update (Function.update w i []) j ((xs.map (f v)).reverse ++ ys)))
      (2*xs.length+1)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.StackLang.Macros.moveRev_runs
statement:
lemma moveRev_runs (i j : K) (hij : i ≠ j) (f : σ → α → α) (v : σ) (buf : Option α)
    (w : K → List α) (xs ys : List α) :
    Runs (moveRev i j f)
      (state v buf (Function.update (Function.update w i xs) j ys))
      (state v none (Function.update (Function.update w i []) j ((xs.map (f v)).reverse ++ ys)))
      (2*xs.length+3)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.StackLang.Macros.moveRow_runs
statement:
lemma moveRow_runs
    {K : Type}
    {α : Type}
    {σ : Type}
    [DecidableEq K]
    [Inhabited α] (i j : K) (hij : i ≠ j) (f : σ → Option α → Option α) (v : σ)
    (buf : Option (Option α)) (w : K → List (Option α)) (xs : List α)
    (suffix ys : List (Option α)) :
    Runs (moveRow i j f)
      (state v buf (Function.update (Function.update w i (xs.map some ++ none::suffix)) j ys))
      (state v none (Function.update (Function.update w i suffix)
        j ((xs.map (fun x => f v (some x))).reverse ++ ys))) (2*xs.length+5)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.StackLang.Macros.rowLoop_runs
statement:
lemma rowLoop_runs
    {K : Type}
    {α : Type}
    {σ : Type}
    [DecidableEq K]
    [Inhabited α] (i j : K) (hij : i ≠ j) (f : σ → Option α → Option α) (v : σ)
    (w : K → List (Option α)) (xs : List α) (suffix ys : List (Option α)) :
    Runs (rowLoop i j f)
      (state v (xs.map some ++ none::suffix).head?
        (Function.update (Function.update w i (xs.map some ++ none::suffix)) j ys))
      (state v (some none) (Function.update (Function.update w i (none::suffix))
        j ((xs.map (fun x => f v (some x))).reverse ++ ys))) (2*xs.length+1)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.StackLang.Macros.skipRowLoop_runs
statement:
lemma skipRowLoop_runs
    {K : Type}
    {α : Type}
    {σ : Type}
    [DecidableEq K]
    [Inhabited α] (i : K) (v : σ) (w : K → List (Option α)) (xs : List α)
    (suffix : List (Option α)) :
    Runs (skipRowLoop i)
      (state v (xs.map some ++ none::suffix).head?
        (Function.update w i (xs.map some ++ none::suffix)))
      (state v (some none) (Function.update w i (none::suffix))) (2*xs.length+1)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.StackLang.Macros.skipRow_runs

OAI.CPTSeparation.StackLang.Macros.zipRowLoop_runs
statement:
lemma zipRowLoop_runs (i o p b : K) (hio : i ≠ o) (hip : i ≠ p) (hib : i ≠ b)
    (hop : o ≠ p) (hob : o ≠ b) (hpb : p ≠ b)
    (f : τ → α → α → α) (v : τ) (w : K → List (Option α))
    (xs ys : List α) (hlen : xs.length = ys.length)
    (suffix os bs : List (Option α)) :
    Runs (zipRowLoop i o p b f)
      (state ((none : Option α),v) (xs.map some ++ none::suffix).head?
        (Function.update (Function.update (Function.update (Function.update w i
          (xs.map some ++ none::suffix)) o os) p (ys.map some)) b bs))
      (state ((none : Option α),v) (some none)
        (Function.update (Function.update (Function.update (Function.update w i (none::suffix))
          o (((List.zipWith (f v) xs ys).map some).reverse ++ os)) p [])
          b ((ys.map some).reverse ++ bs))) (2*xs.length+1)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.StackLang.Macros.zipRow_runs
statement:
lemma zipRow_runs (i o p b : K) (hio : i ≠ o) (hip : i ≠ p) (hib : i ≠ b)
    (hop : o ≠ p) (hob : o ≠ b) (hpb : p ≠ b)
    (f : τ → α → α → α) (v : τ) (buf : Option (Option α)) (w : K → List (Option α))
    (xs ys : List α) (hlen : xs.length = ys.length)
    (suffix os bs : List (Option α)) :
    Runs (zipRow i o p b f)
      (state ((none : Option α),v) buf
        (Function.update (Function.update (Function.update (Function.update w i
          (xs.map some ++ none::suffix)) o os) p (ys.map some)) b bs))
      (state ((none : Option α),v) none
        (Function.update (Function.update (Function.update (Function.update w i suffix)
          o (((List.zipWith (f v) xs ys).map some).reverse ++ os)) p [])
          b ((ys.map some).reverse ++ bs))) (2*xs.length+5)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.StackLang.Program.stepAux_jump
statement:
@[simp] lemma stepAux_jump [DecidableEq K] {Λ : Type} (l : Option Λ) (v : σ) (s : ∀ k, List (Γ k)) :
    TM2.stepAux (jump l) v s = ⟨l,v,s⟩

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.StackLang.Runs.atom
statement: lemma atom (a : Action Γ σ) (s : Store Γ σ) : Runs (.atom a) s (a.run s) 1

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.StackLang.Runs.atom_of
statement: lemma atom_of (a : Action Γ σ) (s t : Store Γ σ) (h : a.run s = t) : Runs (.atom a) s t 1

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.StackLang.Runs.cond_false
statement:
lemma cond_false {f : σ → Bool} {a b : Program Γ σ} {s t : Store Γ σ} {n : ℕ}
    (hf : f s.control = false) (h : Runs b s t n) : Runs (.cond f a b) s t (1+n)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.StackLang.Runs.cond_true
statement:
lemma cond_true {f : σ → Bool} {a b : Program Γ σ} {s t : Store Γ σ} {n : ℕ}
    (hf : f s.control = true) (h : Runs a s t n) : Runs (.cond f a b) s t (1+n)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.StackLang.Runs.loop_false
statement:
lemma loop_false {f : σ → Bool} {b : Program Γ σ} {s : Store Γ σ}
    (h : f s.control = false) : Runs (.loop f b) s s 1

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.StackLang.Runs.loop_steps
statement:
lemma loop_steps {f : σ → Bool} {body : Program Γ σ} (states : ℕ → Store Γ σ) (n b : ℕ)
    (guard : ∀ i < n, f (states i).control = true)
    (stop : f (states n).control = false)
    (step : ∀ i < n, Runs body (states i) (states (i+1)) b) :
    Runs (.loop f body) (states 0) (states n) ((b+1)*n+1)

OAI.CPTSeparation.StackLang.Runs.mono
statement:
lemma mono {p : Program Γ σ} {s t : Store Γ σ} {m n : ℕ}
    (h : Runs p s t m) (hn : m ≤ n) : Runs p s t n

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.StackLang.Runs.seq
statement:
lemma seq {a b : Program Γ σ} {s t u : Store Γ σ} {m n : ℕ}
    (ha : Runs a s t m) (hb : Runs b t u n) : Runs (.seq a b) s u (1+(m+n))

OAI.CPTSeparation.GaussMachine.checkZero_runs
statement:
lemma checkZero_runs (c : Control) (buf : Option Letter) (d : Data) (rs : List (SerialGaussian.Row 0)) :
 Runs checkZero (st c buf {d with mat := payload rs,output := []})
   (st (ctrl 0 (solve rs)) none {d with mat := [],output := boolCode (solve rs)}) (2*rs.length+5)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.GaussMachine.eliminate_runs
statement:
lemma eliminate_runs {n} (c : Control) (buf : Option Letter) (d : Data)
    (rs : List (SerialGaussian.Row (n+1))) :
 Runs eliminate
   (st c buf {d with mat := payload rs,back := [],scan := [],piv := [],pivBack := []})
   (st (ctrl 0 c.answer) none
     {d with mat := payload (nextRows rs),back := [],scan := [],piv := [],pivBack := []})
   (100*(rs.length+1)*(n+3))

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.GaussMachine.eliminationBody_runs
statement:
lemma eliminationBody_runs {n} (a : Bool) (buf : Option Letter) (d : Data)
    (rs : List (SerialGaussian.Row (n+1))) (ws : List Letter) :
 Runs eliminationBody
   (st (ctrl 0 a) buf {d with mat := payload rs,back := [],scan := [],piv := [],pivBack := [],width := none::ws})
   (st (ctrl 0 a) ws.head?
     {d with mat := payload (nextRows rs),back := [],scan := [],piv := [],pivBack := [],width := ws})
   (100*(rs.length+1)*(n+3)+2)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.GaussMachine.eliminationLoop_runs
statement:
lemma eliminationLoop_runs {n} (a : Bool) (d : Data) (rs : List (SerialGaussian.Row n)) :
 Runs eliminationLoop
   (st (ctrl 0 a) (List.replicate n (none : Letter)).head?
     {d with mat := payload rs,back := [],scan := [],piv := [],pivBack := [],width := List.replicate n none})
   (st (ctrl 0 a) none
     {d with mat := payload (normal rs),back := [],scan := [],piv := [],pivBack := [],width := []})
   (200*(rs.length+1)*(n+3)^2)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.GaussMachine.entries_head_tail
statement:
lemma entries_head_tail {n} (r : SerialGaussian.Row (n+1)) :
 r.entries = r.head :: r.tail.entries

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.GaussMachine.entries_length
statement: @[simp] lemma entries_length {n} (r : SerialGaussian.Row n) : r.entries.length = n+1

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.GaussMachine.entries_reduce
statement:
lemma entries_reduce {n} (p r : SerialGaussian.Row (n+1)) :
 (p.reduce r).entries = List.zipWith (fun x y => x-(r.head/p.head)*y) r.tail.entries p.tail.entries

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.GaussMachine.findPivot_runs
statement:
lemma findPivot_runs {n} (c : Control) (buf : Option Letter) (d : Data)
    (rs : List (SerialGaussian.Row (n+1))) :
 Runs findPivot
   (st c buf {d with mat := payload rs,back := [],scan := [],piv := [],pivBack := []})
   (st (ctrl (pivotHead (pivot rs)) c.answer) none
     {d with mat := payload rs,back := [],scan := [],piv := pivotTail (pivot rs),pivBack := []})
   (30*(rs.length+1)*(n+3))

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.GaussMachine.nextRows_length
statement:
@[simp] lemma nextRows_length {n} (rs : List (SerialGaussian.Row (n+1))) :

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.GaussMachine.normal_length
statement:

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.GaussMachine.payload_append

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.GaussMachine.payload_cons

lemma payload_cons {n} (r : SerialGaussian.Row n) (rs) :

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.GaussMachine.payload_head
statement:

statement:
lemma payload_zero_cons (r : SerialGaussian.Row 0) (rs) :

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.GaussMachine.pivotTail_length
statement:
lemma pivotTail_length {n} (p : Option (SerialGaussian.Row (n+1))) :
 (pivotTail p).length ≤ n+1

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.GaussMachine.pivot_nonzero
statement:
lemma pivot_nonzero {n} (rs : List (SerialGaussian.Row (n+1))) :
 ∀ q ∈ pivot rs, q.head ≠ 0

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.GaussMachine.reduceBody_runs
statement:
lemma reduceBody_runs {n} (p : Option (SerialGaussian.Row (n+1)))
    (hp : ∀ q ∈ p, q.head ≠ 0) (r : SerialGaussian.Row (n+1)) (rs) (a : Bool)
    (buf : Option Letter) (d : Data) (bs : List Letter) :
 Runs reduceBody
   (st (ctrl (pivotHead p) a) buf
     {d with mat := payload (r::rs),back := bs,piv := pivotTail p,pivBack := []})
   (st (ctrl (pivotHead p) a) (payload rs).head?
     {d with mat := payload rs,back := (payload [reducedRow p r]).reverse ++ bs,piv := pivotTail p,pivBack := []})
   (4*(n+1)+14)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.GaussMachine.reduceInner_runs
statement:
lemma reduceInner_runs {n} (p : Option (SerialGaussian.Row (n+1)))
    (hp : ∀ q ∈ p, q.head ≠ 0) (r : SerialGaussian.Row (n+1)) (a : Bool)
    (d : Data) (xs bs : List Letter) :
 Runs reduceInner
   (st (reduceControl p r a) none
     {d with mat := r.tail.entries.map some ++ none::xs,back := bs,piv := pivotTail p,pivBack := []})
   (st (reduceControl p r a) none
     {d with mat := xs,back := ((reducedRow p r).entries.map some).reverse ++ bs,piv := pivotTail p,pivBack := []})
   (4*(n+1)+10)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.GaussMachine.reduceLoop_runs
statement:
lemma reduceLoop_runs {n} (p : Option (SerialGaussian.Row (n+1)))
    (hp : ∀ q ∈ p, q.head ≠ 0) (a : Bool) (d : Data)
    (rs : List (SerialGaussian.Row (n+1))) (bs : List Letter) :
 Runs reduceLoop
   (st (ctrl (pivotHead p) a) (payload rs).head?
     {d with mat := payload rs,back := bs,piv := pivotTail p,pivBack := []})
   (st (ctrl (pivotHead p) a) none
     {d with mat := [],back := (payload (rs.map (reducedRow p))).reverse ++ bs,piv := pivotTail p,pivBack := []})
   ((4*(n+1)+15)*rs.length+1)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.GaussMachine.reduceMatrix_runs
statement:
lemma reduceMatrix_runs {n} (p : Option (SerialGaussian.Row (n+1)))
    (hp : ∀ q ∈ p, q.head ≠ 0) (a : Bool) (buf : Option Letter) (d : Data)
    (rs : List (SerialGaussian.Row (n+1))) :

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.GaussMachine.scanBody_pick
statement:
lemma scanBody_pick {n} (a : Bool) (buf : Option Letter) (d : Data)
    (r : SerialGaussian.Row (n+1)) (rs : List (SerialGaussian.Row (n+1))) (hr : r.head ≠ 0) :
 Runs scanBody (st (ctrl 0 a) buf {d with scan := payload (r::rs), pivBack := []})
   (st (ctrl r.head a) (payload rs).head?
     {d with scan := payload rs, pivBack := (r.tail.entries.map some).reverse})

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.GaussMachine.scanBody_skip
statement:
lemma scanBody_skip {n} (c : Control) (buf : Option Letter) (d : Data)
    (r : SerialGaussian.Row (n+1)) (rs : List (SerialGaussian.Row (n+1)))
    (h : c.pivot ≠ 0 ∨ r.head = 0) :
 Runs scanBody (st c buf {d with scan := payload (r::rs)})
   (st {c with factor := 0} (payload rs).head? {d with scan := payload rs})
   (2*(n+1)+10)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.GaussMachine.scanLoop_initial
statement:
lemma scanLoop_initial {n} (a : Bool) (d : Data) (rs : List (SerialGaussian.Row (n+1))) :
 Runs scanLoop (st (ctrl 0 a) (payload rs).head? {d with scan := payload rs,pivBack := []})
   (st (ctrl (pivotHead (pivot rs)) a) none
      {d with scan := [],pivBack := (pivotTail (pivot rs)).reverse})

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.GaussMachine.scanLoop_nonzero
statement:
lemma scanLoop_nonzero {n} (p : Scalar) (hp : p ≠ 0) (a : Bool) (d : Data)
    (rs : List (SerialGaussian.Row (n+1))) :
 Runs scanLoop (st (ctrl p a) (payload rs).head? {d with scan := payload rs})
   (st (ctrl p a) none {d with scan := []}) ((2*(n+1)+13)*rs.length+1)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.GaussMachine.solve_next

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.GaussMachine.solve_normal
statement: lemma solve_normal {n} (rs : List (SerialGaussian.Row n)) : solve (normal rs) = solve rs

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.GaussMachine.solver_runs
statement:
lemma solver_runs {n} (d : Data) (rs : List (SerialGaussian.Row n)) :
 Runs solver
   (st (ctrl 0 true) none {d with mat := payload rs,back := [],scan := [],piv := [],pivBack := [], width := List.replicate n none,output := []})
   (st (ctrl 0 (solve rs)) none {d with mat := [],back := [],scan := [],piv := [],pivBack := [], width := [],output := boolCode (solve rs)})
   (300*(rs.length+1)*(n+3)^2)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.GaussMachine.zeroLoop_runs
statement:
lemma zeroLoop_runs (a : Bool) (d : Data) (rs : List (SerialGaussian.Row 0)) :
 Runs zeroLoop (st (ctrl 0 a) (payload rs).head? {d with mat := payload rs})
   (st (ctrl 0 (a && solve rs)) none {d with mat := []}) (2*rs.length+1)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.CounterLang.Atom.add_runs
statement:
lemma Atom.add_runs (r t : R) (hrt : r ≠ t) (s : State R σ) :
 StackLang.Runs (Atom.compile (.add r t hrt)) s.encode ((Atom.add r t hrt).eval s).encode
   ((Atom.add r t hrt).cost s)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.CounterLang.Atom.compile_runs
statement:
lemma Atom.compile_runs (a : Atom R σ) (s : State R σ) :
 StackLang.Runs a.compile s.encode (a.eval s).encode (a.cost s)

statement:
lemma Atom.zero_runs (r : R) (s : State R σ) :

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.CounterLang.Data.tapes_back
statement: @[simp] lemma tapes_back (d : Data R) (xs : List Letter) : Function.update d.tapes .back xs = ({d with back := xs}).tapes

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.CounterLang.Data.tapes_count

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.CounterLang.Runs.atom_of
statement:
lemma Runs.atom_of {a : Atom R V} {s t : State R V} {n : ℕ}
    (he : a.eval s = t) (hn : a.cost s ≤ n) : Runs (.atom a) s t n

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.CounterLang.Runs.compiles
statement:
lemma Runs.compiles {p : Program R σ} {s t : State R σ} {n : ℕ} (h : Runs p s t n) :
 StackLang.Runs p.compile s.encode t.encode n

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.CounterLang.Runs.loop_steps
statement:
lemma Runs.loop_steps {f : σ → Bool} {p : Program R σ} (states : ℕ → State R σ) (n b : ℕ)
    (guard : ∀ i < n, f (states i).ctl = true) (stop : f (states n).ctl = false)
    (step : ∀ i < n, Runs p (states i) (states (i+1)) b) :
    Runs (.loop f p) (states 0) (states n) ((b+1)*n+1)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.CounterLang.State.ext
OAI.CPTSeparation.CounterLang.bne_nat_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma bne_nat_zero (n : ℕ) : (n != 0) = decide (0 < n)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.CounterLang.bothPositive_runs
statement:
lemma bothPositive_runs (a b : R) (s : State R (Bool × V)) :
 Runs (bothPositive a b) s (flag s (decide (0<s.nums a ∧ 0<s.nums b))) 3

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.CounterLang.compare_runs
statement:
lemma compare_runs (i j a b : R) (hia : i ≠ a) (hjb : j ≠ b)
    (hja : j ≠ a) (hab : a ≠ b) (f : V → Bool → V) (s : State R (Bool × V)) :
 Runs (compare i j a b hia hjb f) s
   {s with ctl := (false,f s.ctl.2 (decide (s.nums i = s.nums j))), nums := Function.update (Function.update s.nums a (s.nums i - s.nums j)) b (s.nums j - s.nums i)}
   (2*s.nums a+2*s.nums b+20*(s.nums i+s.nums j)+40)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.CounterLang.forRange_runs
statement:
lemma forRange_runs (size idx rem : R) (hnr : size ≠ rem) (hir : idx ≠ rem)
   (body : Program R (Bool × V)) (S : ℕ → State R (Bool × V)) (N b : ℕ)
   (hsize : (S 0).nums size = N)
   (hi₀ : (S 0).nums idx = 0) (hr₀ : (S 0).nums rem = 0)
   (hiN : (S N).nums idx = 0) (hrN : (S N).nums rem = 0)
   (hcN : (S N).ctl.1 = false)
   (hb : ∀ i<N, Runs body (indexState idx rem N i (S i))
      (flag (indexState idx rem N i (S (i+1))) false) b) :
 Runs (forRange size idx rem hnr body) (S 0) (S N) ((b+13)*N+20)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.CounterLang.lookup_runs
statement:
lemma lookup_runs (r : R) (f : σ → Option Letter → σ) (s : State R σ) :
 StackLang.Runs (lookup r f) s.encode ((Atom.lookup r f).eval s).encode
   ((Atom.lookup r f).cost s)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.CounterLang.mulBody_runs
statement:
lemma mulBody_runs (a dst tmp : R) (had : a ≠ dst) (hat : a ≠ tmp) (hdt : dst ≠ tmp)
   (s : State R (Bool × V)) (B i : ℕ) (hi : i < B) :
 Runs (mulBody a dst tmp had) (mulState s dst tmp (s.nums a) B i)
   (mulState s dst tmp (s.nums a) B (i+1)) (4*s.nums a+11)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.CounterLang.mulLoop_runs
statement:
lemma mulLoop_runs (a dst tmp : R) (had : a ≠ dst) (hat : a ≠ tmp) (hdt : dst ≠ tmp)
   (s : State R (Bool × V)) (B : ℕ) :
 Runs (mulLoop a dst tmp had) (mulState s dst tmp (s.nums a) B 0)
   (mulState s dst tmp (s.nums a) B B) ((4*s.nums a+12)*B+1)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.CounterLang.multiply_runs
statement:
lemma multiply_runs (a b dst tmp : R) (had : a ≠ dst) (hbt : b ≠ tmp)
   (hat : a ≠ tmp) (hbd : b ≠ dst) (hdt : dst ≠ tmp) (s : State R (Bool × V)) :
 Runs (multiply a b dst tmp had hbt) s
   {s with ctl := (false,s.ctl.2), nums := Function.update (Function.update s.nums dst (s.nums a*s.nums b)) tmp 0}
   (2*s.nums dst+2*s.nums tmp+4*s.nums b+(4*s.nums a+12)*s.nums b+20)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.CounterLang.rangeTail_runs
statement:
lemma rangeTail_runs (idx rem : R) (hir : idx ≠ rem) (N i : ℕ) (s : State R (Bool × V)) (hi : i<N) :
 Runs (.seq (.atom (.inc idx)) (.seq (.atom (.dec rem)) (testPos rem)))
   (flag (indexState idx rem N i s) false) (indexState idx rem N (i+1) s) 5

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.CounterLang.repeatAdd_runs
statement:
lemma repeatAdd_runs (src dst : R) (hnd : src ≠ dst) (k : ℕ) (s : State R V) :
 Runs (repeatAdd src dst hnd k) s
   {s with nums := Function.update s.nums dst (s.nums dst+k*s.nums src)}
   ((4*s.nums src+8)*k+1)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.CounterLang.skipLoop_runs
statement:
lemma skipLoop_runs (v : σ) (d : Data R) (k : ℕ) (xs : List Letter) :
 StackLang.Runs skipLoop
   (state v (List.replicate k (none : Letter)).head? ({d with count := List.replicate k none,work := xs}).tapes)
   (state v none ({d with count := [],work := xs.drop k}).tapes) (2*k+1)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.CounterLang.unary_head
statement: @[simp] lemma unary_head (n : ℕ) : (List.replicate n (none : Letter)).head?.isSome = (n != 0)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.CounterLang.unary_length
OAI.CPTSeparation.CounterLang.unary_update
statement:
@[simp] lemma unary_update (ns : R → ℕ) (i : R) (n : ℕ) :
 unary (Function.update ns i n) = Function.update (unary ns) i (List.replicate n none)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.CounterLang.unary_update_self
statement:
@[simp] lemma unary_update_self (ns : R → ℕ) (r : R) :
 Function.update (unary ns) r (List.replicate (ns r) none) = unary ns

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Bounded.Program.eval_interpret
statement:
lemma Program.eval_interpret (p : Program V) (N : ℕ) (w : List Letter) (e) (s) :
 p.eval N w e s = p.interpret N (readTable N w) e s

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Bounded.Program.time_polynomial
statement:
lemma Program.time_polynomial (p : Program V) :
 ∃ q : Polynomial ℕ, ∀ N, p.time N (8*(N*N)) = q.eval N

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Bounded.cell_runs
statement:
lemma cell_runs (r : Symbol) (i j : Index) (f : V → Bool → V)
    (s : CState V) {S N} (hs : Ready S N s) :
 Runs (Program.compile (.cell r i j f)) s
   (result s ((Program.cell r i j f).eval N s.input (env s) (s.ctl.2,s.output)))
   (1000*(N+1)^2+10*s.input.length)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Bounded.compile_runs
statement:
lemma compile_runs (p : Program V) (S : Finset Index) (hw : p.WF S)
    (N : ℕ) (s : CState V) (hs : Ready S N s) :
 Runs p.compile s (result s (p.eval N s.input (env s) (s.ctl.2,s.output)))
   (p.time N s.input.length)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Bounded.env_index
statement:
@[simp] lemma env_index (s : CState V) (i : Index) (N k) :
 env (indexState (.idx i) (.rem i) N k s) = Function.update (env s) i k

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Bounded.env_result
statement: @[simp] lemma env_result (s : CState V) (v) : env (result s v) = env s

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Bounded.equalCode_runs
statement:
lemma equalCode_runs (i j : Index) (f : V → Bool → V) (s : CState V)
    (ha : s.nums .addr=0) (hp : s.nums .prod=0) (N : ℕ)
    (hi : s.nums (.idx i)≤N) (hj : s.nums (.idx j)≤N) :
 Runs (equalCode i j f) s (result s (f s.ctl.2 (s.nums (.idx i)==s.nums (.idx j)),s.output)) (100*(N+1))

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Bounded.fold_emits
statement:
lemma fold_emits {α : Type} (ls : List α) (step : V × List Letter → α → V × List Letter)
    (v : V) (chunk : α → List Letter)
    (h : ∀ a ∈ ls, ∀ out, step (v,out) a = (v,(chunk a).reverse++out)) (out) :
 ls.foldl step (v,out) = (v,(ls.flatMap chunk).reverse++out)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Bounded.loop_emits
statement:
lemma loop_emits (N : ℕ) (rel : Relation) (body : Program V) (i : Index)
    (e : Index → ℕ) (v : V) (chunk : ℕ → List Letter)
    (h : ∀ k<N, ∀ out, body.interpret N rel (Function.update e i k) (v,out) = (v,(chunk k).reverse++out))
    (out) :
 (Program.loop i body).interpret N rel e (v,out) =
   (v,((List.range N).flatMap chunk).reverse++out)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Bounded.readTable_input
statement:
lemma readTable_input {N} (S : OrderedQuery.Data N) (r : Symbol) (a b : Fin N) :
 readTable N (tableInput S) r a b = S.rel r a b

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Bounded.ready_index
statement:
lemma ready_index {S N} (s : CState V) (hs : Ready S N s) (i : Index) (k : ℕ) (hk : k≤N) :
 Ready (insert i S) N (indexState (.idx i) (.rem i) N k s)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Bounded.ready_result
statement: @[simp] lemma ready_result {S N} (s : CState V) (v) : Ready S N (result s v) ↔ Ready S N s

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Bounded.result_result
statement: @[simp] lemma result_result (s : CState V) (v w) : result (result s v) w = result s w

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.TableMachine.readCell_runs
statement:
lemma readCell_runs {V} (s : CState V) (k : ℕ) (i j : Index) (f : V → Option Letter → V)
   (haddr : s.nums .addr = 0) (hprod : s.nums .prod = 0) (htmp : s.nums .tmp = 0) :
 Runs (readCell k i j f) s
   {s with ctl := (false,f s.ctl.2 s.input[((k*s.nums .size+s.nums (.idx i))*s.nums .size+s.nums (.idx j))]?)}
   (16*k*(s.nums .size)^2+16*s.nums (.idx i)*s.nums .size +
     6*k*s.nums .size+8*k+16*s.nums .size+6*s.nums (.idx i)+16*s.nums (.idx j)+10*s.input.length+101)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.TableMachine.tableInput_length
statement: lemma tableInput_length {N} (S : OrderedQuery.Data N) : (tableInput S).length = 8*(N*N)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.TableMachine.tableInput_lookup
statement:
lemma tableInput_lookup {N} (S : OrderedQuery.Data N) (r : Symbol) (a b : Fin N) :
 (tableInput S)[((OrderedQuery.symbolIndex r).val*N+a.val)*N+b.val]? =
   some (bitLetter (S.rel r a b))

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.MatrixProgram.coefficientCode_spec
statement:
lemma coefficientCode_spec (N : ℕ) (rel : Relation) (e : Index → ℕ) (act mem : Bool) (acc : Scalar) (out) :
 coefficientCode.interpret N rel e (⟨act,mem,false,acc⟩,out) =
   (⟨act,mem,false,coefficient N rel (e .y) (e .a)⟩,out)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.MatrixProgram.coefficientStep_spec
statement:
lemma coefficientStep_spec (N : ℕ) (rel : Relation) (e : Index → ℕ) (act mem : Bool) (acc : Scalar) (out) :
 coefficientStep.interpret N rel e (⟨act,mem,false,acc⟩,out) =
   (⟨act,mem,false,acc+contribution rel (e .y) (e .a) (e .x)⟩,out)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.MatrixProgram.coefficient_eq_ordered
statement: lemma coefficient_eq_ordered (y a : Fin N) : coefficient N rel y a = OrderedQuery.coefficient S y a

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.MatrixProgram.coefficient_fold_spec
statement:
lemma coefficient_fold_spec (N : ℕ) (rel : Relation) (e : Index → ℕ)
    (ls : List ℕ) (act mem : Bool) (acc : Scalar) (out) :
 ls.foldl (fun s k => coefficientStep.interpret N rel (Function.update e .x k) s)
    (⟨act,mem,false,acc⟩,out) =
   (⟨act,mem,false,acc+(ls.map (contribution rel (e .y) (e .a))).sum⟩,out)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.MatrixProgram.consActive_eq
statement:
lemma consActive_eq (t y : Fin N) : consActive N rel t y =
 (S.rel .Cf t t && S.rel .Ed y y && OrderedQuery.incident S t y)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.MatrixProgram.consChunk_eq
statement:
lemma consChunk_eq (t y : Fin N) : consChunk N rel t y =
 (SerialGaussian.Row.encode (OrderedQuery.consistencyRow S t y)).coeff.map some ++
   [some (OrderedQuery.consistencyRow S t y).rhs,none]

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.MatrixProgram.consRowCode_spec
statement:
lemma consRowCode_spec (N : ℕ) (rel : Relation) (e : Index → ℕ) (c : Control) (out) :
 consRowCode.interpret N rel e (c,out) =
   (ctrl false,(consChunk N rel (e .t) (e .y)).reverse++out)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.MatrixProgram.contribution_eq
statement:
lemma contribution_eq (y a x : Fin N) :
 contribution rel y a x = if S.rel .Ed x x ∧ S.rel .I a x then
   ∑ δ : Scalar, if S.rel (.Z δ) y x then δ else 0 else 0

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.MatrixProgram.incidentCode_spec
statement:
lemma incidentCode_spec (N : ℕ) (rel : Relation) (e : Index → ℕ) (c : Control) (out) :
 incidentCode.interpret N rel e (c,out) =
   (ctrl (incident N rel (e .t) (e .y)),out)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.MatrixProgram.incidentStepA_spec
statement:
lemma incidentStepA_spec (N : ℕ) (rel : Relation) (e : Index → ℕ) (act : Bool) (out) :
 incidentStepA.interpret N rel e (ctrl act,out) =
   (ctrl (act || (member rel (e .t) (e .a) && (List.range N).any (edgeTest rel (e .y) (e .a)))),out)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.MatrixProgram.incidentStepX_spec
statement:
lemma incidentStepX_spec (N : ℕ) (rel : Relation) (e : Index → ℕ) (act mem : Bool) (out) :
 incidentStepX.interpret N rel e (⟨act,mem,false,0⟩,out) =
   (⟨act || (mem && edgeTest rel (e .y) (e .a) (e .x)),mem,false,0⟩,out)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.MatrixProgram.incident_eq_ordered
statement: lemma incident_eq_ordered (t y : Fin N) : incident N rel t y = OrderedQuery.incident S t y

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.MatrixProgram.incident_fold_a
statement:
lemma incident_fold_a (N : ℕ) (rel : Relation) (e : Index → ℕ)
    (ls : List ℕ) (act : Bool) (out) :
 ls.foldl (fun s k => incidentStepA.interpret N rel (Function.update e .a k) s)
    (ctrl act,out) =
   (ctrl (act || ls.any (fun a => member rel (e .t) a &&
     (List.range N).any (edgeTest rel (e .y) a))),out)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.MatrixProgram.incident_fold_x
statement:
lemma incident_fold_x (N : ℕ) (rel : Relation) (e : Index → ℕ)
    (ls : List ℕ) (act mem : Bool) (out) :
 ls.foldl (fun s k => incidentStepX.interpret N rel (Function.update e .x k) s)
    (⟨act,mem,false,0⟩,out) =
   (⟨act || (mem && ls.any (edgeTest rel (e .y) (e .a))),mem,false,0⟩,out)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.MatrixProgram.interp_cell
statement:
lemma interp_cell {V} (r i j) (f : V → Bool → V) (N : ℕ) (rel : Relation) (e) (s) :
 (Bounded.Program.cell r i j f).interpret N rel e s = (f s.1 (rel r (e i) (e j)),s.2)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.MatrixProgram.interp_emit
statement:
lemma interp_emit {V} (f : V → Letter) (N : ℕ) (rel : Relation) (e) (s) :
 (Bounded.Program.emit f).interpret N rel e s = (s.1,f s.1::s.2)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.MatrixProgram.interp_load
statement:
lemma interp_load {V} (f : V → V) (N : ℕ) (rel : Relation) (e) (s) :
 (Bounded.Program.load f).interpret N rel e s = (f s.1,s.2)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.MatrixProgram.interp_seq
statement:
lemma interp_seq {V} (a b : Bounded.Program V) (N : ℕ) (rel : Relation) (e) (s) :
 (Bounded.Program.seq a b).interpret N rel e s = b.interpret N rel e (a.interpret N rel e s)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.MatrixProgram.lambdaColumn_spec
statement:
lemma lambdaColumn_spec (N : ℕ) (rel : Relation) (e : Index → ℕ) (act : Bool) (out) :
 lambdaColumn.interpret N rel e (ctrl act,out) =
   (ctrl act,some (if act && member rel (e .t) (e .a) then -coefficient N rel (e .y) (e .a) else 0)::out)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.MatrixProgram.matrix_eq_payload
statement: lemma matrix_eq_payload : matrix N rel = SerialGaussian.payload (SerialGaussian.queryRows S)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.MatrixProgram.matrix_input
statement:
lemma matrix_input {N : ℕ} (S : OrderedQuery.Data N) :
 matrix N (readTable N (tableInput S)) = SerialGaussian.payload (SerialGaussian.queryRows S)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.MatrixProgram.memberCode_spec
statement:
lemma memberCode_spec (N : ℕ) (rel : Relation) (e : Index → ℕ) (c : Control) (out) :
 memberCode.interpret N rel e (c,out) = ({c with member := member rel (e .t) (e .a)},out)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.MatrixProgram.muColumn_spec
statement:
lemma muColumn_spec (N : ℕ) (rel : Relation) (e : Index → ℕ) (act : Bool) (out) :
 muColumn.interpret N rel e (ctrl act,out) =
   (ctrl act,some (if act && (e .z == e .y) then 1 else 0)::out)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.MatrixProgram.normChunk_eq
statement:
lemma normChunk_eq (t : Fin N) : normChunk N rel t =
 (SerialGaussian.Row.encode (OrderedQuery.normalizationRow S t)).coeff.map some ++
   [some (OrderedQuery.normalizationRow S t).rhs,none]

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.MatrixProgram.normColumn_spec
statement:
lemma normColumn_spec (N : ℕ) (rel : Relation) (e : Index → ℕ) (act : Bool) (out) :
 normColumn.interpret N rel e (ctrl act,out) =
   (ctrl act,some (if act && member rel (e .t) (e .a) then 1 else 0)::out)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.MatrixProgram.normRowCode_spec
statement:
lemma normRowCode_spec (N : ℕ) (rel : Relation) (e : Index → ℕ) (c : Control) (out) :
 normRowCode.interpret N rel e (c,out) =
   (ctrl false,(normChunk N rel (e .t)).reverse++out)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.MatrixProgram.ofFn_addCases
statement:
lemma ofFn_addCases {α : Type} {m n : ℕ} (f : Fin m → α) (g : Fin n → α) :
 List.ofFn (Fin.addCases f g) = List.ofFn f ++ List.ofFn g

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.MatrixProgram.program_spec
statement:
lemma program_spec (N : ℕ) (rel : Relation) (e : Index → ℕ) (c : Control) (out) :
 program.interpret N rel e (c,out) = (ctrl false,(matrix N rel).reverse++out)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.MatrixProgram.program_wf
statement: lemma program_wf : program.WF ∅

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.MatrixProgram.range_eq_finRange_map
statement: lemma range_eq_finRange_map (N : ℕ) : List.range N = (List.finRange N).map Fin.val

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.MatrixProgram.range_flatMap_eq
statement:
lemma range_flatMap_eq {α} (N : ℕ) (f : ℕ → List α) :

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.MatrixProgram.range_map_eq
statement:
lemma range_map_eq {α} (N : ℕ) (f : ℕ → α) :
 (List.range N).map f = List.ofFn (fun i : Fin N => f i)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.MatrixProgram.sum_scalar_three
statement: lemma sum_scalar_three (f : Scalar → Scalar) : (∑ δ, f δ) = f 0+f 1+f 2

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.QueryMachine.answer_correct
statement: lemma answer_correct (S : OrderedQuery.OrderedInput) : answer S = true ↔ S.2.query

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.QueryMachine.build_runs
statement:
lemma build_runs {N} (S : OrderedQuery.Data N) :
 CounterLang.Runs build (cs 0 (TableMachine.code ⟨N,S⟩) [])
   (cs N (TableMachine.tableInput S) (SerialGaussian.payload (SerialGaussian.queryRows S)).reverse)
   (8*N+4+MatrixProgram.program.time N (TableMachine.tableInput S).length)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.QueryMachine.code_decode
statement:
lemma code_decode (S : OrderedQuery.OrderedInput) :
 OrderedQuery.decode ((TableMachine.code S).map projectLetter) = S

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.QueryMachine.code_injective
statement: lemma code_injective : Function.Injective TableMachine.code

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.QueryMachine.code_length
statement:
@[simp] lemma code_length (S : OrderedQuery.OrderedInput) :
 (TableMachine.code S).length = S.1+1+8*(S.1*S.1)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.QueryMachine.code_map
statement:
lemma code_map (S : OrderedQuery.OrderedInput) :
 TableMachine.code S = (OrderedQuery.encode S).map includeLetter

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.QueryMachine.cs_ready
statement:
lemma cs_ready (n : ℕ) (input output : List Letter) :
 Bounded.Ready ∅ n (cs n input output)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.QueryMachine.final_configuration
statement:
lemma final_configuration (b : Bool) : configuration (Λ := program.Labels) none (finalStore b) =
 haltList machine (GaussMachine.boolCode b)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.QueryMachine.finish_runs
statement:
lemma finish_runs (n : ℕ) (input : List Letter) (b : Bool) :
 Runs finish
   (combined {cs n input [] with nums := Function.update (TableMachine.headerNums n) .width 0}
     (GaussMachine.ctrl 0 b) {output := GaussMachine.boolCode b})
   (finalStore b) (2*input.length+2*n+9)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.QueryMachine.initial_configuration
statement:
lemma initial_configuration (S : OrderedQuery.OrderedInput) :
 configuration (some program.start)
   (combined (cs 0 (TableMachine.code S) []) (GaussMachine.ctrl 0 true) {}) =
 initList machine (TableMachine.code S)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.QueryMachine.polynomial_eval_mono
statement: lemma polynomial_eval_mono (p : Polynomial ℕ) {a b : ℕ} (h : a ≤ b) : p.eval a ≤ p.eval b

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.QueryMachine.program_runs
statement:
lemma program_runs {N} (S : OrderedQuery.Data N) :
 Runs program (combined (cs 0 (TableMachine.code ⟨N,S⟩) []) (GaussMachine.ctrl 0 true) {})
   (finalStore (SerialGaussian.solve (SerialGaussian.queryRows S))) (time N)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.QueryMachine.project_include
statement: @[simp] lemma project_include (a : OrderedQuery.Alphabet) : projectLetter (includeLetter a) = a

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.QueryMachine.solver_framed
statement:
lemma solver_framed {n} (s : TableMachine.CState MatrixProgram.Control)
 (rs : List (SerialGaussian.Row n)) :
 Runs GaussMachine.solver.frameRight
   (combined s (GaussMachine.ctrl 0 true) {mat := SerialGaussian.payload rs,width := List.replicate n none})
   (combined s (GaussMachine.ctrl 0 (SerialGaussian.solve rs)) {output := GaussMachine.boolCode (SerialGaussian.solve rs)})
   (300*(rs.length+1)*(n+3)^2)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.QueryMachine.time_polynomial
statement: lemma time_polynomial : ∃ p : Polynomial ℕ, ∀ N, time N = p.eval N

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.QueryMachine.transfers_runs
statement:
lemma transfers_runs (s : TableMachine.CState MatrixProgram.Control) (n : ℕ) (xs : List Letter)
 (hs : s.output = xs.reverse) (hw : s.nums .width=n) :
 Runs transfers (combined s (GaussMachine.ctrl 0 true) {})
   (combined {s with output := [], nums := Function.update s.nums .width 0}
     (GaussMachine.ctrl 0 true) {mat := xs,width := List.replicate n none})
   (2*xs.length+2*n+7)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.StackLang.Action.run_frameLeft
statement:
lemma Action.run_frameLeft (a : Action (fun _ : K => α) (Option α × σ))
 (s : SStore K α σ) (v : τ) (g : L → List α) :
 a.frameLeft.run (leftStore s v g) = leftStore (a.run s) v g

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.StackLang.Action.run_frameRight
statement:
lemma Action.run_frameRight (a : Action (fun _ : K => α) (Option α × σ))
 (s : SStore K α σ) (v : τ) (g : L → List α) :
 a.frameRight.run (rightStore s v g) = rightStore (a.run s) v g

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.StackLang.Runs.frameLeft
statement:
lemma Runs.frameLeft {p : SProgram K α σ} {s t} {n} (h : Runs p s t n)
 (v : τ) (g : L → List α) : Runs p.frameLeft (leftStore s v g) (leftStore t v g) n

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.StackLang.Runs.frameRight
statement:
lemma Runs.frameRight {p : SProgram K α σ} {s t} {n} (h : Runs p s t n)
 (v : τ) (g : L → List α) : Runs p.frameRight (rightStore s v g) (rightStore t v g) n

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.StackLang.update_sum_left
statement:
@[simp] lemma update_sum_left (f : K → List α) (g : L → List α) (k : K) (xs : List α) :
 Function.update (Sum.elim f g) (.inl k) xs = Sum.elim (Function.update f k xs) g

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.StackLang.update_sum_right
statement:
@[simp] lemma update_sum_right (f : K → List α) (g : L → List α) (k : L) (xs : List α) :
 Function.update (Sum.elim f g) (.inr k) xs = Sum.elim f (Function.update g k xs)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.TableMachine.headerBody_runs
statement:
lemma headerBody_runs (v : V) (k n : ℕ) (w out : List Letter) :
 Runs (headerBody (V := V)) (headerState v k (n+1) w out) (headerState v (k+1) n w out) 7

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.TableMachine.headerLoop_runs
statement:
lemma headerLoop_runs (v : V) (k n : ℕ) (w out : List Letter) :
 Runs headerLoop (headerState v k n w out)
   (⟨(false,v),headerNums (k+n),w,out⟩ : CState V) (8*n+1)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.TableMachine.headerNums_inc
statement:
lemma headerNums_inc (k : ℕ) :
 Function.update (Function.update (Function.update (headerNums k) .size (k+1)) .width (k+k+1)) .width (k+k+1+1) =
 headerNums (k+1)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.TableMachine.header_runs
statement:
lemma header_runs (v : V) (n : ℕ) (w out : List Letter) :
 Runs header (⟨(false,v),headerNums 0,List.replicate n none ++ some 0::w,out⟩ : CState V)
   (⟨(false,v),headerNums n,w,out⟩ : CState V) (8*n+3)

    ∃ z : ℕ → GaussianInt, (∀ n, z n ∈ A) ∧ Function.Injective z ∧

statement:
theorem SplitSieve.eligible_product_le_norm (s : SplitSieve) (t : Finset ℕ)
    (ht : t ⊆ s.primes) (σ : ℕ → Bool) {v : GaussianInt} (hv : v ≠ 0)
    (hd : ∀ p ∈ t, signedFactor (s.factor p) (σ p) ∣ v) :
    (∏ p ∈ t, (p : ℤ)) ≤ v.norm

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.SplitSieve.line_witness_norm_lower
statement:
theorem SplitSieve.line_witness_norm_lower (s : SplitSieve)
    (t : Finset ℕ) (ht : t ⊆ s.primes) (σ : ℕ → Bool)
    {v w : GaussianInt} (hv : PrimitiveDirection v) (hw : w ≠ 0)
    (hline : determinant v w = 0)
    (hdiv : (∏ p ∈ t, signedFactor (s.factor p) (σ p)) ∣ w) :
    v.norm * (∏ p ∈ t.filter (fun p => ¬ signedFactor (s.factor p) (σ p) ∣ v), (p : ℤ)) ^ 2
      ≤ w.norm

    (hw : (∏ p ∈ t, signedFactor (s.factor p) (σ p)) ∣ (a : GaussianInt) * v) :
    (∏ p ∈ t.filter (fun p => ¬ signedFactor (s.factor p) (σ p) ∣ v), (p : ℤ)) ∣ a

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.sign_hoeffding
statement:
theorem sign_hoeffding {ι : Type uIota} [Fintype ι] (f : ι → Bool → ℝ) (w : ι → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ i b, f i b ∈ Set.Icc 0 (w i)) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 ≤ ε) :
    (signMeasure ι).real {σ | ε + ∑ i, (f i false + f i true) / 2 ≤ ∑ i, f i (σ i)}
      ≤ Real.exp (-ε ^ 2 / (2 * ∑ i, (((‖w i‖₊ / 2) ^ 2 : ℝ≥0) : ℝ)))

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.cubeBoundary_expand_bound
statement:
theorem cubeBoundary_expand_bound {n : ℕ} (S : Cube n → Prop) :

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.cubeBoundary_succ
statement:
theorem cubeBoundary_succ {n : ℕ} (S : Cube (n+1) → Prop) :
    cubeBoundary S = cubeBoundary (fun x => S (false,x)) + cubeBoundary (fun x => S (true,x)) +
      cubeCross (fun x => S (false,x)) (fun x => S (true,x)) +
      cubeCross (fun x => S (true,x)) (fun x => S (false,x))

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.cubeCross_card_le

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.cubeDist_zero_iff

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.cubeSize_mono
statement:
theorem cubeSize_mono {n : ℕ} {S T : Cube n → Prop} (h : ∀ x, S x → T x) :

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.cubeSize_succ

theorem cubeSize_succ {n : ℕ} (S : Cube (n+1) → Prop) :

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.cubeSize_sum_le
statement:
theorem cubeSize_sum_le {n : ℕ} {ι : Type uIota} [Fintype ι] (S : ι → Cube n → Prop)

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.cube_degree
