name: OAI.GaussianMoat.cube_edge_isoperimetric
statement:
theorem cube_edge_isoperimetric (n : ℕ) (S : Cube n → Prop) :
    (cubeSize S : ℝ) * ((n : ℝ) * Real.log 2 - Real.log (cubeSize S)) ≤
      (cubeBoundary S : ℝ) * Real.log 2

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.cube_growth
statement:
theorem cube_growth {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (S : Cube n → Prop) {a E : ℝ}
    (hE : 0 < E) (hlogE : Real.log E ≤ (n : ℝ) * Real.log 2 - a)
    (hsize : (cubeSize S : ℝ) ≤ E) :
    (1 + a / ((n : ℝ) * Real.log 2)) * cubeSize S ≤ cubeSize (cubeExpand S)

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.cube_iter_growth
statement:
theorem cube_iter_growth {n : ℕ} (S : Cube n → Prop) {δ E : ℝ} (hδ : 0 ≤ δ)
    (hgrow : ∀ T : Cube n → Prop, (cubeSize T : ℝ) ≤ E →
      (1+δ)*cubeSize T ≤ cubeSize (cubeExpand T)) (h : ℕ) :
    min E ((1+δ)^h * cubeSize S) ≤ cubeSize (cubeExpandIter S h)

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.cube_separated_bound
statement:
theorem cube_separated_bound {n h : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) {ι : Type uIota} [Fintype ι]
    (S : ι → Cube n → Prop) {a E A : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hE : 0 < E)
    (hlogE : Real.log E ≤ (n : ℝ) * Real.log 2 - a)
    (hseed : ∀ i, A * cubeSize (S i) ≤ E)
    (hfactor : A ≤ (1 + a / ((n : ℝ)*Real.log 2))^h)
    (hsep : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → ∀ x, S i x → ∀ y, S j y → 2*h < cubeDist n x y) :
    A * (∑ i, (cubeSize (S i) : ℝ)) ≤ (2 : ℝ)^n

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.entropy_merge
statement:
theorem entropy_merge {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) :
    2 * min a b * Real.log 2 ≤ (a+b)*Real.log (a+b) - a*Real.log a - b*Real.log b

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.entropy_merge_of_le
statement:
theorem entropy_merge_of_le {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hab : a ≤ b) :
    2 * a * Real.log 2 ≤ (a+b)*Real.log (a+b) - a*Real.log a - b*Real.log b

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.SplitSieve.badLine_primitive
statement:
theorem SplitSieve.badLine_primitive (s : SplitSieve) (Q : Set GaussianInt)
    (L : s.badLines Q) : ∃ v : GaussianInt, PrimitiveDirection v ∧ v ≠ 0 ∧ witnessLine v = L.val

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.SplitSieve.badSign_iff_class
statement:
theorem SplitSieve.badSign_iff_class (s : SplitSieve) (Q : Set GaussianInt) (σ : s.primes → Bool) :
    s.badSign Q σ ↔ ∃ L : s.badLines Q, s.lineClass Q L σ

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.SplitSieve.badWitness_spec
statement:
theorem SplitSieve.badWitness_spec (s : SplitSieve) (Q : Set GaussianInt)
    (σ : {σ : s.primes → Bool // s.badSign Q σ}) :
    s.badWitness Q σ ∈ Q ∧ s.badWitness Q σ ≠ 0 ∧ s.signedProduct σ.val ∣ s.badWitness Q σ

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.SplitSieve.commonProduct_comm
statement:
theorem SplitSieve.commonProduct_comm (s : SplitSieve) (σ τ : s.primes → Bool) :
    s.commonProduct σ τ = s.commonProduct τ σ

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.SplitSieve.commonProduct_dvd_left
statement:
theorem SplitSieve.commonProduct_dvd_left (s : SplitSieve) (σ τ : s.primes → Bool) :
    s.commonProduct σ τ ∣ s.signedProduct σ

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.SplitSieve.commonProduct_dvd_right
statement:
theorem SplitSieve.commonProduct_dvd_right (s : SplitSieve) (σ τ : s.primes → Bool) :
    s.commonProduct σ τ ∣ s.signedProduct τ

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.SplitSieve.extendSigns_mem
statement:
@[simp] theorem SplitSieve.extendSigns_mem (s : SplitSieve) (σ : s.primes → Bool)
    (p : ℕ) (hp : p ∈ s.primes) : s.extendSigns σ p = σ ⟨p,hp⟩

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.SplitSieve.lineClass_subset_event
OAI.GaussianMoat.SplitSieve.line_event_tail
statement:
theorem SplitSieve.line_event_tail (s : SplitSieve) {Q : Set GaussianInt}
    {v : GaussianInt} (hv : PrimitiveDirection v) (hv0 : v ≠ 0) {B ε : ℝ}
    (hQ : ∀ w ∈ Q, (w.norm : ℝ) ≤ B) (hε : 0 ≤ ε)
    (hexcess : ε ≤ (∑ p : s.primes, Real.log (p : ℝ)) - Real.log B / 2) :
    (signMeasure s.primes).real {σ | s.lineEvent Q v σ} ≤
      Real.exp (-ε^2 / (2 * ∑ p : s.primes,
        (((‖Real.log (p : ℝ)‖₊ / 2)^2 : ℝ≥0) : ℝ)))

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.SplitSieve.line_witness_log_lower
statement:
theorem SplitSieve.line_witness_log_lower (s : SplitSieve) (σ : s.primes → Bool)
    {v w : GaussianInt} (hv : PrimitiveDirection v) (hv0 : v ≠ 0) (hw : w ≠ 0)
    (hline : determinant v w = 0) (hdiv : s.signedProduct σ ∣ w)
    {B : ℝ} (hbound : (w.norm : ℝ) ≤ B) :
    Real.log (v.norm : ℝ) / 2 + (∑ p : s.primes, Real.log (p : ℝ)) - Real.log B / 2 ≤
      ∑ p : s.primes, s.lineLog v p (σ p)

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.SplitSieve.logVariance_le
OAI.GaussianMoat.SplitSieve.logVariance_pos
statement:
theorem SplitSieve.logVariance_pos (s : SplitSieve) (hr : 0 < s.primes.card) :
    0 < s.logVariance

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.SplitSieve.log_period
statement:
theorem SplitSieve.log_period (s : SplitSieve) :
    Real.log (s.period : ℝ) = ∑ p : s.primes, Real.log (p : ℝ)

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.SplitSieve.signDist_eq_card
statement:
theorem SplitSieve.signDist_eq_card (s : SplitSieve) (σ τ : s.primes → Bool) :
    signDist σ τ = (s.primes.filter (fun p => s.extendSigns σ p ≠ s.extendSigns τ p)).card

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.cubeEquiv_dist
statement:
theorem cubeEquiv_dist (n : ℕ) (x y : Cube n) :
    signDist (cubeEquiv n x) (cubeEquiv n y) = cubeDist n x y

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.cubeSignEquiv_dist
statement:
theorem cubeSignEquiv_dist (ι : Type uIota) [Fintype ι] (x y : Cube (Fintype.card ι)) :
    signDist (cubeSignEquiv ι x) (cubeSignEquiv ι y) = cubeDist (Fintype.card ι) x y

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.cubeSignEquiv_measure
statement:
theorem cubeSignEquiv_measure {ι : Type uIota} [Fintype ι] (S : (ι → Bool) → Prop) :
    (signMeasure ι).real {σ | S σ} =
      (cubeSize (fun x => S (cubeSignEquiv ι x)) : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ)^Fintype.card ι

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.cubeSize_exists_le_sum
statement:
theorem cubeSize_exists_le_sum {n : ℕ} {ι : Type uIota} [Fintype ι]
    (S : ι → Cube n → Prop) : cubeSize (fun x => ∃ i, S i x) ≤ ∑ i, cubeSize (S i)

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.determinant_rotated
statement:
theorem determinant_rotated (e : ℂ) (he : ‖e‖ = 1) (z w : GaussianInt) :
    (determinant z w : ℝ) =
      (star e * (z : ℂ)).re * (star e * (w : ℂ)).im -
      (star e * (z : ℂ)).im * (star e * (w : ℂ)).re

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.determinant_self
statement: @[simp] theorem determinant_self (v : GaussianInt) : determinant v v = 0

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.determinant_swap
statement: theorem determinant_swap (u v : GaussianInt) : determinant u v = -determinant v u

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.determinant_zero_trans
statement:
theorem determinant_zero_trans {u v w : GaussianInt} (hv : v ≠ 0)
    (huv : determinant u v = 0) (hvw : determinant v w = 0) :
    determinant u w = 0

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.rectangle_cube_growth
statement:
theorem rectangle_cube_growth {r : ℕ} {d : ℝ} (hd : 0 < d) (hd1 : d ≤ 1/4)
    (hlarge : 1000 ≤ d^3 * r) :
    let h := ⌊d * r / 10⌋₊
    d^3 * r / 5120 ≤ (h : ℝ) * Real.log (1 + (d^2 * r / 64) / ((r : ℝ) * Real.log 2))

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.rectangle_determinant_bound
OAI.GaussianMoat.rectangle_hoeffding_exponent
statement:
theorem rectangle_hoeffding_exponent {r d t l V : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (hd : 0 ≤ d)
    (ht : 0 < t) (hl : r*t ≤ l) (hV : 0 < V) (hVup : V ≤ r*t^2) :
    2*(d^2*r/64) ≤ (d*l/2)^2 / (2*V)

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.rectangle_linear_large
statement:
theorem rectangle_linear_large {r d : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hd : 0 ≤ d) (hd1 : d ≤ 1)
    (hlarge : 1000 ≤ d^3 * r) : 1000 ≤ d*r

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.rectangle_log_excess
statement:
theorem rectangle_log_excess {r : ℕ} {d t l : ℝ} (hd : 0 < d) (hd1 : d ≤ 1/4)
    (ht : 1/2 ≤ t) (hl : (r : ℝ)*t ≤ l) (hlarge : 1000 ≤ d^3 * r) :
    d*l/2 ≤ l - ((1-d)*l + Real.log 2/2)

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.rectangle_log_small
statement:
theorem rectangle_log_small {r : ℕ} {d t u l : ℝ}
    (hd : 0 < d) (hd1 : d ≤ 1/4) (ht : 1/2 ≤ t) (hu : 0 ≤ u) (hutu : u ≤ 2*t)
    (hl : (r : ℝ)*t ≤ l) (hlarge : 1000 ≤ d^3 * r) :
    Real.log 2 + (1-d)*l + (2*⌊d*r/10⌋₊ : ℕ)*u < l

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.rectangle_norm_bound
OAI.GaussianMoat.signMeasure_real_set
statement:
theorem signMeasure_real_set {ι : Type uIota} [Fintype ι] (S : Set (ι → Bool)) :
    (signMeasure ι).real S = (∑ σ, if σ ∈ S then (1 : ℝ) else 0) /
      (2 : ℝ)^Fintype.card ι

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.signMeasure_real_singleton
statement:
theorem signMeasure_real_singleton {ι : Type uIota} [Fintype ι] (σ : ι → Bool) :
    (signMeasure ι).real {σ} = ((2 : ℝ)^Fintype.card ι)⁻¹

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.witnessLine_eq
statement:
theorem witnessLine_eq {v w : GaussianInt} (hv : v ≠ 0) (hw : w ≠ 0)
    (hvw : determinant v w = 0) : witnessLine v = witnessLine w

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.FinLaw.H_bool
statement:
theorem H_bool (p : FinLaw Ω) (E : Ω → Bool) :
    p.H E = Real.binEntropy (p.map E true)

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.FinLaw.H_comp_injective
statement:
theorem H_comp_injective (p : FinLaw Ω) (X : Ω → α) (f : α → β)
    (hf : Function.Injective f) : p.H (f ∘ X) = p.H X

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.FinLaw.H_const
statement: @[simp] theorem H_const (p : FinLaw Ω) (a : α) : p.H (fun _ => a) = 0

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.FinLaw.H_eq_of_fibers
statement:
theorem H_eq_of_fibers (p : FinLaw Ω) (X : Ω → α) (Y : Ω → β)
    (hf : ∀ ω ω', X ω = X ω' ↔ Y ω = Y ω') : p.H X = p.H Y

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.FinLaw.H_eq_sum
statement:
theorem H_eq_sum (p : FinLaw Ω) (X : Ω → α) :
    p.H X = -∑ ω, p ω * Real.log (p.map X (X ω))

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.FinLaw.H_le_condH_add
statement:
theorem H_le_condH_add (p : FinLaw Ω) (X : Ω → α) (Y : Ω → β) :
    p.H X ≤ p.condH X Y + p.H Y

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.FinLaw.H_map
statement:
@[simp] theorem H_map (p : FinLaw Ω) (X : Ω → α) (f : α → β) :
    (p.map X).H f = p.H (f ∘ X)

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.FinLaw.H_pair_assoc
statement:
theorem H_pair_assoc (p : FinLaw Ω) (X : Ω → α) (Y : Ω → β) (Z : Ω → γ) :
    p.H (fun ω => (X ω,(Y ω,Z ω))) = p.H (fun ω => ((X ω,Y ω),Z ω))

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.FinLaw.H_pair_comm
statement:
theorem H_pair_comm (p : FinLaw Ω) (X : Ω → α) (Y : Ω → β) :
    p.H (fun ω => (X ω,Y ω)) = p.H (fun ω => (Y ω,X ω))

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.FinLaw.H_pair_function
statement:
theorem H_pair_function (p : FinLaw Ω) (X : Ω → α) (f : α → β) :
    p.H (fun ω => (X ω,f (X ω))) = p.H X

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.FinLaw.H_pair_ge_snd
statement:
theorem H_pair_ge_snd (p : FinLaw Ω) (X : Ω → α) (Y : Ω → β) :
    p.H Y ≤ p.H (fun ω => (X ω,Y ω))

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.FinLaw.H_pair_subadd
statement:
theorem H_pair_subadd (p : FinLaw Ω) (X : Ω → α) (Y : Ω → β) :
    p.H (fun ω => (X ω,Y ω)) ≤ p.H X + p.H Y

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.FinLaw.H_strong_subadd
statement:
theorem H_strong_subadd (p : FinLaw Ω) (X : Ω → α) (Y : Ω → β) (Z : Ω → γ) :
    p.H (fun ω => (X ω,(Y ω,Z ω))) + p.H Y ≤
      p.H (fun ω => (X ω,Y ω)) + p.H (fun ω => (Y ω,Z ω))

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.FinLaw.condH_le_H
statement: theorem condH_le_H (p : FinLaw Ω) (X : Ω → α) (Y : Ω → β) : p.condH X Y ≤ p.H X

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.FinLaw.condH_le_reveal
statement:
theorem condH_le_reveal (p : FinLaw Ω) (X : Ω → α) (Y : Ω → β) (Z : Ω → γ) :
    p.condH X Y ≤ p.H Z + p.condH X (fun ω => (Y ω,Z ω))

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.FinLaw.condH_le_support
statement:
theorem condH_le_support (p : FinLaw Ω) (X : Ω → α) (Y : Ω → β)
    (L : β → Finset α) (hs : ∀ ω, p ω ≠ 0 → X ω ∈ L (Y ω)) :
    p.condH X Y ≤ ∑ b, p.map Y b * Real.log (L b).card

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.FinLaw.condH_mono
statement:
theorem condH_mono (p : FinLaw Ω) (X : Ω → α) (Y : Ω → β) (Z : Ω → γ) :
    p.condH X (fun ω => (Y ω,Z ω)) ≤ p.condH X Y

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.FinLaw.condH_nonneg
statement: theorem condH_nonneg (p : FinLaw Ω) (X : Ω → α) (Y : Ω → β) : 0 ≤ p.condH X Y

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.FinLaw.condH_pair_comm
statement:
theorem condH_pair_comm (p : FinLaw Ω) (X : Ω → α) (Y : Ω → β) (Z : Ω → γ) :
    p.condH X (fun ω => (Y ω,Z ω)) = p.condH X (fun ω => (Z ω,Y ω))

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.FinLaw.condMutualInfo_nonneg
statement:
theorem condMutualInfo_nonneg (p : FinLaw Ω) (X : Ω → α) (Y : Ω → β) (Z : Ω → γ) :
    0 ≤ p.condMutualInfo X Y Z

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.FinLaw.entropySum_le_mass_log_card
statement:
theorem entropySum_le_mass_log_card (p : α → ℝ) (hp : ∀ a, 0 ≤ p a) :
    entropySum p ≤ (∑ a, p a)*Real.log (Fintype.card α) + Real.negMulLog (∑ a, p a)

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.FinLaw.entropySum_le_mass_log_support
statement:
theorem entropySum_le_mass_log_support (p : α → ℝ) (hp : ∀ a, 0 ≤ p a)
    (S : Finset α) (hs : ∀ a, a ∉ S → p a = 0) :
    entropySum p ≤ (∑ a, p a)*Real.log S.card + Real.negMulLog (∑ a, p a)

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.FinLaw.entropySum_scale
statement:
theorem entropySum_scale (p : α → ℝ) (c : ℝ) :
    entropySum (fun a => c*p a) = c*entropySum p + (∑ a, p a)*Real.negMulLog c

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.FinLaw.entropy_ge_snd
statement: theorem entropy_ge_snd (p : FinLaw (α × β)) : (p.map Prod.snd).entropy ≤ p.entropy

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.FinLaw.entropy_le_log_card
statement: theorem entropy_le_log_card (p : FinLaw α) : p.entropy ≤ Real.log (Fintype.card α)

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.FinLaw.entropy_mix_ge
statement:
theorem entropy_mix_ge (p : FinLaw Ω) (q : Ω → FinLaw α) :
    (∑ ω, p ω * (q ω).entropy) ≤ (p.mix q).entropy

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.FinLaw.entropy_nonneg
statement: theorem entropy_nonneg (p : FinLaw α) : 0 ≤ p.entropy

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.FinLaw.entropy_strong_subadd
statement:
theorem entropy_strong_subadd (p : FinLaw (α × (β × γ))) :
    p.entropy + (p.map (fun x => x.2.1)).entropy ≤
      (p.map (fun x => (x.1,x.2.1))).entropy + (p.map Prod.snd).entropy

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.FinLaw.entropy_subadd
statement:
theorem entropy_subadd (p : FinLaw (α × β)) :
    p.entropy ≤ (p.map Prod.fst).entropy + (p.map Prod.snd).entropy

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.FinLaw.ext
statement: @[ext] theorem ext {p q : FinLaw α} (h : ∀ a, p a = q a) : p = q

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.FinLaw.le_one
statement: theorem le_one (p : FinLaw α) (a : α) : p a ≤ 1

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.FinLaw.log_card_le_real
statement:
theorem log_card_le_real (S : Finset α) {b : ℝ} (hb : 1 ≤ b) (hs : (S.card : ℝ) ≤ b) :
    Real.log S.card ≤ Real.log b

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.FinLaw.low_mass_deficit
statement:
theorem low_mass_deficit (p : FinLaw α) (S : Finset α)
    (hs : ∀ a ∈ S, p a ≤ 3 / (8 * (Fintype.card α : ℝ))) :
    (S.card : ℝ) / (8 * (Fintype.card α : ℝ)) ≤ Real.log (Fintype.card α) - p.entropy

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.FinLaw.map_comp
statement:
@[simp] theorem map_comp (p : FinLaw α) (f : α → β) (g : β → γ) :
    (p.map f).map g = p.map (g ∘ f)

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.FinLaw.map_fst_mass
statement:
@[simp] theorem map_fst_mass (p : FinLaw (α × β)) (a : α) :
    p.map Prod.fst a = ∑ b, p (a,b)

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.FinLaw.map_id
statement: @[simp] theorem map_id (p : FinLaw α) : p.map id = p

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.FinLaw.map_mass
statement:
@[simp] theorem map_mass (p : FinLaw α) (f : α → β) (b : β) :
    p.map f b = ∑ a, if f a = b then p a else 0

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.FinLaw.map_snd_mass
statement:
@[simp] theorem map_snd_mass (p : FinLaw (α × β)) (b : β) :
    p.map Prod.snd b = ∑ a, p (a,b)

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.FinLaw.mix_mass
statement:
@[simp] theorem mix_mass (p : FinLaw Ω) (q : Ω → FinLaw α) (a : α) :
    p.mix q a = ∑ ω, p ω * q ω a

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.FinLaw.mutualInfo_nonneg
statement:
theorem mutualInfo_nonneg (p : FinLaw Ω) (X : Ω → α) (Y : Ω → β) :
    0 ≤ p.mutualInfo X Y

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.FinLaw.nonempty
statement: theorem nonempty (p : FinLaw α) : Nonempty α

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.FinLaw.short_list
statement:
theorem short_list (p : FinLaw Ω) (X : Ω → α) (Y : Ω → β)
    (L : β → Finset α) (E : Ω → Bool) {b : ℝ} (hb : 1 ≤ b)
    (hs : ∀ ω, p ω ≠ 0 → E ω = true → X ω ∈ L (Y ω) ∧ ((L (Y ω)).card : ℝ) ≤ b) :
    p.condH X Y ≤ Real.binEntropy (p.map E true) +
      p.map E true * Real.log b + (1-p.map E true)*Real.log (Fintype.card α)

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.FinLaw.short_list_deficit
statement:
theorem short_list_deficit (p : FinLaw Ω) (X : Ω → α) (Y : Ω → β)
    (L : β → Finset α) (E : Ω → Bool) {b : ℝ} (hb : 1 ≤ b)
    (hs : ∀ ω, p ω ≠ 0 → E ω = true → X ω ∈ L (Y ω) ∧ ((L (Y ω)).card : ℝ) ≤ b) :
    p.map E true * (Real.log (Fintype.card α) - Real.log b) - Real.binEntropy (p.map E true)
      ≤ Real.log (Fintype.card α) - p.condH X Y

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.entropySum_subadd
statement:
theorem entropySum_subadd {α : Type uAlpha} {β : Type uBeta} [Fintype α] [Fintype β]
    (p : α → β → ℝ) (hp : ∀ a b, 0 ≤ p a b) :
    (∑ a, ∑ b, Real.negMulLog (p a b)) + Real.negMulLog (∑ a, ∑ b, p a b) ≤
      (∑ a, Real.negMulLog (∑ b, p a b)) + ∑ b, Real.negMulLog (∑ a, p a b)

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.gibbs_point
statement:
theorem gibbs_point {p q : ℝ} (hp : 0 ≤ p) (hq : 0 ≤ q) (habs : q = 0 → p = 0) :
    p - q ≤ p * (Real.log p - Real.log q)

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.gibbs_sum
statement:
theorem gibbs_sum {α : Type uAlpha} [Fintype α] (p q : α → ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ a, 0 ≤ p a) (hq : ∀ a, 0 ≤ q a)
    (habs : ∀ a, q a = 0 → p a = 0) (hsum : ∑ a, p a = ∑ a, q a) :
    0 ≤ ∑ a, p a * (Real.log (p a) - Real.log (q a))

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.negMulLog_sum_le
statement:
theorem negMulLog_sum_le {α : Type uAlpha} [Fintype α] (p : α → ℝ) (hp : ∀ a, 0 ≤ p a) :
    Real.negMulLog (∑ a, p a) ≤ ∑ a, Real.negMulLog (p a)

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.abs_sub_lt_half_of_pixel_eq
statement: theorem abs_sub_lt_half_of_pixel_eq {x y : ℝ} (h : ⌊2*x⌋ = ⌊2*y⌋) : |x-y| < 1/2

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.colorEdge_add
statement:
theorem colorEdge_add {a b c : Fin 3} (h : ¬ Tricolored a b c) :
    colorEdge a b + colorEdge b c = colorEdge a c

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.colorEdge_binary
statement:
theorem colorEdge_binary (a b : Fin 3) (ha : a ≠ 2) (hb : b ≠ 2) :
    colorEdge a b = (b.val : ℤ) - a.val

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.colorEdge_zero_left
statement:
theorem colorEdge_zero_left (a b : Fin 3) (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0) :
    colorEdge a b = 0

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.colorEdge_zero_one
statement:
theorem colorEdge_zero_one (a b : Fin 3) (ha : a ≠ 1) (hb : b ≠ 1) :
    colorEdge a b = 0

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.discrete_rectangle_approx_zero
statement:
theorem discrete_rectangle_approx_zero (f : ℕ → ℕ → ℂ) (m n : ℕ) {D : ℝ} (hD : 0 ≤ D)
    (hhor : ∀ i < m, ∀ j ≤ n, dist (f i j) (f (i+1) j) ≤ D)
    (hver : ∀ i ≤ m, ∀ j < n, dist (f i j) (f i (j+1)) ≤ D)
    (hbottom : ∀ i ≤ m, (f i 0).im < 0)
    (htop : ∀ i ≤ m, 0 ≤ (f i n).im)
    (hleft : ∀ j ≤ n, (f 0 j).re < 0)
    (hright : ∀ j ≤ n, 0 ≤ (f m j).re) :
    ∃ i ≤ m, ∃ j ≤ n, ‖f i j‖ ≤ 4*D

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.discrete_rectangle_approx_zero_rev
statement:
theorem discrete_rectangle_approx_zero_rev (f : ℕ → ℕ → ℂ) (m n : ℕ) {D : ℝ} (hD : 0 ≤ D)

    (hver : ∀ i ≤ m, ∀ j < n, dist (f i j) (f i (j+1)) ≤ D)
    (hbottom : ∀ i ≤ m, 0 < (f i 0).im)
    (htop : ∀ i ≤ m, (f i n).im ≤ 0)
    (hleft : ∀ j ≤ n, (f 0 j).re < 0)
    (hright : ∀ j ≤ n, 0 ≤ (f m j).re) :
    ∃ i ≤ m, ∃ j ≤ n, ‖f i j‖ ≤ 4*D

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.discrete_rectangle_sperner

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.lattice_path_difference_card
statement:
theorem lattice_path_difference_card (v u : ℕ → GaussianInt) {n m : ℕ}
    (hn : 0 < n) (hm : 0 < m) (a b : GaussianInt)
    (hv0 : v 0 = 0) (hu0 : u 0 = 0) (hvn : v n = a) (hum : u m = b)
    (hab : a.re*b.im-a.im*b.re ≠ 0) {D : ℝ} (hD : 0 ≤ D)
    (hv : ∀ i < n, dist (v i:ℂ) (v (i+1):ℂ) ≤ D)
    (hu : ∀ j < m, dist (u j:ℂ) (u (j+1):ℂ) ≤ D)
    (E : Finset GaussianInt) (hE : ∀ i < n, ∀ j < m, v i-u j ∈ E) :
    (a.re*b.im-a.im*b.re).natAbs ≤ E.card*(latticeBall (4*D)).card

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.lattice_path_difference_cover
statement:
theorem lattice_path_difference_cover (v u : ℕ → GaussianInt) {n m : ℕ}
    (hn : 0 < n) (hm : 0 < m) (a b : GaussianInt)
    (hv0 : v 0 = 0) (hu0 : u 0 = 0) (hvn : v n = a) (hum : u m = b)

    (hv : ∀ i < n, dist (v i:ℂ) (v (i+1):ℂ) ≤ D)
    (hu : ∀ j < m, dist (u j:ℂ) (u (j+1):ℂ) ≤ D) (w : GaussianInt) :
    ∃ i < n, ∃ j < m, ∃ s t : ℤ,
      ‖((v i-u j+(s:GaussianInt)*a+(t:GaussianInt)*b-w:GaussianInt):ℂ)‖ ≤ 4*D

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.lattice_rectangle_card
statement:
theorem lattice_rectangle_card (E : Finset GaussianInt) {e c : ℂ} (he : ‖e‖ = 1)

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.path_difference_cover

theorem path_difference_cover (v u : ℕ → ℂ) {n m : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hm : 0 < m)

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.path_difference_cover_horizontal

theorem path_difference_cover_horizontal (v u : ℕ → ℂ) {n m : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hm : 0 < m)

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.differences_card_of_triangle
statement:
theorem differences_card_of_triangle (z : ℕ → GaussianInt) {n t s u : ℕ}
    (ht : t ≤ n) (hs : s ≤ n) (hu : u ≤ n) {D : ℝ} (hD : 0 ≤ D)
    (hz : ∀ i < n, dist (z i:ℂ) (z (i+1):ℂ) ≤ D)
    (hab : (z s-z t).re*(z u-z t).im-(z s-z t).im*(z u-z t).re ≠ 0) :
    ((z s-z t).re*(z u-z t).im-(z s-z t).im*(z u-z t).re).natAbs ≤
      (differences (walkSegment z n)).card * (latticeBall (4*D)).card

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.joinedPath_end

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.mem_differences
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_differences (E : Finset GaussianInt) (w : GaussianInt) :

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.mem_walkSegment
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_walkSegment (z : ℕ → GaussianInt) (n : ℕ) (w : GaussianInt) :

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.walkSegment_dist_le
statement:
theorem walkSegment_dist_le (z : ℕ → GaussianInt) {n : ℕ} {D : ℝ} (hD : 0 ≤ D)
    (hz : ∀ i < n, dist (z i:ℂ) (z (i+1):ℂ) ≤ D) {i j : ℕ} (hi : i ≤ n) (hj : j ≤ n) :
    dist (z i:ℂ) (z j:ℂ) ≤ D*n

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.walk_many_differences
statement:
theorem walk_many_differences (z : ℕ → GaussianInt) {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    (hinj : Function.Injective z) {D : ℝ} (hD : 1 ≤ D)
    (hz : ∀ i < n, dist (z i:ℂ) (z (i+1):ℂ) ≤ D) :
    ∃ (R W : ℝ) (e c : ℂ), 1 ≤ W ∧ W ≤ R ∧ ‖e‖ = 1 ∧
      (∀ p ∈ walkSegment z n, 0 ≤ (e*((p:ℂ)-c)).re ∧
        (e*((p:ℂ)-c)).re ≤ R ∧ |(e*((p:ℂ)-c)).im| ≤ W) ∧
      (n:ℝ) ≤ 18*(R*W) ∧ R*W ≤ D^2*(n:ℝ)^2 ∧
      R*W ≤ max D ((latticeBall (4*D)).card:ℝ)*(differences (walkSegment z n)).card

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.FinLaw.Hf_code
statement:
theorem Hf_code {α : Type uAlpha} (p : FinLaw Ω) (X : Ω → α) :
    p.Hf X = p.H (outputCode X)

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.FinLaw.Hf_comp_le
statement:
theorem Hf_comp_le {α : Type uAlpha} {β : Type uBeta} (p : FinLaw Ω) (X : Ω → α) (f : α → β) :
    p.Hf (f ∘ X) ≤ p.Hf X

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.FinLaw.Hf_const
statement: theorem Hf_const {α : Type uAlpha} (p : FinLaw Ω) (a : α) : p.Hf (fun _ => a) = 0

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.FinLaw.Hf_eq_H
statement: theorem Hf_eq_H {α : Type uAlpha} [Fintype α] (p : FinLaw Ω) (X : Ω → α) : p.Hf X = p.H X

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.FinLaw.Hf_eq_of_fibers
statement:
theorem Hf_eq_of_fibers {α : Type uAlpha} {β : Type uBeta} (p : FinLaw Ω) (X : Ω → α) (Y : Ω → β)
    (hf : ∀ ω ν, X ω = X ν ↔ Y ω = Y ν) : p.Hf X = p.Hf Y

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.FinLaw.Hf_finset_subadd
statement:
theorem Hf_finset_subadd {ι : Type uIota} {α : Type uAlpha} (p : FinLaw Ω) (X : Ω → ι → α) (S : Finset ι) :
    p.Hf (fun ω (i : S) => X ω i) ≤ ∑ i ∈ S, p.Hf (fun ω => X ω i)

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.FinLaw.Hf_le_log_card_sample
statement:
theorem Hf_le_log_card_sample {α : Type uAlpha} (p : FinLaw Ω) (X : Ω → α) :
    p.Hf X ≤ Real.log (Fintype.card Ω)

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.FinLaw.Hf_le_of_determined
statement:
theorem Hf_le_of_determined {α : Type uAlpha} {β : Type uBeta} (p : FinLaw Ω) (X : Ω → α) (Y : Ω → β)
    (h : ∀ ω ν, Y ω = Y ν → X ω = X ν) : p.Hf X ≤ p.Hf Y

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.FinLaw.Hf_nonneg
statement: theorem Hf_nonneg {α : Type uAlpha} (p : FinLaw Ω) (X : Ω → α) : 0 ≤ p.Hf X

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.FinLaw.Hf_pair_assoc
statement:
theorem Hf_pair_assoc {α : Type uAlpha} {β : Type uBeta} {γ : Type uGamma} (p : FinLaw Ω) (X : Ω → α) (Y : Ω → β) (Z : Ω → γ) :
    p.Hf (fun ω => (X ω,(Y ω,Z ω))) = p.Hf (fun ω => ((X ω,Y ω),Z ω))

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.FinLaw.Hf_pair_code
statement:
theorem Hf_pair_code {α : Type uAlpha} {β : Type uBeta} (p : FinLaw Ω) (X : Ω → α) (Y : Ω → β) :
    p.Hf (fun ω => (X ω,Y ω)) = p.H (fun ω => (outputCode X ω,outputCode Y ω))

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.FinLaw.Hf_pair_comm
statement:
theorem Hf_pair_comm {α : Type uAlpha} {β : Type uBeta} (p : FinLaw Ω) (X : Ω → α) (Y : Ω → β) :
    p.Hf (fun ω => (X ω,Y ω)) = p.Hf (fun ω => (Y ω,X ω))

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.FinLaw.Hf_pair_ge_snd
statement:
theorem Hf_pair_ge_snd {α : Type uAlpha} {β : Type uBeta} (p : FinLaw Ω) (X : Ω → α) (Y : Ω → β) :
    p.Hf Y ≤ p.Hf (fun ω => (X ω,Y ω))

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.FinLaw.Hf_pair_subadd
statement:
theorem Hf_pair_subadd {α : Type uAlpha} {β : Type uBeta} (p : FinLaw Ω) (X : Ω → α) (Y : Ω → β) :
    p.Hf (fun ω => (X ω,Y ω)) ≤ p.Hf X+p.Hf Y

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.FinLaw.Hf_strong_subadd
statement:
theorem Hf_strong_subadd {α : Type uAlpha} {β : Type uBeta} {γ : Type uGamma} (p : FinLaw Ω) (X : Ω → α) (Y : Ω → β) (Z : Ω → γ) :
    p.Hf (fun ω => (X ω,(Y ω,Z ω)))+p.Hf Y ≤
      p.Hf (fun ω => (X ω,Y ω))+p.Hf (fun ω => (Y ω,Z ω))

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.FinLaw.Hf_triple_code
statement:
theorem Hf_triple_code {α : Type uAlpha} {β : Type uBeta} {γ : Type uGamma} (p : FinLaw Ω)
    (X : Ω → α) (Y : Ω → β) (Z : Ω → γ) :
    p.Hf (fun ω => (X ω,(Y ω,Z ω))) =
      p.H (fun ω => (outputCode X ω,(outputCode Y ω,outputCode Z ω)))

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.FinLaw.cHf_chain
statement:
theorem cHf_chain {β : Type uBeta} {γ : Type uGamma} (p : FinLaw Ω) (X : Ω → α) (Y : Ω → β) (Z : Ω → γ) :
    p.cHf (fun ω => (X ω,Y ω)) Z = p.cHf X Z + p.cHf Y (fun ω => (X ω,Z ω))

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.FinLaw.cHf_le_Hf
statement:
theorem cHf_le_Hf {α : Type uAlpha} {β : Type uBeta} (p : FinLaw Ω) (X : Ω → α) (Y : Ω → β) :
    p.cHf X Y ≤ p.Hf X

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.FinLaw.cHf_mono
statement:
theorem cHf_mono {α : Type uAlpha} {β : Type uBeta} {γ : Type uGamma} (p : FinLaw Ω) (X : Ω → α) (Y : Ω → β) (Z : Ω → γ) :
    p.cHf X (fun ω => (Y ω,Z ω)) ≤ p.cHf X Y

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.FinLaw.cHf_mono_of_refines
statement:
theorem cHf_mono_of_refines {β : Type uBeta} {γ : Type uGamma} (p : FinLaw Ω)
    (X : Ω → α) (Y : Ω → β) (Z : Ω → γ)
    (h : ∀ ω ν, Y ω = Y ν → Z ω = Z ν) : p.cHf X Y ≤ p.cHf X Z

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.FinLaw.cHf_nonneg
statement:
theorem cHf_nonneg {α : Type uAlpha} {β : Type uBeta} (p : FinLaw Ω) (X : Ω → α) (Y : Ω → β) :
    0 ≤ p.cHf X Y

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.FinLaw.cHf_pair_subadd
statement:
theorem cHf_pair_subadd {β : Type uBeta} {γ : Type uGamma} (p : FinLaw Ω) (X : Ω → α) (Y : Ω → β) (Z : Ω → γ) :
    p.cHf (fun ω => (X ω,Y ω)) Z ≤ p.cHf X Z + p.cHf Y Z

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.FinLaw.enrichment_chain
statement:
theorem enrichment_chain {β : Type uBeta} {γ : Type uGamma} {δ : Type uDelta} {ε : Type uEpsilon} {ζ : Type uZeta} (p : FinLaw Ω)
    (X : Ω → α) (Y : Ω → β) (Bx : Ω → γ) (By : Ω → δ) (h : Ω → ε) (H : Ω → ζ)
    (hh : ∀ ω ν, X ω = X ν → Y ω = Y ν → h ω = h ν)
    (hY : ∀ ω ν, X ω = X ν → h ω = h ν → Y ω = Y ν)
    (hH : ∀ ω ν, H ω = H ν → h ω = h ν) :
    p.cHf h (fun ω => (Bx ω,By ω)) ≤ p.cHf X Bx + p.cHf Y By -
      p.cHf X (fun ω => ((Bx ω,By ω),H ω))

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.FinLaw.orderedEntropy_concave
statement:
theorem orderedEntropy_concave (p : FinLaw Ω) (X : Ω → Fin k → α) {s : ℕ} (hs : s+1 < k) :
    p.orderedEntropy X (s+2)-p.orderedEntropy X (s+1) ≤
      p.orderedEntropy X (s+1)-p.orderedEntropy X s

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.FinLaw.orderedEntropy_nonneg
statement:
theorem orderedEntropy_nonneg (p : FinLaw Ω) (X : Ω → Fin k → α) (s : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ p.orderedEntropy X s

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.FinLaw.orderedEntropy_slope
statement:
theorem orderedEntropy_slope (p : FinLaw Ω) (X : Ω → Fin k → α)
    {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (hbk : b < k) :
    p.orderedEntropy X (b+1)-p.orderedEntropy X b ≤ p.orderedEntropy X b / b

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.FinLaw.orderedEntropy_step
statement:
theorem orderedEntropy_step (p : FinLaw Ω) (X : Ω → Fin k → α) {s : ℕ} (hs : s < k) :
    p.orderedEntropy X (s+1)-p.orderedEntropy X s =
      𝔼 π : Equiv.Perm (Fin k), p.cHf (fun ω => X ω (π ⟨s,hs⟩)) (prefixVar X π s)

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.FinLaw.orderedEntropy_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem orderedEntropy_zero (p : FinLaw Ω) (X : Ω → Fin k → α) :
    p.orderedEntropy X 0 = 0

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.FinLaw.ordered_remaining_exchange
statement:
theorem ordered_remaining_exchange (p : FinLaw Ω) (X : Ω → Fin k → α) (s : ℕ)
    (i j : Fin k) (hi : s ≤ i.val) (hj : s ≤ j.val) :
    (𝔼 π : Equiv.Perm (Fin k), p.cHf (fun ω => X ω (π i)) (prefixVar X π s)) =
      𝔼 π : Equiv.Perm (Fin k), p.cHf (fun ω => X ω (π j)) (prefixVar X π s)

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.FinLaw.outputCode_eq_iff
statement:
@[simp] theorem outputCode_eq_iff {α : Type uAlpha} (X : Ω → α) (ω ν : Ω) :
    outputCode X ω = outputCode X ν ↔ X ω = X ν

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.FinLaw.prefixVar_chain
statement:
theorem prefixVar_chain (p : FinLaw Ω) (X : Ω → Fin k → α) (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin k))
    {s : ℕ} (hs : s < k) :
    p.Hf (prefixVar X π (s+1)) =
      p.Hf (fun ω => (X ω (π ⟨s,hs⟩),prefixVar X π s ω))

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.FinLaw.prefixVar_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem prefixVar_zero (X : Ω → Fin k → α) (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin k)) (ω : Ω) :
    prefixVar X π 0 ω = fun _ => none

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.FinLaw.signedEntropy_slope
statement:
theorem signedEntropy_slope (p : FinLaw Ω) (X : (Fin k → Bool) → Ω → Fin k → α)
    {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (hbk : b < k) :
    p.signedEntropy X (b+1)-p.signedEntropy X b ≤ p.signedEntropy X b / b

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.FinLaw.signedEntropy_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem signedEntropy_zero (p : FinLaw Ω) (X : (Fin k → Bool) → Ω → Fin k → α) :
    p.signedEntropy X 0 = 0

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.finite_gaussianResidue
statement:
lemma finite_gaussianResidue {π : GaussianInt} (hπ : π ≠ 0) :
    Finite (GaussianInt ⧸ multiples π)

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.gaussianResidue_eq
statement:
lemma gaussianResidue_eq (π z w : GaussianInt) :
    gaussianResidue π z = gaussianResidue π w ↔ π ∣ z-w

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.mem_multiples
statement: lemma mem_multiples (π z : GaussianInt) : z ∈ multiples π ↔ π ∣ z

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.multiples_index
statement:
lemma multiples_index {π : GaussianInt} (hπ : π ≠ 0) :
    Nat.card (GaussianInt ⧸ multiples π) = π.norm.natAbs

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.residueCode_add
OAI.GaussianMoat.residueCode_eq
statement:
lemma residueCode_eq (π z w : GaussianInt) :
    residueCode π z = residueCode π w ↔ π ∣ z-w

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.residueCode_range_card
statement:
lemma residueCode_range_card {π : GaussianInt} (hπ : π ≠ 0) :
    (Set.range (residueCode π)).Finite ∧ (Set.range (residueCode π)).ncard = π.norm.natAbs

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.residueCode_sub
OAI.GaussianMoat.twoVectorMap_mul_i
statement:
lemma twoVectorMap_mul_i (π z : GaussianInt) :
    twoVectorMap π (π * ⟨0,1⟩) z = π*z

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.PrimeLogMass.betaMoment_pos
statement: lemma betaMoment_pos (m n : ℕ) : 0 < betaMoment m n

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.PrimeLogMass.betaMoment_quadratic
statement:
lemma betaMoment_quadratic (m n : ℕ) (a b : ℝ) :
    (∫ x : ℝ in 0..1, x^m*(1-x)^n*((x-a)*(b-x))) =
      (a+b)*betaMoment (m+1) n-betaMoment (m+2) n-a*b*betaMoment m n

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.PrimeLogMass.betaMoment_succ
statement:
lemma betaMoment_succ (m n : ℕ) :
    betaMoment (m+1) n = (m+1 : ℝ)/(m+n+2)*betaMoment m n

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.PrimeLogMass.eventually_prime_window_mass
statement:
theorem eventually_prime_window_mass {q : ℕ} [NeZero q] {a : ZMod q} (ha : IsUnit a) :
    ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ᶠ X : ℝ in atTop,
      c*X ≤ ∑ n ∈ (windowIndices X).filter Nat.Prime, residueClass a n / n

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.PrimeLogMass.eventually_residue_window_mass
statement:
theorem eventually_residue_window_mass {q : ℕ} [NeZero q] {a : ZMod q} (ha : IsUnit a) :
    ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ᶠ X : ℝ in atTop,
      c*X ≤ ∑ n ∈ windowIndices X, residueClass a n / n

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.PrimeLogMass.exp_window_lower
statement: lemma exp_window_lower : Real.exp (-(10499/10000 : ℝ)) < 7/20

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.PrimeLogMass.exp_window_upper
statement: lemma exp_window_upper : (11/30 : ℝ) < Real.exp (-(1001/1000 : ℝ))

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.PrimeLogMass.laplace_power
statement:
lemma laplace_power (n j : ℕ) (X : ℝ) (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    (n : ℝ) ^ (-(j+1 : ℝ)/X) =
      (Real.exp (-Real.log n / X))^(j+1)

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.PrimeLogMass.laplace_term
statement:
lemma laplace_term {q : ℕ} [NeZero q] (a : ZMod q) (n j : ℕ) (X : ℝ) :
    residueClass a n / (n : ℝ)^(1+(j+1 : ℝ)/X) =
      residueClass a n / n * (Real.exp (-Real.log n/X))^(j+1)

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.PrimeLogMass.laplace_window_nonpos
statement:
lemma laplace_window_nonpos {X : ℝ} (hX : 0 < X) (n : ℕ)
    (hn : n ≠ 0) (hout : n ∉ windowIndices X) :
    Polynomial.eval (Real.exp (-Real.log n/X)) windowPolynomial ≤ 0

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.PrimeLogMass.mem_windowIndices
statement:
lemma mem_windowIndices (X : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    n ∈ windowIndices X ↔ Real.exp (1001/1000*X) ≤ n ∧ (n : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp (10499/10000*X)

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.PrimeLogMass.polynomial_laplace_summable
statement:
lemma polynomial_laplace_summable {q : ℕ} [NeZero q] (a : ZMod q)
    (P : Polynomial ℝ) {X : ℝ} (hX : 0 < X) :
    Summable (fun n : ℕ => residueClass a n / n * Real.exp (-Real.log n/X) *
      Polynomial.eval (Real.exp (-Real.log n/X)) P)

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.PrimeLogMass.residue_moment_limit
statement:
theorem residue_moment_limit {q : ℕ} [NeZero q] {a : ZMod q} (ha : IsUnit a)
    {j : ℝ} (hj : 0 < j) :
    Tendsto (fun X : ℝ => (∑' n, residueClass a n / (n : ℝ) ^ (1+j/X)) / X)
      atTop (𝓝 ((q.totient : ℝ)⁻¹ / j))

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.PrimeLogMass.residue_real_series
statement:
lemma residue_real_series {q : ℕ} [NeZero q] {a : ZMod q} (ha : IsUnit a)
    {x : ℝ} (hx : 1 < x) :
    ∑' n, residueClass a n / (n : ℝ) ^ x =
      (LFunctionResidueClassAux a x).re + (q.totient : ℝ)⁻¹ / (x - 1)

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.PrimeLogMass.residue_summable
statement:
lemma residue_summable {q : ℕ} [NeZero q] (a : ZMod q) {x : ℝ} (hx : 1 < x) :
    Summable (fun n : ℕ => residueClass a n / (n : ℝ)^x)

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.PrimeLogMass.windowPolynomialAux_eval
statement:
lemma windowPolynomialAux_eval (m n : ℕ) (y : ℝ) :
    Polynomial.eval y (windowPolynomialAux m n) = y^m*(1-y)^n*((y-7/20)*(11/30-y))

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.PrimeLogMass.windowPolynomial_eval
statement:
lemma windowPolynomial_eval (y : ℝ) :
    Polynomial.eval y windowPolynomial = y^1431*(1-y)^2567*((y-7/20)*(11/30-y))

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.PrimeLogMass.windowPolynomial_integral_pos
statement: lemma windowPolynomial_integral_pos : 0 < ∫ x : ℝ in 0..1, Polynomial.eval x windowPolynomial

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.PrimeLogMass.windowPolynomial_le_one
statement:
lemma windowPolynomial_le_one {y : ℝ} (hy : y ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    Polynomial.eval y windowPolynomial ≤ 1

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.PrimeLogMass.windowPolynomial_nonpos
statement:
lemma windowPolynomial_nonpos {y : ℝ} (hy : y ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (hout : y ≤ 7/20 ∨ 11/30 ≤ y) : Polynomial.eval y windowPolynomial ≤ 0

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.PrimeLogMass.window_mass_dominates
statement:
lemma window_mass_dominates {q : ℕ} [NeZero q] (a : ZMod q) {X : ℝ} (hX : 0 < X) :
    (∑' n, residueClass a n / n * Real.exp (-Real.log n/X) *
      Polynomial.eval (Real.exp (-Real.log n/X)) windowPolynomial) ≤
      ∑ n ∈ windowIndices X, residueClass a n / n

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.exists_split_factor
statement:
theorem exists_split_factor {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hmod : p % 4 = 1) :
    ∃ π : GaussianInt, Irreducible π ∧ π.norm = (p : ℤ)

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.irreducible_of_prime_norm
statement:
theorem irreducible_of_prime_norm {π : GaussianInt} {p : ℕ}
    (hp : p.Prime) (hn : π.norm = (p : ℤ)) : Irreducible π

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.FinLaw.Hf_fintype_subadd
statement:
theorem Hf_fintype_subadd {ι : Type uIota} {β : Type uBeta} [Fintype ι] (p : FinLaw Ω)
    (X : Ω → ι → β) : p.Hf X ≤ ∑ i, p.Hf (fun ω => X ω i)

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.FinLaw.Hf_le_log_card_set
statement:
theorem Hf_le_log_card_set {β : Type uBeta} (p : FinLaw Ω) (X : Ω → β)
    (S : Finset β) (hX : ∀ ω, X ω ∈ S) : p.Hf X ≤ Real.log S.card

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.FinLaw.Hf_le_log_card_type
statement:
theorem Hf_le_log_card_type {β : Type uBeta} [Fintype β] (p : FinLaw Ω) (X : Ω → β) :
    p.Hf X ≤ Real.log (Fintype.card β)

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.FinLaw.Hf_mix_ge
statement:
theorem Hf_mix_ge {ι : Type uIota} {β : Type uBeta} [Fintype ι]
    (p : FinLaw ι) (q : ι → FinLaw Ω) (X : Ω → β) :
    (∑ i, p i*(q i).Hf X) ≤ (p.mix q).Hf X

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.FinLaw.Hf_prefix_le
statement:
theorem Hf_prefix_le (p : FinLaw Ω) (X : Ω → Fin k → α) (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin k))
    (s : ℕ) : p.Hf (prefixVar X π s) ≤ p.Hf X

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.FinLaw.Hf_prefix_le_sum
statement:
theorem Hf_prefix_le_sum (p : FinLaw Ω) (X : Ω → Fin k → α)
    (L : Fin k → ℝ) (hL : ∀ i, p.Hf (fun ω => X ω i) ≤ L i)
    (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin k)) {s : ℕ} (hs : s ≤ k) :
    p.Hf (prefixVar X π s) ≤ ∑ j : Fin s, L (π ⟨j.val,by omega⟩)

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.FinLaw.cHf_eq_of_fibers
statement:
theorem cHf_eq_of_fibers {β : Type uBeta} {γ : Type uGamma} (p : FinLaw Ω)
    (X : Ω → α) (Y : Ω → β) (C : Ω → γ)
    (h : ∀ ω ν, C ω = C ν → (X ω = X ν ↔ Y ω = Y ν)) :
    p.cHf X C = p.cHf Y C

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.FinLaw.cHf_finset_subadd
statement:
theorem cHf_finset_subadd {ι : Type uIota} {β : Type uBeta} (p : FinLaw Ω)
    (X : Ω → ι → α) (C : Ω → β) (S : Finset ι) :
    p.cHf (fun ω (i : S) => X ω i) C ≤ ∑ i ∈ S, p.cHf (fun ω => X ω i) C

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.FinLaw.cHf_fintype_subadd
statement:
theorem cHf_fintype_subadd {ι : Type uIota} {β : Type uBeta} [Fintype ι] (p : FinLaw Ω)
    (X : Ω → ι → α) (C : Ω → β) :
    p.cHf X C ≤ ∑ i, p.cHf (fun ω => X ω i) C

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.FinLaw.cHf_le_of_determined
statement:
theorem cHf_le_of_determined {β : Type uBeta} {γ : Type uGamma} (p : FinLaw Ω)
    (X : Ω → α) (Y : Ω → β) (C : Ω → γ)
    (h : ∀ ω ν, Y ω = Y ν → C ω = C ν → X ω = X ν) :
    p.cHf X C ≤ p.cHf Y C

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.FinLaw.fresh_entropy_from_prefix
statement:
theorem fresh_entropy_from_prefix {β : Type uBeta} (p : FinLaw Ω)
    (X Y : Ω → Fin k → α) (d : Ω → Fin k → β) {b s : ℕ}
    (hbs : b < s) (hs : s ≤ k)
    (hd : ∀ i ω ν, X ω i = X ν i → Y ω i = Y ν i → d ω i = d ν i) :
    p.orderedEntropy d s-p.orderedEntropy X b-p.orderedEntropy Y b ≤
      (s-b : ℕ)*(𝔼 π : Equiv.Perm (Fin k),
        p.cHf (fun ω => d ω (π ⟨b,by omega⟩))
          (fun ω => (prefixVar X π b ω,prefixVar Y π b ω)))

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.FinLaw.map_mix
statement:
theorem map_mix {ι : Type uIota} {β : Type uBeta} [Fintype ι] [Fintype β]
    (p : FinLaw ι) (q : ι → FinLaw Ω) (X : Ω → β) :
    (p.mix q).map X = p.mix (fun i => (q i).map X)

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.FinLaw.ordered_enrichment_accounting
statement:
theorem ordered_enrichment_accounting {β : Type uBeta} {γ : Type uGamma} {δ : Type uDelta} (p : FinLaw Ω)
    (X Y Z : Ω → Fin k → α) (d : Ω → Fin k → β) (H : Ω → γ) (E : Ω → δ)
    {b q : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (hbq : b < q) (hq : q ≤ k)
    (hd : ∀ i ω ν, X ω i = X ν i → Y ω i = Y ν i → d ω i = d ν i)
    (hY : ∀ i ω ν, X ω i = X ν i → d ω i = d ν i → Y ω i = Y ν i)
    (hH : ∀ i ω ν, H ω = H ν → d ω i = d ν i)
    (hZ : ∀ i ω ν, X ω i = X ν i → E ω = E ν → Z ω i = Z ν i) :
    (b : ℝ) * ((q-b : ℕ) *
      (𝔼 π : Equiv.Perm (Fin k), p.cHf (fun ω => d ω (π ⟨b,by omega⟩))
        (fun ω => (prefixVar X π b ω,prefixVar Y π b ω))) +
      p.orderedEntropy Z q-p.Hf H-p.Hf E) ≤
      (q : ℝ)*(p.orderedEntropy X b+p.orderedEntropy Y b)

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.FinLaw.ordered_prefix_conditional_bound
statement:
theorem ordered_prefix_conditional_bound {β : Type uBeta} (p : FinLaw Ω)
    (X : Ω → Fin k → α) (C : Equiv.Perm (Fin k) → Ω → β)
    {b q : ℕ} (hbq : b < q) (hq : q ≤ k)
    (hC : ∀ π ω ν, C π ω = C π ν → prefixVar X π b ω = prefixVar X π b ν)
    (hswap : ∀ π (j : Fin k), b ≤ j.val →
      C (π*Equiv.swap ⟨b,by omega⟩ j) = C π) :
    (𝔼 π : Equiv.Perm (Fin k), p.cHf (prefixVar X π q) (C π)) ≤
      (q-b : ℕ) * (𝔼 π : Equiv.Perm (Fin k),
        p.cHf (fun ω => X ω (π ⟨b,by omega⟩)) (C π))

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.FinLaw.ordered_remaining_exchange_cond
statement:
theorem ordered_remaining_exchange_cond {β : Type uBeta} (p : FinLaw Ω)
    (X : Ω → Fin k → α) (C : Equiv.Perm (Fin k) → Ω → β)
    (i j : Fin k) (hC : ∀ π, C (π*Equiv.swap i j) = C π) :
    (𝔼 π : Equiv.Perm (Fin k), p.cHf (fun ω => X ω (π i)) (C π)) =
      𝔼 π : Equiv.Perm (Fin k), p.cHf (fun ω => X ω (π j)) (C π)

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.FinLaw.prefixVar_swap
statement:
theorem prefixVar_swap (X : Ω → Fin k → α) (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin k)) (s : ℕ)
    (i j : Fin k) (hi : s ≤ i.val) (hj : s ≤ j.val) :
    prefixVar X (π*Equiv.swap i j) s = prefixVar X π s

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.FinLaw.prefix_conditional_block
statement:
theorem prefix_conditional_block {β : Type uBeta} (p : FinLaw Ω)
    (X : Ω → Fin k → α) (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin k)) (C : Ω → β)
    {b q : ℕ} (hbq : b ≤ q) (hq : q ≤ k)
    (hC : ∀ ω ν, C ω = C ν → prefixVar X π b ω = prefixVar X π b ν) :
    p.cHf (prefixVar X π q) C ≤
      ∑ j : Fin (q-b), p.cHf (fun ω => X ω (π ⟨b+j.val,by omega⟩)) C

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.FinLaw.uniform_Hf_injective
statement:
theorem uniform_Hf_injective {β : Type uBeta} [Nonempty Ω] (X : Ω → β)
    (hX : Function.Injective X) : (uniform Ω).Hf X = Real.log (Fintype.card Ω)

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.FinLaw.uniform_mass
statement:
@[simp] theorem uniform_mass [Nonempty Ω] (ω : Ω) :
    uniform Ω ω = (Fintype.card Ω : ℝ)⁻¹

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.expect_lower_tail_le
statement:
theorem expect_lower_tail_le {Ω : Type uOmega} [Fintype Ω] [Nonempty Ω]
    (Z : Ω → ℝ) {a δ V : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hV : (𝔼 ω, (Z ω-a)^2) ≤ V) :
    (𝔼 ω, if Z ω < a-δ then (1 : ℝ) else 0) ≤ V/δ^2

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.perm_covariance_nonpos
statement:
theorem perm_covariance_nonpos {ι : Type uIota} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (f : ι → ℝ)
    (hf : ∑ i, f i = 0) {i j : ι} (hij : i ≠ j) :
    (𝔼 π : Equiv.Perm ι, f (π i)*f (π j)) ≤ 0

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.perm_expect_exchange
statement:
lemma perm_expect_exchange {ι : Type uIota} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (f : ι → ℝ) (i j : ι) :
    (𝔼 π : Equiv.Perm ι, f (π i)) = 𝔼 π : Equiv.Perm ι, f (π j)

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.perm_sample_interval_tail
statement:
theorem perm_sample_interval_tail {ι : Type uIota} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Nonempty ι]
    (f : ι → ℝ) (S : Finset ι) {a M δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hf : ∀ i, a ≤ f i ∧ f i ≤ a+M) :
    (𝔼 π : Equiv.Perm ι,
      if (∑ i ∈ S, f (π i)) < S.card*(𝔼 i, f i)-δ then (1 : ℝ) else 0) ≤
      S.card*M^2/δ^2

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.perm_sample_second_moment
statement:
theorem perm_sample_second_moment {ι : Type uIota} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (f : ι → ℝ)
    (hf : ∑ i, f i = 0) (S : Finset ι) {M : ℝ} (hM : ∀ i, (f i)^2 ≤ M) :
    (𝔼 π : Equiv.Perm ι, (∑ i ∈ S, f (π i))^2) ≤ S.card*M

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.PrimeLogMass.dyadicMass_le
statement: lemma dyadicMass_le (j : ℕ) : dyadicMass j ≤ 2*Real.log 4

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.PrimeLogMass.dyadicMass_le_card
statement:
lemma dyadicMass_le_card (j : ℕ) : dyadicMass j ≤
