name: OAI.SingleFold.PowerSystem.pinned
statement:
lemma pinned {b n c : ℕ} {w : Fin 9 → ℕ} (hw : System g ell u₀ b n c w) :
    w 2=px (b*w 0) (n+1) ∧ w 3=py (b*w 0) (n+1) ∧
    w 4=px (w 0) (n+1) ∧ w 5=py (w 0) (n+1)

name: OAI.SingleFold.PowerSystem.sound
statement: lemma sound {b n c : ℕ} {w : Fin 9 → ℕ} (hw : System g ell u₀ b n c w) : 2≤b ∧ c=b^n

name: OAI.SingleFold.PowerSystem.unique
statement: lemma unique {b n c : ℕ} {w w' : Fin 9 → ℕ} (hw : System g ell u₀ b n c w) (hw' : System g ell u₀ b n c w') : w=w'

name: OAI.SingleFold.Binary.bits
statement: theorem bits : SF (fun z : Fin 2 → ℕ => Bits (z 0) (z 1))

name: OAI.SingleFold.Binary.choose_digit
statement:
lemma choose_digit {x y B : ℕ} (hxy : x≤y) (hB : 2^y<B) :
    (B+1)^y/B^x%B=y.choose x

name: OAI.SingleFold.Binary.choose_odd_iff
statement: lemma choose_odd_iff (x y : ℕ) : y.choose x % 2=1 ↔ Bits x y

name: OAI.SingleFold.Binary.complete
statement: lemma complete {x y : ℕ} (h : Bits x y) : ∃ w, System x y w

name: OAI.SingleFold.Binary.extract_unique
statement:
lemma extract_unique {B H N s d r : ℕ} (h : N=s*B*H+d*H+r) (hd : d<B) (hr : r<H) :
    r=N%H ∧ d=N/H%B ∧ s=N/H/B

name: OAI.SingleFold.Binary.le
statement: lemma le {x y : ℕ} (h : Bits x y) : x≤y

name: OAI.SingleFold.Binary.ofDigits_digit
statement:
lemma ofDigits_digit {B : ℕ} (hB : 0<B) (l : List ℕ) (hl : ∀ a∈l, a<B) (i : ℕ) :
    Nat.ofDigits B l/B^i%B=l[i]?.getD 0

name: OAI.SingleFold.Binary.ofDigits_map_range
statement:
lemma ofDigits_map_range (B n : ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℕ) :
    Nat.ofDigits B ((List.range n).map f) = ∑ i∈Finset.range n, f i*B^i

name: OAI.SingleFold.Binary.sound
statement: lemma sound {x y : ℕ} {w : Fin 7 → ℕ} (hw : System x y w) : Bits x y

name: OAI.SingleFold.Binary.split
statement: lemma split (x y : ℕ) : Bits x y ↔ x%2 ≤ y%2 ∧ Bits (x/2) (y/2)

name: OAI.SingleFold.Binary.system_sf
statement: lemma system_sf : SF (fun z : Fin 2⊕Fin 7 → ℕ => System (z (.inl 0)) (z (.inl 1)) (z ∘ Sum.inr))

name: OAI.SingleFold.Binary.unique
statement: lemma unique {x y : ℕ} {w v : Fin 7 → ℕ} (hw : System x y w) (hv : System x y v) : w=v

name: OAI.SingleFold.Binary.zero_right
statement: lemma zero_right (x : ℕ) : Bits x 0 ↔ x=0

name: OAI.SingleFold.Compiler.MapSF.vector
statement:
lemma vector {α ι : Type} [Finite ι] {f : ι → (α → ℕ) → ℕ}
    (h : ∀ i, ScalarSF (f i)) : MapSF (fun z i => f i z)

name: OAI.SingleFold.Compiler.ScalarSF.powerRel
statement:
lemma powerRel (hf : ScalarSF f) (hg : ScalarSF g) (hh : ScalarSF h) :
    SF (fun z => 2≤f z ∧ h z=f z^g z)

name: OAI.SingleFold.Packed.bits_and
statement: lemma bits_and (x y : ℕ) : Bits x y ↔ x&&&y=x

name: OAI.SingleFold.Packed.bits_blocks
statement:
lemma bits_blocks {w : ℕ} (hw : 0 < w) (x y : ℕ) :
    Bits x y ↔ ∀t, Bits (digit (2^w) x t) (digit (2^w) y t)

name: OAI.SingleFold.Packed.bits_full
statement: lemma bits_full (x h : ℕ) : Bits x (2^h-1) ↔ x < 2^h

name: OAI.SingleFold.Packed.bits_le
statement: lemma bits_le {x y : ℕ} (h : Bits x y) : x ≤ y

name: OAI.SingleFold.Packed.bits_mask
statement:
lemma bits_mask {w k c x : ℕ} (hw : 0 < w) (hc : c < 2^w) :
    Bits x (c*ones (2^w) k) ↔ x < (2^w)^k ∧ ∀t < k, Bits (digit (2^w) x t) c

name: OAI.SingleFold.Packed.bits_one
statement: lemma bits_one (x : ℕ) : Bits x 1 ↔ x ≤ 1

name: OAI.SingleFold.Packed.bits_ones
statement:
lemma bits_ones {w k x : ℕ} (hw : 0 < w) :
    Bits x (ones (2^w) k) ↔ x < (2^w)^k ∧ ∀t < k,digit (2^w) x t ≤ 1

name: OAI.SingleFold.Packed.bits_refl
statement: lemma bits_refl (x : ℕ) : Bits x x

name: OAI.SingleFold.Packed.bits_testBit
statement: lemma bits_testBit (x y : ℕ) : Bits x y ↔ ∀ i, x.testBit i=true → y.testBit i=true

name: OAI.SingleFold.Packed.bits_trans
statement: lemma bits_trans {x y z : ℕ} (hxy : Bits x y) (hyz : Bits y z) : Bits x z

name: OAI.SingleFold.Packed.bits_zero_left
statement: lemma bits_zero_left (x : ℕ) : Bits 0 x

name: OAI.SingleFold.Packed.bits_zero_right
statement: lemma bits_zero_right (x : ℕ) : Bits x 0 ↔ x=0

name: OAI.SingleFold.Packed.digit_high
statement: lemma digit_high {B x t : ℕ} (hx : x < B^t) : digit B x t=0

name: OAI.SingleFold.Packed.digit_lt
statement: lemma digit_lt {B : ℕ} (hB : 0 < B) (x t : ℕ) : digit B x t < B

name: OAI.SingleFold.Packed.digit_of_lt
statement: lemma digit_of_lt {B x : ℕ} (hx : x < B) : digit B x 0=x

name: OAI.SingleFold.Packed.digit_pack
statement:
lemma digit_pack {B k : ℕ} (hB : 0 < B) {f : ℕ → ℕ} (hf : ∀ t < k,f t < B) (i : ℕ) :
    digit B (pack B k f) i=if i < k then f i else 0

name: OAI.SingleFold.Packed.digit_sum
statement:
lemma digit_sum {ι : Type} [Fintype ι] {B k : ℕ} (hB : 0 < B) (x : ι → ℕ)
    (hx : ∀i,x i < B^k) (hc : ∀t < k,∑i,digit B (x i) t < B) (t : ℕ) :
    digit B (∑i,x i) t=if t < k then ∑i,digit B (x i) t else 0

name: OAI.SingleFold.Packed.digit_zero
statement: lemma digit_zero (B t : ℕ) : digit B 0 t=0

name: OAI.SingleFold.Packed.digits_ext
statement:
lemma digits_ext {B k x y : ℕ} (hB : 0 < B) (hx : x < B^k) (hy : y < B^k)
    (h : ∀t < k,digit B x t=digit B y t) : x=y

name: OAI.SingleFold.Packed.division_last
statement:
lemma division_last {B T R ρ η : ℕ} (hB : 0 < B) (hR : R < B^(T+1))
    (he : R=ρ*B^T+η) (hη : η < B^T) :
    ρ=digit B R T ∧ η=pack B T (digit B R)

name: OAI.SingleFold.Packed.geometric
statement: lemma geometric {B : ℕ} (hB : 1 < B) (k : ℕ) : (B-1)*ones B k=B^k-1

name: OAI.SingleFold.Packed.ones_mul
statement: lemma ones_mul (B k c : ℕ) : c*ones B k=pack B k (fun _=>c)

name: OAI.SingleFold.Packed.pack_add
statement:
lemma pack_add (B k : ℕ) (f g : ℕ → ℕ) :
    pack B k (fun t=>f t+g t)=pack B k f+pack B k g

name: OAI.SingleFold.Packed.pack_congr
statement: lemma pack_congr {B k : ℕ} {f g : ℕ → ℕ} (h : ∀t < k,f t=g t) : pack B k f=pack B k g

name: OAI.SingleFold.Packed.pack_cons
statement: lemma pack_cons (B k : ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℕ) : pack B (k+1) f=f 0+B*pack B k (fun t=>f (t+1))

name: OAI.SingleFold.Packed.pack_const_zero
statement: lemma pack_const_zero (B k : ℕ) : pack B k (fun _=>0)=0

name: OAI.SingleFold.Packed.pack_digits
statement: lemma pack_digits {B k x : ℕ} (hB : 0 < B) (hx : x < B^k) : pack B k (digit B x)=x

name: OAI.SingleFold.Packed.pack_init
statement:
lemma pack_init (B k a : ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℕ) :
    pack B (k+1) (fun t=>if t=0 then a else f (t-1))=a+B*pack B k f

name: OAI.SingleFold.Packed.pack_injective
OAI.SingleFold.Packed.pack_last
statement: lemma pack_last {B T : ℕ} {f : ℕ → ℕ} (hf : f T=0) : pack B (T+1) f=pack B T f

name: OAI.SingleFold.Packed.pack_lt
statement: lemma pack_lt {B k : ℕ} (_hB : 0 < B) {f : ℕ → ℕ} (hf : ∀ t < k,f t < B) : pack B k f < B^k

name: OAI.SingleFold.Packed.pack_mul
statement:
lemma pack_mul (B k c : ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℕ) :
    pack B k (fun t=>c*f t)=c*pack B k f

name: OAI.SingleFold.Packed.pack_shift
statement:
lemma pack_shift (B k : ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℕ) :
    pack B (k+1) (fun t=>if t=0 then 0 else f (t-1))=B*pack B k f

name: OAI.SingleFold.Packed.pack_succ
statement: lemma pack_succ (B k : ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℕ) : pack B (k+1) f=pack B k f+f k*B^k

name: OAI.SingleFold.Packed.pack_sum
statement:
lemma pack_sum {ι : Type} [Fintype ι] (B k : ℕ) (f : ι → ℕ → ℕ) :
    pack B k (fun t=>∑i,f i t)=∑i,pack B k (f i)

name: OAI.SingleFold.Packed.pack_zero
statement: lemma pack_zero (B : ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℕ) : pack B 0 f=0

name: OAI.SingleFold.Packed.testBit_digit
statement:
lemma testBit_digit (w x t j : ℕ) :
    (digit (2^w) x t).testBit j=(decide (j < w) && x.testBit (w*t+j))

name: OAI.SingleFold.Packed.unique_scale
statement: lemma unique_scale {L : ℕ} (hL : 0 < L) : ∃! w : ℕ, 2*L < 2^w ∧ 2^w ≤ 4*L

name: OAI.SingleFold.Packed.update_coefficients
statement:
lemma update_coefficients {B T m d : ℕ} (hB : 2*m ≤ B) (hd : d < m)
    (r a f : ℕ → ℕ) (hr : ∀t < T+1,r t < m) (ha : ∀t < T,a t ≤ 1) (hf : ∀t < T,f t ≤ 1)
    (he : pack B (T+1) r+B*pack B T f=d+B*(pack B T r+pack B T a)) :
    r 0=d ∧ ∀t < T,r (t+1)+f t=r t+a t

name: OAI.SingleFold.Packed.update_identity
statement:
lemma update_identity {B T d : ℕ} (r a f : ℕ → ℕ) (h0 : r 0=d)
    (hstep : ∀t < T,r (t+1)+f t=r t+a t) :
    pack B (T+1) r+B*pack B T f=d+B*(pack B T r+pack B T a)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.FiniteLaw.assignments_le
statement:
theorem assignments_le {h : ℕ} (μ ν : FiniteLaw (Equiv.Perm Ω)) (C : ℝ)
    (hb : ∀ g, μ g ≤ C * ν g) (x y : Fin h ↪ Ω) :
    μ.assignments x y ≤ C * ν.assignments x y

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.FiniteLaw.assignments_nonneg
statement:
theorem assignments_nonneg {h : ℕ} (μ : FiniteLaw (Equiv.Perm Ω))
    (x y : Fin h ↪ Ω) : 0 ≤ μ.assignments x y

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.FiniteLaw.assignments_ratio_le_four
statement:
theorem assignments_ratio_le_four {h v : ℕ} (μ : FiniteLaw (Equiv.Perm Ω))
    (hμlo : ∀ g, (1/2 : ℝ) * uniform (Equiv.Perm Ω) g ≤ μ g)
    (hμhi : ∀ g, μ g ≤ 2 * uniform (Equiv.Perm Ω) g)
    (x y : Fin h ↪ Ω) (x' y' : Fin (h+v) ↪ Ω) :
    μ.assignments x' y' / μ.assignments x y ≤
      4 * (((Fintype.card Ω - h).descFactorial v : ℝ)⁻¹)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.FiniteLaw.ext
statement: @[ext] theorem ext {μ ν : FiniteLaw Ω} (h : ∀ x, μ x = ν x) : μ = ν

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.FiniteLaw.le_assignments
statement:
theorem le_assignments {h : ℕ} (μ ν : FiniteLaw (Equiv.Perm Ω)) (C : ℝ)
    (hb : ∀ g, C * ν g ≤ μ g) (x y : Fin h ↪ Ω) :
    C * ν.assignments x y ≤ μ.assignments x y

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.FiniteLaw.map_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem map_apply (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) (f : Ω → X) (y : X) :
    μ.map f y = ∑ x, if f x = y then μ x else 0

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.FiniteLaw.mass_le_one
statement: theorem mass_le_one (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) (x : Ω) : μ x ≤ 1

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.FiniteLaw.mix_uniform_between
statement:
theorem mix_uniform_between [Nonempty Ω] (ν : FiniteLaw Ω) {z : ℝ}
    (hz : 0 ≤ z) (hzhalf : z ≤ 1/2) (hzcard : z ≤ (Fintype.card Ω : ℝ)⁻¹)
    (x : Ω) :
    (1/2 : ℝ) * uniform Ω x ≤ (uniform Ω).mix ν z hz (by linarith) x ∧
      (uniform Ω).mix ν z hz (by linarith) x ≤ 2 * uniform Ω x

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.FiniteLaw.sum_assignments
statement:
theorem sum_assignments {h : ℕ} (μ : FiniteLaw (Equiv.Perm Ω))
    (x : Fin h ↪ Ω) : ∑ y, μ.assignments x y = 1

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.FiniteLaw.sum_mass
statement: @[simp] theorem sum_mass (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) : ∑ x, μ x = 1

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.FiniteLaw.uniform_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem uniform_apply [Nonempty Ω] (x : Ω) : uniform Ω x =
    (Fintype.card Ω : ℝ)⁻¹

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.FiniteLaw.uniform_assignments
statement:
theorem uniform_assignments {h : ℕ} (x y : Fin h ↪ Ω) :
    (uniform (Equiv.Perm Ω)).assignments x y =
      ((Fintype.card Ω).descFactorial h : ℝ)⁻¹

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.FiniteLaw.uniform_assignments_pos
statement:
theorem uniform_assignments_pos {h : ℕ} (x y : Fin h ↪ Ω) :
    0 < (uniform (Equiv.Perm Ω)).assignments x y

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.FiniteLaw.uniform_assignments_same
statement:
theorem uniform_assignments_same {h : ℕ} (x y z : Fin h ↪ Ω) :
    (uniform (Equiv.Perm Ω)).assignments x y =
      (uniform (Equiv.Perm Ω)).assignments x z

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.card_onLine
statement:
theorem card_onLine (H : G.Holes h) (j : Fin G.b) (L : G.Line j) :
    Fintype.card {i : Fin h // H.OnLine j L i} = H.lineCount j L

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.compatible_iff_lines
statement:
theorem compatible_iff_lines (H : G.Holes h) (ω : G.Choices) :
    H.Compatible ω ↔ ∀ j L, H.LineCompatible j L (ω j L)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.compatible_iff_step
statement:
theorem compatible_iff_step (H : G.Holes h) (ω : G.Choices) :
    H.Compatible ω ↔ H.StepCompatible ω

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.cost_le
statement: theorem cost_le (H : G.Holes h) : H.cost ≤ (G.b : ℝ) * h

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.cost_nonneg
statement: theorem cost_nonneg (H : G.Holes h) : 0 ≤ H.cost

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.feasible_of_disjoint
statement: theorem feasible_of_disjoint (H : G.Holes h) : H.Feasible

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.lineCompatible_iff_assignments
statement:
theorem lineCompatible_iff_assignments (H : G.Holes h) (j : Fin G.b) (L : G.Line j)
    (σ : Equiv.Perm (Cube (G.bits j))) :
    H.LineCompatible j L σ ↔ (H.lineInput j L).trans σ.toEmbedding = H.lineOutput j L

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.lineCount_le
statement:
theorem lineCount_le (H : G.Holes h) (j : Fin G.b) (L : G.Line j) :
    H.lineCount j L ≤ 2 ^ G.bits j

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.lineProbability_eq
statement:
theorem lineProbability_eq (H : G.Holes h) (j : Fin G.b) (L : G.Line j)
    (μ : FiniteLaw (Equiv.Perm (Cube (G.bits j)))) :
    (∑ σ : {σ // H.LineCompatible j L σ}, μ σ.val) =
      μ.assignments (H.lineInput j L) (H.lineOutput j L)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.line_input_injective
statement:
theorem line_input_injective (H : G.Holes h) (j : Fin G.b) (L : G.Line j) :
    Function.Injective (fun i : {i : Fin h // H.OnLine j L i} => H.path i j.castSucc j)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.line_output_injective
statement:
theorem line_output_injective (H : G.Holes h) (j : Fin G.b) (L : G.Line j) :
    Function.Injective (fun i : {i : Fin h // H.OnLine j L i} => H.path i j.succ j)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.probability_eq_assignments
statement:
theorem probability_eq_assignments (H : G.Holes h) {z : ℝ} (hz : 0 ≤ z) (hz' : z ≤ 1) :
    H.probability z = ∏ j, ∏ L,
      (lineLaw (G.bits j) z hz hz').assignments (H.lineInput j L) (H.lineOutput j L)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.probability_prod
statement:
theorem probability_prod (H : G.Holes h) {z : ℝ} (hz : 0 ≤ z) (hz' : z ≤ 1) :
    H.probability z = ∏ j, ∏ L, ∑ σ : {σ // H.LineCompatible j L σ},
      lineLaw (G.bits j) z hz hz' σ.val

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.probability_zero
statement:
theorem probability_zero (H : G.Holes h) :
    H.probability 0 = ∏ j, ∏ L,
      (((2 ^ G.bits j).descFactorial (H.lineCount j L) : ℝ)⁻¹)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.reference_compatible
statement:
theorem reference_compatible (H : G.Holes h) (hf : H.Feasible) :
    H.Compatible (H.reference hf)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.step_iff_coordinate
statement:
theorem step_iff_coordinate (H : G.Holes h) (ω : G.Choices) :
    H.StepCompatible ω ↔ ∀ i (j : Fin G.b),
      ω j (fun k => H.path i j.castSucc k) (H.path i j.castSucc j) = H.path i j.succ j

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.sum_lineCount
statement:
theorem sum_lineCount (H : G.Holes h) (j : Fin G.b) :
    ∑ L : G.Line j, H.lineCount j L = h

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.sum_subtype_eq_sum_ite_of_iff
statement:
theorem sum_subtype_eq_sum_ite_of_iff {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω]
    {p q : Ω → Prop} [Fintype {a // p a}] [DecidablePred q]
    (h : ∀ a, p a ↔ q a) (f : Ω → ℝ) :
    (∑ a : {a // p a}, f a.val) = ∑ a, if q a then f a else 0

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.boundary_succ
statement:
theorem boundary_succ (ω : G.Choices) {t : ℕ} (ht : t < G.b) :
    G.boundary ω (t+1) = G.stage ω ⟨t,ht⟩ * G.boundary ω t

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.boundary_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem boundary_zero (ω : G.Choices) : G.boundary ω 0 = 1

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.choiceWeight_eq
statement:
@[simp] theorem choiceWeight_eq (G : Grid) (z : ℝ) (hz : 0 ≤ z) (hz' : z ≤ 1)
    (ω : G.Choices) : G.choiceWeight z ω = G.choiceLaw z hz hz' ω

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.choiceWeight_pos
statement:
theorem choiceWeight_pos (G : Grid) {z : ℝ} (hz : 0 ≤ z) (hz' : z < 1)
    (ω : G.Choices) : 0 < G.choiceWeight z ω

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.stage_apply_ne
statement:
theorem stage_apply_ne (ω : G.Choices) (j k : Fin G.b) (hk : k ≠ j) (x : G.Slot) :
    G.stage ω j x k = x k

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.stage_apply_same
statement:
@[simp] theorem stage_apply_same (ω : G.Choices) (j : Fin G.b) (x : G.Slot) :
    G.stage ω j x j = ω j (fun k => x k) (x j)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.full_lineCost_le
statement: theorem full_lineCost_le (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) : lineCost m m ≤ m

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.lineCost_eq
statement:
theorem lineCost_eq (m u : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (hu : u ≤ m) :
    lineCost m u = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range u, (Real.log m - Real.log (m-j : ℕ))

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.lineCost_le
statement: theorem lineCost_le (m u : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (hu : u ≤ m) : lineCost m u ≤ u

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.lineCost_nonneg
statement:
theorem lineCost_nonneg (m u : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (hu : u ≤ m) :
    0 ≤ lineCost m u

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.monotone_prefix_average
statement:
theorem monotone_prefix_average (f : ℕ → ℝ) {u m : ℕ} (hu : u ≤ m)
    (hf : ∀ i < m, ∀ j < m, i ≤ j → f i ≤ f j) :
    (m : ℝ) * (∑ i ∈ Finset.range u, f i) ≤
      (u : ℝ) * (∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, f i)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.sum_corrections
statement:
theorem sum_corrections (m u : ℕ) (hu : u ≤ m) :
    (∑ j ∈ Finset.range u, (Real.log m - Real.log (m-j : ℕ))) =
       (u : ℝ) * Real.log m - Real.log (m.descFactorial u : ℝ)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.UnitaryIrrep.asRepresentation_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma asRepresentation_apply (g : Γ) (v : Fin ρ.dimension → ℂ) :
    ρ.asRepresentation g v=(ρ.matrix g).mulVec v

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.UnitaryIrrep.averageMatrix_star
statement:
lemma averageMatrix_star {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω] (τ : Γ →* Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hu : ∀ g, (τ g).conjTranspose=τ g⁻¹) (w : Ω → ℂ) (g : Ω → Γ) :
    (averageMatrix τ w g).conjTranspose = averageMatrix τ (fun ω => star (w ω))
      (fun ω => (g ω)⁻¹)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.UnitaryIrrep.central_character_operator
statement:
lemma central_character_operator (ρ : UnitaryIrrep Γ) (τ : Γ →* Matrix n n ℂ) :
    ∑ g, Matrix.trace (τ g⁻¹) • ρ.matrix g =
      ((Fintype.card Γ : ℂ) * Module.finrank ℂ
        (ρ.asRepresentation.IntertwiningMap (matrixRepresentation τ)) / ρ.dimension) •
          (1 : Matrix (Fin ρ.dimension) (Fin ρ.dimension) ℂ)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.UnitaryIrrep.central_sum_commute
statement:
lemma central_sum_commute {A : Type*} [Semiring A] [Algebra ℂ A]
    (τ : Γ →* A) (f : Γ → ℂ) (hf : ∀ k g, f (k*g*k⁻¹)=f g) (k : Γ) :
    τ k*(∑ g, f g • τ g)=(∑ g, f g • τ g)*τ k

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.UnitaryIrrep.character_asRepresentation
statement:
lemma character_asRepresentation (g : Γ) :
    ρ.asRepresentation.character g=Matrix.trace (ρ.matrix g)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.UnitaryIrrep.character_norm
statement:
theorem character_norm :
    (Fintype.card Γ : ℂ)⁻¹ *
      ∑ g : Γ, Matrix.trace (ρ.matrix g)*Matrix.trace (ρ.matrix g⁻¹)=1

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.UnitaryIrrep.character_sum_multiplicity
statement:
lemma character_sum_multiplicity (ρ : UnitaryIrrep Γ) (τ : Γ →* Matrix n n ℂ) :
    ∑ g, Matrix.trace (τ g)*Matrix.trace (ρ.matrix g⁻¹)=
      (Fintype.card Γ : ℂ) *
        Module.finrank ℂ (ρ.asRepresentation.IntertwiningMap (matrixRepresentation τ))

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.UnitaryIrrep.coefficient_conj
statement: lemma coefficient_conj (k g : Γ) : ρ.coefficient (k*g*k⁻¹)=ρ.coefficient g

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.UnitaryIrrep.coefficient_convolution
statement:
lemma coefficient_convolution (k : Γ) :
    ∑ g, ρ.coefficient g * ρ.coefficient (g⁻¹*k)=ρ.coefficient k

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.UnitaryIrrep.coefficient_star
statement: lemma coefficient_star (g : Γ) : star (ρ.coefficient g)=ρ.coefficient g⁻¹

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.UnitaryIrrep.commuting_scalar
statement:
theorem commuting_scalar (A : Matrix (Fin ρ.dimension) (Fin ρ.dimension) ℂ)
    (hA : ∀ g, A*ρ.matrix g=ρ.matrix g*A) : ∃ c : ℂ, A=c • (1 : Matrix _ _ ℂ)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.UnitaryIrrep.cross_convolution
statement:
lemma cross_convolution (ρ σ : UnitaryIrrep G)
    (hne : ¬Nonempty (Representation.Equiv σ.asRepresentation ρ.asRepresentation)) (k : G) :
    ∑ g, ρ.coefficient g*σ.coefficient (g⁻¹*k)=0

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.UnitaryIrrep.irrep_sum_trace_norm_sq
statement:
lemma irrep_sum_trace_norm_sq (ρ : UnitaryIrrep Γ) :
    ∑ g, ‖Matrix.trace (ρ.matrix g)‖^2=(Fintype.card Γ : ℝ)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.UnitaryIrrep.lift_averageAlgebra
statement:
lemma lift_averageAlgebra {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω] (τ : Γ →* Matrix n n ℂ)
    (w : Ω → ℂ) (g : Ω → Γ) :
    (MonoidAlgebra.lift ℂ _ Γ) τ (averageAlgebra w g)=averageMatrix τ w g

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.UnitaryIrrep.matrixRepresentation_character
statement:
lemma matrixRepresentation_character (τ : Γ →* Matrix n n ℂ) (g : Γ) :
    (matrixRepresentation τ).character g=Matrix.trace (τ g)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.UnitaryIrrep.matrix_inv
statement: lemma matrix_inv (g : Γ) : ρ.matrix g⁻¹=(ρ.matrix g).conjTranspose

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.UnitaryIrrep.multiplicity_moment_le
statement:
theorem multiplicity_moment_le {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω]
    (ρ : UnitaryIrrep Γ) (τ : Γ →* Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hu : ∀ g, (τ g).conjTranspose=τ g⁻¹) (w : Ω → ℂ) (g : Ω → Γ) (q : ℕ) :
    (Module.finrank ℂ (ρ.asRepresentation.IntertwiningMap (matrixRepresentation τ)) : ℝ) *
      (Matrix.trace (((averageMatrix ρ.matrix w g).conjTranspose*averageMatrix ρ.matrix w g)^q)).re ≤
        (Matrix.trace (((averageMatrix τ w g).conjTranspose*averageMatrix τ w g)^q)).re

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.UnitaryIrrep.multiplicity_sq_le_commutant
statement:
theorem multiplicity_sq_le_commutant (ρ : UnitaryIrrep Γ) (τ : Γ →* Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hu : ∀ g, (τ g).conjTranspose=τ g⁻¹) :
    (Module.finrank ℂ (ρ.asRepresentation.IntertwiningMap (matrixRepresentation τ)))^2 ≤
      Module.finrank ℂ ((matrixRepresentation τ).IntertwiningMap (matrixRepresentation τ))

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.UnitaryIrrep.projected_average_moment
statement:
theorem projected_average_moment {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω]
    (ρ : UnitaryIrrep Γ) (τ : Γ →* Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hu : ∀ g, (τ g).conjTranspose=τ g⁻¹) (w : Ω → ℂ) (g : Ω → Γ) (q : ℕ) :
    Matrix.trace (ρ.projector τ*((averageMatrix τ w g).conjTranspose*averageMatrix τ w g)^q) =
      (Module.finrank ℂ (ρ.asRepresentation.IntertwiningMap (matrixRepresentation τ)) : ℂ) *
        Matrix.trace (((averageMatrix ρ.matrix w g).conjTranspose*averageMatrix ρ.matrix w g)^q)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.UnitaryIrrep.projected_operator_moment
statement:
theorem projected_operator_moment {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω]
    (ρ : UnitaryIrrep Γ) (τ : Γ →* Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hu : ∀ g, (τ g).conjTranspose=τ g⁻¹) (w : Ω → ℂ) (g : Ω → Γ) {q : ℕ} (hq : q ≠ 0) :
    Matrix.trace (((ρ.projector τ*averageMatrix τ w g).conjTranspose*
      (ρ.projector τ*averageMatrix τ w g))^q) =
      (Module.finrank ℂ (ρ.asRepresentation.IntertwiningMap (matrixRepresentation τ)) : ℂ) *
        Matrix.trace (((averageMatrix ρ.matrix w g).conjTranspose*averageMatrix ρ.matrix w g)^q)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.UnitaryIrrep.projector_commute
statement:
lemma projector_commute (τ : Γ →* A) (k : Γ) :
    τ k * ρ.projector τ=ρ.projector τ * τ k

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.UnitaryIrrep.projector_commute_average
statement:
lemma projector_commute_average {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω] (ρ : UnitaryIrrep Γ)
    (τ : Γ →* Matrix n n ℂ) (w : Ω → ℂ) (g : Ω → Γ) :
    ρ.projector τ*averageMatrix τ w g=averageMatrix τ w g*ρ.projector τ

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.UnitaryIrrep.projector_complement_posSemidef
statement:
lemma projector_complement_posSemidef (ρ : UnitaryIrrep Γ) (τ : Γ →* Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hu : ∀ g, (τ g).conjTranspose=τ g⁻¹) : (1-ρ.projector τ).PosSemidef

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.UnitaryIrrep.projector_hermitian
statement:
theorem projector_hermitian (τ : Γ →* Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hu : ∀ g, (τ g).conjTranspose=τ g⁻¹) :
    (ρ.projector τ).conjTranspose=ρ.projector τ

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.UnitaryIrrep.projector_idempotent
statement: theorem projector_idempotent (τ : Γ →* A) : ρ.projector τ * ρ.projector τ=ρ.projector τ

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.UnitaryIrrep.projector_intertwiner
statement:
lemma projector_intertwiner {V W : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V]
    [AddCommGroup W] [Module ℂ W] (ρ : UnitaryIrrep G)
    (τ : Representation ℂ G V) (ν : Representation ℂ G W)
    (F : Representation.IntertwiningMap τ ν) (v : V) :
    (ρ.projector ν) (F v)=F ((ρ.projector τ) v)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.UnitaryIrrep.projector_lift_trace
statement:
theorem projector_lift_trace (ρ : UnitaryIrrep Γ) (τ : Γ →* Matrix n n ℂ)
    (x : MonoidAlgebra ℂ Γ) :
    Matrix.trace (ρ.projector τ*((MonoidAlgebra.lift ℂ _ Γ) τ x)) =
      (Module.finrank ℂ (ρ.asRepresentation.IntertwiningMap (matrixRepresentation τ)) : ℂ) *
        Matrix.trace ((MonoidAlgebra.lift ℂ _ Γ) ρ.matrix x)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.UnitaryIrrep.projector_matrix_asRepresentation
statement:
lemma projector_matrix_asRepresentation (ρ σ : UnitaryIrrep G) :
    ρ.projector σ.asRepresentation=Matrix.toLinAlgEquiv' (ρ.projector σ.matrix)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.UnitaryIrrep.projector_orthogonal
statement:
lemma projector_orthogonal {A : Type*} [Semiring A] [Algebra ℂ A]
    (ρ σ : UnitaryIrrep G)
    (hne : ¬Nonempty (Representation.Equiv σ.asRepresentation ρ.asRepresentation))
    (τ : G →* A) : ρ.projector τ*σ.projector τ=0

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.UnitaryIrrep.projector_other
statement:
lemma projector_other (ρ σ : UnitaryIrrep G)
    (hne : ¬Nonempty (Representation.Equiv ρ.asRepresentation σ.asRepresentation)) :
    ρ.projector σ.matrix=0

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.UnitaryIrrep.projector_posSemidef
statement:
theorem projector_posSemidef (τ : Γ →* Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hu : ∀ g, (τ g).conjTranspose=τ g⁻¹) :
    (ρ.projector τ).PosSemidef

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.UnitaryIrrep.projector_self
statement: theorem projector_self : ρ.projector ρ.matrix=1

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.UnitaryIrrep.projector_twisted_trace
statement:
theorem projector_twisted_trace (ρ : UnitaryIrrep Γ) (τ : Γ →* Matrix n n ℂ) (k : Γ) :
    Matrix.trace (ρ.projector τ*τ k) =
      (Module.finrank ℂ (ρ.asRepresentation.IntertwiningMap (matrixRepresentation τ)) : ℂ) *
        Matrix.trace (ρ.matrix k)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.UnitaryIrrep.sum_trace_norm_sq
statement:
lemma sum_trace_norm_sq (τ : Γ →* Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hu : ∀ g, (τ g).conjTranspose=τ g⁻¹) :
    ∑ g, ‖Matrix.trace (τ g)‖^2=(Fintype.card Γ : ℝ) *
      Module.finrank ℂ ((matrixRepresentation τ).IntertwiningMap (matrixRepresentation τ))

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.UnitaryIrrep.trace_conj
statement:
lemma trace_conj (τ : Γ →* Matrix n n ℂ) (k g : Γ) :
    Matrix.trace (τ (k*g*k⁻¹))=Matrix.trace (τ g)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.UnitaryIrrep.trace_positive_product
statement:
lemma trace_positive_product {A B : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.PosSemidef) (hB : B.PosSemidef) :
    0 ≤ Matrix.trace (A*B)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.UnitaryRealization.exists_unitary
statement:
theorem exists_unitary (σ : Representation ℂ G V) [σ.IsIrreducible] :
    ∃ ρ : UnitaryIrrep G, Nonempty (Representation.Equiv σ ρ.asRepresentation)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.UnitaryRealization.gram_invariant
statement:
lemma gram_invariant (τ : G →* Matrix J J ℂ) (h : G) :
    (τ h).conjTranspose*(∑ g, (τ g).conjTranspose*τ g)*τ h=
      ∑ g, (τ g).conjTranspose*τ g

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.UnitaryRealization.gram_posDef
statement:
lemma gram_posDef (τ : G →* Matrix J J ℂ) :
    (∑ g, (τ g).conjTranspose * τ g).PosDef

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.UnitaryRealization.unitarize
statement:
theorem unitarize (τ : G →* Matrix J J ℂ) :
    ∃ A B : Matrix J J ℂ, A*B=1 ∧ B*A=1 ∧ A.IsHermitian ∧ B.IsHermitian ∧
      (∀ g, (B*τ g*A).conjTranspose*(B*τ g*A)=1)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.card_freeAt
statement:
lemma card_freeAt (H : G.Holes h) (t : Fin (G.b+1)) :
    Fintype.card (H.FreeAt t)=G.size-h

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.columnAction_marked
statement:
lemma columnAction_marked (hf : H.Feasible) (τ : H.ColumnChoices) (i : Fin h) :
    H.columnAction τ (H.path i (suffixTime A B 0))=H.path i (Fin.last _)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.column_constant
statement:
lemma column_constant (i : Fin h) (t : Fin (B.b+1)) :
    (splitSlots A B (H.path i (suffixTime A B t))).1=H.columnOf i

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.column_step_iff
statement:
lemma column_step_iff (x : A.Slot) (τ : B.Choices) :
    (H.columnHoles x).StepCompatible τ ↔ ∀ i : Fin h, H.columnOf i=x → ∀ j : Fin B.b,
      B.stage τ j (splitSlots A B (H.path i (suffixTime A B j.castSucc))).2=
        (splitSlots A B (H.path i (suffixTime A B j.succ))).2

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.compatible_split
statement:
theorem compatible_split (ω : (concat A B).Choices) :
    H.Compatible ω ↔
      (∀ y : B.Slot, (H.rowHoles y).Compatible (rowChoices A B ω y)) ∧
      (∀ x : A.Slot, (H.columnHoles x).Compatible (columnChoices A B ω x))

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.conditionalAverage_eq_sum
statement:
theorem conditionalAverage_eq_sum (H : G.Holes h) (hf : H.Feasible) (z : ℝ)
    (ρ : UnitaryIrrep H.stabilizer) :
    H.conditionalAverage hf z ρ =
      ∑ ω : {ω : G.Choices // H.Compatible ω},
        ((G.choiceWeight z ω.val / H.probability z : ℝ) : ℂ) •
          ρ.matrix (H.residual hf ω)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.conditionalAverage_norm_le
OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.conditionalMoment_le_dimension
OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.conditionalMoment_nonneg
statement:
theorem conditionalMoment_nonneg (H : G.Holes h) (hf : H.Feasible) (z : ℝ)
    (ρ : UnitaryIrrep H.stabilizer) (q : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ schattenMoment q (H.conditionalAverage hf z ρ)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.conditionalWeight_split
statement:
theorem conditionalWeight_split (z : ℝ) (ω : {ω : (concat A B).Choices // H.Compatible ω}) :
    (concat A B).choiceWeight z ω.val/H.probability z=
      (∏ y, A.choiceWeight z (rowChoices A B ω.val y)/(H.rowHoles y).probability z)*
      (∏ x, B.choiceWeight z (columnChoices A B ω.val x)/(H.columnHoles x).probability z)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.junction_average_split
statement:
theorem junction_average_split {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (hf : H.Feasible) (z : ℝ) (τ : H.JunctionFix →* Matrix n n ℂ) :
    (∑ ω : {ω : (concat A B).Choices // H.Compatible ω},
      (((concat A B).choiceWeight z ω.val/H.probability z : ℝ) : ℂ) •
        τ (H.junctionEquiv hf (H.residual hf ω)))=
      H.columnAverage hf z τ*H.rowAverage hf z τ

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.junction_residual
statement:
lemma junction_residual (hf : H.Feasible) (ω : {ω : (concat A B).Choices // H.Compatible ω}) :
    H.junctionEquiv hf (H.residual hf ω)=
      H.columnResidual hf (H.splitCompatibleChoices ω).2*H.rowResidual hf (H.splitCompatibleChoices ω).1

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.probability_pos
statement:
theorem probability_pos (H : G.Holes h) (hf : H.Feasible) {z : ℝ}
    (hz : 0 ≤ z) (hz' : z < 1) : 0 < H.probability z

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.probability_split
statement:
theorem probability_split (z : ℝ) :
    H.probability z=(∏ y, (H.rowHoles y).probability z)*(∏ x, (H.columnHoles x).probability z)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.rowAction_marked
statement:
lemma rowAction_marked (hf : H.Feasible) (τ : H.RowChoices) (i : Fin h) :
    H.rowAction τ (H.path i 0)=H.path i (suffixTime A B 0)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.row_constant
statement:
lemma row_constant (i : Fin h) (t : Fin (A.b+1)) :
    (splitSlots A B (H.path i (prefixTime A B t))).2=H.rowOf i

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.row_step_iff
statement:
lemma row_step_iff (y : B.Slot) (τ : A.Choices) :
    (H.rowHoles y).StepCompatible τ ↔ ∀ i : Fin h, H.rowOf i=y → ∀ j : Fin A.b,
      A.stage τ j (splitSlots A B (H.path i (prefixTime A B j.castSucc))).1=
        (splitSlots A B (H.path i (prefixTime A B j.succ))).1

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.splitCompatibleChoices_weight
statement:
lemma splitCompatibleChoices_weight (z : ℝ)
    (τ : (∀ y : B.Slot, {τ : A.Choices // (H.rowHoles y).Compatible τ}) ×
      (∀ x : A.Slot, {τ : B.Choices // (H.columnHoles x).Compatible τ})) :
    (concat A B).choiceWeight z (H.splitCompatibleChoices.symm τ).val=
      (∏ y, A.choiceWeight z (τ.1 y).val)*(∏ x, B.choiceWeight z (τ.2 x).val)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.split_choice_sweep
statement:
lemma split_choice_sweep (τ : H.RowChoices × H.ColumnChoices) :
    (concat A B).sweep (H.splitCompatibleChoices.symm τ).val=H.columnAction τ.2*H.rowAction τ.1

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.sum_columnCount
statement: lemma sum_columnCount : ∑ x, H.columnCount x=h

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.sum_rowCount
statement: lemma sum_rowCount : ∑ y, H.rowCount y=h

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.sweep_refPair
statement:
lemma sweep_refPair (hf : H.Feasible) :
    (concat A B).sweep (H.reference hf)=H.columnAction (H.refPair hf).2*H.rowAction (H.refPair hf).1

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.boundary_split_prefix
statement:
lemma boundary_split_prefix (A B : Grid) (ω : (concat A B).Choices)
    (x : (concat A B).Slot) (t : ℕ) (ht : t≤A.b) :
    splitSlots A B ((concat A B).boundary ω t x)=
      (A.boundary (rowChoices A B ω (splitSlots A B x).2) t (splitSlots A B x).1,
       (splitSlots A B x).2)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.boundary_split_suffix
statement:
lemma boundary_split_suffix (A B : Grid) (ω : (concat A B).Choices)
    (x : (concat A B).Slot) (t : ℕ) (ht : t≤B.b) :
    splitSlots A B ((concat A B).boundary ω (A.b+t) x)=
      (A.sweep (rowChoices A B ω (splitSlots A B x).2) (splitSlots A B x).1,
       B.boundary (columnChoices A B ω
         (A.sweep (rowChoices A B ω (splitSlots A B x).2) (splitSlots A B x).1)) t
         (splitSlots A B x).2)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.card_slot
statement: @[simp] theorem card_slot (G : Grid) : Fintype.card G.Slot=G.size

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.choiceWeight_split
statement:
theorem choiceWeight_split (A B : Grid) (ω : (concat A B).Choices) (z : ℝ) :
    (concat A B).choiceWeight z ω =
      (∏ y : B.Slot, A.choiceWeight z (rowChoices A B ω y))*
      (∏ x : A.Slot, B.choiceWeight z (columnChoices A B ω x))

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.columnChoices_apply
statement:
lemma columnChoices_apply (A B : Grid) (ω : (concat A B).Choices) (x : A.Slot)
    (i : Fin B.b) (L : B.Line i) :
    columnChoices A B ω x i L=(rightCube A B i).permCongr
      (ω (Fin.natAdd A.b i) (columnLines A B i (x,L)))

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.columnLines_at_slot
statement:
lemma columnLines_at_slot (A B : Grid) (i : Fin B.b) (x : (concat A B).Slot) :
    columnLines A B i ((splitSlots A B x).1,(fun j => (splitSlots A B x).2 j.val))=
      (fun (j : {j : Fin (concat A B).b // j ≠ Fin.natAdd A.b i}) => x j.val)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.columnLines_evaluation
statement:
lemma columnLines_evaluation (A B : Grid) (i : Fin B.b) (x : (concat A B).Slot) :
    (columnLines A B i).symm (fun j => x j.val)=
      ((splitSlots A B x).1,(fun j : {j : Fin B.b // j ≠ i} => (splitSlots A B x).2 j.val))

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.columnSweep_apply
statement:
lemma columnSweep_apply (A B : Grid) (ω : A.Slot → B.Choices) (x : (concat A B).Slot) :
    splitSlots A B (columnSweep A B ω x)=
      ((splitSlots A B x).1,B.sweep (ω (splitSlots A B x).1) (splitSlots A B x).2)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.concat_allowed
statement:
lemma concat_allowed (A B : Grid) (r : ℕ) :
    (concat A B).Allowed r ↔ A.Allowed r ∧ B.Allowed r

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.concat_bits_left
statement:
@[simp] lemma concat_bits_left (A B : Grid) (i : Fin A.b) :
    (concat A B).bits (Fin.castAdd B.b i)=A.bits i

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.concat_bits_right
statement:
@[simp] lemma concat_bits_right (A B : Grid) (i : Fin B.b) :
    (concat A B).bits (Fin.natAdd A.b i)=B.bits i

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.concat_size
statement: lemma concat_size (A B : Grid) : (concat A B).size=A.size*B.size

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.prefix_weight
statement:
lemma prefix_weight (A B : Grid) (ω : (concat A B).Choices) (z : ℝ) (i : Fin A.b) :
    (∏ L : (concat A B).Line (Fin.castAdd B.b i),
      rawLineWeight ((concat A B).bits (Fin.castAdd B.b i)) z (ω (Fin.castAdd B.b i) L))=
    ∏ y : B.Slot, ∏ L : A.Line i, rawLineWeight (A.bits i) z (rowChoices A B ω y i L)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.rawLineWeight_cast
statement:
lemma rawLineWeight_cast {k l : ℕ} (h : k=l) (z : ℝ) (σ : Equiv.Perm (Cube k)) :
    rawLineWeight k z σ=rawLineWeight l z ((Equiv.cast (congrArg Cube h)).permCongr σ)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.rowChoices_apply
statement:
lemma rowChoices_apply (A B : Grid) (ω : (concat A B).Choices) (y : B.Slot)
    (i : Fin A.b) (L : A.Line i) :
    rowChoices A B ω y i L=(leftCube A B i).permCongr
      (ω (Fin.castAdd B.b i) (rowLines A B i (L,y)))

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.rowLines_at_slot
statement:
lemma rowLines_at_slot (A B : Grid) (i : Fin A.b) (x : (concat A B).Slot) :
    rowLines A B i ((fun j => (splitSlots A B x).1 j.val),(splitSlots A B x).2)=
      (fun (j : {j : Fin (concat A B).b // j ≠ Fin.castAdd B.b i}) => x j.val)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.rowLines_evaluation
statement:
lemma rowLines_evaluation (A B : Grid) (i : Fin A.b) (x : (concat A B).Slot) :
    (rowLines A B i).symm (fun j => x j.val)=
      ((fun j : {j : Fin A.b // j ≠ i} => (splitSlots A B x).1 j.val),(splitSlots A B x).2)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.rowSweep_apply
statement:
lemma rowSweep_apply (A B : Grid) (ω : B.Slot → A.Choices) (x : (concat A B).Slot) :
    splitSlots A B (rowSweep A B ω x)=
      (A.sweep (ω (splitSlots A B x).2) (splitSlots A B x).1,(splitSlots A B x).2)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.rowSweep_eq_boundary
statement:
theorem rowSweep_eq_boundary (A B : Grid) (ω : (concat A B).Choices) :
    rowSweep A B (rowChoices A B ω)=(concat A B).boundary ω A.b

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.splitSlots_left
statement:
@[simp] lemma splitSlots_left (A B : Grid) (x : (concat A B).Slot) (i : Fin A.b) :
    (splitSlots A B x).1 i = (Equiv.cast (by simp : Cube ((concat A B).bits (Fin.castAdd B.b i))=Cube (A.bits i)))
      (x (Fin.castAdd B.b i))

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.splitSlots_right
statement:
@[simp] lemma splitSlots_right (A B : Grid) (x : (concat A B).Slot) (j : Fin B.b) :
    (splitSlots A B x).2 j = (Equiv.cast (by simp : Cube ((concat A B).bits (Fin.natAdd A.b j))=Cube (B.bits j)))
      (x (Fin.natAdd A.b j))

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.stage_split_left
statement:
theorem stage_split_left (A B : Grid) (ω : (concat A B).Choices) (i : Fin A.b)
    (x : (concat A B).Slot) :
    splitSlots A B ((concat A B).stage ω (Fin.castAdd B.b i) x)=
      (A.stage (rowChoices A B ω (splitSlots A B x).2) i (splitSlots A B x).1,
        (splitSlots A B x).2)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.stage_split_right
statement:
theorem stage_split_right (A B : Grid) (ω : (concat A B).Choices) (i : Fin B.b)
    (x : (concat A B).Slot) :
    splitSlots A B ((concat A B).stage ω (Fin.natAdd A.b i) x)=
      ((splitSlots A B x).1,B.stage (columnChoices A B ω (splitSlots A B x).1) i (splitSlots A B x).2)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.suffix_weight
statement:
lemma suffix_weight (A B : Grid) (ω : (concat A B).Choices) (z : ℝ) (i : Fin B.b) :
    (∏ L : (concat A B).Line (Fin.natAdd A.b i),
      rawLineWeight ((concat A B).bits (Fin.natAdd A.b i)) z (ω (Fin.natAdd A.b i) L))=
    ∏ x : A.Slot, ∏ L : B.Line i, rawLineWeight (B.bits i) z (columnChoices A B ω x i L)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.sweep_eq_column_mul_row
statement:
theorem sweep_eq_column_mul_row (A B : Grid) (ω : (concat A B).Choices) :
    (concat A B).sweep ω=columnSweep A B (columnChoices A B ω)*rowSweep A B (rowChoices A B ω)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.sweep_split
statement:
theorem sweep_split (A B : Grid) (ω : (concat A B).Choices) (x : (concat A B).Slot) :
    splitSlots A B ((concat A B).sweep ω x)=
      (A.sweep (rowChoices A B ω (splitSlots A B x).2) (splitSlots A B x).1,
       B.sweep (columnChoices A B ω
         (A.sweep (rowChoices A B ω (splitSlots A B x).2) (splitSlots A B x).1))
         (splitSlots A B x).2)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Marked.card_free
statement:
lemma card_free [Fintype X] [Fintype I] (x : I → X) (hx : Function.Injective x) :
    Fintype.card (Free x)=Fintype.card X-Fintype.card I

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Marked.freeEquiv_apply
statement:
lemma freeEquiv_apply (x : I → X) (y : I → Y) (e : X ≃ Y) (he : ∀ i, e (x i)=y i)
    (z : Free x) : (freeEquiv x y e he z).val=e z.val

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.finDeleteLeft_inl
statement:
@[simp] lemma finDeleteLeft_inl {m n : ℕ} (i : Fin m) (j : {j : Fin m // j ≠ i}) :
    (finDeleteLeft (n := n) i (Sum.inl j)).val=Fin.castAdd n j.val

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.finDeleteLeft_inr
statement:
@[simp] lemma finDeleteLeft_inr {m n : ℕ} (i : Fin m) (j : Fin n) :
    (finDeleteLeft (n := n) i (Sum.inr j)).val=Fin.natAdd m j

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.finDeleteRight_inl
statement:
@[simp] lemma finDeleteRight_inl {m n : ℕ} (i : Fin n) (j : Fin m) :
    (finDeleteRight (m := m) i (Sum.inl j)).val=Fin.castAdd n j

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.finDeleteRight_inr
statement:
@[simp] lemma finDeleteRight_inr {m n : ℕ} (i : Fin n) (j : {j : Fin n // j ≠ i}) :
    (finDeleteRight (m := m) i (Sum.inr j)).val=Fin.natAdd m j.val

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.commutantEval_injective
statement: lemma commutantEval_injective (p l : ℕ) : Function.Injective (commutantEval p l)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.commutant_entry_zero_adjacent_mismatch
statement:
theorem commutant_entry_zero_adjacent_mismatch {p n : ℕ} (A : commutant p (n+2))
    (u w : Word p (n+2)) (hu : u 0 = u 1) (hw : w 0 = w 1)
    (hm : odd (u 0) ↔ ¬ odd (w 0)) : A.val u w = 0

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.commutant_entry_zero_repeated_mismatch
statement:
theorem commutant_entry_zero_repeated_mismatch {p l : ℕ} (A : commutant p l)
    (u w : Word p l) (i j : Fin l) (hij : i ≠ j) (hu : u i = u j) (hw : w i = w j)
    (hm : odd (u i) ↔ ¬ odd (w i)) : A.val u w = 0

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.commutant_finrank_le
statement:
theorem commutant_finrank_le (p l : ℕ) :
    Module.finrank ℂ (commutant p l) ≤ (l+1)^((2*p)*(2*p))

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.commutant_transport
statement:
lemma commutant_transport {p l : ℕ} (A : commutant p l) (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin l))
    (u w : Word p l) :
    A.val (wordPerm σ u) (wordPerm σ w) = phase σ u * phase σ w * A.val u w

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.commutant_zero_transport
statement:
lemma commutant_zero_transport {p l : ℕ} (A : commutant p l)
    (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin l)) {u w : Word p l} (h : A.val u w=0) :
    A.val (wordPerm σ u) (wordPerm σ w)=0

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.densityPower_commute
statement:
theorem densityPower_commute {p l : ℕ} (r : EvenDensity p)
    (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin l)) :
    matrix σ * densityPower l r.val=densityPower l r.val * matrix σ

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.densityPower_mul
statement:
lemma densityPower_mul {p : ℕ} (l : ℕ) (a b : Matrix (Letter p) (Letter p) ℂ) :
    densityPower l (a*b)=densityPower l a * densityPower l b

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.densityPower_parity_of_ne_zero
statement:
lemma densityPower_parity_of_ne_zero {p l : ℕ} (r : EvenDensity p)
    {u w : Word p l} (h : densityPower l r.val u w ≠ 0) :
    ∀ i, odd (u i) ↔ odd (w i)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.densityPower_permute
statement:
lemma densityPower_permute {p l : ℕ} (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin l))
    (r : Matrix (Letter p) (Letter p) ℂ) (u w : Word p l) :
    densityPower l r (wordPerm σ u) (wordPerm σ w)=densityPower l r u w

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.densityPower_posSemidef
statement:
lemma densityPower_posSemidef {p : ℕ} (l : ℕ) (r : Matrix (Letter p) (Letter p) ℂ)
    (hr : r.PosSemidef) : (densityPower l r).PosSemidef

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.densityPower_star
statement:
lemma densityPower_star {p : ℕ} (l : ℕ) (r : Matrix (Letter p) (Letter p) ℂ) :
    densityPower l r.conjTranspose=(densityPower l r).conjTranspose

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.densityPower_trace
statement:
lemma densityPower_trace {p : ℕ} (l : ℕ) (r : Matrix (Letter p) (Letter p) ℂ) :
    Matrix.trace (densityPower l r)=(Matrix.trace r)^l

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.endomorphismMatrix_injective
statement:
lemma endomorphismMatrix_injective (p l : ℕ) :
    Function.Injective (endomorphismMatrix p l)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.evenDensityPower_trace
statement:
lemma evenDensityPower_trace {p : ℕ} (l : ℕ) (r : EvenDensity p) :
    Matrix.trace (densityPower l r.val)=1

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.exists_perm_pair
statement:
lemma exists_perm_pair {X : Type*} [DecidableEq X] (a b c d : X)
    (hab : a ≠ b) (hcd : c ≠ d) :
    ∃ g : Equiv.Perm X, g a = c ∧ g b = d

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.isotypic_eq_projector
statement:
lemma isotypic_eq_projector {p l : ℕ} (ρ : UnitaryIrrep (Equiv.Perm (Fin l))) :
    isotypic (p := p) ρ=ρ.projector (action p l)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.isotypic_posSemidef
statement:
theorem isotypic_posSemidef {p l : ℕ} (ρ : UnitaryIrrep (Equiv.Perm (Fin l))) :
    (isotypic (p := p) ρ).PosSemidef

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.isotypic_trace
statement:
theorem isotypic_trace {p l : ℕ} (ρ : UnitaryIrrep (Equiv.Perm (Fin l))) :
    Matrix.trace (isotypic (p := p) ρ)=(ρ.dimension : ℂ)*
      Module.finrank ℂ (ρ.asRepresentation.IntertwiningMap (tensorRepresentation p l))

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.matrix_inv
statement:
lemma matrix_inv {p l : ℕ} (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin l)) :
    matrix (p := p) σ⁻¹=(matrix (p := p) σ).conjTranspose

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.matrix_mul
statement:
theorem matrix_mul {p l : ℕ} (σ τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin l)) :
    matrix (p := p) (σ*τ)=matrix σ * matrix τ

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.matrix_one
statement: theorem matrix_one (p l : ℕ) : matrix (p := p) (1 : Equiv.Perm (Fin l))=1

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.matrix_unitary
statement:
theorem matrix_unitary {p l : ℕ} (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin l)) :
    (matrix (p := p) σ).conjTranspose * matrix σ=1

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.mismatchSlots_card_le
statement:
theorem mismatchSlots_card_le {p l : ℕ} (A : commutant p l)
    (u w : Word p l) (hne : A.val u w ≠ 0) :
    (mismatchSlots u w).card ≤ (2*p)*(2*p)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.mul_signed_entry
statement:
lemma mul_signed_entry {p l : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Word p l) (Word p l) ℂ)
    (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin l)) (u w : Word p l) :
    (A*matrix (p := p) σ) u w=A u (wordPerm σ w)*phase σ w

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.multiplicity_le
statement:
theorem multiplicity_le (p l : ℕ) (ρ : UnitaryIrrep (Equiv.Perm (Fin l))) :
    Module.finrank ℂ (ρ.asRepresentation.IntertwiningMap (tensorRepresentation p l)) ≤
      (l+1)^((2*p)*(2*p))

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.phase_eq_of_parity
statement:
lemma phase_eq_of_parity {p l : ℕ} (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin l))
    (u w : Word p l) (h : ∀ i, odd (u i) ↔ odd (w i)) : phase σ u=phase σ w

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.phase_mul
statement:
theorem phase_mul {p l : ℕ} (σ τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin l)) (w : Word p l) :
    phase (σ*τ) w = phase σ (wordPerm τ w) * phase τ w

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.phase_ne_zero
statement: lemma phase_ne_zero {p l : ℕ} (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin l)) (w : Word p l) : phase σ w ≠ 0

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.phase_one
statement: lemma phase_one {p l : ℕ} (w : Word p l) : phase (1 : Equiv.Perm (Fin l)) w=1

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.phase_prod
statement:
lemma phase_prod {p l : ℕ} (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin l)) (w : Word p l) :
    phase σ w = ∏ ij ∈ Equiv.Perm.finPairsLT l,
      (if odd (w ij.1) ∧ odd (w ij.2) ∧ σ ij.1 < σ ij.2 then (-1 : ℂ) else 1)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.phase_square
statement:
lemma phase_square {p l : ℕ} (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin l)) (u : Word p l) :
    phase σ u * phase σ u = 1

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.phase_star_mul
statement:
lemma phase_star_mul {p l : ℕ} (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin l)) (w : Word p l) :
    star (phase σ w)*phase σ w=1

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.phase_swap01
statement:
lemma phase_swap01 {p n : ℕ} (w : Word p (n+2)) :
    phase (Equiv.swap (0 : Fin (n+2)) 1) w =
      if odd (w 1) ∧ odd (w 0) then (-1 : ℂ) else 1

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.profileRep_spec
statement:
lemma profileRep_spec {p l : ℕ} (q : OccurringProfile p l) :
    profile (profileRep q).1 (profileRep q).2=q.val

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.profile_eq_exists_perm
OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.profile_fiber_card
statement:
lemma profile_fiber_card {p l : ℕ} (u w : Word p l) (a : Letter p × Letter p) :
    Fintype.card {i : Fin l // (u i,w i)=a}=(profile u w a).val

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.regroupPhase_of_same_parity
statement:
lemma regroupPhase_of_same_parity {p l : ℕ} (u u' w : Word p l)
    (h : ∀ i, odd (u i) ↔ odd (u' i)) : regroupPhase u w = regroupPhase u' w

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.regroupPhase_permute
statement:
theorem regroupPhase_permute {p l : ℕ} (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin l)) (u w : Word p l)
    (hfix : ∀ i, (odd (u i) ↔ ¬ odd (w i)) → σ i = i) :
    regroupPhase (wordPerm σ u) (wordPerm σ w) * phase σ u * phase σ w =
      regroupPhase u w

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.regroupPhase_square
statement:
lemma regroupPhase_square {p l : ℕ} (u w : Word p l) :
    regroupPhase u w * regroupPhase u w = 1

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.regroupPhase_star
statement:
lemma regroupPhase_star {p l : ℕ} (u w : Word p l) :
    star (regroupPhase u w) = regroupPhase u w

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.regrouped_commutant_invariant
statement:
theorem regrouped_commutant_invariant {p l : ℕ} (A : commutant p l)
    (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin l)) (u w : Word p l)
    (hfix : ∀ i, (odd (u i) ↔ ¬ odd (w i)) → σ i = i) :
    regroupPhase (wordPerm σ u) (wordPerm σ w) *
        A.val (wordPerm σ u) (wordPerm σ w) = regroupPhase u w * A.val u w

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.signed_mul_entry
statement:
lemma signed_mul_entry {p l : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Word p l) (Word p l) ℂ)
    (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin l)) (u w : Word p l) :
    (matrix (p := p) σ*A) (wordPerm σ u) w=phase σ u*A u w

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.swap01_inversion_iff
statement:
lemma swap01_inversion_iff (n : ℕ) (i j : Fin (n+2)) :
    (j < i ∧ Equiv.swap (0 : Fin (n+2)) 1 i < Equiv.swap 0 1 j) ↔
      i = 1 ∧ j = 0

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.tensor_endomorphisms_finrank_le
statement:
theorem tensor_endomorphisms_finrank_le (p l : ℕ) :
    Module.finrank ℂ ((tensorRepresentation p l).IntertwiningMap (tensorRepresentation p l)) ≤
      (l+1)^((2*p)*(2*p))

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.wordPerm_mul
statement:
lemma wordPerm_mul {p l : ℕ} (σ τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin l)) :
    wordPerm (p := p) (σ*τ) = wordPerm σ * wordPerm τ

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.wordPerm_swap01_of_equal
statement:
lemma wordPerm_swap01_of_equal {p n : ℕ} (w : Word p (n+2)) (hw : w 0 = w 1) :
    wordPerm (Equiv.swap (0 : Fin (n+2)) 1) w = w

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.OrdinaryTensor.amplitude_congr
statement:
lemma amplitude_congr (h : Histogram I A) {u w : I → A} (he : count u = count w) :
    amplitude h u = amplitude h w

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.OrdinaryTensor.amplitude_eq_counts
statement:
lemma amplitude_eq_counts (h : Histogram I A) (w : I → A) :
    amplitude h w = ∏ a, (Real.sqrt ((h.val a : ℝ)/Fintype.card I)) ^ count w a

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.OrdinaryTensor.amplitude_square
statement:
lemma amplitude_square (h : Histogram I A) (w : I → A) :
    amplitude h w ^ 2 = (∏ a, (h.val a : ℝ) ^ count w a) /
      (Fintype.card I : ℝ) ^ Fintype.card I

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.OrdinaryTensor.block_entry
statement:
lemma block_entry (h : Histogram I A) (u w : I → A) :
    block h u w = if histogram u = h ∧ histogram w = h then (1 : ℂ) else 0

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.OrdinaryTensor.block_posSemidef
statement: lemma block_posSemidef (h : Histogram I A) : (block h).PosSemidef

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.OrdinaryTensor.card_transporter
statement:
lemma card_transporter (u w : I → A) :
    Fintype.card {g : Equiv.Perm I // permute g u = w} =
      if count u = count w then ∏ a, (count u a).factorial else 0

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.OrdinaryTensor.card_wordStabilizer
statement:
lemma card_wordStabilizer (w : I → A) :
    Fintype.card {σ : Equiv.Perm I // ∀ i, w (σ i) = w i} =
      ∏ a : A, (count w a).factorial

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.OrdinaryTensor.char_star_mul
statement:
lemma char_star_mul (t : ZMod (Fintype.card I+1)) :
    ZMod.stdAddChar t * star (ZMod.stdAddChar t) = 1

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.OrdinaryTensor.count_le
statement: lemma count_le (w : I → A) (a : A) : count w a ≤ Fintype.card I

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.OrdinaryTensor.count_representative
statement: lemma count_representative (h : Histogram I A) : count (representative h) = h.val

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.OrdinaryTensor.counts_eq_exists_perm
statement:
lemma counts_eq_exists_perm {u w : I → A} (h : count u = count w) :
    ∃ σ : Equiv.Perm I, permute σ u = w

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.OrdinaryTensor.empiricalVector_square
statement:
lemma empiricalVector_square (h : Histogram I A) (t : PhaseSpace I A) (a : A) :
    empiricalVector h t a * star (empiricalVector h t a) =
      (((h.val a : ℝ)/Fintype.card I : ℝ) : ℂ)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.OrdinaryTensor.empiricalVector_unit
statement:
lemma empiricalVector_unit (hn : 0 < Fintype.card I) (h : Histogram I A) (t : PhaseSpace I A) :
    (∑ a, empiricalVector h t a * star (empiricalVector h t a)) = 1

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.OrdinaryTensor.factorial_mode
statement: lemma factorial_mode (n t : ℕ) : n^t * n.factorial ≤ n^n * t.factorial

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.OrdinaryTensor.factorial_step_upper
statement: lemma factorial_step_upper (t k : ℕ) : (t+k).factorial ≤ t.factorial * (t+k)^k

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.OrdinaryTensor.finiteMixture_posSemidef
statement: lemma finiteMixture_posSemidef : (finiteMixture (I := I) (A := A)).PosSemidef

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.OrdinaryTensor.finiteMixture_trace
statement:
lemma finiteMixture_trace [Nonempty A] (hn : 0 < Fintype.card I) :
    Matrix.trace (finiteMixture (I := I) (A := A)) = 1

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.OrdinaryTensor.histogramAmplitude_mk
statement:
lemma histogramAmplitude_mk (h : Histogram I A) (w : I → A) :
    histogramAmplitude h (histogram w) = amplitude h w

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.OrdinaryTensor.histogramWeight_mk
statement:
lemma histogramWeight_mk (r : A → ℕ) (u : I → A) :
    histogramWeight r (histogram u) = typeWeight r u

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.OrdinaryTensor.histogram_card_le
statement: lemma histogram_card_le : Fintype.card (Histogram I A) ≤ (Fintype.card I+1)^Fintype.card A

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.OrdinaryTensor.histogram_representative
statement: lemma histogram_representative (h : Histogram I A) : histogram (representative h) = h

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.OrdinaryTensor.histogram_surjective
statement: lemma histogram_surjective : Function.Surjective (histogram (I := I) (A := A))

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.OrdinaryTensor.momentFrame_eq_perm_sum
statement:
lemma momentFrame_eq_perm_sum :
    (momentFrame (I := I) (A := A)) =
      ∑ σ : Equiv.Perm I, (fun u w => if permute σ w = u then (1 : ℂ) else 0 : Matrix _ _ ℂ)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.OrdinaryTensor.orbitSize_mk
statement:
lemma orbitSize_mk (w : I → A) :
    orbitSize (histogram w) = Fintype.card {u : I → A // count u = count w}

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.OrdinaryTensor.orbitSize_pos
statement: lemma orbitSize_pos (h : Histogram I A) : 0 < orbitSize h

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.OrdinaryTensor.orbit_card_mul_factorials
statement:
lemma orbit_card_mul_factorials (u : I → A) :
    Fintype.card {w : I → A // count w = count u} * (∏ a, (count u a).factorial) =
      (Fintype.card I).factorial

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.OrdinaryTensor.outer_apply
statement: lemma outer_apply {J : Type*} (v : J → ℂ) (i j : J) : outer v i j = v i * star (v j)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.OrdinaryTensor.outer_posSemidef
statement: lemma outer_posSemidef {J : Type*} [Finite J] (v : J → ℂ) : (outer v).PosSemidef

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.OrdinaryTensor.outer_tensorVector_trace
statement:
lemma outer_tensorVector_trace (z : A → ℂ) :
    Matrix.trace (outer (tensorVector (I := I) z)) =
      (∑ a, z a * star (z a))^Fintype.card I

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.OrdinaryTensor.outer_trace_nonneg
statement: lemma outer_trace_nonneg (v : (I → A) → ℂ) : 0 ≤ Matrix.trace (outer v)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.OrdinaryTensor.permute_count
statement: lemma permute_count (σ : Equiv.Perm I) (w : I → A) : count (permute σ w) = count w

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.OrdinaryTensor.permute_mul
statement:
lemma permute_mul (σ τ : Equiv.Perm I) :
    permute (A := A) (σ*τ) = permute σ * permute τ

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.OrdinaryTensor.phaseFrame_blocks
statement:
lemma phaseFrame_blocks (h : Histogram I A) :
    phaseFrame h = ∑ k : Histogram I A, ((histogramAmplitude h k : ℂ)^2) • block k

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.OrdinaryTensor.phaseFrame_entry
statement:
lemma phaseFrame_entry (h : Histogram I A) (u w : I → A) :
    phaseFrame h u w = if count u = count w then ((amplitude h u : ℂ)^2) else 0

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.OrdinaryTensor.phaseFrame_posSemidef
statement: lemma phaseFrame_posSemidef (h : Histogram I A) : (phaseFrame h).PosSemidef

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.OrdinaryTensor.phaseFrame_sum_blocks
statement:
lemma phaseFrame_sum_blocks :
    (∑ h : Histogram I A, phaseFrame h) = ∑ k : Histogram I A,
      (∑ h : Histogram I A, (histogramAmplitude h k : ℂ)^2) • block k

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.OrdinaryTensor.phaseFrame_trace
statement:
lemma phaseFrame_trace [Nonempty A] (hn : 0 < Fintype.card I) (h : Histogram I A) :
    Matrix.trace (phaseFrame h) = 1

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.OrdinaryTensor.phaseSpace_card_pos
statement: lemma phaseSpace_card_pos : 0 < Fintype.card (PhaseSpace I A)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.OrdinaryTensor.phase_conjugate_sum
statement:
lemma phase_conjugate_sum (c d : A → ℕ) (hc : ∀ a, c a ≤ Fintype.card I)
    (hd : ∀ a, d a ≤ Fintype.card I) :
    (∑ t : PhaseSpace I A,
      (∏ a, ZMod.stdAddChar (t a * (c a : ZMod (Fintype.card I+1)))) *
        star (∏ a, ZMod.stdAddChar (t a * (d a : ZMod (Fintype.card I+1))))) =
      if c = d then (Fintype.card (PhaseSpace I A) : ℂ) else 0

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.OrdinaryTensor.prod_word_eq_counts
statement:
lemma prod_word_eq_counts {R : Type*} [CommMonoid R] (r : A → R) (w : I → A) :
    (∏ i, r (w i)) = ∏ a, r a ^ count w a

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.OrdinaryTensor.rawMixture_domination
statement:
lemma rawMixture_domination [Nonempty A] :
    (rawMixture (I := I) (A := A) - finiteMixture).PosSemidef

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.OrdinaryTensor.rawMixture_eq
statement:
lemma rawMixture_eq : rawMixture (I := I) (A := A) =
    ((Fintype.card (Histogram I A) : ℂ)*(Fintype.card (PhaseSpace I A) : ℂ)) • finiteMixture

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.OrdinaryTensor.rawMixture_posSemidef
statement: lemma rawMixture_posSemidef : (rawMixture (I := I) (A := A)).PosSemidef

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.OrdinaryTensor.sum_count
statement: lemma sum_count (w : I → A) : ∑ a, count w a = Fintype.card I

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.OrdinaryTensor.sum_histogramWeight
statement:
lemma sum_histogramWeight (r : A → ℕ) :
    (∑ h : Histogram I A, histogramWeight r h) = (∑ a, r a)^Fintype.card I

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.OrdinaryTensor.symProjector_entry
statement:
lemma symProjector_entry (u w : I → A) : symProjector u w =
    if histogram u = histogram w then (orbitSize (histogram u) : ℂ)⁻¹ else 0

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.OrdinaryTensor.symProjector_idempotent
statement: lemma symProjector_idempotent : (symProjector (I := I) (A := A)) * symProjector = symProjector

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.OrdinaryTensor.symProjector_mulVec_of_constant
statement:
lemma symProjector_mulVec_of_constant (v : (I → A) → ℂ)
    (hv : ∀ u w, count u = count w → v u = v w) :
    (symProjector (I := I) (A := A)).mulVec v = v

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.OrdinaryTensor.symProjector_posSemidef
statement: lemma symProjector_posSemidef : (symProjector (I := I) (A := A)).PosSemidef

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.OrdinaryTensor.tensorVector_empirical
statement:
lemma tensorVector_empirical (h : Histogram I A) (t : PhaseSpace I A) (w : I → A) :
    tensorVector (empiricalVector h t) w = (amplitude h w : ℂ) * wordPhase t w

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.OrdinaryTensor.typeWeight_mul_factorials
statement:
lemma typeWeight_mul_factorials (r : A → ℕ) (u : I → A) :
    typeWeight r u * (∏ a, (count u a).factorial) =
      (Fintype.card I).factorial * (∏ a, r a ^ count u a)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.OrdinaryTensor.wordPhase_eq_prod
statement:
lemma wordPhase_eq_prod (t : PhaseSpace I A) (w : I → A) :
    wordPhase t w = ∏ i, ZMod.stdAddChar (t (w i))

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.OrdinaryTensor.wordPhase_orthogonality
statement:
lemma wordPhase_orthogonality (u w : I → A) :
    (∑ t : PhaseSpace I A, wordPhase t u * star (wordPhase t w)) =
      if count u = count w then (Fintype.card (PhaseSpace I A) : ℂ) else 0

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.OrdinaryTensor.wordPhase_star_mul
statement:
lemma wordPhase_star_mul (t : PhaseSpace I A) (w : I → A) :
    wordPhase t w * star (wordPhase t w) = 1

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.FiniteAtomic.uniform_integral
statement:
lemma uniform_integral (x : I → X) (f : X → V) :
    (∫ z, f z ∂uniform x) = (Fintype.card I : ℝ)⁻¹ • ∑ i, f (x i)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.ExceptionPattern.card_le
statement: lemma card_le : Fintype.card (ExceptionPattern p l) ≤ (l+1)^((2*p)*(2*p))

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.ExceptionPattern.component_image
statement:
lemma component_image (F : ExceptionPattern p l) (A : commutant p l) (x : F.FreeWord) :
    F.component A (F.fill x) = A.val (F.fill x).1 (F.fill x).2

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.ExceptionPattern.component_inclusion
statement:
lemma component_inclusion (F : ExceptionPattern p l) (A : commutant p l) :
    F.component A = (inclusion F.embedding).mulVec (fun x => A.val (F.fill x).1 (F.fill x).2)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.ExceptionPattern.component_partialTrace
statement:
lemma component_partialTrace (F : ExceptionPattern p l) (A : commutant p l) :
    partialTrace (PositiveTensor.outer ((inclusion F.embedding).mulVec (F.purified A))) =
      partialTrace (PositiveTensor.outer (F.component A))

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.ExceptionPattern.component_square_sum
statement:
lemma component_square_sum (A : commutant p l) (q : Word p l × Word p l) :
    ∑ F : ExceptionPattern p l, F.component A q * star (F.component A q) =
      A.val q.1 q.2 * star (A.val q.1 q.2)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.ExceptionPattern.component_sum
statement:
lemma component_sum (A : commutant p l) :
    ∑ F : ExceptionPattern p l, F.component A = fun q => A.val q.1 q.2

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.ExceptionPattern.data_card_le
statement: lemma data_card_le (F : ExceptionPattern p l) : Fintype.card F.Data ≤ (l+1)^(8*p^2)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.ExceptionPattern.encode_eq_some
statement:
lemma encode_eq_some (F : ExceptionPattern p l) (a : Pair p) (i : Fin l) :
    F.encode a = some i ↔ ∃ hi : i ∈ F.sites, F.pair ⟨i,hi⟩ = a

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.ExceptionPattern.encode_injective
statement: lemma encode_injective : Function.Injective (encode (p := p) (l := l))

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.ExceptionPattern.entry_in_range
statement:
lemma entry_in_range (A : commutant p l) (u w : Word p l) (h : A.val u w ≠ 0) :
    ∃ x : (entryPattern A u w h).FreeWord, (entryPattern A u w h).fill x = (u,w)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.ExceptionPattern.extendPerm_free
statement:
lemma extendPerm_free (F : ExceptionPattern p l) (σ : Equiv.Perm F.Free) (i : F.Free) :
    F.extendPerm σ i.val = (σ i).val

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.ExceptionPattern.extendPerm_pin
statement:
lemma extendPerm_pin (F : ExceptionPattern p l) (σ : Equiv.Perm F.Free) (i : F.sites) :
    F.extendPerm σ i.val = i.val

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.ExceptionPattern.fillPair_at_free
statement:
lemma fillPair_at_free (F : ExceptionPattern p l) (x : F.FreeWord) (i : F.Free) :
    F.fillPair x i.val = (x i).val

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.ExceptionPattern.fillPair_at_pin
statement:
lemma fillPair_at_pin (F : ExceptionPattern p l) (x : F.FreeWord) (i : F.sites) :
    F.fillPair x i.val = F.pair i

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.ExceptionPattern.fill_disjoint
statement:
lemma fill_disjoint {F G : ExceptionPattern p l} (x : F.FreeWord) (y : G.FreeWord)
    (he : F.fill x = G.fill y) : F = G

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.ExceptionPattern.fill_injective
statement: lemma fill_injective (F : ExceptionPattern p l) : Function.Injective F.fill

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.ExceptionPattern.fill_mismatch_iff
statement:
lemma fill_mismatch_iff (F : ExceptionPattern p l) (x : F.FreeWord) (i : Fin l) :
    (odd ((F.fill x).1 i) ↔ ¬ odd ((F.fill x).2 i)) ↔ i ∈ F.sites

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.ExceptionPattern.fill_transport
statement:
lemma fill_transport (F : ExceptionPattern p l) (σ : Equiv.Perm F.Free) (x : F.FreeWord) :
    F.fill (fun i => x (σ⁻¹ i)) =
      (wordPerm (F.extendPerm σ) (F.fill x).1, wordPerm (F.extendPerm σ) (F.fill x).2)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.ExceptionPattern.filled_product_partialTrace
statement:
lemma filled_product_partialTrace (F : ExceptionPattern p l) (z : MatchedPair p → ℂ)
    (hz : ∑ a, z a * star (z a) = 1) :
    partialTrace (PositiveTensor.outer ((inclusion F.embedding).mulVec (OrdinaryTensor.tensorVector z))) =
      pinnedDensity F.sites (fun i => (F.pair i).1) (pairDensity z hz)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.ExceptionPattern.free_card
statement: lemma free_card (F : ExceptionPattern p l) : Fintype.card F.Free = l-F.sites.card

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.ExceptionPattern.free_card_le
statement: lemma free_card_le (F : ExceptionPattern p l) : Fintype.card F.Free ≤ l

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.ExceptionPattern.free_card_pos
statement: lemma free_card_pos (F : ExceptionPattern p l) (hl : (2*p)*(2*p) < l) : 0 < Fintype.card F.Free

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.ExceptionPattern.free_power_le
statement:
lemma free_power_le (F : ExceptionPattern p l) (s : ℕ) (hls : l ≤ s) :
    (Fintype.card F.Free+1 : ℕ)^(2*Fintype.card (MatchedPair p)) ≤ (s+1)^(8*p^2)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.ExceptionPattern.matchedPair_nonempty
statement: lemma matchedPair_nonempty (hp : 0 < p) : Nonempty (MatchedPair p)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.ExceptionPattern.mem_sites_iff
statement:
lemma mem_sites_iff (F : ExceptionPattern p l) (i : Fin l) :
    i ∈ F.sites ↔ ∃ a, F.encode a = some i

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.ExceptionPattern.pairProduct_fill
statement:
lemma pairProduct_fill (F : ExceptionPattern p l) (z : MatchedPair p → ℂ) (x : F.FreeWord) :
    F.pairProduct z (F.fill x) = OrdinaryTensor.tensorVector z x

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.ExceptionPattern.pairProduct_inclusion
statement:
lemma pairProduct_inclusion (F : ExceptionPattern p l) (z : MatchedPair p → ℂ) :
    (inclusion F.embedding).mulVec (OrdinaryTensor.tensorVector z) = F.pairProduct z

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.ExceptionPattern.pairProduct_nonzero
statement:
lemma pairProduct_nonzero (F : ExceptionPattern p l) (z : MatchedPair p → ℂ)
    (q : Word p l × Word p l) (hq : F.pairProduct z q ≠ 0) : q ∈ Set.range F.fill

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.ExceptionPattern.purified_inclusion
statement:
lemma purified_inclusion (F : ExceptionPattern p l) (A : commutant p l) :
    (inclusion F.embedding).mulVec (F.purified A) =
      fun q => regroupPhase q.1 q.2 * F.component A q

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.ExceptionPattern.purified_invariant
statement:
lemma purified_invariant (F : ExceptionPattern p l) (A : commutant p l)
    (σ : Equiv.Perm F.Free) (x : F.FreeWord) :
    F.purified A (fun i => x (σ⁻¹ i)) = F.purified A x

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.ExceptionPattern.purified_trace
statement:
lemma purified_trace (F : ExceptionPattern p l) (A : commutant p l) :
    Matrix.trace (OrdinaryTensor.outer (F.purified A)) =
      Matrix.trace (PositiveTensor.outer (F.component A))

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.ExceptionPattern.purified_trace_le
statement:
lemma purified_trace_le (F : ExceptionPattern p l) (A : commutant p l) :
    Matrix.trace (OrdinaryTensor.outer (F.purified A)) ≤ Matrix.trace (A.val*A.val.conjTranspose)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.ExceptionPattern.rawDensity_posSemidef
statement:
lemma rawDensity_posSemidef (F : ExceptionPattern p l) (s : ℕ) (hp : 0 < p) (hn : 0 < Fintype.card F.Free) :
    (F.rawDensity s hp hn).PosSemidef

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.ExceptionPattern.rawMixture_partialTrace
statement:
lemma rawMixture_partialTrace (F : ExceptionPattern p l) (hn : 0 < Fintype.card F.Free) :
    partialTrace (inclusion F.embedding *
      (OrdinaryTensor.rawMixture (I := F.Free) (A := MatchedPair p)) * (inclusion F.embedding).conjTranspose) =
      F.rawPinned hn

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.ExceptionPattern.rawPinned_absorption
statement:
lemma rawPinned_absorption (F : ExceptionPattern p l) (s : ℕ) (hp : 0 < p)
    (hps : p ≤ s) (hls : l ≤ s) (hn : 0 < Fintype.card F.Free) :
    ((((s+1 : ℝ)^(13*p^2)) : ℂ) • F.rawDensity s hp hn - F.rawPinned hn).PosSemidef

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.ExceptionPattern.rawPinned_domination
statement:
lemma rawPinned_domination (F : ExceptionPattern p l) (hp : 0 < p) (hn : 0 < Fintype.card F.Free) :
    (F.rawPinned hn - partialTrace (inclusion F.embedding *
      (OrdinaryTensor.finiteMixture (I := F.Free) (A := MatchedPair p)) * (inclusion F.embedding).conjTranspose)).PosSemidef

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.ExceptionPattern.rawPinned_posSemidef
statement:
lemma rawPinned_posSemidef (F : ExceptionPattern p l) (hn : 0 < Fintype.card F.Free) :
    (F.rawPinned hn).PosSemidef

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.ExceptionPattern.siteAmplitude_free
statement:
lemma siteAmplitude_free (F : ExceptionPattern p l) (z : MatchedPair p → ℂ) (x : F.FreeWord) (i : F.Free) :
    F.siteAmplitude z i.val ((F.fill x).1 i.val) ((F.fill x).2 i.val) = z (x i)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.ExceptionPattern.siteAmplitude_pin
statement:
lemma siteAmplitude_pin (F : ExceptionPattern p l) (z : MatchedPair p → ℂ) (x : F.FreeWord) (i : F.sites) :
    F.siteAmplitude z i.val ((F.fill x).1 i.val) ((F.fill x).2 i.val) = 1

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.ExceptionPattern.sites_card_le
statement: lemma sites_card_le (F : ExceptionPattern p l) : F.sites.card ≤ (2*p)*(2*p)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.ExceptionPattern.sum_purified_trace
statement:
lemma sum_purified_trace (A : commutant p l) :
    ∑ F : ExceptionPattern p l, Matrix.trace (OrdinaryTensor.outer (F.purified A)) =
      Matrix.trace (A.val*A.val.conjTranspose)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.basisDensity_le_one
statement: lemma basisDensity_le_one (a : Letter p) : (1-basisDensity a).PosSemidef

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.basisDensity_posSemidef
statement: lemma basisDensity_posSemidef (a : Letter p) : (basisDensity a).PosSemidef

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.basisDensity_trace
statement: lemma basisDensity_trace (a : Letter p) : Matrix.trace (basisDensity a) = 1

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.densityPower_one
statement: lemma densityPower_one (p l : ℕ) : densityPower l (1 : Matrix (Letter p) (Letter p) ℂ) = 1

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.densityPower_smul
statement:
lemma densityPower_smul {p : ℕ} (l : ℕ) (c : ℂ) (r : Matrix (Letter p) (Letter p) ℂ) :
    densityPower l (c • r) = c^l • densityPower l r

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.densityProfile_card_le
statement: lemma densityProfile_card_le (p l : ℕ) : Fintype.card (DensityProfile p l) ≤ (l+1)^(12*p^2)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.densityProfile_nonempty
statement: lemma densityProfile_nonempty (hp : 0 < p) : Nonempty (DensityProfile p l)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.density_domination_small
statement:
theorem density_domination_small (s p l : ℕ) (hp : 0 < p) (hps : p ≤ s) (hls : l ≤ s)
    (hl : l ≤ (2*p)*(2*p)) (ρ : UnitaryIrrep (Equiv.Perm (Fin l))) :
    ∃ μ : Measure (EvenDensity p), IsProbabilityMeasure μ ∧
      (((ρ.dimension : ℂ) * ((s+1 : ℕ) : ℂ)^(12*p^2)) •
        (∫ r : EvenDensity p, densityPower l r.val ∂μ) - isotypic (p := p) ρ).PosSemidef

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.depolarized_even
statement:
lemma depolarized_even (s : ℕ) (r : EvenDensity p) (i j : Letter p)
    (hij : odd i ↔ ¬ odd j) : depolarized s r i j = 0

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.depolarized_free
statement:
lemma depolarized_free (s : ℕ) (r : EvenDensity p) :
    (depolarized s r - (keep s : ℂ) • r.val).PosSemidef

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.depolarized_pin
statement:
lemma depolarized_pin (s : ℕ) (r : EvenDensity p) (a : Letter p) :
    (depolarized s r - (noise s p : ℂ) • basisDensity a).PosSemidef

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.depolarized_posSemidef
statement: lemma depolarized_posSemidef (s : ℕ) (r : EvenDensity p) : (depolarized s r).PosSemidef

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.depolarized_trace
statement: lemma depolarized_trace (s : ℕ) (hp : 0 < p) (r : EvenDensity p) : Matrix.trace (depolarized s r) = 1

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.domination_coefficient
statement:
lemma domination_coefficient (D s p : ℕ) (hD : 0 < D) :
    (Complex.ofReal (Real.exp (Real.log D+41*p^2*Real.log (s+1)))) =
      (D : ℂ)*((s+1 : ℕ) : ℂ)^(41*p^2)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.finite_uniform_domination
statement:
lemma finite_uniform_domination (s p l : ℕ) (hp : 0 < p) (hps : p ≤ s) (hls : l ≤ s)
    (hl : l ≤ (2*p)*(2*p)) (ρ : UnitaryIrrep (Equiv.Perm (Fin l))) :
    (((ρ.dimension : ℂ)*((s+1 : ℕ) : ℂ)^(12*p^2)) •
      densityPower l (uniformDensity p hp).val-isotypic (p := p) ρ).PosSemidef

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.isotypic_mem_commutant
statement:
lemma isotypic_mem_commutant {p l : ℕ} (ρ : UnitaryIrrep (Equiv.Perm (Fin l))) :
    isotypic (p := p) ρ ∈ commutant p l

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.isotypic_self_mul
statement:
lemma isotypic_self_mul {p l : ℕ} (ρ : UnitaryIrrep (Equiv.Perm (Fin l))) :
    isotypic (p := p) ρ * (isotypic (p := p) ρ).conjTranspose = isotypic (p := p) ρ

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.isotypic_trace_le
statement:
lemma isotypic_trace_le (s p l : ℕ) (hls : l ≤ s) (ρ : UnitaryIrrep (Equiv.Perm (Fin l))) :
    Matrix.trace (isotypic (p := p) ρ) ≤ (ρ.dimension : ℂ)*((s+1 : ℕ) : ℂ)^(4*p^2)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.keep_add_noise
statement: lemma keep_add_noise (s p : ℕ) (hp : 0 < p) : keep s + noise s p*(2*p) = 1

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.keep_nonneg
statement: lemma keep_nonneg (s : ℕ) : 0 ≤ keep s

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.keep_pow_lower
statement: lemma keep_pow_lower (s n : ℕ) (hn : n ≤ s) : 1 ≤ (s+1 : ℝ) * (keep s)^n

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.matchedPair_card_le
statement: lemma matchedPair_card_le (p : ℕ) : Fintype.card (MatchedPair p) ≤ (2*p)*(2*p)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.noise_nonneg
statement: lemma noise_nonneg (s p : ℕ) : 0 ≤ noise s p

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.pairAmplitude_even
statement:
lemma pairAmplitude_even {p : ℕ} (z : MatchedPair p → ℂ) (a b : Letter p)
    (hab : odd a ↔ ¬ odd b) :
    (pairAmplitude z * (pairAmplitude z).conjTranspose) a b = 0

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.pairAmplitude_unit_trace
statement:
lemma pairAmplitude_unit_trace {p : ℕ} (z : MatchedPair p → ℂ)
    (hz : ∑ a, z a * star (z a) = 1) :
    Matrix.trace (pairAmplitude z * (pairAmplitude z).conjTranspose) = 1

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.partialTrace_regroup
statement:
theorem partialTrace_regroup {p l : ℕ} (E : Finset (Fin l))
    (v : Word p l × Word p l → ℂ)
    (hv : ∀ u w, v (u,w) ≠ 0 → ∀ i,
      (odd (u i) ↔ ¬ odd (w i)) ↔ i ∈ E) :
    partialTrace (PositiveTensor.outer (fun uw => regroupPhase uw.1 uw.2 * v uw)) =
      partialTrace (PositiveTensor.outer v)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.pinAmplitude_density
statement: lemma pinAmplitude_density (a : Pair p) : pinAmplitude a * (pinAmplitude a).conjTranspose = basisDensity a.1

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.pin_coefficient_le
statement:
lemma pin_coefficient_le (s p k : ℕ) (hp : 0 < p) (hps : p ≤ s)
    (hk : k ≤ (2*p)*(2*p)) :
    (s+1 : ℝ) * ((s+1 : ℝ)*(2*p))^k ≤ (s+1 : ℝ)^(13*p^2)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.pinnedDensity_posSemidef
statement:
lemma pinnedDensity_posSemidef (E : Finset (Fin l)) (a : E → Letter p) (r : EvenDensity p) :
    (pinnedDensity E a r).PosSemidef

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.pinned_absorption
statement:
theorem pinned_absorption (s : ℕ) (hp : 0 < p) (hls : l ≤ s)
    (E : Finset (Fin l)) (a : E → Letter p) (r : EvenDensity p) :
    (((s+1 : ℝ) * ((s+1 : ℝ)*(2*p))^E.card : ℝ) : ℂ) •
      densityPower l (depolarized s r) - pinnedDensity E a r |>.PosSemidef

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.pinned_absorption_uniform
statement:
theorem pinned_absorption_uniform (s : ℕ) (hp : 0 < p) (hps : p ≤ s) (hls : l ≤ s)
    (E : Finset (Fin l)) (hE : E.card ≤ (2*p)*(2*p)) (a : E → Letter p) (r : EvenDensity p) :
    ((((s+1 : ℝ)^(13*p^2)) : ℂ) • densityPower l (depolarized s r) - pinnedDensity E a r).PosSemidef

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.rawProfileDensity_eq
statement:
lemma rawProfileDensity_eq (s p l : ℕ) (hp : 0 < p) (hl : (2*p)*(2*p) < l) :
    rawProfileDensity s p l hp hl = ∑ F : ExceptionPattern p l, F.rawDensity s hp (F.free_card_pos hl)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.rawProfileDensity_posSemidef
statement:
lemma rawProfileDensity_posSemidef (s p l : ℕ) (hp : 0 < p) (hl : (2*p)*(2*p) < l) :
    (rawProfileDensity s p l hp hl).PosSemidef

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.small_power_le
statement:
lemma small_power_le (s p l : ℕ) (hps : p ≤ s) (hl : l ≤ (2*p)*(2*p)) :
    (2*p)^l ≤ (s+1)^(8*p^2)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.uniformDensity_power
statement:
lemma uniformDensity_power (p l : ℕ) (hp : 0 < p) :
    densityPower l (uniformDensity p hp).val = (((2*p : ℕ) : ℂ)^l)⁻¹ • 1

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.FiberBlocks.action_apply
statement:
lemma action_apply (σ : ∀ i, Equiv.Perm (Fin (size f i))) (i : Fin r) (j : Fin (size f i)) :
    action f σ (cards f i j).val=(cards f i (σ i j)).val

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.FiberBlocks.action_restrict
statement:
lemma action_restrict (σ : Equiv.Perm L) (hσ : ∀ x, f (σ x)=f x) :
    action f (restrict f σ hσ)=σ

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.FiberBlocks.ambient_action
statement:
lemma ambient_action (e : Fin (Fintype.card L) ≃ L)
    (σ : ∀ i, Equiv.Perm (Fin (size f i))) :
    Equiv.permCongr e.symm (action f σ)=
      regroup f e*Equiv.permCongr (finCongr (total f)) (perm (size f) σ)*(regroup f e)⁻¹

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.FiberBlocks.label_regroup
statement:
lemma label_regroup (e : Fin (Fintype.card L) ≃ L) (k : Fin (Fintype.card L)) :
    ((positions (size f)).symm ((finCongr (total f)).symm ((regroup f e)⁻¹ k))).1=f (e k)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.FiberBlocks.label_slots
statement:
lemma label_slots (k : Fin (∑ i, size f i)) :
    f (slots f k)=((positions (size f)).symm k).1

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.FiberBlocks.restrict_apply
statement:
lemma restrict_apply (σ : Equiv.Perm L) (hσ : ∀ x, f (σ x)=f x)
    (i : Fin r) (j : Fin (size f i)) :
    (cards f i (restrict f σ hσ i j)).val=σ (cards f i j).val

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.FiberBlocks.slots_positions
statement:
lemma slots_positions (i : Fin r) (j : Fin (size f i)) :
    slots f (positions (size f) ⟨i,j⟩)=(cards f i j).val

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.FiberBlocks.total
statement: lemma total : ∑ i, size f i=Fintype.card L
