name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.OrderedBlocks.encode_injective
statement: lemma encode_injective : Function.Injective (encode n)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.OrderedBlocks.encode_lt_of_block
statement:
lemma encode_lt_of_block {i j : Fin r} (hij : i < j) (a : Fin (n i)) (b : Fin (n j)) :

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.OrderedBlocks.encode_lt_same
statement:
lemma encode_lt_same {i : Fin r} (a b : Fin (n i)) :
    encode n ⟨i,a⟩ < encode n ⟨i,b⟩ ↔ a < b

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.OrderedBlocks.offset_next_le
statement: lemma offset_next_le (i j : Fin r) (hij : i < j) : offset n i+n i ≤ offset n j

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.OrderedBlocks.offset_next_le_total
statement: lemma offset_next_le_total (i : Fin r) : offset n i+n i ≤ ∑ j, n j

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.OrderedBlocks.perm_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma perm_apply (σ : ∀ i, Equiv.Perm (Fin (n i))) (i : Fin r) (j : Fin (n i)) :
    perm n σ (positions n ⟨i,j⟩)=positions n ⟨i,σ i j⟩

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.OrderedBlocks.perm_inv
statement:
lemma perm_inv (σ : ∀ i, Equiv.Perm (Fin (n i))) :
    (perm n σ)⁻¹=perm n (fun i => (σ i)⁻¹)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.OrderedBlocks.positions_apply
statement: lemma positions_apply (x : (i : Fin r) × Fin (n i)) : positions n x=encode n x

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.OrderedBlocks.positions_lt_of_block
statement:
lemma positions_lt_of_block {i j : Fin r} (hij : i < j) (a : Fin (n i)) (b : Fin (n j)) :
    positions n ⟨i,a⟩ < positions n ⟨j,b⟩

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.OrderedBlocks.positions_lt_same
statement:
lemma positions_lt_same {i : Fin r} (a b : Fin (n i)) :
    positions n ⟨i,a⟩ < positions n ⟨i,b⟩ ↔ a < b

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.ambientAverage_factor
statement:
lemma ambientAverage_factor (h : (∑ i, n i)=l) (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin l))
    {Ω : Fin r → Type*} [∀ i, Fintype (Ω i)]
    (w : ∀ i, Ω i → ℂ) (g : ∀ i, Ω i → Equiv.Perm (Fin (n i))) :
    ambientAverage (p := p) n h σ w g=
      matrix σ*lengthMatrix h (groupedAverage n w g)*(matrix σ).conjTranspose

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.ambientProjectorAlgebra_lift
statement:
lemma ambientProjectorAlgebra_lift (h : (∑ i, n i)=l) (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin l))
    (ρ : ∀ i, UnitaryIrrep (Equiv.Perm (Fin (n i)))) :
    MonoidAlgebra.lift ℂ _ _ (action p l) (ambientProjectorAlgebra n h σ ρ)=
      ambientProjector (p := p) n h σ ρ

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.ambientProjector_commute_average
statement:
lemma ambientProjector_commute_average (h : (∑ i, n i)=l) (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin l))
    {Ω : Fin r → Type*} [∀ i, Fintype (Ω i)]
    (ρ : ∀ i, UnitaryIrrep (Equiv.Perm (Fin (n i))))
    (w : ∀ i, Ω i → ℂ) (g : ∀ i, Ω i → Equiv.Perm (Fin (n i))) :
    ambientProjector (p := p) n h σ ρ*ambientAverage n h σ w g=
      ambientAverage n h σ w g*ambientProjector n h σ ρ

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.ambientProjector_idempotent
statement:
lemma ambientProjector_idempotent (h : (∑ i, n i)=l) (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin l))
    (ρ : ∀ i, UnitaryIrrep (Equiv.Perm (Fin (n i)))) :
    ambientProjector (p := p) n h σ ρ*ambientProjector n h σ ρ=ambientProjector n h σ ρ

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.ambientProjector_posSemidef
statement:
lemma ambientProjector_posSemidef (h : (∑ i, n i)=l) (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin l))
    (ρ : ∀ i, UnitaryIrrep (Equiv.Perm (Fin (n i)))) :
    (ambientProjector (p := p) n h σ ρ).PosSemidef

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.ambient_projected_moment
statement:
theorem ambient_projected_moment (h : (∑ i, n i)=l) (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin l))
    {Ω : Fin r → Type*} [∀ i, Fintype (Ω i)]
    (ρ : ∀ i, UnitaryIrrep (Equiv.Perm (Fin (n i))))
    (w : ∀ i, Ω i → ℂ) (g : ∀ i, Ω i → Equiv.Perm (Fin (n i)))
    {q : ℕ} (hq : q ≠ 0) :
    Matrix.trace (((ambientProjector (p := p) n h σ ρ*ambientAverage n h σ w g).conjTranspose*
      (ambientProjector n h σ ρ*ambientAverage n h σ w g))^q)=
      ∏ i, (Module.finrank ℂ ((ρ i).asRepresentation.IntertwiningMap
        (matrixRepresentation (action p (n i)))) : ℂ)*
        Matrix.trace (((averageMatrix (ρ i).matrix (w i) (g i)).conjTranspose*
          averageMatrix (ρ i).matrix (w i) (g i))^q)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.blockPerm_inv
statement:
lemma blockPerm_inv {m n : ℕ} (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin m)) (τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) :
    (blockPerm σ τ)⁻¹=blockPerm σ⁻¹ τ⁻¹

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.blockPerm_left
statement:
@[simp] lemma blockPerm_left {m n : ℕ} (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin m)) (τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (i : Fin m) :
    blockPerm σ τ (Fin.castAdd n i)=Fin.castAdd n (σ i)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.blockPerm_right
statement:
@[simp] lemma blockPerm_right {m n : ℕ} (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin m)) (τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (i : Fin n) :
    blockPerm σ τ (Fin.natAdd m i)=Fin.natAdd m (τ i)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.conjugate_moment
statement:
lemma conjugate_moment {X : Type*} [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X]
    (U A : Matrix X X ℂ) (hU : U.conjTranspose*U=1) (hU' : U*U.conjTranspose=1) (q : ℕ) :
    Matrix.trace (((U*A*U.conjTranspose).conjTranspose*(U*A*U.conjTranspose))^q)=
      Matrix.trace ((A.conjTranspose*A)^q)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.conjugate_mul
statement:
lemma conjugate_mul {X : Type*} [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X]
    (U A B : Matrix X X ℂ) (hU : U.conjTranspose*U=1) :
    (U*A*U.conjTranspose)*(U*B*U.conjTranspose)=U*(A*B)*U.conjTranspose

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.conjugate_pow
statement:
lemma conjugate_pow {X : Type*} [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X]
    (U A : Matrix X X ℂ) (hU : U.conjTranspose*U=1) (hU' : U*U.conjTranspose=1) (q : ℕ) :
    (U*A*U.conjTranspose)^q=U*A^q*U.conjTranspose

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.densityPower_commute_lift
statement:
lemma densityPower_commute_lift {l : ℕ} (r : Matrix (Letter p) (Letter p) ℂ)
    (hr : IsEven r) (x : MonoidAlgebra ℂ (Equiv.Perm (Fin l))) :
    (MonoidAlgebra.lift ℂ _ _ (action p l) x)*densityPower l r =
      densityPower l r*(MonoidAlgebra.lift ℂ _ _ (action p l) x)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.densityPower_commute_of_even
statement:
lemma densityPower_commute_of_even {l : ℕ} (r : Matrix (Letter p) (Letter p) ℂ)
    (hr : IsEven r) (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin l)) :
    matrix σ*densityPower l r=densityPower l r*matrix σ

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.exists_even_whitening
statement:
theorem exists_even_whitening {R : Type*} [Fintype R] [Nonempty R]
    (r : R → EvenDensity p) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    let B := (Fintype.card R : ℂ)⁻¹ • ∑ i, (r i).val + (ε : ℂ) • (1 : Matrix (Letter p) (Letter p) ℂ)
    ∃ A : Matrix (Letter p) (Letter p) ℂ, A.PosSemidef ∧ IsEven A ∧ A*B*A=1 ∧
      ((Fintype.card R : ℂ) • (1 : Matrix (Letter p) (Letter p) ℂ)-
        ∑ i, A*(r i).val*A).PosSemidef

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.fiberProjectorAlgebra_lift
statement:
lemma fiberProjectorAlgebra_lift (e : Fin (Fintype.card L) ≃ L)
    (ρ : ∀ i, UnitaryIrrep (Equiv.Perm (Fin (FiberBlocks.size f i)))) :
    MonoidAlgebra.lift ℂ _ _ (action p (Fintype.card L)) (fiberProjectorAlgebra f e ρ)=
      fiberProjector (p := p) f e ρ

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.fiberProjector_idempotent
statement:
lemma fiberProjector_idempotent (e : Fin (Fintype.card L) ≃ L)
    (ρ : ∀ i, UnitaryIrrep (Equiv.Perm (Fin (FiberBlocks.size f i)))) :
    fiberProjector (p := p) f e ρ*fiberProjector f e ρ=fiberProjector f e ρ

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.fiberProjector_posSemidef
statement:
lemma fiberProjector_posSemidef (e : Fin (Fintype.card L) ≃ L)
    (ρ : ∀ i, UnitaryIrrep (Equiv.Perm (Fin (FiberBlocks.size f i)))) :
    (fiberProjector (p := p) f e ρ).PosSemidef

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.groupWord_wordPerm
statement:
lemma groupWord_wordPerm (σ : ∀ i, Equiv.Perm (Fin (n i))) (w : Word p (∑ i, n i)) :
    groupWord n p (wordPerm (perm n σ) w)=fun i => wordPerm (σ i) (groupWord n p w i)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.groupedAverage_factor
statement:
lemma groupedAverage_factor {Ω : Fin r → Type*} [∀ i, Fintype (Ω i)]
    (w : ∀ i, Ω i → ℂ) (g : ∀ i, Ω i → Equiv.Perm (Fin (n i))) :
    groupedAverage (p := p) n w g=
      Matrix.reindex (groupWord n p).symm (groupWord n p).symm
        (DependentTensor.tensor (fun i => averageMatrix (action p (n i)) (w i) (g i)))

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.groupedProjector_commute_average
statement:
lemma groupedProjector_commute_average {Ω : Fin r → Type*} [∀ i, Fintype (Ω i)]
    (ρ : ∀ i, UnitaryIrrep (Equiv.Perm (Fin (n i))))
    (w : ∀ i, Ω i → ℂ) (g : ∀ i, Ω i → Equiv.Perm (Fin (n i))) :
    groupedProjector (p := p) n ρ*groupedAverage n w g=groupedAverage n w g*groupedProjector n ρ

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.groupedProjector_factor
statement:
lemma groupedProjector_factor (ρ : ∀ i, UnitaryIrrep (Equiv.Perm (Fin (n i)))) :
    groupedProjector (p := p) n ρ=
      Matrix.reindex (groupWord n p).symm (groupWord n p).symm
        (DependentTensor.tensor (fun i => (ρ i).projector (action p (n i))))

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.groupedProjector_idempotent
statement:
lemma groupedProjector_idempotent (ρ : ∀ i, UnitaryIrrep (Equiv.Perm (Fin (n i)))) :
    groupedProjector (p := p) n ρ*groupedProjector n ρ=groupedProjector n ρ

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.groupedProjector_posSemidef
statement:
lemma groupedProjector_posSemidef (ρ : ∀ i, UnitaryIrrep (Equiv.Perm (Fin (n i)))) :
    (groupedProjector (p := p) n ρ).PosSemidef

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.grouped_densityPower
statement:
lemma grouped_densityPower (a : Fin r → EvenDensity p) :
    (DependentTensor.tensor (fun i => densityPower (n i) (a i).val)).submatrix
      (groupWord n p) (groupWord n p)=TensorBoard.tensor (fun k => (groupedSite n a k).val)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.grouped_projected_moment
statement:
theorem grouped_projected_moment {Ω : Fin r → Type*} [∀ i, Fintype (Ω i)]
    (ρ : ∀ i, UnitaryIrrep (Equiv.Perm (Fin (n i))))
    (w : ∀ i, Ω i → ℂ) (g : ∀ i, Ω i → Equiv.Perm (Fin (n i)))
    {q : ℕ} (hq : q ≠ 0) :
    Matrix.trace (((groupedProjector (p := p) n ρ*groupedAverage n w g).conjTranspose*
      (groupedProjector n ρ*groupedAverage n w g))^q)=
      ∏ i, (Module.finrank ℂ ((ρ i).asRepresentation.IntertwiningMap
        (matrixRepresentation (action p (n i)))) : ℂ)*
        Matrix.trace (((averageMatrix (ρ i).matrix (w i) (g i)).conjTranspose*
          averageMatrix (ρ i).matrix (w i) (g i))^q)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.isEven_add
statement:
lemma isEven_add {A B : Matrix (Letter p) (Letter p) ℂ} (hA : IsEven A) (hB : IsEven B) :
    IsEven (A+B)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.isEven_iff_commute
statement:
lemma isEven_iff_commute (A : Matrix (Letter p) (Letter p) ℂ) :
    IsEven A ↔ Commute A (grading p)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.isEven_one
statement: lemma isEven_one : IsEven (1 : Matrix (Letter p) (Letter p) ℂ)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.isEven_smul
statement:
lemma isEven_smul (c : ℂ) {A : Matrix (Letter p) (Letter p) ℂ} (hA : IsEven A) :
    IsEven (c • A)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.isEven_sum
statement:
lemma isEven_sum {I : Type*} [Fintype I] (A : I → Matrix (Letter p) (Letter p) ℂ)
    (hA : ∀ i, IsEven (A i)) : IsEven (∑ i, A i)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.matrix_blockPerm
statement:
theorem matrix_blockPerm {p m n : ℕ} (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin m)) (τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) :
    matrix (p := p) (blockPerm σ τ)=blockMatrix (matrix σ) (matrix τ)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.matrix_grouped
statement:
theorem matrix_grouped (σ : ∀ i, Equiv.Perm (Fin (n i))) :
    matrix (p := p) (perm n σ)=
      Matrix.reindex (groupWord n p).symm (groupWord n p).symm
        (DependentTensor.tensor (fun i => matrix (σ i)))

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.matrix_trace_reindex
statement:
lemma matrix_trace_reindex {X Y : Type*} [Fintype X] [Fintype Y] (e : X ≃ Y)
    (A : Matrix X X ℂ) : Matrix.trace (Matrix.reindex e e A)=Matrix.trace A

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.matrix_unitary_reverse
statement:
lemma matrix_unitary_reverse (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin l)) :
    matrix (p := p) σ*(matrix σ).conjTranspose=1

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.phase_blockPerm
statement:
lemma phase_blockPerm {p m n : ℕ} (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin m)) (τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n))
    (w : Word p (m+n)) :
    phase (blockPerm σ τ) w=phase σ (fun i => w (Fin.castAdd n i))*
      phase τ (fun i => w (Fin.natAdd m i))

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.phase_double_prod
statement:
lemma phase_double_prod {p l : ℕ} (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin l)) (w : Word p l) :
    phase σ w=∏ i : Fin l, ∏ j : Fin l,
      if j < i ∧ odd (w i) ∧ odd (w j) ∧ σ i < σ j then (-1 : ℂ) else 1

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.phase_grouped
statement:
lemma phase_grouped (σ : ∀ i, Equiv.Perm (Fin (n i))) (w : Word p (∑ i, n i)) :
    phase (perm n σ) w=∏ i, phase (σ i) (fun j => w (positions n ⟨i,j⟩))

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.prod_positions
statement:
lemma prod_positions (f : Fin (∑ i, n i) → ℂ) :
    ∏ x, f x=∏ i, ∏ j : Fin (n i), f (positions n ⟨i,j⟩)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.reindex_moment
statement:
lemma reindex_moment {X Y : Type*} [Fintype X] [Fintype Y] [DecidableEq X] [DecidableEq Y]
    (e : X ≃ Y) (A : Matrix X X ℂ) (q : ℕ) :
    Matrix.trace ((((Matrix.reindexAlgEquiv ℂ ℂ e A).conjTranspose)*(Matrix.reindexAlgEquiv ℂ ℂ e A))^q)=
      Matrix.trace ((A.conjTranspose*A)^q)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.splitWord_wordPerm
statement:
lemma splitWord_wordPerm {p m n : ℕ} (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin m)) (τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n))
    (w : Word p (m+n)) :
    splitWord p m n (wordPerm (blockPerm σ τ) w)=
      (wordPerm σ (splitWord p m n w).1,wordPerm τ (splitWord p m n w).2)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.tensor_covariance
statement:
lemma tensor_covariance (A : Fin l → Matrix (Letter p) (Letter p) ℂ)
    (hA : ∀ i, IsEven (A i)) (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin l)) :
    matrix σ*TensorBoard.tensor A=
      TensorBoard.tensor (fun i => A (σ⁻¹ i))*matrix σ

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.tensor_signed_conjugate
statement:
lemma tensor_signed_conjugate (A : Fin l → Matrix (Letter p) (Letter p) ℂ)
    (hA : ∀ i, IsEven (A i)) (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin l)) :

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.averageWithReference_moment
statement:
theorem averageWithReference_moment (hf : H.Feasible)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.columnResidual_split
statement:
lemma columnResidual_split (hf : H.Feasible) (ω : H.ColumnChoices) (x : (concat A B).Slot) :

      ((splitSlots A B x).1,(B.sweep ((H.refPair hf).2 (splitSlots A B x).1).val)⁻¹

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.column_size_le
statement: lemma column_size_le (i : Fin (Fintype.card A.Slot)) : FiberBlocks.size H.columnIndex i ≤ B.size

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.conditionalAverage_eq_junction
statement:
theorem conditionalAverage_eq_junction (hf : H.Feasible) (z : ℝ)
    (ρ : UnitaryIrrep H.stabilizer) :
    H.conditionalAverage hf z ρ=H.columnAverage hf z (H.junctionIrrep hf ρ).matrix*
      H.rowAverage hf z (H.junctionIrrep hf ρ).matrix

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.junctionTime
statement: lemma junctionTime : prefixTime A B (Fin.last A.b)=suffixTime A B 0

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.residualWithReference_eq
statement:
lemma residualWithReference_eq (hf : H.Feasible)

    H.residualWithReference ω0 ω=H.residualWithReference ω0 ⟨H.reference hf,H.reference_compatible hf⟩*

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.rowResidual_split
statement:
lemma rowResidual_split (hf : H.Feasible) (ω : H.RowChoices) (x : (concat A B).Slot) :
    splitSlots A B ((H.rowResidual hf ω).val x)=
      (A.sweep (ω (splitSlots A B x).2).val
        ((A.sweep ((H.refPair hf).1 (splitSlots A B x).2).val)⁻¹ (splitSlots A B x).1),
       (splitSlots A B x).2)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.row_size_le
statement: lemma row_size_le (i : Fin (Fintype.card B.Slot)) : FiberBlocks.size H.rowIndex i ≤ A.size

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.columnSweep_inv_apply
statement:
lemma columnSweep_inv_apply (A B : Grid) (ω : A.Slot → B.Choices) (x : (concat A B).Slot) :
    splitSlots A B ((columnSweep A B ω)⁻¹ x)=
      ((splitSlots A B x).1,(B.sweep (ω (splitSlots A B x).1))⁻¹ (splitSlots A B x).2)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.rowSweep_inv_apply
statement:
lemma rowSweep_inv_apply (A B : Grid) (ω : B.Slot → A.Choices) (x : (concat A B).Slot) :
    splitSlots A B ((rowSweep A B ω)⁻¹ x)=
      ((A.sweep (ω (splitSlots A B x).2))⁻¹ (splitSlots A B x).1,(splitSlots A B x).2)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.evenTrace_real
statement:
lemma evenTrace_real {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (K : Matrix n n ℂ) (q : ℕ) :
    Matrix.trace ((K.conjTranspose*K)^q)=((Matrix.trace ((K.conjTranspose*K)^q)).re : ℂ)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.schattenMoment_unitary_left
statement:
lemma schattenMoment_unitary_left {d : ℕ} (q : ℕ) (A U : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ)
    (hU : U.conjTranspose*U=1) : schattenMoment q (U*A)=schattenMoment q A

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Overlap.finite_mixture_overlap
statement:
theorem finite_mixture_overlap (R Q P : Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hR : R.IsHermitian) (hR2 : R*R=R) (hQ : Q.IsHermitian) (hQ2 : Q*Q=Q)
    (hP : P.IsHermitian) (hP2 : P*P=P) (hPQ : P*Q=Q*P)
    (u : I → ℝ) (v : J → ℝ) (hu : ∀ i, 0 ≤ u i) (hv : ∀ j, 0 ≤ v j)
    (hsu : ∑ i, u i=1) (hsv : ∑ j, v j=1)
    (U : I → Matrix n n ℂ) (V : J → Matrix n n ℂ) (A : I → Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hU : ∀ i, (U i).PosSemidef) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian)
    (cr cc D t E : ℝ) (hcr : 0 ≤ cr) (hcc : 0 ≤ cc) (hD : 0 ≤ D) (ht : 0 ≤ t)
    (hrow : ((cr : ℂ) • (∑ i, (u i : ℂ) • U i)-R).PosSemidef)
    (hcol : ((cc : ℂ) • (∑ j, (v j : ℂ) • V j)-Q).PosSemidef)
    (hwhite : ∀ i, ((t : ℂ) • (A i*Q*A i)-(D : ℂ) • (Q*P)).PosSemidef)
    (hpair : ∀ i j, (Matrix.trace (A i*U i*A i*V j)).re ≤ E) :
    D*‖Q*P*R‖^2 ≤ cr*cc*t*E

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Overlap.norm_le_trace
statement: lemma norm_le_trace (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (hA : A.PosSemidef) : ‖A‖ ≤ (Matrix.trace A).re

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Overlap.norm_sq_le_trace
statement:
lemma norm_sq_le_trace (A : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    ‖A‖^2 ≤ (Matrix.trace (A.conjTranspose*A)).re

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Overlap.overlap_norm_sq_le_trace
statement:
lemma overlap_norm_sq_le_trace (R Q P : Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hR : R.IsHermitian) (hR2 : R*R=R) (hQ : Q.IsHermitian) (hQ2 : Q*Q=Q)
    (hP : P.IsHermitian) (hP2 : P*P=P) (hPQ : P*Q=Q*P) :
    ‖Q*P*R‖^2 ≤ (Matrix.trace (R*(Q*P))).re

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Overlap.projection_product_posSemidef
statement:
lemma projection_product_posSemidef (P Q : Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hP : P.IsHermitian) (hP2 : P*P=P) (hQ : Q.PosSemidef) (hPQ : P*Q=Q*P) :
    (P*Q).PosSemidef

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Overlap.trace_four_swap
statement:
lemma trace_four_swap (A Q U : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    Matrix.trace (A*Q*A*U)=Matrix.trace (A*U*A*Q)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Overlap.trace_mixture_re
statement:
lemma trace_mixture_re (w : I → ℝ) (U : I → Matrix n n ℂ) (W : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    (Matrix.trace ((∑ i, (w i : ℂ) • U i)*W)).re = ∑ i, w i*(Matrix.trace (U i*W)).re

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Overlap.trace_smul_re
statement:
lemma trace_smul_re (t : ℝ) (W : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    (Matrix.trace ((t : ℂ) • W)).re=t*(Matrix.trace W).re

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Overlap.whitened_projector_domination
statement:
lemma whitened_projector_domination (ρ : UnitaryIrrep Γ) (τ : Γ →* Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hu : ∀ g, (τ g).conjTranspose=τ g⁻¹)
    (T A Q : Matrix n n ℂ) (hT : T.PosSemidef)
    (hcomm : ∀ g, τ g*T=T*τ g) (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (hATA : A*T*A=1) (hAP : A*ρ.projector τ=ρ.projector τ*A)
    (hAQ : A*Q=Q*A) (hQ : Q.IsHermitian) (hQ2 : Q*Q=Q)
    (hPQ : ρ.projector τ*Q= Q*ρ.projector τ) :
    (Matrix.trace T • (A*Q*A) - (ρ.dimension : ℂ) • (Q*ρ.projector τ)).PosSemidef

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SpectralBlock.dimension_mul_eigenvalue_le_trace
statement:
lemma dimension_mul_eigenvalue_le_trace (ρ : UnitaryIrrep Γ) (τ : Γ →* Matrix n n ℂ)
    (r : n → ℝ) (hr : ∀ i, 0 ≤ r i)
    (hτ : ∀ g, τ g * Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (r i : ℂ)) =
      Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (r i : ℂ)) * τ g)
    (hP : ρ.projector τ * Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (r i : ℂ)) = Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (r i : ℂ)))
    (i : n) : (ρ.dimension : ℝ)*r i ≤ ∑ j, r j

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SpectralBlock.level_card_le_trace
statement:
lemma level_card_le_trace (r : n → ℝ) (hr : ∀ i, 0 ≤ r i) (v : ℝ) :
    Fintype.card (Level r v) * v ≤ ∑ i, r i

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SpectralBlock.mul_restrict
statement:
lemma mul_restrict (r : n → ℝ) (v : ℝ) (A B : Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hA : ∀ i j, r i ≠ r j → A i j=0) :
    (A*B).submatrix (Subtype.val : Level r v → n) (Subtype.val : Level r v → n) =
      A.submatrix (Subtype.val : Level r v → n) (Subtype.val : Level r v → n) * B.submatrix (Subtype.val : Level r v → n) (Subtype.val : Level r v → n)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SpectralBlock.offDiagonal_zero
statement:
lemma offDiagonal_zero (τ : Γ →* Matrix n n ℂ) (r : n → ℝ)
    (hτ : ∀ g, τ g * Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (r i : ℂ)) =
      Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (r i : ℂ)) * τ g) :
    ∀ g i j, r i ≠ r j → τ g i j=0

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SpectralBlock.projector_on_level
statement:
lemma projector_on_level (P : Matrix n n ℂ) (r : n → ℝ) (v : ℝ) (hv : v ≠ 0)
    (hP : P * Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (r i : ℂ)) = Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (r i : ℂ))) :
    P.submatrix (Subtype.val : Level r v → n) (Subtype.val : Level r v → n) = 1

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SpectralBlock.projector_representation
statement:
lemma projector_representation (ρ : UnitaryIrrep Γ) (τ : Γ →* Matrix n n ℂ)
    (r : n → ℝ) (v : ℝ) (hτ : ∀ g i j, r i ≠ r j → τ g i j=0) :
    ρ.projector (representation τ r v hτ) =
      (ρ.projector τ).submatrix (Subtype.val : Level r v → n) (Subtype.val : Level r v → n)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.UnitaryIrrep.dimension_le_of_projector_one
statement:
lemma dimension_le_of_projector_one (ρ : UnitaryIrrep Γ) (τ : Γ →* Matrix n n ℂ)
    [Nonempty n] (h : ρ.projector τ = 1) : ρ.dimension ≤ Fintype.card n

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.UnitaryIrrep.invariant_projector_trace_domination
statement:
theorem invariant_projector_trace_domination (ρ : UnitaryIrrep Γ) (τ : Γ →* Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hu : ∀ g, (τ g).conjTranspose=τ g⁻¹) (T : Matrix n n ℂ) (hT : T.PosSemidef)
    (hcomm : ∀ g, τ g*T=T*τ g) :
    (Matrix.trace T • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) - (ρ.dimension : ℂ) •
      (ρ.projector τ * T * ρ.projector τ)).PosSemidef

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.UnitaryIrrep.projector_map
statement:
lemma projector_map (ρ : UnitaryIrrep Γ) {m : Type*} [Fintype m] [DecidableEq m]
    (e : Matrix n n ℂ →ₐ[ℂ] Matrix m m ℂ) (τ : Γ →* Matrix n n ℂ) :
    ρ.projector (e.toMonoidHom.comp τ) = e (ρ.projector τ)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.UnitaryIrrep.projector_trace
statement:
lemma projector_trace (ρ : UnitaryIrrep Γ) (τ : Γ →* Matrix n n ℂ) :
    Matrix.trace (ρ.projector τ) = (ρ.dimension : ℂ) *
      Module.finrank ℂ (ρ.asRepresentation.IntertwiningMap (matrixRepresentation τ))

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.UnitaryIrrep.supported_trace_domination
statement:
theorem supported_trace_domination (ρ : UnitaryIrrep Γ) (τ : Γ →* Matrix n n ℂ)
    (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (hA : A.PosSemidef)
    (hcomm : ∀ g, τ g * A = A * τ g) (hP : ρ.projector τ * A = A) :
    (Matrix.trace A • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) - (ρ.dimension : ℂ) • A).PosSemidef

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.densityPower_commute_projector
statement:
lemma densityPower_commute_projector {p l : ℕ} (r : Matrix (Letter p) (Letter p) ℂ)
    (hr : IsEven r) (ρ : UnitaryIrrep (Equiv.Perm (Fin l))) :
    densityPower l r*ρ.projector (action p l)=ρ.projector (action p l)*densityPower l r

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.even_average_trace
statement:
lemma even_average_trace {R : Type*} [Fintype R] [Nonempty R] {p : ℕ}
    (r : R → EvenDensity p) (ε : ℝ) :
    Matrix.trace ((Fintype.card R : ℂ)⁻¹ • (∑ i, (r i).val)+
      (ε : ℂ) • (1 : Matrix (Letter p) (Letter p) ℂ)) = 1+ε*(2*p)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.UnitaryIrrep.projector_commute_lift
statement:
lemma projector_commute_lift (ρ : UnitaryIrrep Γ) (τ : Γ →* Matrix n n ℂ)
    (x : MonoidAlgebra ℂ Γ) :
    ρ.projector τ*MonoidAlgebra.lift ℂ _ _ τ x=MonoidAlgebra.lift ℂ _ _ τ x*ρ.projector τ

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.CharacterCount.card_le_of_classifier
statement:
theorem card_le_of_classifier [Fintype I] {C : Type*} [Fintype C]
    (classifier : G → C)
    (hclass : ∀ i g h, classifier g=classifier h → (τ i).character g=(τ i).character h)
    (hne : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → IsEmpty (Representation.Equiv (τ i) (τ j))) :
    Fintype.card I ≤ Fintype.card C

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.CharacterCount.characters_independent
statement:
lemma characters_independent
    (hne : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → IsEmpty (Representation.Equiv (τ i) (τ j))) :

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.CharacterCount.complete_of_classifier
statement:
theorem complete_of_classifier (classifier : G → C)
    (hτ : ∀ i g h, classifier g=classifier h → (τ i).character g=(τ i).character h)
    (hne : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → IsEmpty (Representation.Equiv (τ i) (τ j)))
    {W : Type w} [AddCommGroup W] [Module ℂ W] [FiniteDimensional ℂ W]
    (σ : Representation ℂ G W) [σ.IsIrreducible]
    (hσ : ∀ g h, classifier g=classifier h → σ.character g=σ.character h) :
    ∃ i, Nonempty (Representation.Equiv (τ i) σ)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.CharacterCount.permutation_character_factors
statement:
lemma permutation_character_factors {X V : Type*} [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X]

    (g h : Equiv.Perm X) (he : g.partition=h.partition) : τ.character g=τ.character h

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.RepDetection.exists_cross_nonzero
statement:
theorem exists_cross_nonzero (τ : Representation ℂ G V) [τ.IsIrreducible]

    ∃ g, P * τ g * Q ≠ 0

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.RepDetection.exists_irreducible_detecting
statement:
theorem exists_irreducible_detecting (τ : Representation ℂ G V)
    (A : Module.End ℂ V) (hA : A ≠ 0) :
    ∃ S : Subrepresentation τ, S.toRepresentation.IsIrreducible ∧
      ∃ v : S.toSubmodule, A v ≠ 0

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.RepDetection.subrep_bot
statement:
@[simp] lemma subrep_bot (τ : Representation ℂ G V) :

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.RepDetection.subrep_top
statement:
@[simp] lemma subrep_top (τ : Representation ℂ G V) :

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.YoungCorner.alternatingSum_left
statement:
lemma alternatingSum_left (f : X → ℕ) (ρ : Equiv.Perm X →* A)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.YoungCorner.alternatingSum_subrepresentation

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.YoungCorner.card_boxes_eq_rowLens_sum
statement:
lemma card_boxes_eq_rowLens_sum (μ : YoungDiagram) :
    Fintype.card (Boxes μ)=μ.rowLens.sum

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.YoungCorner.card_column_prefix
statement:
lemma card_column_prefix (μ : YoungDiagram) (t j : ℕ) :
    ((rowPrefix μ t).filter (fun x => x.val.2=j)).card=min t (μ.colLen j)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.YoungCorner.card_diagramOfPartition
statement:
lemma card_diagramOfPartition {n : ℕ} (p : Nat.Partition n) :

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.YoungCorner.card_row
statement:

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.YoungCorner.card_source_column_le
statement:
lemma card_source_column_le (μ ν : YoungDiagram) (e : Boxes μ ≃ Boxes ν)
    (hnc : ∀ x y, x.val.1=y.val.1 → (e x).val.2=(e y).val.2 → x=y) (t j : ℕ) :
    ((rowPrefix μ t).filter (fun x => (e x).val.2=j)).card ≤ min t (ν.colLen j)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.YoungCorner.col_lt
statement: lemma col_lt (μ : YoungDiagram) (x : Boxes μ) : x.val.2 < μ.rowLen x.val.1

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.YoungCorner.colored_corner_zero
statement:
lemma colored_corner_zero (f g : X → ℕ) (ρ : Equiv.Perm X →* A)
    (σ : Equiv.Perm X) (x y : X) (hxy : x ≠ y)
    (hrow : f x=f y) (hcol : g (σ⁻¹ x)=g (σ⁻¹ y)) :
    fixedSum f ρ * ρ σ * alternatingSum g ρ=0

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.YoungCorner.cross_dominance
statement:
lemma cross_dominance (μ ν : YoungDiagram) (t : X ≃ Boxes μ) (u : X ≃ Boxes ν)
    (τ : Representation ℂ (Equiv.Perm X) V) [τ.IsIrreducible]
    (hP : fixedSum (rowColor t) τ ≠ 0) (hQ : alternatingSum (colColor u) τ ≠ 0) (k : ℕ) :
    (rowPrefix μ k).card≤(rowPrefix ν k).card

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.YoungCorner.diagramOfPartition_injective
statement: lemma diagramOfPartition_injective {n : ℕ} : Function.Injective (@diagramOfPartition n)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.YoungCorner.diagramOfPartition_rowLens

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.YoungCorner.eq_of_prefix_dominance

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.YoungCorner.equiv_of_same_shape
statement:
theorem equiv_of_same_shape {V W : Type} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V]
    [FiniteDimensional ℂ V] [AddCommGroup W] [Module ℂ W] [FiniteDimensional ℂ W]
    (τ : Representation ℂ (Equiv.Perm X) V) (σ : Representation ℂ (Equiv.Perm X) W)
    [τ.IsIrreducible] [σ.IsIrreducible]

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.YoungCorner.exists_partitionShape

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.YoungCorner.exists_shape_constituent

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.YoungCorner.factor_column_row

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.YoungCorner.fixedSum_right

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.YoungCorner.fixedSum_subrepresentation

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.YoungCorner.hasShape_equiv

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.YoungCorner.partitionRep_complete
statement:
theorem partitionRep_complete {V : Type} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V] [FiniteDimensional ℂ V]
    (τ : Representation ℂ (Equiv.Perm X) V) [τ.IsIrreducible] :

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.YoungCorner.partitionRep_hasShape
statement:
lemma partitionRep_hasShape (p : Nat.Partition (Fintype.card X)) :
    hasShape (diagramOfPartition p) (partitionFilling p (X := X)) (partitionRep p (X := X))

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.YoungCorner.partitionRep_inequivalent
statement:
lemma partitionRep_inequivalent (p q : Nat.Partition (Fintype.card X)) (hpq : p ≠ q) :
    IsEmpty (Representation.Equiv (partitionRep p (X := X)) (partitionRep q (X := X)))

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.YoungCorner.partitionRows_pos
statement:
lemma partitionRows_pos {n : ℕ} (p : Nat.Partition n) (x : ℕ)
    (hx : x ∈ p.parts.sort (· ≥ ·)) : 0 < x

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.YoungCorner.partitionUnitary_complete
statement:
lemma partitionUnitary_complete {V : Type} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V]
    [FiniteDimensional ℂ V] (τ : Representation ℂ (Equiv.Perm X) V) [τ.IsIrreducible] :
    ∃ p, Nonempty (Representation.Equiv (partitionUnitary X p).asRepresentation τ)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.YoungCorner.partitionUnitary_equiv
statement:
lemma partitionUnitary_equiv (p : Nat.Partition (Fintype.card X)) :
    Nonempty (Representation.Equiv (partitionRep p (X := X))
      (partitionUnitary X p).asRepresentation)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.YoungCorner.partitionUnitary_inequivalent
statement:
lemma partitionUnitary_inequivalent (p q : Nat.Partition (Fintype.card X)) (hpq : p ≠ q) :
    ¬Nonempty (Representation.Equiv (partitionUnitary X p).asRepresentation
      (partitionUnitary X q).asRepresentation)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.YoungCorner.partition_matrix_resolution
statement:
lemma partition_matrix_resolution {J : Type} [Fintype J] [DecidableEq J]
    (τ : Equiv.Perm X →* Matrix J J ℂ) :
    ∑ p, (partitionUnitary X p).projector τ=1

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.YoungCorner.partition_projector_resolution
statement:
theorem partition_projector_resolution {V : Type} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V]
    [FiniteDimensional ℂ V] (τ : Representation ℂ (Equiv.Perm X) V) :
    ∑ p, (partitionUnitary X p).projector τ=1

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.YoungCorner.prefix_dominance
statement:
theorem prefix_dominance (μ ν : YoungDiagram) (e : Boxes μ ≃ Boxes ν)
    (hnc : ∀ x y, x.val.1=y.val.1 → (e x).val.2=(e y).val.2 → x=y) (t : ℕ) :
    (rowPrefix μ t).card≤(rowPrefix ν t).card

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.YoungCorner.prefix_succ
statement:
lemma prefix_succ (μ : YoungDiagram) (t : ℕ) :
    (rowPrefix μ (t+1)).card=(rowPrefix μ t).card+μ.rowLen t

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.YoungCorner.regular_apply
statement: @[simp] lemma regular_apply (g : G) (f : G → ℂ) (x : G) : regular G g f x=f (g⁻¹*x)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.YoungCorner.regular_hasShape
statement:
lemma regular_hasShape (μ : YoungDiagram) (t : X ≃ Boxes μ) :
    hasShape μ t (regular (Equiv.Perm X))

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.YoungCorner.rowColumn_injective
statement:
lemma rowColumn_injective (μ : YoungDiagram) (σ : Equiv.Perm (Boxes μ))
    (h : NoCollision μ σ) (i : Fin (μ.colLen 0)) : Function.Injective (rowColumn μ σ i)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.YoungCorner.row_column_intersection
statement:
lemma row_column_intersection (μ : YoungDiagram) (t : X ≃ Boxes μ)
    (r : colorStabilizer (rowColor t)) (c : colorStabilizer (colColor t)) :
    (r : Equiv.Perm X)*(c : Equiv.Perm X)=1 ↔ r=1 ∧ c=1

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.YoungCorner.row_lt
statement: lemma row_lt (μ : YoungDiagram) (x : Boxes μ) : x.val.1 < μ.colLen 0

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.YoungCorner.shapeSubrep_hasShape
statement:
lemma shapeSubrep_hasShape (μ : YoungDiagram) (t : X ≃ Boxes μ) :
    hasShape μ t (shapeSubrep μ t).toRepresentation

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.YoungCorner.shape_unique
statement:
theorem shape_unique (μ ν : YoungDiagram) (t : X ≃ Boxes μ) (u : X ≃ Boxes ν)
    (τ : Representation ℂ (Equiv.Perm X) V) [τ.IsIrreducible]
    (hμ : hasShape μ t τ) (hν : hasShape ν u τ) : μ=ν

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.YoungCorner.signScalar_swap
statement:
@[simp] lemma signScalar_swap {X : Type*} [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] (a b : X) (hab : a ≠ b) :
    signScalar (Equiv.swap a b) = -1

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.YoungCorner.sortPerm_ge
statement:
lemma sortPerm_ge {n : ℕ} (f : Fin n → ℕ) (hf : Function.Injective f) (i : Fin n) :
    i.val ≤ f (sortPerm f hf i)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.YoungCorner.sortingRows_col_ge
statement:
lemma sortingRows_col_ge (μ : YoungDiagram) (σ : Equiv.Perm (Boxes μ)) (h : NoCollision μ σ)
    (x : Boxes μ) : x.val.2 ≤ (σ (sortingRows μ σ h x)).val.2

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.YoungCorner.sortingRows_mem
statement:
lemma sortingRows_mem (μ : YoungDiagram) (σ : Equiv.Perm (Boxes μ)) (h : NoCollision μ σ) :
    sortingRows μ σ h ∈ rows μ

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.YoungCorner.strictMono_fin_nat_ge
statement: lemma strictMono_fin_nat_ge {n : ℕ} (f : Fin n → ℕ) (hf : StrictMono f) (i : Fin n) : i.val ≤ f i

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.YoungCorner.swap_mem_color
statement:
lemma swap_mem_color (f : X → ℕ) (x y : X) (h : f x=f y) :
    Equiv.swap x y ∈ colorStabilizer f

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.YoungCorner.values_card
statement: lemma values_card {n : ℕ} (f : Fin n → ℕ) (hf : Function.Injective f) : (values f).card=n

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.activeProjector_independent
statement:
lemma activeProjector_independent (p l : ℕ) :
    LinearIndependent ℂ (activeProjector (p := p) (l := l))

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.activeProjector_mul
statement:
lemma activeProjector_mul {p l : ℕ} (a b : ActiveType p l) :
    (activeProjector a).val*(activeProjector b).val=
      if a=b then (activeProjector a).val else 0

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.activeProjector_nonzero
statement:
lemma activeProjector_nonzero {p l : ℕ} (a : ActiveType p l) :
    (activeProjector a).val ≠ 0

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.active_card_le
statement:
theorem active_card_le (p l : ℕ) :
    Fintype.card (ActiveType p l) ≤ (l+1)^((2*p)*(2*p))

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.active_inequivalent
statement:
lemma active_inequivalent {p l : ℕ} (a b : ActiveType p l) (hab : a ≠ b) :
    ¬Nonempty (Representation.Equiv (activeIrrep a).asRepresentation (activeIrrep b).asRepresentation)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.active_resolution
statement:
theorem active_resolution (p l : ℕ) :
    ∑ a : ActiveType p l, (activeProjector a).val=1

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.actual_label_overlap_contract
statement:
lemma actual_label_overlap_contract {c : ℕ} (f : L → Fin r) (g : L → Fin c)
    (e : Fin (Fintype.card L) ≃ L) (hp : 0 < p)
    (α : BlockType (size f) p) (β : BlockType (size g) p)
    (ρ : UnitaryIrrep (Equiv.Perm (Fin (Fintype.card L)))) :
    ‖fiberProjector g e (fun j => activeIrrep (β j))*ρ.projector (action p (Fintype.card L))*
      fiberProjector f e (fun i => activeIrrep (α i))‖ ≤ 1

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.ambient_block_resolution
statement:
lemma ambient_block_resolution (h : (∑ i, n i)=l) (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin l)) :
    (∑ α : BlockType n p, ambientProjector (p := p) n h σ (fun i => activeIrrep (α i)))=1

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.block_resolution
statement: lemma block_resolution : ∑ α : BlockType n p, blockProjector n α=1

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.exp_blockEntropy
statement:
lemma exp_blockEntropy {n : Fin r → ℕ} (α : BlockType n p) :
    Real.exp (blockEntropy α)=∏ i, ((activeIrrep (α i)).dimension : ℝ)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.fiber_block_resolution
statement:
lemma fiber_block_resolution (f : L → Fin r) (e : Fin (Fintype.card L) ≃ L) :
    (∑ α : BlockType (size f) p, fiberProjector (p := p) f e (fun i => activeIrrep (α i)))=1

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.nat_pow_eq_exp
statement: lemma nat_pow_eq_exp (s t : ℕ) : ((s+1 : ℕ) : ℝ)^t=Real.exp ((t : ℝ)*Real.log (s+1 : ℕ))

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.phase_conj_of_parity_stable
statement:
lemma phase_conj_of_parity_stable {p l : ℕ} (σ g : Equiv.Perm (Fin l)) (w : Word p l)
    (h : ∀ i, odd (w (σ i)) ↔ odd (w i)) :
    phase (g*σ*g⁻¹) (wordPerm g w)=phase σ w

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.phase_eq_of_same_parity
statement:
lemma phase_eq_of_same_parity {p l : ℕ} (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin l)) (u w : Word p l)
    (h : ∀ i, odd (u i) ↔ odd (w i)) : phase σ u=phase σ w

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.phase_ofSubtype
statement:
lemma phase_ofSubtype {p l : ℕ} (w : Word p l)
    (σ : Equiv.Perm {i : Fin l // odd (w i)}) :
    phase (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype σ) w = YoungCorner.signScalar σ

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.phase_of_fix_even
statement:
lemma phase_of_fix_even {p l : ℕ} (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin l)) (w : Word p l)
    (h : ∀ i, ¬ odd (w i) → σ i=i) : phase σ w=YoungCorner.signScalar σ

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.phase_of_fix_odd
statement:
lemma phase_of_fix_odd {p l : ℕ} (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin l)) (w : Word p l)
    (h : ∀ i, odd (w i) → σ i=i) : phase σ w=1

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.phase_swap_odd
statement:
lemma phase_swap_odd {p l : ℕ} (w : Word p l) (i j : Fin l) (hij : i ≠ j)
    (hi : odd (w i)) (hj : odd (w j)) : phase (Equiv.swap i j) w = -1

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SignedTensor.wordPerm_same_parity
statement:
lemma wordPerm_same_parity {p l : ℕ} (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin l)) (w : Word p l)
    (h : ∀ i, odd (w (σ i)) ↔ odd (w i)) :
    ∀ i, odd (wordPerm σ w i) ↔ odd (w i)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.YoungCorner.detecting_shape_constituent
statement:
lemma detecting_shape_constituent {X V : Type*} [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X]
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V] [FiniteDimensional ℂ V]
    (τ : Representation ℂ (Equiv.Perm X) V) (t : X ≃ Boxes μ) (h : hasShape μ t τ) :
    ∃ S : Subrepresentation τ, S.toRepresentation.IsIrreducible ∧ hasShape μ t S.toRepresentation

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.YoungCorner.hookLetter_col_eq
statement:
lemma hookLetter_col_eq (h : Hook μ p) (x y : Boxes μ)
    (hx : p≤x.val.1) (he : hookLetter h x=hookLetter h y) : x.val.2=y.val.2

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.YoungCorner.hookLetter_odd
statement:
lemma hookLetter_odd (h : Hook μ p) (x : Boxes μ) :
    SignedTensor.odd (hookLetter h x) ↔ p≤x.val.1

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.YoungCorner.hookLetter_row_eq
statement:
lemma hookLetter_row_eq (h : Hook μ p) (x y : Boxes μ)
    (hx : x.val.1<p) (he : hookLetter h x=hookLetter h y) : x.val.1=y.val.1

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.YoungCorner.hook_contribution
statement:
lemma hook_contribution (t : Fin l ≃ Boxes μ) (h : Hook μ p)
    (r : colorStabilizer (rowColor t)) (c : colorStabilizer (colColor t)) :
    let w : SignedTensor.Word p l := fun x => hookLetter h (t x)
    signScalar c.val * SignedTensor.matrix (r.val*c.val) w w =
      if w=SignedTensor.wordPerm (r.val*c.val) w then 1 else 0

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.YoungCorner.hook_corner_fixed
statement: lemma hook_corner_fixed {X : Type*} (t : X ≃ Boxes μ) (h : Hook μ p) (r : colorStabilizer (rowColor t)) (c : colorStabilizer (colColor t)) (hw : ∀ x, hookLetter h (t ((r : Equiv.Perm X) (c.val x)))=hookLetter h (t x)) : (∀ x, (t x).val.1

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.YoungCorner.hook_corner_matrix_ne
statement:
lemma hook_corner_matrix_ne (t : Fin l ≃ Boxes μ) (h : Hook μ p) :
    fixedSum (rowColor t) (SignedTensor.action p l) *
      alternatingSum (colColor t) (SignedTensor.action p l) ≠ 0

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.YoungCorner.hook_corner_phase
statement:
lemma hook_corner_phase {l : ℕ} (t : Fin l ≃ Boxes μ) (h : Hook μ p)
    (r : colorStabilizer (rowColor t)) (c : colorStabilizer (colColor t))
    (hw : ∀ x, hookLetter h (t ((r : Equiv.Perm (Fin l)) (c.val x)))=hookLetter h (t x)) :
    SignedTensor.phase ((r : Equiv.Perm (Fin l))*c.val) (fun x => hookLetter h (t x))=
      signScalar (c : Equiv.Perm (Fin l))

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.YoungCorner.hook_multiplicity_pos
statement:
lemma hook_multiplicity_pos {p l : ℕ} {μ : YoungDiagram}
    (ρ : UnitaryIrrep (Equiv.Perm (Fin l))) (t : Fin l ≃ Boxes μ)
    (hρ : hasShape μ t ρ.asRepresentation) (hhook : Hook μ p) :
    0 < Module.finrank ℂ (ρ.asRepresentation.IntertwiningMap (matrixRepresentation (action p l)))

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.YoungCorner.hook_occurs
statement:
theorem hook_occurs {V : Type} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V] [FiniteDimensional ℂ V]
    (ρ : Representation ℂ (Equiv.Perm (Fin l)) V) [ρ.IsIrreducible]
    (t : Fin l ≃ Boxes μ) (hρ : hasShape μ t ρ) (h : Hook μ p) :
    ∃ S : Subrepresentation (signedRep p l),
      Nonempty (Representation.Equiv ρ S.toRepresentation)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.YoungCorner.signScalar_square
statement:
lemma signScalar_square {X : Type*} [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] (c : Equiv.Perm X) :
    signScalar c * signScalar c=1

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.YoungCorner.signedRep_hasShape
statement:
lemma signedRep_hasShape (t : Fin l ≃ Boxes μ) (h : Hook μ p) :
    hasShape μ t (signedRep p l)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.column_entropy_sum
statement:
lemma column_entropy_sum {p : ℕ} (β : BlockType (FiberBlocks.size H.columnIndex) p) (c e : ℝ) :
    (∑ i, (-c*Real.log (activeIrrep (β i)).dimension+
      e*H.columnCount (H.columnSite i)*Real.log B.size-(H.columnHoles (H.columnSite i)).cost))=
      -c*blockEntropy β+e*h*Real.log B.size-∑ x, (H.columnHoles x).cost

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.cost_split
statement: theorem cost_split : H.cost=(∑ y, (H.rowHoles y).cost)+(∑ x, (H.columnHoles x).cost)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.cost_stage_column
statement:
lemma cost_stage_column (j : Fin B.b) :
    (∑ L : (concat A B).Line (Fin.natAdd A.b j),
      Real.log (((2 ^ (concat A B).bits (Fin.natAdd A.b j) : ℕ) : ℝ) ^
          H.lineCount (Fin.natAdd A.b j) L /
        ((2 ^ (concat A B).bits (Fin.natAdd A.b j)).descFactorial
          (H.lineCount (Fin.natAdd A.b j) L) : ℝ)))=
      ∑ x : A.Slot, ∑ L : B.Line j,
        Real.log (((2^B.bits j : ℕ) : ℝ)^(H.columnHoles x).lineCount j L /
          ((2^B.bits j).descFactorial ((H.columnHoles x).lineCount j L) : ℝ))

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.cost_stage_row
statement:
lemma cost_stage_row (j : Fin A.b) :
    (∑ L : (concat A B).Line (Fin.castAdd B.b j),
      Real.log (((2 ^ (concat A B).bits (Fin.castAdd B.b j) : ℕ) : ℝ) ^
          H.lineCount (Fin.castAdd B.b j) L /
        ((2 ^ (concat A B).bits (Fin.castAdd B.b j)).descFactorial
          (H.lineCount (Fin.castAdd B.b j) L) : ℝ)))=
      ∑ y : B.Slot, ∑ L : A.Line j,
        Real.log (((2^A.bits j : ℕ) : ℝ)^(H.rowHoles y).lineCount j L /
          ((2^A.bits j).descFactorial ((H.rowHoles y).lineCount j L) : ℝ))

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.lineCount_column
statement:
lemma lineCount_column (j : Fin B.b) (x : A.Slot) (L : B.Line j) :
    H.lineCount (Fin.natAdd A.b j) (columnLines A B j (x,L))=(H.columnHoles x).lineCount j L

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.lineCount_row
statement:
lemma lineCount_row (j : Fin A.b) (L : A.Line j) (y : B.Slot) :
    H.lineCount (Fin.castAdd B.b j) (rowLines A B j (L,y))=(H.rowHoles y).lineCount j L

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.onLine_column_iff
statement:
lemma onLine_column_iff (j : Fin B.b) (x : A.Slot) (L : B.Line j) (i : Fin h) :
    H.OnLine (Fin.natAdd A.b j) (columnLines A B j (x,L)) i ↔
      H.columnOf i=x ∧ (fun k : {k : Fin B.b // k≠j} =>
        (splitSlots A B (H.path i (suffixTime A B j.castSucc))).2 k.val)=L

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.onLine_row_iff
statement:
lemma onLine_row_iff (j : Fin A.b) (L : A.Line j) (y : B.Slot) (i : Fin h) :
    H.OnLine (Fin.castAdd B.b j) (rowLines A B j (L,y)) i ↔
      H.rowOf i=y ∧ (fun k : {k : Fin A.b // k≠j} =>
        (splitSlots A B (H.path i (prefixTime A B j.castSucc))).1 k.val)=L

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.row_column_index_injective
statement: lemma row_column_index_injective : Function.Injective (fun x : H.JunctionFree => (H.rowIndex x,H.columnIndex x))

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.row_entropy_sum
statement:
lemma row_entropy_sum {p : ℕ} (α : BlockType (FiberBlocks.size H.rowIndex) p) (c e : ℝ) :
    (∑ i, (-c*Real.log (activeIrrep (α i)).dimension+
      e*H.rowCount (H.rowSite i)*Real.log A.size-(H.rowHoles (H.rowSite i)).cost))=
      -c*blockEntropy α+e*h*Real.log A.size-∑ y, (H.rowHoles y).cost

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Coverage.sum_ite_exists_le
statement:
theorem sum_ite_exists_le {X J : Type*} [Fintype X] [Fintype J]
    (w : X → ℝ) (hw : ∀ x, 0 ≤ w x) (P : J → X → Prop) :
    (∑ x, if ∃ j, P j x then w x else 0) ≤ ∑ j, ∑ x, if P j x then w x else 0

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.FiniteLaw.map_event
statement:
theorem map_event {A B : Type*} [Fintype A] [Fintype B]
    (μ : FiniteLaw A) (f : A → B) (P : B → Prop) :
    (∑ b, if P b then μ.map f b else 0) = ∑ a, if P (f a) then μ a else 0

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.FiniteLaw.uniform_eval
statement:
theorem uniform_eval {A B : Type*} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] [Fintype B]
    [Nonempty B] (a : A) (b : B) :
    (∑ f : A → B, if f a = b then uniform (A → B) f else 0) =
      (Fintype.card B : ℝ)⁻¹

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.FiniteLaw.uniform_pi
statement:
theorem uniform_pi {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    {X : ι → Type*} [∀ i, Fintype (X i)] [∀ i, Nonempty (X i)] :
    uniform (∀ i, X i) = independent (fun i => uniform (X i))

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.alternating_cancel
statement:
lemma alternating_cancel {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] (s : Finset ι) (i : ι) (hi : i ∈ s)
    (P : Finset ι → ℝ)
    (hP : ∀ A ⊆ s.erase i, P (insert i A) = P A) :
    ∑ A ∈ s.powerset, (-1 : ℝ) ^ A.card * P A = 0

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.extraLineEvent_insert
statement:
theorem extraLineEvent_insert {G : Grid} {k : ℕ} (x y : Fin k → G.Slot)
    (A : Finset (Fin k)) (i : Fin k) (j : Fin G.b) (L : G.Line j)
    (σ : Equiv.Perm (Cube (G.bits j))) :
    G.extraLineEvent x y (insert i A) j L σ ↔
      ((G.pathLine (x i) (y i) j = L → σ (x i j) = y i j) ∧
        G.extraLineEvent x y A j L σ)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.extraLineEvent_insert_off
statement:
theorem extraLineEvent_insert_off {G : Grid} {k : ℕ} (x y : Fin k → G.Slot)
    (A : Finset (Fin k)) (i : Fin k) (j : Fin G.b) (L : G.Line j)
    (hne : G.pathLine (x i) (y i) j ≠ L)
    (σ : Equiv.Perm (Cube (G.bits j))) :
    G.extraLineEvent x y (insert i A) j L σ ↔ G.extraLineEvent x y A j L σ

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.extraProbability_eq_conditionalEndpoint
statement:
theorem extraProbability_eq_conditionalEndpoint (H : G.Holes h) (x y : Fin k → G.Slot)
    (A : Finset (Fin k))
    (μ : ∀ j : Fin G.b, FiniteLaw (Equiv.Perm (Cube (G.bits j)))) :
    H.extraProbability x y A μ = H.conditionalEndpointProbability x y A μ

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.extraProbability_isolated_insert
statement:
theorem extraProbability_isolated_insert (H : G.Holes h) (x y : Fin k → G.Slot)
    (A : Finset (Fin k)) (i : Fin k) (hi : i ∉ A)
    (his : H.LineIsolated x y i)
    (μ : ∀ j : Fin G.b, FiniteLaw (Equiv.Perm (Cube (G.bits j))))
    (hμ : ∀ j, OneCardUniform (μ j)) :
    H.extraProbability x y (insert i A) μ =
      (G.size : ℝ)⁻¹ * H.extraProbability x y A μ

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.lineCompatible_of_empty
statement:
theorem lineCompatible_of_empty (H : G.Holes h) (j : Fin G.b) (L : G.Line j)
    (he : ∀ i, ¬ H.OnLine j L i) (σ : Equiv.Perm (Cube (G.bits j))) :
    H.LineCompatible j L σ

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.lineIsolated_of_not_covered
statement:
theorem lineIsolated_of_not_covered (H : G.Holes h) (hH : H.Feasible)
    (x : Fin k → G.Slot × G.Slot) (i : Fin k)
    (hi : i ∉ Coverage.sharingCoverage G.lineShares H.endpointData x) :
    H.LineIsolated (fun a => (x a).1) (fun a => (x a).2) i

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.lineMass_hole_normalizer
statement:
theorem lineMass_hole_normalizer (H : G.Holes h) {z : ℝ}
    (hz : 0 ≤ z) (hz' : z ≤ 1) :
    (∑ ω, if H.Compatible ω then
      G.productLineMass (fun j => lineLaw (G.bits j) z hz hz') ω else 0) =
      H.probability z

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.localExtraProbability_insert_off
statement:
theorem localExtraProbability_insert_off (H : G.Holes h) (x y : Fin k → G.Slot)
    (A : Finset (Fin k)) (i : Fin k) (j : Fin G.b) (L : G.Line j)
    (μ : FiniteLaw (Equiv.Perm (Cube (G.bits j))))
    (hne : G.pathLine (x i) (y i) j ≠ L) :
    H.localExtraProbability x y (insert i A) j L μ =
      H.localExtraProbability x y A j L μ

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.localExtraProbability_isolated_insert
statement:
theorem localExtraProbability_isolated_insert (H : G.Holes h) (x y : Fin k → G.Slot)
    (A : Finset (Fin k)) (i : Fin k) (hi : i ∉ A)
    (his : H.LineIsolated x y i) (j : Fin G.b)
    (μ : FiniteLaw (Equiv.Perm (Cube (G.bits j)))) (hμ : OneCardUniform μ) :
    H.localExtraProbability x y (insert i A) j (G.pathLine (x i) (y i) j) μ =
      (2^G.bits j : ℝ)⁻¹

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.localExtraProbability_no_paths
statement:
theorem localExtraProbability_no_paths (H : G.Holes h) (x y : Fin k → G.Slot)
    (A : Finset (Fin k)) (j : Fin G.b) (L : G.Line j)
    (μ : FiniteLaw (Equiv.Perm (Cube (G.bits j))))
    (he : ∀ i, ¬ H.OnLine j L i)
    (ha : ∀ i ∈ A, G.pathLine (x i) (y i) j ≠ L) :
    H.localExtraProbability x y A j L μ = 1

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.path_eq_pathBetween
statement:
theorem path_eq_pathBetween (H : G.Holes h) (hH : H.Feasible)
    (i : Fin h) (t : Fin (G.b+1)) :
    H.path i t = G.pathBetween (H.endpointData i).1 (H.endpointData i).2 t

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.placementKernel_eq_zero_of_isolated
statement:
theorem placementKernel_eq_zero_of_isolated (H : G.Holes h) (x y : Fin k → G.Slot)
    (i : Fin k) (his : H.LineIsolated x y i)
    (μ : ∀ j : Fin G.b, FiniteLaw (Equiv.Perm (Cube (G.bits j))))
    (hμ : ∀ j, OneCardUniform (μ j)) : H.placementKernel x y μ = 0

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.placementKernel_lineLaw_eq_zero_of_isolated
statement:
theorem Grid.Holes.placementKernel_lineLaw_eq_zero_of_isolated
    {G : Grid} {h k : ℕ} (H : G.Holes h) (x y : Fin k → G.Slot)
    (i : Fin k) (his : H.LineIsolated x y i)
    (z : ℝ) (hz : 0 ≤ z) (hz' : z ≤ 1) :
    H.placementKernel x y (fun j => lineLaw (G.bits j) z hz hz') = 0

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.placementKernel_ne_zero_coverage
statement:
theorem placementKernel_ne_zero_coverage (H : G.Holes h) (hH : H.Feasible)
    (x : Fin k → G.Slot × G.Slot) (z : ℝ) (hz : 0 ≤ z) (hz' : z ≤ 1)
    (hQ : H.placementKernel (fun a => (x a).1) (fun a => (x a).2)
      (fun j => lineLaw (G.bits j) z hz hz') ≠ 0) :
    (Coverage.sharingCoverage G.lineShares H.endpointData x).card = k

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.stageExtraProbability_isolated_insert
statement:
theorem stageExtraProbability_isolated_insert (H : G.Holes h) (x y : Fin k → G.Slot)
    (A : Finset (Fin k)) (i : Fin k) (hi : i ∉ A)
    (his : H.LineIsolated x y i) (j : Fin G.b)
    (μ : FiniteLaw (Equiv.Perm (Cube (G.bits j)))) (hμ : OneCardUniform μ) :
    (∏ L : G.Line j, H.localExtraProbability x y (insert i A) j L μ) =
      (2^G.bits j : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∏ L : G.Line j, H.localExtraProbability x y A j L μ

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.boundary_coordinate_before
statement:
theorem boundary_coordinate_before (ω : G.Choices) (x : G.Slot) (k : Fin G.b)
    (t : ℕ) (ht : t ≤ k.val) : G.boundary ω t x k = x k

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.boundary_coordinate_stable
statement:
theorem boundary_coordinate_stable (ω : G.Choices) (x : G.Slot) (k : Fin G.b)
    (u v : ℕ) (hku : k.val < u) (huv : u ≤ v) (hvb : v ≤ G.b) :
    G.boundary ω v x k = G.boundary ω u x k

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.boundary_eq_pathBetween
statement:
theorem boundary_eq_pathBetween (ω : G.Choices) (x : G.Slot) (t : Fin (G.b+1)) :
    G.boundary ω t x = G.pathBetween x (G.sweep ω x) t

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.endpointEvent_iff_lines
statement:
theorem endpointEvent_iff_lines {k : ℕ} (x y : Fin k → G.Slot)
    (A : Finset (Fin k)) (ω : G.Choices) :
    G.endpointEvent x y A ω ↔ ∀ j L, G.extraLineEvent x y A j L (ω j L)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.endpointWeight_nonneg
statement: theorem endpointWeight_nonneg (p : G.Slot × G.Slot) : 0 ≤ G.endpointWeight p

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.endpointWeight_total
statement: theorem endpointWeight_total : ∑ p, G.endpointWeight p = 1

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.lineShares_symm
statement: theorem lineShares_symm : ∀ ⦃left right⦄, G.lineShares left right → G.lineShares right left

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.lineSharingRate_nonneg
statement: theorem lineSharingRate_nonneg : 0 ≤ G.lineSharingRate

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.pathBetween_input
statement:
@[simp] theorem pathBetween_input (x y : G.Slot) (j : Fin G.b) :
    G.pathBetween x y j.castSucc j = x j

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.pathBetween_last
statement:
@[simp] theorem pathBetween_last (x y : G.Slot) :
    G.pathBetween x y (Fin.last G.b) = y

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.pathBetween_output
statement:
@[simp] theorem pathBetween_output (x y : G.Slot) (j : Fin G.b) :
    G.pathBetween x y j.succ j = y j

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.pathBetween_step
statement:
theorem pathBetween_step (x y : G.Slot) (j k : Fin G.b) (hne : k ≠ j) :
    G.pathBetween x y j.succ k = G.pathBetween x y j.castSucc k

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.pathBetween_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem pathBetween_zero (x y : G.Slot) : G.pathBetween x y 0 = x

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.probability_lineShares_le
statement:
theorem probability_lineShares_le (q : G.Slot × G.Slot) :
    (∑ p, if G.lineShares p q then G.endpointWeight p else 0) ≤ G.lineSharingRate

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.probability_path_line
statement:
theorem probability_path_line (j : Fin G.b) (L : G.Line j) :
    (∑ p : G.Slot × G.Slot, if G.pathLine p.1 p.2 j = L then G.endpointWeight p else 0) =
      (2^G.bits j : ℝ) / G.size

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.probability_path_vertex
statement:
theorem probability_path_vertex (t : Fin (G.b+1)) (v : G.Slot) :
    (∑ p : G.Slot × G.Slot, if G.pathBetween p.1 p.2 t = v then G.endpointWeight p else 0) =
      (G.size : ℝ)⁻¹

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.probability_vertexShares_le
statement:
theorem probability_vertexShares_le (q : G.Slot × G.Slot) :
    (∑ p, if G.vertexShares p q then G.endpointWeight p else 0) ≤ G.vertexSharingRate

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.sum_pathBetween
statement:
theorem sum_pathBetween (t : Fin (G.b+1)) (f : G.Slot → ℝ) :
    (∑ p : G.Slot × G.Slot, f (G.pathBetween p.1 p.2 t)) =
      (G.size : ℝ) * ∑ x : G.Slot, f x

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.sum_productLineMass_event
statement:
theorem sum_productLineMass_event
    (μ : ∀ j : Fin G.b, FiniteLaw (Equiv.Perm (Cube (G.bits j))))
    (P : ∀ j : Fin G.b, G.Line j → Equiv.Perm (Cube (G.bits j)) → Prop) :
    (∑ ω, if ∀ j L, P j L (ω j L) then G.productLineMass μ ω else 0) =
      ∏ j, ∏ L, ∑ σ, if P j L σ then μ j σ else 0

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.sum_slot_line
statement:
theorem sum_slot_line (j : Fin G.b) (L : G.Line j) (c : ℝ) :
    (∑ x : G.Slot, if (fun k : {k : Fin G.b // k ≠ j} => x k) = L then c else 0) =
      (2^G.bits j : ℝ) * c

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.sweep_eq_iff_line_assignments
statement:
theorem sweep_eq_iff_line_assignments (ω : G.Choices) (x y : G.Slot) :
    G.sweep ω x = y ↔
      ∀ j, ω j (G.pathLine x y j) (x j) = y j

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.vertexShares_symm
statement: theorem vertexShares_symm : ∀ ⦃left right⦄, G.vertexShares left right → G.vertexShares right left

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.vertexSharingRate_nonneg
statement: theorem vertexSharingRate_nonneg : 0 ≤ G.vertexSharingRate

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.binaryBoundary_before
statement:
theorem binaryBoundary_before {d : ℕ} (bits : BinaryChoices d) (x : Cube d) (k : Fin d)
    (t : ℕ) (ht : t ≤ k.val) : binaryBoundary bits t x k = x k

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.binaryBoundary_eq_path
statement:
theorem binaryBoundary_eq_path {d : ℕ} (bits : BinaryChoices d) (x : Cube d)
    (t : ℕ) (ht : t ≤ d) :
    binaryBoundary bits t x = binaryPath x (binarySweep d bits x) t

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.binaryBoundary_last
statement:
@[simp] theorem binaryBoundary_last {d : ℕ} (bits : BinaryChoices d) :
    binaryBoundary bits d = binarySweep d bits

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.binaryBoundary_stable
statement:
theorem binaryBoundary_stable {d : ℕ} (bits : BinaryChoices d) (x : Cube d) (k : Fin d)
    (u v : ℕ) (hku : k.val < u) (huv : u ≤ v) (hvd : v ≤ d) :
    binaryBoundary bits v x k = binaryBoundary bits u x k

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.binaryBoundary_succ
statement:
theorem binaryBoundary_succ {d : ℕ} (bits : BinaryChoices d) {t : ℕ} (ht : t < d) :
    binaryBoundary bits (t+1) = binaryLayer ⟨t,ht⟩ (bits ⟨t,ht⟩) * binaryBoundary bits t

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.binaryBoundary_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem binaryBoundary_zero {d : ℕ} (bits : BinaryChoices d) :
    binaryBoundary bits 0 = 1

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.binaryLaw_one_card
statement:
theorem binaryLaw_one_card (d : ℕ) (x y : Cube d) :
    (∑ σ, if σ x = y then binaryLaw d σ else 0) = (2^d : ℝ)⁻¹

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.binaryLayer_apply_ne
statement:
theorem binaryLayer_apply_ne {d : ℕ} (j k : Fin d) (hne : k ≠ j)
    (bits : ({k : Fin d // k ≠ j} → Bool) → Bool) (x : Cube d) :
    binaryLayer j bits x k = x k

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.binaryLayer_apply_same
statement:
@[simp] theorem binaryLayer_apply_same {d : ℕ} (j : Fin d)
    (bits : ({k : Fin d // k ≠ j} → Bool) → Bool) (x : Cube d) :
    binaryLayer j bits x j = Bool.xor (x j) (bits (fun k => x k))

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.binaryPath_last
statement: @[simp] theorem binaryPath_last {d : ℕ} (x y : Cube d) : binaryPath x y d = y

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.binaryPath_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem binaryPath_zero {d : ℕ} (x y : Cube d) : binaryPath x y 0 = x

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.binarySweep_eq_iff_coins
statement:
theorem binarySweep_eq_iff_coins {d : ℕ} (bits : BinaryChoices d) (x y : Cube d) :
    binarySweep d bits x = y ↔
      ∀ j, bits j (binaryPathLine x y j) = Bool.xor (x j) (y j)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.lineLaw_one_card
statement:
theorem lineLaw_one_card (d : ℕ) (z : ℝ) (hz : 0 ≤ z) (hz' : z ≤ 1) :
    Grid.Holes.OneCardUniform (lineLaw d z hz hz')

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.sum_prod_ite_all
statement:
theorem sum_prod_ite_all {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    {X : ι → Type*} [∀ i, Fintype (X i)]
    (w : ∀ i, X i → ℝ) (P : ∀ i, X i → Prop) :
    (∑ x : ∀ i, X i, if ∀ i, P i (x i) then ∏ i, w i (x i) else 0) =
      ∏ i, ∑ y, if P i y then w i y else 0

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.uniformLaw_one_card
statement:
theorem uniformLaw_one_card (d : ℕ) (x y : Cube d) :
    (∑ σ : Equiv.Perm (Cube d), if σ x = y then FiniteLaw.uniform _ σ else 0) =
      (2^d : ℝ)⁻¹

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.FiniteLaw.assignments_pos_of_comparison
statement:
theorem assignments_pos_of_comparison {h : ℕ} (μ : FiniteLaw (Equiv.Perm Ω))
    (hlo : ∀ g, (1/2 : ℝ)*uniform (Equiv.Perm Ω) g ≤ μ g)
    (x y : Fin h ↪ Ω) : 0 < μ.assignments x y

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.FiniteLaw.assignments_ratio_comparison
statement:
theorem assignments_ratio_comparison {h h' : ℕ} (μ : FiniteLaw (Equiv.Perm Ω))
    (hlo : ∀ g, (1/2 : ℝ)*uniform (Equiv.Perm Ω) g ≤ μ g)
    (hhi : ∀ g, μ g ≤ 2*uniform (Equiv.Perm Ω) g)
    (x y : Fin h ↪ Ω) (x' y' : Fin h' ↪ Ω) :
    μ.assignments x' y' / μ.assignments x y ≤
      4 * ((uniform (Equiv.Perm Ω)).assignments x' y' /
        (uniform (Equiv.Perm Ω)).assignments x y)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.augment_compatible_iff
statement:
theorem augment_compatible_iff (H : G.Holes h) (u v : Fin t → G.Slot) (hu : H.ValidInput u)
    (ω : G.Choices) (hω : H.Compatible ω) (hv : ∀ i, G.sweep ω (u i) = v i)
    (ν : G.Choices) :
    (H.augment u v hu ω hω hv).Compatible ν ↔
      H.Compatible ν ∧ ∀ i, G.sweep ν (u i) = v i

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.augment_extends
statement:
theorem augment_extends (H : G.Holes h) (u v : Fin t → G.Slot) (hu : H.ValidInput u)
    (ω : G.Choices) (hω : H.Compatible ω) (hv : ∀ i, G.sweep ω (u i) = v i) :
    (H.augment u v hu ω hω hv).Extends H

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.augment_new
statement:
@[simp] theorem augment_new (H : G.Holes h) (u v : Fin t → G.Slot) (hu : H.ValidInput u)
    (ω : G.Choices) (hω : H.Compatible ω) (hv : ∀ i, G.sweep ω (u i) = v i)
    (i : Fin t) (s : Fin (G.b+1)) :
    (H.augment u v hu ω hω hv).path (Fin.natAdd h i) s =
      G.pathBetween (u i) (v i) s

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.augment_old
statement:
@[simp] theorem augment_old (H : G.Holes h) (u v : Fin t → G.Slot) (hu : H.ValidInput u)
    (ω : G.Choices) (hω : H.Compatible ω) (hv : ∀ i, G.sweep ω (u i) = v i)
    (i : Fin h) (s : Fin (G.b+1)) :
    (H.augment u v hu ω hω hv).path (Fin.castAdd t i) s = H.path i s

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.endpointEvent_iff_selected
statement:
theorem endpointEvent_iff_selected (u v : Fin k → G.Slot) (A : Finset (Fin k))
    (ω : G.Choices) : G.endpointEvent u v A ω ↔
      ∀ i : Fin A.card, G.sweep ω (u (selected A i)) = v (selected A i)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.lineCompatible_eq_of_no_extra
statement:
theorem lineCompatible_eq_of_no_extra {t : ℕ} (J : G.Holes (h+t))
    (H : G.Holes h) (he : J.Extends H) (j : Fin G.b) (L : G.Line j)
    (hno : J.extraCount j L = 0) (σ : Equiv.Perm (Cube (G.bits j))) :
    J.LineCompatible j L σ ↔ H.LineCompatible j L σ

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.lineCount_add
statement:
theorem lineCount_add {t : ℕ} (J : G.Holes (h+t)) (H : G.Holes h)
    (he : J.Extends H) (j : Fin G.b) (L : G.Line j) :
    J.lineCount j L = H.lineCount j L + J.extraCount j L

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.lineProb_eq_of_no_extra
statement:
theorem lineProb_eq_of_no_extra (J : G.Holes (h+t)) (H : G.Holes h)
    (he : J.Extends H) (j : Fin G.b) (L : G.Line j) (hno : J.extraCount j L = 0)
    (μ : FiniteLaw (Equiv.Perm (Cube (G.bits j)))) :
    J.lineProb j L μ = H.lineProb j L μ

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.lineProb_nonneg
statement:
theorem lineProb_nonneg (H : G.Holes h) (j : Fin G.b) (L : G.Line j)
    (μ : FiniteLaw (Equiv.Perm (Cube (G.bits j)))) : 0 ≤ H.lineProb j L μ

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.lineProb_ratio_le
statement:
theorem lineProb_ratio_le (J : G.Holes (h+t)) (H : G.Holes h)
    (he : J.Extends H) (j : Fin G.b) (L : G.Line j)
    (μ : FiniteLaw (Equiv.Perm (Cube (G.bits j))))
    (hlo : ∀ g, (1/2 : ℝ)*FiniteLaw.uniform _ g ≤ μ g)
    (hhi : ∀ g, μ g ≤ 2*FiniteLaw.uniform _ g) :
    J.lineProb j L μ / H.lineProb j L μ ≤
      (4 : ℝ) ^ J.usedLine j L *
        (J.lineProb j L (FiniteLaw.uniform _) / H.lineProb j L (FiniteLaw.uniform _))

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.log_probability_zero
statement:
theorem log_probability_zero (H : G.Holes h) :
    Real.log (H.probability 0) = H.cost - (h : ℝ) * Real.log (G.size : ℝ)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.log_size
statement:
theorem log_size (G : Grid) : Real.log (G.size : ℝ) =
    ∑ j, Real.log ((2 ^ G.bits j : ℕ) : ℝ)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.no_extra_iff
statement:
theorem no_extra_iff {t : ℕ} (J : G.Holes (h+t)) (j : Fin G.b) (L : G.Line j) :
    J.extraCount j L = 0 ↔ ∀ i : Fin t, ¬ J.OnLine j L (Fin.natAdd h i)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.probability_prod_lineProb
statement:
theorem probability_prod_lineProb (H : G.Holes h) {z : ℝ} (hz : 0 ≤ z) (hz' : z ≤ 1) :
    H.probability z = ∏ j, ∏ L : G.Line j, H.lineProb j L (lineLaw (G.bits j) z hz hz')

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.probability_zero_eq_exp
statement:
theorem probability_zero_eq_exp (H : G.Holes h) :
    H.probability 0 = Real.exp (H.cost - (h : ℝ)*Real.log (G.size : ℝ))

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.probability_zero_pos
statement: theorem probability_zero_pos (H : G.Holes h) : 0 < H.probability 0

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.probability_zero_prod_lineProb
statement:
theorem probability_zero_prod_lineProb (H : G.Holes h) :
    H.probability 0 = ∏ j, ∏ L : G.Line j, H.lineProb j L (FiniteLaw.uniform _)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.selected_mem
statement: theorem selected_mem (A : Finset (Fin k)) (i : Fin A.card) : selected A i ∈ A

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.selected_range
statement:
theorem selected_range (A : Finset (Fin k)) (a : Fin k) (ha : a ∈ A) :
    ∃ i, selected A i = a

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.sum_extraCount
statement:
theorem sum_extraCount {t : ℕ} (J : G.Holes (h+t)) (j : Fin G.b) :
    ∑ L : G.Line j, J.extraCount j L = t

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.sum_usedLine_le
statement:
theorem sum_usedLine_le (J : G.Holes (h+t)) :
    (∑ j, ∑ L : G.Line j, J.usedLine j L) ≤ t*G.b

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.uniform_lineProb_pos
statement:
theorem uniform_lineProb_pos (H : G.Holes h) (j : Fin G.b) (L : G.Line j) :
    0 < H.lineProb j L (FiniteLaw.uniform _)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.validInput_selected
statement:
theorem validInput_selected (H : G.Holes h) (u : Fin k → G.Slot) (hu : H.ValidInput u)
    (A : Finset (Fin k)) : H.ValidInput (fun i => u (selected A i))

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.OrderedPlacements.action_apply
statement: @[simp] lemma action_apply (g : Equiv.Perm X) (x : I ↪ X) (i : I) : action g x i=g (x i)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.OrderedPlacements.card_placements
statement: lemma card_placements : Fintype.card (I ↪ X)=(Fintype.card X).descFactorial (Fintype.card I)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.OrderedPlacements.mem_stabilizer_iff
statement:
lemma mem_stabilizer_iff (x0 : I ↪ X) (g : Equiv.Perm X) :
    g ∈ (chart x0).stabilizer ↔ ∀ i, g (x0 i)=x0 i

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.OrderedPlacements.rangeEquiv_apply
statement:
lemma rangeEquiv_apply (x0 x : I ↪ X) (i : I) :
    (rangeEquiv x0 x ⟨x0 i,⟨i,rfl⟩⟩).val=x i

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.PlacementInduction.Chart.average_block
statement:
theorem average_block (ρ : UnitaryIrrep C.stabilizer) (w : W → ℝ) (hw : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ w ω)
    (g : W → G) (y x : Ω) :
    (averageMatrix (C.action ρ) (fun ω => (w ω : ℂ)) g).submatrix (fun i => (y,i)) (fun j => (x,j))=
      (C.transition w g y x : ℂ) • C.conditionalBlock ρ w g y x

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.PlacementInduction.Chart.card_group
statement: lemma card_group : Fintype.card G=Fintype.card Ω*Fintype.card C.stabilizer

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.PlacementInduction.Chart.cocycle_fixed
statement:
lemma cocycle_fixed (x : Ω) (h : C.stabilizer) :
    C.cocycle ((C.fixedEquiv x h).val) x=h

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.PlacementInduction.Chart.cocycle_inv
statement:
lemma cocycle_inv (g : G) (x : Ω) :
    C.cocycle g⁻¹ (a g x)=(C.cocycle g x)⁻¹

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.PlacementInduction.Chart.cocycle_mul
statement:
@[simp] lemma cocycle_mul (g h : G) (x : Ω) :
    C.cocycle (g*h) x=C.cocycle g (a h x)*C.cocycle h x

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.PlacementInduction.Chart.cocycle_one
statement: @[simp] lemma cocycle_one (x : Ω) : C.cocycle 1 x=1

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.PlacementInduction.Chart.cocycle_residual
statement:
lemma cocycle_residual (x y : Ω) (g₀ g : G) (h₀ : y=a g₀ x) (hg : y=a g x) :
    C.cocycle g x=C.cocycle g₀ x*(C.pointEquiv x).symm (C.transitionResidual x y g₀ g h₀ hg)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.PlacementInduction.Chart.conditionalBlock_eq
statement:
theorem conditionalBlock_eq (ρ : UnitaryIrrep C.stabilizer) (w : W → ℝ) (g : W → G)
    (x y : Ω) (ω₀ : W) (h₀ : y=a (g ω₀) x) :
    C.conditionalBlock ρ w g y x=ρ.matrix (C.cocycle (g ω₀) x)*C.transitionAverage ρ w g x y ω₀ h₀

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.PlacementInduction.Chart.fixed_character_sum
statement:
lemma fixed_character_sum (ρ : UnitaryIrrep C.stabilizer) (τ : UnitaryIrrep G) (x : Ω) :
    (∑ g : G, if a g x=x then Matrix.trace (ρ.matrix (C.cocycle g x))*Matrix.trace (τ.matrix g⁻¹) else 0)=
      ∑ h : C.stabilizer, Matrix.trace (ρ.matrix h)*Matrix.trace (τ.matrix (h.val)⁻¹)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.PlacementInduction.Chart.induced_character_sum
statement:
lemma induced_character_sum (ρ : UnitaryIrrep C.stabilizer) (τ : UnitaryIrrep G) :
    (∑ g : G, Matrix.trace (C.action ρ g)*Matrix.trace (τ.matrix g⁻¹))=
      (Fintype.card Ω : ℂ)*
        ∑ h : C.stabilizer, Matrix.trace (ρ.matrix h)*Matrix.trace (τ.matrix (h.val)⁻¹)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.PlacementInduction.Chart.induced_moment_bound
statement:
theorem induced_moment_bound (ρ : UnitaryIrrep C.stabilizer) (τ : UnitaryIrrep G)
    {W : Type*} [Fintype W] (w : W → ℂ) (g : W → G) (q : ℕ) :
    (Module.finrank ℂ (ρ.asRepresentation.IntertwiningMap
      (matrixRepresentation (τ.matrix.comp C.stabilizer.subtype))) : ℝ)*
        (Matrix.trace (((averageMatrix τ.matrix w g).conjTranspose*averageMatrix τ.matrix w g)^q)).re ≤
          (Matrix.trace (((averageMatrix (C.action ρ) w g).conjTranspose*averageMatrix (C.action ρ) w g)^q)).re

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.PlacementInduction.Chart.invrep_reaches
statement: lemma invrep_reaches (x : Ω) : a (C.rep x)⁻¹ x=C.base

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.PlacementInduction.Chart.matrix_inv
statement: lemma matrix_inv (g : G) : C.matrix ρ g⁻¹=(C.matrix ρ g).conjTranspose

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.PlacementInduction.Chart.matrix_mul
statement: lemma matrix_mul (g h : G) : C.matrix ρ (g*h)=C.matrix ρ g*C.matrix ρ h

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.PlacementInduction.Chart.matrix_one
statement: lemma matrix_one : C.matrix ρ 1=1

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.PlacementInduction.Chart.matrix_unitary
statement: lemma matrix_unitary (g : G) : (C.matrix ρ g).conjTranspose*C.matrix ρ g=1

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.PlacementInduction.Chart.multiplicity_eq
statement:
theorem multiplicity_eq (ρ : UnitaryIrrep C.stabilizer) (τ : UnitaryIrrep G) :
    Module.finrank ℂ (τ.asRepresentation.IntertwiningMap (matrixRepresentation (C.action ρ)))=
      Module.finrank ℂ (ρ.asRepresentation.IntertwiningMap
        (matrixRepresentation (τ.matrix.comp C.stabilizer.subtype)))

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.PlacementInduction.Chart.trace_matrix
statement:
lemma trace_matrix (g : G) : Matrix.trace (C.matrix ρ g)=
    ∑ x : Ω, if a g x=x then Matrix.trace (ρ.matrix (C.cocycle g x)) else 0

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.PlacementInduction.Chart.transition_columns
statement:
lemma transition_columns (w : W → ℝ) (hs : ∑ ω, w ω=1) (g : W → G) (x : Ω) :
    ∑ y, C.transition w g y x=1

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.PlacementInduction.Chart.transition_nonneg
statement:
lemma transition_nonneg (w : W → ℝ) (hw : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ w ω) (g : W → G) (y x : Ω) :
    0 ≤ C.transition w g y x

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.PlacementInduction.Chart.transition_rows
statement:
lemma transition_rows (w : W → ℝ) (hs : ∑ ω, w ω=1) (g : W → G) (y : Ω) :
    ∑ x, C.transition w g y x=1

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.PlacementInduction.Chart.weight_le_transition
statement:
lemma weight_le_transition (w : W → ℝ) (hw : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ w ω) (g : W → G)
    (x y : Ω) (ω : W) (hω : y=a (g ω) x) : w ω ≤ C.transition w g y x

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.PlacementInduction.Chart.zero_transition_sum
statement:
lemma zero_transition_sum (ρ : UnitaryIrrep C.stabilizer) (w : W → ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ w ω) (g : W → G) (y x : Ω) (hz : C.transition w g y x=0) :
    (∑ ω, if y=a (g ω) x then (w ω : ℂ) • ρ.matrix (C.cocycle (g ω) x) else 0)=0

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.BlockCycles.edgeWeight_columns
statement:
lemma edgeWeight_columns (A B : Matrix (Ω × n) (Ω × n) ℂ) (p : Ω → Ω → ℝ)
    (hc : ∀ x, ∑ y, p y x=1) (hr : ∀ y, ∑ x, p y x=1) (x : Ω) :
    ∑ y, edgeWeight A B p y x=1

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.BlockCycles.edge_moment_nonneg
statement:
lemma edge_moment_nonneg (A B : Matrix (Ω × n) (Ω × n) ℂ)
    (K : Ω → Ω → Matrix n n ℂ) (q : ℕ) (y x : Ω) :
    0 ≤ (Matrix.trace (((edgeFiber A B K y x).conjTranspose*edgeFiber A B K y x)^q)).re

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.BlockCycles.edge_potential
statement:
lemma edge_potential (A B : Matrix (Ω × n) (Ω × n) ℂ) (p : Ω → Ω → ℝ)
    (K : Ω → Ω → Matrix n n ℂ) (q : ℕ) (E : ℝ)
    (hPT : ∀ y x, p y x*(Matrix.trace (((K y x).conjTranspose*K y x)^q)).re ≤ E) (y x : Ω) :
    edgeWeight A B p y x*
      (Matrix.trace (((edgeFiber A B K y x).conjTranspose*edgeFiber A B K y x)^q)).re ≤ E

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.augmented_compatible
statement:
lemma augmented_compatible (x : H.Placement (k := k))
    (ω₀ : {ω : G.Choices // H.Compatible ω}) (ω : G.Choices) :
    (H.augmented x ω₀).Compatible ω ↔ H.Compatible ω ∧
      ∀ i, G.sweep ω (x i).val=G.sweep ω₀.val (x i).val

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.augmented_extends
statement:
lemma augmented_extends (x : H.Placement (k := k))
    (ω₀ : {ω : G.Choices // H.Compatible ω}) : (H.augmented x ω₀).Extends H

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.augmented_feasible
statement:
lemma augmented_feasible (x : H.Placement (k := k)) (ω₀ : {ω : G.Choices // H.Compatible ω}) :
    (H.augmented x ω₀).Feasible

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.placementWeight_nonneg
statement:
lemma placementWeight_nonneg (hf : H.Feasible) {z : ℝ} (hz : 0 ≤ z) (hz' : z < 1)
    (ω : {ω : G.Choices // H.Compatible ω}) : 0 ≤ H.placementWeight z ω

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.placementWeight_sum
statement:
lemma placementWeight_sum (hf : H.Feasible) {z : ℝ} (hz : 0 ≤ z) (hz' : z < 1) :
    ∑ ω, H.placementWeight z ω=1

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.placement_valid
statement: lemma placement_valid (x : H.Placement (k := k)) : H.ValidInput (fun i => (x i).val)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.placements_card_le
statement: lemma placements_card_le : Fintype.card (H.Placement (k := k)) ≤ G.size^k

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.chainWeight_succ
statement:
theorem chainWeight_succ {n : ℕ} (P : Fin (n+1) → Ω → Ω → ℝ)
    (x : Fin (n+2) → Ω) :
    chainWeight P x = P 0 (x 0) (x 1) *
      chainWeight (fun i => P i.succ) (fun i => x i.succ)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.cycle_geometric_identity
statement:
theorem cycle_geometric_identity {n : ℕ} (p : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) (hp : ∀ i, 0 ≤ p i) :
    (∏ i, (p i)^((n : ℝ)/(n+1))) =
      ∏ r, (∏ i, if i = r then (1 : ℝ) else p i)^((n+1 : ℝ)⁻¹)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.deletedCycle_last
statement:
theorem deletedCycle_last {n : ℕ} (P : Fin (n+1) → Ω → Ω → ℝ)
    (x : Fin (n+1) → Ω) :
    deletedCycle P x (Fin.last n) = chainWeight (fun i => P i.castSucc) x

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.deletedCycle_rotate
statement:
theorem deletedCycle_rotate {n : ℕ} (P : Fin (n+1) → Ω → Ω → ℝ)
    (x : Fin (n+1) → Ω) (r : Fin (n+1)) :
    let e := finCycle (r-Fin.last n)
    deletedCycle P x r =
      deletedCycle (fun i => P (e i)) (tupleReindex e x) (Fin.last n)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.prod_deleted_numbers
statement:
theorem prod_deleted_numbers {n : ℕ} (p : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) :
    (∏ r, ∏ i, if i = r then (1 : ℝ) else p i) = (∏ i, p i)^n

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.stochastic_cycle_holder
statement:
theorem stochastic_cycle_holder {n : ℕ} (P : Fin (n+1) → Ω → Ω → ℝ)
    (hP0 : ∀ i x y, 0 ≤ P i x y) (hP : ∀ i y, ∑ x, P i x y = 1) :
    (∑ x : Fin (n+1) → Ω, ∏ i, (P i (x i) (x (i+1)))^((n : ℝ)/(n+1))) ≤
      Fintype.card Ω

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.stochastic_cycle_holder_length
statement:
theorem stochastic_cycle_holder_length {N : ℕ} [NeZero N]
    (P : Fin N → Ω → Ω → ℝ) (hP0 : ∀ i x y, 0 ≤ P i x y)
    (hP : ∀ i y, ∑ x, P i x y=1) :
    (∑ x : Fin N → Ω, ∏ i, (P i (x i) (x (i+1)))^(1-(N : ℝ)⁻¹)) ≤ Fintype.card Ω

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.sum_chainWeight
statement:
theorem sum_chainWeight {n : ℕ} (P : Fin n → Ω → Ω → ℝ)
    (hP : ∀ i y, ∑ x, P i x y = 1) :
    ∑ x, chainWeight P x = Fintype.card Ω

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.sum_deletedCycle
statement:
theorem sum_deletedCycle {n : ℕ} (P : Fin (n+1) → Ω → Ω → ℝ)
    (hP : ∀ i y, ∑ x, P i x y = 1) (r : Fin (n+1)) :
    ∑ x, deletedCycle P x r = Fintype.card Ω

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.sum_tuple_split
statement:
theorem sum_tuple_split (n : ℕ) (f : (Fin (n+1) → Ω) → ℝ) :
    ∑ x, f x = ∑ a, ∑ x, f (Fin.cons a x)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.weighted_root_le
statement:
lemma weighted_root_le {p t E r : ℝ} (hp : 0 ≤ p) (ht : 0 ≤ t) (hE : 0 ≤ E)
    (hr : 0 < r) (hh : p*t ≤ E) :
    p*t^r ≤ E^r*p^(1-r)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.CommutingRestriction.homAction_alternatingSum
statement:
lemma homAction_alternatingSum {Y : Type*} [Fintype Y] [DecidableEq Y]
    (τ : Representation ℂ G V) (σ : Representation ℂ (Equiv.Perm Y) V)
    (hc : ∀ g h, Commute (τ g) (σ h)) (ρ : Representation ℂ G W)
    (color : Y → ℕ) (f : ρ.IntertwiningMap τ) (w : W) :
    (YoungCorner.alternatingSum color (homAction τ σ hc ρ) f) w=
      YoungCorner.alternatingSum color σ (f w)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.CommutingRestriction.homAction_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma homAction_apply (τ : Representation ℂ G V) (σ : Representation ℂ H V)
    (hc : ∀ g h, Commute (τ g) (σ h)) (ρ : Representation ℂ G W)
    (h : H) (f : ρ.IntertwiningMap τ) (w : W) : homAction τ σ hc ρ h f w=σ h (f w)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.CommutingRestriction.homAction_fixedSum
statement:
lemma homAction_fixedSum {Y : Type*} [Fintype Y] [DecidableEq Y]
    (τ : Representation ℂ G V) (σ : Representation ℂ (Equiv.Perm Y) V)
    (hc : ∀ g h, Commute (τ g) (σ h)) (ρ : Representation ℂ G W)
    (color : Y → ℕ) (f : ρ.IntertwiningMap τ) (w : W) :
    (YoungCorner.fixedSum color (homAction τ σ hc ρ) f) w=YoungCorner.fixedSum color σ (f w)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.CommutingRestriction.joint_corner_multiplicity
statement:
theorem joint_corner_multiplicity (τ : Representation ℂ (Equiv.Perm X) V)
    (σ : Representation ℂ (Equiv.Perm Y) V) (hc : ∀ g h, Commute (τ g) (σ h))
    (μ ν : YoungDiagram) (t : X ≃ Boxes μ) (u : Y ≃ Boxes ν)
    (δ : Representation ℂ (Equiv.Perm Y) Z) [δ.IsIrreducible] (hδ : hasShape ν u δ)
    (hne : (fixedSum (rowColor t) τ * alternatingSum (colColor t) τ) *
      (fixedSum (rowColor u) σ * alternatingSum (colColor u) σ) ≠ 0) :
    ∃ S : Subrepresentation τ, S.toRepresentation.IsIrreducible ∧ hasShape μ t S.toRepresentation ∧
      Module.finrank ℂ Z ≤ Module.finrank ℂ (S.toRepresentation.IntertwiningMap τ)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.CommutingRestriction.sum_intertwine
statement:
lemma sum_intertwine {Y : Type*} [Fintype Y] [DecidableEq Y]
    (τ : Representation ℂ G V) (σ : Representation ℂ (Equiv.Perm Y) V)
    (hc : ∀ g h, Commute (τ g) (σ h)) (f g : Y → ℕ) (x : G) :
    Commute (τ x) (YoungCorner.fixedSum f σ * YoungCorner.alternatingSum g σ)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.RestrictionBound.dimension_le_pow_mul
statement:
theorem dimension_le_pow_mul (ρ : Representation ℂ (Equiv.Perm Ω) V) [ρ.IsIrreducible]
    (a : I → Ω) (W : Submodule ℂ V) (hW : W ≠ ⊥)
    (hstable : ∀ g : Equiv.Perm Ω, (∀ i, g (a i)=a i) → ∀ w ∈ W, ρ g w ∈ W) :
    Module.finrank ℂ V ≤ (Fintype.card Ω)^(Fintype.card I)*Module.finrank ℂ W

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.RestrictionBound.orbit_span_top
statement:
lemma orbit_span_top (ρ : Representation ℂ (Equiv.Perm Ω) V) [ρ.IsIrreducible]
