    (v : V) (hv : v ≠ 0) : Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range (fun g => ρ g v))=⊤

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.YoungCorner.alternatingSum_absorb
statement:
lemma alternatingSum_absorb (f : X → ℕ) (g : Y → ℕ) (τ : Equiv.Perm X →* A)
    (φ : Equiv.Perm Y →* Equiv.Perm X)
    (hφ : ∀ c : colorStabilizer g, φ c.val ∈ colorStabilizer f)
    (hs : ∀ c : Equiv.Perm Y, signScalar (φ c)=signScalar c) :
    alternatingSum g (τ.comp φ) * alternatingSum f τ=
      (Fintype.card (colorStabilizer g) : ℂ) • alternatingSum f τ

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.YoungCorner.alternatingSum_reparam
statement:
lemma alternatingSum_reparam (e : X ≃ Y) (f : Y → ℕ) (τ : Representation ℂ (Equiv.Perm Y) V) :
    alternatingSum (fun x => f (e x)) (τ.comp e.permCongrHom)=alternatingSum f τ

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.YoungCorner.boxesSplit_inl
statement:
@[simp] lemma boxesSplit_inl (μ : YoungDiagram) (p : ℕ) (x : Boxes (hookPart μ p)) :
    (boxesSplit μ p (Sum.inl x)).val=x.val

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.YoungCorner.boxesSplit_inr
statement:
@[simp] lemma boxesSplit_inr (μ : YoungDiagram) (p : ℕ) (x : Boxes (removedPart μ p)) :
    (boxesSplit μ p (Sum.inr x)).val=shifted p x.val

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.YoungCorner.fixedSum_absorb
statement:
lemma fixedSum_absorb (f : X → ℕ) (g : Y → ℕ) (τ : Equiv.Perm X →* A)
    (φ : Equiv.Perm Y →* Equiv.Perm X)
    (hφ : ∀ r : colorStabilizer g, φ r.val ∈ colorStabilizer f) :
    fixedSum f τ * fixedSum g (τ.comp φ)=
      (Fintype.card (colorStabilizer g) : ℂ) • fixedSum f τ

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.YoungCorner.fixedSum_reparam
statement:
lemma fixedSum_reparam (e : X ≃ Y) (f : Y → ℕ) (τ : Representation ℂ (Equiv.Perm Y) V) :
    fixedSum (fun x => f (e x)) (τ.comp e.permCongrHom)=fixedSum f τ

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.YoungCorner.hasShape_reparam
statement:
lemma hasShape_reparam (μ : YoungDiagram) (e : X ≃ Y) (t : Y ≃ Boxes μ)
    (τ : Representation ℂ (Equiv.Perm Y) V) :
    hasShape μ (e.trans t) (τ.comp e.permCongrHom) ↔ hasShape μ t τ

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.YoungCorner.hookPart_property
statement: lemma hookPart_property (μ : YoungDiagram) (p : ℕ) (x : Boxes (hookPart μ p)) : x.val.1

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.YoungCorner.hook_dimension_upper
statement:
theorem hook_dimension_upper {V : Type} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V]
    [FiniteDimensional ℂ V] (μ : YoungDiagram) (p : ℕ)
    (τ : Representation ℂ (Equiv.Perm (Boxes μ)) V) [τ.IsIrreducible]
    (S : Subrepresentation (τ.comp (leftPerm (boxesSplit μ p)))) (hS : S ≠ ⊥) :
    Module.finrank ℂ V ≤ (Fintype.card (Boxes μ))^(Fintype.card (Boxes (removedPart μ p))) *
      Module.finrank ℂ S.toSubmodule

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.YoungCorner.hook_removed_joint
statement:
lemma hook_removed_joint {A : Type*} [Ring A] [Algebra ℂ A]
    (μ : YoungDiagram) (p : ℕ) (τ : Equiv.Perm (Boxes μ) →* A)
    (hμ : fixedSum (fun x : Boxes μ => x.val.1) τ * alternatingSum (fun x : Boxes μ => x.val.2) τ ≠ 0) :
    (fixedSum (fun x : Boxes (hookPart μ p) => x.val.1) (τ.comp (leftPerm (boxesSplit μ p))) *
      alternatingSum (fun x : Boxes (hookPart μ p) => x.val.2) (τ.comp (leftPerm (boxesSplit μ p)))) *
    (fixedSum (fun x : Boxes (removedPart μ p) => x.val.1) (τ.comp (rightPerm (boxesSplit μ p))) *
      alternatingSum (fun x : Boxes (removedPart μ p) => x.val.2) (τ.comp (rightPerm (boxesSplit μ p)))) ≠ 0

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.YoungCorner.hook_removed_multiplicity
statement:
theorem hook_removed_multiplicity {V W : Type} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V]
    [FiniteDimensional ℂ V] [AddCommGroup W] [Module ℂ W] [FiniteDimensional ℂ W]
    (μ : YoungDiagram) (p : ℕ) (τ : Representation ℂ (Equiv.Perm (Boxes μ)) V)
    (hτ : hasShape μ (Equiv.refl _) τ)
    (δ : Representation ℂ (Equiv.Perm (Boxes (removedPart μ p))) W) [δ.IsIrreducible]
    (hδ : hasShape (removedPart μ p) (Equiv.refl _) δ) :
    ∃ S : Subrepresentation (τ.comp (leftPerm (boxesSplit μ p))),
      S.toRepresentation.IsIrreducible ∧ hasShape (hookPart μ p) (Equiv.refl _) S.toRepresentation ∧
      Module.finrank ℂ W ≤ Module.finrank ℂ
        (S.toRepresentation.IntertwiningMap (τ.comp (leftPerm (boxesSplit μ p))))

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.YoungCorner.joint_of_full_corner
statement:
lemma joint_of_full_corner (τ : Equiv.Perm X →* A)
    (fR fC : X → ℕ) (gR gC : Y → ℕ) (hR hC : Z → ℕ)
    (φ : Equiv.Perm Y →* Equiv.Perm X) (ψ : Equiv.Perm Z →* Equiv.Perm X)
    (hφR : ∀ r : colorStabilizer gR, φ r.val ∈ colorStabilizer fR)
    (hφC : ∀ c : colorStabilizer gC, φ c.val ∈ colorStabilizer fC)
    (hψR : ∀ r : colorStabilizer hR, ψ r.val ∈ colorStabilizer fR)
    (hψC : ∀ c : colorStabilizer hC, ψ c.val ∈ colorStabilizer fC)
    (hφs : ∀ g : Equiv.Perm Y, signScalar (φ g)=signScalar g)
    (hψs : ∀ g : Equiv.Perm Z, signScalar (ψ g)=signScalar g)
    (hcomm : ∀ g h, Commute (φ g) (ψ h))
    (hne : fixedSum fR τ * alternatingSum fC τ ≠ 0) :
    (fixedSum gR (τ.comp φ)*alternatingSum gC (τ.comp φ)) *
      (fixedSum hR (τ.comp ψ)*alternatingSum hC (τ.comp ψ)) ≠ 0

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.YoungCorner.leftPerm_cols
statement:
lemma leftPerm_cols (μ : YoungDiagram) (p : ℕ) (c : cols (hookPart μ p)) :
    leftPerm (boxesSplit μ p) c.val ∈ cols μ

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.YoungCorner.leftPerm_inl
statement:
@[simp] lemma leftPerm_inl (e : Y ⊕ Z ≃ X) (g : Equiv.Perm Y) (x : Y) :
    leftPerm e g (e (Sum.inl x))=e (Sum.inl (g x))

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.YoungCorner.leftPerm_inr
statement:
@[simp] lemma leftPerm_inr (e : Y ⊕ Z ≃ X) (g : Equiv.Perm Y) (x : Z) :
    leftPerm e g (e (Sum.inr x))=e (Sum.inr x)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.YoungCorner.leftPerm_range_of_fix_right
statement:
lemma leftPerm_range_of_fix_right (e : Y ⊕ Z ≃ X) (g : Equiv.Perm X)
    (hfix : ∀ z, g (e (Sum.inr z))=e (Sum.inr z)) : ∃ h, leftPerm e h=g

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.YoungCorner.leftPerm_rows
statement:
lemma leftPerm_rows (μ : YoungDiagram) (p : ℕ) (r : rows (hookPart μ p)) :
    leftPerm (boxesSplit μ p) r.val ∈ rows μ

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.YoungCorner.mem_hookPart
statement: @[simp] lemma mem_hookPart (μ : YoungDiagram) (p : ℕ) (x : ℕ × ℕ) : x ∈ hookPart μ p ↔ x ∈ μ ∧ (x.1

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.YoungCorner.mem_removedPart
statement:
@[simp] lemma mem_removedPart (μ : YoungDiagram) (p : ℕ) (x : ℕ × ℕ) :
    x ∈ removedPart μ p ↔ shifted p x ∈ μ

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.YoungCorner.rectangle_card_le
statement:
lemma rectangle_card_le (μ : YoungDiagram) (x : Boxes μ) :
    (x.val.1+1)*(x.val.2+1)≤Fintype.card (Boxes μ)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.YoungCorner.removedPart_rank_lt
statement:
lemma removedPart_rank_lt (μ : YoungDiagram) (p : ℕ) (x : Boxes (removedPart μ p)) :
    x.val.1+x.val.2 < 2*(Fintype.card (Boxes μ)/(p+1))

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.YoungCorner.rightPerm_cols
statement:
lemma rightPerm_cols (μ : YoungDiagram) (p : ℕ) (c : cols (removedPart μ p)) :
    rightPerm (boxesSplit μ p) c.val ∈ cols μ

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.YoungCorner.rightPerm_inl
statement:
@[simp] lemma rightPerm_inl (e : Y ⊕ Z ≃ X) (g : Equiv.Perm Z) (x : Y) :
    rightPerm e g (e (Sum.inl x))=e (Sum.inl x)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.YoungCorner.rightPerm_inr
statement:
@[simp] lemma rightPerm_inr (e : Y ⊕ Z ≃ X) (g : Equiv.Perm Z) (x : Z) :
    rightPerm e g (e (Sum.inr x))=e (Sum.inr (g x))

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.YoungCorner.rightPerm_rows
statement:
lemma rightPerm_rows (μ : YoungDiagram) (p : ℕ) (r : rows (removedPart μ p)) :
    rightPerm (boxesSplit μ p) r.val ∈ rows μ

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.YoungCorner.shifted_injective
statement: lemma shifted_injective (p : ℕ) : Function.Injective (shifted p)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.YoungCorner.signScalar_leftPerm
statement:
lemma signScalar_leftPerm (e : Y ⊕ Z ≃ X) (g : Equiv.Perm Y) :
    signScalar (leftPerm e g)=signScalar g

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.YoungCorner.signScalar_ne_zero
statement: lemma signScalar_ne_zero (g : Equiv.Perm X) : signScalar g ≠ 0

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.YoungCorner.signScalar_rightPerm
statement:
lemma signScalar_rightPerm (e : Y ⊕ Z ≃ X) (g : Equiv.Perm Z) :
    signScalar (rightPerm e g)=signScalar g

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.YoungCorner.splitPerm_commute
statement:
lemma splitPerm_commute (e : Y ⊕ Z ≃ X) (g : Equiv.Perm Y) (h : Equiv.Perm Z) :
    Commute (leftPerm e g) (rightPerm e h)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.YoungCorner.split_card
statement:
lemma split_card (μ : YoungDiagram) (p : ℕ) :
    Fintype.card (Boxes (hookPart μ p))+Fintype.card (Boxes (removedPart μ p))=
      Fintype.card (Boxes μ)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.endpoint_productMass
statement:
theorem endpoint_productMass (p : Fin k → G.Slot × G.Slot) :
    Coverage.productMass G.endpointWeight p = (G.size : ℝ)⁻¹^(2*k)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.extraProbability_nonneg
statement:
theorem extraProbability_nonneg (H : G.Holes h) (x y : Fin k → G.Slot)
    (A : Finset (Fin k)) (μ : ∀ j, FiniteLaw (Equiv.Perm (Cube (G.bits j)))) :
    0 ≤ H.extraProbability x y A μ

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.placementHSsq_eq_full
statement:
theorem placementHSsq_eq_full (H : G.Holes h)
    (μ : ∀ j, FiniteLaw (Equiv.Perm (Cube (G.bits j)))) :
    H.placementHSsq (k := k) μ =
      ∑ p : Fin k → G.Slot × G.Slot,
        Coverage.productMass G.endpointWeight p *
          if H.ValidInput (fun i => (p i).1) ∧ H.ValidOutput (fun i => (p i).2) then
            ((G.size : ℝ)^k * H.placementKernel (fun i => (p i).1) (fun i => (p i).2) μ)^2
          else 0

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.retainedSite_ne_removed
statement:
lemma retainedSite_ne_removed (a : Boxes (hookPart μ p))
    (i : Fin (Fintype.card (Boxes (removedPart μ p)))) :
    H.retainedSite μ p e a ≠ H.removedPlacement μ p e i

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.UnitaryIrrep.asRepresentation_pullback
statement:
lemma asRepresentation_pullback (ρ : UnitaryIrrep Γ) (e : Λ ≃* Γ) :
    (ρ.pullback e).asRepresentation=ρ.asRepresentation.comp e.toMonoidHom

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.UnitaryIrrep.dimension_eq_finrank
statement:
lemma dimension_eq_finrank (ρ : UnitaryIrrep Γ) :
    Module.finrank ℂ (Fin ρ.dimension → ℂ)=ρ.dimension

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.MomentExpansion.NonnegCoeffs.add
statement:
theorem NonnegCoeffs.add {p q : MvPolynomial L ℝ} (hp : NonnegCoeffs p) (hq : NonnegCoeffs q) :
    NonnegCoeffs (p+q)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.MomentExpansion.NonnegCoeffs.mul
statement:
theorem NonnegCoeffs.mul {p q : MvPolynomial L ℝ} (hp : NonnegCoeffs p) (hq : NonnegCoeffs q) :
    NonnegCoeffs (p*q)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.MomentExpansion.centered_power_le
statement:
theorem centered_power_le (C x : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hx1 : x ≤ 1) (b : ℕ) :
    (1+C*x)^b-1 ≤ ((1+C)^b-1)*x

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.MomentExpansion.fallingCenteredMoment_eq_integral
statement:
theorem fallingCenteredMoment_eq_integral {L : Type*} (m h : L → ℕ) (l : L)
    (hm : 0 < m l) (v u : ℕ) (huv : v+u ≤ m l-h l) :
    lineCenteredMoment (fun l => fallingMoment (m l) (h l)) l v u =
      ∫ x, ((m l : ℝ)/x)^v * ((m l : ℝ)/x-1)^u
        ∂gammaMeasure ((m l-h l : ℕ)+1) 1

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.MomentExpansion.fallingMoment_eq_integral
statement:
theorem fallingMoment_eq_integral {m h n : ℕ} (hn : n ≤ m-h) :
    fallingMoment m h n =
      ∫ x, ((m : ℝ)/x)^n ∂gammaMeasure ((m-h : ℕ)+1) 1

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.MomentExpansion.fallingMoment_integrable
statement:
theorem fallingMoment_integrable {m h n : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (hn : n ≤ m-h) :
    Integrable (fun x => ((m : ℝ)/x)^n) (gammaMeasure ((m-h : ℕ)+1) 1)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.MomentExpansion.fallingMoment_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem fallingMoment_zero (m h : ℕ) : fallingMoment m h 0 = 1

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.MomentExpansion.goodExpansion_degree
statement:
theorem goodExpansion_degree (G : Finset I) (path : I → J → L) (l : L) :
    (goodExpansion G path).degreeOf l ≤ ∑ i ∈ G, ∑ j : J, if path i j = l then 1 else 0

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.MomentExpansion.goodExpansion_eval
statement:
theorem goodExpansion_eval (G : Finset I) (path : I → J → L) (t : ℝ) :
    MvPolynomial.eval (fun _ => t) (goodExpansion G path) =
      ((1+t)^Fintype.card J-1)^G.card

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.MomentExpansion.goodExpansion_eval_le
statement:
theorem goodExpansion_eval_le (G : Finset I) (path : I → J → L)
    (C x : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hx1 : x ≤ 1) :
    MvPolynomial.eval (fun _ => C*x) (goodExpansion G path) ≤
      (1+C)^(Fintype.card J*G.card) * x^G.card

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.MomentExpansion.goodExpansion_nonneg
statement:
theorem goodExpansion_nonneg (G : Finset I) (path : I → J → L) :
    NonnegCoeffs (goodExpansion G path)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.MomentExpansion.nonnegCoeffs_X
statement: theorem nonnegCoeffs_X (l : L) : NonnegCoeffs (X l : MvPolynomial L ℝ)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.MomentExpansion.nonnegCoeffs_one
statement: theorem nonnegCoeffs_one : NonnegCoeffs (1 : MvPolynomial L ℝ)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.MomentExpansion.nonnegCoeffs_prod
statement:
theorem nonnegCoeffs_prod {I : Type*} (S : Finset I) (p : I → MvPolynomial L ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ i ∈ S, NonnegCoeffs (p i)) : NonnegCoeffs (∏ i ∈ S, p i)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.MomentExpansion.nonnegCoeffs_sum
statement:
theorem nonnegCoeffs_sum {I : Type*} (S : Finset I) (p : I → MvPolynomial L ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ i ∈ S, NonnegCoeffs (p i)) : NonnegCoeffs (∑ i ∈ S, p i)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.MomentExpansion.pathExpansion_degree
statement:
theorem pathExpansion_degree (S : Finset J) (f : J → L) (l : L) :
    (pathExpansion S f).degreeOf l ≤ ∑ j ∈ S, if f j = l then 1 else 0

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.MomentExpansion.pathExpansion_eq
statement:
theorem pathExpansion_eq (S : Finset J) (f : J → L) :
    pathExpansion S f = (∏ j ∈ S, ((X (f j) : MvPolynomial L ℝ)+1))-1

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.MomentExpansion.pathExpansion_eval
statement:
theorem pathExpansion_eval (S : Finset J) (f : J → L) (t : ℝ) :
    MvPolynomial.eval (fun _ => t) (pathExpansion S f) = (1+t)^S.card-1

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.MomentExpansion.pathExpansion_nonneg
statement:
theorem pathExpansion_nonneg (S : Finset J) (f : J → L) :
    NonnegCoeffs (pathExpansion S f)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.MomentExpansion.pathExpansion_shift
statement:
theorem pathExpansion_shift (S : Finset J) (f : J → L) :
    MvPolynomial.aeval (fun l => (X l : MvPolynomial L ℝ)-1) (pathExpansion S f) =
      (∏ j ∈ S, (X (f j) : MvPolynomial L ℝ))-1

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.MomentExpansion.shiftedMoment_goodExpansion_eq
statement:
theorem shiftedMoment_goodExpansion_eq (m : L → ℕ → ℝ) (r : L → ℕ)
    (G : Finset I) (path : I → J → L) :
    shiftedMoment m r (goodExpansion G path) =
      ∑ A ∈ G.powerset, (-1 : ℝ)^A.card * ∏ l, m l (r l+incidenceCount (G\A) path l)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.MomentExpansion.shiftedMoment_monomial
statement:
theorem shiftedMoment_monomial (m : L → ℕ → ℝ) (hm : ∀ l, m l 0 = 1)
    (r : L → ℕ) (d : L →₀ ℕ) (a : ℝ) :
    shiftedMoment m r (monomial d a) = a * ∏ l, lineCenteredMoment m l (r l) (d l)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.MomentExpansion.tensorMoment_X_centered_power
statement:
theorem tensorMoment_X_centered_power (m : L → ℕ → ℝ) (hm : ∀ l, m l 0 = 1)
    (l : L) (r u : ℕ) :
    tensorMoment m ((X l : MvPolynomial L ℝ)^r * (X l-1)^u) =
      lineCenteredMoment m l r u

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.MomentExpansion.tensorMoment_X_pow
statement:
theorem tensorMoment_X_pow (m : L → ℕ → ℝ) (hm : ∀ l, m l 0 = 1) (l : L) (n : ℕ) :
    tensorMoment m (X l ^ n) = m l n

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.MomentExpansion.tensorMoment_monomial
statement:
@[simp] theorem tensorMoment_monomial (m : L → ℕ → ℝ) (d : L →₀ ℕ) (a : ℝ) :
    tensorMoment m (monomial d a) = a * ∏ l, m l (d l)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.MomentExpansion.tensorMoment_mul_disjoint
statement:
theorem tensorMoment_mul_disjoint (m : L → ℕ → ℝ) (hm : ∀ l, m l 0 = 1)
    (p q : MvPolynomial L ℝ) (hd : Disjoint p.vars q.vars) :
    tensorMoment m (p*q) = tensorMoment m p * tensorMoment m q

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.MomentExpansion.tensorMoment_one
statement:
@[simp] theorem tensorMoment_one (m : L → ℕ → ℝ) (hm : ∀ l, m l 0 = 1) :
    tensorMoment m 1 = 1

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.MomentExpansion.tensorMoment_path_monomial
statement:
theorem tensorMoment_path_monomial (m : L → ℕ → ℝ) (r : L → ℕ)
    (A : Finset I) (path : I → J → L) :
    tensorMoment m ((∏ l, (X l : MvPolynomial L ℝ)^r l) *
      ∏ i ∈ A, ∏ j : J, X (path i j)) =
        ∏ l, m l (r l+incidenceCount A path l)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.MomentExpansion.tensorMoment_prod_separated
statement:
theorem tensorMoment_prod_separated (m : L → ℕ → ℝ) (hm : ∀ l, m l 0 = 1)
    (S : Finset L) (p : L → MvPolynomial L ℝ) (hp : ∀ l ∈ S, (p l).vars ⊆ {l}) :
    tensorMoment m (∏ l ∈ S, p l) = ∏ l ∈ S, tensorMoment m (p l)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.MomentExpansion.tensorMoment_sum
statement:
theorem tensorMoment_sum (m : L → ℕ → ℝ) (p : MvPolynomial L ℝ) :
    tensorMoment m p = ∑ d ∈ p.support, p.coeff d * ∏ l, m l (d l)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.MomentExpansion.vars_X_centered_power
statement:
theorem vars_X_centered_power (l : L) (r u : ℕ) :
    (((X l : MvPolynomial L ℝ)^r) * (X l - 1)^u).vars ⊆ {l}

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.abs_pow_integrable
statement:
theorem abs_pow_integrable {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω}
    {X : Ω → ℝ} (hX : AEMeasurable X μ) (u : ℕ) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t)
    (hp : Integrable (fun x => exp (t * X x)) μ)
    (hn : Integrable (fun x => exp (-t * X x)) μ) :
    Integrable (fun x => |X x|^u) μ

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.abs_pow_integral_le
statement:
theorem abs_pow_integral_le {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω}
    {X : Ω → ℝ} (hX : AEMeasurable X μ) (u : ℕ) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t)
    (hp : Integrable (fun x => exp (t * X x)) μ)
    (hn : Integrable (fun x => exp (-t * X x)) μ) :
    (∫ x, |X x|^u ∂μ) ≤ ((u : ℝ)/t)^u *
      ((∫ x, exp (t*X x) ∂μ) + (∫ x, exp (-t*X x) ∂μ))

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.abs_pow_le_exp_sum
statement:
theorem abs_pow_le_exp_sum (x : ℝ) (u : ℕ) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) :
    |x|^u ≤ ((u : ℝ)/t)^u * (exp (t*x) + exp (-t*x))

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.gamma_abs_centered_moment_le
statement:
theorem gamma_abs_centered_moment_le {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) {u : ℕ}
    (hu : 1 ≤ u) (hua : 4*(u : ℝ) ≤ a) :
    (∫ x, |x-a|^u ∂gammaMeasure a 1) ≤
      (2 * exp 2 * Real.sqrt (a*u))^u

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.gamma_centered_mgf
statement:
theorem gamma_centered_mgf {a t : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (ht : t < 1) :
    (∫ x, exp (t*(x-a)) ∂gammaMeasure a 1) = exp (a*(-t-log (1-t)))

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.gamma_centered_mgf_integrable
statement:
theorem gamma_centered_mgf_integrable {a t : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (ht : t < 1) :
    Integrable (fun x => exp (t*(x-a))) (gammaMeasure a 1)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.gamma_centered_mgf_le
statement:
theorem gamma_centered_mgf_le {a t : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (ht : |t| ≤ 1/2) :
    (∫ x, exp (t*(x-a)) ∂gammaMeasure a 1) ≤ exp (2*a*t^2)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.gamma_inverse_tilt
statement:
theorem gamma_inverse_tilt {a m : ℝ} (k : ℕ) (hak : (k : ℝ) < a)
    (f : ℝ → ℝ) :
    (∫ x, (m/x)^k * f x ∂gammaMeasure a 1) =
      (m^k * Gamma (a-k) / Gamma a) * (∫ x, f x ∂gammaMeasure (a-k) 1)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.gamma_light_line_identity
statement:
theorem gamma_light_line_identity {m h u v : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (huv : h+u+v ≤ m) :
    (∫ x, ((m : ℝ)/x)^v * |(m : ℝ)/x-1|^u
      ∂gammaMeasure ((m-h : ℕ)+1) 1) =
      ((m : ℝ)^(u+v) / ((m-h).descFactorial (u+v) : ℝ)) *
      (∫ x, |1-x/(m : ℝ)|^u ∂gammaMeasure ((m-h : ℕ)+1-(u+v : ℕ)) 1)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.gamma_mgf
statement:
theorem gamma_mgf {a t : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (ht : t < 1) :
    (∫ x, exp (t*x) ∂gammaMeasure a 1) = (1/(1-t))^a

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.gamma_mgf_integrable
statement:
theorem gamma_mgf_integrable {a t : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (ht : t < 1) :
    Integrable (fun x => exp (t*x)) (gammaMeasure a 1)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.gamma_normalized_moment_le
statement:
theorem gamma_normalized_moment_le {a m η : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hm : 0 < m)
    (hη : 0 ≤ η) (hη1 : η ≤ 1) {u : ℕ} (hu : 1 ≤ u)
    (hua : 4*(u : ℝ) ≤ a) (ham : a ≤ m) (huη : (u : ℝ) ≤ m*η)
    (hbias : |1-a/m| ≤ η) :
    (∫ x, |1-x/m|^u ∂gammaMeasure a 1) ≤
      (8 * exp 2 * Real.sqrt η)^u

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.gamma_ratio_descFactorial
statement:
theorem gamma_ratio_descFactorial {n k : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ n) :
    Gamma ((n : ℝ)+1-k) / Gamma ((n : ℝ)+1) = (n.descFactorial k : ℝ)⁻¹

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.integral_gamma_congr
statement:
theorem integral_gamma_congr {a r : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hr : 0 < r)
    {f g : ℝ → ℝ} (hfg : ∀ x, 0 < x → f x = g x) :
    (∫ x, f x ∂gammaMeasure a r) = ∫ x, g x ∂gammaMeasure a r

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.integral_gamma_eq
statement:
theorem integral_gamma_eq {a r : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hr : 0 < r) (f : ℝ → ℝ) :
    (∫ x, f x ∂gammaMeasure a r) =
      ∫ x in Ioi 0, (r^a / Gamma a * x^(a-1) * exp (-(r*x))) * f x

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.log_mgf_bound
statement: theorem log_mgf_bound {t : ℝ} (ht : |t| ≤ 1/2) : -t - log (1-t) ≤ 2*t^2

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.adjoin_compatible_iff
statement:
theorem adjoin_compatible_iff (H : G.Holes h) (x y : Fin k → G.Slot) (A : Finset (Fin k))
    (hv : H.JointDisjoint x y A) (ω : G.Choices) :
    (H.adjoin x y A hv).Compatible ω ↔ H.Compatible ω ∧ G.endpointEvent x y A ω

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.adjoin_new
statement:
@[simp] theorem adjoin_new (H : G.Holes h) (x y : Fin k → G.Slot) (A : Finset (Fin k))
    (hv : H.JointDisjoint x y A) (a : Fin A.card) (s : Fin (G.b+1)) :
    (H.adjoin x y A hv).path (Fin.natAdd h a) s =
      G.pathBetween (x (selected A a)) (y (selected A a)) s

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.adjoin_old
statement:
@[simp] theorem adjoin_old (H : G.Holes h) (x y : Fin k → G.Slot) (A : Finset (Fin k))
    (hv : H.JointDisjoint x y A) (a : Fin h) (s : Fin (G.b+1)) :
    (H.adjoin x y A hv).path (Fin.castAdd A.card a) s = H.path a s

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.alternating_good_extensions
statement:
theorem alternating_good_extensions (H : G.Holes h) (x y : Fin k → G.Slot)
    (hx : H.ValidInput x) (η : ℝ) (J : Finset (Fin k))
    (hJ : Disjoint J (H.goodSet x y η)) :
    (∑ A ∈ (H.goodSet x y η).powerset, (-1 : ℝ)^A.card *
      ((G.size : ℝ)^(J∪(H.goodSet x y η\A)).card *
        H.extraProbability x y (J∪(H.goodSet x y η\A)) (fun _ => FiniteLaw.uniform _))) =
      (if H.EndpointPossible x y J then H.nonlightFactor x y η J else 0) *
        shiftedMoment (H.lightMoment x y η) (incidenceCount J (G.stagePath x y))
          (goodExpansion (H.goodSet x y η) (G.stagePath x y))

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.augment_selected_extraCount
statement:
theorem augment_selected_extraCount (H : G.Holes h) (x y : Fin k → G.Slot)
    (hx : H.ValidInput x) (A : Finset (Fin k)) (ω : G.Choices) (hω : H.Compatible ω)
    (he : G.endpointEvent x y A ω) (j : Fin G.b) (L : G.Line j) :
    (H.augment (fun i => x (selected A i)) (fun i => y (selected A i))
      (H.validInput_selected x hx A) ω hω ((endpointEvent_iff_selected x y A ω).mp he)).extraCount j L =
      auxCount x y A j L

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.auxCount_sum
statement:
theorem auxCount_sum (x y : Fin k → G.Slot) (A : Finset (Fin k)) (j : Fin G.b) :
    ∑ L : G.Line j, auxCount x y A j L = A.card

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.descFactorial_add_split
statement:
theorem descFactorial_add_split (n a b : ℕ) :
    n.descFactorial (a+b) = n.descFactorial a * (n-a).descFactorial b

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.endpointPossible_iff_jointDisjoint
statement:
theorem endpointPossible_iff_jointDisjoint (H : G.Holes h) (x y : Fin k → G.Slot)
    (hx : H.ValidInput x) (A : Finset (Fin k)) :
    H.EndpointPossible x y A ↔ H.JointDisjoint x y A

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.endpointPossible_lineCount_le
statement:
theorem endpointPossible_lineCount_le (H : G.Holes h) (x y : Fin k → G.Slot)
    (hx : H.ValidInput x) (A : Finset (Fin k)) (hA : H.EndpointPossible x y A)
    (l : G.StageLine) : H.lineCount l.1 l.2 + incidenceCount A (G.stagePath x y) l ≤ 2^G.bits l.1

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.endpointPossible_union_iff
statement:
theorem endpointPossible_union_iff (H : G.Holes h) (x y : Fin k → G.Slot)
    (hx : H.ValidInput x) (A S : Finset (Fin k))
    (hS : ∀ i ∈ S, H.VertexIsolated x y i) :
    H.EndpointPossible x y (A∪S) ↔ H.EndpointPossible x y A

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.feasible_of_disjoint_paths
statement: theorem feasible_of_disjoint_paths (H : G.Holes h) : H.Feasible

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.incidenceCount_good_nonlight
OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.incidenceCount_mono
OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.incidenceCount_stagePath
statement:
theorem incidenceCount_stagePath (x y : Fin k → G.Slot) (A : Finset (Fin k))
    (j : Fin G.b) (L : G.Line j) :
    incidenceCount A (G.stagePath x y) ⟨j,L⟩ = auxCount x y A j L

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.incidenceCount_stagePath_any
statement:
theorem incidenceCount_stagePath_any (x y : Fin k → G.Slot) (A : Finset (Fin k))
    (l : G.StageLine) :
    incidenceCount A (G.stagePath x y) l = auxCount x y A l.1 l.2

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.incidenceCount_total
statement:
theorem incidenceCount_total (x y : Fin k → G.Slot) (A : Finset (Fin k)) :
    ∑ l : G.StageLine, incidenceCount A (G.stagePath x y) l = G.b*A.card

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.incidenceCount_union
statement:
theorem incidenceCount_union (x y : Fin k → G.Slot) {A B : Finset (Fin k)}
    (hAB : Disjoint A B) (l : G.StageLine) :
    incidenceCount (A∪B) (G.stagePath x y) l =
      incidenceCount A (G.stagePath x y) l + incidenceCount B (G.stagePath x y) l

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.jointDisjoint_mono
statement:
theorem jointDisjoint_mono (H : G.Holes h) (x y : Fin k → G.Slot)
    {A B : Finset (Fin k)} (hAB : A ⊆ B) (hB : H.JointDisjoint x y B) :
    H.JointDisjoint x y A

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.jointDisjoint_union_iff
statement:
theorem jointDisjoint_union_iff (H : G.Holes h) (x y : Fin k → G.Slot)
    (A S : Finset (Fin k)) (hS : ∀ i ∈ S, H.VertexIsolated x y i) :
    H.JointDisjoint x y (A∪S) ↔ H.JointDisjoint x y A

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.lightMoment_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem lightMoment_zero (H : G.Holes h) (x y : Fin k → G.Slot) (η : ℝ) (l : G.StageLine) :
    H.lightMoment x y η l 0 = 1

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.mem_goodSet
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_goodSet (H : G.Holes h) (x y : Fin k → G.Slot) (η : ℝ) (i : Fin k) :
    i ∈ H.goodSet x y η ↔ H.Good x y η i

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.nonlightFactor_nonneg
statement:
theorem nonlightFactor_nonneg (H : G.Holes h) (x y : Fin k → G.Slot)
    (η : ℝ) (J : Finset (Fin k)) : 0 ≤ H.nonlightFactor x y η J

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.scaled_extraProbability_good_union
statement:
theorem scaled_extraProbability_good_union (H : G.Holes h) (x y : Fin k → G.Slot)
    (hx : H.ValidInput x) (η : ℝ) (J S : Finset (Fin k))
    (hJ : Disjoint J (H.goodSet x y η)) (hS : S ⊆ H.goodSet x y η) :
    (G.size : ℝ)^(J∪S).card * H.extraProbability x y (J∪S) (fun _ => FiniteLaw.uniform _) =
      (if H.EndpointPossible x y J then H.nonlightFactor x y η J else 0) *
        ∏ l : G.StageLine, H.lightMoment x y η l
          (incidenceCount J (G.stagePath x y) l+incidenceCount S (G.stagePath x y) l)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.scaled_extraProbability_uniform
statement:
theorem scaled_extraProbability_uniform (H : G.Holes h) (x y : Fin k → G.Slot)
    (hx : H.ValidInput x) (A : Finset (Fin k)) :
    (G.size : ℝ)^A.card * H.extraProbability x y A (fun _ => FiniteLaw.uniform _) =
      if H.EndpointPossible x y A then
        ∏ j, ∏ L : G.Line j, fallingMoment (2^G.bits j) (H.lineCount j L) (auxCount x y A j L)
      else 0

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.selected_sum
statement:
theorem selected_sum {R : Type*} [AddCommMonoid R]
    (A : Finset (Fin k)) (f : Fin k → R) :
    (∑ i : Fin A.card, f (selected A i)) = ∑ a ∈ A, f a

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.size_pow_eq_aux_product
statement:
theorem size_pow_eq_aux_product (x y : Fin k → G.Slot) (A : Finset (Fin k)) :
    (G.size : ℝ)^A.card =
      ∏ j, ∏ L : G.Line j, ((2^G.bits j : ℕ) : ℝ)^auxCount x y A j L

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.MomentExpansion.fallingMoment_one_le
statement: theorem fallingMoment_one_le {m h n : ℕ} (hn : h+n ≤ m) : 1 ≤ fallingMoment m h n

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.alternating_good_split
statement:
theorem alternating_good_split [Fintype I] (G : Finset I) (f : Finset I → ℝ) :
    (∑ A ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset I).powerset,
      (-1 : ℝ)^(Fintype.card I-A.card)*f A) =
    ∑ J ∈ ((Finset.univ : Finset I)\G).powerset,
      (-1 : ℝ)^(Fintype.card I-J.card-G.card) *
        ∑ A ∈ G.powerset, (-1 : ℝ)^A.card * f (J ∪ (G\A))

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.sum_powerset_sdiff
statement:
theorem sum_powerset_sdiff {R : Type*} [AddCommMonoid R]
    (A : Finset I) (f : Finset I → R) :
    ∑ S ∈ A.powerset, f (A\S) = ∑ S ∈ A.powerset, f S

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.sum_powerset_union
statement:
theorem sum_powerset_union {R : Type*} [AddCommMonoid R]
    (A B : Finset I) (hAB : Disjoint A B) (f : Finset I → R) :
    ∑ S ∈ (A∪B).powerset, f S =
      ∑ J ∈ A.powerset, ∑ S ∈ B.powerset, f (J∪S)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Placement.alternatingKernel_mulVec_top
statement:
theorem alternatingKernel_mulVec_top (coords : Y → I → U)
    (s : ℝ) (hs : s ≠ 0) (p : Finset I → X → Y → ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ A x, DependsOn coords A (fun y => (p A x y : ℂ)))
    {v : Y → ℂ} (hv : v ∈ topSpace coords) :
    (alternatingKernel s p).mulVec v = Matrix.mulVec (fun x y => (p Finset.univ x y : ℂ)) v

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Placement.alternatingKernel_mul_conjTranspose
statement:
theorem alternatingKernel_mul_conjTranspose {D : Type*} [Fintype D]
    (coords : Y → I → U) (s : ℝ) (hs : s ≠ 0)
    (p : Finset I → X → Y → ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ A x, DependsOn coords A (fun y => (p A x y : ℂ)))
    (B : Matrix D Y ℂ)
    (hB : ∀ A : Finset I, A ≠ Finset.univ → ∀ f : Y → ℂ,
      DependsOn coords A f → B.mulVec f = 0) :
    alternatingKernel s p * B.conjTranspose =
      (show Matrix X Y ℂ from fun x y => (p Finset.univ x y : ℂ)) * B.conjTranspose

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Placement.fullKernel_top_norm_le
statement:
theorem fullKernel_top_norm_le (coords : Y → I → U)
    (s : ℝ) (hs : s ≠ 0) (p : Finset I → X → Y → ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ A x, DependsOn coords A (fun y => (p A x y : ℂ)))
    (v : EuclideanSpace ℂ Y) (hv : (fun y => v y) ∈ topSpace coords) :
    ‖(EuclideanSpace.equiv X ℂ).symm
      (Matrix.mulVec (fun x y => (p Finset.univ x y : ℂ)) v)‖ ≤
      Real.sqrt (∑ x, ∑ y, ‖alternatingKernel s p x y‖^2)*‖v‖

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Placement.matrix_l2_norm_le_hs
statement:
theorem matrix_l2_norm_le_hs (A : Matrix X Y ℂ) :
    ‖A‖ ≤ Real.sqrt (∑ x, ∑ y, ‖A x y‖^2)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.PlacementOccurrence.actionMatrix_entry
statement: lemma actionMatrix_entry (g : Γ) (x y : X) : actionMatrix (X := X) g x y=if g⁻¹ • x=y then 1 else 0

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.PlacementOccurrence.actionMatrix_mulVec
statement:
lemma actionMatrix_mulVec (g : Γ) (f : X → ℂ) :
    (actionMatrix g).mulVec f=fun x => f (g⁻¹ • x)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.PlacementOccurrence.actionMatrix_unitary
statement: lemma actionMatrix_unitary (g : Γ) : (actionMatrix (X := X) g).conjTranspose*actionMatrix g=1

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.PlacementOccurrence.first_level_norm_le
statement:
theorem first_level_norm_le (ρ : UnitaryIrrep (Equiv.Perm Ω))
    (u : Fin ρ.dimension → ℂ) (hu : u ≠ 0) (x₀ : I ↪ Ω)
    (hfixed : ∀ g : Equiv.Perm Ω, (∀ i, g (x₀ i)=x₀ i) → ρ.asRepresentation g u=u)
    (hnof : ∀ A : Finset Ω, A.card < Fintype.card I → ∀ v : Fin ρ.dimension → ℂ,
      (∀ g : Equiv.Perm Ω, (∀ a ∈ A, g a=a) → ρ.asRepresentation g v=v) → v=0)
    {W : Type*} [Fintype W] (w : W → ℂ) (g : W → Equiv.Perm Ω)
    (s : ℝ) (hs : s ≠ 0) (p : Finset I → (I ↪ Ω) → (I ↪ Ω) → ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ A x, DependsOn (fun y : I ↪ Ω => y) A (fun y => (p A x y : ℂ)))
    (hfull : (show Matrix (I ↪ Ω) (I ↪ Ω) ℂ from fun x y => (p Finset.univ x y : ℂ))=
      ∑ a : W, w a • actionMatrix (X := I ↪ Ω) (g a)) :
    ‖∑ a : W, w a • ρ.matrix (g a)‖ ≤
      ‖alternatingKernel s p‖

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.PlacementOccurrence.synthesisMatrix_covariant
statement:
lemma synthesisMatrix_covariant (ρ : UnitaryIrrep Γ) (u : Fin ρ.dimension → ℂ) (x₀ : X) (g : Γ) :
    synthesisMatrix ρ u x₀*actionMatrix g=ρ.matrix g*synthesisMatrix ρ u x₀

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.PlacementOccurrence.synthesisMatrix_mulVec
statement:
lemma synthesisMatrix_mulVec (ρ : UnitaryIrrep Γ) (u : Fin ρ.dimension → ℂ) (x₀ : X) (f : X → ℂ) :
    (synthesisMatrix ρ u x₀).mulVec f=orbitSynthesis ρ.asRepresentation u x₀ f

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.PlacementOccurrence.synthesisMatrix_ne_zero
statement:
lemma synthesisMatrix_ne_zero (ρ : UnitaryIrrep Γ) (u : Fin ρ.dimension → ℂ) (hu : u ≠ 0) (x₀ : X)
    (hfixed : ∀ g : Γ, g • x₀=x₀ → ρ.asRepresentation g u=u) : synthesisMatrix ρ u x₀ ≠ 0

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SparseDimension.commuting_scalar
statement:
theorem commuting_scalar {Γ : Type*} [Group Γ]
    (ρ : Representation ℂ Γ V) [ρ.IsIrreducible]
    (A : Module.End ℂ V) (hA : ∀ g, A * ρ g = ρ g * A) :
    ∃ c : ℂ, A = c • (1 : Module.End ℂ V)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SparseDimension.exists_constituent_le_half
statement:
theorem exists_constituent_le_half {Γ : Type*} [Group Γ] [Fintype Γ]
    (ρ : Representation ℂ Γ V) [Nontrivial V]
    (hn : ¬ρ.IsIrreducible) :
    ∃ S : Subrepresentation ρ, 0 < Module.finrank ℂ S.toSubmodule ∧
      S.toRepresentation.IsIrreducible ∧
      2 * Module.finrank ℂ S.toSubmodule ≤ Module.finrank ℂ V

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SparseDimension.exists_minimal_constituent
statement:
theorem exists_minimal_constituent {Γ : Type*} [Group Γ]
    (ρ : Representation ℂ Γ V) [Nontrivial V] :
    ∃ S : Subrepresentation ρ, 0 < Module.finrank ℂ S.toSubmodule ∧
      S.toRepresentation.IsIrreducible ∧
      ∀ T : Subrepresentation ρ, T ≠ ⊥ →
        Module.finrank ℂ S.toSubmodule ≤ Module.finrank ℂ T.toSubmodule

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SparseDimension.finrank_eq_one_of_fixTwo_irreducible
statement:
theorem finrank_eq_one_of_fixTwo_irreducible
    (ρ : Representation ℂ (Equiv.Perm Ω) V) [ρ.IsIrreducible]
    (a b : Ω) (hab : a ≠ b)
    [hirr : Representation.IsIrreducible (ρ.comp (fixTwo a b).subtype)] :
    Module.finrank ℂ V = 1

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SparseDimension.finrank_eq_one_of_scalars
statement:
theorem finrank_eq_one_of_scalars {Γ : Type*} [Group Γ]
    (ρ : Representation ℂ Γ V) [ρ.IsIrreducible]
    (hs : ∀ g, ∃ c : ℂ, ρ g = c • (1 : Module.End ℂ V)) :
    Module.finrank ℂ V = 1

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SparseDimension.irreducible_comp_surjective
statement:
theorem irreducible_comp_surjective {Γ Δ : Type*} [Group Γ] [Group Δ]
    (ρ : Representation ℂ Γ V) [ρ.IsIrreducible]
    (f : Δ →* Γ) (hf : Function.Surjective f) :
    Representation.IsIrreducible (ρ.comp f)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SparseDimension.subrep_bot_toSubmodule
statement:
@[simp] theorem subrep_bot_toSubmodule {Γ : Type*} [Group Γ]
    (ρ : Representation ℂ Γ V) : (⊥ : Subrepresentation ρ).toSubmodule = ⊥

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SparseDimension.subrep_top_toSubmodule
statement:
@[simp] theorem subrep_top_toSubmodule {Γ : Type*} [Group Γ]
    (ρ : Representation ℂ Γ V) : (⊤ : Subrepresentation ρ).toSubmodule = ⊤

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.UnitaryIrrep.adjoint_intertwines
statement:
theorem adjoint_intertwines {X : Type*} [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X]
    (P : Γ →* Matrix X X ℂ) (hP : ∀ g, (P g).conjTranspose * P g = 1)
    (B : Matrix (Fin ρ.dimension) X ℂ)
    (hB : ∀ g, B * P g = ρ.matrix g * B) (g : Γ) :
    P g * B.conjTranspose = B.conjTranspose * ρ.matrix g

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.UnitaryIrrep.intertwiner_gram_scalar
statement:
theorem intertwiner_gram_scalar {X : Type*} [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X]
    (P : Γ →* Matrix X X ℂ) (hP : ∀ g, (P g).conjTranspose * P g = 1)
    (B : Matrix (Fin ρ.dimension) X ℂ)
    (hB : ∀ g, B * P g = ρ.matrix g * B) :
    ∃ c : ℂ, B * B.conjTranspose = c • (1 : Matrix _ _ ℂ)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.UnitaryIrrep.norm_le_compression
statement:
theorem norm_le_compression {X : Type*} [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X]
    (P : Γ →* Matrix X X ℂ) (hP : ∀ g, (P g).conjTranspose * P g = 1)
    (B : Matrix (Fin ρ.dimension) X ℂ) (hne : B ≠ 0)
    (hB : ∀ g, B * P g = ρ.matrix g * B)
    (K : Matrix (Fin ρ.dimension) (Fin ρ.dimension) ℂ) (Q : Matrix X X ℂ)
    (hQ : Q * B.conjTranspose = B.conjTranspose * K) : ‖K‖ ≤ ‖Q‖

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.alternatingKernel_eq_placementKernel
statement:
theorem alternatingKernel_eq_placementKernel (H : G.Holes h)
    (μ : ∀ j, FiniteLaw (Equiv.Perm (Cube (G.bits j))))
    (x : H.InputPlacements k) (y : H.OutputPlacements k) :
    Placement.alternatingKernel (G.size : ℝ)
      (fun A (x : H.InputPlacements k) (y : H.OutputPlacements k) => H.extraProbability x.val y.val A μ)
      x y = (H.placementKernel x.val y.val μ : ℂ)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.card_covered_by_good_and_bad
statement:
theorem card_covered_by_good_and_bad (H : G.Holes h) (hH : H.Feasible)
    (p : Fin k → G.Slot × G.Slot) (η : ℝ) :
    k ≤ (H.goodSet (fun i => (p i).1) (fun i => (p i).2) η).card +
      (sharingCoverage G.vertexShares H.endpointData p).card +
      ∑ j, ((H.holeHeavyHits p η j).card + (particleHeavyHits p η j).card)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.extraProbability_dependsOn
statement:
theorem extraProbability_dependsOn (H : G.Holes h)
    (μ : ∀ j, FiniteLaw (Equiv.Perm (Cube (G.bits j)))) (A : Finset (Fin k))
    (x : H.InputPlacements k) :
    Placement.DependsOn (fun y : H.OutputPlacements k => y.val) A
      (fun y => (H.extraProbability x.val y.val A μ : ℂ))

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.fewGood_cover
statement:
theorem fewGood_cover (H : G.Holes h) (hH : H.Feasible)
    (p : Fin k → G.Slot × G.Slot) (η : ℝ)
    (he : ((H.goodSet (fun i => (p i).1) (fun i => (p i).2) η).card : ℝ) < k/2) :
    (k : ℝ)/4 ≤ ((sharingCoverage G.vertexShares H.endpointData p).card : ℝ) ∨
      ∃ j, (k : ℝ)/(8*G.b) ≤ ((H.holeHeavyHits p η j).card : ℝ) ∨
        (k : ℝ)/(8*G.b) ≤ ((particleHeavyHits p η j).card : ℝ)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.not_good_cover
statement:
theorem not_good_cover (H : G.Holes h) (hH : H.Feasible)
    (p : Fin k → G.Slot × G.Slot) (η : ℝ) (i : Fin k)
    (hi : i ∉ H.goodSet (fun i => (p i).1) (fun i => (p i).2) η) :
    i ∈ sharingCoverage G.vertexShares H.endpointData p ∨
      ∃ j, i ∈ H.holeHeavyHits p η j ∨ i ∈ particleHeavyHits p η j

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.not_vertexIsolated_iff
statement:
theorem not_vertexIsolated_iff (H : G.Holes h) (hH : H.Feasible)
    (p : Fin k → G.Slot × G.Slot) (i : Fin k) :
    ¬ H.VertexIsolated (fun i => (p i).1) (fun i => (p i).2) i ↔
      i ∈ sharingCoverage G.vertexShares H.endpointData p

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.placementHSsq_eq_subtype
statement:
theorem placementHSsq_eq_subtype (H : G.Holes h)
    (μ : ∀ j, FiniteLaw (Equiv.Perm (Cube (G.bits j)))) :
    H.placementHSsq (k := k) μ =
      ∑ x : H.InputPlacements k, ∑ y : H.OutputPlacements k,
        ‖(H.placementKernel x.val y.val μ : ℂ)‖^2

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.probability_holeHeavy_single
statement:
theorem probability_holeHeavy_single (H : G.Holes h) {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η) (j : Fin G.b) :
    (∑ p : G.Slot × G.Slot, if G.pathLine p.1 p.2 j ∈ H.holeHeavy η j then G.endpointWeight p else 0) ≤
      2*h/((G.size : ℝ)*η)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.transitionMatrix_top_norm_le
statement:
theorem transitionMatrix_top_norm_le (H : G.Holes h)
    (μ : ∀ j, FiniteLaw (Equiv.Perm (Cube (G.bits j))))
    (v : EuclideanSpace ℂ (H.OutputPlacements k))
    (hv : (fun y => v y) ∈ H.placementTop k) :
    ‖(EuclideanSpace.equiv (H.InputPlacements k) ℂ).symm ((H.transitionMatrix μ).mulVec v)‖ ≤
      Real.sqrt (H.placementHSsq (k := k) μ) * ‖v‖

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.exists_unused_line
statement:
lemma exists_unused_line (x y : Fin k → G.Slot) (j : Fin G.b)
    (hj : h+k < Fintype.card (G.Line j)) :
    ∃ L : G.Line j, (∀ i : Fin h, ¬ H.OnLine j L i) ∧
      ∀ i : Fin k, G.pathLine (x i) (y i) j ≠ L

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.outputPlacementEquiv_apply
statement:
lemma outputPlacementEquiv_apply (hf : H.Feasible) (y : Fin k ↪ H.FreeAt 0) (i : Fin k) :
    (H.outputPlacementEquiv hf y).val i=G.sweep (H.reference hf) (y i).val

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.referenceAlternating_entry
statement:
lemma referenceAlternating_entry (hf : H.Feasible)
    (μ : ∀ j, FiniteLaw (Equiv.Perm (Cube (G.bits j)))) (x y : Fin k ↪ H.FreeAt 0) :
    alternatingKernel (G.size : ℝ) (H.referencePartial hf μ) x y=
      (H.placementKernel (H.inputPlacementEquiv x).val (H.outputPlacementEquiv hf y).val μ : ℂ)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.referenceAlternating_hs
statement:
lemma referenceAlternating_hs (hf : H.Feasible)
    (μ : ∀ j, FiniteLaw (Equiv.Perm (Cube (G.bits j)))) :
    (∑ x : Fin k ↪ H.FreeAt 0, ∑ y : Fin k ↪ H.FreeAt 0,
      ‖alternatingKernel (G.size : ℝ) (H.referencePartial hf μ) x y‖^2)=H.placementHSsq (k := k) μ

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.referencePartial_depends
statement:
lemma referencePartial_depends (hf : H.Feasible)
    (μ : ∀ j, FiniteLaw (Equiv.Perm (Cube (G.bits j)))) (A : Finset (Fin k)) (x : Fin k ↪ H.FreeAt 0) :
    Placement.DependsOn (fun y : Fin k ↪ H.FreeAt 0 => y) A
      (fun y => (H.referencePartial hf μ A x y : ℂ))

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.signed_endpoint_factorization
statement:
lemma signed_endpoint_factorization (x y : Fin k → G.Slot) (A : Finset (Fin k))
    (μ : ∀ j, FiniteLaw (Equiv.Perm (Cube (G.bits j)))) :
    (∑ ω : G.Choices, if H.Compatible ω ∧ G.endpointEvent x y A ω then
      G.productLineMass μ ω*realSign (G.sweep ω) else 0)=
      ∏ j, ∏ L, ∑ σ, if H.jointLineEvent x y A j L σ then μ j σ*realSign σ else 0

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.signed_endpoint_zero_many
statement:
theorem signed_endpoint_zero_many (x y : Fin k → G.Slot) {z : ℝ}
    (hz : 0 ≤ z) (hz' : z ≤ 1) (j : Fin G.b) (hj : 0 < G.bits j)
    (hsize : h+k < Fintype.card (G.Line j)) :

      G.choiceWeight z ω*realSign (G.sweep ω) else 0)=0

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.signed_endpoint_zero_of_unused

lemma signed_endpoint_zero_of_unused (x y : Fin k → G.Slot) (A : Finset (Fin k))
    {z : ℝ} (hz : 0 ≤ z) (hz' : z ≤ 1) (j : Fin G.b) (hj : 0 < G.bits j)

    (hpaths : ∀ i ∈ A, G.pathLine (x i) (y i) j ≠ L) :

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.uniform_signed_joint_zero
statement:
lemma uniform_signed_joint_zero (x y : Fin k → G.Slot) (j : Fin G.b)
    (L : G.Line j) (a b : Cube (G.bits j)) (hab : a ≠ b)
    (haH : ∀ i : Fin h, H.OnLine j L i → H.path i j.succ j ≠ a)
    (hbH : ∀ i : Fin h, H.OnLine j L i → H.path i j.succ j ≠ b)
    (haP : ∀ i, G.pathLine (x i) (y i) j=L → y i j ≠ a)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.realSign_fiberPerm

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.realSign_stage

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.realSign_sweep

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.signed_line_factorization
statement:
lemma signed_line_factorization (G : Grid)

    (P : ∀ j : Fin G.b, G.Line j → Equiv.Perm (Cube (G.bits j)) → Prop) :
    (∑ ω : G.Choices, if ∀ j L, P j L (ω j L) then G.productLineMass μ ω*realSign (G.sweep ω) else 0)=
      ∏ j, ∏ L, ∑ σ, if P j L σ then μ j σ*realSign σ else 0

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.PlacementOccurrence.average_zero_of_placement_zero

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.boolSwitch_apply
statement: theorem boolSwitch_apply (b x : Bool) : boolSwitch b x = Bool.xor x b

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.exists_two_unassigned
statement:
lemma exists_two_unassigned {I U V : Type*} [Fintype I] [Fintype U] [Fintype V]
    [DecidableEq U] [DecidableEq V] (f : I → U × V)
    (hh : Fintype.card I+Fintype.card V < Fintype.card (U × V)) :
    ∃ a b : U, ∃ v : V, a ≠ b ∧ (∀ i, f i ≠ (a,v)) ∧ ∀ i, f i ≠ (b,v)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.pairSwitch_eq_prod
statement:
theorem pairSwitch_eq_prod {L : Type*} (bits : L → Bool) :

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.sign_binaryLayer
statement:
theorem sign_binaryLayer {d : ℕ} (j : Fin d)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.sign_binarySweep
statement:

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.sign_boolSwitch
statement: theorem sign_boolSwitch (b : Bool) : realSign (boolSwitch b) = if b then -1 else 1

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.sign_pairSwitch
statement:
theorem sign_pairSwitch {L : Type*} [Fintype L] (bits : L → Bool) :

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.signed_sum_zero_of_swap

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.sum_binary_realSign

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.SparseScalar.fewGood_bound

lemma fewGood_bound {b k : ℕ} (hb : 1 ≤ b) (hB : b ≤ B0) (hk : 1 ≤ k)
    {s v u t : ℝ} (hs : 1 < s) (hv : 0 ≤ v) (hu : 0 ≤ u) (ht : 0 ≤ t)
    (hvs : v ≤ s^(-theta/2)) (hus : u ≤ s^(-theta/2)) (hts : t ≤ s^(-theta/2))
    (C : Fin b → ℝ) (hC0 : ∀ j, 0 ≤ C j)
    (hC : ∀ j, C j ≤ Real.exp (theta*k*Real.log s/(32*B0)))
    (habs : Real.log (1+2*(B0:ℝ))+Real.log 2 ≤ xi*Real.log s) :
    (2:ℝ)^k*v^((k:ℝ)/8)+∑ j : Fin b,
      ((2:ℝ)^k*u^((k:ℝ)/(8*b))+C j*2^k*t^((k:ℝ)/(8*b))) ≤ s^(-xi*k)

lemma eventually_absorb_hook (q : ℕ) :

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.ScalarInduction.eventually_constant_le_power
statement:
lemma eventually_constant_le_power (ε C : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∀ᶠ s : ℝ in atTop, C ≤ s^ε

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.ScalarInduction.eventually_log_power_bound
statement:
lemma eventually_log_power_bound (u v r C : ℝ) (huv : u < v) (hC : 0 < C) :
    ∀ᶠ s : ℝ in atTop, 0 < s ∧ s^u*(Real.log s)^r ≤ C*s^v

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.ScalarInduction.eventually_mainSizeReady
statement: lemma eventually_mainSizeReady (q : ℕ) : ∀ᶠ s : ℝ in atTop, MainSizeReady q s

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.ScalarInduction.hook_comparison
statement:
lemma hook_comparison {L F h cStar eStar E : ℝ} (hL : 0 < L) (hF : 0 ≤ F) (hh : 0 ≤ h)
    (hc : c0+1/Real.sqrt L+1/(20*Real.sqrt L) ≤ cStar)
    (he : eStar+cStar/L ≤ e0-1/Real.sqrt L-1/(20*Real.sqrt L)) :
    -cStar*F+eStar*h*L+cStar*h+E ≤
      -(c0+1/Real.sqrt L+1/(20*Real.sqrt L))*F+
        (e0-1/Real.sqrt L-1/(20*Real.sqrt L))*h*L+E

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.ScalarInduction.hook_strengthening
statement:
lemma hook_strengthening {L : ℝ} (hL : 0<L) (hroot : 2/e0 ≤ Real.sqrt L)
    (hc : c0+(11/10:ℝ)/Real.sqrt L ≤ 2*c0) :
    c0+1/Real.sqrt L+1/(20*Real.sqrt L) ≤ c0+(11/10:ℝ)/Real.sqrt L ∧
    e0-(11/10:ℝ)/Real.sqrt L+(c0+(11/10:ℝ)/Real.sqrt L)/L ≤
      e0-1/Real.sqrt L-1/(20*Real.sqrt L)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.ScalarInduction.improved_coefficients
statement:
lemma improved_coefficients {L t : ℝ} (hL : 0<L) (ht : 0<t) (htL : t≤(4/5)*L) :
    c0+(11/10:ℝ)/Real.sqrt L ≤ c0+1/Real.sqrt t ∧
    e0-1/Real.sqrt t ≤ e0-(11/10:ℝ)/Real.sqrt L

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.ScalarInduction.reciprocal_sqrt_gap
statement:
lemma reciprocal_sqrt_gap {L t : ℝ} (hL : 0 < L) (ht : 0 < t) (htL : t ≤ (4/5)*L) :
    (11/10 : ℝ)/Real.sqrt L ≤ 1/Real.sqrt t

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.ScalarInduction.removed_cost_bound
statement:
lemma removed_cost_bound {s k b F Fd : ℝ} {q : ℕ}
    (hs : 1<s) (hk : 0≤k) (hb : 0≤b) (hb' : b≤(e0/4)*Real.log s)
    (hF : s^(1-a/4)≤F) (hFd : 0≤Fd) (hS : MainSizeReady q s)
    (hEnt : s^(1-a/2)≤k → (a/4)*k*Real.log s≤Fd) :
    (c0+e0)*k*Real.log s+Real.log 4*k*b-Fd+s^((9:ℝ)/10) ≤ F/(20*Real.sqrt (Real.log s))

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.ScalarInduction.removed_endgame
statement:
theorem removed_endgame (L F Fg Fd k h b C : ℝ) (_ : ℝ) (err : ℝ)
    (hL : 0 < L) (_ : 0 ≤ F) (hh : 0 ≤ h) (_ : 0 ≤ k)
    (hD : F ≤ Fg+k*L) (hroot : 0 < Real.sqrt L)
    (hcost : (c0+e0)*k*L+Real.log 4*k*b-Fd+err ≤ F/(20*Real.sqrt L)) :
    -(c0+1/Real.sqrt L+1/(20*Real.sqrt L))*Fg+
      (e0-1/Real.sqrt L-1/(20*Real.sqrt L))*(h+k)*L+err-C+Real.log 4*k*b-Fd ≤
      -(c0+1/Real.sqrt L)*F+(e0-1/Real.sqrt L)*h*L-C

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.YoungCorner.card_perm_le_colors_mul_stabilizer
statement:
lemma card_perm_le_colors_mul_stabilizer {X Y : Type*} [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X]
    [Fintype Y] (f : X → Y) :
    (Fintype.card X).factorial ≤ (Fintype.card Y)^(Fintype.card X) * Fintype.card (colorStabilizer f)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.YoungCorner.col_row_col_eq_one
statement:
lemma col_row_col_eq_one (μ : YoungDiagram) (c d : cols μ) (r : rows μ) :
    (c.val*r.val)*d.val=1 ↔ r=1 ∧ d=c⁻¹

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.YoungCorner.col_youngVector_ne_zero
statement:
lemma col_youngVector_ne_zero (μ : YoungDiagram) :
    sumCol μ (regular (Equiv.Perm (Boxes μ))) (youngVector μ) ≠ 0

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.YoungCorner.col_youngVector_one
statement:
lemma col_youngVector_one (μ : YoungDiagram) :
    sumCol μ (regular (Equiv.Perm (Boxes μ))) (youngVector μ) 1=(Fintype.card (cols μ) : ℂ)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.YoungCorner.corner_scalar
statement:
theorem corner_scalar (μ : YoungDiagram) (ρ : Equiv.Perm (Boxes μ) →* A)
    (σ : Equiv.Perm (Boxes μ)) :
    ∃ c : ℂ, sumRow μ ρ * ρ σ * sumCol μ ρ = c • (sumRow μ ρ * sumCol μ ρ)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.YoungCorner.corner_zero_of_collision
statement:
lemma corner_zero_of_collision (μ : YoungDiagram) (ρ : Equiv.Perm (Boxes μ) →* A)
    (σ : Equiv.Perm (Boxes μ)) (x y : Boxes μ) (hxy : x ≠ y)
    (hrow : x.val.1=y.val.1) (hcol : (σ⁻¹ x).val.2=(σ⁻¹ y).val.2) :
    sumRow μ ρ * ρ σ * sumCol μ ρ=0

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.YoungCorner.rankVectors_eval
statement:
lemma rankVectors_eval (μ : YoungDiagram) (u t : ranks μ) :
    regular (Equiv.Perm (Boxes μ)) u.val (youngVector μ) t.val=if u=t then 1 else 0

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.YoungCorner.rankVectors_independent
statement:
lemma rankVectors_independent (μ : YoungDiagram) :
    LinearIndependent ℂ (fun u : ranks μ => regular (Equiv.Perm (Boxes μ)) u.val (youngVector μ))

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.YoungCorner.rank_card_le_shape_finrank
statement:
lemma rank_card_le_shape_finrank (μ : YoungDiagram) {V : Type} [AddCommGroup V]
    [Module ℂ V] [FiniteDimensional ℂ V] (τ : Representation ℂ (Equiv.Perm (Boxes μ)) V)
    [τ.IsIrreducible] (hτ : hasShape μ (Equiv.refl _) τ) :
    Fintype.card (ranks μ) ≤ Module.finrank ℂ V

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.YoungCorner.rank_row_col
statement:
lemma rank_row_col (μ : YoungDiagram) (r : rows μ) (c : cols μ)
    (h : ∀ x : Boxes μ, ((r.val*c.val) x).val.1+((r.val*c.val) x).val.2=x.val.1+x.val.2) :
    r=1 ∧ c=1

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.YoungCorner.rowImage_line
OAI.CoordinateSweeps.YoungCorner.shape_dimension_entropy
statement:
lemma shape_dimension_entropy (μ : YoungDiagram) {V : Type} [AddCommGroup V]
    [Module ℂ V] [FiniteDimensional ℂ V] (τ : Representation ℂ (Equiv.Perm (Boxes μ)) V)
    [τ.IsIrreducible] (hτ : hasShape μ (Equiv.refl _) τ)
    (L : ℕ) (hL : ∀ x : Boxes μ, x.val.1+x.val.2<L) :
    (Fintype.card (Boxes μ)).factorial ≤ L^(Fintype.card (Boxes μ))*Module.finrank ℂ V

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.YoungCorner.spechtSeed_exists
statement:
lemma spechtSeed_exists (μ : YoungDiagram) :
    ∃ S : Subrepresentation (columnModule μ).toRepresentation,
      S.toRepresentation.IsIrreducible ∧ hasShape μ (Equiv.refl _) S.toRepresentation ∧
      ∃ v : S.toSubmodule, ((v : (columnModule μ).toSubmodule) : Equiv.Perm (Boxes μ) → ℂ)=youngVector μ

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.YoungCorner.sumCol_left
statement:
lemma sumCol_left (μ : YoungDiagram) (ρ : Equiv.Perm (Boxes μ) →* A)
    (c : cols μ) : ρ c * sumCol μ ρ = (signScalar (c : Equiv.Perm (Boxes μ)))⁻¹ • sumCol μ ρ

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.YoungCorner.sumRow_right
statement:
lemma sumRow_right (μ : YoungDiagram) (ρ : Equiv.Perm (Boxes μ) →* A)
    (r : rows μ) : sumRow μ ρ * ρ r = sumRow μ ρ

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.YoungCorner.sumRow_square
statement:
lemma sumRow_square (μ : YoungDiagram) {A : Type*} [Ring A] [Algebra ℂ A]
    (ρ : Equiv.Perm (Boxes μ) →* A) :
    sumRow μ ρ * sumRow μ ρ=(Fintype.card (rows μ) : ℂ) • sumRow μ ρ

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.YoungCorner.sumRow_youngVector
statement:
lemma sumRow_youngVector (μ : YoungDiagram) :
    sumRow μ (regular (Equiv.Perm (Boxes μ))) (youngVector μ)=
      (Fintype.card (rows μ) : ℂ) • youngVector μ

lemma swap_mem_rows (μ : YoungDiagram) (x y : Boxes μ) (h : x.val.1=y.val.1) :

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.allowance_lower
statement:
theorem allowance_lower {r : ℕ} (hr : ScaleLarge r) (hG : G.Allowed r) :
    (e0/4) * h * Real.log G.size ≤ e G.size * h * Real.log G.size - H.cost

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.allowance_nonneg
statement:
lemma allowance_nonneg {r : ℕ} (hr : ScaleLarge r) (hG : G.Allowed r) :

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.conditional_automatic
statement:
theorem conditional_automatic (hf : H.Feasible) {z : ℝ} (hz : 0 ≤ z) (hz1 : z < 1)
    (ρ : UnitaryIrrep H.stabilizer) (q : ℕ)
    (ha : (1+c G.size)*Real.log ρ.dimension ≤
      e G.size*h*Real.log G.size-H.cost) :
    logMoment (schattenMoment q (H.conditionalAverage hf z ρ)) ≤
      ((-c G.size*Real.log ρ.dimension+e G.size*h*Real.log G.size-H.cost : ℝ) : EReal)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.conditional_dimension_one
statement:
theorem conditional_dimension_one {r : ℕ} (hr : ScaleLarge r) (hG : G.Allowed r)
    (hf : H.Feasible) {z : ℝ} (hz : 0 ≤ z) (hz1 : z < 1)
    (ρ : UnitaryIrrep H.stabilizer) (hρ : ρ.dimension=1) (q : ℕ) :
    logMoment (schattenMoment q (H.conditionalAverage hf z ρ)) ≤
      ((-c G.size*Real.log ρ.dimension+e G.size*h*Real.log G.size-H.cost : ℝ) : EReal)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.single_base_moment
statement:
theorem single_base_moment {r : ℕ} (hd : d ≤ 2*r) (hf : H.Feasible)
    (ρ : UnitaryIrrep H.stabilizer) (hρ : ρ.dimension ≠ 1)
    {z : ℝ} (hz : 0 ≤ z) (hz' : z ≤ baseZeta r)
    {q : ℕ} (hq : 1 ≤ q) :
    schattenMoment q (H.conditionalAverage hf z ρ) ≤ (ρ.dimension : ℝ)⁻¹

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.single_base_norm
statement:
theorem single_base_norm {r : ℕ} (hd : d ≤ 2*r) (hf : H.Feasible)
    (ρ : UnitaryIrrep H.stabilizer) (hρ : ρ.dimension ≠ 1)
    {z : ℝ} (hz : 0 ≤ z) (hz' : z ≤ baseZeta r) :
    ‖H.conditionalAverage hf z ρ‖ ≤ (baseWidth r)⁻¹

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.single_compatible_iff
statement:
lemma single_compatible_iff (ω : (Grid.single d).Choices) :
    H.Compatible ω ↔ ∀ i, (Grid.single d).sweep ω (H.path i 0)=H.path i 1

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.single_conditionalAverage
statement:
lemma single_conditionalAverage (hf : H.Feasible) (z : ℝ)
    (ρ : UnitaryIrrep H.stabilizer) :
    H.conditionalAverage hf z ρ =
      ((∑ g : H.stabilizer, (Grid.single d).choiceWeight z
        ((H.singleResidualEquiv hf).symm g).val : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹ •
      ∑ g : H.stabilizer, ((Grid.single d).choiceWeight z
        ((H.singleResidualEquiv hf).symm g).val : ℂ) • ρ.matrix g

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.single_conditional_main
statement:
theorem single_conditional_main {r : ℕ} (hr : ScaleLarge r)
    (hG : (Grid.single d).Allowed r) (hf : H.Feasible)
    {z : ℝ} (hz : 0 ≤ z) (hz' : z ≤ baseZeta r)
    (ρ : UnitaryIrrep H.stabilizer) {q : ℕ} (hq : 1 ≤ q) :
    logMoment (schattenMoment q (H.conditionalAverage hf z ρ)) ≤
      ((-c (Grid.single d).size*Real.log ρ.dimension+
        e (Grid.single d).size*h*Real.log (Grid.single d).size-H.cost : ℝ) : EReal)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.single_conditional_moment_le
statement:
theorem single_conditional_moment_le (hf : H.Feasible)
    (ρ : UnitaryIrrep H.stabilizer) (hρ : ¬ ∀ g, ρ.matrix g=1)
    {z : ℝ} (hz : 0 ≤ z) (hz1 : z ≤ 1/2) (q : ℕ) :
    schattenMoment q (H.conditionalAverage hf z ρ) ≤
      (Fintype.card (Equiv.Perm (Cube d)) : ℝ) *
        (2*z*(Fintype.card (Equiv.Perm (Cube d)) : ℝ))^(2*q)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.single_conditional_norm_le
statement:
theorem single_conditional_norm_le (hf : H.Feasible)
    (ρ : UnitaryIrrep H.stabilizer) (hρ : ¬ ∀ g, ρ.matrix g=1)
    {z : ℝ} (hz : 0 ≤ z) (hz1 : z ≤ 1/2) :
    ‖H.conditionalAverage hf z ρ‖ ≤
      2*z*(Fintype.card (Equiv.Perm (Cube d)) : ℝ)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.single_dimension_le

lemma single_dimension_le (ρ : UnitaryIrrep H.stabilizer) :

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.single_probability
statement:
lemma single_probability (hf : H.Feasible) (z : ℝ) :
    H.probability z = ∑ g : H.stabilizer,
      (Grid.single d).choiceWeight z ((H.singleResidualEquiv hf).symm g).val

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.conditional_main_b_one
statement:
theorem conditional_main_b_one {r : ℕ} (hr : ScaleLarge r)
    (G : Grid) (hb : G.b=1) (hG : G.Allowed r)
    {h : ℕ} (H : G.Holes h) (hf : H.Feasible)
    {z : ℝ} (hz : 0 ≤ z) (hz' : z ≤ baseZeta r)
    (ρ : UnitaryIrrep H.stabilizer) {q : ℕ} (hq : 1 ≤ q) :
    logMoment (schattenMoment q (H.conditionalAverage hf z ρ)) ≤
      ((-c G.size*Real.log ρ.dimension+e G.size*h*Real.log G.size-H.cost : ℝ) : EReal)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.singleSlot_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem singleSlot_apply (d : ℕ) (x : (single d).Slot) :
    singleSlot d x = x 0

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.singleSlot_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem singleSlot_symm_apply (d : ℕ) (x : Cube d) (j : Fin 1) :

statement:

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.single_choiceWeight
statement:
lemma single_choiceWeight (d : ℕ) (z : ℝ) (ω : (single d).Choices) :
    (single d).choiceWeight z ω=
      (1-z)*(Fintype.card (Equiv.Perm (Cube d)) : ℝ)⁻¹+
        z*binaryLaw d (singleChoice d ω)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.single_stage_apply
statement:
lemma single_stage_apply (d : ℕ) (ω : (single d).Choices) (x : (single d).Slot) :

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.single_sweep
statement:
lemma single_sweep (d : ℕ) (ω : (single d).Choices) :
    (single d).sweep ω=(singleSlot d).symm.permCongr (singleChoice d ω)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.UnitaryIrrep.affine_average_norm_le
statement:
theorem affine_average_norm_le (hρ : ¬ ∀ g, ρ.matrix g=1)
    (u : ℝ) (hu : 0 < u) (w : Γ → ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ g, 0 ≤ w g) (hw1 : ∀ g, w g ≤ 1)
    {z : ℝ} (hz : 0 ≤ z) (hz1 : z ≤ 1/2) :
    ‖((∑ g, ((1-z)*u+z*w g) : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹ •
       ∑ g, (((1-z)*u+z*w g : ℝ) : ℂ) • ρ.matrix g‖ ≤ 2*z/u

    ∃ k t : ℕ, k ≤ 2*t ∧ 2^t ≤ ρ.dimension ∧ ρ.dimension ≤ (Fintype.card Ω)^k ∧
      k ≤ Fintype.card Ω ∧ Nonempty (Level ρ k)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.YoungCorner.removed_dimension_entropy
statement:
lemma removed_dimension_entropy (μ : YoungDiagram) (p s : ℕ)
    (hs : 0<s) (hM : Fintype.card (Boxes μ) ≤ s)
    (hfloor : (s:ℝ)^a ≤ p+1) (hL : 800 ≤ Real.log s)
    (hk : (s:ℝ)^(1-a/2) ≤ Fintype.card (Boxes (removedPart μ p))) :
    (a/4)*(Fintype.card (Boxes (removedPart μ p)):ℝ)*Real.log s ≤
      Real.log (Module.finrank ℂ (shapeSubrep (removedPart μ p) (Equiv.refl _)).toSubmodule)

    mean p f = mean (fun a => p (e a)) (fun ω => f (fun b => ω (e.symm b)))

name: OAI.FiniteAssociation.mean_option
statement:
theorem mean_option [Fintype E] (p : Option E → Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (f : (Option E → Bool) → ℝ) :
    mean p f = (p none : ℝ) * mean (fun e => p (some e)) (fun ω => f (extend ω true)) +
      (1 - (p none : ℝ)) * mean (fun e => p (some e)) (fun ω => f (extend ω false))

name: OAI.HyperedgeComparison.coeff_const
statement:
theorem coeff_const {n : ℕ} (H : Hypergraph V E)
    (p : E → Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (hp : ∀ e, (p e : ℝ) < 1)
    (x : Fin n → V) (hx : Function.Injective x) (k i : Fin n) (c : ℝ) :
    coeff H p x k (fun _ => c) i = if i = k then c else 0

name: OAI.HyperedgeComparison.coeff_identity
statement:
theorem coeff_identity [Fintype V] {n : ℕ} (H : Hypergraph V E)
    (p : E → Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (x : Fin n → V) (k : Fin n) (F : Set V → ℝ) :
    coeff H p x k F = coeff H p x k (resample H p (x k) (earlier x k) F) +
      ∑ j, if k < j then coeff H p x j (residualMean H p (x k) (earlier x k) · F) else 0

name: OAI.HyperedgeComparison.coeff_nonneg
statement:
theorem coeff_nonneg [Fintype V] {n : ℕ} (H : Hypergraph V E)
    (p : E → Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (hp : ∀ e, (p e : ℝ) < 1)
    (x : Fin n → V) (hx : Function.Injective x) (k : Fin n) (F : Set V → ℝ)
    (hF0 : ∀ U ∈ ClusterDomain (x k) (earlier x k), 0 ≤ F U)
    (hFm : MonotoneOn F (ClusterDomain (x k) (earlier x k))) (i : Fin n) :
    0 ≤ coeff H p x k F i

name: OAI.HyperedgeComparison.coeff_tendsto
statement:
theorem coeff_tendsto {n : ℕ} (H : Hypergraph V E) (p : E → Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (x : Fin n → V) (k i : Fin n) (F : ℕ → Set V → ℝ) (c : ℝ)
    (h : ∀ U ∈ ClusterDomain (x k) (earlier x k),
      Tendsto (fun t => F t U) atTop (nhds c)) :
    Tendsto (fun t => coeff H p x k (F t) i) atTop
      (nhds (coeff H p x k (fun _ => c) i))

name: OAI.HyperedgeComparison.column_conditional_expectation
statement:
theorem column_conditional_expectation [Fintype V] {n : ℕ} (H : Hypergraph V E)
    (p : E → Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (x : Fin n → V) (k i : Fin n)
    (g : (E → Bool) → Set V → ℝ)
    (hg : ∀ U ω ω', (∀ e, Disjoint (H e) U → ω' e = ω e) → g ω' U = g ω U) :
    (∫ ω, if firstRoot H x ω ∅ k i then g ω (cluster H ω ∅ (x k)) else 0 ∂law p) =
      column H p x k (fun U => ∫ ω, g ω U ∂law p) i

name: OAI.HyperedgeComparison.column_const
statement:
theorem column_const {n : ℕ} (H : Hypergraph V E)
    (p : E → Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (x : Fin n → V) (k : Fin n) (c : ℝ) :
    column H p x k (fun _ => c) = c • column H p x k (fun _ => 1)

name: OAI.HyperedgeComparison.column_hitsOther
statement:
theorem column_hitsOther {n : ℕ} (H : Hypergraph V E)
    (p : E → Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (x : Fin n → V) (k : Fin n) :
    column H p x k (hitsOther x k) = column H p x k (fun _ => 1) -
      Pi.single k (isolatedMass H p x k)

name: OAI.HyperedgeComparison.column_identity
statement:
theorem column_identity [Fintype V] {n : ℕ} (H : Hypergraph V E)
    (p : E → Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (x : Fin n → V) (k i : Fin n) (F : Set V → ℝ) :
    column H p x k F i = column H p x k (resample H p (x k) (earlier x k) F) i +
      ∑ j, if k < j then column H p x j (residualMean H p (x k) (earlier x k) · F) i
        else 0

name: OAI.HyperedgeComparison.column_resample
statement:
theorem column_resample [Fintype V] {n : ℕ} (H : Hypergraph V E)
    (p : E → Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (x : Fin n → V) (k i : Fin n) (F : Set V → ℝ) :
    column H p x k (resample H p (x k) (earlier x k) F) i =
      ∫ ω, if firstRoot H x ω ∅ k i then
        meanAfterDelete H p (x k) (clusters H ω ∅ (earlier x k)) F else 0 ∂law p

name: OAI.HyperedgeComparison.column_residual
statement:
theorem column_residual [Fintype V] {n : ℕ} (H : Hypergraph V E)
    (p : E → Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (x : Fin n → V) (k j i : Fin n)
    (hkj : k < j) (F : Set V → ℝ) :
    column H p x j (residualMean H p (x k) (earlier x k) · F) i =
      ∫ ω, if firstRoot H x ω ∅ j i ∧ x k ∉ clusters H ω ∅ (earlier x k) then
        meanAfterDelete H p (x k) (clusters H ω ∅ (earlier x k)) F -
          F (cluster H ω ∅ (x k)) else 0 ∂law p

name: OAI.HyperedgeComparison.column_tendsto
statement:
theorem column_tendsto {n : ℕ} (H : Hypergraph V E) (p : E → Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (x : Fin n → V) (k i : Fin n) (F : ℕ → Set V → ℝ) (c : ℝ)
    (h : ∀ U ∈ ClusterDomain (x k) (earlier x k),
      Tendsto (fun t => F t U) atTop (nhds c)) :
    Tendsto (fun t => column H p x k (F t) i) atTop
      (nhds (column H p x k (fun _ => c) i))

name: OAI.HyperedgeComparison.conditioning_weight
statement:
theorem conditioning_weight [Fintype V] (H : Hypergraph V E)
    (p : E → Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (s : V) (D S : Set V)
    (w : Set V → ℝ) (F : Set V → ℝ) (hw : ∀ U, s ∈ U → w U = 0) :
    (∫ ω, w (clusters H ω D S) * F (cluster H ω D s) ∂law p) =
      ∫ ω, w (clusters H ω D S) *
        meanAfterDelete H p s (D ∪ clusters H ω D S) F ∂law p

name: OAI.HyperedgeComparison.exact_cluster_weight
statement:
theorem exact_cluster_weight [Fintype V] (H : Hypergraph V E)
    (p : E → Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (D S : Set V) (f : Set V → ℝ)
    (g : (E → Bool) → Set V → ℝ)
    (hg : ∀ U ω ω', (∀ e, Disjoint (H e) U → ω' e = ω e) → g ω' U = g ω U) :
    (∫ ω, f (clusters H ω D S) * g ω (clusters H ω D S) ∂law p) =
      ∫ ω, f (clusters H ω D S) * (∫ ω', g ω' (clusters H ω D S) ∂law p) ∂law p

name: OAI.HyperedgeComparison.exists_target_list
statement:
theorem exists_target_list [Fintype V] (A : Set V) (o : V) (ho : o ∉ A) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, ∃ x : Fin (n+1) → V, Function.Injective x ∧
      x (Fin.last n) = o ∧ earlier x (Fin.last n) = A

name: OAI.HyperedgeComparison.exists_unique_firstRoot
statement:
theorem exists_unique_firstRoot {n : ℕ} (H : Hypergraph V E) (x : Fin n → V)
    (ω : E → Bool) (D : Set V) (i : Fin n) : ∃! k, firstRoot H x ω D k i

name: OAI.HyperedgeComparison.expectationVector_eq_sum_columns
statement:
theorem expectationVector_eq_sum_columns {n : ℕ} (H : Hypergraph V E)
    (p : E → Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (x : Fin n → V) (F : Set V → ℝ) :
    expectationVector H p x F = ∑ k, column H p x k F

name: OAI.HyperedgeComparison.expectation_comparison
statement:
theorem expectation_comparison [Fintype V] {n : ℕ} (H : Hypergraph V E)
    (p : E → Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (hp : ∀ e, (p e : ℝ) < 1)
    (x : Fin (n + 1) → V) (hx : Function.Injective x) (F : Set V → ℝ)
    (hF0 : ∀ U, 0 ≤ F U) (hFm : Monotone F) (b : ℝ)
    (hb : ∀ j ≠ Fin.last n, b ≤ expectationVector H p x F j) :
    b * (1 - baseMatrix H p x (Fin.last n) (Fin.last n)) ≤
      expectationVector H p x F (Fin.last n)

name: OAI.HyperedgeComparison.expectation_jointObservable
statement:
theorem expectation_jointObservable {n : ℕ} (H : Hypergraph V E)
    (p : E → Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (x : Fin n → V) (A T : Set V) (i : Fin n) :
    expectationVector H p x (jointObservable A T) i =
      eventProb p (fun ω => Meets H ω ∅ (x i) A ∧ Meets H ω ∅ (x i) T)

name: OAI.HyperedgeComparison.expectation_jointObservable_of_mem
statement:
theorem expectation_jointObservable_of_mem {n : ℕ} (H : Hypergraph V E)
    (p : E → Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (x : Fin n → V) (A T : Set V) (i : Fin n) (hi : x i ∈ A) :
    expectationVector H p x (jointObservable A T) i =
      eventProb p (fun ω => Meets H ω ∅ (x i) T)

name: OAI.HyperedgeComparison.failure_comparison
statement:
theorem failure_comparison [Fintype V] (H : Hypergraph V E)
    (p : E → Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (o : V) (A T : Set V) (b : ℝ) (hb0 : 0 ≤ b)
    (hb : ∀ a ∈ A, 1 - b ≤ eventProb p (fun ω => Meets H ω ∅ a T)) :
    eventProb p (fun ω => Meets H ω ∅ o A ∧ ¬Meets H ω ∅ o T) ≤ b

name: OAI.HyperedgeComparison.failure_comparison_mul
statement:
theorem failure_comparison_mul [Fintype V] (H : Hypergraph V E)
    (p : E → Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (o : V) (A T : Set V) (b : ℝ)
    (hb : ∀ a ∈ A, 1 - b ≤ eventProb p (fun ω => Meets H ω ∅ a T)) :
    eventProb p (fun ω => Meets H ω ∅ o A ∧ ¬Meets H ω ∅ o T) ≤
      b * eventProb p (fun ω => Meets H ω ∅ o A)

name: OAI.HyperedgeComparison.firstListed_partition
statement:
theorem firstListed_partition {n : ℕ} (H : Hypergraph V E) (x : Fin n → V)
    (ω : E → Bool) (k i : Fin n) (a : ℝ) :
    (if x k ∉ clusters H ω ∅ (earlier x k) ∧ x i ∉ clusters H ω ∅ (earlier x k)
      then a else 0) =
      (if firstRoot H x ω ∅ k i then a else 0) +
        ∑ j, if k < j ∧ firstRoot H x ω ∅ j i ∧ x k ∉ clusters H ω ∅ (earlier x k)
          then a else 0

name: OAI.HyperedgeComparison.firstRoot_iff
statement:
theorem firstRoot_iff {n : ℕ} {H : Hypergraph V E} {x : Fin n → V} {ω : E → Bool}
    {D : Set V} {k i : Fin n} :
    firstRoot H x ω D k i ↔ Connected H ω D (x k) (x i) ∧
      ∀ j < k, ¬Connected H ω D (x j) (x i)

name: OAI.HyperedgeComparison.firstRoot_notin_earlier_clusters
OAI.HyperedgeComparison.independent_of_disjoint_bits
statement:
theorem independent_of_disjoint_bits (p : E → Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (J : Finset E) (f g : (E → Bool) → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ ω ω', (∀ e ∈ J, ω' e = ω e) → f ω' = f ω)
    (hg : ∀ ω ω', (∀ e ∉ J, ω' e = ω e) → g ω' = g ω) :
    IndepFun f g (law p)

name: OAI.HyperedgeComparison.integral_eq_sum_fibers
statement:
theorem integral_eq_sum_fibers {I : Type uI} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
    (p : E → Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (X : (E → Bool) → I) (f : (E → Bool) → ℝ) :
    (∫ ω, f ω ∂law p) = ∑ i, ∫ ω, if X ω = i then f ω else 0 ∂law p

name: OAI.HyperedgeComparison.integral_firstListed_partition
statement:
theorem integral_firstListed_partition {n : ℕ} (H : Hypergraph V E)
    (p : E → Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (x : Fin n → V) (k i : Fin n)
    (g : (E → Bool) → ℝ) :
    (∫ ω, if x k ∉ clusters H ω ∅ (earlier x k) ∧ x i ∉ clusters H ω ∅ (earlier x k)
      then g ω else 0 ∂law p) =
      (∫ ω, if firstRoot H x ω ∅ k i then g ω else 0 ∂law p) +
        ∑ j, ∫ ω, if k < j ∧ firstRoot H x ω ∅ j i ∧ x k ∉ clusters H ω ∅ (earlier x k)
          then g ω else 0 ∂law p

name: OAI.HyperedgeComparison.integral_indicator_sub
statement:
theorem integral_indicator_sub (p : E → Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (P : (E → Bool) → Prop) [DecidablePred P] (f g : (E → Bool) → ℝ) :
    (∫ ω, if P ω then f ω - g ω else 0 ∂law p) =
      (∫ ω, if P ω then f ω else 0 ∂law p) -
        ∫ ω, if P ω then g ω else 0 ∂law p

name: OAI.HyperedgeComparison.inverse_expectation_nonneg
statement:
theorem inverse_expectation_nonneg [Fintype V] {n : ℕ} (H : Hypergraph V E)
    (p : E → Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (hp : ∀ e, (p e : ℝ) < 1)
    (x : Fin n → V) (hx : Function.Injective x) (F : Set V → ℝ)
    (hF0 : ∀ U, 0 ≤ F U) (hFm : Monotone F) (i : Fin n) :
    0 ≤ ((baseMatrix H p x)⁻¹ *ᵥ expectationVector H p x F) i

name: OAI.HyperedgeComparison.inverse_last_diag_mul
statement:
theorem inverse_last_diag_mul {n : ℕ} (H : Hypergraph V E)
    (p : E → Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (hp : ∀ e, (p e : ℝ) < 1)
    (x : Fin (n + 1) → V) (hx : Function.Injective x) :
    (baseMatrix H p x)⁻¹ (Fin.last n) (Fin.last n) *
      baseMatrix H p x (Fin.last n) (Fin.last n) = 1

name: OAI.HyperedgeComparison.inverse_mulVec_one
statement:
theorem inverse_mulVec_one {n : ℕ} (H : Hypergraph V E)
    (p : E → Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (hp : ∀ e, (p e : ℝ) < 1)
    (x : Fin n → V) (hx : Function.Injective x) :
    (baseMatrix H p x)⁻¹ *ᵥ (fun _ => 1) = fun _ => 1

name: OAI.HyperedgeComparison.inverse_offdiag_nonpos
statement:
theorem inverse_offdiag_nonpos [Fintype V] {n : ℕ} (H : Hypergraph V E)
    (p : E → Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (hp : ∀ e, (p e : ℝ) < 1)
    (x : Fin n → V) (hx : Function.Injective x) {k i : Fin n} (hik : i ≠ k) :
    (baseMatrix H p x)⁻¹ i k ≤ 0

statement:
theorem isolatedMass_pos {n : ℕ} (H : Hypergraph V E)

name: OAI.HyperedgeComparison.joint_comparison
statement:
theorem joint_comparison [Fintype V] (H : Hypergraph V E)
    (p : E → Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (o : V) (A T : Set V) (b : ℝ)
    (hb : ∀ a ∈ A, b ≤ eventProb p (fun ω => Meets H ω ∅ a T)) :
    b * eventProb p (fun ω => Meets H ω ∅ o A) ≤
      eventProb p (fun ω => Meets H ω ∅ o A ∧ Meets H ω ∅ o T)

name: OAI.HyperedgeComparison.joint_comparison_ennreal
statement:
theorem joint_comparison_ennreal [Fintype V] (H : Hypergraph V E)
    (p : E → Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (o : V) (A T : Set V) (b : ℝ≥0∞)
    (hA : A.Nonempty) (hb : ∀ a ∈ A, b ≤ law p {ω | Meets H ω ∅ a T}) :
    law p {ω | Meets H ω ∅ o A} * b ≤
      law p {ω | Meets H ω ∅ o A ∧ Meets H ω ∅ o T}

name: OAI.HyperedgeComparison.joint_comparison_list
statement:
theorem joint_comparison_list [Fintype V] {n : ℕ} (H : Hypergraph V E)
    (p : E → Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (hp : ∀ e, (p e : ℝ) < 1)
    (x : Fin (n+1) → V) (hx : Function.Injective x) (T : Set V) (b : ℝ)
    (hb : ∀ j ≠ Fin.last n, b ≤ eventProb p (fun ω => Meets H ω ∅ (x j) T)) :
    b * eventProb p (fun ω => Meets H ω ∅ (x (Fin.last n)) (earlier x (Fin.last n))) ≤
      eventProb p (fun ω => Meets H ω ∅ (x (Fin.last n)) (earlier x (Fin.last n)) ∧
        Meets H ω ∅ (x (Fin.last n)) T)

name: OAI.HyperedgeComparison.joint_comparison_of_lt_one
statement:
theorem joint_comparison_of_lt_one [Fintype V] (H : Hypergraph V E)
    (p : E → Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (hp : ∀ e, (p e : ℝ) < 1)
    (o : V) (A T : Set V) (b : ℝ)
    (hb : ∀ a ∈ A, b ≤ eventProb p (fun ω => Meets H ω ∅ a T)) :
    b * eventProb p (fun ω => Meets H ω ∅ o A) ≤
      eventProb p (fun ω => Meets H ω ∅ o A ∧ Meets H ω ∅ o T)

name: OAI.HyperedgeComparison.last_diagonal_avoidance
statement:
theorem last_diagonal_avoidance {n : ℕ} (H : Hypergraph V E)
    (p : E → Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (x : Fin (n+1) → V) :
    baseMatrix H p x (Fin.last n) (Fin.last n) =
      1 - eventProb p (fun ω => Meets H ω ∅ (x (Fin.last n)) (earlier x (Fin.last n)))

name: OAI.HyperedgeComparison.law_mass
statement:
theorem law_mass (p : E → Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (ω : E → Bool) :
    (law p).real {ω} = ∏ e, if ω e = true then (p e : ℝ) else 1 - (p e : ℝ)

OAI.HyperedgeComparison.resample_tendsto_constant
statement:
theorem resample_tendsto_constant [Fintype V] (H : Hypergraph V E)
    (p : E → Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (hp : ∀ e, (p e : ℝ) < 1)
    (s : V) (S : Set V) (hs : s ∉ S) (F : Set V → ℝ)
    (hF : ∀ U ∈ ClusterDomain s S, 0 ≤ F U) :
    ∃ c : ℝ, 0 ≤ c ∧ ∀ U ∈ ClusterDomain s S,
      Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => ((resample H p s S)^[n] F) U) atTop (nhds c)

name: OAI.HyperedgeComparison.resamplingTransition_act
statement:
theorem resamplingTransition_act [Fintype V] (H : Hypergraph V E)
    (p : E → Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (s : V) (S : Set V) (F : Set V → ℝ)
    (U : ClusterDomain s S) :
    (resamplingTransition H p s S).act (fun T => F T.1) U =
      resample H p s S F U.1

name: OAI.HyperedgeComparison.resamplingTransition_atom
statement:
theorem resamplingTransition_atom [Fintype V] (H : Hypergraph V E)
    (p : E → Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (s : V) (S : Set V) (hs : s ∉ S)
    (U : ClusterDomain s S) :
    (law p).real {fun _ => false} ≤ (resamplingTransition H p s S).weight U
      ⟨{s}, ⟨by simp, by simpa using hs⟩⟩

name: OAI.HyperedgeComparison.residualMean_alternative
statement:
theorem residualMean_alternative [Fintype V] (H : Hypergraph V E)
    (p : E → Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (s : V) (S U : Set V) (F : Set V → ℝ) :
    residualMean H p s S U F =
      ∫ ω, if s ∈ clusters H ω U S then 0 else
        meanAfterDelete H p s (clusters H ω U S) F - F (cluster H ω U s) ∂law p

name: OAI.HyperedgeComparison.residualMean_eq_integral
statement:
theorem residualMean_eq_integral [Fintype V] (H : Hypergraph V E)
    (p : E → Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (s : V) (S U : Set V) (F : Set V → ℝ) :
    residualMean H p s S U F = ∫ ω, residualSample H ω s S U F ∂law p

name: OAI.HyperedgeComparison.sum_column
statement:
theorem sum_column {n : ℕ} (H : Hypergraph V E)
    (p : E → Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (x : Fin n → V) (F : Set V → ℝ) (i : Fin n) :
    ∑ k, column H p x k F i = ∫ ω, F (cluster H ω ∅ (x i)) ∂law p

name: OAI.HyperedgeComparison.sum_firstRoot

    (ω : E → Bool) (D : Set V) (i : Fin n) (F : Set V → ℝ) :
    (∑ k, if firstRoot H x ω D k i then F (cluster H ω D (x k)) else 0) =

statement:
@[simp] theorem contains_cube (c x : Vertex) (m : ℕ) :
    (cube c m).Contains x ↔ ∀ i, |x i-c i| ≤ (m : ℤ)

name: OAI.CriticalZ3.Box.contains_expand
statement:
theorem contains_expand (B : Box) (j : ℕ) {x : Vertex} (h : B.Contains x) :
    (B.expand j).Contains x

name: OAI.CriticalZ3.Box.cube_bonds_card
statement:
theorem cube_bonds_card (c : Vertex) (m : ℕ) :
    (cube c m).bonds.card = (cube 0 m).bonds.card

name: OAI.CriticalZ3.Box.cube_bonds_translate
statement:
theorem cube_bonds_translate (c : Vertex) (m : ℕ) :
    (cube c m).bonds = (cube 0 m).bonds.image (translateBond c)

name: OAI.CriticalZ3.Box.cube_contains_translate
statement:
@[simp] theorem cube_contains_translate (c x : Vertex) (m : ℕ) :
    (cube c m).Contains (translateVertex c x) ↔ (cube 0 m).Contains x

name: OAI.CriticalZ3.Box.expand_expand
statement: @[simp] theorem expand_expand (B : Box) (j k : ℕ) : (B.expand j).expand k = B.expand (j+k)

name: OAI.CriticalZ3.Box.expand_mono
statement:
theorem expand_mono (B : Box) {j k : ℕ} (hjk : j ≤ k) {x : Vertex}
    (h : (B.expand j).Contains x) : (B.expand k).Contains x

name: OAI.CriticalZ3.Box.expanded_seed_width
statement:
theorem expanded_seed_width (B : Box) {m j : ℕ} (hmj : m ≤ j) (i : Fin 3) :
    (B.expand j).lower i+m ≤ (B.expand j).upper i-m

name: OAI.CriticalZ3.Box.ext
statement: @[ext] theorem ext {B C : Box} (hl : B.lower = C.lower) (hu : B.upper = C.upper) : B = C

name: OAI.CriticalZ3.Box.exterior_neighbor_unique
OAI.CriticalZ3.Box.line_contains
statement:
theorem line_contains (B : Box) {x : Vertex} (hx : B.Contains x) (i : Fin 3)
    (n : ℤ) (hn : B.lower i ≤ n ∧ n ≤ B.upper i) : B.Contains (Function.update x i n)

name: OAI.CriticalZ3.Box.line_path
statement:
theorem line_path (B : Box) {x : Vertex} (hx : B.Contains x) (i : Fin 3)
    {b : ℤ} (hb : B.lower i ≤ b ∧ b ≤ B.upper i) :
    Relation.ReflTransGen B.Within x (Function.update x i b)

name: OAI.CriticalZ3.Box.line_path_le
statement:
theorem line_path_le (B : Box) {x : Vertex} (hx : B.Contains x) (i : Fin 3)
    {a b : ℤ} (ha : B.lower i ≤ a) (hb : b ≤ B.upper i) (hab : a ≤ b) :
    Relation.ReflTransGen B.Within (Function.update x i a) (Function.update x i b)

name: OAI.CriticalZ3.Box.line_step
statement:
theorem line_step (x : Vertex) (i : Fin 3) (n : ℤ) :
    Function.update x i (n+1) = step (Function.update x i n) i

name: OAI.CriticalZ3.Box.mem_bonds
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_bonds (B : Box) (e : Bond) :
    e ∈ B.bonds ↔ B.Contains e.1 ∧ B.Contains (step e.1 e.2)

name: OAI.CriticalZ3.Box.neighbor_coordinates
statement:
theorem neighbor_coordinates {x y : Vertex} (h : NearestNeighbor x y) :
    ∃ i, |y i-x i| = 1 ∧ ∀ k, k ≠ i → y k = x k

name: OAI.CriticalZ3.Box.neighbor_distance
statement:
theorem neighbor_distance {x y : Vertex} (h : NearestNeighbor x y) (i : Fin 3) :
    |y i-x i| ≤ 1

name: OAI.CriticalZ3.Box.neighbor_in_expand
statement:
theorem neighbor_in_expand (B : Box) {x y : Vertex}
    (hx : B.Contains x) (hxy : NearestNeighbor x y) : (B.expand 1).Contains y

name: OAI.CriticalZ3.Box.seedCenter_bounds
statement:
theorem seedCenter_bounds (C : Box) (m : ℕ)
    (hw : ∀ i, C.lower i+m ≤ C.upper i-m) (z : Vertex) (i : Fin 3) :
    C.lower i+m ≤ C.seedCenter m z i ∧ C.seedCenter m z i ≤ C.upper i-m

name: OAI.CriticalZ3.Box.seed_center_near
statement:
theorem seed_center_near (C : Box) (m : ℕ)
    (hw : ∀ i, C.lower i+m ≤ C.upper i-m) {z y : Vertex}
    (hz : C.Contains z) (hyz : NearestNeighbor y z) (i : Fin 3) :
    |C.seedCenter m z i-y i| ≤ (m : ℤ)+1

name: OAI.CriticalZ3.Box.seed_contained
statement:
theorem seed_contained (C : Box) (m : ℕ)
    (hw : ∀ i, C.lower i+m ≤ C.upper i-m) (z : Vertex) :
    ∀ x, (cube (C.seedCenter m z) m).Contains x → C.Contains x

name: OAI.CriticalZ3.Box.seed_contains_entry
statement:
theorem seed_contains_entry (C : Box) (m : ℕ)
    (hw : ∀ i, C.lower i+m ≤ C.upper i-m) {z : Vertex} (hz : C.Contains z) :
    (cube (C.seedCenter m z) m).Contains z

name: OAI.CriticalZ3.Box.separated_centers
statement:
theorem separated_centers (C : Box) (m : ℕ)
    (hw : ∀ i, C.lower i+m ≤ C.upper i-m) {y y' z z' : Vertex}
    (hz : C.Contains z) (hz' : C.Contains z')
    (hy : NearestNeighbor y z) (hy' : NearestNeighbor y' z')
    (hsep : ∃ i, (4*m+2 : ℤ) < |y i-y' i|) :
    ∃ i, (2*m : ℤ) < |C.seedCenter m z i-C.seedCenter m z' i|

name: OAI.CriticalZ3.Box.separated_subset
statement:
theorem separated_subset (s : Finset Vertex) (m K : ℕ)
    (hcard : K*(8*m+5)^3 ≤ s.card) :
    ∃ t ⊆ s, t.card = K ∧
      ∀ a ∈ t, ∀ b ∈ t, a ≠ b → ∃ i, (4*m+2 : ℤ) < |a i-b i|

name: OAI.CriticalZ3.Box.step_translate
statement:
@[simp] theorem step_translate (c x : Vertex) (i : Fin 3) :
    step (translateVertex c x) i = translateVertex c (step x i)

name: OAI.CriticalZ3.Box.translateVertex_injective

name: OAI.CriticalZ3.Box.within_symm
statement: theorem within_symm (B : Box) {x y : Vertex} (h : B.Within x y) : B.Within y x

name: OAI.CriticalZ3.LatticeGraph.adj_neighbor
statement:

name: OAI.CriticalZ3.LatticeGraph.adj_open

name: OAI.CriticalZ3.LatticeGraph.adj_symm
