name: OAI.CriticalZ3.LatticeGraph.conn_determined
statement:
theorem conn_determined (m : Model) (ω ω' : m.Config)
    (h : ∀ e ∈ G.bits m, ω' e = ω e) (x y : G.Node) :
    G.Conn m ω' x y ↔ G.Conn m ω x y

name: OAI.CriticalZ3.LatticeGraph.conn_iff
statement:
theorem conn_iff (m : Model) (ω : m.Config) (x y : G.Node) :
    G.Conn m ω x y ↔ G.Open m ω x ∧ Relation.ReflTransGen (G.Adj m ω) x y

name: OAI.CriticalZ3.LatticeGraph.conn_open
statement:
theorem conn_open (m : Model) {ω : m.Config} {x y : G.Node} (h : G.Conn m ω x y) :
    G.Open m ω x ∧ G.Open m ω y

name: OAI.CriticalZ3.LatticeGraph.conn_symm
statement:
theorem conn_symm (m : Model) {ω : m.Config} {x y : G.Node} (h : G.Conn m ω x y) :
    G.Conn m ω y x

name: OAI.CriticalZ3.LatticeGraph.conn_trans
statement:
theorem conn_trans (m : Model) {ω : m.Config} {x y z : G.Node}
    (h : G.Conn m ω x y) (h' : G.Conn m ω y z) : G.Conn m ω x z

name: OAI.CriticalZ3.LatticeGraph.containsBox_node
statement:
theorem containsBox_node {B : Box} (h : G.ContainsBox B) {x : Vertex}
    (hx : B.Contains x) : x ∈ G.vertices

name: OAI.CriticalZ3.LatticeGraph.failure_comparison
statement:
theorem failure_comparison (m : Model) (p : m.Bit → Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (o : G.Node) (A T : Set Vertex) {b : ℝ} (hb0 : 0 ≤ b)
    (hb : ∀ a : G.Node, a.1 ∈ A →
      1-b ≤ (ProductCylinder.law p).real {ω | G.Meets m ω a T}) :
    (ProductCylinder.law p).real {ω | G.Meets m ω o A ∧ ¬G.Meets m ω o T} ≤ b

name: OAI.CriticalZ3.LatticeGraph.incidence_internal
statement:
theorem incidence_internal {B : Box} {x y : Vertex} {e : Bond}
    (hx : B.Contains x) (hy : B.Contains y) (he : Incidence e x y) : e ∈ B.bonds

name: OAI.CriticalZ3.LatticeGraph.lift_path
statement:
theorem lift_path {r : Vertex → Vertex → Prop} {s : G.Node → G.Node → Prop}
    (hmem : ∀ x y, r x y → y ∈ G.vertices)
    (hrel : ∀ (x y : G.Node), r x.1 y.1 → s x y)

name: OAI.CriticalZ3.LatticeGraph.measurableSet_meets
statement:
theorem measurableSet_meets (m : Model) (o : G.Node) (T : Set Vertex) :

name: OAI.CriticalZ3.LatticeGraph.meets_determined
statement:
theorem meets_determined (m : Model) (o : G.Node) (T : Set Vertex) :
    ProductCylinder.DeterminedBy (F := Prop) (G.bits m) (fun ω => G.Meets m ω o T)

name: OAI.CriticalZ3.LatticeGraph.neighbor_incidence
statement:
theorem neighbor_incidence {x y : Vertex} (h : NearestNeighbor x y) :

statement:
theorem open_box_adj (m : Model) {B : Box} (hB : G.ContainsBox B)

name: OAI.CriticalZ3.Box.entry_eq
statement:
theorem entry_eq {C : Box} {y z : Vertex} (hy : ¬C.Contains y)

name: OAI.CriticalZ3.Box.entry_spec
statement:
theorem entry_spec {C : Box} {y : Vertex} (h : C.Exterior y) :

name: OAI.CriticalZ3.Box.exterior_expand
statement:
theorem exterior_expand {C : Box} {y : Vertex} (h : C.Exterior y) :

theorem entrants_determined (m : Model) (C : Box) (o : G.Node) :

name: OAI.CriticalZ3.LatticeGraph.entryBit_not_outside
statement:
theorem entryBit_not_outside (m : Model) {C : Box} {y : Vertex} (hy : C.Exterior y) :

theorem entryBits_card (m : Model) (C : Box) (ω : m.Config) (o : G.Node) :

name: OAI.CriticalZ3.LatticeGraph.entryBits_determined
statement:
theorem entryBits_determined (m : Model) (C : Box) (o : G.Node) :

name: OAI.CriticalZ3.LatticeGraph.outsideAdj_determined
statement:
theorem outsideAdj_determined (m : Model) (C : Box) (ω ω' : m.Config)

statement:

    (h : ∀ e ∈ G.outsideBits m C, ω' e = ω e) (o y : G.Node) :

name: OAI.CriticalZ3.incidence_unique

theorem incidence_unique {e f : Bond} {x y : Vertex}

name: OAI.CriticalZ3.neighborBond_eq

theorem neighborBond_incidence {x y : Vertex} (h : NearestNeighbor x y) :

    (he : C.entryBit .bond y = C.entryBit .bond z) : y = z

name: OAI.CriticalZ3.Box.crossing_not_internal

name: OAI.CriticalZ3.Box.cube_bits_card
statement:
theorem cube_bits_card (m : Model) (c : Vertex) (r : ℕ) :

name: OAI.CriticalZ3.Box.seedBox_contained
statement:
theorem seedBox_contained (C : Box) (r : ℕ)
    (hw : ∀ i, C.lower i+r ≤ C.upper i-r) (y : Vertex) :
    ∀ x, (C.seedBox r y).Contains x → C.Contains x

name: OAI.CriticalZ3.Box.successBits_card
statement:
theorem successBits_card (C : Box) (r : ℕ) (m : Model)
    (hw : ∀ i, C.lower i+r ≤ C.upper i-r) {y : Vertex} (hy : C.Exterior y) :
    (C.successBits r m y).card = successCard m r

name: OAI.CriticalZ3.Box.successBits_disjoint
statement:
theorem successBits_disjoint (C : Box) (r : ℕ) (m : Model)
    (hw : ∀ i, C.lower i+r ≤ C.upper i-r) {y z : Vertex}
    (hy : C.Exterior y) (hz : C.Exterior z) (hsep : ∃ i, (4*r+2 : ℤ) < |y i-z i|) :
    Disjoint (C.successBits r m y) (C.successBits r m z)

name: OAI.CriticalZ3.LatticeGraph.ContainsBox.mono

theorem ContainsBox.mono {B C : Box} (hC : G.ContainsBox C)

name: OAI.CriticalZ3.LatticeGraph.successBits_disjoint_outside
statement:
theorem successBits_disjoint_outside (m : Model) (C : Box) (r : ℕ)
    (hw : ∀ i, C.lower i+r ≤ C.upper i-r) {y : Vertex} (hy : C.Exterior y) :

name: OAI.CriticalZ3.LatticeGraph.success_reaches_center
statement:
theorem success_reaches_center (m : Model) (C : Box) (r : ℕ)
    (hw : ∀ i, C.lower i+r ≤ C.upper i-r) (hC : G.ContainsBox (C.expand 1))
    {ω : m.Config} {o y : G.Node} (hy : y.1 ∈ G.entrants m C ω o)
    (hs : ∀ e ∈ C.successBits r m y.1, ω e = true) :
    ∃ v : G.Node, v.1 = C.relayCenter r y.1 ∧ G.Conn m ω o v

name: OAI.InfiniteConditioning.allValue_determined
statement:
theorem allValue_determined (J : Finset E) (b : Bool) :
    ProductCylinder.DeterminedBy (F := Prop) J (fun ω => ω ∈ allValue J b)

name: OAI.InfiniteConditioning.fixedParameter_congr
statement:
theorem fixedParameter_congr (p : E → Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (J : Finset E)
    {ξ ξ' : E → Bool} (h : ∀ e ∈ J, ξ e = ξ' e) :
    fixedParameter p J ξ = fixedParameter p J ξ'

name: OAI.InfiniteConditioning.map_replace
statement:
theorem map_replace (p : E → Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (J : Finset E) (ξ : E → Bool) :
    (ProductCylinder.law p).map (replace J ξ) = ProductCylinder.law (fixedParameter p J ξ)

name: OAI.InfiniteConditioning.measurableSet_allValue
statement: theorem measurableSet_allValue (J : Finset E) (b : Bool) : MeasurableSet (allValue J b)

name: OAI.InfiniteConditioning.measurableSet_pattern
statement: theorem measurableSet_pattern (J : Finset E) (ξ : E → Bool) : MeasurableSet (pattern J ξ)

name: OAI.InfiniteConditioning.measurableSet_select
OAI.InfiniteConditioning.pattern_extend_iff
statement:
theorem pattern_extend_iff (J : Finset E) (a : J → Bool) (ω : E → Bool) :
    ω ∈ pattern J (ProductCylinder.extend J a) ↔ J.restrict ω = a

name: OAI.InfiniteConditioning.replace_eq_of_pattern
statement:
theorem replace_eq_of_pattern {J : Finset E} {ξ ω : E → Bool} (h : ω ∈ pattern J ξ) :

name: OAI.InfiniteConditioning.single_probability
statement:
theorem single_probability (p : E → Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (e : E) (b : Bool) :
    (ProductCylinder.law p).real {ω | ω e = b} = bitProbability (p e) b

name: OAI.InfiniteConditioning.conditionalProbability_determined
statement:
theorem conditionalProbability_determined (p : E → Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (J : Finset E)

    ProductCylinder.DeterminedBy J (conditionalProbability p J C)

name: OAI.ShellEstimates.bad_count_bound
statement:
theorem bad_count_bound (Z : Ω → ℝ) (hZ : Integrable Z μ) (hZ0 : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ Z ω)
    {a γ τ : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (_hτ : 0 < τ)
    (hmean : ∫ ω, Z ω ∂μ ≤ a*γ/τ) :
    μ.real {ω | a/2 ≤ Z ω} ≤ 2*γ/τ

name: OAI.ShellEstimates.exists_layer
statement:
theorem exists_layer {I : Type uI} [Fintype I] [Nonempty I]
    (Q A : I → Set Ω) (hAm : ∀ i, MeasurableSet (A i))
    (hAd : Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (A i) (A j))) {α : ℝ} (hα : 0 < α)
    (hblock : ∀ i, α*μ.real (Q i) ≤ μ.real (A i)) :
    ∃ i, μ.real (Q i) ≤ 1/(α*Fintype.card I)

name: OAI.ShellEstimates.no_good_subset
OAI.ShellEstimates.success_count_bound
statement:
theorem success_count_bound (S : Ω → ℝ) (hS : MemLp S 2 μ)
    {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hmean : ∫ ω, S ω ∂μ = a)
    (hvar : variance S μ ≤ a) :
    μ.real {ω | S ω < a/2} ≤ 4/a

name: OAI.TrialCounts.count_mean
statement:
theorem count_mean (A : I → Set Ω) (hA : ∀ i, MeasurableSet (A i)) :
    (∫ ω, count A ω ∂μ) = ∑ i, μ.real (A i)

name: OAI.TrialCounts.count_memLp
statement:
theorem count_memLp (A : I → Set Ω) (hA : ∀ i, MeasurableSet (A i)) :
    MemLp (count A) 2 μ

name: OAI.TrialCounts.count_nonneg
statement: theorem count_nonneg (A : I → Set Ω) (ω : Ω) : 0 ≤ count A ω

name: OAI.TrialCounts.count_variance_le
statement:
theorem count_variance_le (A : I → Set Ω) (hA : ∀ i, MeasurableSet (A i))
    {c : ℝ} (hc : ∀ i, μ.real (A i) = c)
    (hpair : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → μ.real (A i ∩ A j) ≤ c*c) :
    variance (count A) μ ≤ Fintype.card I*c

name: OAI.TrialCounts.indicator_mean
statement:
theorem indicator_mean (A : Set Ω) (hA : MeasurableSet A) :
    (∫ ω, A.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) ω ∂μ) = μ.real A

name: OAI.TrialCounts.indicator_product
statement:
theorem indicator_product (A B : Set Ω) :
    A.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) * B.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) =
      (A ∩ B).indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ))

name: OAI.TrialCounts.no_good_probability
statement:
theorem no_good_probability (A B : I → Set Ω)
    (hA : ∀ i, MeasurableSet (A i)) (hB : ∀ i, MeasurableSet (B i))
    {c γ τ : ℝ} (hcpos : 0 < Fintype.card I*c) (hτ : 0 < τ)
    (hc : ∀ i, μ.real (A i) = c)
    (hpair : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → μ.real (A i ∩ A j) ≤ c*c)
    (hbad : ∀ i, μ.real (B i) ≤ c*γ/τ) :
    μ.real {ω | ∀ i, ω ∈ A i → ω ∈ B i} ≤ 4/(Fintype.card I*c)+2*γ/τ

    prob p P * prob p Q ≤ prob p (fun ω => P ω ∧ Q ω)

name: OAI.ProductCylinder.increasing_and
statement:
theorem increasing_and (J : Finset E) (p : E → Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (A B : Set (E → Bool))
    (hA : DeterminedBy (F := Prop) J (fun ω => ω ∈ A))
    (hB : DeterminedBy (F := Prop) J (fun ω => ω ∈ B))
    (hmA : Monotone (fun ω => ω ∈ A)) (hmB : Monotone (fun ω => ω ∈ B)) :
    (law p).real A*(law p).real B ≤ (law p).real (A ∩ B)

name: OAI.ProductCylinder.probability_congr_parameters
statement:
theorem probability_congr_parameters (J : Finset E)
    (p q : E → Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (hpq : ∀ e ∈ J, p e = q e)
    (A : Set (E → Bool)) (hA : DeterminedBy (F := Prop) J (fun ω => ω ∈ A)) :
    (law p).real A = (law q).real A

name: OAI.ProductCylinder.seed_failure_bound
statement:
theorem seed_failure_bound (J : Finset E) (p : E → Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (O A C : Set (E → Bool))
    (hO : DeterminedBy (F := Prop) J (fun ω => ω ∈ O))
    (hA : DeterminedBy (F := Prop) J (fun ω => ω ∈ A))
    (hmO : Monotone (fun ω => ω ∈ O)) (hmA : Monotone (fun ω => ω ∈ A))
    (hsub : O ∩ A ⊆ C) {γ : ℝ} (hprob : 1-γ ≤ (law p).real A) :
    (law p).real (O ∩ Cᶜ) ≤ (law p).real O*γ

name: OAI.CriticalScales.contour_budget
statement:
theorem contour_budget :

name: OAI.CriticalScales.contour_power

name: OAI.CriticalScales.error_budgets
statement:
theorem error_budgets {f : ℝ} (hf0 : 0 < f) (hf1 : f < 1) :
    ∃ δ η τ γ : ℝ,
      δ ∈ Set.Ioo 0 1 ∧ η ∈ Set.Ioo 0 1 ∧ τ ∈ Set.Ioo 0 1 ∧ γ ∈ Set.Ioo 0 1 ∧
      δ+52*η/δ < f ∧ τ < η/4 ∧ γ < δ ∧ 2*γ/τ < η/4

name: OAI.LatticeRelay.P_thirteen_subset
statement:
theorem P_thirteen_subset {r R : ℤ} (_hR : 0 < R) (hr : 100*(R+1) < r) :
    P r R 13 ⊆ Cube (axisCenter (20*r+1)) (4*r)

name: OAI.LatticeRelay.P_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem P_zero (r R : ℤ) : P r R 0 = Cube 0 (4*r)

name: OAI.LatticeRelay.axisCenter_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem axisCenter_zero : axisCenter 0 = 0

name: OAI.LatticeRelay.contraction_cube
statement:
theorem contraction_cube {r a : ℤ} (_hr : 0 ≤ r) (ha : 0 ≤ a)
    (ha' : 6*r+a < 10*r) (h : Fin 3) {u : Vertex}
    (hu : ∀ i, |u i| ≤ if i < h then 2*r+a else 4*r+a) :
    Cube u (2*r) ⊆ Prism r

name: OAI.LatticeRelay.contraction_face
statement:
theorem contraction_face {r a : ℤ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (h : Fin 3)
    {u : Vertex}
    (hu : ∀ i, |u i| ≤ if i < h then 2*r+a else 4*r+a) :
    QuarterFace u (2*r) h (inward u) ⊆
      Rect 0 (fun i => if i ≤ h then 2*r+a else 4*r+a)

name: OAI.LatticeRelay.contraction_interface
statement:
theorem contraction_interface {r R : ℤ} (hR : 0 < R) (hr : 100*(R+1) < r)

    HasInterface r R 0 (contractionWidths r R t)
      (Rect 0 (contractionWidths r R (t+1)))

name: OAI.LatticeRelay.expanded_route_subset_prism

theorem expanded_route_subset_prism {r R : ℤ} (hR : 0 < R) (hr : 100*(R+1) < r)
    {i : ℕ} (hi : i < 13) :
    Expand (routeCenter r i) (routeWidths r R i) R ⊆ Prism r

theorem inward_endpoint_bound {a s W : ℤ} (_hs : 0 ≤ s) (hW : s ≤ W)

name: OAI.LatticeRelay.translation_cube

    (_hR : 0 < R) (hr : 100*(R+1) < r)

name: OAI.LatticeRelay.translation_face

    (hs : s = 2*r ∨ s = 2*r+1) (hsw : s ≤ w) :
    HasInterface r R (axisCenter a) (fun _ => w-R) (Cube (axisCenter (a+s)) w)

name: OAI.MeasureTheory.finite_relay_bound
statement:
theorem finite_relay_bound (μ : _root_.MeasureTheory.Measure Ω) [_root_.MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (A : ℕ → Set Ω)
    (η : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (h : ∀ i < n, μ.real (A i \ A (i+1)) ≤ η) :

name: OAI.FiniteTrails.exists_closed_trail
statement:
theorem exists_closed_trail (tail head : D → V)
    (hbal : ∀ v, Fintype.card {d // head d = v} = Fintype.card {d // tail d = v})
    (w : D → ℤ) (hw : ∑ d, w d ≠ 0) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, ∃ hn : 0 < n, ∃ e : Fin n → D, Function.Injective e ∧
      (∀ i : Fin n, tail (e (next hn i)) = head (e i)) ∧ (∑ i, w (e i)) ≠ 0

name: OAI.FiniteTrails.exists_cycle_nonzero
statement:
theorem exists_cycle_nonzero (σ : Equiv.Perm D) (w : D → ℤ)
    (hw : ∑ d, w d ≠ 0) :
    ∃ d, (∑ e : D, if σ.SameCycle d e then w e else 0) ≠ 0

name: OAI.FiniteTrails.period_pos
statement: theorem period_pos (σ : Equiv.Perm D) (d : D) : 0 < minimalPeriod σ d

name: OAI.FiniteTrails.successor_tail
statement:

    (hbal : ∀ v, Fintype.card {d // head d = v} = Fintype.card {d // tail d = v})
    (d : D) : tail (successor tail head hbal d) = head d

name: OAI.PlanarBoundary.balanced
OAI.PlanarBoundary.boundary_flux
statement:
theorem boundary_flux (X : Finset Point) :
    (∑ e : Boundary X, rayFlux (tail e) (head e)) = if (0,0) ∈ X then 1 else 0

name: OAI.PlanarBoundary.card_code
statement: theorem card_code (n : ℕ) : Fintype.card (Code n) = 4*n*4^n

name: OAI.PlanarBoundary.cell_flux
statement:
theorem cell_flux (cell : Point) :
    (∑ d : Direction, sideFlux cell d) = if cell = (0,0) then 1 else 0

name: OAI.PlanarBoundary.coordinate_diameter
statement:
theorem coordinate_diameter {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (v : Fin n → Point)
    (hedge : ∀ i, Neighbor (v i) (v (FiniteTrails.next hn i))) (i j : Fin n) :
    (v i).1-(v j).1 < 2*(n : ℤ)

name: OAI.PlanarBoundary.exists_anchored_trail
statement:
theorem exists_anchored_trail (X : Finset Point) (hX : (0,0) ∈ X) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, ∃ hn : 0 < n, ∃ e : Fin n → Boundary X,
      Function.Injective e ∧
      (∀ i, tail (e (FiniteTrails.next hn i)) = head (e i)) ∧
      ∃ i, 0 < (tail (e i)).1 ∧ (tail (e i)).1 < 2*(n : ℤ) ∧
        rayFlux (tail (e i)) (head (e i)) ≠ 0

name: OAI.PlanarBoundary.exists_boundary_code
statement:
theorem exists_boundary_code (X : Finset Point) (hX : (0,0) ∈ X) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, ∃ _hn : 0 < n, ∃ c : Code n, ∃ e : Fin n → Boundary X,
      Function.Injective e ∧ ∀ i, traceSide c i = (e i).val

name: OAI.PlanarBoundary.head_ne_tail
statement: theorem head_ne_tail {X : Finset Point} (e : Boundary X) : head e ≠ tail e

name: OAI.PlanarBoundary.head_neighbor
statement: theorem head_neighbor {X : Finset Point} (e : Boundary X) : Neighbor (tail e) (head e)

name: OAI.PlanarBoundary.internal_flux_zero
statement:
theorem internal_flux_zero (X : Finset Point) :
    (∑ e : {e : FullSide X // isInternal e}, sideFlux e.val.1.val e.val.2) = 0

name: OAI.PlanarBoundary.lineFlux_sum_zero

theorem lineFlux_sum_zero {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (v : Fin n → Point) :

name: OAI.PlanarBoundary.neighbor_coord

name: OAI.PlanarBoundary.next_eq_rotate

name: OAI.PlanarBoundary.opposite_opposite
statement: theorem opposite_opposite (d : Direction) : opposite (opposite d) = d

name: OAI.PlanarBoundary.outward_opposite
statement: theorem outward_opposite (d : Direction) : outward (opposite d) = -outward d

name: OAI.PlanarBoundary.rayFlux_eq_lineFlux
statement:
theorem rayFlux_eq_lineFlux {a b : Point} (h : Neighbor a b) :

name: OAI.PlanarBoundary.rayFlux_ne_zero_height

name: OAI.PlanarBoundary.rayFlux_reverse

name: OAI.PlanarBoundary.reverse_head

name: OAI.PlanarBoundary.reverse_tail

name: OAI.PlanarBoundary.shiftIndex_injective

theorem shiftIndex_injective {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (a : Fin n) :

name: OAI.PlanarBoundary.shiftIndex_next
statement:
theorem shiftIndex_next {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (a i : Fin n) :

name: OAI.PlanarBoundary.sideFlux_reverse
statement:
theorem sideFlux_reverse (cell : Point) (d : Direction) :

name: OAI.PlanarBoundary.side_neighbor
statement:
theorem side_neighbor (cell : Point) (d : Direction) :
    Neighbor (cell+tailOffset d) (cell+headOffset d)

name: OAI.PlanarBoundary.trace_reconstruct
statement:
theorem trace_reconstruct {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) {X : Finset Point}
    (e : Fin n → Boundary X) (he : ∀ i, tail (e (FiniteTrails.next hn i)) = head (e i))
    (c : Code n) (hanchor : anchor c = tail (e ⟨0,hn⟩))
    (hword : ∀ i, c.2.2 i = (e i).val.2) :
    ∀ i, traceSide c i = (e i).val

name: OAI.PlanarBoundary.trace_succ
statement:
theorem trace_succ {n : ℕ} (c : Code n) (k : ℕ) :
    tracePosition c (k+1) = tracePosition c k+displacement (wordAt c.2.2 k)

name: OAI.PlanarBoundary.two_sides
statement:
theorem two_sides {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (v : Fin n → Point)
    (hedge : ∀ i, Neighbor (v i) (v (FiniteTrails.next hn i)))
    (hw : (∑ i, rayFlux (v i) (v (FiniteTrails.next hn i))) ≠ 0) :
    (∃ i, 0 < (v i).1 ∧ rayFlux (v i) (v (FiniteTrails.next hn i)) ≠ 0) ∧
      ∃ j, (v j).1 ≤ 0

name: OAI.FiniteMatching.conflict_card
statement:
theorem conflict_card (a b : E → V)
    (hdeg : ∀ v, (incident a b v).card ≤ 4) (e : E) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (conflict a b e)).card ≤ 7

name: OAI.FiniteMatching.conflict_refl
statement: theorem conflict_refl (a b : E → V) (e : E) : conflict a b e e

name: OAI.FiniteMatching.conflict_symm
statement: theorem conflict_symm (a b : E → V) {e f : E} : conflict a b e f → conflict a b f e

name: OAI.FiniteMatching.endpoint_injective
statement:
theorem endpoint_injective (a b : E → V) (s : Finset E)
    (hp : (s : Set E).Pairwise (fun e f => ¬conflict a b e f)) (choice : s → Bool) :
    Function.Injective (fun e : s => if choice e then a e.val else b e.val)

name: OAI.FiniteMatching.exists_matching
statement:
theorem exists_matching (a b : E → V) (hdeg : ∀ v, (incident a b v).card ≤ 4) :
    ∃ s : Finset E, (s : Set E).Pairwise (fun e f => ¬conflict a b e f) ∧
      Fintype.card E ≤ 7*s.card

name: OAI.GreedyPacking.exists_packing
statement:
theorem exists_packing (t : Finset α) (R : α → α → Prop)
    (hrefl : ∀ a ∈ t, R a a) (hsym : ∀ a ∈ t, ∀ b ∈ t, R a b → R b a)
    (M : ℕ) (hM : ∀ a ∈ t, (t.filter (R a)).card ≤ M) :
    ∃ s : Finset α, s ⊆ t ∧ (s : Set α).Pairwise (fun a b => ¬R a b) ∧ t.card ≤ M*s.card

name: OAI.GreedyPacking.exists_packing_card
statement:
theorem exists_packing_card (t : Finset α) (R : α → α → Prop)
    (hrefl : ∀ a ∈ t, R a a) (hsym : ∀ a ∈ t, ∀ b ∈ t, R a b → R b a)
    (M K : ℕ) (hM0 : 0 < M) (hM : ∀ a ∈ t, (t.filter (R a)).card ≤ M)
    (ht : K*M ≤ t.card) :
    ∃ s : Finset α, s ⊆ t ∧ s.card = K ∧ (s : Set α).Pairwise (fun a b => ¬R a b)

name: OAI.PlanarBoundary.boundary_degree
statement:
theorem boundary_degree (X : Finset Point) (v : Point) :
    Fintype.card {e : Boundary X // primalInside e = v ∨ primalOutside e = v} ≤ 4

name: OAI.PlanarBoundary.code_degree
statement:
theorem code_degree {n : ℕ} (c : Code n) (hc : Valid c) (v : Point) :
    (FiniteMatching.incident (inner c) (outer c) v).card ≤ 4

name: OAI.PlanarBoundary.exists_code_matching
statement:
theorem exists_code_matching {n : ℕ} (c : Code n) (hc : Valid c) :
    ∃ s : Finset (Fin n),
      (s : Set (Fin n)).Pairwise (fun i j => ¬FiniteMatching.conflict (inner c) (outer c) i j) ∧
      n ≤ 7*s.card

name: OAI.PlanarBoundary.blocked_bound
statement:
theorem blocked_bound {n : ℕ} (Bad : Point → Set Ω) (c : Code n) (hc : Valid c)
    {f : ℝ} (hf0 : 0 < f) (hf1 : 2*f ≤ 1)
    (hbad : ∀ s : Finset Point, μ.real {ω | ∀ v ∈ s, ω ∈ Bad v} ≤ f^s.card) :
    μ.real (blocked Bad c) ≤ (2*f)^((n : ℝ)/7)

name: OAI.PlanarBoundary.candidates_bound
statement:
theorem candidates_bound (Bad : Point → Set Ω) {f : ℝ} (hf0 : 0 < f) (hf1 : 2*f ≤ 1)
    (hbad : ∀ s : Finset Point, μ.real {ω | ∀ v ∈ s, ω ∈ Bad v} ≤ f^s.card) (n : ℕ) :
    μ.real (⋃ c : {c : Code n // Valid c}, candidate Bad c) ≤
      4*(n : ℝ)*4^n*(2*f)^((n : ℝ)/7)

name: OAI.PlanarBoundary.encoded_budget_hasSum
statement:
theorem encoded_budget_hasSum :
    HasSum (fun n : ℕ => 4*(n : ℝ)*4^n*(2*CriticalScales.contourError)^((n : ℝ)/7)) (25/144 : ℝ)

name: OAI.PlanarBoundary.finite_good_bound
statement:
theorem finite_good_bound (Good : Ω → Set Point) (Bad : Point → Set Ω)
    (houtside : ∀ ω, (Good ω).Finite → ∀ x ∈ Good ω, ∀ d : Direction,
      x+outward d ∉ Good ω → ω ∈ Bad (x+outward d))
    (hbad : ∀ s : Finset Point,
      μ.real {ω | ∀ v ∈ s, ω ∈ Bad v} ≤ CriticalScales.contourError^s.card) :
    μ.real {ω | (Good ω).Finite ∧ (0,0) ∈ Good ω} ≤ 25/144

name: OAI.PlanarBoundary.finite_good_subset
statement:
theorem finite_good_subset (Good : Ω → Set Point) (Bad : Point → Set Ω)
    (houtside : ∀ ω, (Good ω).Finite → ∀ x ∈ Good ω, ∀ d : Direction,
      x+outward d ∉ Good ω → ω ∈ Bad (x+outward d)) :
    {ω | (Good ω).Finite ∧ (0,0) ∈ Good ω} ⊆
      ⋃ n, ⋃ c : {c : Code n // Valid c}, candidate Bad c

name: OAI.PlanarBoundary.union_bound
statement:
theorem union_bound (A : ℕ → Set Ω) (g : ℕ → ℝ) (hg0 : ∀ n, 0 ≤ g n)
    (hg : Summable g) (hA : ∀ n, μ.real (A n) ≤ g n) :
    μ.real (⋃ n, A n) ≤ ∑' n, g n

    child p hp h (u+v) i=child p hp h u i+child p hp h v i

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.RecursiveModel.child_apply

lemma child_apply (p : ℝ≥0∞) [Fact (1 ≤ p)] (hp : 0 < p.toReal) (h : ℕ) (v : Full p (h+1)) (i : ℕ) (s : Coord h) :

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.RecursiveModel.child_finiteLp

lemma child_finiteLp (p : ℝ≥0∞) [Fact (1 ≤ p)] (hp : 0 < p.toReal) (h : ℕ) (v : Vec (h+1)) (i : ℕ) :

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.RecursiveModel.child_neg

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.RecursiveModel.child_sum

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.RecursiveModel.child_zero

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.RecursiveModel.children_apply

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.UpperFunction.Data.positiveArray_norm

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.DirectLayers.Regular.supported_selection
statement:
lemma supported_selection (k : ℕ) (f : Vertex k → X) {s L η r q : ℝ}
    (hl : ∀ u v,s*distance k u v ≤ ‖f u-f v‖)
    (hu : ∀ u v,‖f u-f v‖ ≤ L*distance k u v)
    (hη : 0 < η) (hr : r < s) (hq : 0 ≤ q) (hqr : q ≤ r-η) :
    ∃ (T : Protocol X I k) (e : History k → Edge k),
      T.Martingale ∧ T.Nested ∧ T.Anchored ∧ T.CommonHeads ∧ T.Supported A.projection ∧
      (∀ u,‖T.last u-slope f (e u)‖ < ((k:ℝ)+1)*η) ∧
      (k:ℝ)*q^2 ≤ T.freshSum A.projection

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.DirectLayers.Regular.true_selection
statement:
lemma true_selection (k : ℕ) (f : Vertex k → X) {s L η r q : ℝ}
    (hl : ∀ u v,s*distance k u v ≤ ‖f u-f v‖)
    (hu : ∀ u v,‖f u-f v‖ ≤ L*distance k u v)
    (hη : 0 < η) (hr : r < s) (hq : 0 ≤ q) (hqr : q ≤ r-2*η) :
    ∃ (T : Protocol X I k) (e : History k → Edge k),
      T.Martingale ∧ T.Nested ∧ T.Anchored ∧ T.CommonHeads ∧
      (∀ u,T.last u=slope f (e u)) ∧
      (∀ u,‖T.last u-A.projection (T.lastHead u) (T.last u)‖ < η) ∧
      (k:ℝ)*q^2 ≤ T.freshSum A.projection ∧ T.leakageSum A.projection ≤ (k:ℝ)*η^2

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.DirectLayers.adaptive_graph

theorem adaptive_graph {C : ℝ} (hin : SignInput A.projection C) {D t : ℝ} (k : ℕ)
    (f : Vertex k → X) (hf : HasDistortion k f D t) :
    (k:ℝ)/16 ≤ C*(D^2+(k:ℝ)*((2:ℝ)^k)⁻¹^2) ∧
      C*(D^2+(k:ℝ)*((2:ℝ)^k)⁻¹^2) ≤ C*(D^2+1)

    (hu : ∀ u v,‖f u-f v‖ ≤ L*distance k u v)
    (T : Protocol X I k) (e : History k → Edge k)
    (he : ∀ u,‖T.last u-slope f (e u)‖ < ((k:ℝ)+1)*η)
    (hC : L+((k:ℝ)+1)*η ≤ C) : ∀ u,‖T.last u‖ ≤ C

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.DirectLayers.gap_graph
statement:
theorem gap_graph (hin : GapInput A.projection) {D t γ : ℝ} (k : ℕ)
    (f : Vertex k → X) (hf : HasDistortion k f D t) (hγ : 0 < γ)
    (hγa : γ < (2/D)/8) (hγk : γ < 1/((k:ℝ)+1)) :
    ∃ T : Protocol X I k,T.Martingale ∧ T.Nested ∧ T.Anchored ∧ T.CommonHeads ∧ T.Supported A.projection ∧
      T.terminalEnergy ≤ 4 ∧ T.initialEnergy+(k:ℝ)*((2/D)/8)^2/400 ≤ T.terminalEnergy ∧
      (k:ℝ)*((2/D)/8)^2/400 ≤ T.initialEnergy+(k:ℝ)*((2/D)/8)^2/400

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.Resolvent.purificationKernel_eq
statement:
lemma purificationKernel_eq {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.PosSemidef)
    {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) : purificationKernel A s = 1 - s • resolvent A s

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.Resolvent.purificationKernel_square_le
statement:
lemma purificationKernel_square_le {A B : Matrix n n ℂ}
    (hA : A.PosSemidef) (hB : B.PosSemidef) {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) :
    (purificationKernel A s - purificationKernel B s)ᴴ *
      (purificationKernel A s - purificationKernel B s) ≤
      s • (resolvent B s * (A - B) * resolvent A s * (A - B) * resolvent B s)

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.Resolvent.purificationKernel_sub
statement:
lemma purificationKernel_sub {A B : Matrix n n ℂ}
    (hA : A.PosSemidef) (hB : B.PosSemidef) {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) :
    purificationKernel A s - purificationKernel B s =
      s • (resolvent A s * (A - B) * resolvent B s)

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.Resolvent.second_resolvent_identity

lemma second_resolvent_identity (A B : Matrix n n ℂ) (hA : IsUnit A) (hB : IsUnit B) :
    A⁻¹ = B⁻¹ - B⁻¹ * (A - B) * B⁻¹ +
      B⁻¹ * (A - B) * A⁻¹ * (A - B) * B⁻¹

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.Resolvent.weighted_kernel_square_le
statement:
lemma weighted_kernel_square_le {J : Type u_J} [Fintype J]
    (A : J → Matrix n n ℂ) (w : J → ℝ) (B : Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hA : ∀ j, (A j).PosSemidef) (hB : B.PosSemidef)
    (hw0 : ∀ j, 0 ≤ w j) (hw : ∑ j, w j = 1) (hmean : ∑ j, w j • A j = B)
    {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) :
    ∑ j, w j • ((purificationKernel (A j) s - purificationKernel B s)ᴴ *
      (purificationKernel (A j) s - purificationKernel B s)) ≤
    s • ∑ j, w j • (resolvent (A j) s - resolvent B s)

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.Resolvent.weighted_resolvent_identity
statement:
lemma weighted_resolvent_identity {J : Type u_J} [Fintype J]
    (A : J → Matrix n n ℂ) (w : J → ℝ) (B : Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hA : ∀ j, (A j).PosSemidef) (hB : B.PosSemidef)
    (hw : ∑ j, w j = 1) (hmean : ∑ j, w j • A j = B)
    {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) :
    ∑ j, w j • (resolvent (A j) s - resolvent B s) =
      ∑ j, w j • (resolvent B s * (A j - B) * resolvent (A j) s *
        (A j - B) * resolvent B s)

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.Resolvent.entropy_gap_integrand_eq
statement:
lemma entropy_gap_integrand_eq {J : Type u_J} [Fintype J]
    (A : J → Matrix n n ℂ) (w : J → ℝ) (B : Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hA : ∀ j, (A j).PosSemidef) (hB : B.PosSemidef)
    (hw : ∑ j, w j = 1) (hmean : ∑ j, w j • A j = B)
    {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) :
    (∑ j, w j • entropyIntegrand (A j) s) - entropyIntegrand B s =
      s • ∑ j, w j • (resolvent (A j) s - resolvent B s)

statement:
lemma fromBlocks_sub {q : Type u_q} (A A' : Matrix m n ℂ) (B B' : Matrix m p ℂ)

OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.hsSq_blocks
statement:
lemma hsSq_blocks {q : Type u_q} [Fintype q] (A : Matrix m n ℂ) (B : Matrix m p ℂ)
    (C : Matrix q n ℂ) (D : Matrix q p ℂ) :
    hsSq (Matrix.fromBlocks A B C D) = hsSq A + hsSq B + hsSq C + hsSq D

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.hsSq_cfc_sub_le

lemma hsSq_cfc_sub_le [DecidableEq n] {A B : Matrix n n ℂ}

    hsSq (cfc f A - cfc f B) ≤ L * hsSq (A - B)

statement: lemma hsSq_nonneg (M : Matrix m n ℂ) : 0 ≤ hsSq M

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.hsSq_right_absolute_sub_le
statement:
theorem hsSq_right_absolute_sub_le [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n] (M N : Matrix m n ℂ) :
    hsSq (CFC.sqrt (Mᴴ * M) - CFC.sqrt (Nᴴ * N)) ≤ 2 * hsSq (M - N)

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.hsSq_spectral_mixed
statement:
lemma hsSq_spectral_mixed [DecidableEq n] {A B : Matrix n n ℂ}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hB : B.IsHermitian) (f g : ℝ → ℝ) :
    hsSq (cfc f A - cfc g B) =
      ∑ i, ∑ j, (f (hA.eigenvalues i) - g (hB.eigenvalues j)) ^ 2 *
        Complex.normSq (((hA.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ *
          (hB.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n ℂ)) i j)

statement:
lemma binProjection_mismatch_le (L : Finset ℤ) {A B : Matrix n n ℂ}

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.exists_shift_spectralEnvelope_le
statement:
lemma exists_shift_spectralEnvelope_le {ι : Type u_ι} [Fintype ι] (w : ι → ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) (hs : ∑ i, w i = 1) (A B : ι → Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hA : ∀ i, (A i).PosSemidef) (hB : ∀ i, (B i).PosSemidef)
    (hAe : ∀ i, hsSq (A i) = 1) (hBe : ∀ i, hsSq (B i) = 1)
    {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε ≤ 1) :
    ∃ s : ℝ, (∑ i, w i * spectralEnvelope (hA i).isHermitian (hB i).isHermitian ε s) ≤
      (6/ε) * Real.sqrt (∑ i, w i * hsSq (A i-B i))

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.integral_binEnvelope_le
statement:
lemma integral_binEnvelope_le {a b ε : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b)
    (hε : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε ≤ 1) :
    (∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, binEnvelope a b ε s) ≤ 3/ε * |a-b| * (a+b)

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.integral_spectralEnvelope_le
statement:
lemma integral_spectralEnvelope_le {A B : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.PosSemidef) (hB : B.PosSemidef)
    {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε ≤ 1) :
    (∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, spectralEnvelope hA.isHermitian hB.isHermitian ε s) ≤
    3/ε * (Real.sqrt (hsSq (A-B)) * Real.sqrt (2*(hsSq A+hsSq B)))

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.integral_spectralEnvelope_unit_le

lemma integral_spectralEnvelope_unit_le {A B : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.PosSemidef) (hB : B.PosSemidef)
    (hAe : hsSq A = 1) (hBe : hsSq B = 1) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε ≤ 1) :
    (∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, spectralEnvelope hA.isHermitian hB.isHermitian ε s) ≤
    (6/ε) * Real.sqrt (hsSq (A-B))

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.log_difference_bound
statement:
lemma log_difference_bound {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a ≤ b) :

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.logarithmic_envelope_bound
statement:
lemma logarithmic_envelope_bound {a b ε : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b)
    (hε : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε ≤ 1) :
    (a-b)^2 + 2*a*b*(|Real.log a-Real.log b|/ε) ≤ 3/ε * |a-b| * (a+b)

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.overlap_distance
statement:
lemma overlap_distance {A B : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hB : B.IsHermitian) :
    (∑ i, ∑ j, (hA.eigenvalues i - hB.eigenvalues j)^2 * overlap hA hB i j) = hsSq (A-B)

statement:
lemma overlap_row {A B : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hB : B.IsHermitian) (i : n) :

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.overlap_square_sum_le
statement:
lemma overlap_square_sum_le {A B : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hB : B.IsHermitian) :
    (∑ i, ∑ j, (hA.eigenvalues i + hB.eigenvalues j)^2 * overlap hA hB i j) ≤

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.overlap_transport_le
statement:
lemma overlap_transport_le {A B : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hB : B.IsHermitian) :
    (∑ i, ∑ j, |hA.eigenvalues i - hB.eigenvalues j| *
      (hA.eigenvalues i + hB.eigenvalues j) * overlap hA hB i j) ≤
      Real.sqrt (hsSq (A-B)) * Real.sqrt (2 * (hsSq A + hsSq B))

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.scalar_mismatch_le
statement:
lemma scalar_mismatch_le (L : Finset ℤ) (ε s : ℝ) {a b : ℝ}

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.unitary_col_normSq

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.eval_one
statement:
lemma eval_one [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n] (C : Matrix m n ℂ) :
    eval C 1 1 = (hsSq C : ℂ)

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.eval_pullback
statement:
lemma eval_pullback (C : Matrix m n ℂ) (K : Matrix p m ℂ) (L : Matrix q n ℂ)
    (A : Matrix p p ℂ) (B : Matrix q q ℂ) :
    eval C (Kᴴ*A*K) (Lᴴ*B*L) = eval (K*C*Lᵀ) A B

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.eval_real
statement:
lemma eval_real {C : Matrix m n ℂ} {A : Matrix m m ℂ} {B : Matrix n n ℂ}
    (hA : A.PosSemidef) (hB : B.PosSemidef) : eval C A B = (prob C A B : ℂ)

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.exists_common_bins
statement:
lemma exists_common_bins {ι : Type u_ι} [Fintype ι] (A : ι → Matrix n n ℂ) (ε s : ℝ) :
    ∃ L : Finset ℤ, 0 ∈ L ∧ ∀ i, CoversBins L (A i) ε s

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.hsSq_add_le
statement: lemma hsSq_add_le (M N : Matrix m n ℂ) : hsSq (M+N) ≤ 2*(hsSq M+hsSq N)

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.hsSq_kronecker
statement:
lemma hsSq_kronecker (C : Matrix m n ℂ) (D : Matrix p q ℂ) :
    hsSq (C ⊗ₖ D) = hsSq C * hsSq D

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.hsSq_mul_contraction
statement:
lemma hsSq_mul_contraction {W : Matrix m n ℂ} (hW : Wᴴ*W ≤ 1)
    {p : Type u_p} [Fintype p] (M : Matrix n p ℂ) : hsSq (W*M) ≤ hsSq M

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.hsSq_mul_projection_le
statement:
lemma hsSq_mul_projection_le {P : Matrix m m ℂ} (hP : P.IsHermitian) (hPP : P*P=P)
    (M : Matrix m n ℂ) : hsSq (P*M) ≤ hsSq M

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.hsSq_mul_right_contraction
statement:
lemma hsSq_mul_right_contraction [DecidableEq n] {W : Matrix n p ℂ} (hW : W*Wᴴ ≤ 1)
    (M : Matrix m n ℂ) : hsSq (M*W) ≤ hsSq M

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.hsSq_neg
statement: lemma hsSq_neg (M : Matrix m n ℂ) : hsSq (-M) = hsSq M

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.hsSq_orthogonal_projection_sum
statement:
lemma hsSq_orthogonal_projection_sum {ι : Type u_ι} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (P : ι → Matrix m m ℂ) (F : ι → Matrix m n ℂ) (r : ι → ℝ)
    (hP : ∀ i, (P i).IsHermitian) (hPP : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → P i*P j=0) :
    hsSq (∑ i, r i • (P i*F i)) = ∑ i, (r i)^2*hsSq (P i*F i)

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.hsSq_smul
statement: lemma hsSq_smul (r : ℝ) (M : Matrix m n ℂ) : hsSq (r • M) = r^2*hsSq M

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.hsSq_sub_comm
statement: lemma hsSq_sub_comm (M N : Matrix m n ℂ) : hsSq (M-N) = hsSq (N-M)

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.hsSq_sum_orthogonal
statement:
lemma hsSq_sum_orthogonal {ι : Type u_ι} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (F : ι → Matrix m n ℂ) (hF : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → (F i)ᴴ*F j=0) :
    hsSq (∑ i, F i) = ∑ i, hsSq (F i)

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.polar_contraction
statement: lemma polar_contraction (M : Matrix m n ℂ) : (polar M)ᴴ*polar M ≤ 1

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.polar_crossBins_error_le
statement:
lemma polar_crossBins_error_le (L : Finset ℤ) (M N : Matrix n n ℂ)
    {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (s : ℝ) (hL : CoversBins L (rightAbs M) ε s) :
    hsSq (M-polar M*crossBins L (rightAbs M) (rightAbs N) ε s) ≤
      2*ε^2*hsSq M + 2*binMismatch L (rightAbs M) (rightAbs N) ε s

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.polar_gram
statement:
lemma polar_gram (M : Matrix m n ℂ) :
    (polar M)ᴴ * polar M = supportInverse (rightAbs M) * rightAbs M

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.polar_gram_bin
statement:
lemma polar_gram_bin (M : Matrix m n ℂ) (ε s : ℝ) (l : ℤ) :
    ((polar M)ᴴ*polar M)*binProjection (rightAbs M) ε s l = binProjection (rightAbs M) ε s l

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.polar_mul_rightAbs
statement: lemma polar_mul_rightAbs (M : Matrix m n ℂ) : polar M * rightAbs M = M

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.prob_add_left
statement:
lemma prob_add_left (C : Matrix m n ℂ) (A A' : Matrix m m ℂ) (B : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    prob C (A+A') B = prob C A B + prob C A' B

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.prob_add_right
statement:
lemma prob_add_right (C : Matrix m n ℂ) (A : Matrix m m ℂ) (B B' : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    prob C A (B+B') = prob C A B + prob C A B'

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.prob_kronecker
statement:
lemma prob_kronecker (C : Matrix m n ℂ) (D : Matrix p q ℂ)
    {A : Matrix m m ℂ} {B : Matrix n n ℂ} {E : Matrix p p ℂ} {F : Matrix q q ℂ}
    (hA : A.PosSemidef) (hB : B.PosSemidef) (hE : E.PosSemidef) (hF : F.PosSemidef) :
    prob (C ⊗ₖ D) (A ⊗ₖ E) (B ⊗ₖ F) = prob C A B * prob D E F

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.prob_nonneg
statement:
lemma prob_nonneg {C : Matrix m n ℂ} {A : Matrix m m ℂ} {B : Matrix n n ℂ}
    (hA : A.PosSemidef) (hB : B.PosSemidef) : 0 ≤ prob C A B

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.prob_one
statement:
lemma prob_one [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n] (C : Matrix m n ℂ) :
    prob C 1 1 = hsSq C

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.prob_pullback
statement:
lemma prob_pullback (C : Matrix m n ℂ) (K : Matrix p m ℂ) (L : Matrix q n ℂ)
    (A : Matrix p p ℂ) (B : Matrix q q ℂ) :
    prob C (Kᴴ*A*K) (Lᴴ*B*L) = prob (K*C*Lᵀ) A B

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.projection_le_one
statement: lemma projection_le_one {P : Matrix n n ℂ} (hP : P.IsHermitian) (hPP : P*P=P) : P ≤ 1

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.rightAbs_pos
statement: lemma rightAbs_pos (M : Matrix m n ℂ) : (rightAbs M).PosSemidef

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.rightAbs_sq
statement: lemma rightAbs_sq (M : Matrix m n ℂ) : rightAbs M * rightAbs M = Mᴴ*M

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.roundedAbs_energy_le
statement:
lemma roundedAbs_energy_le {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.PosSemidef)
    {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (s : ℝ) : hsSq (roundedAbs A ε s) ≤ hsSq A

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.roundedAbs_eq_sum
statement:
lemma roundedAbs_eq_sum (L : Finset ℤ) {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (ε s : ℝ)
    (hL : CoversBins L A ε s) :
    roundedAbs A ε s = ∑ l : L, binScale ε s l • binProjection A ε s l

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.roundedAbs_error_le
statement:
lemma roundedAbs_error_le {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.PosSemidef)
    {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (s : ℝ) : hsSq (A-roundedAbs A ε s) ≤ ε^2*hsSq A

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.sum_binScale_indicator
statement:
lemma sum_binScale_indicator (L : Finset ℤ) (ε s a : ℝ)
    (h : 0 < a → ⌊Real.log a/ε+s⌋ ∈ L) :
    (∑ l ∈ L, binScale ε s l * binIndicator ε s l a) = binWeight a ε s

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.supportInverse_bin
statement:
lemma supportInverse_bin {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (ε s : ℝ) (l : ℤ) :
    (supportInverse A*A)*binProjection A ε s l = binProjection A ε s l

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.supportInverse_mul_le_one
statement:
lemma supportInverse_mul_le_one {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) :
    supportInverse A * A ≤ 1

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.POVM.pull_pos
statement:
lemma POVM.pull_pos (P : POVM m A) (K : Matrix m n ℂ) (a : A) :
    (P.pull K a).PosSemidef

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.POVM.pull_sum
statement:
lemma POVM.pull_sum (P : POVM m A) (K : Matrix m n ℂ) :
    ∑ a, P.pull K a = Kᴴ * K

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.eval_submatrix
statement:
lemma eval_submatrix {m : Type u_m} {n : Type u_n} {p : Type u_p} {q : Type u_q} [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [Fintype p] [Fintype q]
    (C : Matrix m n ℂ) (U : Matrix m m ℂ) (V : Matrix n n ℂ) (e : p ≃ m) (f : q ≃ n) :
    eval (C.submatrix e f) (U.submatrix e e) (V.submatrix f f) = eval C U V

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.exists_strategy_of_finite
statement:
lemma exists_strategy_of_finite {m n X Y A B : Type}
    [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n] [Nonempty m] [Nonempty n]
    [Fintype A] [Fintype B] (C : Matrix m n ℂ) (hC : hsSq C = 1)
    (P : X → POVM m A) (Q : Y → POVM n B) :
    ∃ S : Strategy X Y A B, ∀ x y a b, S.born x y a b = prob C ((P x).effect a) ((Q y).effect b)

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.filter_mass_bounds
statement:
lemma filter_mass_bounds (D : Matrix n q ℂ) (K : Matrix m n ℂ) (L : Matrix p q ℂ)
    (hK : Kᴴ*K ≤ 1) (hL : Lᴴ*L ≤ 1) :
    hsSq (K*D*Lᵀ) ≤ hsSq (K*D) ∧ hsSq (K*D*Lᵀ) ≤ hsSq (D*Lᵀ) ∧
      hsSq (K*D) ≤ hsSq D ∧ hsSq (D*Lᵀ) ≤ hsSq D

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.finite_filter_geometric_value
statement:
lemma finite_filter_geometric_value {m n p q : Type} [Fintype m] [Fintype n]
    [Fintype p] [Fintype q] [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n] [DecidableEq p] [DecidableEq q]
    [Nonempty n] [Nonempty q] {x y a b : ℕ} (G : Game x y a b)
    (D : Matrix n q ℂ) (hD : hsSq D = 1)
    (P : Fin (x+1) → POVM m (Fin (a+1))) (Q : Fin (y+1) → POVM p (Fin (b+1)))
    (K : Fin (x+1) → Matrix m n ℂ) (L : Fin (y+1) → Matrix p q ℂ)
    (hK : ∀ x, (K x)ᴴ*K x ≤ 1) (hL : ∀ y, (L y)ᴴ*L y ≤ 1) (t : ℕ) :
    (∑ z : Fin (x+1) × Fin (y+1), G.questionProb z *
      (payoff (K z.1*D*(L z.2)ᵀ) (P z.1) (Q z.2) (G.accepts z.1 z.2) *
        ∑ j ∈ Finset.range t, (prob D (1-(K z.1)ᴴ*K z.1) (1-(L z.2)ᴴ*L z.2))^j)) ≤
      entangledValue G

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.finite_filter_value
statement:
theorem finite_filter_value {m n p q : Type} [Fintype m] [Fintype n]
    [Fintype p] [Fintype q] [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n] [DecidableEq p] [DecidableEq q]
    [Nonempty n] [Nonempty q] {x y a b : ℕ} (G : Game x y a b)
    (D : Matrix n q ℂ) (hD : hsSq D = 1)
    (P : Fin (x+1) → POVM m (Fin (a+1))) (Q : Fin (y+1) → POVM p (Fin (b+1)))
    (K : Fin (x+1) → Matrix m n ℂ) (L : Fin (y+1) → Matrix p q ℂ)
    (hK : ∀ x, (K x)ᴴ*K x ≤ 1) (hL : ∀ y, (L y)ᴴ*L y ≤ 1) :
    (∑ z : Fin (x+1) × Fin (y+1), G.questionProb z *
      (payoff (K z.1*D*(L z.2)ᵀ) (P z.1) (Q z.2) (G.accepts z.1 z.2) /
        (1-prob D (1-(K z.1)ᴴ*K z.1) (1-(L z.2)ᴴ*L z.2)))) ≤ entangledValue G

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.finite_filter_value_unnormalized
statement:
theorem finite_filter_value_unnormalized {m n p q : Type} [Fintype m] [Fintype n]
    [Fintype p] [Fintype q] [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n] [DecidableEq p] [DecidableEq q]
    [Nonempty n] [Nonempty q] {x y a b : ℕ} (G : Game x y a b)
    (D : Matrix n q ℂ) (hD : 0 < hsSq D)
    (P : Fin (x+1) → POVM m (Fin (a+1))) (Q : Fin (y+1) → POVM p (Fin (b+1)))
    (K : Fin (x+1) → Matrix m n ℂ) (L : Fin (y+1) → Matrix p q ℂ)
    (hK : ∀ x, (K x)ᴴ*K x ≤ 1) (hL : ∀ y, (L y)ᴴ*L y ≤ 1) :
    (∑ z : Fin (x+1) × Fin (y+1), G.questionProb z *
      (payoff (K z.1*D*(L z.2)ᵀ) (P z.1) (Q z.2) (G.accepts z.1 z.2) /
        (hsSq (K z.1*D) + hsSq (D*(L z.2)ᵀ) - hsSq (K z.1*D*(L z.2)ᵀ)))) ≤
      entangledValue G

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.firstSuccess_payoff_geometric
statement:
lemma firstSuccess_payoff_geometric {m n p q A B : Type} [Fintype m] [Fintype n]
    [Fintype p] [Fintype q] [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n] [DecidableEq p] [DecidableEq q]
    [Fintype A] [Fintype B]
    (D : Matrix n q ℂ) (hD : hsSq D = 1) (P : POVM m A) (Q : POVM p B)
    (K : Matrix m n ℂ) (L : Matrix p q ℂ) (hK : Kᴴ*K ≤ 1) (hL : Lᴴ*L ≤ 1)
    (a₀ : A) (b₀ : B) (t : ℕ) (V : A → B → Bool) :
    payoff (K*D*Lᵀ) P Q V *
      (∑ j ∈ Finset.range t, (prob D (1-Kᴴ*K) (1-Lᴴ*L))^j) ≤
      payoff (tensorPower D t) (firstSuccess P K hK a₀ t) (firstSuccess Q L hL b₀ t) V

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.firstSuccess_prob_geometric
statement:
lemma firstSuccess_prob_geometric {m n p q A B : Type} [Fintype m] [Fintype n]
    [Fintype p] [Fintype q] [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n] [DecidableEq p] [DecidableEq q]
    [Fintype A] [Fintype B]
    (D : Matrix n q ℂ) (hD : hsSq D = 1) (P : POVM m A) (Q : POVM p B)
    (K : Matrix m n ℂ) (L : Matrix p q ℂ) (hK : Kᴴ*K ≤ 1) (hL : Lᴴ*L ≤ 1)
    (a₀ : A) (b₀ : B) (t : ℕ) (a : A) (b : B) :
    prob (K*D*Lᵀ) (P.effect a) (Q.effect b) *
      (∑ j ∈ Finset.range t, (prob D (1-Kᴴ*K) (1-Lᴴ*L))^j) ≤
      prob (tensorPower D t) ((firstSuccess P K hK a₀ t).effect a)
        ((firstSuccess Q L hL b₀ t).effect b)

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.firstSuccess_prob_succ
statement:
lemma firstSuccess_prob_succ {m n p q A B : Type} [Fintype m] [Fintype n]
    [Fintype p] [Fintype q] [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n] [DecidableEq p] [DecidableEq q]
    [Fintype A] [Fintype B]
    (D : Matrix n q ℂ) (hD : hsSq D = 1) (P : POVM m A) (Q : POVM p B)
    (K : Matrix m n ℂ) (L : Matrix p q ℂ) (hK : Kᴴ*K ≤ 1) (hL : Lᴴ*L ≤ 1)
    (a₀ : A) (b₀ : B) (t : ℕ) (a : A) (b : B) :
    prob (K*D*Lᵀ) (P.effect a) (Q.effect b) +
      prob D (1-Kᴴ*K) (1-Lᴴ*L) *
        prob (tensorPower D t) ((firstSuccess P K hK a₀ t).effect a)
          ((firstSuccess Q L hL b₀ t).effect b) ≤
      prob (tensorPower D (t+1)) ((firstSuccess P K hK a₀ (t+1)).effect a)
        ((firstSuccess Q L hL b₀ (t+1)).effect b)

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.geometric_contribution_tendsto
statement:
lemma geometric_contribution_tendsto {w z : ℝ} (hz0 : 0 ≤ z) (hz1 : z ≤ 1)
    (hw : z = 1 → w = 0) :
    Tendsto (fun t : ℕ => w * ∑ j ∈ Finset.range t, z^j) atTop (𝓝 (w/(1-z)))

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.hsSq_tensorPower
statement:
lemma hsSq_tensorPower {m n : Type} [Fintype m] [Fintype n] (D : Matrix m n ℂ) (t : ℕ) :
    hsSq (tensorPower D t) = hsSq D ^ t

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.kronecker_sum_left
statement:
lemma kronecker_sum_left {ι : Type u_ι} [Fintype ι] (M : ι → Matrix m m ℂ)
    (N : Matrix n n ℂ) : (∑ i, M i) ⊗ₖ N = ∑ i, M i ⊗ₖ N

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.kronecker_sum_right
statement:
lemma kronecker_sum_right {ι : Type u_ι} [Fintype ι] (M : Matrix m m ℂ)
    (N : ι → Matrix n n ℂ) : M ⊗ₖ (∑ i, N i) = ∑ i, M ⊗ₖ N i

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.output_zero_of_fail_full
statement:
lemma output_zero_of_fail_full (D : Matrix n q ℂ) (K : Matrix m n ℂ) (L : Matrix p q ℂ)
    (hK : Kᴴ*K ≤ 1) (hL : Lᴴ*L ≤ 1)
    (h : prob D (1-Kᴴ*K) (1-Lᴴ*L) = hsSq D) : hsSq (K*D*Lᵀ) = 0

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.payoff_le_hsSq
statement:
lemma payoff_le_hsSq (C : Matrix m n ℂ) (P : POVM m A) (Q : POVM n B) (V : A → B → Bool) :
    payoff C P Q V ≤ hsSq C

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.payoff_nonneg
statement:
lemma payoff_nonneg (C : Matrix m n ℂ) (P : POVM m A) (Q : POVM n B) (V : A → B → Bool) :
    0 ≤ payoff C P Q V

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.payoff_smul
statement:
lemma payoff_smul {m : Type u_m} {n : Type u_n} {A : Type u_A} {B : Type u_B} [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n]
    [Fintype A] [Fintype B] (r : ℝ) (C : Matrix m n ℂ) (P : POVM m A) (Q : POVM n B)
    (V : A → B → Bool) : payoff (r • C) P Q V = r^2 * payoff C P Q V

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.prob_fail
statement:
lemma prob_fail (D : Matrix n q ℂ) (K : Matrix m n ℂ) (L : Matrix p q ℂ) :
    prob D (1-Kᴴ*K) (1-Lᴴ*L) =
      hsSq D - hsSq (K*D) - hsSq (D*Lᵀ) + hsSq (K*D*Lᵀ)

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.prob_fail_le
statement:
lemma prob_fail_le (D : Matrix n q ℂ) (K : Matrix m n ℂ) (L : Matrix p q ℂ)
    (hK : Kᴴ*K ≤ 1) (hL : Lᴴ*L ≤ 1) :
    prob D (1-Kᴴ*K) (1-Lᴴ*L) ≤ hsSq D

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.prob_first_step_ge
statement:
lemma prob_first_step_ge {m : Type u_m} {n : Type u_n} {p : Type u_p} {q : Type u_q} [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [Fintype p] [Fintype q]
    [DecidableEq p] [DecidableEq q]
    (C : Matrix m n ℂ) (D : Matrix p q ℂ) (hD : hsSq D = 1)
    {G F : Matrix m m ℂ} {H J : Matrix n n ℂ} {E : Matrix p p ℂ} {T : Matrix q q ℂ}
    (hG : G.PosSemidef) (hF : F.PosSemidef) (hH : H.PosSemidef) (hJ : J.PosSemidef)
    (hE : E.PosSemidef) (hT : T.PosSemidef) :
    prob C G H + prob C F J * prob D E T ≤
      prob (C ⊗ₖ D) (G ⊗ₖ 1 + F ⊗ₖ E) (H ⊗ₖ 1 + J ⊗ₖ T)

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.prob_gram
statement:
lemma prob_gram (D : Matrix n q ℂ) (K : Matrix m n ℂ) (L : Matrix p q ℂ) :
    prob D (Kᴴ*K) (Lᴴ*L) = hsSq (K*D*Lᵀ)

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.prob_left_gram
statement:
lemma prob_left_gram (D : Matrix n q ℂ) (K : Matrix m n ℂ) :
    prob D (Kᴴ*K) 1 = hsSq (K*D)

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.prob_right_gram
statement:
lemma prob_right_gram (D : Matrix n q ℂ) (L : Matrix p q ℂ) :
    prob D 1 (Lᴴ*L) = hsSq (D*Lᵀ)

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.prob_smul
statement:
lemma prob_smul {m : Type u_m} {n : Type u_n} [Fintype m] [Fintype n]
    (r : ℝ) (C : Matrix m n ℂ) (A : Matrix m m ℂ) (B : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    prob (r • C) A B = r^2 * prob C A B

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.prob_sub_left
statement:
lemma prob_sub_left (C : Matrix m n ℂ) (A A' : Matrix m m ℂ) (B : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    prob C (A-A') B = prob C A B - prob C A' B

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.prob_sub_right
statement:
lemma prob_sub_right (C : Matrix m n ℂ) (A : Matrix m m ℂ) (B B' : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    prob C A (B-B') = prob C A B - prob C A B'

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.prob_sum_left
statement:
lemma prob_sum_left {m : Type u_m} {n : Type u_n} {ι : Type u_ι} [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [Fintype ι]
    (C : Matrix m n ℂ) (A : ι → Matrix m m ℂ) (B : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    prob C (∑ i, A i) B = ∑ i, prob C (A i) B

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.prob_sum_right
statement:
lemma prob_sum_right {m : Type u_m} {n : Type u_n} {ι : Type u_ι} [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [Fintype ι]
    (C : Matrix m n ℂ) (A : Matrix m m ℂ) (B : ι → Matrix n n ℂ) :
    prob C A (∑ i, B i) = ∑ i, prob C A (B i)

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.prob_total
statement:
lemma prob_total (C : Matrix m n ℂ) (P : POVM m A) (Q : POVM n B) :
    ∑ a, ∑ b, prob C (P.effect a) (Q.effect b) = hsSq C

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.binResource_pos
statement:
lemma binResource_pos [Nonempty n] (L : Finset ℤ) [Nonempty L] (ε s : ℝ) :
    0 < hsSq (binResource (n := n) L ε s)

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.binResource_transpose
statement:
lemma binResource_transpose (L : Finset ℤ) (ε s : ℝ) :
    (binResource (n := n) L ε s)ᵀ = binResource (n := n) L ε s

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.bin_left_mass
statement:
lemma bin_left_mass (L : Finset ℤ) (M : Matrix n n ℂ) (ε s : ℝ)
    (hL : CoversBins L (rightAbs M) ε s) :
    hsSq (binFilter L M ε s*binResource (n := n) L ε s) = hsSq (roundedAbs (rightAbs M) ε s)

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.bin_output
statement:
lemma bin_output (L : Finset ℤ) (M N : Matrix n n ℂ) (ε s : ℝ) :
    binFilter L M ε s * binResource (n := n) L ε s * (bobBinFilter L N ε s)ᵀ =
      polar M*crossBins L (rightAbs M) (rightAbs N) ε s

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.bin_right_mass
statement:
lemma bin_right_mass (L : Finset ℤ) (N : Matrix n n ℂ) (ε s : ℝ)
    (hL : CoversBins L (rightAbs N) ε s) :
    hsSq (binResource (n := n) L ε s*(bobBinFilter L N ε s)ᵀ) = hsSq (roundedAbs (rightAbs N) ε s)

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.bobBinFilter_contraction
statement:
lemma bobBinFilter_contraction (L : Finset ℤ) (N : Matrix n n ℂ) (ε s : ℝ) :
    (bobBinFilter L N ε s)ᴴ*bobBinFilter L N ε s ≤ 1

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.correlated_sampling_value
statement:
theorem correlated_sampling_value {n : Type} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] [Nonempty n]
    {x y a b : ℕ} (G : Game x y a b)
    (M : Fin (x+1) → Matrix n n ℂ) (N : Fin (y+1) → Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hM : ∀ x, hsSq (M x) = 1) (hN : ∀ y, hsSq (N y) = 1)
    (P : Fin (x+1) → POVM n (Fin (a+1))) (Q : Fin (y+1) → POVM n (Fin (b+1)))
    {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε ≤ 1) :
    (∑ z : Fin (x+1) × Fin (y+1), G.questionProb z *
      payoff (M z.1) (P z.1) (Q z.2) (G.accepts z.1 z.2)) ≤ entangledValue G +
      4*Real.sqrt (2*ε^2+(12/ε)*Real.sqrt (2*∑ z : Fin (x+1) × Fin (y+1),
        G.questionProb z * hsSq (M z.1-N z.2)))

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.filter_approximation_value
statement:
theorem filter_approximation_value {m n p q : Type} [Fintype m] [Fintype n]
    [Fintype p] [Fintype q] [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n] [DecidableEq p] [DecidableEq q]
    [Nonempty n] [Nonempty q] {x y a b : ℕ} (G : Game x y a b)
    (D : Matrix n q ℂ) (hD : 0 < hsSq D)
    (M : Fin (x+1) → Matrix m p ℂ) (hM : ∀ x, hsSq (M x) = 1)
    (P : Fin (x+1) → POVM m (Fin (a+1))) (Q : Fin (y+1) → POVM p (Fin (b+1)))
    (K : Fin (x+1) → Matrix m n ℂ) (L : Fin (y+1) → Matrix p q ℂ)
    (hK : ∀ x, (K x)ᴴ*K x ≤ 1) (hL : ∀ y, (L y)ᴴ*L y ≤ 1)
    (hA : ∀ x, hsSq (K x*D) ≤ 1) (hB : ∀ y, hsSq (D*(L y)ᵀ) ≤ 1) :
    (∑ z : Fin (x+1) × Fin (y+1), G.questionProb z *
        payoff (M z.1) (P z.1) (Q z.2) (G.accepts z.1 z.2)) ≤ entangledValue G +
      4*Real.sqrt (∑ z : Fin (x+1) × Fin (y+1), G.questionProb z *
        hsSq (M z.1 - K z.1*D*(L z.2)ᵀ))

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.flat_form
statement:
lemma flat_form (C : Matrix m n ℂ) (W : Matrix (m × n) (m × n) ℂ) :
    Matrix.trace ((flat C)ᴴ*(W*flat C)) = star (vec C) ⬝ᵥ (W *ᵥ vec C)

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.flat_sub
statement: lemma flat_sub (C D : Matrix m n ℂ) : flat (C-D) = flat C-flat D

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.hsSq_difference_le
statement:
lemma hsSq_difference_le (M N : Matrix m n ℂ) (hM : hsSq M ≤ 1) (hN : hsSq N ≤ 1) :
    hsSq M - hsSq N ≤ 2 * Real.sqrt (hsSq (M-N))

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.hsSq_flat
statement: lemma hsSq_flat (C : Matrix m n ℂ) : hsSq (flat C) = hsSq C

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.hsSq_le_one_norm
statement: lemma hsSq_le_one_norm {M : Matrix m n ℂ} (hM : hsSq M ≤ 1) : ‖M‖ ≤ 1

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.hsSq_polar_bin
statement:
lemma hsSq_polar_bin (M : Matrix n n ℂ) (ε s : ℝ) (l : ℤ) :
    hsSq (polar M*binProjection (rightAbs M) ε s l) =
      hsSq (binProjection (rightAbs M) ε s l)

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.hsSq_roundedAbs_eq_sum
statement:
lemma hsSq_roundedAbs_eq_sum (L : Finset ℤ) {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (ε s : ℝ) (hL : CoversBins L A ε s) :
    hsSq (roundedAbs A ε s) = ∑ l : L, (binScale ε s l)^2*hsSq (binProjection A ε s l)

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.hsSq_rowBlocks
statement:
lemma hsSq_rowBlocks (F : ι → Matrix m n ℂ) :
    hsSq (rowBlocks F) = ∑ l, hsSq (F l)

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.hsSq_transpose
statement: lemma hsSq_transpose (C : Matrix m n ℂ) : hsSq Cᵀ = hsSq C

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.norm_eq_sqrt_hsSq
statement: lemma norm_eq_sqrt_hsSq (M : Matrix m n ℂ) : ‖M‖ = Real.sqrt (hsSq M)

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.payoff_difference_le
statement:
lemma payoff_difference_le (C D : Matrix m n ℂ) (P : POVM m A) (Q : POVM n B)
    (V : A → B → Bool) (hC : hsSq C ≤ 1) (hD : hsSq D ≤ 1) :
    payoff C P Q V - payoff D P Q V ≤ 2*Real.sqrt (hsSq (C-D))

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.payoff_eq_form
statement:
lemma payoff_eq_form (C : Matrix m n ℂ) (P : POVM m A) (Q : POVM n B)
    (V : A → B → Bool) :
    payoff C P Q V = (star (vec C) ⬝ᵥ (winEffect P Q V *ᵥ vec C)).re

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.payoff_eq_hsSq
statement:
lemma payoff_eq_hsSq (C : Matrix m n ℂ) (P : POVM m A) (Q : POVM n B)
    (V : A → B → Bool) :
    payoff C P Q V = hsSq (CFC.sqrt (winEffect P Q V) * flat C)

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.payoff_ratio_loss
statement:
lemma payoff_ratio_loss {w q a b c e : ℝ} (_he : 0 ≤ e) (hq : 0 ≤ q) (hqc : q ≤ c)
    (hca : c ≤ a) (hcb : c ≤ b) (ha : a ≤ 1) (hb : b ≤ 1)
    (hwq : w-q ≤ 2*Real.sqrt e) (hc : 1-c ≤ 2*Real.sqrt e) :
    w ≤ q/(a+b-c) + 4*Real.sqrt e

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.projectionRows_contraction
statement:
lemma projectionRows_contraction [DecidableEq n] [DecidableEq ι] (P : ι → Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hP : ∀ l, (P l).IsHermitian) (hPP : ∀ l, P l*P l = P l)
    (horth : ∀ l t, l ≠ t → P l*P t = 0) : (rowBlocks P)ᴴ*rowBlocks P ≤ 1

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.projectionRows_gram
statement:
lemma projectionRows_gram [DecidableEq ι] (P : ι → Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hP : ∀ l, (P l).IsHermitian) (hPP : ∀ l, P l*P l = P l)
    (horth : ∀ l t, l ≠ t → P l*P t = 0) :
    (rowBlocks P)ᴴ*rowBlocks P = Matrix.blockDiagonal P

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.rowBlocks_mul_diagonal
statement:
lemma rowBlocks_mul_diagonal [DecidableEq n] [DecidableEq ι]
    (F : ι → Matrix m n ℂ) (r : ι → ℝ) :
    rowBlocks F * Matrix.diagonal (fun j : n × ι => (r j.2 : ℂ)) =
      rowBlocks (fun l => r l • F l)

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.rowBlocks_mul_transpose
statement:
lemma rowBlocks_mul_transpose (F : ι → Matrix m n ℂ) (G : ι → Matrix p n ℂ) [Fintype n] :
    rowBlocks F * (rowBlocks G)ᵀ = ∑ l, F l*(G l)ᵀ

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.winEffect_le_one
statement:
lemma winEffect_le_one (P : POVM m A) (Q : POVM n B) (V : A → B → Bool) :
    winEffect P Q V ≤ 1

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.winEffect_pos
statement:
lemma winEffect_pos (P : POVM m A) (Q : POVM n B) (V : A → B → Bool) :
    (winEffect P Q V).PosSemidef

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.winSqrt_contraction
statement:
lemma winSqrt_contraction (P : POVM m A) (Q : POVM n B) (V : A → B → Bool) :
    (CFC.sqrt (winEffect P Q V))ᴴ*CFC.sqrt (winEffect P Q V) ≤ 1

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.FiniteProbability.Law.avg_add
statement:
lemma avg_add (p : Law α) (f g : α → E) :
    p.avg (fun x => f x+g x) = p.avg f+p.avg g

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.FiniteProbability.Law.avg_comm
statement:
lemma avg_comm (p : Law α) (q : Law β) (f : α → β → E) :
    p.avg (fun x => q.avg (f x)) = q.avg (fun y => p.avg (fun x => f x y))

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.FiniteProbability.Law.avg_const
statement: lemma avg_const (p : Law α) (e : E) : p.avg (fun _ => e) = e

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.FiniteProbability.Law.avg_eq_sum
statement: lemma avg_eq_sum (p : Law α) (f : α → ℝ) : p.avg f = ∑ x, p.weight x*f x

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.FiniteProbability.Law.avg_indicator
statement:
lemma avg_indicator (p : Law α) (x : α) :
    p.avg (fun y => if y=x then (1 : ℝ) else 0) = p.weight x

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.FiniteProbability.Law.avg_le_const
statement: lemma avg_le_const (p : Law α) {f : α → ℝ} {r : ℝ} (h : ∀ x, f x ≤ r) : p.avg f ≤ r

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.FiniteProbability.Law.avg_linear
statement:
lemma avg_linear (p : Law α) (f : α → E) {F : Type u_F} [AddCommMonoid F] [Module ℝ F]
    (L : E →ₗ[ℝ] F) : L (p.avg f) = p.avg (fun x => L (f x))

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.FiniteProbability.Law.avg_log_pi
statement:
lemma avg_log_pi (p : Law (ι → α)) (q : ι → Law α) (hs : Supports p (pi q)) :
    p.avg (fun z => Real.log ((pi q).weight z)) =
      ∑ i, (p.marginal i).avg (fun x => Real.log ((q i).weight x))

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.FiniteProbability.Law.avg_mono
statement: lemma avg_mono (p : Law α) {f g : α → ℝ} (h : ∀ x, f x ≤ g x) : p.avg f ≤ p.avg g

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.FiniteProbability.Law.avg_nonneg
statement: lemma avg_nonneg (p : Law α) {f : α → ℝ} (hf : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x) : 0 ≤ p.avg f

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.FiniteProbability.Law.avg_smul
statement:
lemma avg_smul (p : Law α) (r : ℝ) (f : α → E) :
    p.avg (fun x => r • f x) = r • p.avg f

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.FiniteProbability.Law.avg_sub
statement:
lemma avg_sub {F : Type u_F} [AddCommGroup F] [Module ℝ F]
    (p : Law α) (f g : α → F) :
    p.avg (fun x => f x-g x) = p.avg f-p.avg g

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.FiniteProbability.Law.avg_sum
statement:
lemma avg_sum {ι : Type u_ι} [Fintype ι] (p : Law α) (f : ι → α → E) :
    p.avg (fun x => ∑ i, f i x) = ∑ i, p.avg (f i)

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.FiniteProbability.Law.bind_avg
statement:
lemma bind_avg (p : Law α) (q : α → Law β) (f : β → E) :
    (p.bind q).avg f = p.avg (fun x => (q x).avg f)

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.FiniteProbability.Law.coordDensity_eq
statement:
lemma coordDensity_eq (q : ι → Law α) (f : (ι → α) → ℝ) (i : ι) (x : α) :
    coordDensity q f i x = (pi (fun j : {j // j ≠ i} => q j)).avg
      (fun r => f ((Equiv.funSplitAt i α).symm (x,r)))

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.FiniteProbability.Law.coordDensity_nonneg
statement:
lemma coordDensity_nonneg (q : ι → Law α) (f : (ι → α) → ℝ) (hf : ∀ z, 0 ≤ f z)
    (i : ι) (x : α) : 0 ≤ coordDensity q f i x

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.FiniteProbability.Law.coordDensity_total
statement:
lemma coordDensity_total (q : ι → Law α) (f : (ι → α) → ℝ)
    (ht : (pi q).avg f = 1) (i : ι) : (q i).avg (coordDensity q f i) = 1

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.FiniteProbability.Law.coord_entropy_sum_le
statement:
lemma coord_entropy_sum_le (q : ι → Law α) (f : (ι → α) → ℝ) (hf : ∀ z, 0 ≤ f z)
    (ht : (pi q).avg f = 1) :
    (∑ i, (q i).avg (fun x => coordDensity q f i x*Real.log (coordDensity q f i x))) ≤
      (pi q).avg (fun z => f z*Real.log (f z))

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.FiniteProbability.Law.disintegrate_first
statement:
lemma disintegrate_first (p : Law (α×β)) (b₀ : β) (f : α×β → E) :
    p.avg f = p.first.avg (fun x => (p.givenFirst b₀ x).avg (fun y => f (x,y)))

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.FiniteProbability.Law.disintegrate_second
statement:
lemma disintegrate_second (p : Law (α×β)) (a₀ : α) (f : α×β → E) :
    p.avg f = p.second.avg (fun y => (p.givenSecond a₀ y).avg (fun x => f (x,y)))

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.FiniteProbability.Law.first_given
statement:
lemma first_given (p : Law (α×β)) (b₀ : β) (x : α) (y : β) :
    p.first.weight x*(p.givenFirst b₀ x).weight y = p.weight (x,y)

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.FiniteProbability.Law.kl_log_sub
statement:
lemma kl_log_sub (p q : Law α) (hs : Supports p q) :
    p.kl q = p.avg (fun x => Real.log (p.weight x)) -
      p.avg (fun x => Real.log (q.weight x))

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.FiniteProbability.Law.kl_nonneg
statement: lemma kl_nonneg (p q : Law α) (hs : Supports p q) : 0 ≤ p.kl q

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.FiniteProbability.Law.kl_tensorization
statement:
lemma kl_tensorization (p : Law (ι → α)) (q : ι → Law α)
    (hs : Supports p (pi q)) :
    (∑ i, (p.marginal i).kl (q i)) ≤ p.kl (pi q)

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.FiniteProbability.Law.kl_tilt
statement:
lemma kl_tilt (p : Law α) (f : α → ℝ) (hf : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x) (ht : p.avg f = 1) :
    (p.tilt f hf ht).kl p = p.avg (fun x => f x*Real.log (f x))

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.FiniteProbability.Law.kl_tilt_le
statement:
lemma kl_tilt_le (p : Law α) (f : α → ℝ) (hf : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x) (ht : p.avg f = 1)
    {B : ℝ} (_hB : 0 < B) (hb : ∀ x, f x ≤ B) : (p.tilt f hf ht).kl p ≤ Real.log B

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.FiniteProbability.Law.map_avg
statement:
lemma map_avg [DecidableEq β] (p : Law α) (f : α → β) (g : β → E) :
    (p.map f).avg g = p.avg (fun x => g (f x))

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.FiniteProbability.Law.map_weight_pos
statement:
lemma map_weight_pos [DecidableEq β] (p : Law α) (f : α → β) (x : α)
    (hx : 0 < p.weight x) : 0 < (p.map f).weight (f x)

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.FiniteProbability.Law.marginal_avg
statement:
lemma marginal_avg (p : Law (ι → α)) (i : ι) (f : α → E) :
    (p.marginal i).avg f = p.avg (fun z => f (z i))

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.FiniteProbability.Law.marginal_density_avg
statement:
lemma marginal_density_avg (q : ι → Law α) (f : (ι → α) → ℝ) (hf : ∀ z, 0 ≤ f z)
    (ht : (pi q).avg f = 1) (i : ι) (g : α → ℝ) :
    (((pi q).tilt f hf ht).marginal i).avg g =
      (q i).avg (fun x => coordDensity q f i x*g x)

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.FiniteProbability.Law.marginal_density_weight
statement:
lemma marginal_density_weight (q : ι → Law α) (f : (ι → α) → ℝ) (hf : ∀ z, 0 ≤ f z)
    (ht : (pi q).avg f = 1) (i : ι) (x : α) :
    (((pi q).tilt f hf ht).marginal i).weight x = (q i).weight x*coordDensity q f i x

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.FiniteProbability.Law.marginal_tilt_eq
statement:
lemma marginal_tilt_eq (q : ι → Law α) (f : (ι → α) → ℝ) (hf : ∀ z, 0 ≤ f z)
    (ht : (pi q).avg f = 1) (i : ι) :
    ((pi q).tilt f hf ht).marginal i = (q i).tilt (coordDensity q f i)
      (coordDensity_nonneg q f hf i) (coordDensity_total q f ht i)

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.FiniteProbability.Law.mul_log_ratio_lower
statement:
lemma mul_log_ratio_lower {p q : ℝ} (hp : 0 ≤ p) (hq : 0 ≤ q)
    (hs : p ≠ 0 → q ≠ 0) : p-q ≤ p*Real.log (p/q)

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.FiniteProbability.Law.normalize_weight
statement:
lemma normalize_weight [DecidableEq α] (w : α → ℝ) (hw : ∀ x, 0 ≤ w x) (a₀ x : α) :
    (∑ y, w y)*(normalize w hw a₀).weight x = w x

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.FiniteProbability.Law.pi_avg_prod
statement:
lemma pi_avg_prod {ι : Type u_ι} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (p : ι → Law α)
    (f : ι → α → ℝ) :
    (pi p).avg (fun z => ∏ i, f i (z i)) = ∏ i, (p i).avg (f i)

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.FiniteProbability.Law.pi_avg_split
statement:
lemma pi_avg_split (p : ι → Law α) (i : ι) (f : (ι → α) → E) :
    (pi p).avg f = (p i).avg (fun u =>
      (pi (fun j : {j // j ≠ i} => p j)).avg
        (fun r => f ((Equiv.funSplitAt i α).symm (u,r))))

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.FiniteProbability.Law.pi_avg_update
statement:
lemma pi_avg_update (p : ι → Law α) (i : ι) (f : (ι → α) → E) :
    (pi p).avg (fun z => (p i).avg (fun u => f (Function.update z i u))) = (pi p).avg f

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.FiniteProbability.Law.pi_weight_split
statement:
lemma pi_weight_split (p : ι → Law α) (i : ι) (u : α) (r : {j // j ≠ i} → α) :
    (pi p).weight ((Equiv.funSplitAt i α).symm (u,r)) =
      (p i).weight u * (pi (fun j : {j // j ≠ i} => p j)).weight r

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.FiniteProbability.Law.point_avg
statement: lemma point_avg [DecidableEq α] (x : α) (f : α → E) : (point x).avg f = f x

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.FiniteProbability.Law.prod_avg
statement:
lemma prod_avg (p : Law α) (q : Law β) (f : α × β → E) :
    (p.prod q).avg f = p.avg (fun x => q.avg (fun y => f (x,y)))

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.FiniteProbability.Law.prod_split
statement:
lemma prod_split (f : ι → ℝ) (i : ι) :
    ∏ j, f j = f i * ∏ j : {j // j ≠ i}, f j

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.FiniteProbability.Law.second_given
statement:
lemma second_given (p : Law (α×β)) (a₀ : α) (x : α) (y : β) :
    p.second.weight y*(p.givenSecond a₀ y).weight x = p.weight (x,y)

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.FiniteProbability.Law.split_update
statement:
lemma split_update (i : ι) (z : ι → α) (u : α) :
    Function.update z i u = (Equiv.funSplitAt i α).symm (u, fun j => z j)

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.FiniteProbability.Law.supports_marginal
statement:
lemma supports_marginal (p : Law (ι → α)) (q : ι → Law α)
    (hs : Supports p (pi q)) (i : ι) : Supports (p.marginal i) (q i)

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.FiniteProbability.Law.supports_marginal_pi
statement: lemma supports_marginal_pi (p : Law (ι → α)) : Supports p (pi p.marginal)

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.FiniteProbability.Law.tilt_avg
statement:
lemma tilt_avg (p : Law α) (f : α → ℝ) (hf : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x) (ht : p.avg f = 1)
    (g : α → ℝ) : (p.tilt f hf ht).avg g = p.avg (fun x => f x*g x)

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.FiniteProbability.Law.tilt_supports
statement:
lemma tilt_supports (p : Law α) (f : α → ℝ) (hf : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x) (ht : p.avg f = 1) :
    Supports (p.tilt f hf ht) p

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.FiniteProbability.Law.update_split
statement:
lemma update_split (i : ι) (r : {j // j ≠ i} → α) (u v : α) :
    Function.update ((Equiv.funSplitAt i α).symm (u,r)) i v =
      (Equiv.funSplitAt i α).symm (v,r)

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.FiniteProbability.Law.weight_le_one
statement: lemma weight_le_one (p : Law α) (x : α) : p.weight x ≤ 1

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.OperatorEntropy.effectEntropy_nonpos
statement:
lemma effectEntropy_nonpos {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.PosSemidef) (hA1 : A ≤ 1) :
    effectEntropy A ≤ 0

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.OperatorEntropy.functional_entropy_lower
statement:
lemma functional_entropy_lower (Φ : Matrix n n ℂ →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ)
    (hΦ : ∀ A : Matrix n n ℂ, A.PosSemidef → 0 ≤ Φ A)
    (hmass : Φ 1 ≤ 1) {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.PosSemidef) :
    -Φ (effectEntropy A) ≤ Real.negMulLog (Φ A)

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.OperatorEntropy.prob_entropy_left_lower
statement:
lemma prob_entropy_left_lower (C : Matrix m n ℂ) (hC : hsSq C ≤ 1)
    {A : Matrix m m ℂ} {B : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.PosSemidef)
    (hB : B.PosSemidef) (hB1 : B ≤ 1) :
    -prob C (effectEntropy A) B ≤ Real.negMulLog (prob C A B)

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.OperatorEntropy.prob_entropy_right_lower
statement:
lemma prob_entropy_right_lower (C : Matrix m n ℂ) (hC : hsSq C ≤ 1)
    {A : Matrix m m ℂ} {B : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.PosSemidef)
    (hA1 : A ≤ 1) (hB : B.PosSemidef) :
    -prob C A (effectEntropy B) ≤ Real.negMulLog (prob C A B)

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.OperatorEntropy.prob_mono_left
statement:
lemma prob_mono_left (C : Matrix m n ℂ) {A A' : Matrix m m ℂ} {B : Matrix n n ℂ}
    (hB : B.PosSemidef) (hA : A ≤ A') : prob C A B ≤ prob C A' B

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.OperatorEntropy.prob_mono_right
statement:
lemma prob_mono_right (C : Matrix m n ℂ) {A : Matrix m m ℂ} {B B' : Matrix n n ℂ}
    (hA : A.PosSemidef) (hB : B ≤ B') : prob C A B ≤ prob C A B'

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.OperatorEntropy.prob_smul_left
statement:
lemma prob_smul_left (C : Matrix m n ℂ) (r : ℝ) (A : Matrix m m ℂ) (B : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    prob C (r • A) B = r*prob C A B

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.OperatorEntropy.prob_smul_right
statement:
lemma prob_smul_right (C : Matrix m n ℂ) (r : ℝ) (A : Matrix m m ℂ) (B : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    prob C A (r • B) = r*prob C A B

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.OperatorEntropy.spectralLinear_one
statement:
lemma spectralLinear_one (U : Matrix n n ℂ) (hU : U*Uᴴ=1) :
    spectralLinear U (fun _ => 1) = 1

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.OperatorEntropy.spectralLinear_single_pos
statement:
lemma spectralLinear_single_pos (U : Matrix n n ℂ) (i : n) :
    (spectralLinear U (Pi.single i 1)).PosSemidef

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.OperatorEntropy.spectralLinear_sum
statement:
lemma spectralLinear_sum (U : Matrix n n ℂ) (v : n → ℝ) :
    spectralLinear U v = ∑ i, v i • spectralLinear U (Pi.single i 1)

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.ScalarEntropy.avg_entropy_jensen
statement:
lemma avg_entropy_jensen (p : Law α) (f : α → ℝ) (hf : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x) :
    p.avg f * Real.log (p.avg f) ≤ p.avg (fun x => f x*Real.log (f x))

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.ScalarEntropy.avg_entropy_nonneg
statement:
lemma avg_entropy_nonneg (p : Law α) (f : α → ℝ) (hf : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x)
    (ht : p.avg f = 1) : 0 ≤ p.avg (fun x => f x*Real.log (f x))

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.ScalarEntropy.avg_hellinger_le_entropy
statement:
lemma avg_hellinger_le_entropy (p : Law α) (f : α → ℝ) (hf : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x)
    (ht : p.avg f = 1) :
    p.avg (fun x => (Real.sqrt (f x)-1)^2) ≤ p.avg (fun x => f x*Real.log (f x))

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.ScalarEntropy.first_density_entropy_le
statement:
lemma first_density_entropy_le [DecidableEq β] (p : Law (α×β)) (b₀ : β)
    (f : α×β → ℝ) (hf : ∀ z, 0 ≤ f z) :
    p.first.avg (fun x => (p.givenFirst b₀ x).avg (fun y => f (x,y)) *
      Real.log ((p.givenFirst b₀ x).avg (fun y => f (x,y)))) ≤
      p.avg (fun z => f z*Real.log (f z))

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.ScalarEntropy.hellinger_le_entropy
statement:
lemma hellinger_le_entropy {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    (Real.sqrt t-1)^2 ≤ t*Real.log t-t+1

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.ScalarEntropy.negMulLog_subprob
statement:
lemma negMulLog_subprob {ι : Type u_ι} [Fintype ι]
    (w t : ι → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) (hs : ∑ i, w i ≤ 1)
    (ht : ∀ i, 0 ≤ t i) :
    (∑ i, w i * Real.negMulLog (t i)) ≤ Real.negMulLog (∑ i, w i*t i)

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.ScalarEntropy.second_density_entropy_le
statement:
lemma second_density_entropy_le [DecidableEq α] (p : Law (α×β)) (a₀ : α)
    (f : α×β → ℝ) (hf : ∀ z, 0 ≤ f z) :
    p.second.avg (fun y => (p.givenSecond a₀ y).avg (fun x => f (x,y)) *
      Real.log ((p.givenSecond a₀ y).avg (fun x => f (x,y)))) ≤
      p.avg (fun z => f z*Real.log (f z))

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.ScalarEntropy.weighted_negMulLog_le
statement:
lemma weighted_negMulLog_le {ι : Type u_ι} [Fintype ι]
    (w t : ι → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) (ht : ∀ i, 0 ≤ t i)
    {d p : ℝ} (hd : 0 < d) (hs : ∑ i, w i ≤ d) (hp : 0 < p)
    (hm : ∑ i, w i*t i = p) :
    (∑ i, w i*Real.negMulLog (t i)) ≤ p*Real.log (d/p)

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.FiniteProbability.Law.left_ignoresLeft
statement:
lemma left_ignoresLeft (μ : Law (X×Y)) (x₀ : X) (i : I) (f : Profile I X Y → E) :
    IgnoresLeft (μ.left x₀ i f) i

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.FiniteProbability.Law.left_ignoresLeft_other
statement:
lemma left_ignoresLeft_other (μ : Law (X×Y)) (x₀ : X) {i j : I} (hij : i ≠ j)
    {f : Profile I X Y → E} (hf : IgnoresLeft f j) : IgnoresLeft (μ.left x₀ i f) j

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.FiniteProbability.Law.left_ignoresRight_other
statement:
lemma left_ignoresRight_other (μ : Law (X×Y)) (x₀ : X) {i j : I} (hij : i ≠ j)
    {f : Profile I X Y → E} (hf : IgnoresRight f j) : IgnoresRight (μ.left x₀ i f) j

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.FiniteProbability.Law.left_linear
statement:
lemma left_linear (μ : Law (X×Y)) (x₀ : X) (i : I)
    (f : Profile I X Y → E) (L : E →ₗ[ℝ] F) (z : Profile I X Y) :
    L (μ.left x₀ i f z) = μ.left x₀ i (fun q => L (f q)) z

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.FiniteProbability.Law.left_of_ignores
statement:
lemma left_of_ignores (μ : Law (X×Y)) (x₀ : X) (i : I)
    {f : Profile I X Y → E} (hf : IgnoresLeft f i) : μ.left x₀ i f = f

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.FiniteProbability.Law.left_update
statement:
lemma left_update (μ : Law (X×Y)) (x₀ : X) {i j : I} (hij : i ≠ j)
    (f : Profile I X Y → E) (z : Profile I X Y) (q : X×Y) :
    μ.left x₀ j f (Function.update z i q) =
      μ.left x₀ j (fun r => f (Function.update r i q)) z

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.FiniteProbability.Law.lefts_ignoresLeft_mem
statement:
lemma lefts_ignoresLeft_mem (μ : Law (X×Y)) (x₀ : X) (l : List I)
    (f : Profile I X Y → E) {i : I} (hi : i ∈ l) : IgnoresLeft (μ.lefts x₀ l f) i

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.FiniteProbability.Law.lefts_ignoresRight_notMem
statement:
lemma lefts_ignoresRight_notMem (μ : Law (X×Y)) (x₀ : X) (l : List I)
    {f : Profile I X Y → E} {i : I} (hi : i ∉ l) (hf : IgnoresRight f i) :
    IgnoresRight (μ.lefts x₀ l f) i

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.FiniteProbability.Law.lefts_linear
statement:
lemma lefts_linear (μ : Law (X×Y)) (x₀ : X) (l : List I) (f : Profile I X Y → E)
    (L : E →ₗ[ℝ] F) (z : Profile I X Y) :
    L (μ.lefts x₀ l f z) = μ.lefts x₀ l (fun q => L (f q)) z

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.FiniteProbability.Law.lefts_sum
statement:
lemma lefts_sum (μ : Law (X×Y)) (x₀ : X) (l : List I) (f : R → Profile I X Y → E)
    (z : Profile I X Y) :
    μ.lefts x₀ l (fun q => ∑ r, f r q) z = ∑ r, μ.lefts x₀ l (f r) z

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.FiniteProbability.Law.pair_avg_left
statement:
lemma pair_avg_left (μ : Law (X×Y)) (x₀ : X) (f : X×Y → E) :
    μ.avg (fun z => (μ.givenSecond x₀ z.2).avg (fun x => f (x,z.2))) = μ.avg f

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.FiniteProbability.Law.pair_avg_right
statement:
lemma pair_avg_right (μ : Law (X×Y)) (y₀ : Y) (f : X×Y → E) :
    μ.avg (fun z => (μ.givenFirst y₀ z.1).avg (fun y => f (z.1,y))) = μ.avg f

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.FiniteProbability.Law.pi_avg_left
statement:
lemma pi_avg_left (μ : Law (X×Y)) (x₀ : X) (i : I) (f : Profile I X Y → E) :
    (pi (fun _ : I => μ)).avg (μ.left x₀ i f) = (pi (fun _ : I => μ)).avg f

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.FiniteProbability.Law.pi_avg_right
statement:
lemma pi_avg_right (μ : Law (X×Y)) (y₀ : Y) (i : I) (f : Profile I X Y → E) :
    (pi (fun _ : I => μ)).avg (μ.right y₀ i f) = (pi (fun _ : I => μ)).avg f

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.FiniteProbability.Law.pi_fixed_left_pairing
statement:
lemma pi_fixed_left_pairing (μ : Law (X×Y)) (x₀ : X) {i j : I} (hij : i ≠ j)
    (q : X×Y) (f : Profile I X Y → E)
    (L : Profile I X Y → E →ₗ[ℝ] F) (hL : IgnoresLeft L j) :
    (pi (fun _ : I => μ)).avg (fun z => L (Function.update z i q)
      (μ.left x₀ j f (Function.update z i q))) =
    (pi (fun _ : I => μ)).avg (fun z => L (Function.update z i q) (f (Function.update z i q)))

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.FiniteProbability.Law.pi_fixed_lefts_pairing
statement:
lemma pi_fixed_lefts_pairing (μ : Law (X×Y)) (x₀ : X) (l : List I) {i : I} (hi : i ∉ l)
    (q : X×Y) (f : Profile I X Y → E)
    (L : Profile I X Y → E →ₗ[ℝ] F) (hL : ∀ j ∈ l, IgnoresLeft L j) :
    (pi (fun _ : I => μ)).avg (fun z => L (Function.update z i q)
      (μ.lefts x₀ l f (Function.update z i q))) =
    (pi (fun _ : I => μ)).avg (fun z => L (Function.update z i q) (f (Function.update z i q)))

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.FiniteProbability.Law.pi_fixed_right_pairing
statement:
lemma pi_fixed_right_pairing (μ : Law (X×Y)) (y₀ : Y) {i j : I} (hij : i ≠ j)
    (q : X×Y) (f : Profile I X Y → E)
    (L : Profile I X Y → E →ₗ[ℝ] F) (hL : IgnoresRight L j) :
    (pi (fun _ : I => μ)).avg (fun z => L (Function.update z i q)
      (μ.right y₀ j f (Function.update z i q))) =
    (pi (fun _ : I => μ)).avg (fun z => L (Function.update z i q) (f (Function.update z i q)))

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.FiniteProbability.Law.pi_fixed_rights_pairing
statement:
lemma pi_fixed_rights_pairing (μ : Law (X×Y)) (y₀ : Y) (l : List I) {i : I} (hi : i ∉ l)
    (q : X×Y) (f : Profile I X Y → E)
    (L : Profile I X Y → E →ₗ[ℝ] F) (hL : ∀ j ∈ l, IgnoresRight L j) :
    (pi (fun _ : I => μ)).avg (fun z => L (Function.update z i q)
      (μ.rights y₀ l f (Function.update z i q))) =
    (pi (fun _ : I => μ)).avg (fun z => L (Function.update z i q) (f (Function.update z i q)))

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.FiniteProbability.Law.pi_left_pairing
statement:
lemma pi_left_pairing (μ : Law (X×Y)) (x₀ : X) (i : I) (f : Profile I X Y → E)
    (L : Profile I X Y → E →ₗ[ℝ] F) (hL : IgnoresLeft L i) :
    (pi (fun _ : I => μ)).avg (fun z => L z (μ.left x₀ i f z)) =
      (pi (fun _ : I => μ)).avg (fun z => L z (f z))

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.FiniteProbability.Law.pi_lefts_pairing
statement:
lemma pi_lefts_pairing (μ : Law (X×Y)) (x₀ : X) (l : List I) (f : Profile I X Y → E)
    (L : Profile I X Y → E →ₗ[ℝ] F) (hL : ∀ i ∈ l, IgnoresLeft L i) :
    (pi (fun _ : I => μ)).avg (fun z => L z (μ.lefts x₀ l f z)) =
      (pi (fun _ : I => μ)).avg (fun z => L z (f z))

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.FiniteProbability.Law.pi_right_pairing
statement:
lemma pi_right_pairing (μ : Law (X×Y)) (y₀ : Y) (i : I) (f : Profile I X Y → E)

    (pi (fun _ : I => μ)).avg (fun z => L z (μ.right y₀ i f z)) =
