name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.FiniteProbability.Law.pi_rights_pairing
statement:
lemma pi_rights_pairing (μ : Law (X×Y)) (y₀ : Y) (l : List I) (f : Profile I X Y → E)
    (L : Profile I X Y → E →ₗ[ℝ] F) (hL : ∀ i ∈ l, IgnoresRight L i) :
    (pi (fun _ : I => μ)).avg (fun z => L z (μ.rights y₀ l f z)) =
      (pi (fun _ : I => μ)).avg (fun z => L z (f z))

statement:
lemma right_ignoresLeft_other (μ : Law (X×Y)) (y₀ : Y) {i j : I} (hij : i ≠ j)
    {f : Profile I X Y → E} (hf : IgnoresLeft f j) : IgnoresLeft (μ.right y₀ i f) j

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.FiniteProbability.Law.right_ignoresRight
statement:
lemma right_ignoresRight (μ : Law (X×Y)) (y₀ : Y) (i : I) (f : Profile I X Y → E) :

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.FiniteProbability.Law.right_ignoresRight_other
statement:
lemma right_ignoresRight_other (μ : Law (X×Y)) (y₀ : Y) {i j : I} (hij : i ≠ j)

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.FiniteProbability.Law.right_linear
statement:
lemma right_linear (μ : Law (X×Y)) (y₀ : Y) (i : I)
    (f : Profile I X Y → E) (L : E →ₗ[ℝ] F) (z : Profile I X Y) :
    L (μ.right y₀ i f z) = μ.right y₀ i (fun q => L (f q)) z

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.FiniteProbability.Law.right_of_ignores
statement:
lemma right_of_ignores (μ : Law (X×Y)) (y₀ : Y) (i : I)
    {f : Profile I X Y → E} (hf : IgnoresRight f i) : μ.right y₀ i f = f

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.FiniteProbability.Law.right_update
statement:
lemma right_update (μ : Law (X×Y)) (y₀ : Y) {i j : I} (hij : i ≠ j)
    (f : Profile I X Y → E) (z : Profile I X Y) (q : X×Y) :
    μ.right y₀ j f (Function.update z i q) =
      μ.right y₀ j (fun r => f (Function.update r i q)) z

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.FiniteProbability.Law.rights_ignoresLeft_notMem
statement:
lemma rights_ignoresLeft_notMem (μ : Law (X×Y)) (y₀ : Y) (l : List I)

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.FiniteProbability.Law.rights_ignoresRight_mem
statement:
lemma rights_ignoresRight_mem (μ : Law (X×Y)) (y₀ : Y) (l : List I)
    (f : Profile I X Y → E) {i : I} (hi : i ∈ l) : IgnoresRight (μ.rights y₀ l f) i

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.FiniteProbability.Law.rights_linear
statement:
lemma rights_linear (μ : Law (X×Y)) (y₀ : Y) (l : List I) (f : Profile I X Y → E)
    (L : E →ₗ[ℝ] F) (z : Profile I X Y) :
    L (μ.rights y₀ l f z) = μ.rights y₀ l (fun q => L (f q)) z

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.FiniteProbability.Law.rights_sum
statement:
lemma rights_sum (μ : Law (X×Y)) (y₀ : Y) (l : List I) (f : R → Profile I X Y → E)

    μ.rights y₀ l (fun q => ∑ r, f r q) z = ∑ r, μ.rights y₀ l (f r) z

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.FiniteProbability.Law.updateLeft_comm
statement:
lemma updateLeft_comm (z : Profile I X Y) {i j : I} (hij : i ≠ j) (x x' : X) :
    updateLeft (updateLeft z i x) j x' = updateLeft (updateLeft z j x') i x

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.FiniteProbability.Law.updateLeft_right_comm
statement:
lemma updateLeft_right_comm (z : Profile I X Y) (i j : I) (x : X) (y : Y) :
    updateLeft (updateRight z j y) i x = updateRight (updateLeft z i x) j y

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.FiniteProbability.Law.updateLeft_same
statement:
lemma updateLeft_same (z : Profile I X Y) (i : I) (x x' : X) :
    updateLeft (updateLeft z i x) i x' = updateLeft z i x'

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.FiniteProbability.Law.updateLeft_self
statement: lemma updateLeft_self (z : Profile I X Y) (i : I) : updateLeft z i (z i).1 = z

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.FiniteProbability.Law.updateLeft_update
statement:
lemma updateLeft_update (z : Profile I X Y) {i j : I} (hij : i ≠ j)
    (q : X×Y) (x : X) :
    updateLeft (Function.update z i q) j x = Function.update (updateLeft z j x) i q

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.FiniteProbability.Law.updateRight_comm
statement:
lemma updateRight_comm (z : Profile I X Y) {i j : I} (hij : i ≠ j) (y y' : Y) :
    updateRight (updateRight z i y) j y' = updateRight (updateRight z j y') i y

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.FiniteProbability.Law.updateRight_same
statement:
lemma updateRight_same (z : Profile I X Y) (i : I) (y y' : Y) :
    updateRight (updateRight z i y) i y' = updateRight z i y'

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.FiniteProbability.Law.updateRight_self
statement: lemma updateRight_self (z : Profile I X Y) (i : I) : updateRight z i (z i).2 = z

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.FiniteProbability.Law.updateRight_update
statement:
lemma updateRight_update (z : Profile I X Y) {i j : I} (hij : i ≠ j)
    (q : X×Y) (y : Y) :
    updateRight (Function.update z i q) j y = Function.update (updateRight z j y) i q

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.FiniteProbability.Law.avg_matrix_le
statement:
lemma avg_matrix_le (p : Law R) {A : R → Matrix n n ℂ} {B : Matrix n n ℂ}
    (h : ∀ r, A r ≤ B) : p.avg A ≤ B

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.FiniteProbability.Law.avg_matrix_mono
statement:
lemma avg_matrix_mono (p : Law R) {A B : R → Matrix n n ℂ} (h : ∀ r, A r ≤ B r) :
    p.avg A ≤ p.avg B

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.FiniteProbability.Law.avg_posSemidef
statement:
lemma avg_posSemidef (p : Law R) (A : R → Matrix n n ℂ) (hA : ∀ r, (A r).PosSemidef) :
    (p.avg A).PosSemidef

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.FiniteProbability.Law.lefts_le
statement:
lemma lefts_le (μ : Law (X×Y)) (x₀ : X) (l : List I)
    (f : Profile I X Y → Matrix n n ℂ) {B : Matrix n n ℂ} (hf : ∀ z, f z ≤ B) :
    ∀ z, μ.lefts x₀ l f z ≤ B

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.FiniteProbability.Law.lefts_posSemidef
statement:
lemma lefts_posSemidef (μ : Law (X×Y)) (x₀ : X) (l : List I)
    (f : Profile I X Y → Matrix n n ℂ) (hf : ∀ z, (f z).PosSemidef) :
    ∀ z, (μ.lefts x₀ l f z).PosSemidef

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.FiniteProbability.Law.rights_le
statement:
lemma rights_le (μ : Law (X×Y)) (y₀ : Y) (l : List I)
    (f : Profile I X Y → Matrix n n ℂ) {B : Matrix n n ℂ} (hf : ∀ z, f z ≤ B) :
    ∀ z, μ.rights y₀ l f z ≤ B

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.FiniteProbability.Law.rights_posSemidef
statement:
lemma rights_posSemidef (μ : Law (X×Y)) (y₀ : Y) (l : List I)
    (f : Profile I X Y → Matrix n n ℂ) (hf : ∀ z, (f z).PosSemidef) :
    ∀ z, (μ.rights y₀ l f z).PosSemidef

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.OperatorEntropy.potential_left_lower
statement:
lemma potential_left_lower (C : Matrix m n ℂ) (hC : hsSq C ≤ 1)
    (w : R → ℝ) (hw : ∀ r, 0 ≤ w r) (F : R → Matrix m m ℂ) (H : R → Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hF : ∀ r, (F r).PosSemidef) (hH : ∀ r, (H r).PosSemidef) (hH1 : ∀ r, H r ≤ 1)
    {d p : ℝ} (hd : 0 < d) (hs : ∑ r, w r ≤ d) (hp : 0 < p)
    (hm : ∑ r, w r*prob C (F r) (H r) = p) :
    -p*Real.log (d/p) ≤ ∑ r, w r * prob C (effectEntropy (F r)) (H r)

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.OperatorEntropy.potential_left_nonpos
statement:
lemma potential_left_nonpos (C : Matrix m n ℂ)
    (w : R → ℝ) (hw : ∀ r, 0 ≤ w r) (F : R → Matrix m m ℂ) (H : R → Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hF : ∀ r, (F r).PosSemidef) (hF1 : ∀ r, F r ≤ 1) (hH : ∀ r, (H r).PosSemidef) :
    (∑ r, w r * prob C (effectEntropy (F r)) (H r)) ≤ 0

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.OperatorEntropy.potential_right_lower
statement:
lemma potential_right_lower (C : Matrix m n ℂ) (hC : hsSq C ≤ 1)
    (w : R → ℝ) (hw : ∀ r, 0 ≤ w r) (F : R → Matrix m m ℂ) (H : R → Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hF : ∀ r, (F r).PosSemidef) (hF1 : ∀ r, F r ≤ 1) (hH : ∀ r, (H r).PosSemidef)
    {d p : ℝ} (hd : 0 < d) (hs : ∑ r, w r ≤ d) (hp : 0 < p)
    (hm : ∑ r, w r*prob C (F r) (H r) = p) :
    -p*Real.log (d/p) ≤ ∑ r, w r * prob C (F r) (effectEntropy (H r))

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.OperatorEntropy.potential_right_nonpos
statement:
lemma potential_right_nonpos (C : Matrix m n ℂ)
    (w : R → ℝ) (hw : ∀ r, 0 ≤ w r) (F : R → Matrix m m ℂ) (H : R → Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hF : ∀ r, (F r).PosSemidef) (hH : ∀ r, (H r).PosSemidef) (hH1 : ∀ r, H r ≤ 1) :

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.POVM.coarsen_sum
statement:
lemma coarsen_sum (P : POVM n A) (f : A → B) (g : B → Matrix n n ℂ →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) :
    (∑ b, g b ((P.coarsen f).effect b)) = ∑ a, g (f a) (P.effect a)

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.POVM.le_one
statement: lemma le_one (P : POVM n A) (a : A) : P.effect a ≤ 1

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.Resolvent.effectIndex_eq
statement:
lemma effectIndex_eq (A : J → Matrix n n ℂ) {T : Matrix n n ℂ} (hT : T ∈ Set.range A) :
    A (effectIndex A T) = T

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.MixedExposure.fixed_mixed_pairing
statement:
lemma fixed_mixed_pairing (μ : Law (X×Y)) (x₀ : X) (y₀ : Y) (l r : List I)
    (hlr : ∀ i ∈ l, i ∉ r) (C : Matrix m n ℂ)
    (F : Profile I X Y → Matrix m m ℂ) (H : Profile I X Y → Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hF : ∀ i ∈ r, IgnoresRight F i) (hH : ∀ i ∈ l, IgnoresLeft H i)
    (θ : Profile I X Y → ℝ) (hθL : ∀ i ∈ l, IgnoresLeft θ i) (hθR : ∀ i ∈ r, IgnoresRight θ i)
    (i : I) (hiL : i ∉ l) (hiR : i ∉ r) (q : X×Y) :
    (pi (fun _ : I => μ)).avg (fun z => θ (Function.update z i q) * prob C
      (μ.lefts x₀ l F (Function.update z i q)) (μ.rights y₀ r H (Function.update z i q))) =
    (pi (fun _ : I => μ)).avg (fun z => θ (Function.update z i q) *
      prob C (F (Function.update z i q)) (H (Function.update z i q)))

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.MixedExposure.mixed_pairing
statement:
lemma mixed_pairing (μ : Law (X×Y)) (x₀ : X) (y₀ : Y) (l r : List I)
    (hlr : ∀ i ∈ l, i ∉ r) (C : Matrix m n ℂ)
    (F : Profile I X Y → Matrix m m ℂ) (H : Profile I X Y → Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hF : ∀ i ∈ r, IgnoresRight F i) (hH : ∀ i ∈ l, IgnoresLeft H i)
    (θ : Profile I X Y → ℝ) (hθL : ∀ i ∈ l, IgnoresLeft θ i) (hθR : ∀ i ∈ r, IgnoresRight θ i) :
    (pi (fun _ : I => μ)).avg (fun z => θ z * prob C (μ.lefts x₀ l F z) (μ.rights y₀ r H z)) =
    (pi (fun _ : I => μ)).avg (fun z => θ z * prob C (F z) (H z))

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.MixedExposure.averaged_potential_left_bounds
statement:
lemma averaged_potential_left_bounds (ρ : Law Z) (C : Matrix m n ℂ) (hC : hsSq C ≤ 1)
    (θ : R → Z → ℝ) (hθ : ∀ r z, 0 ≤ θ r z) (hθ1 : ∀ r z, θ r z ≤ 1)
    (F : R → Z → Matrix m m ℂ) (H : R → Z → Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hF : ∀ r z, (F r z).PosSemidef) (hF1 : ∀ r z, F r z ≤ 1)
    (hH : ∀ r z, (H r z).PosSemidef) (hH1 : ∀ r z, H r z ≤ 1)
    {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hm : (∑ r, ρ.avg (fun z => θ r z*prob C (F r z) (H r z))) = p) :
    -p*Real.log ((Fintype.card R : ℝ)/p) ≤
      ∑ r, ρ.avg (fun z => θ r z*prob C (effectEntropy (F r z)) (H r z)) ∧
    (∑ r, ρ.avg (fun z => θ r z*prob C (effectEntropy (F r z)) (H r z))) ≤ 0

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.MixedExposure.averaged_potential_right_bounds
statement:
lemma averaged_potential_right_bounds (ρ : Law Z) (C : Matrix m n ℂ) (hC : hsSq C ≤ 1)
    (θ : R → Z → ℝ) (hθ : ∀ r z, 0 ≤ θ r z) (hθ1 : ∀ r z, θ r z ≤ 1)
    (F : R → Z → Matrix m m ℂ) (H : R → Z → Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hF : ∀ r z, (F r z).PosSemidef) (hF1 : ∀ r z, F r z ≤ 1)
    (hH : ∀ r z, (H r z).PosSemidef) (hH1 : ∀ r z, H r z ≤ 1)
    {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hm : (∑ r, ρ.avg (fun z => θ r z*prob C (F r z) (H r z))) = p) :
    -p*Real.log ((Fintype.card R : ℝ)/p) ≤
      ∑ r, ρ.avg (fun z => θ r z*prob C (F r z) (effectEntropy (H r z))) ∧
    (∑ r, ρ.avg (fun z => θ r z*prob C (F r z) (effectEntropy (H r z)))) ≤ 0

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.MixedExposure.chainLeft_next_local
statement:
lemma chainLeft_next_local (μ : Law (X×Y)) (x₀ : X) (l : List I) (hN : l.Nodup)
    (F : R → Profile I X Y → E) (hF : ∀ r i, IgnoresRight (F r) i)
    (j : ℕ) (hj : j < l.length) (r : R) :
    IgnoresRight (chainLeft μ x₀ l F (j+1) r) l[j]

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.MixedExposure.chainLeft_step
statement:
lemma chainLeft_step (μ : Law (X×Y)) (x₀ : X) (l : List I) (F : R → Profile I X Y → E)
    (j : ℕ) (hj : j < l.length) (r : R) :
    chainLeft μ x₀ l F j r = μ.left x₀ l[j] (chainLeft μ x₀ l F (j+1) r)

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.MixedExposure.chainRight_prev_local
statement:
lemma chainRight_prev_local (μ : Law (X×Y)) (y₀ : Y) (l : List I) (hN : l.Nodup)
    (H : R → Profile I X Y → E) (hH : ∀ r i, IgnoresLeft (H r) i)
    (j : ℕ) (hj : j < l.length) (r : R) :
    IgnoresLeft (chainRight μ y₀ l H j r) l[j]

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.MixedExposure.chainRight_step
statement:
lemma chainRight_step (μ : Law (X×Y)) (y₀ : Y) (l : List I) (H : R → Profile I X Y → E)
    (j : ℕ) (hj : j < l.length) (r : R) :
    chainRight μ y₀ l H (j+1) r = μ.right y₀ l[j] (chainRight μ y₀ l H j r)

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.MixedExposure.chain_mass
statement:
lemma chain_mass (μ : Law (X×Y)) (x₀ : X) (y₀ : Y) (l : List I) (hN : l.Nodup)
    (C : Matrix m n ℂ) (F : R → Profile I X Y → Matrix m m ℂ)
    (H : R → Profile I X Y → Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hF : ∀ r i, IgnoresRight (F r) i) (hH : ∀ r i, IgnoresLeft (H r) i)
    (θ : R → Profile I X Y → ℝ)
    (hθL : ∀ r i, i ∈ l → IgnoresLeft (θ r) i) (hθR : ∀ r i, i ∈ l → IgnoresRight (θ r) i)
    (j : ℕ) :
    (∑ r, (pi (fun _ : I => μ)).avg (fun z => θ r z *
      prob C (chainLeft μ x₀ l F j r z) (chainRight μ y₀ l H j r z))) =
    ∑ r, (pi (fun _ : I => μ)).avg (fun z => θ r z * prob C (F r z) (H r z))

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.MixedExposure.fin_telescope_bound
statement:
lemma fin_telescope_bound {N : ℕ} (U : ℕ → ℝ) (e : Fin N → ℝ) (L : ℝ)
    (hstep : ∀ i, e i ≤ U (i+1)-U i) (h0 : -L ≤ U 0) (hN : U N ≤ 0) :
    ∑ i, e i ≤ L

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.MixedExposure.fin_telescope_bound_rev
statement:
lemma fin_telescope_bound_rev {N : ℕ} (U : ℕ → ℝ) (e : Fin N → ℝ) (L : ℝ)
    (hstep : ∀ i, e i ≤ U i-U (i+1)) (h0 : U 0 ≤ 0) (hN : -L ≤ U N) :
    ∑ i, e i ≤ L

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.MixedExposure.left_update_eq
statement:
lemma left_update_eq (μ : Law (X×Y)) (x₀ : X) (i : I)
    (F : Profile I X Y → Matrix m m ℂ) (z : Profile I X Y) (q : X×Y) :
    μ.left x₀ i F (Function.update z i q) =
      (μ.givenSecond x₀ q.2).avg (fun x => F (Function.update z i (x,q.2)))

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.MixedExposure.list_fresh_not_prefix
statement:
lemma list_fresh_not_prefix {I : Type u_I} (l : List I) (hN : l.Nodup) (j : ℕ)
    (hj : j < l.length) : l[j] ∉ (l.take j).reverse

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.MixedExposure.list_fresh_not_suffix
statement:
lemma list_fresh_not_suffix {I : Type u_I} (l : List I) (hN : l.Nodup) (j : ℕ)
    (hj : j < l.length) : l[j] ∉ l.drop (j+1)

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.MixedExposure.list_suffix_prefix_disjoint
statement:
lemma list_suffix_prefix_disjoint {I : Type u_I} (l : List I) (hN : l.Nodup) (j : ℕ) :
    ∀ i ∈ l.drop j, i ∉ (l.take j).reverse

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.MixedExposure.massAt_left
statement:
lemma massAt_left (μ : Law (X×Y)) (x₀ : X) (θ : R → Profile I X Y → ℝ) (p : ℝ) (i : I)
    (C : Matrix m n ℂ) (F : R → Profile I X Y → Matrix m m ℂ)
    (H : R → Profile I X Y → Matrix n n ℂ) (hH : ∀ r, IgnoresLeft (H r) i) (q : X×Y) :
    massAt μ θ p i C (fun r => μ.left x₀ i (F r)) H q =
      (μ.givenSecond x₀ q.2).avg (fun x => massAt μ θ p i C F H (x,q.2))

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.MixedExposure.massAt_right
statement:
lemma massAt_right (μ : Law (X×Y)) (y₀ : Y) (θ : R → Profile I X Y → ℝ) (p : ℝ) (i : I)
    (C : Matrix m n ℂ) (F : R → Profile I X Y → Matrix m m ℂ)
    (H : R → Profile I X Y → Matrix n n ℂ) (hF : ∀ r, IgnoresRight (F r) i) (q : X×Y) :
    massAt μ θ p i C F (fun r => μ.right y₀ i (H r)) q =
      (μ.givenFirst y₀ q.1).avg (fun y => massAt μ θ p i C F H (q.1,y))

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.MixedExposure.right_update_eq
statement:
lemma right_update_eq (μ : Law (X×Y)) (y₀ : Y) (i : I)
    (H : Profile I X Y → Matrix n n ℂ) (z : Profile I X Y) (q : X×Y) :
    μ.right y₀ i H (Function.update z i q) =
      (μ.givenFirst y₀ q.1).avg (fun y => H (Function.update z i (q.1,y)))

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.MixedExposure.tested_weight_sum_le
statement:
lemma tested_weight_sum_le (ρ : Law Z) (θ : R → Z → ℝ) (hθ1 : ∀ r z, θ r z ≤ 1) :
    (∑ t : R×Z, ρ.weight t.2 * θ t.1 t.2) ≤ Fintype.card R

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.avg_payoff_difference_unbounded
statement:
lemma avg_payoff_difference_unbounded {Z : Type u_Z} {m : Type u_m} {n : Type u_n} {A : Type u_A} {B : Type u_B} [Fintype Z] [Fintype m] [Fintype n]
    [Fintype A] [Fintype B] [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n]
    (μ : Law Z) (C D : Z → Matrix m n ℂ) (hD : ∀ z, hsSq (D z) ≤ 1)
    (P : Z → POVM m A) (Q : Z → POVM n B) (V : Z → A → B → Bool) :
    μ.avg (fun z => payoff (C z) (P z) (Q z) (V z)) -
      μ.avg (fun z => payoff (D z) (P z) (Q z) (V z)) ≤
      2*Real.sqrt (μ.avg (fun z => hsSq (C z-D z))) + μ.avg (fun z => hsSq (C z-D z))

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.correlated_sampling_value_rect
statement:
lemma correlated_sampling_value_rect {m n : Type} [Fintype m] [DecidableEq m] [Nonempty m]
    [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] [Nonempty n]
    {x y a b : ℕ} (G : Game x y a b)
    (M : Fin (x+1) → Matrix m n ℂ) (N : Fin (y+1) → Matrix m n ℂ)
    (hM : ∀ x, hsSq (M x) = 1) (hN : ∀ y, hsSq (N y) = 1)
    (P : Fin (x+1) → POVM m (Fin (a+1))) (Q : Fin (y+1) → POVM n (Fin (b+1)))
    {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε ≤ 1) :
    (∑ z : Fin (x+1) × Fin (y+1), G.questionProb z *
      payoff (M z.1) (P z.1) (Q z.2) (G.accepts z.1 z.2)) ≤ entangledValue G +
      4*Real.sqrt (2*ε^2+(12/ε)*Real.sqrt (2*∑ z : Fin (x+1) × Fin (y+1),
        G.questionProb z * hsSq (M z.1-N z.2)))

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.hsSq_blockDiagonal
statement:
lemma hsSq_blockDiagonal (C : R → Matrix m n ℂ) :
    hsSq (Matrix.blockDiagonal C) = ∑ r, hsSq (C r)

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.hsSq_difference_unbounded
statement:
lemma hsSq_difference_unbounded (C D : Matrix m n ℂ) (hD : hsSq D ≤ 1) :
    hsSq C - hsSq D ≤ 2*Real.sqrt (hsSq (C-D)) + hsSq (C-D)

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.hsSq_eq_zero_iff
statement: lemma hsSq_eq_zero_iff (C : Matrix m n ℂ) : hsSq C = 0 ↔ C = 0

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.hsSq_squareState
statement: lemma hsSq_squareState (C : Matrix m n ℂ) : hsSq (squareState C) = hsSq C

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.hsSq_unitize
statement: lemma hsSq_unitize (C D : Matrix m n ℂ) (hD : hsSq D = 1) : hsSq (unitize C D) = 1

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.hsSq_weightedBlock
statement:
lemma hsSq_weightedBlock (w : R → ℝ) (hw : ∀ r, 0 ≤ w r) (C : R → Matrix m n ℂ) :
    hsSq (weightedBlock w C) = ∑ r, w r*hsSq (C r)

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.hsSq_weightedBlock_sub
statement:
lemma hsSq_weightedBlock_sub (w : R → ℝ) (hw : ∀ r, 0 ≤ w r) (C D : R → Matrix m n ℂ) :
    hsSq (weightedBlock w C-weightedBlock w D) = ∑ r, w r*hsSq (C r-D r)

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.payoff_blockDiagonal
statement:
lemma payoff_blockDiagonal (C : R → Matrix m n ℂ) (P : R → POVM m A) (Q : R → POVM n B)
    (V : A → B → Bool) :
    payoff (Matrix.blockDiagonal C) (POVM.blocks P) (POVM.blocks Q) V =
      ∑ r, payoff (C r) (P r) (Q r) V

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.payoff_difference_unbounded
statement:
lemma payoff_difference_unbounded (C D : Matrix m n ℂ) (P : POVM m A) (Q : POVM n B)
    (V : A → B → Bool) (hD : hsSq D ≤ 1) :
    payoff C P Q V - payoff D P Q V ≤ 2*Real.sqrt (hsSq (C-D)) + hsSq (C-D)

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.payoff_squareState
statement:
lemma payoff_squareState (C : Matrix m n ℂ) (P : POVM m A) (Q : POVM n B)
    (a₀ : A) (b₀ : B) (V : A → B → Bool) :
    payoff (squareState C) (P.sum (POVM.default a₀)) ((POVM.default b₀).sum Q) V = payoff C P Q V

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.payoff_weightedBlock
statement:
lemma payoff_weightedBlock (w : R → ℝ) (hw : ∀ r, 0 ≤ w r) (C : R → Matrix m n ℂ)
    (P : R → POVM m A) (Q : R → POVM n B) (V : A → B → Bool) :
    payoff (weightedBlock w C) (POVM.blocks P) (POVM.blocks Q) V =
      ∑ r, w r*payoff (C r) (P r) (Q r) V

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.posSemidef_blockDiagonal
statement:
lemma posSemidef_blockDiagonal (A : R → Matrix m m ℂ) (hA : ∀ r, (A r).PosSemidef) :
    (Matrix.blockDiagonal A).PosSemidef

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.posSemidef_fromBlocks_diag
OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.prob_blockDiagonal
statement:
lemma prob_blockDiagonal (C : R → Matrix m n ℂ) (A : R → Matrix m m ℂ)
    (B : R → Matrix n n ℂ) :
    prob (Matrix.blockDiagonal C) (Matrix.blockDiagonal A) (Matrix.blockDiagonal B) =
      ∑ r, prob (C r) (A r) (B r)

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.prob_squareState
statement:
lemma prob_squareState (C : Matrix m n ℂ) (A₁ : Matrix m m ℂ) (A₂ : Matrix n n ℂ)
    (B₁ : Matrix m m ℂ) (B₂ : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    prob (squareState C) (Matrix.fromBlocks A₁ 0 0 A₂) (Matrix.fromBlocks B₁ 0 0 B₂) =
      prob C A₁ B₂

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.squareState_sub
statement: lemma squareState_sub (C D : Matrix m n ℂ) : squareState (C-D) = squareState C-squareState D

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.trace_blockDiagonal
statement:
lemma trace_blockDiagonal (C : R → Matrix m m ℂ) :
    Matrix.trace (Matrix.blockDiagonal C) = ∑ r, Matrix.trace (C r)

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.unitize_distance
statement:
lemma unitize_distance (C D : Matrix m n ℂ) (hD : hsSq D = 1) :
    hsSq (C-unitize C D) = (Real.sqrt (hsSq C)-1)^2

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.weightedBlock_sub
statement:
lemma weightedBlock_sub (w : R → ℝ) (C D : R → Matrix m n ℂ) :
    weightedBlock w (fun r => C r-D r) = weightedBlock w C-weightedBlock w D

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.FiniteProbability.Law.ignoresLeft_update
statement:
lemma ignoresLeft_update {f : Profile I X Y → E} {i : I} (hf : IgnoresLeft f i)
    (z : Profile I X Y) (x x' : X) (y : Y) :
    f (Function.update z i (x,y)) = f (Function.update z i (x',y))

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.FiniteProbability.Law.ignoresRight_update
statement:
lemma ignoresRight_update {f : Profile I X Y → E} {i : I} (hf : IgnoresRight f i)
    (z : Profile I X Y) (x : X) (y y' : Y) :
    f (Function.update z i (x,y)) = f (Function.update z i (x,y'))

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.FiniteProbability.Law.ignores_update
statement:
lemma ignores_update {f : Profile I X Y → E} {i : I} (hL : IgnoresLeft f i) (hR : IgnoresRight f i)
    (z : Profile I X Y) (q : X×Y) : f (Function.update z i q) = f z

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.MixedExposure.chain_fixed_mass
statement:
lemma chain_fixed_mass (μ : Law (X×Y)) (x₀ : X) (y₀ : Y) (l : List I) (hN : l.Nodup)
    (C : Matrix m n ℂ) (F : R → Profile I X Y → Matrix m m ℂ)
    (H : R → Profile I X Y → Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hF : ∀ r i, IgnoresRight (F r) i) (hH : ∀ r i, IgnoresLeft (H r) i)
    (θ : R → Profile I X Y → ℝ)
    (hθL : ∀ r i, i ∈ l → IgnoresLeft (θ r) i) (hθR : ∀ r i, i ∈ l → IgnoresRight (θ r) i)
    (p : ℝ) (j : Fin l.length) (q : X×Y) :
    massAt μ θ p l[j.val] C (chainLeft μ x₀ l F (j+1)) (chainRight μ y₀ l H j) q =
      massAt μ θ p l[j.val] C F H q

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.MixedExposure.eventDensity_nonneg
statement:
lemma eventDensity_nonneg (θ : R → Profile I X Y → ℝ) (hθ : ∀ r z, 0 ≤ θ r z)
    {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (C : Matrix m n ℂ)
    (F : R → Profile I X Y → Matrix m m ℂ) (H : R → Profile I X Y → Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hF : ∀ r z, (F r z).PosSemidef) (hH : ∀ r z, (H r z).PosSemidef) (z : Profile I X Y) :
    0 ≤ eventDensity θ p C F H z

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.MixedExposure.eventDensity_total
statement:
lemma eventDensity_total (μ : Law (X×Y)) (θ : R → Profile I X Y → ℝ)
    {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (C : Matrix m n ℂ)
    (F : R → Profile I X Y → Matrix m m ℂ) (H : R → Profile I X Y → Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hm : (∑ r, (pi (fun _ : I => μ)).avg (fun z => θ r z*prob C (F r z) (H r z))) = p) :
    (pi (fun _ : I => μ)).avg (eventDensity θ p C F H) = 1

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.MixedExposure.fresh_avg_weighted
statement:
lemma fresh_avg_weighted (μ : Law (X×Y)) (i : I) (θ : R → Profile I X Y → ℝ)
    (hθL : ∀ r, IgnoresLeft (θ r) i) (hθR : ∀ r, IgnoresRight (θ r) i)
    (g : R → Profile I X Y → ℝ) :
    μ.avg (fun q => ∑ r, (pi (fun _ : I => μ)).avg (fun z => θ r z*g r (Function.update z i q))) =
      ∑ r, (pi (fun _ : I => μ)).avg (fun z => θ r z*g r z)

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.MixedExposure.massAt_eq_coordDensity
statement:
lemma massAt_eq_coordDensity (μ : Law (X×Y)) (θ : R → Profile I X Y → ℝ) (p : ℝ)
    (C : Matrix m n ℂ) (F : R → Profile I X Y → Matrix m m ℂ)
    (H : R → Profile I X Y → Matrix n n ℂ) (i : I)
    (hθL : ∀ r, IgnoresLeft (θ r) i) (hθR : ∀ r, IgnoresRight (θ r) i) (q : X×Y) :
    massAt μ θ p i C F H q = coordDensity (fun _ : I => μ) (eventDensity θ p C F H) i q

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.MixedExposure.stateAt_distance_left
statement:
lemma stateAt_distance_left (μ : Law (X×Y)) (θ : R → Profile I X Y → ℝ)
    (hθ : ∀ r z, 0 ≤ θ r z) {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (i : I)
    (C : Matrix m n ℂ) (U U' : R → Profile I X Y → Matrix u m ℂ)
    (V : R → Profile I X Y → Matrix v n ℂ) (q : X×Y) :
    hsSq (stateAt μ θ p i C U V q-stateAt μ θ p i C U' V q) =
      (1/p)*∑ r, (pi (fun _ : I => μ)).avg (fun z => θ r z * hsSq
        ((U r (Function.update z i q)-U' r (Function.update z i q))*C*(V r (Function.update z i q))ᵀ))

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.MixedExposure.stateAt_distance_right
statement:
lemma stateAt_distance_right (μ : Law (X×Y)) (θ : R → Profile I X Y → ℝ)
    (hθ : ∀ r z, 0 ≤ θ r z) {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (i : I)
    (C : Matrix m n ℂ) (U : R → Profile I X Y → Matrix u m ℂ)
    (V V' : R → Profile I X Y → Matrix v n ℂ) (q : X×Y) :
    hsSq (stateAt μ θ p i C U V q-stateAt μ θ p i C U V' q) =
      (1/p)*∑ r, (pi (fun _ : I => μ)).avg (fun z => θ r z * hsSq
        (U r (Function.update z i q)*C*(V r (Function.update z i q)-V' r (Function.update z i q))ᵀ))

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.MixedExposure.stateAt_left_local
statement:
lemma stateAt_left_local (μ : Law (X×Y)) (θ : R → Profile I X Y → ℝ) (p : ℝ) (i : I)
    (C : Matrix m n ℂ) (U : R → Profile I X Y → Matrix u m ℂ)
    (V : R → Profile I X Y → Matrix v n ℂ)
    (hU : ∀ r, IgnoresLeft (U r) i) (hV : ∀ r, IgnoresLeft (V r) i)
    (x x' : X) (y : Y) : stateAt μ θ p i C U V (x,y) = stateAt μ θ p i C U V (x',y)

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.MixedExposure.stateAt_norm
statement:
lemma stateAt_norm (μ : Law (X×Y)) (θ : R → Profile I X Y → ℝ)
    (hθ : ∀ r z, 0 ≤ θ r z) {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (i : I)
    (C : Matrix m n ℂ) (U : R → Profile I X Y → Matrix u m ℂ)
    (V : R → Profile I X Y → Matrix v n ℂ) (q : X×Y) :
    hsSq (stateAt μ θ p i C U V q) = (1/p)*∑ r, (pi (fun _ : I => μ)).avg
      (fun z => θ r z * hsSq (U r (Function.update z i q)*C*(V r (Function.update z i q))ᵀ))

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.MixedExposure.stateAt_norm_gram
statement:
lemma stateAt_norm_gram (μ : Law (X×Y)) (θ : R → Profile I X Y → ℝ)
    (hθ : ∀ r z, 0 ≤ θ r z) {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (i : I)
    (C : Matrix m n ℂ) (U : R → Profile I X Y → Matrix u m ℂ)
    (V : R → Profile I X Y → Matrix v n ℂ)
    (F : R → Profile I X Y → Matrix m m ℂ) (H : R → Profile I X Y → Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hU : ∀ r z, (U r z)ᴴ*U r z=F r z) (hV : ∀ r z, (V r z)ᴴ*V r z=H r z) (q : X×Y) :
    hsSq (stateAt μ θ p i C U V q) = (1/p)*∑ r, (pi (fun _ : I => μ)).avg
      (fun z => θ r z*prob C (F r (Function.update z i q)) (H r (Function.update z i q)))

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.MixedExposure.stateAt_right_local
statement:
lemma stateAt_right_local (μ : Law (X×Y)) (θ : R → Profile I X Y → ℝ) (p : ℝ) (i : I)
    (C : Matrix m n ℂ) (U : R → Profile I X Y → Matrix u m ℂ)
    (V : R → Profile I X Y → Matrix v n ℂ)
    (hU : ∀ r, IgnoresRight (U r) i) (hV : ∀ r, IgnoresRight (V r) i)
    (x : X) (y y' : Y) : stateAt μ θ p i C U V (x,y) = stateAt μ θ p i C U V (x,y')

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.avg_unitize_triangle
statement:
lemma avg_unitize_triangle {Z : Type u_Z} [Fintype Z] (μ : Law Z)
    (C D : Z → Matrix m n ℂ) (E : Matrix m n ℂ) :
    μ.avg (fun z => hsSq (C z-unitize (D z) E)) ≤
      2*(μ.avg (fun z => hsSq (C z-D z))+μ.avg (fun z => hsSq (D z-unitize (D z) E)))

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.first_unitize_cost
statement:
lemma first_unitize_cost (μ : Law (X×Y)) (y₀ : Y) (f : X×Y → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ z, 0 ≤ f z) (ht : μ.avg f = 1) (M : X → Matrix m n ℂ)
    (hM : ∀ x, hsSq (M x) = (μ.givenFirst y₀ x).avg (fun y => f (x,y)))
    (E : Matrix m n ℂ) (hE : hsSq E = 1) :
    μ.avg (fun z => hsSq (M z.1-unitize (M z.1) E)) ≤ μ.avg (fun z => f z*Real.log (f z))

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.hsSq_basisState
statement: lemma hsSq_basisState (i : m) (j : n) : hsSq (basisState i j) = 1

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.hsSq_triangle
statement: lemma hsSq_triangle (C D E : Matrix m n ℂ) : hsSq (C-E) ≤ 2*(hsSq (C-D)+hsSq (D-E))

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.second_unitize_cost
statement:
lemma second_unitize_cost (μ : Law (X×Y)) (x₀ : X) (f : X×Y → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ z, 0 ≤ f z) (ht : μ.avg f = 1) (N : Y → Matrix m n ℂ)
    (hN : ∀ y, hsSq (N y) = (μ.givenSecond x₀ y).avg (fun x => f (x,y)))
    (E : Matrix m n ℂ) (hE : hsSq E = 1) :
    μ.avg (fun z => hsSq (N z.2-unitize (N z.2) E)) ≤ μ.avg (fun z => f z*Real.log (f z))

statement:
lemma rawB_eq (j : Fin S.l.length) (q : X×Y) : S.rawB j q.2 =

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.integrable_id_gaussian

theorem integrable_id_gaussian (d : ℕ) :

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.integrable_id_restrict

theorem integrable_id_restrict (d : ℕ) (A : Set (Space d)) :

statement:
theorem sum_centroid_eq_zero {d k : ℕ} {A : Fin k → Set (Space d)}

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.value_nonneg
statement: theorem value_nonneg {d k : ℕ} (A : Fin k → Set (Space d)) : 0 ≤ value A

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Reduction.activeCount_merge_lt
OAI.GaussianPropeller.Reduction.active_centroid_ne_other
statement:
theorem active_centroid_ne_other {A : Fin k → Set (Space d)} (hA : MinimalOptimal A)
    (hpos : 0 < value A) {i j : Fin k} (hi : gaussian d (A i) ≠ 0) (hij : i ≠ j) :
    centroid (A i) ≠ centroid (A j)

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Reduction.active_centroid_ne_zero
statement:
theorem active_centroid_ne_zero {A : Fin k → Set (Space d)} (hA : MinimalOptimal A)
    (hpos : 0 < value A) {i : Fin k} (hi : gaussian d (A i) ≠ 0) : centroid (A i) ≠ 0

statement:
theorem assigned_le_scoreMax {A : Fin k → Set (Space d)} (hA : IsPartition A) (v : Tuple d k) :
    (fun x => ∑ i, (A i).indicator (fun x => ⟪v.ofLp i, x⟫) x) ≤ᵐ[gaussian d]
      scoreMax v.ofLp

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Reduction.centroid_eq_zero_of_null
statement: theorem centroid_eq_zero_of_null {A : Set (Space d)} (hA : gaussian d A = 0) : centroid A = 0

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Reduction.centroid_union
statement:
theorem centroid_union {A : Fin k → Set (Space d)} (hA : IsPartition A)
    {i j : Fin k} (hij : i ≠ j) : centroid (A i ∪ A j) = centroid (A i) + centroid (A j)

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Reduction.continuous_scoreMax
statement: theorem continuous_scoreMax (v : Fin k → Space d) : Continuous (scoreMax v)

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Reduction.continuous_width
statement: theorem continuous_width : Continuous (width : Tuple d k → ℝ)

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Reduction.exists_max_width
statement:
theorem exists_max_width [NeZero d] :
    ∃ v : Tuple d k, ‖v‖ = 1 ∧ ∀ w : Tuple d k, ‖w‖ = 1 → width w ≤ width v

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Reduction.exists_minimal_optimal
statement:
theorem exists_minimal_optimal [NeZero d] :
    ∃ A : Fin k → Set (Space d), MinimalOptimal A

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Reduction.exists_optimal_partition
statement:
theorem exists_optimal_partition [NeZero d] :
    ∃ A : Fin k → Set (Space d), IsPartition A ∧
      ∀ B : Fin k → Set (Space d), IsPartition B → value B ≤ value A

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Reduction.exists_scoreMax
statement:
theorem exists_scoreMax (v : Fin k → Space d) (x : Space d) :
    ∃ i, ⟪v i, x⟫ = scoreMax v x

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Reduction.exists_unique_scoreCell
statement:
theorem exists_unique_scoreCell (v : Fin k → Space d) (x : Space d) :
    ∃! i, x ∈ scoreCell v i

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Reduction.gaussian_hyperplane_null
statement:
theorem gaussian_hyperplane_null (z : Space d) (hz : z ≠ 0) (c : ℝ) :
    gaussian d {x | ⟪z, x⟫ = c} = 0

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Reduction.integrable_scoreMax
statement:
theorem integrable_scoreMax (v : Tuple d k) :
    Integrable (scoreMax v.ofLp) (gaussian d)

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Reduction.le_scoreMax
statement:
theorem le_scoreMax (v : Fin k → Space d) (i : Fin k) (x : Space d) :
    ⟪v i, x⟫ ≤ scoreMax v x

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Reduction.measurableSet_closedCell
statement:
theorem measurableSet_closedCell (z : Fin k → Space d) (i : Fin k) :
    MeasurableSet (closedCell z i)

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Reduction.measurable_scoreCell
statement:
theorem measurable_scoreCell (v : Fin k → Space d) (i : Fin k) :
    MeasurableSet (scoreCell v i)

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Reduction.merge_partition
statement:
theorem merge_partition {A : Fin k → Set (Space d)} (hA : IsPartition A)
    {i j : Fin k} (hij : i ≠ j) : IsPartition (merge A i j)

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Reduction.negative_inner_of_minimal
statement:
theorem negative_inner_of_minimal {A : Fin k → Set (Space d)} (hA : MinimalOptimal A)
    {i j : Fin k} (hij : i ≠ j) (hi : gaussian d (A i) ≠ 0) (hj : gaussian d (A j) ≠ 0) :
    ⟪centroid (A i), centroid (A j)⟫ < 0

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Reduction.norm_moments_le
OAI.GaussianPropeller.Reduction.norm_moments_sq
statement: theorem norm_moments_sq (A : Fin k → Set (Space d)) : ‖moments A‖ ^ 2 = value A

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Reduction.norm_scoreMax_le
statement:
theorem norm_scoreMax_le (v : Tuple d k) (x : Space d) :
    ‖scoreMax v.ofLp x‖ ≤ ‖v‖ * ‖x‖

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Reduction.norm_scoreMax_sub_le
statement:
theorem norm_scoreMax_sub_le (v w : Tuple d k) (x : Space d) :
    ‖scoreMax v.ofLp x - scoreMax w.ofLp x‖ ≤ ‖v - w‖ * ‖x‖

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Reduction.optimal_winning_ae
statement:
theorem optimal_winning_ae {A : Fin k → Set (Space d)} (hA : Optimal A) :
    ∀ᵐ x ∂gaussian d, ∀ i, x ∈ A i → ⟪centroid (A i), x⟫ =
      scoreMax (fun j => centroid (A j)) x

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Reduction.pairing_integral
statement:
theorem pairing_integral {A : Fin k → Set (Space d)} (hA : IsPartition A)
    (v : Tuple d k) :
    ⟪v, moments A⟫ = ∫ x, ∑ i, (A i).indicator (fun x => ⟪v.ofLp i, x⟫) x
      ∂gaussian d

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Reduction.pairing_le_width
statement:
theorem pairing_le_width {A : Fin k → Set (Space d)} (hA : IsPartition A)
    (v : Tuple d k) : ⟪v, moments A⟫ ≤ width v

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Reduction.pairing_scoreCell
statement:
theorem pairing_scoreCell (v : Tuple d k) :
    ⟪v, moments (scoreCell v.ofLp)⟫ = width v

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Reduction.scoreCell_partition
statement: theorem scoreCell_partition (v : Fin k → Space d) : IsPartition (scoreCell v)

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Reduction.scoreCell_score
statement:
theorem scoreCell_score (v : Fin k → Space d) {i : Fin k} {x : Space d}
    (hx : x ∈ scoreCell v i) : ⟪v i, x⟫ = scoreMax v x

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Reduction.scoreMax_le_iff
statement:
theorem scoreMax_le_iff (v : Fin k → Space d) (x : Space d) (b : ℝ) :
    scoreMax v x ≤ b ↔ ∀ i, ⟪v i, x⟫ ≤ b

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Reduction.scoreMax_sub_le
statement:
theorem scoreMax_sub_le (v w : Tuple d k) (x : Space d) :
    scoreMax v.ofLp x - scoreMax w.ofLp x ≤ ‖v - w‖ * ‖x‖

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Reduction.two_nonzero_centroids
statement:
theorem two_nonzero_centroids {A : Fin k → Set (Space d)} (hA : IsPartition A)
    (hpos : 0 < value A) : ∃ i j, i ≠ j ∧ centroid (A i) ≠ 0 ∧ centroid (A j) ≠ 0

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Reduction.value_merge
statement:
theorem value_merge {A : Fin k → Set (Space d)} (hA : IsPartition A)
    {i j : Fin k} (hij : i ≠ j) :
    value (merge A i j) = value A + 2 * ⟪centroid (A i), centroid (A j)⟫

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Reduction.width_lipschitz_bound
statement:
theorem width_lipschitz_bound (v w : Tuple d k) :
    ‖width v - width w‖ ≤ (∫ x : Space d, ‖x‖ ∂gaussian d) * ‖v - w‖

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Reduction.width_moments_of_optimal
statement:
theorem width_moments_of_optimal {A : Fin k → Set (Space d)} (hA : Optimal A) :
    width (moments A) = value A

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Reduction.width_nonneg
statement: theorem width_nonneg (v : Tuple d k) : 0 ≤ width v

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Reduction.erase_univ_nonempty
statement:
lemma erase_univ_nonempty (hk : 2 ≤ k) (i : Fin k) :
    (Finset.univ.erase i).Nonempty

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Reduction.integral_omittedMax
statement:
lemma integral_omittedMax (hk : 2 ≤ k) (z : Fin k → Space d)
    (hz : ∑ j, z j = 0) (i : Fin k) :
    ∫ x, omittedMax hk z i x ∂gaussian d = width (recentered z i)

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Reduction.omittedMax_integrable
statement:
lemma omittedMax_integrable (hk : 2 ≤ k) (z : Fin k → Space d)
    (hz : ∑ j, z j = 0) (i : Fin k) :
    Integrable (omittedMax hk z i) (gaussian d)

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Reduction.optimal_loss_lower
statement:
theorem optimal_loss_lower (hk : 2 ≤ k) {A : Fin k → Set (Space d)}
    (hA : Optimal A) (i : Fin k) :
    value A - Real.sqrt (value A) *
      Real.sqrt (value A - ((k:ℝ)/((k:ℝ)-1)) * ‖centroid (A i)‖^2) ≤
    ∫ x, max (⟪centroid (A i),x⟫ -
      omittedMax hk (fun j => centroid (A j)) i x) 0 ∂gaussian d

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Reduction.optimal_width_le
statement:
theorem optimal_width_le {A : Fin k → Set (Space d)} (hA : Optimal A)
    (v : Tuple d k) : width v ≤ Real.sqrt (value A) * ‖v‖

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Reduction.positive_gap_eq
statement:
lemma positive_gap_eq (hk : 2 ≤ k) (z : Fin k → Space d)
    (i : Fin k) (x : Space d) :
    max (⟪z i,x⟫ - omittedMax hk z i x) 0 = scoreMax z x - omittedMax hk z i x

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Reduction.recentered_norm_sq
statement:
lemma recentered_norm_sq (hk : 2 ≤ k) (z : Fin k → Space d)
    (hz : ∑ j, z j = 0) (i : Fin k) :
    ‖recentered z i‖^2 = (∑ j, ‖z j‖^2) -
      ((k:ℝ)/((k:ℝ)-1)) * ‖z i‖^2

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Reduction.scoreMax_eq_max_omitted
statement:
lemma scoreMax_eq_max_omitted (hk : 2 ≤ k) (z : Fin k → Space d)
    (i : Fin k) (x : Space d) : scoreMax z x = max ⟪z i,x⟫ (omittedMax hk z i x)

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Reduction.scoreMax_recentered
statement:
lemma scoreMax_recentered (hk : 2 ≤ k) (z : Fin k → Space d)
    (hz : ∑ j, z j = 0) (i : Fin k) (x : Space d) :
    scoreMax (recentered z i).ofLp x = omittedMax hk z i x + ⟪((k:ℝ)-1)⁻¹ • z i,x⟫

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Reduction.sum_erase_zero
statement:
lemma sum_erase_zero (z : Fin k → Space d) (hz : ∑ j, z j = 0) (i : Fin k) :
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, z j = -z i

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Reduction.sum_erased_centered
statement:
lemma sum_erased_centered (hk : 2 ≤ k) (z : Fin k → Space d)
    (hz : ∑ j, z j = 0) (i : Fin k) :
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, (z j + ((k:ℝ)-1)⁻¹ • z i) = 0

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Gram.affineIndependent
statement:
theorem affineIndependent (z : ι → E)
    (hneg : Pairwise (fun i j => ⟪z i, z j⟫ < 0)) (hsum : ∑ i, z i = 0) :
    AffineIndependent ℝ z

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Gram.coefficients_constant
statement:
theorem coefficients_constant (z : ι → E)
    (hneg : Pairwise (fun i j => ⟪z i, z j⟫ < 0)) (hsum : ∑ i, z i = 0)
    (a : ι → ℝ) (ha : ∑ i, a i • z i = 0) (i j : ι) : a j = a i

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Gram.exists_inner_values
statement:
theorem exists_inner_values [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] (v : ι → E)
    (hv : LinearIndependent ℝ v) (a : ι → ℝ) :
    ∃ h ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range v), ∀ i, ⟪h, v i⟫ = a i

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Gram.exists_translation
statement:
theorem exists_translation [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] (z : ι → E)
    (hneg : Pairwise (fun i j => ⟪z i, z j⟫ < 0)) (hsum : ∑ i, z i = 0)
    (i : ι) : ∃ h ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range z),
      (∀ j, j ≠ i → ⟪h, z i - z j⟫ = 1) ∧
        ⟪h, z i⟫ = ((Fintype.card ι : ℝ) - 1) / (Fintype.card ι : ℝ)

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Gram.finrank_span
statement:

    (i : ι) : Module.finrank ℝ (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range z)) =
      Fintype.card ι - 1

OAI.GaussianPropeller.HeatMaximum.deficit_coercive_radius
statement:
lemma deficit_coercive_radius {a b ε L M : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b)
    (hab : a+b=1) (hε : 0 < ε) (hL : 0 ≤ L) (hM : 0 ≤ M) :
    ∃ R : ℝ, ∀ (v : E → ℝ) (σ : ℝ), ε ≤ σ →
      (∀ x, |v x| ≤ M+L*‖x‖) → ∀ x y,
      R ≤ ‖x‖ ∨ R ≤ ‖y‖ → 0 ≤ deficit v a b σ x y

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.HeatMaximum.deficit_lower
statement:

    (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hab : a+b=1) (hL : 0 ≤ L)
    (hε : 0 < ε) (hσε : ε ≤ σ) (hv : ∀ x, |v x| ≤ M+L*‖x‖) (x y : E) :
    ε/2*(a*‖x‖^2+b*‖y‖^2)-2*M-2*L^2/ε ≤ deficit v a b σ x y

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.HeatMaximum.exists_negative_minimum
statement:
lemma exists_negative_minimum [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [ProperSpace E]
    {F : ℝ → E → E → ℝ} {T R : ℝ} {x₀ y₀ : E}
    (hF : Continuous (fun q : ℝ × E × E => F q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2))
    (hT : 0 ≤ T) (hnegative : F T x₀ y₀ < 0)
    (hinitial : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ F 0 x y)
    (hcoercive : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, ∀ x y,
      R ≤ ‖x‖ ∨ R ≤ ‖y‖ → 0 ≤ F t x y) :
    ∃ t ∈ Ioc 0 T, ∃ x y, F t x y < 0 ∧
      (∀ x' y', F t x y ≤ F t x' y') ∧
      (∀ s ∈ Icc 0 t, F t x y ≤ F s x y)

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.HeatMaximum.heat_concave
statement:
lemma heat_concave [ProperSpace E] {ι : Type uι} [Fintype ι] (basis : ι → E)
    (hbasis : ∀ i, ‖basis i‖ = 1)
    {v : ℝ → E → ℝ} {p : ℝ → E → E} {H : ℝ → E → E → ℝ}
    {T L M : ℝ} (hT : 0 ≤ T) (hL : 0 ≤ L) (hM : 0 ≤ M)
    (hv : Continuous (fun q : ℝ × E => v q.1 q.2))
    (hinitial : ConcaveOn ℝ univ (v 0))
    (hp : ∀ t ∈ Ioc 0 T, ∀ x, HasFDerivAt (v t) (innerSL ℝ (p t x)) x)
    (hH : ∀ t ∈ Ioc 0 T, ∀ x e, HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => ⟪p t (x+s • e),e⟫) (H t x e) 0)
    (hvt : ∀ t ∈ Ioc 0 T, ∀ x, HasDerivAt (fun s => v s x)
      (((∑ i, H t x (basis i))-v t x*‖p t x‖^2)/2) t)
    (hpbound : ∀ t ∈ Ioc 0 T, ∀ x, ‖p t x‖ ≤ L)
    (hvbound : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, ∀ x, |v t x| ≤ M+L*‖x‖) :
    ConcaveOn ℝ univ (v T)

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.HeatMaximum.heat_deficit_nonneg
statement:
lemma heat_deficit_nonneg [ProperSpace E] {ι : Type uι} [Fintype ι] (basis : ι → E)
    (hbasis : ∀ i, ‖basis i‖ = 1)
    {v : ℝ → E → ℝ} {p : ℝ → E → E} {H : ℝ → E → E → ℝ}
    {T a b ε L M : ℝ} (hT : 0 ≤ T) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hab : a+b=1)
    (hε : 0 < ε) (hL : 0 ≤ L) (hM : 0 ≤ M)
    (hv : Continuous (fun q : ℝ × E => v q.1 q.2))
    (hinitial : ConcaveOn ℝ univ (v 0))
    (hp : ∀ t ∈ Ioc 0 T, ∀ x, HasFDerivAt (v t) (innerSL ℝ (p t x)) x)
    (hH : ∀ t ∈ Ioc 0 T, ∀ x e, HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => ⟪p t (x+s • e),e⟫) (H t x e) 0)
    (hvt : ∀ t ∈ Ioc 0 T, ∀ x, HasDerivAt (fun s => v s x)
      (((∑ i, H t x (basis i))-v t x*‖p t x‖^2)/2) t)
    (hpbound : ∀ t ∈ Ioc 0 T, ∀ x, ‖p t x‖ ≤ L)
    (hvbound : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, ∀ x, |v t x| ≤ M+L*‖x‖) (x y : E) :
    0 ≤ deficit (v T) a b (ε*Real.exp (((Fintype.card ι : ℝ)+2*L*(M+L)+1)*T)) x y

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.HeatMaximum.min_gradient_left
statement:
lemma min_gradient_left {v : E → ℝ} {p : E → E} {a b σ : ℝ} {x y : E}
    (hp : ∀ x, HasFDerivAt v (innerSL ℝ (p x)) x) (ha : 0 < a)
    (hm : ∀ x' y', deficit v a b σ x y ≤ deficit v a b σ x' y') :
    p (a • x+b • y)-p x = -(2*σ) • x

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.HeatMaximum.min_gradient_right
statement:
lemma min_gradient_right {v : E → ℝ} {p : E → E} {a b σ : ℝ} {x y : E}

    (hm : ∀ x' y', deficit v a b σ x y ≤ deficit v a b σ x' y') :

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.HeatMaximum.min_hessian_diagonal
statement:
lemma min_hessian_diagonal {v : E → ℝ} {p : E → E} {H : E → E → ℝ}
    {a b σ : ℝ} {x y : E} (hab : a+b=1)
    (hp : ∀ x, HasFDerivAt v (innerSL ℝ (p x)) x)
    (hH : ∀ x e, HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => ⟪p (x+s • e),e⟫) (H x e) 0)
    (hm : ∀ x' y', deficit v a b σ x y ≤ deficit v a b σ x' y') (e : E) :
    0 ≤ H (a • x+b • y) e-a*H x e-b*H y e+2*σ*‖e‖^2

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.HeatMaximum.min_laplacian_bound
statement:
lemma min_laplacian_bound {ι : Type uι} [Fintype ι] (basis : ι → E)
    (hbasis : ∀ i, ‖basis i‖ = 1)
    {v : E → ℝ} {p : E → E} {H : E → E → ℝ}
    {a b σ : ℝ} {x y : E} (hab : a+b=1)
    (hp : ∀ x, HasFDerivAt v (innerSL ℝ (p x)) x)
    (hH : ∀ x e, HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => ⟪p (x+s • e),e⟫) (H x e) 0)
    (hm : ∀ x' y', deficit v a b σ x y ≤ deficit v a b σ x' y') :
    -2*σ*(Fintype.card ι : ℝ) ≤
      (∑ i, H (a • x+b • y) (basis i))-a*(∑ i, H x (basis i))-b*(∑ i, H y (basis i))

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.HeatMaximum.no_forbidden_minimum
statement:
lemma no_forbidden_minimum {ι : Type uι} [Fintype ι] (basis : ι → E)
    (hbasis : ∀ i, ‖basis i‖ = 1)
    {v : ℝ → E → ℝ} {p : E → E} {H : E → E → ℝ} {σf : ℝ → ℝ}
    {a b L M t : ℝ} {x y : E} (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hab : a+b=1)
    (hL : 0 ≤ L) (hM : 0 ≤ M) (ht : 0 < t) (hσ : 0 < σf t)
    (hp : ∀ x, HasFDerivAt (v t) (innerSL ℝ (p x)) x)
    (hH : ∀ x e, HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => ⟪p (x+s • e),e⟫) (H x e) 0)
    (hvt : ∀ x, HasDerivAt (fun s => v s x)
      (((∑ i, H x (basis i))-v t x*‖p x‖^2)/2) t)
    (hσt : HasDerivAt σf (((Fintype.card ι : ℝ)+2*L*(M+L)+1)*σf t) t)
    (hpbound : ∀ x, ‖p x‖ ≤ L) (hvbound : ∀ x, |v t x| ≤ M+L*‖x‖)
    (hm : ∀ x' y', deficit (v t) a b (σf t) x y ≤ deficit (v t) a b (σf t) x' y')
    (hmTime : ∀ s ∈ Icc 0 t, deficit (v t) a b (σf t) x y ≤ deficit (v s) a b (σf s) x y)
    (hneg : deficit (v t) a b (σf t) x y ≤ 0) : False

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.HeatMaximum.reaction_bound
statement:
lemma reaction_bound {E : Type uE} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    {p₀ p₁ p₂ : E} {a b σ L M r s v₀ v₁ v₂ : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hab : a+b=1) (hσ : 0 ≤ σ)
    (hL : 0 ≤ L) (hM : 0 ≤ M) (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hs : 0 ≤ s)
    (hp₀ : ‖p₀‖ ≤ L) (hp₁ : ‖p₁‖ ≤ L) (hp₂ : ‖p₂‖ ≤ L)
    (hv₁ : |v₁| ≤ M+L*r) (hv₂ : |v₂| ≤ M+L*s)
    (hp₁₀ : ‖p₀-p₁‖ ≤ 2*σ*r) (hp₂₀ : ‖p₀-p₂‖ ≤ 2*σ*s)
    (hdef : v₀-a*v₁-b*v₂+σ*(1+a*r^2+b*s^2) ≤ 0) :
    v₀*‖p₀‖^2-a*v₁*‖p₁‖^2-b*v₂*‖p₂‖^2 ≤
      4*L*σ*(M+L)*(1+a*r^2+b*s^2)

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.HeatMaximum.second_deriv_nonneg_of_localMin
OAI.GaussianPropeller.HeatMaximum.square_norm_difference_bound
statement:
lemma square_norm_difference_bound {E : Type uE} [NormedAddCommGroup E]

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Analytic.lintegral_orthonormal_triple
statement:
lemma lintegral_orthonormal_triple (v : Fin 3 → E) (hv : Orthonormal ℝ v)
    (f : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ≥0∞) (hf : Measurable f) :
    ∫⁻ x, f (⟪v 0,x⟫,⟪v 1,x⟫,⟪v 2,x⟫) ∂stdGaussian E =
      ∫⁻ s : ℝ, (∫⁻ u : ℝ, (∫⁻ w : ℝ, f (s,u,w) ∂gaussianReal 0 1)
        ∂gaussianReal 0 1) ∂gaussianReal 0 1

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Analytic.map_inner_stdGaussian
statement:
lemma map_inner_stdGaussian (v : E) :

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Analytic.map_orthonormal_stdGaussian
statement:
lemma map_orthonormal_stdGaussian (v : ι → E) (hv : Orthonormal ℝ v) :

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Analytic.map_orthonormal_triple_stdGaussian
statement:
lemma map_orthonormal_triple_stdGaussian (v : Fin 3 → E) (hv : Orthonormal ℝ v) :

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.PairIntegral.lintegral_affine_gaussian_le
statement:
lemma lintegral_affine_gaussian_le (f : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞) (hf : Measurable f) (b : ℝ)
    {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) :
    ∫⁻ x : ℝ, f (a*x+b) ∂gaussianReal 0 1 ≤

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.PairIntegral.lintegral_affine_volume
statement:
lemma lintegral_affine_volume (f : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞) (hf : Measurable f) (b : ℝ)

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.PairIntegral.lintegral_gaussian_pair_le
statement:
lemma lintegral_gaussian_pair_le (f : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ≥0∞) (hf : Measurable f)
    (b : ℝ) {a c : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hc : 0 < c) :
    ∫⁻ x : ℝ, (∫⁻ y : ℝ, f (a*x,b*x+c*y) ∂gaussianReal 0 1) ∂gaussianReal 0 1 ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal ((2*Real.pi*a*c)⁻¹) * ∫⁻ u : ℝ, ∫⁻ v : ℝ, f (u,v)

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.PairIntegral.lintegral_gaussian_std_le

lemma lintegral_gaussian_std_le (f : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞) (hf : Measurable f) :

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.PairIntegral.lintegral_triangle
statement:
lemma lintegral_triangle (s : ℝ) :

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.PairIntegral.lintegral_triangle_gaussian
statement:
lemma lintegral_triangle_gaussian {a c : ℝ} (b : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hc : 0 < c) :

      ∂gaussianReal 0 1) ∂gaussianReal 0 1) ∂gaussianReal 0 1 ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (9/(2*Real.pi*Real.sqrt (2*Real.pi)*a*c))

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.PairIntegral.lintegral_triangle_shifted
statement:

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Pair.centroid_residual_pair
statement:
lemma centroid_residual_pair (K : Set E) (hK : MeasurableSet K)
    (z r s : E) (hz : z ≠ 0) (hzK : ∫ x in K, x ∂stdGaussian E = z)
    (hzr : ⟪z,r⟫ = 0) (hzs : ⟪z,s⟫ = 0)
    {L M : ℝ} (hL : 0 < L) (hM : 0 < M)
    (hrK : ∀ x ∈ K, ⟪r,x⟫ ≤ L*⟪z,x⟫)
    (hsK : ∀ x ∈ K, ⟪s,x⟫ ≤ M*⟪z,x⟫)
    (hd : 0 < ‖r‖^2*‖s‖^2-⟪r,s⟫^2) :
    Real.sqrt (‖r‖^2*‖s‖^2-⟪r,s⟫^2) ≤
      9*‖z‖*L*M/(2*Real.pi*Real.sqrt (2*Real.pi))

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Pair.integral_inner_eq_inner_integral
statement:
lemma integral_inner_eq_inner_integral (K : Set E) (w : E) :

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Pair.setIntegral_inner_le_triangle
statement:
lemma setIntegral_inner_le_triangle (K : Set E) (hK : MeasurableSet K)
    (e u v : E) (he : ‖e‖ = 1) (heu : ⟪e,u⟫ = 0) (hev : ⟪e,v⟫ = 0)
    (hd : 0 < ‖u‖^2*‖v‖^2-⟪u,v⟫^2)
    (huK : ∀ x ∈ K, ⟪u,x⟫ ≤ ⟪e,x⟫) (hvK : ∀ x ∈ K, ⟪v,x⟫ ≤ ⟪e,x⟫)
    (hu0 : ∫ x in K, ⟪u,x⟫ ∂stdGaussian E = 0)
    (hv0 : ∫ x in K, ⟪v,x⟫ ∂stdGaussian E = 0) :
    ∫ x in K, ⟪e,x⟫ ∂stdGaussian E ≤
      9/(2*Real.pi*Real.sqrt (2*Real.pi)*Real.sqrt (‖u‖^2*‖v‖^2-⟪u,v⟫^2))

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Pair.sqrt_gram_smul
statement:
lemma sqrt_gram_smul {u v : E} {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) :
    Real.sqrt (‖a • u‖^2*‖b • v‖^2-⟪a • u,b • v⟫^2) =
      a*b*Real.sqrt (‖u‖^2*‖v‖^2-⟪u,v⟫^2)

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Pair.triangle_inner_bound
statement:
lemma triangle_inner_bound (e u v : E) (he : ‖e‖ = 1)
    (heu : ⟪e,u⟫ = 0) (hev : ⟪e,v⟫ = 0)
    (hd : 0 < ‖u‖^2*‖v‖^2-⟪u,v⟫^2) :
    ∫⁻ x, triangle ⟪e,x⟫ ⟪u,x⟫ ⟪v,x⟫ ∂stdGaussian E ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (9/(2*Real.pi*Real.sqrt (2*Real.pi)*
        Real.sqrt (‖u‖^2*‖v‖^2-⟪u,v⟫^2)))

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.PairGeometry.orthonormal_triple_of_gram_pos
statement:
lemma orthonormal_triple_of_gram_pos (e u v : E) (he : ‖e‖ = 1)
    (heu : ⟪e,u⟫ = 0) (hev : ⟪e,v⟫ = 0)
    (hd : 0 < ‖u‖^2*‖v‖^2-⟪u,v⟫^2) :
    ∃ (f : Fin 3 → E) (a b c : ℝ), Orthonormal ℝ f ∧
      f 0 = e ∧ 0 < a ∧ 0 < c ∧ u = a • f 1 ∧ v = b • f 1 + c • f 2 ∧
      (a*c)^2 = ‖u‖^2*‖v‖^2-⟪u,v⟫^2

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Reduction.active_centroid_rank
statement:
theorem active_centroid_rank {A : Fin k → Set (Space d)} (hA : MinimalOptimal A)

    Module.finrank ℝ (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range (fun j : activeLabels A => centroid (A j)))) =

statement:
theorem active_centroids_obtuse {A : Fin k → Set (Space d)} (hA : MinimalOptimal A) :

theorem centroid_closedCell {A : Fin k → Set (Space d)} (hA : MinimalOptimal A)
    (hpos : 0 < value A) {i : Fin k} (hi : gaussian d (A i) ≠ 0) :
    centroid (closedCell (fun j => centroid (A j)) i) = centroid (A i)

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Polar.integral_homogeneous
statement:
lemma integral_homogeneous (f : E → ℝ) (q : ℕ)
    (hf : ∀ (r : ℝ), 0 < r → ∀ x, f (r • x) = r^q * f x) :
    ∫ x, f x ∂stdGaussian E =
      ((Real.sqrt (2*Real.pi))⁻¹ ^ Fintype.card ι *
      ∫ r in Ioi (0:ℝ), r^(Fintype.card ι - 1 + q) * Real.exp (-r^2/2)) *
      ∫ θ : S, f θ.1 ∂(V).toSphere

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Polar.integral_norm
statement:
lemma integral_norm (hd : Fintype.card ι = 3) :
    ∫ x : E, ‖x‖ ∂stdGaussian E = 4/sqrt (2*Real.pi)

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Polar.integral_norm_pow_exp
statement:
lemma integral_norm_pow_exp (q : ℕ) {a : ℝ} (_ha : 0≤a) :
    ∫ x : E, ‖x‖^q*exp (-a*‖x‖^2) ∂stdGaussian E =
      radial (Fintype.card ι-1+q) (a+1/2)/radial (Fintype.card ι-1) (1/2)

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Polar.integral_radial
statement:
lemma integral_radial (f : ℝ → ℝ) :
    ∫ x : E, f ‖x‖ ∂stdGaussian E =
      ((sqrt (2*Real.pi))⁻¹ ^ Fintype.card ι * ∫ _ : S, (1:ℝ) ∂(volume : Measure E).toSphere) *
      ∫ r in Ioi (0:ℝ), r^(Fintype.card ι-1)*exp (-r^2/2)*f r

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Polar.integral_radial_normalized
statement:
lemma integral_radial_normalized (f : ℝ → ℝ) :
    ∫ x : E, f ‖x‖ ∂stdGaussian E =
      (∫ r in Ioi (0:ℝ), r^(Fintype.card ι-1)*exp (-r^2/2)*f r) /
      radial (Fintype.card ι-1) (1/2)

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Polar.integral_stdGaussian_polar
statement:
lemma integral_stdGaussian_polar (f : E → ℝ) :
    ∫ x, f x ∂stdGaussian E = (Real.sqrt (2*Real.pi))⁻¹ ^ Fintype.card ι *
      ∫ p : S × Ioi (0 : ℝ), Real.exp (-p.2.1^2/2) * f (p.2.1 • p.1.1)
        ∂(V).toSphere.prod (Measure.volumeIoiPow (Fintype.card ι - 1))

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Polar.integral_volumeIoiPow
statement:
lemma integral_volumeIoiPow (d : ℕ) (g : ℝ → ℝ) :
    (∫ r : Ioi (0:ℝ), g r.1 ∂Measure.volumeIoiPow d) =
      ∫ r in Ioi (0:ℝ), r^d * g r

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Polar.integral_volume_polar
statement:
lemma integral_volume_polar (f : E → ℝ) :
    ∫ x, f x = ∫ p : S × Ioi (0 : ℝ), f (p.2.1 • p.1.1)
      ∂(V).toSphere.prod (Measure.volumeIoiPow (Fintype.card ι - 1))

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Reduction.configuration_determinants
statement:
lemma configuration_determinants (z:Fin k→Space d) (hsum:∑ j,z j=0)
    (hneg:Pairwise (fun j l=>⟪z j,z l⟫<0)) (i:Fin k) (hi:z i≠0)
    {j l q : Fin k} (hij:i≠j) (hil:i≠l) (hiq:i≠q) (hjl:j≠l) (hjq:j≠q) (hlq:l≠q)
    (hj:‖z q‖≤‖z j‖) (hl:‖z q‖≤‖z l‖) (hmin:‖z i‖≤‖z q‖)
    (hpair:∀ a b, i≠a → i≠b →
      ‖residualVector (z i) (z a)‖^2*‖residualVector (z i) (z b)‖^2-
      ⟪residualVector (z i) (z a),residualVector (z i) (z b)⟫^2≤
      (3/Real.pi)^2*‖z i‖^2*(1+residualCoefficient (z i) (z a))^2*
      (1+residualCoefficient (z i) (z b))^2) :
    (‖z q‖^2-‖z i‖^2)*(‖z j‖^2+‖z l‖^2-‖z q‖^2-2*‖z i‖^2)≤
      8*(3/Real.pi)^2*‖z i‖^2 ∧
    (3/2:ℝ)*(‖z q‖^2-‖z i‖^2)^2≤10*(3/Real.pi)^2*‖z i‖^2

    (hpos : ∀ i < m, 0 < r i) (hordered : AntitoneOn r (Set.Iio m))

    (hnorm : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, r i ^ 2 = 1)
    (hprob : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, P i = 1)
    (hquad : ∀ i < m, (if m = 5 then (0.929 : ℝ) else 0.884) * r i ^ 2 ≤ P i)
    (hlin : ∀ i < m, 0.415 * r i + 0.15 * r i ^ 2 ≤ P i)
    (hdet₁ : (r 2 ^ 2 - r (m - 1) ^ 2) *
      (r 0 ^ 2 + r 1 ^ 2 - r 2 ^ 2 - 2 * r (m - 1) ^ 2) ≤
        8 * (3 / Real.pi) ^ 2 * r (m - 1) ^ 2)
    (hdet₂ : (3 / 2 : ℝ) * (r 2 ^ 2 - r (m - 1) ^ 2) ^ 2 ≤
      10 * (3 / Real.pi) ^ 2 * r (m - 1) ^ 2) : False

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Scalar.smallRoot_five

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Scalar.sum_prefix_le

theorem sum_prefix_le (f : ℕ → ℝ) {p m : ℕ} (hp : p ≤ m)

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Scalar.sum_split
statement:
theorem sum_split (f : ℕ → ℝ) {p m : ℕ} (hp : p ≤ m) :
    (∑ i ∈ Finset.range p, f i) + (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m - p), f (p + i)) =
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, f i

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Scalar.third_radius_gt

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Reduction.sqrt_threshold

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Reduction.residual_fourth_le

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Reduction.Configuration.impossible_five_or_more
statement: lemma impossible_five_or_more (D:Configuration d k) (hk:5≤k) : False

name: OAI.NoiselessRegression.dyadic_power_cancel
statement:
lemma dyadic_power_cancel (m k : ℕ) :
    (2 : ℝ) ^ (m * (k + 1)) * ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ k) ^ (m + 1) =
      (2 : ℝ) ^ m * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ k

name: OAI.NoiselessRegression.inverse_moment_of_tube_bound
statement:
theorem inverse_moment_of_tube_bound (μ : Measure X) (f : X → ℝ) (m : ℕ)
    (hf : Measurable f) (hnonneg : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x) (C : ℝ≥0∞)
    (htube : ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → r ≤ 1 →
      μ {x | f x ≤ r} ≤ C * ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ (m + 1))) :
    ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal ((f x)⁻¹ ^ m) ∂μ ≤
      μ Set.univ + C * (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ (m + 1)

name: OAI.NoiselessRegression.inverse_pow_dyadic_majorant
statement:
lemma inverse_pow_dyadic_majorant (f : X → ℝ) (m : ℕ) (hf : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x) (x : X) :
    ENNReal.ofReal ((f x)⁻¹ ^ m) ≤
      1 + ∑' k : ℕ, ({x | f x ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ k}).indicator
        (fun _ => ENNReal.ofReal ((2 : ℝ) ^ (m * (k + 1)))) x

name: OAI.NoiselessRegression.HasLocalMassBound.any_center
OAI.NoiselessRegression.card_le_volume_ratio
statement:
theorem card_le_volume_ratio (s : Finset E) {r R : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    (hs : ∀ x ∈ s, ‖x‖ ≤ R)
    (hsep : ∀ x ∈ s, ∀ y ∈ s, x ≠ y → r ≤ dist x y) :
    (s.card : ℝ) ≤ ((R + r / 2) / (r / 2)) ^ Module.finrank ℝ E

name: OAI.NoiselessRegression.exists_net_of_finite_packing_bound
statement:
theorem exists_net_of_finite_packing_bound (A : Set E) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) (N : ℕ)
    (hcard : ∀ s : Finset E, (∀ x ∈ s, x ∈ A) →
      (∀ x ∈ s, ∀ y ∈ s, x ≠ y → r < dist x y) → s.card ≤ N) :
    ∃ s : Finset E, (∀ x ∈ s, x ∈ A) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ s, ∀ y ∈ s, x ≠ y → r < dist x y) ∧
      ∀ x ∈ A, ∃ y ∈ s, dist x y ≤ r

name: OAI.NoiselessRegression.exists_unit_ball_net
statement:
theorem exists_unit_ball_net {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (hr1 : r ≤ 1) :
    ∃ s : Finset E, (∀ x ∈ s, ‖x‖ ≤ 1) ∧
      (s.card : ℝ) ≤ (3 / r) ^ Module.finrank ℝ E ∧
      ∀ x : E, ‖x‖ ≤ 1 → ∃ y ∈ s, dist x y ≤ r

name: OAI.NoiselessRegression.HasLocalMassBound.affine_inverse_moment
statement:
theorem HasLocalMassBound.affine_inverse_moment {ν : Measure E} {a : ℝ}
    (hν : HasLocalMassBound ν a) (hsupport : ν.support ⊆ Metric.closedBall 0 1)
    (L : AffineSubspace ℝ E) [Nonempty L] (m : ℕ)
    (hmargin : (Module.finrank ℝ L.direction : ℝ) + (m + 1 : ℕ) ≤ a) :
    ∫⁻ t, ENNReal.ofReal ((Metric.infDist t L)⁻¹ ^ m) ∂ν ≤
      ν Set.univ +
        ENNReal.ofReal ((3 : ℝ) ^ Module.finrank ℝ L.direction * (4 : ℝ) ^ a) *
          (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ (m + 1)

name: OAI.NoiselessRegression.HasLocalMassBound.affine_null
statement:
theorem HasLocalMassBound.affine_null {ν : Measure E} {a : ℝ}
    (hν : HasLocalMassBound ν a) (hsupport : ν.support ⊆ Metric.closedBall 0 1)
    (L : AffineSubspace ℝ E) [Nonempty L]
    (hmargin : (Module.finrank ℝ L.direction : ℝ) + 1 ≤ a) : ν L = 0

name: OAI.NoiselessRegression.HasLocalMassBound.affine_tube
statement:
theorem HasLocalMassBound.affine_tube {ν : Measure E} {a : ℝ}
    (hν : HasLocalMassBound ν a) (hsupport : ν.support ⊆ Metric.closedBall 0 1)
    (L : AffineSubspace ℝ E) [Nonempty L] {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (hr1 : r ≤ 1) :
    ν {t | Metric.infDist t L ≤ r} ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal ((3 / r) ^ Module.finrank ℝ L.direction * (4 * r) ^ a)

name: OAI.NoiselessRegression.HasLocalMassBound.affine_tube_pow
statement:
theorem HasLocalMassBound.affine_tube_pow {ν : Measure E} {a : ℝ}
    (hν : HasLocalMassBound ν a) (hsupport : ν.support ⊆ Metric.closedBall 0 1)
    (L : AffineSubspace ℝ E) [Nonempty L] (k : ℕ)
    (hmargin : (Module.finrank ℝ L.direction : ℝ) + k ≤ a)
    {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (hr1 : r ≤ 1) :
    ν {t | Metric.infDist t L ≤ r} ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal ((3 : ℝ) ^ Module.finrank ℝ L.direction * (4 : ℝ) ^ a) *
        ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ k)

name: OAI.NoiselessRegression.exists_affine_tube_cover
statement:
theorem exists_affine_tube_cover (L : AffineSubspace ℝ E) [Nonempty L]
    {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (hr1 : r ≤ 1) :
    ∃ s : Finset L.direction,
      (s.card : ℝ) ≤ (3 / r) ^ Module.finrank ℝ L.direction ∧
      ∀ t : E, ‖t‖ ≤ 1 → Metric.infDist t L ≤ r →
        ∃ y ∈ s, dist t ((y : E) + (orthogonalProjection L 0 : E)) ≤ 2 * r

name: OAI.NoiselessRegression.tube_radius_factors
statement:
lemma tube_radius_factors (ℓ : ℕ) (a : ℝ) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) :
    (3 / r) ^ ℓ * (4 * r) ^ a =
      (3 : ℝ) ^ ℓ * (4 : ℝ) ^ a * r ^ (a - ℓ)

name: OAI.NoiselessRegression.gram_linear_combination
statement:
lemma gram_linear_combination (w : ι → E) (T : Matrix ι ι ℝ) :
    Matrix.gram ℝ (fun j => ∑ i, (T i j) • w i) =
      T.transpose * Matrix.gram ℝ w * T

name: OAI.NoiselessRegression.gsUpper_det
statement: lemma gsUpper_det (v : Fin n → E) : (gsUpper n v).det = 1

name: OAI.NoiselessRegression.image_Iio_castSucc
statement:
lemma image_Iio_castSucc (v : Fin (n+1) → E) (j : Fin n) :

name: OAI.NoiselessRegression.image_Iio_last

name: OAI.NoiselessRegression.infDist_affine_mk'

name: OAI.NoiselessRegression.lintegral_pi_snoc
statement:
lemma lintegral_pi_snoc (f : (Fin (n+1) → E) → ℝ≥0∞) (hf : Measurable f) :
    ∫⁻ v, f v ∂Measure.pi (fun _ => ν) =
      ∫⁻ v : Fin n → E, ∫⁻ x, f (Fin.snoc v x) ∂ν ∂Measure.pi (fun _ => ν)

name: OAI.NoiselessRegression.gaussianReal_le_volume
statement: lemma gaussianReal_le_volume : gaussianReal 0 1 ≤ (volume : Measure ℝ)

name: OAI.NoiselessRegression.lintegral_fin_prod
statement:
lemma lintegral_fin_prod (n : ℕ) (f : Fin n → X → ℝ≥0∞) (hf : ∀ i, Measurable (f i)) :
    ∫⁻ x : Fin n → X, ∏ i, f i (x i) ∂Measure.pi (fun _ => μ) =
      ∏ i, ∫⁻ x, f i x ∂μ

name: OAI.NoiselessRegression.lintegral_pow_pi
statement:
lemma lintegral_pow_pi (f : X → ℝ≥0∞) (hf : Measurable f) (n : ℕ) :
    (∫⁻ x, f x ∂μ)^n =
      ∫⁻ x : Fin n → X, ∏ i, f (x i) ∂Measure.pi (fun _ => μ)

name: OAI.NoiselessRegression.lintegral_product_differences
statement:
lemma lintegral_product_differences (φ : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞) (hφ : Measurable φ)
    (hφ1 : ∫⁻ x, φ x = 1) (m n : ℕ) (y : Fin m → ℝ) :
    ∫⁻ z : Fin m → Fin n → ℝ,
      ∏ j, φ (y j) * ∏ i, φ (y j - z j i) = ∏ j, φ (y j)

name: OAI.NoiselessRegression.measure_pi_smul
statement:
lemma measure_pi_smul {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] {X : ι → Type*}
    [∀ i, MeasurableSpace (X i)] (μ : ∀ i, Measure (X i)) [∀ i, SigmaFinite (μ i)]
    (c : ℝ≥0∞) (hc : c ≠ ∞) :
    Measure.pi (fun i => c • μ i) = c ^ Fintype.card ι • Measure.pi μ

name: OAI.NoiselessRegression.orthonormal_gaussian_map
statement:
lemma orthonormal_gaussian_map {n : ℕ} {u : Fin n → E} (hu : Orthonormal ℝ u) :
    (stdGaussian E).map (fun x => fun i => ⟪u i, x⟫) =
      Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => gaussianReal 0 1)

name: OAI.NoiselessRegression.ae_pi_snoc
statement:
lemma ae_pi_snoc {P : (Fin (n+1) → E) → Prop} (hP : MeasurableSet {v | P v}) :
    (∀ᵐ v ∂Measure.pi (fun _ => ν), P v) ↔
      ∀ᵐ v : Fin n → E ∂Measure.pi (fun _ => ν), ∀ᵐ x ∂ν, P (Fin.snoc v x)

name: OAI.NoiselessRegression.ae_replica_linearIndependent
statement:
theorem ae_replica_linearIndependent {ν : Measure E} [IsFiniteMeasure ν]
    {a : ℝ} (hν : HasLocalMassBound ν a)
    (hsupport : ν.support ⊆ Metric.closedBall 0 1) (p : E)
    (n : ℕ) (hmargin : (n : ℝ) ≤ a) :
    ∀ᵐ v : Fin n → E ∂Measure.pi (fun _ => ν),
      LinearIndependent ℝ (fun j => v j - p)

name: OAI.NoiselessRegression.affine_inverse_moment_le_replicaConstant
statement:
lemma affine_inverse_moment_le_replicaConstant {ν : Measure E} [IsFiniteMeasure ν]
    {a : ℝ} (hν : HasLocalMassBound ν a)
    (hsupport : ν.support ⊆ Metric.closedBall 0 1)
    (L : AffineSubspace ℝ E) [Nonempty L] (m : ℕ)
    (hmargin : (Module.finrank ℝ L.direction : ℝ) + (m + 1 : ℕ) ≤ a) :
    ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal ((Metric.infDist x L)⁻¹ ^ m) ∂ν ≤ replicaConstant ν a m

name: OAI.NoiselessRegression.gram_integral_bound
statement:
theorem gram_integral_bound {ν : Measure E} [IsFiniteMeasure ν]
    {a : ℝ} (hν : HasLocalMassBound ν a)
    (hsupport : ν.support ⊆ Metric.closedBall 0 1) (m : ℕ) (p : E)
    (n : ℕ) (hmargin : (n : ℝ) + m ≤ a) :
    ∫⁻ v : Fin n → E, ENNReal.ofReal
      ((Real.sqrt (Matrix.gram ℝ (fun j => v j - p)).det)⁻¹ ^ m)
      ∂Measure.pi (fun _ => ν) ≤ (replicaConstant ν a m)^n

name: OAI.NoiselessRegression.measurable_replicaWeight
statement:
lemma measurable_replicaWeight (m : ℕ) (p : E) (n : ℕ) :

name: OAI.NoiselessRegression.replicaWeight_eq_det
statement:
lemma replicaWeight_eq_det (m : ℕ) (p : E) {n : ℕ} (v : Fin n → E) :
    replicaWeight m p v = ENNReal.ofReal
      ((Real.sqrt (Matrix.gram ℝ (fun j => v j - p)).det)⁻¹ ^ m)

name: OAI.NoiselessRegression.replicaWeight_snoc
statement:
lemma replicaWeight_snoc (m : ℕ) (p : E) {n : ℕ} (v : Fin n → E) (x : E) :
    replicaWeight m p (Fin.snoc v x) = replicaWeight m p v *
      ENNReal.ofReal ((Metric.infDist x (AffineSubspace.mk' p
        (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range (fun i => v i - p))) : Set E))⁻¹ ^ m)

name: OAI.NoiselessRegression.replica_integral_bound
statement:
theorem replica_integral_bound {ν : Measure E} [IsFiniteMeasure ν]
    {a : ℝ} (hν : HasLocalMassBound ν a)
    (hsupport : ν.support ⊆ Metric.closedBall 0 1) (m : ℕ) (p : E)
    (n : ℕ) (hmargin : (n : ℝ) + m ≤ a) :
    ∫⁻ v : Fin n → E, replicaWeight m p v ∂Measure.pi (fun _ => ν) ≤
      (replicaConstant ν a m) ^ n

name: OAI.NoiselessRegression.ennreal_rpow_iInf
statement:
lemma ennreal_rpow_iInf {ι : Sort*} (f : ι → ℝ≥0∞) {α : ℝ} (hα : 0 < α) :
    (⨅ i, f i)^α = ⨅ i, (f i)^α

name: OAI.NoiselessRegression.lintegral_gaussian_shift_scale
statement:
lemma lintegral_gaussian_shift_scale (m : ℕ) (δ : ℝ) (hδ : δ ≠ 0)
    (a : Fin m → ℝ) (f : (Fin m → ℝ) → ℝ≥0∞) (hf : Measurable f) :
    ∫⁻ u : Fin m → ℝ, f (fun j => a j + δ * u j)
      ∂Measure.pi (fun _ => gaussianReal 0 1) =
    ∫⁻ y : Fin m → ℝ, (∏ j, gaussianPDF 0 (NNReal.mk (δ^2) (sq_nonneg δ)) (y j - a j)) * f y

name: OAI.NoiselessRegression.map_apply_open_le_of_tendsto
statement:
lemma map_apply_open_le_of_tendsto (F : X → Y) (Fₖ : ℕ → X → Y)
    (hF : Measurable F) (hFₖ : ∀ k, Measurable (Fₖ k))
    (ht : ∀ x, Tendsto (fun k => Fₖ k x) atTop (𝓝 (F x)))
    (C : ℝ≥0∞) (α : ℝ)
    (hbound : ∀ k U, IsOpen U → (ρ.map (Fₖ k)) U ≤ C * (τ U)^α)

name: OAI.NoiselessRegression.measurable_projectionSmoothing

name: OAI.NoiselessRegression.measure_apply_le_of_isOpen
statement:
lemma measure_apply_le_of_isOpen (μ τ : Measure Y) [τ.OuterRegular]
    {C : ℝ≥0∞} (hC : C ≠ ∞) {α : ℝ} (hα : 0 < α)

name: OAI.NoiselessRegression.measure_pi_withDensity
statement:
lemma measure_pi_withDensity (n : ℕ) (f : Fin n → X → ℝ≥0∞)
    (hf : ∀ i, Measurable (f i)) [∀ i, SigmaFinite (μ.withDensity (f i))] :
    Measure.pi (fun i => μ.withDensity (f i)) =
      (Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => μ)).withDensity (fun x => ∏ i, f i (x i))

name: OAI.NoiselessRegression.pi_gaussian_map_scale
statement:
lemma pi_gaussian_map_scale (m : ℕ) (δ : ℝ) :
    (Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin m => gaussianReal 0 1)).map
      (fun u => fun j => δ * u j) =
      Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin m => gaussianReal 0 (NNReal.mk (δ^2) (sq_nonneg δ)))

name: OAI.NoiselessRegression.pi_gaussian_withDensity
statement:
lemma pi_gaussian_withDensity (m : ℕ) (v : ℝ≥0) (hv : v ≠ 0) :
    Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin m => gaussianReal 0 v) =
      (volume : Measure (Fin m → ℝ)).withDensity (fun y => ∏ j, gaussianPDF 0 v (y j))

name: OAI.NoiselessRegression.projectionSmoothing_pow
statement:
lemma projectionSmoothing_pow (ν : Measure E) [SigmaFinite ν]
    (φ : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞) (hφ : Measurable φ) (m n : ℕ)
    (z : (Fin m → E) × (Fin m → ℝ)) :
    (projectionSmoothing ν φ m z)^(n+1) =
      ∫⁻ w : E × (Fin n → E),
        (∏ j, φ (z.2 j - ⟪w.1, z.1 j⟫)) *
          ∏ i, ∏ j, φ (z.2 j - ⟪w.2 i, z.1 j⟫)
        ∂ν.prod (Measure.pi (fun _ => ν))

name: OAI.NoiselessRegression.withDensity_apply_le_moment
statement:
lemma withDensity_apply_le_moment (f : X → ℝ≥0∞) (hf : Measurable f)
    {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 < p) {C : ℝ≥0∞}
    (hC : ∫⁻ x, f x ^ p ∂μ ≤ C) (S : Set X) (hS : MeasurableSet S) :
    μ.withDensity f S ≤ C^(1/p) * (μ S)^(1 - 1/p)

name: OAI.NoiselessRegression.gaussianCoupling_map_noisyObservation
statement:
lemma gaussianCoupling_map_noisyObservation (ν : Measure E) [SigmaFinite ν]
    (m : ℕ) (δ : ℝ) (hδ : δ ≠ 0) :
    (gaussianCoupling ν m).map (noisyObservation m δ) =
      (matrixLabelReference (E := E) m).withDensity

lemma gaussianCoupling_map_noisyObservation_zero (ν : Measure E) [SigmaFinite ν] (m : ℕ) :

name: OAI.NoiselessRegression.continuous_coordinateNorm

name: OAI.NoiselessRegression.gaussianPDF_le_exp

name: OAI.NoiselessRegression.lintegral_quarterGaussian_le
statement:

statement:
theorem AmbientGrowth.mixed_inverse_le {μ : Measure E} {n m r : ℕ} {B D : ℝ}
    (hBμ : AmbientGrowth μ (m+r) B) (hDμ : AmbientGrowth μ n D)
    (hB : 0 < B) (hD : 0 < D) (hr : 1 ≤ r) (hn : m+r < n)
    (V : Submodule ℝ E) (s : E) (hmargin : Module.finrank ℝ V + (m+1) ≤ m+r)
    (hsupp : ∀ᵐ u ∂μ, ‖u-s‖ ≤ 2) :
    ∫⁻ u, mixedInverse s V m r u ∂μ ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (4 * shellConstant (Module.finrank ℝ V) n m r *
        B * (1 + max (Real.log (D/B)) 0))

name: OAI.CurrentProjection.AmbientGrowth.radial_tube
statement:
theorem AmbientGrowth.radial_tube {μ : Measure E} {a : ℕ} {A : ℝ}
    (hμ : AmbientGrowth μ a A) (V : Submodule ℝ E) (s : E)
    {R η : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R) (hη : 0 < η) (hη1 : η ≤ 1) :
    μ {u | ‖u - s‖ ≤ R ∧ Metric.infDist (u - s) (V : Set E) ≤ η * R} ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal ((3 / η) ^ Module.finrank ℝ V * (A * (2 * (η * R)) ^ a))

name: OAI.CurrentProjection.AmbientGrowth.radial_tube_pow
statement:
lemma AmbientGrowth.radial_tube_pow {μ : Measure E} {a : ℕ} {A : ℝ}
    (hμ : AmbientGrowth μ a A) (hA : 0 ≤ A) (V : Submodule ℝ E) (s : E)
    (k : ℕ) (hmargin : Module.finrank ℝ V + k ≤ a)
    {R η : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R) (hη : 0 < η) (hη1 : η ≤ 1) :
    μ {u | ‖u - s‖ ≤ R ∧ Metric.infDist (u - s) (V : Set E) ≤ η * R} ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (3 ^ Module.finrank ℝ V * 2 ^ a * A * R ^ a) *
        ENNReal.ofReal (η ^ k)

name: OAI.CurrentProjection.AmbientGrowth.shell_mixed_inverse
statement:
theorem AmbientGrowth.shell_mixed_inverse {μ : Measure E} {a m r : ℕ} {A : ℝ}
    (hμ : AmbientGrowth μ a A) (hA : 0 ≤ A) (V : Submodule ℝ E) (s : E)
    (hmargin : Module.finrank ℝ V + (m+1) ≤ a) (hdegree : m+r ≤ a)
    {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R) :
    ∫⁻ u in radialShell s R, mixedInverse s V m r u ∂μ ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (shellConstant (Module.finrank ℝ V) a m r * A * R ^ (a-(m+r)))

name: OAI.CurrentProjection.AmbientGrowth.shell_normalized_inverse
statement:
theorem AmbientGrowth.shell_normalized_inverse {μ : Measure E} {a m : ℕ} {A : ℝ}
    (hμ : AmbientGrowth μ a A) (hA : 0 ≤ A) (V : Submodule ℝ E) (s : E)
    (hmargin : Module.finrank ℝ V + (m+1) ≤ a) {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R) :
    ∫⁻ u in radialShell s R,
      ENNReal.ofReal (((Metric.infDist (u-s) (V : Set E) / R)⁻¹) ^ m) ∂μ ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal ((1 + 3 ^ Module.finrank ℝ V * 2 ^ (a+m+1)) * A * R ^ a)

name: OAI.CurrentProjection.exists_radial_tube_cover
statement:
theorem exists_radial_tube_cover (V : Submodule ℝ E) (s : E)
    {R η : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R) (hη : 0 < η) (hη1 : η ≤ 1) :
    ∃ t : Finset V, (t.card : ℝ) ≤ (3 / η) ^ Module.finrank ℝ V ∧
      ∀ u : E, ‖u - s‖ ≤ R → Metric.infDist (u - s) (V : Set E) ≤ η * R →
        ∃ y ∈ t, dist u (s + R • (y : E)) ≤ 2 * (η * R)

name: OAI.CurrentProjection.messagePosterior_refinement
statement:
lemma messagePosterior_refinement {S W E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace S] [MeasurableSpace W]
    [MeasurableSpace E] [StandardBorelSpace S] [Nonempty S]
    [MeasurableSingletonClass W] [MeasurableSingletonClass E]
    (P : Measure (S×W)) [IsFiniteMeasure P] (e : S×W → E) (he : Measurable e)
    {w : W} {v : E} (hv : (refineSignal P e).snd {(w,v)} ≠ 0) :
    messagePosterior (refineSignal P e) (w,v) =
      (messagePosterior P w {x | e (x,w) = v})⁻¹ •
        (messagePosterior P w).restrict {x | e (x,w) = v}

name: OAI.CurrentProjection.mixed_entropy_log_bound
statement:
lemma mixed_entropy_log_bound {A X Z : Type*} [MeasurableSpace A] [MeasurableSpace X]
    [MeasurableSpace Z] (P : Measure (A×X)) [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    (γ : Measure X) (η : Measure Z) [IsProbabilityMeasure γ] [IsProbabilityMeasure η]
    (hKL : klDiv P (P.fst.prod γ) ≠ ∞)
    (K : (A×X)×Z → ℝ≥0∞) (hKm : Measurable K) (hKt : ∀ z, K z ≠ ∞)
    (hKint : ∀ ax, ∫⁻ z, K (ax,z) ∂η ≠ ∞)
    (C : A → ℝ) (hCm : Measurable C) (hC0 : ∀ a, 0 ≤ C a)
    (hCI : Integrable (fun a => Real.log (1+C a)) P.fst)
    {q : ℕ} (hq : 1 ≤ q)
    (hMoment : ∀ a, ∫⁻ x, (∫⁻ z, K ((a,x),z) ∂η)^q ∂γ ≤ (ENNReal.ofReal (C a))^q) :
    ∫⁻ axz, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.log (1+(K axz).toReal)) ∂P.prod η ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal ((klDiv P (P.fst.prod γ)).toReal / q +
        ∫ a, Real.log (1+C a) ∂P.fst)

lemma conditionalKL_chain {Z A B : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Z] [MeasurableSpace A]

name: OAI.CurrentProjection.criticalClass_cover
statement:
lemma criticalClass_cover {d n ℓ j : ℕ} (F : Measure (Sphere d)) [IsProbabilityMeasure F]
    (D : ℝ) (hD : 0 ≤ D) (hF : LocalGrowth F n D) (hℓ : ℓ < n) (q : ℤ) :
    ∃ s : Finset (Sphere d), (∀ x ∈ s, x ∈ criticalClass F ℓ j q) ∧
      (s.card:ℝ) ≤ Real.exp (1-(q:ℝ)) / criticalRadius j^ℓ ∧
      ∀ x ∈ criticalClass F ℓ j q, ∃ y ∈ s, dist x y ≤ 2*criticalRadius j

    {q : ℤ} {s : Sphere d} (hs : s ∈ criticalClass F ℓ j q) :
    ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp ((q:ℝ)-1) * criticalRadius j^ℓ) ≤
      F {x | dist (x:Vector d) (s:Vector d) ≤ criticalRadius j}

    F {x | dist (x:Vector d) (s:Vector d) ≤ criticalRadius i} ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp q * criticalRadius i^ℓ)

    (s : Finset (Sphere d)) (hs : ∀ x ∈ s, x ∈ criticalClass F ℓ j q)
    (hsep : ∀ x ∈ s, ∀ y ∈ s, x ≠ y → 2 * criticalRadius j < dist x y) :

lemma density_mutualInformation_comparison {Z W : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Z] [MeasurableSpace W]

    (P Q : Measure (Z×W)) [IsProbabilityMeasure P] [IsProbabilityMeasure Q]
    (Λ : Measure Z) [SigmaFinite Λ] (g : Z → ℝ) (hg : Measurable g) (hgpos : ∀ z, 0<g z)

    (p : Z×W → ℝ≥0∞) (hp : Measurable p)
    (hQ : (Λ.prod Q.snd).withDensity p = Q)
    (hfst : P.fst = Q.fst) (hsnd : P.snd = Q.snd) (hPQ : klDiv P Q ≠ ∞)
    (hpP : Integrable (fun z => logPositive (p z)) P)
    (hpQ : Integrable (fun z => logPositive (p z)) Q)
    (hgQ : Integrable (fun z => Real.log (g z)) Q.fst) :
    Integrable (fun z => Real.log (p z).toReal) P ∧
    Integrable (fun z => Real.log (p z).toReal) Q ∧
    mutualInformation P ≠ ∞ ∧ mutualInformation Q ≠ ∞ ∧
    (mutualInformation P).toReal = (mutualInformation Q).toReal + (klDiv P Q).toReal +
      (∫ z, Real.log (p z).toReal ∂P) - (∫ z, Real.log (p z).toReal ∂Q)

name: OAI.CurrentProjection.weightedCauchyCross_integral_bound

lemma weightedCauchyCross_integral_bound {d : ℕ} (μ : Measure (Sphere d)) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]

    (∫ x, ∫ t, regularizedReciprocal e s t *
      (sphereCauchyCross e s t x + Real.log (regularizedReciprocal e s t)) ∂μ
      ∂gaussianVectorPair d) ≤ regularizedScale μ e s * cauchyTiltConstant

name: OAI.CurrentProjection.cauchyMixture_experiment_bound

name: OAI.CurrentProjection.mixed_entropy_log_bound_ae
statement:
lemma mixed_entropy_log_bound_ae {A X Z : Type*} [MeasurableSpace A] [MeasurableSpace X]
    [MeasurableSpace Z] (P : Measure (A×X)) [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    (γ : Measure X) (η : Measure Z) [IsProbabilityMeasure γ] [IsProbabilityMeasure η]
    (hKL : klDiv P (P.fst.prod γ) ≠ ∞)
    (K : (A×X)×Z → ℝ≥0∞) (hKm : Measurable K) (hKt : ∀ z, K z ≠ ∞)
    (hKint : ∀ ax, ∫⁻ z, K (ax,z) ∂η ≠ ∞)
    (C : A → ℝ) (hCm : Measurable C) (hC0 : ∀ a, 0 ≤ C a)
    (hCI : Integrable (fun a => Real.log (1+C a)) P.fst)
    {q : ℕ} (hq : 1 ≤ q)
    (hMoment : ∀ᵐ a ∂P.fst, ∫⁻ x, (∫⁻ z, K ((a,x),z) ∂η)^q ∂γ ≤ (ENNReal.ofReal (C a))^q) :
    ∫⁻ axz, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.log (1+(K axz).toReal)) ∂P.prod η ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal ((klDiv P (P.fst.prod γ)).toReal / q +
        ∫ a, Real.log (1+C a) ∂P.fst)

lemma scalarCube_projection {d : ℕ} {C : Type*} [MeasurableSpace C]
    (κ : Kernel C (Sphere d)) [IsSFiniteKernel κ] (z : C×Vector d) (s : Sphere d) (δ : ℝ) :
    scalarCube (scalarProjectionKernel κ z) ⟪(s:Vector d),z.2⟫ δ =
      ∫⁻ t : Sphere d, cubeKernel δ ⟪(t:Vector d)-(s:Vector d),z.2⟫ ∂κ z.1

statement:
lemma vectorSmoothing_pow (ν : Measure E) [IsFiniteMeasure ν]
    (m n : ℕ) (φ : (Fin m → ℝ) → ℝ≥0∞) (hφ : Measurable φ)
    (z : (Fin m → E) × (Fin m → ℝ)) :
    (vectorSmoothing ν m φ z)^(n+1) =
      ∫⁻ w : E × (Fin n → E),
        φ (fun j => z.2 j - ⟪w.1, z.1 j⟫) *
          ∏ i, φ (fun j => z.2 j - ⟪w.2 i, z.1 j⟫)
        ∂ν.prod (Measure.pi (fun _ => ν))

statement:
lemma frame_cost_root {d m n : ℕ} (hd : 1 ≤ d) (hm : m ≤ d)
    (a K R : ℝ) (hK : 0 ≤ K) (hR : 0 < R) {v : ℝ≥0∞}
    (h : v ≤ (2 : ℝ≥0∞)^m * ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt (2*d))^(m*n) *
      (ENNReal.ofReal (K*R^(a-m))^(n+1) * ENNReal.ofReal (R^m) *
        (128 : ℝ≥0∞)^(d*n))) :

      ENNReal.ofReal ((256 : ℝ)^d * (256*Real.sqrt d)^((m:ℝ)*(1-1/((n:ℝ)+1))) * K *
        R^(a-(m:ℝ)*(1-1/((n:ℝ)+1))))
