name: OAI.ProjectionMoments.rawPolarRows_orthonormal
statement:
lemma rawPolarRows_orthonormal {k : ℕ} {X : Fin k → E} (hX : LinearIndependent ℝ X) :
    Orthonormal ℝ (rawPolarRows X)

name: OAI.ProjectionMoments.rawPolarRows_rotateRows
statement:
lemma rawPolarRows_rotateRows {k : ℕ} (X : Fin k → E) (O : Rotation E) :
    rawPolarRows (rotateRows O X) = rotateRows O (rawPolarRows X)

name: OAI.ProjectionMoments.unit_ball_volume_bound
statement:
lemma unit_ball_volume_bound (k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) :
    (volume : Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k))) (Metric.ball 0 1) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal ((6 / Real.sqrt k)^k)

name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.Polar.introducing_radius
statement:
lemma introducing_radius :
    MeasurePreserving
      (fun z : Metric.sphere (0 : E) 1 × Ioi (0 : ℝ) => z.2.val • z.1.val)
      ((volume : Measure E).toSphere.prod (Measure.volumeIoiPow (Module.finrank ℝ E-1)))
      volume

name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.Polar.lintegral_polar
statement:
lemma lintegral_polar (f : E → ℝ≥0∞) (hf : Measurable f) :
    (∫⁻ x, f x ∂(volume : Measure E)) =
    ∫⁻ s : Metric.sphere (0 : E) 1, ∫⁻ r : Ioi (0 : ℝ), f (r.val • s.val)
      ∂Measure.volumeIoiPow (Module.finrank ℝ E-1) ∂(volume : Measure E).toSphere

name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.Polar.measurable_radial
statement:
lemma measurable_radial {g : Metric.sphere (0 : E) 1 → ℝ≥0∞} (hg : Measurable g) :
    Measurable (radial g)

name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.Polar.orthogonal_sum_volume
statement:
lemma orthogonal_sum_volume (H : Submodule ℝ E) :
    MeasurePreserving (fun z : H × Hᗮ => (z.1 : E)+(z.2 : E))
      ((volume : Measure H).prod (volume : Measure Hᗮ)) volume

name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.Polar.orthogonal_volume_ratio
statement:
lemma orthogonal_volume_ratio (K : Submodule ℝ E) :
    (volume : Measure K) (Metric.ball 0 1) *
      (volume : Measure Kᗮ) (Metric.ball 0 1) ≤
        (2 : ℝ≥0∞)^Module.finrank ℝ E * (volume : Measure E) (Metric.ball 0 1)

name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.Polar.radial_ball_integral
statement:
lemma radial_ball_integral {g : Metric.sphere (0 : E) 1 → ℝ≥0∞} (hg : Measurable g) :
    (∫⁻ x in Metric.ball (0 : E) 1, radial g x ∂volume) =
      (volume (Metric.ball (0 : E) 1)) * ∫⁻ s, g s ∂Affine.sphereLaw E

name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.Polar.radial_smul
statement:
lemma radial_smul (g : Metric.sphere (0 : E) 1 → ℝ≥0∞)
    (s : Metric.sphere (0 : E) 1) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) : radial g (r • s.val) = g s

name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.Polar.radius_inverse_density
statement:
lemma radius_inverse_density (k b : ℕ) (hb : b+1 ≤ k) :
    (Measure.volumeIoiPow (k-1)).withDensity
      (fun r : Ioi (0 : ℝ) => (ENNReal.ofReal (r.val^b))⁻¹) =
        Measure.volumeIoiPow (k-b-1)

name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.Polar.radius_inverse_integral
statement:
lemma radius_inverse_integral (k b : ℕ) (hb : b+1 ≤ k) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) :
    (∫⁻ r in Iio (⟨t,ht⟩ : Ioi (0 : ℝ)), (ENNReal.ofReal (r.val^b))⁻¹
      ∂Measure.volumeIoiPow (k-1)) = ENNReal.ofReal (t^(k-b)/((k-b : ℕ) : ℝ))

name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.Quarter.exists_even_turn
statement:
lemma exists_even_turn {k : ℕ} (hk : Module.finrank ℝ E = k+k) :
    ∃ e : E ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E, (∀ x, ⟪x,e x⟫ = 0) ∧ (∀ x, e (e x) = -x)

name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.Quarter.exists_small_fixed
statement:
lemma exists_small_fixed (U : Submodule ℝ E) :
    ∃ F : Submodule ℝ E, F ≤ Uᗮ ∧
      Module.finrank ℝ Fᗮ ≤ Module.finrank ℝ U + 1 ∧
      ∃ e : F ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] F, (∀ x, ⟪x,e x⟫ = 0) ∧ (∀ x, e (e x) = -x)

name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.Quarter.extend_apply
statement:
lemma extend_apply (F : Submodule ℝ E) (e : F ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] F) (x : E) :
    extend F e x = (e (F.orthogonalProjectionOnto x) : E) + Fᗮ.starProjection x

name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.Quarter.extend_fixed
statement:
lemma extend_fixed (F : Submodule ℝ E) (e : F ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] F) {x : E} (hx : x ∈ Fᗮ) :
    extend F e x = x

name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.Quarter.extend_norm_sq
statement:
lemma extend_norm_sq (F : Submodule ℝ E) (e : F ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] F) (he : ∀ y, ⟪y,e y⟫ = 0)
    (x : E) : dist x (extend F e x)^2 = 2*‖F.orthogonalProjectionOnto x‖^2

name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.Quarter.extend_square_norm_sq
statement:
lemma extend_square_norm_sq (F : Submodule ℝ E) (e : F ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] F)
    (he : ∀ y, e (e y) = -y) (x : E) :
    dist x (extend F e (extend F e x))^2 = 4*‖F.orthogonalProjectionOnto x‖^2

name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.Quarter.subspace_dimension
statement:
lemma subspace_dimension (U : Submodule ℝ E) {k : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ Module.finrank ℝ U) :
    ∃ F : Submodule ℝ E, F ≤ U ∧ Module.finrank ℝ F = k

name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.Quarter.twinTurn_inner
statement:
lemma twinTurn_inner (F : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup F] [InnerProductSpace ℝ F]
    (x : WithLp 2 (F × F)) : ⟪x,twinTurn F x⟫ = 0

name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.Quarter.twinTurn_square
statement:
lemma twinTurn_square (F : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup F] [InnerProductSpace ℝ F]
    (x : WithLp 2 (F × F)) : twinTurn F (twinTurn F x) = -x

name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.Slice.Test.measurable_point
statement: lemma Test.measurable_point {k : ℕ} (A : Test E k) : Measurable A.point

name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.Slice.angular_ballCap_bound
statement:
lemma angular_ballCap_bound {g : Metric.sphere (0 : E) 1 → ℝ≥0∞} {k b : ℕ} {C : ℝ≥0∞}
    (hc : Controlled g k b C) (K : Submodule ℝ E) [Nontrivial K]
    (hK : Module.finrank ℝ K = k) {z x : E} (hz : z ∈ Kᗮ) (hx : x ∈ Kᗮ)
    {r t : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) :
    (∫⁻ s : Metric.sphere (0 : K) 1, ballCap g z t (x+r • (s.val : E))
      ∂(volume : Measure K).toSphere) ≤
        (if ‖x‖ < 1 ∧ r < t then
          ((volume : Measure K).toSphere univ) * C * (ENNReal.ofReal (r^b))⁻¹ else 0)

name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.Slice.ballCap_integral
statement:
lemma ballCap_integral {g : Metric.sphere (0 : E) 1 → ℝ≥0∞} (hg : Measurable g)
    {k b : ℕ} {C : ℝ≥0∞} (hc : Controlled g k b C)
    (K : Submodule ℝ E) [Nontrivial K] (hK : Module.finrank ℝ K = k)
    (hb : b+1 ≤ k) {z : E} (hz : z ∈ Kᗮ) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) :
    (∫⁻ y : E, ballCap g z t y ∂volume) ≤
      ((volume : Measure K).toSphere univ) * C *
        ENNReal.ofReal (t^(k-b)/((k-b : ℕ) : ℝ)) *
          (volume : Measure Kᗮ) (Metric.ball 0 1)

name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.Slice.ballCap_le
statement:
lemma ballCap_le (g : Metric.sphere (0 : E) 1 → ℝ≥0∞) (z : E) (t : ℝ) (x : E) :
    ballCap g z t x ≤ Polar.radial g x

name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.Slice.ballCap_support
statement:
lemma ballCap_support (g : Metric.sphere (0 : E) 1 → ℝ≥0∞)
    (K : Submodule ℝ E) {z x : E} (hz : z ∈ Kᗮ) (hx : x ∈ Kᗮ)
    {r t : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (s : Metric.sphere (0 : K) 1)
    (hnz : ballCap g z t (x+r • (s.val : E)) ≠ 0) :
    ‖x‖ < 1 ∧ r < t ∧ radiusNorm x r < 1

name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.Slice.controlled_cap_bound
statement:
lemma controlled_cap_bound {g : Metric.sphere (0 : E) 1 → ℝ≥0∞} (hg : Measurable g)
    {k b : ℕ} {C : ℝ≥0∞} (hc : Controlled g k b C)
    (K : Submodule ℝ E) [Nontrivial K] (hK : Module.finrank ℝ K = k)
    (hb : b+1 ≤ k) (h2b : 2*b ≤ k) {z : E} (hz : z ∈ Kᗮ) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) :
    (∫⁻ s, capFunction g z t s ∂Affine.sphereLaw E) ≤
      (2 : ℝ≥0∞)^(Module.finrank ℝ E+1) * C * ENNReal.ofReal (t^(k-b))

name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.Slice.measurable_ballCap
statement:
lemma measurable_ballCap {g : Metric.sphere (0 : E) 1 → ℝ≥0∞}
    (hg : Measurable g) (z : E) (t : ℝ) : Measurable (ballCap g z t)

name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.Slice.measurable_capFunction
statement:
lemma measurable_capFunction {g : Metric.sphere (0 : E) 1 → ℝ≥0∞}
    (hg : Measurable g) (z : E) (t : ℝ) : Measurable (capFunction g z t)

name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.Slice.norm_eq_radiusNorm
statement:
lemma norm_eq_radiusNorm (K : Submodule ℝ E) {x : E} (hx : x ∈ Kᗮ)
    (s : Metric.sphere (0 : K) 1) (r : ℝ) : ‖x+r • (s.val : E)‖ = radiusNorm x r

name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.Slice.orthogonal_radius_norm
statement:
lemma orthogonal_radius_norm (K : Submodule ℝ E) {x : E} (hx : x ∈ Kᗮ)
    (s : Metric.sphere (0 : K) 1) (r : ℝ) :
    ‖x+r • (s.val : E)‖^2 = ‖x‖^2+r^2

name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.Slice.radial_on_slice
statement:
lemma radial_on_slice (g : Metric.sphere (0 : E) 1 → ℝ≥0∞)
    (K : Submodule ℝ E) {x : E} (hx : x ∈ Kᗮ) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r)
    (s : Metric.sphere (0 : K) 1) :
    Polar.radial g (x+r • (s.val : E)) = g ((scaledTest K hx r hr).point s)

name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.Slice.radial_slice_bound
statement:
lemma radial_slice_bound {g : Metric.sphere (0 : E) 1 → ℝ≥0∞} {k b : ℕ} {C : ℝ≥0∞}
    (hc : Controlled g k b C) (K : Submodule ℝ E) (hK : Module.finrank ℝ K = k)
    {x : E} (hx : x ∈ Kᗮ) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (hsmall : radiusNorm x r ≤ 1) :
    (∫⁻ s : Metric.sphere (0 : K) 1, Polar.radial g (x+r • (s.val : E))
      ∂Affine.sphereLaw K) ≤ C * (ENNReal.ofReal (r^b))⁻¹

name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.Slice.radiusNorm_pos
statement: lemma radiusNorm_pos (x : E) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) : 0 < radiusNorm x r

name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.Slice.radiusNorm_sq
statement: lemma radiusNorm_sq (x : E) (r : ℝ) : radiusNorm x r ^ 2 = ‖x‖^2+r^2

name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.Slice.radius_mass_le
statement:
lemma radius_mass_le (K : Submodule ℝ E) {b : ℕ} (hb : b+1 ≤ Module.finrank ℝ K)
    (h2b : 2*b ≤ Module.finrank ℝ K) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) :
    ((volume : Measure K).toSphere univ) *
      ENNReal.ofReal (t^(Module.finrank ℝ K-b)/((Module.finrank ℝ K-b : ℕ) : ℝ)) ≤
        2 * (volume : Measure K) (Metric.ball 0 1) * ENNReal.ofReal (t^(Module.finrank ℝ K-b))

name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.Slice.sphere_integral_unnormalize
statement:
lemma sphere_integral_unnormalize (g : Metric.sphere (0 : E) 1 → ℝ≥0∞) :
    (∫⁻ s, g s ∂(volume : Measure E).toSphere) =
      ((volume : Measure E).toSphere univ) * (∫⁻ s, g s ∂Affine.sphereLaw E)

name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.Weighted.borel_onTest
statement: lemma borel_onTest {d n : ℕ} (A : Affine.Test d n) : Measurable (onTest A)

name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.Weighted.nestedSpaceEquiv_val
statement:
@[simp] lemma nestedSpaceEquiv_val {d n k : ℕ} (A : Affine.Test d n)
    (B : Slice.Test A.space k) (x : B.space) :
    (nestedSpaceEquiv A B x : Vector d) = (x.val : Vector d)

name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.Weighted.nestedTest_point
statement:
lemma nestedTest_point {d n k : ℕ} (A : Affine.Test d n) (B : Slice.Test A.space k)
    (s : Metric.sphere (0 : B.space) 1) :
    onTest (nestedTest A B) (@Polar.sphereMap B.space (B.space.map A.space.subtype)
      B.space.normedAddCommGroup B.space.innerProductSpace
      (B.space.map A.space.subtype).normedAddCommGroup (B.space.map A.space.subtype).innerProductSpace (nestedSpaceEquiv A B) s) =
      onTest A (B.point s)

name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.Weighted.radius_le_one
statement: lemma radius_le_one {d n : ℕ} (A : Affine.Test d n) : A.radius ≤ 1

name: OAI.SubsphereRegression.HasLocalMassBound.affine_inverse_moment
statement:
theorem HasLocalMassBound.affine_inverse_moment {ν : Measure E} {a : ℝ}
    (hν : HasLocalMassBound ν a) (hsupport : ν.support ⊆ Metric.closedBall 0 1)
    (L : AffineSubspace ℝ E) [Nonempty L] (m : ℕ)
    (hmargin : (Module.finrank ℝ L.direction : ℝ) + (m + 1 : ℕ) ≤ a) :
    ∫⁻ t, ENNReal.ofReal ((Metric.infDist t L)⁻¹ ^ m) ∂ν ≤
      ν Set.univ +
        ENNReal.ofReal ((3 : ℝ) ^ Module.finrank ℝ L.direction * (4 : ℝ) ^ a) *
          (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ (m + 1)

name: OAI.SubsphereRegression.HasLocalMassBound.affine_null
statement:
theorem HasLocalMassBound.affine_null {ν : Measure E} {a : ℝ}
    (hν : HasLocalMassBound ν a) (hsupport : ν.support ⊆ Metric.closedBall 0 1)
    (L : AffineSubspace ℝ E) [Nonempty L]
    (hmargin : (Module.finrank ℝ L.direction : ℝ) + 1 ≤ a) : ν L = 0

name: OAI.SubsphereRegression.HasLocalMassBound.affine_tube
statement:
theorem HasLocalMassBound.affine_tube {ν : Measure E} {a : ℝ}
    (hν : HasLocalMassBound ν a) (hsupport : ν.support ⊆ Metric.closedBall 0 1)
    (L : AffineSubspace ℝ E) [Nonempty L] {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (hr1 : r ≤ 1) :
    ν {t | Metric.infDist t L ≤ r} ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal ((3 / r) ^ Module.finrank ℝ L.direction * (4 * r) ^ a)

name: OAI.SubsphereRegression.HasLocalMassBound.affine_tube_pow
statement:
theorem HasLocalMassBound.affine_tube_pow {ν : Measure E} {a : ℝ}
    (hν : HasLocalMassBound ν a) (hsupport : ν.support ⊆ Metric.closedBall 0 1)
    (L : AffineSubspace ℝ E) [Nonempty L] (k : ℕ)
    (hmargin : (Module.finrank ℝ L.direction : ℝ) + k ≤ a)
    {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (hr1 : r ≤ 1) :
    ν {t | Metric.infDist t L ≤ r} ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal ((3 : ℝ) ^ Module.finrank ℝ L.direction * (4 : ℝ) ^ a) *
        ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ k)

name: OAI.SubsphereRegression.HasLocalMassBound.any_center
OAI.SubsphereRegression.card_le_volume_ratio
statement:
theorem card_le_volume_ratio (s : Finset E) {r R : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    (hs : ∀ x ∈ s, ‖x‖ ≤ R)
    (hsep : ∀ x ∈ s, ∀ y ∈ s, x ≠ y → r ≤ dist x y) :
    (s.card : ℝ) ≤ ((R + r / 2) / (r / 2)) ^ Module.finrank ℝ E

name: OAI.SubsphereRegression.dyadic_power_cancel
statement:
lemma dyadic_power_cancel (m k : ℕ) :
    (2 : ℝ) ^ (m * (k + 1)) * ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ k) ^ (m + 1) =
      (2 : ℝ) ^ m * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ k

name: OAI.SubsphereRegression.exists_affine_tube_cover
statement:
theorem exists_affine_tube_cover (L : AffineSubspace ℝ E) [Nonempty L]
    {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (hr1 : r ≤ 1) :
    ∃ s : Finset L.direction,
      (s.card : ℝ) ≤ (3 / r) ^ Module.finrank ℝ L.direction ∧
      ∀ t : E, ‖t‖ ≤ 1 → Metric.infDist t L ≤ r →
        ∃ y ∈ s, dist t ((y : E) + (orthogonalProjection L 0 : E)) ≤ 2 * r

name: OAI.SubsphereRegression.exists_net_of_finite_packing_bound
statement:
theorem exists_net_of_finite_packing_bound (A : Set E) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) (N : ℕ)
    (hcard : ∀ s : Finset E, (∀ x ∈ s, x ∈ A) →
      (∀ x ∈ s, ∀ y ∈ s, x ≠ y → r < dist x y) → s.card ≤ N) :
    ∃ s : Finset E, (∀ x ∈ s, x ∈ A) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ s, ∀ y ∈ s, x ≠ y → r < dist x y) ∧
      ∀ x ∈ A, ∃ y ∈ s, dist x y ≤ r

name: OAI.SubsphereRegression.exists_unit_ball_net
statement:
theorem exists_unit_ball_net {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (hr1 : r ≤ 1) :
    ∃ s : Finset E, (∀ x ∈ s, ‖x‖ ≤ 1) ∧
      (s.card : ℝ) ≤ (3 / r) ^ Module.finrank ℝ E ∧
      ∀ x : E, ‖x‖ ≤ 1 → ∃ y ∈ s, dist x y ≤ r

name: OAI.SubsphereRegression.inverse_moment_of_tube_bound
statement:
theorem inverse_moment_of_tube_bound (μ : Measure X) (f : X → ℝ) (m : ℕ)
    (hf : Measurable f) (hnonneg : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x) (C : ℝ≥0∞)
    (htube : ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → r ≤ 1 →
      μ {x | f x ≤ r} ≤ C * ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ (m + 1))) :
    ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal ((f x)⁻¹ ^ m) ∂μ ≤
      μ Set.univ + C * (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ (m + 1)

name: OAI.SubsphereRegression.inverse_pow_dyadic_majorant
statement:
lemma inverse_pow_dyadic_majorant (f : X → ℝ) (m : ℕ) (hf : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x) (x : X) :
    ENNReal.ofReal ((f x)⁻¹ ^ m) ≤
      1 + ∑' k : ℕ, ({x | f x ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ k}).indicator
        (fun _ => ENNReal.ofReal ((2 : ℝ) ^ (m * (k + 1)))) x

name: OAI.SubsphereRegression.tube_radius_factors
statement:
lemma tube_radius_factors (ℓ : ℕ) (a : ℝ) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) :
    (3 / r) ^ ℓ * (4 * r) ^ a =
      (3 : ℝ) ^ ℓ * (4 : ℝ) ^ a * r ^ (a - ℓ)

name: OAI.SubsphereRegression.ae_pi_snoc
statement:
lemma ae_pi_snoc {P : (Fin (n+1) → E) → Prop} (hP : MeasurableSet {v | P v}) :
    (∀ᵐ v ∂Measure.pi (fun _ => ν), P v) ↔
      ∀ᵐ v : Fin n → E ∂Measure.pi (fun _ => ν), ∀ᵐ x ∂ν, P (Fin.snoc v x)

name: OAI.SubsphereRegression.ae_replica_linearIndependent
statement:
theorem ae_replica_linearIndependent {ν : Measure E} [IsFiniteMeasure ν]
    {a : ℝ} (hν : HasLocalMassBound ν a)
    (hsupport : ν.support ⊆ Metric.closedBall 0 1) (p : E)
    (n : ℕ) (hmargin : (n : ℝ) ≤ a) :
    ∀ᵐ v : Fin n → E ∂Measure.pi (fun _ => ν),
      LinearIndependent ℝ (fun j => v j - p)

name: OAI.SubsphereRegression.affine_inverse_moment_le_replicaConstant
statement:
lemma affine_inverse_moment_le_replicaConstant {ν : Measure E} [IsFiniteMeasure ν]
    {a : ℝ} (hν : HasLocalMassBound ν a)
    (hsupport : ν.support ⊆ Metric.closedBall 0 1)
    (L : AffineSubspace ℝ E) [Nonempty L] (m : ℕ)
    (hmargin : (Module.finrank ℝ L.direction : ℝ) + (m + 1 : ℕ) ≤ a) :
    ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal ((Metric.infDist x L)⁻¹ ^ m) ∂ν ≤ replicaConstant ν a m

name: OAI.SubsphereRegression.gram_integral_bound
statement:
theorem gram_integral_bound {ν : Measure E} [IsFiniteMeasure ν]
    {a : ℝ} (hν : HasLocalMassBound ν a)
    (hsupport : ν.support ⊆ Metric.closedBall 0 1) (m : ℕ) (p : E)
    (n : ℕ) (hmargin : (n : ℝ) + m ≤ a) :
    ∫⁻ v : Fin n → E, ENNReal.ofReal
      ((Real.sqrt (Matrix.gram ℝ (fun j => v j - p)).det)⁻¹ ^ m)
      ∂Measure.pi (fun _ => ν) ≤ (replicaConstant ν a m)^n

name: OAI.SubsphereRegression.gram_linear_combination
statement:
lemma gram_linear_combination (w : ι → E) (T : Matrix ι ι ℝ) :
    Matrix.gram ℝ (fun j => ∑ i, (T i j) • w i) =
      T.transpose * Matrix.gram ℝ w * T

name: OAI.SubsphereRegression.gsUpper_det
statement: lemma gsUpper_det (v : Fin n → E) : (gsUpper n v).det = 1

name: OAI.SubsphereRegression.image_Iio_castSucc
statement:
lemma image_Iio_castSucc (v : Fin (n+1) → E) (j : Fin n) :
    v '' Set.Iio j.castSucc = (fun i => v i.castSucc) '' Set.Iio j

name: OAI.SubsphereRegression.image_Iio_last
statement:
lemma image_Iio_last (v : Fin (n+1) → E) :
    v '' Set.Iio (Fin.last n) = Set.range (fun i : Fin n => v i.castSucc)

name: OAI.SubsphereRegression.infDist_affine_mk'
statement:
lemma infDist_affine_mk' (p x : E) (K : Submodule ℝ E) :
    Metric.infDist x (AffineSubspace.mk' p K : Set E) =
      Metric.infDist (x - p) (K : Set E)

name: OAI.SubsphereRegression.lintegral_pi_snoc
statement:
lemma lintegral_pi_snoc (f : (Fin (n+1) → E) → ℝ≥0∞) (hf : Measurable f) :
    ∫⁻ v, f v ∂Measure.pi (fun _ => ν) =
      ∫⁻ v : Fin n → E, ∫⁻ x, f (Fin.snoc v x) ∂ν ∂Measure.pi (fun _ => ν)

name: OAI.SubsphereRegression.measurable_replicaWeight
statement:
lemma measurable_replicaWeight (m : ℕ) (p : E) (n : ℕ) :

name: OAI.SubsphereRegression.replicaWeight_eq_det
statement:
lemma replicaWeight_eq_det (m : ℕ) (p : E) {n : ℕ} (v : Fin n → E) :
    replicaWeight m p v = ENNReal.ofReal
      ((Real.sqrt (Matrix.gram ℝ (fun j => v j - p)).det)⁻¹ ^ m)

name: OAI.SubsphereRegression.replicaWeight_snoc
statement:
lemma replicaWeight_snoc (m : ℕ) (p : E) {n : ℕ} (v : Fin n → E) (x : E) :
    replicaWeight m p (Fin.snoc v x) = replicaWeight m p v *
      ENNReal.ofReal ((Metric.infDist x (AffineSubspace.mk' p
        (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range (fun i => v i - p))) : Set E))⁻¹ ^ m)

name: OAI.SubsphereRegression.replica_integral_bound
statement:
theorem replica_integral_bound {ν : Measure E} [IsFiniteMeasure ν]
    {a : ℝ} (hν : HasLocalMassBound ν a)
    (hsupport : ν.support ⊆ Metric.closedBall 0 1) (m : ℕ) (p : E)
    (n : ℕ) (hmargin : (n : ℝ) + m ≤ a) :
    ∫⁻ v : Fin n → E, replicaWeight m p v ∂Measure.pi (fun _ => ν) ≤
      (replicaConstant ν a m) ^ n

name: OAI.SubsphereRegression.ennreal_rpow_iInf
statement:
lemma ennreal_rpow_iInf {ι : Sort*} (f : ι → ℝ≥0∞) {α : ℝ} (hα : 0 < α) :

name: OAI.SubsphereRegression.gaussianReal_le_volume

name: OAI.SubsphereRegression.lintegral_fin_prod
statement:
lemma lintegral_fin_prod (n : ℕ) (f : Fin n → X → ℝ≥0∞) (hf : ∀ i, Measurable (f i)) :
    ∫⁻ x : Fin n → X, ∏ i, f i (x i) ∂Measure.pi (fun _ => μ) =

name: OAI.SubsphereRegression.lintegral_gaussian_shift_scale
statement:
lemma lintegral_gaussian_shift_scale (m : ℕ) (δ : ℝ) (hδ : δ ≠ 0)
    (a : Fin m → ℝ) (f : (Fin m → ℝ) → ℝ≥0∞) (hf : Measurable f) :
    ∫⁻ u : Fin m → ℝ, f (fun j => a j + δ * u j)
      ∂Measure.pi (fun _ => gaussianReal 0 1) =
    ∫⁻ y : Fin m → ℝ, (∏ j, gaussianPDF 0 (NNReal.mk (δ^2) (sq_nonneg δ)) (y j - a j)) * f y

name: OAI.SubsphereRegression.lintegral_pow_pi

lemma lintegral_pow_pi (f : X → ℝ≥0∞) (hf : Measurable f) (n : ℕ) :

name: OAI.SubsphereRegression.lintegral_product_differences
statement:
lemma lintegral_product_differences (φ : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞) (hφ : Measurable φ)

name: OAI.SubsphereRegression.projectionSmoothing_pow
statement:
lemma projectionSmoothing_pow (ν : Measure E) [SigmaFinite ν]
    (φ : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞) (hφ : Measurable φ) (m n : ℕ)
    (z : (Fin m → E) × (Fin m → ℝ)) :
    (projectionSmoothing ν φ m z)^(n+1) =
      ∫⁻ w : E × (Fin n → E),
        (∏ j, φ (z.2 j - ⟪w.1, z.1 j⟫)) *
          ∏ i, ∏ j, φ (z.2 j - ⟪w.2 i, z.1 j⟫)
        ∂ν.prod (Measure.pi (fun _ => ν))

lemma angularSuccess_eq_integral_tape (L : Stream E J T) (hL : L.BorelRules)

name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.Fixed.Stream.average_euclideanSuccess_le_one
statement:
lemma average_euclideanSuccess_le_one [Nontrivial E] (L : Stream E J T) (η : ℝ) :

      ∂(sphereLaw E).prod (rowsLaw E T)) ≤ 1

name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.Fixed.Stream.average_euclideanSuccess_zero_bound
statement:
lemma average_euclideanSuccess_zero_bound [Nontrivial E] (L : Stream E J 0) (hL : L.BorelRules)

    (∫⁻ z : Sphere E × (Fin 0 → E), L.euclideanSuccess η z.1.val z.2
      ∂(sphereLaw E).prod (rowsLaw E 0)) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal ((3 : ℝ)*4^Module.finrank ℝ E) *

name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.Fixed.Stream.euclideanSuccess_eq_integral_tape

name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.Fixed.Stream.measurable_detChain_param
statement:

name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.Fixed.Stream.run_eq_bind_chain
statement:
lemma run_eq_bind_chain (L : Stream E J T) (s : E) (x : Fin T → E) (n : ℕ) :

name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.Fixed.Stream.stepDet_map
statement:
lemma stepDet_map (L : Stream E J T) (s : E) (x : Fin T → E) (n : ℕ) (q : J) :

name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.Fixed.Stream.stepDet_measurable

name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.Fixed.Stream.streamRoute_eq_detChain
statement:
lemma streamRoute_eq_detChain (L : Stream E J T) (s : E) (ω : Tape E J T)
    (x : Fin T → E) {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≤ T) :
    SubsphereRegression.streamRoute (L.tapeTransition ω) 0 n ω.1
      ((fun i => x (Fin.castLE hn i)), fun i => ⟪s,x (Fin.castLE hn i)⟫) =
      detChain (L.stepDet s x) ω.1 n (fun i => ω.2.1 (Fin.castLE hn i))

name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.Fixed.Stream.tapeEstimate_eq_route
statement:
lemma tapeEstimate_eq_route (L : Stream E J T) (s : E) (ω : Tape E J T) (x : Fin T → E) :
    L.tapeEstimate s ω x = ω.2.2
      (SubsphereRegression.streamRoute (L.tapeTransition ω) 0 T ω.1 (x,fun i => ⟪s,x i⟫))

statement:
lemma gaussian_orthogonal_rows {E : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E] (H : Submodule ℝ E) (T : ℕ) :
    MeasurePreserving (fun z : (Fin T → H) × (Fin T → Hᗮ) =>
      fun i => (z.1 i : E) + (z.2 i : E))
      ((Measure.pi (fun _ => stdGaussian H)).prod (Measure.pi (fun _ => stdGaussian Hᗮ)))
      (Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin T => stdGaussian E))

statement:
lemma gaussian_orthogonal_sum {E : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]

    MeasurePreserving (fun z : H × Hᗮ => (z.1 : E) + (z.2 : E))
      ((stdGaussian H).prod (stdGaussian Hᗮ)) (stdGaussian E)

name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.stdGaussian_prod_map
statement:
lemma stdGaussian_prod_map {E F : Type*}

    [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    [NormedAddCommGroup F] [InnerProductSpace ℝ F] [FiniteDimensional ℝ F]
    [MeasurableSpace F] [BorelSpace F] :
    ((stdGaussian E).prod (stdGaussian F)).map (WithLp.toLp 2) =
      stdGaussian (WithLp 2 (E × F))

name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.Affine.affine_parameters
statement:
lemma affine_parameters {d n ell : ℕ} (hd : 128 ≤ d) (hn : (d+1)/2 + 2*ell ≤ n) :
    let q := (n-1)/4
    2 ≤ q ∧ n ≤ 5*q ∧ d ≤ 2*n ∧ d/16 ≤ q ∧ d/8 ≤ 2*q ∧
      2*(d/32) ≤ 2*q ∧ ell*(d/16)/q+1 ≤ ell+1

name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.Affine.affine_zero_bound

name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.Fixed.two_le_boundConstant

name: OAI.SubsphereRegression.precision_from_stream_bound_half_aux
statement:
lemma precision_from_stream_bound_half_aux {d M T a q : ℕ} {ε A : ℝ}
    (hd : 32 ≤ d) (hT : d ≤ 32*T) (hq : 0 < q) (hdq : d ≤ 8*q)
    (ha : d ≤ 4*a) (hM : (M : ℝ) ≤ A * (d : ℝ)^2) (hA : 0 < A)
    (hε : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε ≤ 1)
    (hbound : (1/2 : ℝ) ≤ ((T : ℝ)+1) * ((3 : ℝ)*4^d * ε^a) *
      ((32768 : ℝ)^d * ((2 : ℝ)^M)^(1/(q : ℝ)))^(T/q+1)) :
    (1 / (4*(1024+512*A))) * (d : ℝ) * Real.log (1/ε) ≤ (T : ℝ)

name: OAI.SubsphereRegression.three_sets_bound

lemma three_sets_bound {μ : Measure E} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {A B C : Set E}
    (_hA : NullMeasurableSet A μ) (hB : NullMeasurableSet B μ) (hC : NullMeasurableSet C μ)
    {b : ℝ≥0∞} (hAB : μ (A∩B) ≤ b) (hAC : μ (A∩C) ≤ b) (hBC : μ (B∩C) ≤ b) :
    μ A + μ B + μ C ≤ 1 + (b+b+b)

name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.Weighted.terminal_average
statement:
lemma terminal_average {d n : ℕ} (A : Affine.Test d n) [Nontrivial A.space]
    (π : Measure (Sphere d)) [IsProbabilityMeasure π]
    {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (hsmall : ε/A.radius ≤ 1)
    {a : ℝ} (ha : a ≤ (n-1 : ℕ)) :
    (∫⁻ s : Affine.Sphere A.space, terminalInput π ε (onTest A s)
      ∂Affine.sphereLaw A.space) ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal ((3 : ℝ)*4^n)*(ENNReal.ofReal (ε/A.radius))^a

    {a : ℝ} (ha : a ≤ (n-1 : ℕ)) :
    Affine.sphereLaw A.space {s : Affine.Sphere A.space |
      Real.arccos ⟪u.val,A.point s⟫ ≤ ε} ≤

      ENNReal.ofReal ((16 : ℝ)^d)*(ENNReal.ofReal ε)^((d : ℝ)/16)
