lemma block_right_fix_e (V : Submodule ℝ E) (e : Metric.sphere (0 : V) 1) (w : Orthogonal Vᗮ) :
    blockIso V 1 w (e.val : E) = (e.val : E)

name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.Mixture.block_right_latitude_mem
statement:
lemma block_right_latitude_mem (V : Submodule ℝ E) (e : Metric.sphere (0 : V) 1)
    (w : Orthogonal Vᗮ) {x : E} (hx : x ∈ latitudeSpace V e) :
    blockIso V 1 w x ∈ latitudeSpace V e

name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.Mixture.block_right_latitude_stable
statement:
lemma block_right_latitude_stable (V : Submodule ℝ E) (e : Metric.sphere (0 : V) 1)
    (w : Orthogonal Vᗮ) :
    (latitudeSpace V e).map (blockIso V 1 w).toLinearMap = latitudeSpace V e

name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.Mixture.gammaMeasure_restrict_density
statement:
lemma gammaMeasure_restrict_density (a : ℝ) :
    gammaMeasure a 1 = (volume.restrict (Ioi (0 : ℝ))).withDensity (gammaPDF a 1)

name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.Mixture.gammaPDF_measurable
statement: lemma gammaPDF_measurable (a r : ℝ) : Measurable (gammaPDF a r)

name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.Mixture.gammaSphereConstant_ne_top
statement: lemma gammaSphereConstant_ne_top : gammaSphereConstant E ≠ ∞

name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.Mixture.gammaSphere_density
statement:
lemma gammaSphere_density : gammaSphere (E := E) = gammaSphereConstant E •
    (volume : Measure E).withDensity (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-‖x‖^2)))

name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.Mixture.gammaSphere_lintegral
statement:
lemma gammaSphere_lintegral {f : E → ℝ≥0∞} (hf : Measurable f) :
    (∫⁻ x, f x ∂gammaSphere (E := E)) = gammaSphereConstant E *
      ∫⁻ x : E, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-‖x‖^2)) * f x ∂volume

name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.Mixture.gammaSphere_sqnorm
statement:
lemma gammaSphere_sqnorm : MeasurePreserving (fun x : E => ‖x‖^2) gammaSphere
    (gammaMeasure ((Module.finrank ℝ E : ℝ)/2) 1)

name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.Mixture.gamma_ae_pos
statement: lemma gamma_ae_pos (a : ℝ) : ∀ᵐ x ∂gammaMeasure a 1, 0 < x

name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.Mixture.gamma_beta_density
statement:
lemma gamma_beta_density {a b q r : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b)
    (hq : q ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) (hr : 0 < r) :
    ENNReal.ofReal r * (gammaPDF a 1 (q*r) * gammaPDF b 1 ((1-q)*r)) =
      betaPDF a b q * gammaPDF (a+b) 1 r

name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.Mixture.gamma_prod_ae_domain
statement:
lemma gamma_prod_ae_domain (a b : ℝ) (hb : 0 < b) :
    ∀ᵐ z ∂(gammaMeasure a 1).prod (gammaMeasure b 1), z ∈ gammaDomain

name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.Mixture.gamma_ratio_preserving
statement:
lemma gamma_ratio_preserving {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) :
    MeasurePreserving (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => z.1/(z.1+z.2))
      ((gammaMeasure a 1).prod (gammaMeasure b 1)) (betaMeasure a b)

name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.Mixture.gamma_sqrt_lintegral
statement:
lemma gamma_sqrt_lintegral (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) {f : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞} (hf : Measurable f) :
    (∫⁻ x, f (Real.sqrt x) ∂gammaMeasure ((d : ℝ)/2) 1) =
      ENNReal.ofReal (2/Real.Gamma ((d : ℝ)/2)) *
        ∫⁻ r : Ioi (0 : ℝ), ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-(r.val^2))) * f r.val
          ∂Measure.volumeIoiPow (d-1)

name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.Mixture.gamma_square_density
statement:
lemma gamma_square_density {d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) :
    ENNReal.ofReal (2*r) * gammaPDF ((d : ℝ)/2) 1 (r^2) =
      ENNReal.ofReal (2/Real.Gamma ((d : ℝ)/2)) * ENNReal.ofReal (r^(d-1)) *
        ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-(r^2)))

name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.Mixture.gamma_sum_preserving
statement:
lemma gamma_sum_preserving {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) :
    MeasurePreserving (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => z.1+z.2)
      ((gammaMeasure a 1).prod (gammaMeasure b 1)) (gammaMeasure (a+b) 1)

name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.Mixture.isotropic_density_preserving
statement:
lemma isotropic_density_preserving (c : ℝ≥0∞) (e : E ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E) :
    MeasurePreserving e
      (c • (volume : Measure E).withDensity (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-‖x‖^2))))
      (c • (volume : Measure E).withDensity (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-‖x‖^2))))

name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.Mixture.latitude_e_norm
statement: lemma latitude_e_norm (V : Submodule ℝ E) (e : Metric.sphere (0 : V) 1) : ‖(e.val : E)‖ = 1

name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.Mixture.latitude_perp_le
statement:
lemma latitude_perp_le (V : Submodule ℝ E) (e : Metric.sphere (0 : V) 1) :
    Vᗮ ≤ latitudeSpace V e

name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.Mixture.latitude_rank
statement:
lemma latitude_rank (V : Submodule ℝ E) (e : Metric.sphere (0 : V) 1) :
    Module.finrank ℝ (latitudeSpace V e)+1 = Module.finrank ℝ E

name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.Mixture.lintegral_betaSplit
statement:
lemma lintegral_betaSplit (f : (ℝ × ℝ) → ℝ≥0∞) :
    (∫⁻ z in gammaDomain, f z) =
      ∫⁻ z in betaDomain, ENNReal.ofReal z.2 * f (betaSplit z)

name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.Mixture.lintegral_beta_gamma
statement:
lemma lintegral_beta_gamma {f : (ℝ × ℝ) → ℝ≥0∞} (hf : Measurable f) (a b c : ℝ) :
    (∫⁻ z, f z ∂(betaMeasure a b).prod (gammaMeasure c 1)) =
      ∫⁻ z in betaDomain, (betaPDF a b z.1 * gammaPDF c 1 z.2) * f z

name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.Mixture.lintegral_gamma_eq
statement:
lemma lintegral_gamma_eq {f : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞} (hf : Measurable f) (a : ℝ) :
    (∫⁻ x, f x ∂gammaMeasure a 1) = ∫⁻ x in Ioi (0 : ℝ), gammaPDF a 1 x * f x

name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.Mixture.lintegral_gamma_prod
statement:
lemma lintegral_gamma_prod {f : (ℝ × ℝ) → ℝ≥0∞} (hf : Measurable f) (a b : ℝ) :
    (∫⁻ z, f z ∂(gammaMeasure a 1).prod (gammaMeasure b 1)) =
      ∫⁻ z in gammaDomain, (gammaPDF a 1 z.1 * gammaPDF b 1 z.2) * f z

name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.Mixture.lintegral_square
statement:
lemma lintegral_square (f : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞) :
    (∫⁻ x in Ioi (0 : ℝ), f x) =
      ∫⁻ r in Ioi (0 : ℝ), ENNReal.ofReal (2*r) * f (r^2)

name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.Mixture.measurable_betaJoin
statement: lemma measurable_betaJoin : Measurable betaJoin

name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.Mixture.measurable_mixtureSampler
statement: lemma measurable_mixtureSampler (V : Submodule ℝ E) : Measurable (mixtureSampler V)

name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.Mixture.measurable_normalize
statement: lemma measurable_normalize : Measurable (NormedSpace.normalize : E → E)

name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.Mixture.measurable_perpCoordinate
statement: lemma measurable_perpCoordinate (V : Submodule ℝ E) : Measurable (perpCoordinate V)

name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.Mixture.nested_orthogonal_projection_norm
statement:
lemma nested_orthogonal_projection_norm (U N : Submodule ℝ E) (h : U ≤ N) (x : N) :
    ‖(U.comap N.subtype)ᗮ.orthogonalProjectionOnto x‖ = ‖Uᗮ.orthogonalProjectionOnto (x : E)‖

name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.Mixture.nested_orthogonal_starProjection
statement:
lemma nested_orthogonal_starProjection (U N : Submodule ℝ E) (h : U ≤ N) (x : N) :
    ((((U.comap N.subtype)ᗮ).starProjection x : N) : E) = Uᗮ.starProjection (x : E)

name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.Mixture.nested_projection_norm
statement:
lemma nested_projection_norm (U N : Submodule ℝ E) (h : U ≤ N) (x : N) :
    ‖(U.comap N.subtype).orthogonalProjectionOnto x‖ = ‖U.orthogonalProjectionOnto (x : E)‖

name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.Mixture.nested_rank
statement:
lemma nested_rank (U N : Submodule ℝ E) (h : U ≤ N) :
    Module.finrank ℝ (U.comap N.subtype) = Module.finrank ℝ U

name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.Mixture.nested_starProjection
statement:
lemma nested_starProjection (U N : Submodule ℝ E) (h : U ≤ N) (x : N) :
    (((U.comap N.subtype).starProjection x : N) : E) = U.starProjection (x : E)

name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.Mixture.normalize_isometry
statement:
lemma normalize_isometry (e : E ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E) (x : E) :
    NormedSpace.normalize (e x) = e (NormedSpace.normalize x)

name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.Mixture.normalize_sum_sqproj
statement:
lemma normalize_sum_sqproj (V : Submodule ℝ E) (x : V) (y : Vᗮ) :
    ‖V.orthogonalProjectionOnto (NormedSpace.normalize ((x : E)+(y : E)))‖^2 =
      ‖x‖^2/(‖x‖^2+‖y‖^2)

name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.Mixture.orthogonal_exp_mul
statement:
lemma orthogonal_exp_mul (V : Submodule ℝ E) (x : V) (y : Vᗮ) :
    ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-‖x‖^2)) * ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-‖y‖^2)) =
      ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-‖(x : E)+(y : E)‖^2))

name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.Mixture.orthogonal_norm_add
statement:
lemma orthogonal_norm_add (V : Submodule ℝ E) (x : V) (y : Vᗮ) :
    ‖(x : E)+(y : E)‖^2 = ‖x‖^2+‖y‖^2

name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.Mixture.perpCoordinate_blockIso
statement:
lemma perpCoordinate_blockIso (V : Submodule ℝ E) (u : Orthogonal V) (w : Orthogonal Vᗮ) (x : E) :
    perpCoordinate V (blockIso V u w x) = perpCoordinate V x

name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.Mixture.preserving_map_of_intertwining
statement:
lemma preserving_map_of_intertwining {X Y : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableSpace Y]
    {μ : Measure X} {f : X → Y} {g : X → X} {h : Y → Y}
    (hf : Measurable f) (hg : MeasurePreserving g μ μ) (hh : Measurable h)
    (hc : ∀ x, f (g x) = h (f x)) : MeasurePreserving h (μ.map f) (μ.map f)

name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.Mixture.restrictIso_coe
statement:
lemma restrictIso_coe (N : Submodule ℝ E) (e : E ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E)
    (he : N.map e.toLinearMap = N) (x : N) : (restrictIso N e he x : E) = e (x : E)

name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.Mixture.square_image_Ioi
statement: lemma square_image_Ioi : (fun r : ℝ => r^2) '' Ioi (0 : ℝ) = Ioi (0 : ℝ)

name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.Mixture.square_inj_Ioi
statement: lemma square_inj_Ioi : InjOn (fun r : ℝ => r^2) (Ioi (0 : ℝ))

name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.Mixture.stable_map_eq
statement:
lemma stable_map_eq (N : Submodule ℝ E) (e : E ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E)
    (h : ∀ x ∈ N, e x ∈ N) (hinv : ∀ x ∈ N, e.symm x ∈ N) :
    N.map e.toLinearMap = N

name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.Mixture.beta_product_preserving
statement:
lemma beta_product_preserving {a b c : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hc : 0 < c) :
    MeasurePreserving (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => z.1*z.2)
      ((betaMeasure a b).prod (betaMeasure (a+b) c)) (betaMeasure a (b+c))

name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.Mixture.latitude_coordinate
statement:
lemma latitude_coordinate (V : Submodule ℝ E) (e : Metric.sphere (0 : V) 1)
    (u : Orthogonal V) (x : latitudeSpace V e) {q : ℝ} (hq : 0 ≤ q) :
    perpCoordinate V (blockIso V u 1
      (Real.sqrt (1-q) • (e.val : E)+Real.sqrt q • (x : E))) =
      q * perpCoordinate V (x : E)

name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.Mixture.latitude_coordinate_rank_one
statement:
lemma latitude_coordinate_rank_one (V : Submodule ℝ E) (e : Metric.sphere (0 : V) 1)
    (hV : Module.finrank ℝ V = 1) (x : latitudeSpace V e) :
    perpCoordinate V (x : E) = ‖x‖^2

name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.Mixture.latitude_norm
statement:
lemma latitude_norm (V : Submodule ℝ E) (e : Metric.sphere (0 : V) 1)
    (x : latitudeSpace V e) (hx : ‖x‖ = 1) {q : ℝ} (hq : 0 ≤ q) (hq1 : q ≤ 1) :
    ‖Real.sqrt (1-q) • (e.val : E)+Real.sqrt q • (x : E)‖ = 1

name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.Mixture.latitude_rank_one
statement:
lemma latitude_rank_one (V : Submodule ℝ E) (e : Metric.sphere (0 : V) 1)
    (hV : Module.finrank ℝ V = 1) : latitudeSpace V e = Vᗮ

name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.Mixture.measurable_directionSampler
statement:
lemma measurable_directionSampler (V N : Submodule ℝ E) :
    Measurable (fun z : Orthogonal Vᗮ × N => blockIso V 1 z.1 (z.2 : E))

name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.Mixture.measurable_latitudeSampler
statement:
lemma measurable_latitudeSampler (V : Submodule ℝ E) (e : Metric.sphere (0 : V) 1) :
    Measurable (fun z : ℝ × (Orthogonal V × latitudeSpace V e) => blockIso V z.2.1 1
      (Real.sqrt (1-z.1) • (e.val : E)+Real.sqrt z.1 • (z.2.2 : E)))

name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.betaMeasure_two_component
statement:
theorem betaMeasure_two_component {a A b B D : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hA : a ≤ A) (hB : b ≤ B)
    (hAD : A - a ≤ D) (hBD : B - b ≤ D) :
    betaMeasure a b ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((2 : ℝ) ^ D) •
      (betaMeasure A b + betaMeasure a B)

name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.betaPDFReal_domination_left_half
statement:
lemma betaPDFReal_domination_left_half {a b B D x : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hB : b ≤ B) (hD : B - b ≤ D)
    (hx : x ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ)) :
    betaPDFReal a b x ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ D * betaPDFReal a B x

name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.betaPDFReal_domination_right_half
statement:
lemma betaPDFReal_domination_right_half {a A b D x : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hA : a ≤ A) (hD : A - a ≤ D)
    (hx : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ x) :
    betaPDFReal a b x ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ D * betaPDFReal A b x

name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.beta_antitone_left
statement:
lemma beta_antitone_left {a A b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (h : a ≤ A) :
    beta A b ≤ beta a b

name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.beta_antitone_right
statement:
lemma beta_antitone_right {a b B : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (h : b ≤ B) :
    beta a B ≤ beta a b

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.entropy_moment_bound
statement:
lemma entropy_moment_bound [Nonempty α] (P : Law α) (f : α → ℝ) :
    P.mean f ≤ P.uniformDeficit +
      Real.log ((∑ x, Real.exp (f x)) / Fintype.card α)

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.gibbs_le
statement:
lemma gibbs_le (P : Law α) (a : α → ℝ) (ha : ∀ x, 0 ≤ a x)
    (hZ : 0 < ∑ x, a x) (hs : ∀ x, a x = 0 → P.mass x = 0) :
    P.mean (fun x => Real.log (a x)) -
      (∑ x, P.mass x * Real.log (P.mass x)) ≤ Real.log (∑ x, a x)

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.mean_map
statement:
lemma mean_map (P : Law α) (f : α → β) (g : β → ℝ) :
    (P.map f).mean g = P.mean (g ∘ f)

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.pointwise_entropy_lower
statement:
lemma pointwise_entropy_lower {p q : ℝ} (hp : 0 ≤ p) (hq : 0 ≤ q)
    (hzero : q = 0 → p = 0) : p - q ≤ p * Real.log (p / q)

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.relativeEntropy_nonneg
statement:
lemma relativeEntropy_nonneg (P Q : Law α)
    (hzero : ∀ a, Q.mass a = 0 → P.mass a = 0) :
    0 ≤ P.relativeEntropy Q

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.relativeEntropy_uniform
statement:
lemma relativeEntropy_uniform [Nonempty α] (P : Law α) :
    P.relativeEntropy uniform = P.uniformDeficit

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.uniformDeficit_nonneg
statement:
lemma uniformDeficit_nonneg [Nonempty α] (P : Law α) :
    0 ≤ P.uniformDeficit

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.condEntropy_const
statement:
lemma condEntropy_const (P : Law α) (X : α → β) (c : γ) :
    P.condEntropy X (fun _ => c) = (P.map X).entropy

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.condEntropy_eq_mean
statement:
lemma condEntropy_eq_mean (P : Law α) (X : α → β) (Y : α → γ) :
    P.condEntropy X Y = -P.mean (fun a => Real.log (P.condMass X Y a))

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.condMass_pos
statement:
lemma condMass_pos (P : Law α) (X : α → β) (Y : α → γ)
    {a : α} (ha : 0 < P.mass a) : 0 < P.condMass X Y a

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.entropy_func_pair
statement:
lemma entropy_func_pair (P : Law α) (X : α → β) (f : β → γ) :
    (P.map (fun a => (X a, f (X a)))).entropy = (P.map X).entropy

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.entropy_map_injective
statement:
lemma entropy_map_injective (P : Law α) (f : α → β) (hf : Function.Injective f) :
    (P.map f).entropy = P.entropy

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.entropy_nonneg
statement: lemma entropy_nonneg (P : Law α) : 0 ≤ P.entropy

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.entropy_pair_comm
statement:
lemma entropy_pair_comm (P : Law α) (X : α → β) (Y : α → γ) :
    (P.map (fun a => (X a, Y a))).entropy =
      (P.map (fun a => (Y a, X a))).entropy

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.ext
statement: @[ext] lemma ext (P Q : Law α) (h : ∀ a, P.mass a = Q.mass a) : P = Q

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.map_id
statement: lemma map_id (P : Law α) : P.map id = P

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.map_map
statement:
lemma map_map (P : Law α) (f : α → β) (g : β → γ) :
    (P.map f).map g = P.map (g ∘ f)

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.map_mass_mean
statement:
lemma map_mass_mean (P : Law α) (f : α → β) (b : β) :
    (P.map f).mass b = P.mean (fun a => if f a = b then 1 else 0)

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.map_mass_pos
statement:
lemma map_mass_pos (P : Law α) (f : α → β) {a : α} (ha : 0 < P.mass a) :
    0 < (P.map f).mass (f a)

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.mass_le_map
statement:
lemma mass_le_map (P : Law α) (f : α → β) (a : α) :
    P.mass a ≤ (P.map f).mass (f a)

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.mass_le_one
statement: lemma mass_le_one (P : Law α) (a : α) : P.mass a ≤ 1

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.mean_add
statement:
lemma mean_add (P : Law α) (f g : α → ℝ) :
    P.mean (fun a => f a + g a) = P.mean f + P.mean g

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.mean_congr_support
statement:
lemma mean_congr_support (P : Law α) {f g : α → ℝ}
    (h : ∀ a, 0 < P.mass a → f a = g a) : P.mean f = P.mean g

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.mean_const
statement: lemma mean_const (P : Law α) (c : ℝ) : P.mean (fun _ => c) = c

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.mean_const_mul
statement:
lemma mean_const_mul (P : Law α) (c : ℝ) (f : α → ℝ) :
    P.mean (fun a => c * f a) = c * P.mean f

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.mean_mono
statement:
lemma mean_mono (P : Law α) {f g : α → ℝ} (h : ∀ a, f a ≤ g a) :
    P.mean f ≤ P.mean g

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.mean_mul_const
statement:
lemma mean_mul_const (P : Law α) (f : α → ℝ) (c : ℝ) :
    P.mean (fun a => f a * c) = P.mean f * c

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.mean_sub
statement:
lemma mean_sub (P : Law α) (f g : α → ℝ) :
    P.mean (fun a => f a - g a) = P.mean f - P.mean g

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.uniformDeficit_eq
statement:
lemma uniformDeficit_eq (P : Law α) :
    P.uniformDeficit = Real.log (Fintype.card α) - P.entropy

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.condEntropy_le_prediction
statement:
lemma condEntropy_le_prediction (P : Law α) (X : α → β) (Y : α → γ)
    (K : γ → Law β) (hs : ∀ a, 0 < P.mass a → 0 < (K (Y a)).mass (X a)) :
    P.condEntropy X Y ≤ -P.mean (fun a => Real.log ((K (Y a)).mass (X a)))

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.map_mass_pos_iff
statement:
lemma map_mass_pos_iff (P : Law α) (f : α → β) (b : β) :
    0 < (P.map f).mass b ↔ ∃ a, f a = b ∧ 0 < P.mass a

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.condEntropy_chain
statement:
lemma condEntropy_chain (P : Law α) (X : α → β) (Y : α → γ) (Z : α → δ) :
    P.condEntropy (fun a => (X a, Y a)) Z =
      P.condEntropy X Z + P.condEntropy Y (fun a => (X a, Z a))

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.condEntropy_le_entropy
statement:
lemma condEntropy_le_entropy (P : Law α) (X : α → β) (Y : α → γ) :
    P.condEntropy X Y ≤ (P.map X).entropy

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.entropy_chain
statement:
lemma entropy_chain {n : ℕ} (P : Law α) (X : Fin n → α → β) :
    (∑ i : Fin n, P.condEntropy (X i) (history X i)) =
      (P.map (fun a i => X i a)).entropy

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.entropy_chain_history
statement:
lemma entropy_chain_history {n : ℕ} (P : Law α) (X : Fin n → α → β) (Y : α → γ) :
    (∑ i : Fin n, P.condEntropy (X i) (fun a => (Y a, history X i a))) =
      P.condEntropy (fun a i => X i a) Y

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.entropy_eq_of_fibers
statement:
lemma entropy_eq_of_fibers (P : Law α) (X : α → β) (Y : α → γ)
    (hf : ∀ a b, X a = X b ↔ Y a = Y b) : (P.map X).entropy = (P.map Y).entropy

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.entropy_pair_le
statement:
lemma entropy_pair_le (P : Law α) (X : α → β) (Y : α → γ) :
    (P.map (fun a => (X a, Y a))).entropy ≤ (P.map X).entropy + (P.map Y).entropy

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.entropy_tuple_le
statement:
lemma entropy_tuple_le {n : ℕ} (P : Law α) (X : Fin n → α → β) :
    (P.map (fun a i => X i a)).entropy ≤ ∑ i, (P.map (X i)).entropy

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.history_eq_iff
statement:
lemma history_eq_iff {n : ℕ} (X : Fin n → α → β) (t : ℕ) (a b : α) :
    history X t a = history X t b ↔ ∀ i : Fin n, (i : ℕ) < t → X i a = X i b

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.history_step_fibers
statement:
lemma history_step_fibers {n : ℕ} (X : Fin n → α → β) (Y : α → γ)
    (i : Fin n) (a b : α) :
    (X i a, (Y a, history X i a)) = (X i b, (Y b, history X i b)) ↔
      (Y a, history X (i + 1) a) = (Y b, history X (i + 1) b)

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.sum_fin_telescope
statement:
lemma sum_fin_telescope (n : ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℝ) :
    (∑ i : Fin n, (f (i + 1) - f i)) = f n - f 0

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.condEntropy_eq_of_fibers
statement:
lemma condEntropy_eq_of_fibers {α β γ δ : Type*}
    [Fintype α] [Fintype β] [Fintype γ] [Fintype δ]
    (P : Law α) (X : α → β) (Y : α → γ) (Z : α → δ)
    (h : ∀ a b, Y a = Y b ↔ Z a = Z b) :
    P.condEntropy X Y = P.condEntropy X Z

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.condEntropy_out_eq_of_fibers
statement:
lemma condEntropy_out_eq_of_fibers {α β γ δ : Type*}
    [Fintype α] [Fintype β] [Fintype γ] [Fintype δ]
    (P : Law α) (X : α → β) (V : α → δ) (Y : α → γ)
    (h : ∀ a b, X a = X b ↔ V a = V b) :
    P.condEntropy X Y = P.condEntropy V Y

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.grid_base_chain
statement:
lemma grid_base_chain {A D : ℕ} (Q : Law (Grid A D)) (k : Fin D) :
    (∑ i : Fin A, Q.condEntropy (fun a => a.2 k i) (colHistory k i)) =
      (Q.map (fun a => a.2 k)).entropy

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.grid_comparison_sum
statement:
lemma grid_comparison_sum {A D : ℕ} (Q : Law (Grid A D)) (e : Equiv.Perm (Fin D)) :
    (∑ k : Fin D, ∑ i : Fin A,
      (Q.condEntropy (fun a => a.2 k i) (colHistory k i) -
        Q.condEntropy (fun a => a.2 k i) (gridPast e k i))) =
      (Q.map Prod.fst).entropy + (∑ k : Fin D, (Q.map (fun a => a.2 k)).entropy) -
        Q.entropy

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.grid_inner_chain
statement:
lemma grid_inner_chain {A D : ℕ} (Q : Law (Grid A D))
    (e : Equiv.Perm (Fin D)) (k : Fin D) :
    (∑ i : Fin A, Q.condEntropy (fun a => a.2 k i) (gridPast e k i)) =
      Q.condEntropy (fun a => a.2 k) (fun a => (a.1, priorCols e k a))

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.grid_outer_chain
statement:
lemma grid_outer_chain {A D : ℕ} (Q : Law (Grid A D)) (e : Equiv.Perm (Fin D)) :
    (∑ k : Fin D, Q.condEntropy (fun a => a.2 k) (fun a => (a.1, priorCols e k a))) =
      Q.entropy - (Q.map Prod.fst).entropy

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.priorCols_eq_iff
statement:
lemma priorCols_eq_iff {A D : ℕ} (e : Equiv.Perm (Fin D)) (k : Fin D)
    (a b : Grid A D) :
    priorCols e k a = priorCols e k b ↔ ∀ l, e l < e k → a.2 l = b.2 l

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.priorCols_history_fibers
statement:
lemma priorCols_history_fibers {A D : ℕ} (e : Equiv.Perm (Fin D)) (k : Fin D)
    (a b : Grid A D) : priorCols e k a = priorCols e k b ↔
      Law.history (fun t : Fin D => fun c : Grid A D => c.2 (e.symm t)) (e k) a =
      Law.history (fun t : Fin D => fun c : Grid A D => c.2 (e.symm t)) (e k) b

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.condEntropy_light_comparison
statement:
lemma condEntropy_light_comparison (P : Law α) (X : α → β) (Y : α → γ)
    (K : γ → Law β) (L S : γ → β → Prop)
    (hK : ∀ a, 0 < P.mass a → 0 < (K (Y a)).mass (X a))
    (hS : ∀ a, 0 < P.mass a → S (Y a) (X a)) :
    P.mean (fun a => if L (Y a) (X a) then
      -Real.log ((K (Y a)).prob (fun b => L (Y a) b ∧ S (Y a) b) /
        (K (Y a)).prob (L (Y a))) else 0) ≤
      -P.mean (fun a => Real.log ((K (Y a)).mass (X a))) - P.condEntropy X Y

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.lightRescale_log
statement:
lemma lightRescale_log (P : Law α) (L S : α → Prop) {a : α}
    (hp : 0 < P.mass a) (hS : S a) :
    Real.log ((P.lightRescale L S).mass a) = Real.log (P.mass a) -
      (if L a then Real.log (P.prob (fun b => L b ∧ S b) / P.prob L) else 0)

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.lightRescale_mass_of_mem
OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.lightRescale_mass_of_not
statement:
lemma lightRescale_mass_of_not (P : Law α) (L S : α → Prop) {a : α} (ha : ¬L a) :
    (P.lightRescale L S).mass a = P.mass a

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.lightRescale_pos
statement:
lemma lightRescale_pos (P : Law α) (L S : α → Prop) {a : α}
    (hp : 0 < P.mass a) (hS : S a) : 0 < (P.lightRescale L S).mass a

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.light_cost_nonneg
statement:
lemma light_cost_nonneg (P : Law α) (L S : α → Prop) :
    0 ≤ -Real.log (P.prob (fun b => L b ∧ S b) / P.prob L)

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.mass_le_prob
statement:
lemma mass_le_prob (P : Law α) (S : α → Prop) {a : α} (ha : S a) :
    P.mass a ≤ P.prob S

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.prob_eq_mean
statement:
lemma prob_eq_mean (P : Law α) (S : α → Prop) [DecidablePred S] :
    P.prob S = P.mean (fun a => if S a then 1 else 0)

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.prob_le_one
statement: lemma prob_le_one (P : Law α) (S : α → Prop) : P.prob S ≤ 1

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.prob_mono
statement:
lemma prob_mono (P : Law α) {S T : α → Prop} (h : ∀ a, S a → T a) :
    P.prob S ≤ P.prob T

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.prob_nonneg
statement: lemma prob_nonneg (P : Law α) (S : α → Prop) : 0 ≤ P.prob S

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.prob_not
statement: lemma prob_not (P : Law α) (S : α → Prop) : P.prob (fun a => ¬S a) = 1 - P.prob S

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.condEntropy_predict_comparison
statement:
lemma condEntropy_predict_comparison {δ : Type*} [Fintype δ]
    (P : Law α) (X : α → β) (Y : α → γ) (Z : α → δ)
    (g : δ → γ) (hg : ∀ a, g (Z a) = Y a) :
    P.condEntropy X Z ≤ P.condEntropy X Y

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.mean_predict
statement:
lemma mean_predict (P : Law α) (X : α → β) (Y : α → γ) (f : γ → β → ℝ) :
    P.mean (fun a => (P.predict X Y (Y a)).mean (f (Y a))) =
      P.mean (fun a => f (Y a) (X a))

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.mean_predict_log
statement:
lemma mean_predict_log (P : Law α) (X : α → β) (Y : α → γ) :
    P.mean (fun a => Real.log ((P.predict X Y (Y a)).mass (X a))) =
      -P.condEntropy X Y

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.mean_predict_prob
statement:
lemma mean_predict_prob (P : Law α) (X : α → β) (Y : α → γ) (S : γ → β → Prop) :
    P.mean (fun a => (P.predict X Y (Y a)).prob (S (Y a))) =
      P.prob (fun a => S (Y a) (X a))

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.predict_mass
statement:
lemma predict_mass (P : Law α) (X : α → β) (Y : α → γ) (y : γ)
    (hy : 0 < (P.map Y).mass y) (x : β) :
    (P.predict X Y y).mass x =
      (P.map (fun a => (X a, Y a))).mass (x, y) / (P.map Y).mass y

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.predict_mass_self
statement:
lemma predict_mass_self (P : Law α) (X : α → β) (Y : α → γ)
    {a : α} (ha : 0 < P.mass a) :
    (P.predict X Y (Y a)).mass (X a) = P.condMass X Y a

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.predict_mass_zero
statement:
lemma predict_mass_zero (P : Law α) (X : α → β) (Y : α → γ) {y : γ} {x : β}
    (hy : 0 < (P.map Y).mass y)
    (h : ∀ a, 0 < P.mass a → Y a = y → X a ≠ x) :
    (P.predict X Y y).mass x = 0

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.predict_pos
statement:
lemma predict_pos (P : Law α) (X : α → β) (Y : α → γ)
    {a : α} (ha : 0 < P.mass a) : 0 < (P.predict X Y (Y a)).mass (X a)

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.prob_eq_map_mass
statement:
lemma prob_eq_map_mass (P : Law α) (Y : α → γ) (y : γ) :
    P.prob (fun a => Y a = y) = (P.map Y).mass y

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.restrict_mass
statement:
lemma restrict_mass (P : Law α) (S : α → Prop) (h : 0 < P.prob S) (a : α) :
    (P.restrict S).mass a = (if S a then P.mass a else 0) / P.prob S

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.columnCost_le_comparison
statement:
lemma columnCost_le_comparison {A D : ℕ} (Q : Law (Grid A D))
    (hQ : ∀ a, 0 < Q.mass a → Compatible a.1 a.2) (H : ℝ)
    (e : Equiv.Perm (Fin D)) (k : Fin D) (i : Fin A) :
    Q.mean (columnCost Q H e k i) ≤
      Q.condEntropy (fun a => a.2 k i) (colHistory k i) -
      Q.condEntropy (fun a => a.2 k i) (gridPast e k i)

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.columnCost_nonneg
statement:
lemma columnCost_nonneg {A D : ℕ} (Q : Law (Grid A D)) (H : ℝ)
    (e : Equiv.Perm (Fin D)) (k : Fin D) (i : Fin A) (a : Grid A D) :
    0 ≤ columnCost Q H e k i a

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.columnFor_actual
statement:
lemma columnFor_actual {A D : ℕ} (a : Grid A D) (ha : Compatible a.1 a.2)
    (k : Fin D) (i : Fin A) : columnFor a ha ((a.1 i).symm k) (a.2 k i) = k

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.columnFor_output
statement:
@[simp] lemma columnFor_output {A D : ℕ} (a : Grid A D) (ha : Compatible a.1 a.2)
    (j : Fin D) (h : Fin A) : columnFor a ha j (outputEquiv a ha j h) = a.1 h j

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.gridAllowed_actual
statement:
lemma gridAllowed_actual {A D : ℕ} (a : Grid A D) (ha : Compatible a.1 a.2)
    (e : Equiv.Perm (Fin D)) (k : Fin D) (i : Fin A) :
    gridAllowed k i (gridPast e k i a) (a.2 k i)

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.gridAllowed_iff_rank
statement:
lemma gridAllowed_iff_rank {A D : ℕ} (a : Grid A D) (ha : Compatible a.1 a.2)
    (e : Equiv.Perm (Fin D)) (k : Fin D) (i : Fin A) (w : Fin A) :
    gridAllowed k i (gridPast e k i a) w ↔ e k ≤ e (columnFor a ha ((a.1 i).symm k) w)

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.outputEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma outputEquiv_apply {A D : ℕ} (a : Grid A D) (ha : Compatible a.1 a.2)
    (j : Fin D) (h : Fin A) : outputEquiv a ha j h = a.2 (a.1 h j) h

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.heavy_mass_bound
statement:
lemma heavy_mass_bound (P R : Law α) {H : ℝ} (hH : 0 < H)
    (hs : ∀ a, R.mass a = 0 → P.mass a = 0) :
    (Real.log H - 1) * P.prob (fun a => H * R.mass a < P.mass a) ≤
      P.relativeEntropy R

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.mean_mono_support
statement:
lemma mean_mono_support (P : Law α) {f g : α → ℝ}
    (h : ∀ a, 0 < P.mass a → f a ≤ g a) : P.mean f ≤ P.mean g

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.mean_nonneg
statement: lemma mean_nonneg (P : Law α) {f : α → ℝ} (hf : ∀ a, 0 ≤ f a) : 0 ≤ P.mean f

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.mean_sum
statement:
lemma mean_sum {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (P : Law α) (f : ι → α → ℝ) :
    P.mean (fun a => ∑ i, f i a) = ∑ i, P.mean (f i)

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.neg_log_mean_le
statement:
lemma neg_log_mean_le (P : Law α) (f : α → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ a, 0 < P.mass a → 0 < f a) (hmean : 0 < P.mean f) :
    -Real.log (P.mean f) ≤ P.mean (fun a => -Real.log (f a))

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.uniform_mean_equiv
statement:
lemma uniform_mean_equiv [Nonempty α] (e : α ≃ α) (f : α → ℝ) :
    (uniform : Law α).mean (fun a => f (e a)) = (uniform : Law α).mean f

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.uniform_prob_equiv
statement:
lemma uniform_prob_equiv [Nonempty α] (e : α ≃ α) (S : α → Prop) :
    (uniform : Law α).prob (fun a => S (e a)) = (uniform : Law α).prob S

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.average_inverse_rank
statement:
lemma average_inverse_rank {D : ℕ} (hD : 0 < D) (a : ℝ) :
    (∑ t : Fin D, a / ((((D - (t : ℕ) : ℕ) : ℝ) / (D : ℝ)))) / D =
      a * (harmonic D : ℝ)

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.average_log_rank_lower
statement:
lemma average_log_rank_lower {D : ℕ} (hD : 0 < D) :
    1 - (1 + Real.log (D : ℝ)) / (D : ℝ) ≤
      (∑ t : Fin D, -Real.log (((D - (t : ℕ) : ℕ) : ℝ) / (D : ℝ))) / D

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.log_factorial_upper
statement:
lemma log_factorial_upper (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) :
    Real.log (n.factorial : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) * Real.log n - n + 1 + Real.log n

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.log_step_lower
statement:
lemma log_step_lower {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) :
    Real.log x + 1 ≤ (x + 1) * Real.log (x + 1) - x * Real.log x

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.neg_log_add_lower
statement:
lemma neg_log_add_lower {b a : ℝ} (hb : 0 < b) (ha : 0 ≤ a) :
    -Real.log b - a / b ≤ -Real.log (b + a)

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.sum_inv_sub
statement:
lemma sum_inv_sub (n : ℕ) :
    (∑ t : Fin n, 1 / ((n - (t : ℕ) : ℕ) : ℝ)) = (harmonic n : ℝ)

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.sum_log_sub
statement:
lemma sum_log_sub (n : ℕ) :
    (∑ t : Fin n, Real.log ((n - (t : ℕ) : ℕ) : ℝ)) = Real.log (n.factorial : ℝ)

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.sum_reverse_succ
statement:
lemma sum_reverse_succ (n : ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℝ) :
    (∑ t : Fin n, f (n - (t : ℕ))) = ∑ t : Fin n, f ((t : ℕ) + 1)

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.prescribed_function_card_le
statement:
lemma prescribed_function_card_le {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
    (s : Finset α) (f : α → α) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun τ : Equiv.Perm α => ∀ x ∈ s, τ x = f x)).card ≤
      (Fintype.card α - s.card).factorial

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.prescribed_permutation_card
statement:
lemma prescribed_permutation_card {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
    (s : Finset α) (σ : Equiv.Perm α) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun τ : Equiv.Perm α => ∀ x ∈ s, τ x = σ x)).card =
      (Fintype.card α - s.card).factorial

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.restrict_prob
statement:
lemma restrict_prob (P : Law α) (S T : α → Prop) (hS : 0 < P.prob S) :
    (P.restrict S).prob T = P.prob (fun a => S a ∧ T a) / P.prob S

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.uniform_prob_card
statement:
lemma uniform_prob_card (S : α → Prop) [DecidablePred S] :
    (uniform : Law α).prob S =
      ((Finset.univ.filter S).card : ℝ) / Fintype.card α

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.rankLaw_mass_pos_iff
statement:
lemma rankLaw_mass_pos_iff {D : ℕ} (k t : Fin D) (e : Equiv.Perm (Fin D)) :
    0 < (rankLaw k t).mass e ↔ e k = t

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.rankLaw_other_prob_le
statement:
lemma rankLaw_other_prob_le {D : ℕ} (hD : 2 ≤ D) (k l t s : Fin D) (hkl : k ≠ l) :
    (rankLaw k t).prob (fun e => e l = s) ≤ 1 / (D - 1 : ℕ)

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.uniform_rank_prob
statement:
lemma uniform_rank_prob {D : ℕ} (k t : Fin D) :
    (Law.uniform : Law (Equiv.Perm (Fin D))).prob (fun e => e k = t) = 1 / (D : ℝ)

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.uniform_two_rank_prob_le
statement:
lemma uniform_two_rank_prob_le {D : ℕ} (hD : 2 ≤ D) (k l t s : Fin D) (hkl : k ≠ l) :
    (Law.uniform : Law (Equiv.Perm (Fin D))).prob (fun e => e k = t ∧ e l = s) ≤
      1 / ((D : ℝ) * (D - 1 : ℕ))

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.mean_comm
statement:
lemma mean_comm (P : Law α) (Q : Law β) (f : α → β → ℝ) :
    P.mean (fun a => Q.mean (f a)) = Q.mean (fun b => P.mean (fun a => f a b))

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.mean_ite_const
statement:
lemma mean_ite_const (P : Law α) (S : α → Prop) [DecidablePred S] (x y : ℝ) :
    P.mean (fun a => if S a then x else y) =
      P.prob S * x + (1 - P.prob S) * y

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.prob_congr_support
statement:
lemma prob_congr_support (P : Law α) {S T : α → Prop}
    (h : ∀ a, 0 < P.mass a → (S a ↔ T a)) : P.prob S = P.prob T

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.prob_eq_sum_filter
statement:
lemma prob_eq_sum_filter (P : Law α) (S : α → Prop) [DecidablePred S] :
    P.prob S = ∑ a ∈ Finset.univ.filter S, P.mass a

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.prob_le_card_mul
statement:
lemma prob_le_card_mul (P : Law α) (S : α → Prop) [DecidablePred S]
    (c : ℝ) (hc : ∀ a, S a → P.mass a ≤ c) :
    P.prob S ≤ ((Finset.univ.filter S).card : ℝ) * c

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.prob_map
statement:
lemma prob_map (P : Law α) (f : α → β) (S : β → Prop) :
    (P.map f).prob S = P.prob (fun a => S (f a))

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.rankLaw_allowed_mean_le
statement:
lemma rankLaw_allowed_mean_le {β : Type*} [Fintype β] {D : ℕ} (hD : 2 ≤ D)
    (B : Law β) (f : β → Fin D) (k t : Fin D) :
    (rankLaw k t).mean (fun e => B.prob (fun b => e k ≤ e (f b))) ≤
      ((D - (t : ℕ) : ℕ) : ℝ) / (D : ℝ) + B.prob (fun b => f b = k)

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.rankLaw_later_le
statement:
lemma rankLaw_later_le {D : ℕ} (hD : 2 ≤ D) (k l t : Fin D) (hkl : k ≠ l) :
    (rankLaw k t).prob (fun e => e k ≤ e l) ≤
      ((D - (t : ℕ) : ℕ) : ℝ) / (D : ℝ)

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.rankLaw_mean_average
statement:
lemma rankLaw_mean_average {D : ℕ} (k : Fin D) (g : Equiv.Perm (Fin D) → ℝ) :
    (∑ t, (rankLaw k t).mean g) / (D : ℝ) =
      (Law.uniform : Law (Equiv.Perm (Fin D))).mean g

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.random_order_exclusion
statement:
lemma random_order_exclusion {β : Type*} [Fintype β] {D : ℕ} (hD : 2 ≤ D)
    (B : Law β) (f : β → Fin D) (k : Fin D)
    (hα : 0 < B.prob (fun b => f b = k)) :
    1 - (1 + Real.log (D : ℝ)) / (D : ℝ) -
        B.prob (fun b => f b = k) * (1 + Real.log (D : ℝ)) ≤
      (Law.uniform : Law (Equiv.Perm (Fin D))).mean
        (fun e => -Real.log (B.prob (fun b => e k ≤ e (f b))))

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.average_columnCost_good
statement:
lemma average_columnCost_good {A D : ℕ} (hD : 2 ≤ D) (Q : Law (Grid A D))
    (a : Grid A D) (hQa : 0 < Q.mass a) (ha : Compatible a.1 a.2)
    {H K : ℝ} (hH : 0 ≤ H) (k : Fin D) (i : Fin A)
    (hL : 1/2 ≤ (columnPrediction Q k i (colHistory k i a)).prob
      (columnLight Q H k i (colHistory k i a)))
    (haL : columnLight Q H k i (colHistory k i a) (a.2 k i))
    (hK : (entryClumpSize k i a : ℝ) ≤ K) :
    1 - exposureError A D H K i ≤
      (Law.uniform : Law (Equiv.Perm (Fin D))).mean (fun e => columnCost Q H e k i a)

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.exposureError_nonneg
statement:
lemma exposureError_nonneg {A D : ℕ} (hD : 1 ≤ D) {H K : ℝ} (hH : 0 ≤ H) (hK : 0 ≤ K)
    (i : Fin A) : 0 ≤ exposureError A D H K i

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.light_restrict_mass_le
OAI.ThorpCompatibility.protected_mass_le
statement:
lemma protected_mass_le {A D : ℕ} (a : Grid A D) (ha : Compatible a.1 a.2)
    (j k : Fin D) (B : Law (Fin A)) (b : ℝ) (hb : ∀ w, B.mass w ≤ b) :
    B.prob (fun w => columnFor a ha j w = k) ≤ (cellRows a.1 (j,k)).card * b

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.descFactorial_exponential_lower
statement:
lemma descFactorial_exponential_lower (n k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ n) :
    ((n : ℝ) / Real.exp 1) ^ k ≤ (n.descFactorial k : ℝ)

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.log_descFactorial_integral
statement:
lemma log_descFactorial_integral (n k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ n) :
    (n : ℝ) * Real.log n - (n - k : ℕ) * Real.log (n - k : ℕ) - k ≤
      Real.log (n.descFactorial k : ℝ)

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.log_descFactorial_lower
statement:
lemma log_descFactorial_lower (n k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ n) :
    (k : ℝ) * (Real.log n - 1) ≤ Real.log (n.descFactorial k : ℝ)

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.log_step_bound
statement:
lemma log_step_bound (n : ℕ) :
    ((n : ℝ) + 1) * Real.log ((n : ℝ) + 1) - (n : ℝ) * Real.log n ≤
      Real.log ((n : ℝ) + 1) + 1

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.prescribed_function_probability_le
statement:
lemma prescribed_function_probability_le {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
    (hn : 0 < Fintype.card α) (s : Finset α) (f : α → α) :
    ((Finset.univ.filter (fun τ : Equiv.Perm α => ∀ x ∈ s, τ x = f x)).card : ℝ) /
      Fintype.card (Equiv.Perm α) ≤ (Real.exp 1 / Fintype.card α) ^ s.card

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.uniformProbability_all
statement:
lemma uniformProbability_all {ι α : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype α] [DecidableEq ι]
    (P : ι → α → Prop) :
    uniformProbability (fun f : ι → α => ∀ i, P i (f i)) =
      ∏ i, uniformProbability (P i)

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.uniformProbability_def
statement:
lemma uniformProbability_def {α : Type*} [Fintype α] (P : α → Prop)
    [DecidablePred P] :
    uniformProbability P = ((Finset.univ.filter P).card : ℝ) / Fintype.card α

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.uniformProbability_eq_zero
statement:
lemma uniformProbability_eq_zero {α : Type*} [Fintype α] (P : α → Prop)
    (h : ¬ ∃ x, P x) : uniformProbability P = 0

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.uniformProbability_nonneg
statement:
lemma uniformProbability_nonneg {α : Type*} [Fintype α] (P : α → Prop) :
    0 ≤ uniformProbability P

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.lists_incidence_count
statement:
lemma lists_incidence_count {α β : Type*} [Fintype α] [Fintype β] [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β]

    (S : β × β → Finset α) (r : α → Equiv.Perm β) (hr : MeetsLists S r) :
    ∑ i, (Finset.univ.filter (fun j => i ∈ S (j, r i j))).card =
      ∑ b, (S b).card

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.uniformMean_const_mul
statement:
lemma uniformMean_const_mul {α : Type*} [Fintype α] (a : ℝ) (f : α → ℝ) :
    uniformMean (fun x => a * f x) = a * uniformMean f

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.uniformMean_indicator
statement:
lemma uniformMean_indicator {α : Type*} [Fintype α] (P : α → Prop) [DecidablePred P] :
    uniformMean (fun x => if P x then 1 else 0) = uniformProbability P

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.uniformMean_mono
statement:
lemma uniformMean_mono {α : Type*} [Fintype α] {f g : α → ℝ} (h : ∀ x, f x ≤ g x) :
    uniformMean f ≤ uniformMean g

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.uniformMean_sum
statement:
lemma uniformMean_sum {α β : Type*} [Fintype α] [Fintype β] (f : α → β → ℝ) :
    uniformMean (fun x => ∑ y, f x y) = ∑ y, uniformMean (fun x => f x y)

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.cell_clump_exp_le
statement:
lemma cell_clump_exp_le {α β : Type*} [Fintype α] [Fintype β] [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β]
    (H z : ℝ) (hH : 0 ≤ H) (r : α → Equiv.Perm β) (b : β × β) :
    Real.exp (z * (if H < (cellRows r b).card then ((cellRows r b).card : ℝ) else 0)) ≤
      ∑ s : Finset α, clumpWeight H z s *
        (if ∀ i ∈ s, r i b.1 = b.2 then 1 else 0)

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.clumpWeight_nonneg
statement:
lemma clumpWeight_nonneg {α : Type*} (H z : ℝ) (s : Finset α) :
    0 ≤ clumpWeight H z s

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.clump_expansion
statement:
lemma clump_expansion {α β : Type*} [Fintype α] [Fintype β] [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β]
    (H z : ℝ) (r : α → Equiv.Perm β) :
    (∏ b : β × β, ∑ s : Finset α, clumpWeight H z s *
      (if ∀ i ∈ s, r i b.1 = b.2 then 1 else 0)) =
    ∑ S : β × β → Finset α, (∏ b, clumpWeight H z (S b)) *
      (if MeetsLists S r then 1 else 0)

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.binomial_large_size_sum
statement:
lemma binomial_large_size_sum (a : ℕ) (H t : ℝ) (hH : 0 ≤ H) (ht : 0 ≤ t)
    (hsmall : Real.exp 2 * a * t ≤ H) :
    (∑ h ∈ Finset.range (a + 1),
      if h = 0 then (1 : ℝ) else if H < h then (a.choose h : ℝ) * t ^ h else 0) ≤
        1 + (a + 1 : ℕ) * Real.exp (-H)

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.binomial_large_size_term
statement:
lemma binomial_large_size_term (a h : ℕ) (H t : ℝ) (hH : 0 ≤ H) (ht : 0 ≤ t)
    (hsmall : Real.exp 2 * a * t ≤ H) (hh : H < h) :
    (a.choose h : ℝ) * t ^ h ≤ Real.exp (-H)

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.choose_poisson_bound
statement:
lemma choose_poisson_bound (a h : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    (a.choose h : ℝ) * t ^ h ≤ (Real.exp 1 * a * t / h) ^ h

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.clumpWeight_eq_card
statement:
lemma clumpWeight_eq_card {α : Type*} (H z : ℝ) (s : Finset α) :
    clumpWeight H z s =
      if s.card = 0 then 1 else if H < s.card then Real.exp (z * s.card) else 0

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.clump_subset_sum
statement:
lemma clump_subset_sum {α : Type*} [Fintype α] (H z ρ : ℝ) :
    (∑ s : Finset α, clumpWeight H z s * ρ ^ s.card) =
      ∑ h ∈ Finset.range (Fintype.card α + 1),
        if h = 0 then 1 else if H < h then
          (Nat.choose (Fintype.card α) h : ℝ) * (Real.exp z * ρ) ^ h else 0

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.sum_finset_card
statement:
lemma sum_finset_card {α : Type*} [Fintype α] (f : ℕ → ℝ) :
    (∑ s : Finset α, f s.card) =
      ∑ h ∈ Finset.range (Fintype.card α + 1), (Nat.choose (Fintype.card α) h : ℝ) * f h

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.clump_polynomial_parameter
OAI.ThorpCompatibility.clump_small_parameter
statement:
lemma clump_small_parameter {m : ℝ} (hm : 1 ≤ m) {A D : ℕ}
    (hA : (A : ℝ) ≤ 2*m) (hD : m/2 ≤ D)
    (hp : 4 * Real.exp 3 * m ^ (1/400 : ℝ) ≤ m ^ (1/100 : ℝ)) :
    Real.exp 2 * A * (Real.exp (1/400 * Real.log m) * (Real.exp 1 / D)) ≤
      m ^ (1/100 : ℝ)

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.eventual_clump_parameters
statement:
lemma eventual_clump_parameters :
    ∀ᶠ m : ℝ in atTop, 1 ≤ m ∧
      4 * Real.exp 3 * m ^ (1 / 400 : ℝ) ≤ m ^ (1 / 100 : ℝ) ∧
      12 * m ^ (3 : ℕ) * Real.exp (-(m ^ (1 / 100 : ℝ))) ≤ Real.log 2

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.average_columnCost_lower
statement:
lemma average_columnCost_lower {A D : ℕ} (hD : 2 ≤ D) (Q : Law (Grid A D))
    (a : Grid A D) (hQa : 0 < Q.mass a) (ha : Compatible a.1 a.2)
    {H K : ℝ} (hH : 0 ≤ H) (hK : 0 ≤ K) (k : Fin D) (i : Fin A) :
    1 - exposureError A D H K i - 2 * entryHeavyMass Q H k i a -
      (if ¬columnLight Q H k i (colHistory k i a) (a.2 k i) then 1 else 0) -
      (if K < (entryClumpSize k i a : ℝ) then 1 else 0) ≤
      (Law.uniform : Law (Equiv.Perm (Fin D))).mean (fun e => columnCost Q H e k i a)

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.entryHeavyMass_nonneg
statement:
lemma entryHeavyMass_nonneg {A D : ℕ} (Q : Law (Grid A D)) (H : ℝ)
    (k : Fin D) (i : Fin A) (a : Grid A D) : 0 ≤ entryHeavyMass Q H k i a

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.mean_columnCost_lower
statement:
lemma mean_columnCost_lower {A D : ℕ} (hD : 2 ≤ D) (Q : Law (Grid A D))
    (hQ : ∀ a, 0 < Q.mass a → Compatible a.1 a.2)
    {H K : ℝ} (hH : 0 ≤ H) (hK : 0 ≤ K) (k : Fin D) (i : Fin A) :
    1 - exposureError A D H K i - 3 * Q.mean (entryHeavyMass Q H k i) -
      Q.mean (fun a => if K < (entryClumpSize k i a : ℝ) then 1 else 0) ≤
      (Law.uniform : Law (Equiv.Perm (Fin D))).mean (fun e => Q.mean (columnCost Q H e k i))

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.mean_entry_heavy
statement:
lemma mean_entry_heavy {A D : ℕ} (Q : Law (Grid A D)) (H : ℝ) (k : Fin D) (i : Fin A) :
    Q.mean (entryHeavyMass Q H k i) =
      Q.mean (fun a => if ¬columnLight Q H k i (colHistory k i a) (a.2 k i) then 1 else 0)

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.cellRows_weight_sum
statement:
lemma cellRows_weight_sum {α β : Type*} [Fintype α] [Fintype β]
    (r : α → Equiv.Perm β) (v : β × β → ℝ) :
    (∑ i : α, ∑ j : β, v (j, r i j)) =
      ∑ b : β × β, (cellRows r b).card * v b

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.clumpCount_eq_entries
statement:
lemma clumpCount_eq_entries {A D : ℕ} (K : ℝ) (a : Grid A D) :
    (∑ k : Fin D, ∑ i : Fin A, if K < (entryClumpSize k i a : ℝ) then 1 else 0) =
      (clumpCount K a.1 : ℝ)

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.grid_deficit_decomposition
statement:
lemma grid_deficit_decomposition {A D : ℕ} (Q : Law (Grid A D)) :
    Q.uniformDeficit = (Q.map Prod.fst).uniformDeficit +
      (∑ k : Fin D, (Q.map (fun a => a.2 k)).uniformDeficit) +
        ((Q.map Prod.fst).entropy + (∑ k : Fin D, (Q.map (fun a => a.2 k)).entropy) - Q.entropy)

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.grid_entropy_charge
statement:
lemma grid_entropy_charge {A D : ℕ} (hD : 2 ≤ D) (Q : Law (Grid A D))
    (hQ : ∀ a, 0 < Q.mass a → Compatible a.1 a.2)
    {H K : ℝ} (hH : 0 ≤ H) (hK : 0 ≤ K) :
    (A : ℝ) * D - totalExposureError A D H K -
      3 * (∑ k : Fin D, ∑ i : Fin A, Q.mean (entryHeavyMass Q H k i)) -
      Q.mean (fun a => (clumpCount K a.1 : ℝ)) ≤
      (Q.map Prod.fst).entropy + (∑ k : Fin D, (Q.map (fun a => a.2 k)).entropy) - Q.entropy

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.mean_clumpCount_eq_entries
statement:
lemma mean_clumpCount_eq_entries {A D : ℕ} (Q : Law (Grid A D)) (K : ℝ) :
    (∑ k : Fin D, ∑ i : Fin A,
      Q.mean (fun a => if K < (entryClumpSize k i a : ℝ) then 1 else 0)) =
      Q.mean (fun a => (clumpCount K a.1 : ℝ))

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.sum_exposureError
statement:
lemma sum_exposureError {A D : ℕ} (hD : 0 < D) (H K : ℝ) :
    (∑ _ : Fin D, ∑ i : Fin A, exposureError A D H K i) =
      totalExposureError A D H K

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.entropy_uniformOn_comparison
statement:
lemma entropy_uniformOn_comparison (P : Law α) (s : Finset α) (hs : s.Nonempty)
    (hz : ∀ a, a ∉ s → P.mass a = 0) :
    P.relativeEntropy (uniformOn s hs) = Real.log (s.card : ℝ) - P.entropy

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.heavy_mass_uniformOn
statement:
lemma heavy_mass_uniformOn (P : Law α) (s : Finset α) (hs : s.Nonempty)
    (hz : ∀ a, a ∉ s → P.mass a = 0) {H : ℝ} (hH : 0 < H) :
    (Real.log H - 1) * P.prob (fun a => H / (s.card : ℝ) < P.mass a) ≤
      Real.log (s.card : ℝ) - P.entropy

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.mean_neg
statement: lemma mean_neg (P : Law α) (f : α → ℝ) : P.mean (fun a => -f a) = -P.mean f

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.mean_prediction_entropy
statement:
lemma mean_prediction_entropy {β γ : Type*} [Fintype β] [Fintype γ]
    (P : Law α) (X : α → β) (Y : α → γ) :
    P.mean (fun a => (P.predict X Y (Y a)).entropy) = P.condEntropy X Y

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.card_remainingValues
statement:
lemma card_remainingValues {A : ℕ} (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin A)) (i : Fin A) :
    (remainingValues σ i).card = A - (i : ℕ)

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.columnPrediction_unused
statement:
lemma columnPrediction_unused {A D : ℕ} (Q : Law (Grid A D)) (k : Fin D) (i : Fin A)
    (a : Grid A D) (hQa : 0 < Q.mass a) (w : Fin A) (hw : w ∉ remainingValues (a.2 k) i) :
    (columnPrediction Q k i (colHistory k i a)).mass w = 0

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.column_heavy_bound
statement:
lemma column_heavy_bound {A D : ℕ} (Q : Law (Grid A D)) (k : Fin D)
    {H : ℝ} (hH : 0 < H) :
    (Real.log H - 1) * (∑ i : Fin A, Q.mean (entryHeavyMass Q H k i)) ≤
      (Q.map (fun a => a.2 k)).uniformDeficit

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.entry_heavy_mass_bound
statement:
lemma entry_heavy_mass_bound {A D : ℕ} (Q : Law (Grid A D)) (k : Fin D) (i : Fin A)
    (a : Grid A D) (hQa : 0 < Q.mass a) {H : ℝ} (hH : 0 < H) :
    (Real.log H - 1) * entryHeavyMass Q H k i a ≤
      Real.log ((A - (i : ℕ) : ℕ) : ℝ) -
        (columnPrediction Q k i (colHistory k i a)).entropy

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.mean_entry_heavy_bound
statement:
lemma mean_entry_heavy_bound {A D : ℕ} (Q : Law (Grid A D)) (k : Fin D) (i : Fin A)
    {H : ℝ} (hH : 0 < H) :
    (Real.log H - 1) * Q.mean (entryHeavyMass Q H k i) ≤
      Real.log ((A - (i : ℕ) : ℕ) : ℝ) -
        Q.condEntropy (fun a => a.2 k i) (colHistory k i)

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.mem_remainingValues
statement:
lemma mem_remainingValues {A : ℕ} (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin A)) (i w : Fin A) :
    w ∈ remainingValues σ i ↔ i ≤ σ.symm w

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.remainingValues_nonempty
statement:
lemma remainingValues_nonempty {A : ℕ} (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin A)) (i : Fin A) :
    (remainingValues σ i).Nonempty

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.absorb_entropy_losses
statement:
lemma absorb_entropy_losses {ell R r C M T J n E : ℝ}
    (hl : 1000 ≤ ell) (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hR : r ≤ R) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hM : ell * M ≤ 200 * C) (hT : ell * T ≤ 400 * R + 400)
    (hJ : R + C + n - E - 3*M - T ≤ J) :
    n - E - 1 + (1 - 1000/ell) * (r+C) ≤ J

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.clump_deficit_bound
statement:
lemma clump_deficit_bound {A D : ℕ} (Q : Law (Grid A D)) (m : ℝ)
    (hmgf : uniformMean (fun r : Rows A D =>
      Real.exp ((1/400 * Real.log m) * clumpCount (m^(1/100:ℝ)) r)) ≤ 2) :
    Real.log m * Q.mean (fun a => (clumpCount (m^(1/100:ℝ)) a.1 : ℝ)) ≤
      400 * jointRowDeficit Q + 400

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.colDeficit_nonneg
statement: lemma colDeficit_nonneg {A D : ℕ} (Q : Law (Grid A D)) : 0 ≤ colDeficit Q

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.heavyTotal_log_bound
OAI.ThorpCompatibility.heavyTotal_nonneg
statement:
lemma heavyTotal_nonneg {A D : ℕ} (Q : Law (Grid A D)) (H : ℝ) :
    0 ≤ heavyTotal Q H

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.rowDeficit_le_joint
statement:
lemma rowDeficit_le_joint {A D : ℕ} (Q : Law (Grid A D)) :
    rowDeficit Q ≤ jointRowDeficit Q

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.rowDeficit_nonneg
statement: lemma rowDeficit_nonneg {A D : ℕ} (Q : Law (Grid A D)) : 0 ≤ rowDeficit Q

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.grid_entropy_estimate
statement:
lemma grid_entropy_estimate {A D : ℕ} (hD : 2 ≤ D) (Q : Law (Grid A D))
    (hQ : ∀ a, 0 < Q.mass a → Compatible a.1 a.2) {m : ℝ}
    (hm : 0 < m) (hl : 1000 ≤ Real.log m)
    (hmgf : uniformMean (fun r : Rows A D =>
      Real.exp ((1/400 * Real.log m) * clumpCount (m^(1/100:ℝ)) r)) ≤ 2) :
    (A : ℝ)*D - totalExposureError A D (m^(1/100:ℝ)) (m^(1/100:ℝ)) - 1 +
      (1 - 1000/Real.log m) * (rowDeficit Q + colDeficit Q) ≤ Q.uniformDeficit

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.entropy_normalization_error
statement:
lemma entropy_normalization_error {m : ℝ} (hm : 1 ≤ m) {A D : ℕ}
    (hA0 : 0 < A) (hD0 : 0 < D) (hA : (A:ℝ) ≤ 2*m) (hD : (D:ℝ) ≤ 2*m) :
    totalExposureError A D (m^(1/100:ℝ)) (m^(1/100:ℝ)) + 2 + 2*Real.log m ≤
      50000*m^(108/100:ℝ)

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.exposure_error_polynomial
statement:
lemma exposure_error_polynomial {m : ℝ} (hm : 1 ≤ m) {A D : ℕ}
    (hA0 : 0 < A) (hD0 : 0 < D) (hA : (A:ℝ) ≤ 2*m) (hD : (D:ℝ) ≤ 2*m) :
    totalExposureError A D (m^(1/100:ℝ)) (m^(1/100:ℝ)) ≤
      41820 * m * (m^(1/100:ℝ))^4

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.log_side_bound
statement:
lemma log_side_bound {m x : ℝ} (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hx : 0 < x) (hu : x ≤ 2*m) :
    1 + Real.log x ≤ 102 * m^(1/100:ℝ)

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.exists_mass_pos
statement: lemma exists_mass_pos (P : Law α) : ∃ x, 0 < P.mass x

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.tilt_log_partition
statement:
lemma tilt_log_partition [Nonempty α] (a : α → ℝ) (ha : ∀ x, 0 ≤ a x)
    (hZ : 0 < ∑ x, a x) :
    (Law.tilt a ha hZ).mean (fun x => Real.log (a x)) -
      (Law.tilt a ha hZ).uniformDeficit = Real.log (uniformMean a)

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.uniformMean_rpow_pos
statement:
lemma uniformMean_rpow_pos [Nonempty α] (P : Law α) (w : α → ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ x, 0 ≤ w x) (hs : ∀ x, w x = 0 → P.mass x = 0) (p : ℝ) :
    0 < uniformMean (fun x => (w x)^p)

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.weighted_gibbs_le
statement:
lemma weighted_gibbs_le [Nonempty α] (P : Law α) {θ : ℝ} (hθ : 0 < θ)
    (w : α → ℝ) (hw : ∀ x, 0 ≤ w x) (hs : ∀ x, w x = 0 → P.mass x = 0) :
    P.mean (fun x => Real.log (w x)) - θ*P.uniformDeficit ≤
      Real.log (marginalFactor θ w)

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.map_support_weight
statement:
lemma Law.map_support_weight {α β : Type*} [Fintype α] [Fintype β]
    (P : Law α) (f : α → β) (w : β → ℝ)
    (hs : ∀ a, 0 < P.mass a → 0 < w (f a)) (x : β) (hx : w x = 0) :
    (P.map f).mass x = 0

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.marginalFactor_pos
statement:
lemma Law.marginalFactor_pos {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [Nonempty α]
    (P : Law α) (θ : ℝ) (w : α → ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ x, 0 ≤ w x) (hs : ∀ x, w x = 0 → P.mass x = 0) :
    0 < marginalFactor θ w

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.compatibilityWeight_nonneg
statement:
lemma compatibilityWeight_nonneg {A D : ℕ}
    (w : Fin A → Equiv.Perm (Fin D) → ℝ)
    (v : Fin D → Equiv.Perm (Fin A) → ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ i σ, 0 ≤ w i σ) (hv : ∀ k σ, 0 ≤ v k σ) (a : Grid A D) :
    0 ≤ compatibilityWeight w v a

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.compatibilityWeight_support
statement:
lemma compatibilityWeight_support {A D : ℕ}
    (w : Fin A → Equiv.Perm (Fin D) → ℝ)
    (v : Fin D → Equiv.Perm (Fin A) → ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ i σ, 0 ≤ w i σ) (hv : ∀ k σ, 0 ≤ v k σ)
    {a : Grid A D} (ha : 0 < compatibilityWeight w v a) :
    Compatible a.1 a.2 ∧ (∀ i, 0 < w i (a.1 i)) ∧ (∀ k, 0 < v k (a.2 k))

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.compatibility_log_mean_bound
statement:
lemma compatibility_log_mean_bound {A D : ℕ} (hD : 2 ≤ D) {m : ℝ}
    (hm : 0 < m) (hl : 1000 ≤ Real.log m) (hθ : 0 < 1 - 1000/Real.log m)
    (hmgf : uniformMean (fun r : Rows A D =>
      Real.exp ((1/400 * Real.log m) * clumpCount (m^(1/100:ℝ)) r)) ≤ 2)
    (w : Fin A → Equiv.Perm (Fin D) → ℝ)
    (v : Fin D → Equiv.Perm (Fin A) → ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ i σ, 0 ≤ w i σ) (hv : ∀ k σ, 0 ≤ v k σ)
    (hZ : 0 < ∑ a : Grid A D, compatibilityWeight w v a) :
    Real.log (uniformMean (compatibilityWeight w v)) ≤
      -(A:ℝ)*D + totalExposureError A D (m^(1/100:ℝ)) (m^(1/100:ℝ)) + 1 +
      (∑ i, Real.log (marginalFactor (1-1000/Real.log m) (w i))) +
      (∑ k, Real.log (marginalFactor (1-1000/Real.log m) (v k)))

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.grid_log_weight_mean
statement:
lemma grid_log_weight_mean {A D : ℕ} (Q : Law (Grid A D))
    (w : Fin A → Equiv.Perm (Fin D) → ℝ)
    (v : Fin D → Equiv.Perm (Fin A) → ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ i σ, 0 ≤ w i σ) (hv : ∀ k σ, 0 ≤ v k σ)
    (hs : ∀ a, 0 < Q.mass a → 0 < compatibilityWeight w v a) :
    Q.mean (fun a => Real.log (compatibilityWeight w v a)) =
      (∑ i : Fin A, (Q.map (fun a => a.1 i)).mean (fun σ => Real.log (w i σ))) +
      (∑ k : Fin D, (Q.map (fun a => a.2 k)).mean (fun σ => Real.log (v k σ)))

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.grid_weight_variational
statement:
lemma grid_weight_variational {A D : ℕ} (Q : Law (Grid A D)) {θ : ℝ} (hθ : 0 < θ)
    (w : Fin A → Equiv.Perm (Fin D) → ℝ)
    (v : Fin D → Equiv.Perm (Fin A) → ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ i σ, 0 ≤ w i σ) (hv : ∀ k σ, 0 ≤ v k σ)
    (hs : ∀ a, 0 < Q.mass a → 0 < compatibilityWeight w v a) :
    Q.mean (fun a => Real.log (compatibilityWeight w v a)) - θ*(rowDeficit Q + colDeficit Q) ≤
      (∑ i, Real.log (marginalFactor θ (w i))) + (∑ k, Real.log (marginalFactor θ (v k)))

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.marginalFactor_nonneg
statement:
lemma marginalFactor_nonneg {α : Type*} [Fintype α] (θ : ℝ) (w : α → ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ x, 0 ≤ w x) : 0 ≤ marginalFactor θ w

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.log_normalizingFactor_upper
statement:
lemma log_normalizingFactor_upper (A D : ℕ) (hA : 0 < A) (hD : 0 < D) :
    Real.log ((Nat.factorial (A*D) : ℝ) /
      ((Nat.factorial D : ℝ)^A * (Nat.factorial A : ℝ)^D)) ≤
      (A:ℝ)*D + 1 + Real.log ((A:ℝ)*D)

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.weightedCompatibility_bound
statement:
lemma weightedCompatibility_bound {A D : ℕ} {m : ℝ}
    (hm : 4 ≤ m) (hmdef : m^2 = (A:ℝ)*D)
    (hl : 1000 ≤ Real.log m) (hθ : 0 < 1-1000/Real.log m)
    (hAl : m/2 ≤ A) (hAu : (A:ℝ) ≤ 2*m)
    (hDl : m/2 ≤ D) (hDu : (D:ℝ) ≤ 2*m)
    (hmgf : uniformMean (fun r : Rows A D =>
      Real.exp ((1/400 * Real.log m) * clumpCount (m^(1/100:ℝ)) r)) ≤ 2)
    (w : Fin A → Equiv.Perm (Fin D) → ℝ)
    (v : Fin D → Equiv.Perm (Fin A) → ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ i σ, 0 ≤ w i σ) (hv : ∀ k σ, 0 ≤ v k σ) :
    weightedCompatibility A D w v ≤
      Real.exp (50000*((A:ℝ)*D)^(54/100:ℝ)) *
        (∏ i, marginalFactor (1-1000/Real.log m) (w i)) *
        (∏ k, marginalFactor (1-1000/Real.log m) (v k))

name: OAI.Problem346.binary_power_factorization

    (r : ℕ) (hr : 0 < r) (x y : A) (c : ℂ) :
    ∃ z : Fin r → ℂ, (∏ i : Fin r, (x - z i • y)) = x ^ r + c • y ^ r

name: OAI.Problem346.symMonomialRaw_binary_power
statement:
theorem symMonomialRaw_binary_power (V : Type*) [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V]
    (r : ℕ) (hr : 0 < r) (x y : V) (c : ℂ) :
    ∃ v : Fin r → V, symMonomialRaw r V v =
      (SymmetricAlgebra.ι ℂ V x) ^ r + c • (SymmetricAlgebra.ι ℂ V y) ^ r

name: OAI.Problem346.symMonomialRaw_binary_power_mul
statement:
theorem symMonomialRaw_binary_power_mul (V : Type*) [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V]
    (r m : ℕ) (hr : 0 < r) (x y : V) (c : ℂ) (u : Fin m → V) :
    ∃ v : Fin (r + m) → V, symMonomialRaw (r + m) V v =
      ((SymmetricAlgebra.ι ℂ V x) ^ r + c • (SymmetricAlgebra.ι ℂ V y) ^ r) *
        symMonomialRaw m V u

name: OAI.Problem346.symMonomial_binary_power_mul
statement:
theorem symMonomial_binary_power_mul (V : Type*) [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V]
    (r m : ℕ) (hr : 0 < r) (x y : V) (c : ℂ) (u : Fin m → V) :
    ∃ v : Fin (r + m) → V, symMonomial (r + m) V v =
      symMonomial (r + m) V (Fin.append (fun _ : Fin r => x) u) +
        c • symMonomial (r + m) V (Fin.append (fun _ : Fin r => y) u)

theorem binary_diagonal_to_mixed_products (r m : ℕ) (hr : 0 < r)

    (hT : IsSymmetricMultilinearForm (r+1) (r+m) V T)
    (hdiag : ∀ y : Fin (r+m) → V, T (fun _ => symMonomial (r+m) V y) = 0)

name: OAI.Problem346.ShiftInjectivity.eq_zero_of_positive_weight
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_positive_weight (D E H : Module.End K M)
    (hDE : ∀ z, D (E z) = E (D z) - H z)
    (hHE : ∀ z, H (E z) = E (H z) + (2 : K) • E z)
    (x : M) (w : ℕ) (hw : 0 < w) (hx : H x = (w : K) • x)
    (hDx : D x = 0) (hnil : ∃ N : ℕ, (E ^ N) x = 0) : x = 0

name: OAI.Problem346.ShiftInjectivity.lowering_pow
statement:
theorem lowering_pow (D E H : Module.End K M)
    (hDE : ∀ z, D (E z) = E (D z) - H z)
    (hHE : ∀ z, H (E z) = E (H z) + (2 : K) • E z)
    (x : M) (w : K) (hx : H x = w • x) (hDx : D x = 0) (n : ℕ) :
    D ((E ^ (n + 1)) x) =
      (-((n + 1 : K) * (w + n))) • (E ^ n) x

name: OAI.Problem346.ShiftInjectivity.weight_pow
statement:
theorem weight_pow (E H : Module.End K M)
    (hHE : ∀ z, H (E z) = E (H z) + (2 : K) • E z)
    (x : M) (w : K) (hx : H x = w • x) (n : ℕ) :
    H ((E ^ n) x) = (w + 2 * (n : K)) • (E ^ n) x

name: OAI.Problem346.PolynomialShift.commutator
statement:
theorem commutator (src dst : B) (h : src ≠ dst) :
    ⁅derivation (K := K) (I := I) dst src, derivation (K := K) (I := I) src dst⁆ =
      derivation (K := K) (I := I) src src - derivation (K := K) (I := I) dst dst

name: OAI.Problem346.PolynomialShift.commutator_apply
statement:
theorem commutator_apply (src dst : B) (h : src ≠ dst)
    (p : MvPolynomial (B × I) K) :
    shift dst src (shift src dst p) - shift src dst (shift dst src p) =
      euler src p - euler dst p

name: OAI.Problem346.PolynomialShift.derivation_X
statement:
@[simp]
theorem derivation_X (src dst block : B) (i : I) :
    derivation (K := K) src dst (MvPolynomial.X (block, i)) =
      if block = src then MvPolynomial.X (dst, i) else 0

name: OAI.Problem346.PolynomialShift.shift_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem shift_apply (src dst : B) (p : MvPolynomial (B × I) K) :
    shift src dst p = derivation src dst p

name: OAI.Problem346.PolynomialShift.weight_commutator
statement:
theorem weight_commutator (src dst : B) (h : src ≠ dst) :
    ⁅derivation (K := K) (I := I) src src - derivation (K := K) (I := I) dst dst,
      derivation (K := K) (I := I) dst src⁆ = (2 : K) • derivation (K := K) (I := I) dst src

name: OAI.Problem346.exists_multilinear_extension_of_basis
statement:
theorem exists_multilinear_extension_of_basis
    {R I W : Type*} [Field R] [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
    {M X K : I → Type*} [∀ i, AddCommGroup (M i)] [∀ i, Module R (M i)]
    [AddCommGroup W] [Module R W]
    (s : ∀ i, X i → M i) (B : ∀ i, Basis (K i) R (M i))
    (t : ∀ i, K i → X i) (ht : ∀ i k, s i (t i k) = B i k)
    (F : (∀ i, X i) → W)
    (hlinear : ∀ x : ∀ i, X i, ∀ i,
      ∃ L : M i →ₗ[R] W, ∀ y, L (s i y) = F (Function.update x i y)) :
    ∃ G : MultilinearMap R M W, ∀ x : ∀ i, X i, F x = G (fun i => s i (x i))

    (s : ∀ i, X i → M i) (B : ∀ i, Basis (K i) R (M i))

name: OAI.Problem346.exists_symPow_lift_on_spanning

    (F : (Fin n → X) → W)
    (hlinear : ∀ x : Fin n → X, ∀ i : Fin n,
      ∃ L : V →ₗ[ℂ] W, ∀ y, L (s y) = F (Function.update x i y))
    (hsym : ∀ (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (x : Fin n → X),
      F (fun i => x (σ i)) = F x) :
    ∃ L : SymPow n V →ₗ[ℂ] W, ∀ x : Fin n → X,
      L (symMonomial n V (fun i => s (x i))) = F x

name: OAI.Problem346.DualEmbedding.exists_intertwining_injection_of_surjective
statement:
theorem exists_intertwining_injection_of_surjective {G : Type*}
    (e : E ≃ₗ[R] Module.Dual R E') (f : F ≃ₗ[R] Module.Dual R F')
    (A : G → E →ₗ[R] E) (B : G → F →ₗ[R] F)
    (A' : G → E' →ₗ[R] E') (B' : G → F' →ₗ[R] F')
    (he : ∀ g x z, e (A g x) z = e x (A' g z))
    (hf : ∀ g y w, f (B g y) w = f y (B' g w))
    (μ : E' →ₗ[R] F') (hμ : Function.Surjective μ)
    (hcomm : ∀ g, μ.comp (A' g) = (B' g).comp μ) :
    ∃ ι : F →ₗ[R] E, Function.Injective ι ∧
      ∀ g, (A g).comp ι = ι.comp (B g)
