theorem transpose_intertwines
    (e : E ≃ₗ[R] Module.Dual R E') (f : F ≃ₗ[R] Module.Dual R F')
    (μ : E' →ₗ[R] F') (A : E →ₗ[R] E) (A' : E' →ₗ[R] E')
    (B : F →ₗ[R] F) (B' : F' →ₗ[R] F')
    (he : ∀ x z, e (A x) z = e x (A' z))
    (hf : ∀ y w, f (B y) w = f y (B' w))
    (hμ : μ.comp A' = B'.comp μ) :
    A.comp (transpose e f μ) = (transpose e f μ).comp B

name: OAI.Problem346.EncodingDegree.blockHomogeneous_expansion
statement:
theorem blockHomogeneous_expansion [DecidableEq B]
    (c : (S → K) → R) (blocks : S → B) (b : B) :
    MvPolynomial.IsWeightedHomogeneous
      (fun x : B × K => if x.1 = b then 1 else 0)
      (∑ k : S → K, MvPolynomial.C (c k) *
        ∏ i : S, MvPolynomial.X (blocks i, k i))
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => blocks i = b)).card

name: OAI.Problem346.EncodingDegree.sum_weight_update
statement:
theorem sum_weight_update (blocks : S → B) (w : B → ℕ)
    (i : S) (b : B) :
    (∑ j : S, w ((Function.update blocks i b) j)) + w (blocks i) =
      (∑ j : S, w (blocks j)) + w b

name: OAI.Problem346.EncodingDegree.weightedHomogeneous_expansion
statement:
theorem weightedHomogeneous_expansion (c : (S → K) → R) (blocks : S → B)
    (w : B → ℕ) :
    MvPolynomial.IsWeightedHomogeneous (fun x : B × K => w x.1)
      (∑ k : S → K, MvPolynomial.C (c k) *
        ∏ i : S, MvPolynomial.X (blocks i, k i))
      (∑ i : S, w (blocks i))

name: OAI.Problem346.eval_multilinearPolynomial
statement:
theorem eval_multilinearPolynomial
    (L : MultilinearMap ℂ (fun _ : ι => V) ℂ)
    (e : κ → V) (block : ι → β) (z : β × κ → ℂ) :
    MvPolynomial.eval z (multilinearPolynomial L e block) =
      L (fun i => ∑ k, z (block i, k) • e k)

name: OAI.Problem346.eval_multilinearPolynomial_basis
statement:
theorem eval_multilinearPolynomial_basis
    (L : MultilinearMap ℂ (fun _ : ι => V) ℂ)
    (e : Module.Basis κ ℂ V) (block : ι → β) (v : β → V) :
    MvPolynomial.eval (fun z : β × κ => e.repr (v z.1) z.2)
      (multilinearPolynomial L e block) = L (fun i => v (block i))

name: OAI.Problem346.multilinearPolynomial_eq_zero
statement:
theorem multilinearPolynomial_eq_zero
    (L : MultilinearMap ℂ (fun _ : ι => V) ℂ)
    (e : κ → V) (block : ι → β)
    (h : ∀ v : β → V, L (fun i => v (block i)) = 0) :
    multilinearPolynomial L e block = 0

name: OAI.Problem346.multilinearPolynomial_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem multilinearPolynomial_eq_zero_iff
    (L : MultilinearMap ℂ (fun _ : ι => V) ℂ)
    (e : Module.Basis κ ℂ V) (block : ι → β) :
    multilinearPolynomial L e block = 0 ↔
      ∀ v : β → V, L (fun i => v (block i)) = 0

name: OAI.Problem346.multilinearPolynomial_perm
statement:
theorem multilinearPolynomial_perm
    (L : MultilinearMap ℂ (fun _ : ι => V) ℂ)
    (e : κ → V) (block : ι → β) (σ : Equiv.Perm ι)
    (hσ : ∀ x : ι → V, L (fun i => x (σ i)) = L x) :
    multilinearPolynomial L e (fun i => block (σ i)) =
      multilinearPolynomial L e block

name: OAI.Problem346.multilinearPolynomial_sum_updates
statement:
theorem multilinearPolynomial_sum_updates [DecidableEq ι]
    (L : MultilinearMap ℂ (fun _ : ι => V) ℂ)
    (e : κ → V) (block : ι → β) (s : Finset ι) (j : ι) (dst : β)
    (hlabel : ∀ i ∈ s, block i = block j)
    (hsym : ∀ i ∈ s, ∀ x : ι → V,
      L (fun k => x (Equiv.swap i j k)) = L x) :
    (∑ i ∈ s, multilinearPolynomial L e (Function.update block i dst)) =
      (s.card : ℂ) • multilinearPolynomial L e (Function.update block j dst)

name: OAI.Problem346.multilinearPolynomial_update_eq
statement:
theorem multilinearPolynomial_update_eq [DecidableEq ι]
    (L : MultilinearMap ℂ (fun _ : ι => V) ℂ)
    (e : κ → V) (block : ι → β) (i j : ι) (dst : β)
    (hij : block i = block j)
    (hsym : ∀ x : ι → V, L (fun k => x (Equiv.swap i j k)) = L x) :
    multilinearPolynomial L e (Function.update block i dst) =
      multilinearPolynomial L e (Function.update block j dst)

name: OAI.Problem346.SlotPolynomial.derivation_polynomial
statement:
theorem derivation_polynomial [DecidableEq B]
    (c : (S → I) → R) (l : S → B) (src dst : B)
    (D : Derivation R (MvPolynomial (B × I) R) (MvPolynomial (B × I) R))
    (hD : ∀ b i, D (MvPolynomial.X (b, i)) =
      if b = src then MvPolynomial.X (dst, i) else 0) :
    D (polynomial c l) =
      ∑ s ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun s => l s = src),
        polynomial c (Function.update l s dst)

name: OAI.Problem346.SlotPolynomial.derivation_polynomial_eq_card_smul
statement:
theorem derivation_polynomial_eq_card_smul [DecidableEq B]
    (c : (S → I) → R) (l : S → B) (src dst : B) (t : S) (ht : l t = src)
    (D : Derivation R (MvPolynomial (B × I) R) (MvPolynomial (B × I) R))
    (hD : ∀ b i, D (MvPolynomial.X (b, i)) =
      if b = src then MvPolynomial.X (dst, i) else 0)
    (hc : ∀ s, l s = src → ∀ k, c (k ∘ Equiv.swap s t) = c k) :
    D (polynomial c l) =
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun s => l s = src)).card •
        polynomial c (Function.update l t dst)

name: OAI.Problem346.SlotPolynomial.derivation_prod
statement:
theorem derivation_prod (D : Derivation R A A) (s : Finset S) (f : S → A) :
    D (∏ i ∈ s, f i) =
      ∑ i ∈ s, ∏ j ∈ s, Function.update f i (D (f i)) j

name: OAI.Problem346.SlotPolynomial.polynomial_reindex
statement:
theorem polynomial_reindex (c : (S → I) → R) (l : S → B) (e : Equiv.Perm S) :
    polynomial c (l ∘ e) = polynomial (fun k => c (k ∘ e)) l

name: OAI.Problem346.SlotPolynomial.polynomial_reindex_of_invariant
statement:
theorem polynomial_reindex_of_invariant (c : (S → I) → R) (l : S → B)
    (e : Equiv.Perm S) (hc : ∀ k, c (k ∘ e) = c k) :
    polynomial c (l ∘ e) = polynomial c l

name: OAI.Problem346.SlotPolynomial.polynomial_update_eq
statement:
theorem polynomial_update_eq (c : (S → I) → R) (l : S → B) (s t : S) (dst : B)
    (hl : l s = l t)
    (hc : ∀ k, c (k ∘ Equiv.swap s t) = c k) :
    polynomial c (Function.update l s dst) = polynomial c (Function.update l t dst)

name: OAI.Problem346.symMonomialMultilinearRaw_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem symMonomialMultilinearRaw_apply (v : Fin n → V) :
    symMonomialMultilinearRaw n V v = symMonomialRaw n V v

name: OAI.Problem346.tensorToSymPowRaw_range
statement:
theorem tensorToSymPowRaw_range :
    LinearMap.range (tensorToSymPowRaw n V) = symPowSubmodule n V

name: OAI.Problem346.tensorToSymPowRaw_tprod
statement:
@[simp] theorem tensorToSymPowRaw_tprod (v : Fin n → V) :
    tensorToSymPowRaw n V (PiTensorProduct.tprod ℂ v) = symMonomialRaw n V v

name: OAI.Problem346.tensorToSymPow_surjective
statement: theorem tensorToSymPow_surjective : Function.Surjective (tensorToSymPow n V)

name: OAI.Problem346.tensorToSymPow_tprod
statement:
@[simp] theorem tensorToSymPow_tprod (v : Fin n → V) :
    tensorToSymPow n V (PiTensorProduct.tprod ℂ v) = symMonomial n V v

name: OAI.Problem346.firstLabel_initial_zero_row
statement:
@[simp] theorem firstLabel_initial_zero_row (r m : ℕ) (j : Fin (r+m)) :
    firstLabel r m 0 (0,j) = some none

name: OAI.Problem346.firstLabel_succ_row
statement:
@[simp] theorem firstLabel_succ_row (r m k : ℕ) (i : Fin r) (j : Fin (r+m)) :
    firstLabel r m k (i.succ,j) =
      Fin.addCases (fun _ : Fin r => none) (fun j : Fin m => some (some j)) j

name: OAI.Problem346.firstLabel_zero_row
statement:
@[simp] theorem firstLabel_zero_row (r m k : ℕ) (j : Fin (r+m)) :
    firstLabel r m k (0,j) =
      if h : j.val < k ∧ j.val < m then some (some ⟨j.val,h.2⟩) else some none

name: OAI.Problem346.firstLabelCount_t
statement:
theorem firstLabelCount_t (r m k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ m) :
    firstLabelCount r m k (some none) = r + m - k

name: OAI.Problem346.firstLabelCount_x
statement: theorem firstLabelCount_x (r m k : ℕ) : firstLabelCount r m k none = r * r

name: OAI.Problem346.firstLabelCount_y
statement:
theorem firstLabelCount_y (r m k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ m) (y : Fin m) :
    firstLabelCount r m k (some (some y)) = r + if y.val < k then 1 else 0

name: OAI.Problem346.firstLabel_card
statement:
theorem firstLabel_card (r m k : ℕ) (c : FirstBlock m) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun p => firstLabel r m k p = c)).card =
      firstLabelCount r m k c

name: OAI.Problem346.firstLabel_card_t
statement:
theorem firstLabel_card_t (r m k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ m) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun p => firstLabel r m k p = some none)).card = r + m - k

name: OAI.Problem346.firstLabel_card_y
statement:
theorem firstLabel_card_y (r m k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ m) (y : Fin m) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun p => firstLabel r m k p = some (some y))).card =
      r + if y.val < k then 1 else 0

name: OAI.Problem346.firstLabel_card_y_next
statement:
theorem firstLabel_card_y_next (r m k : ℕ) (hk : k < m) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun p => firstLabel r m k p = some (some ⟨k, hk⟩))).card = r

name: OAI.Problem346.firstLabel_eq_t_iff
statement:
theorem firstLabel_eq_t_iff (r m k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ m)
    (p : Fin (r + 1) × Fin (r + m)) :
    firstLabel r m k p = some none ↔ p.1 = 0 ∧ k ≤ p.2.val

name: OAI.Problem346.firstLabel_step
statement:
theorem firstLabel_step (r m k : ℕ) (hk : k < m) :
    firstLabel r m (k + 1) = Function.update (firstLabel r m k)
      (0, ⟨k, Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hk (Nat.le_add_left m r)⟩) (some (some ⟨k, hk⟩))

name: OAI.Problem346.firstLabel_succ
statement:
@[simp] theorem firstLabel_succ (r m k : ℕ) (i : Fin r) (j : Fin (r + m)) :
    firstLabel r m k (i.succ, j) =
      Fin.addCases (fun _ : Fin r => none) (fun j : Fin m => some (some j)) j

name: OAI.Problem346.firstLabel_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem firstLabel_zero (r m k : ℕ) (j : Fin (r + m)) :
    firstLabel r m k (0, j) =
      if h : j.val < k ∧ j.val < m then some (some ⟨j.val, h.2⟩) else some none

name: OAI.Problem346.firstLabel_zero_eq_t_iff
statement:
theorem firstLabel_zero_eq_t_iff (r m k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ m) (j : Fin (r + m)) :
    firstLabel r m k (0, j) = some none ↔ k ≤ j.val

name: OAI.Problem346.firstLabel_zero_eq_y_iff
statement:
theorem firstLabel_zero_eq_y_iff (r m k : ℕ) (_hk : k ≤ m)
    (j : Fin (r + m)) (y : Fin m) :
    firstLabel r m k (0, j) = some (some y) ↔ j.val = y.val ∧ y.val < k

name: OAI.Problem346.firstLabel_zero_ne_x
statement:
@[simp] theorem firstLabel_zero_ne_x (r m k : ℕ) (j : Fin (r + m)) :
    firstLabel r m k (0, j) ≠ none

name: OAI.Problem346.flattenedForm_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem flattenedForm_apply {a b : ℕ} {V : Type u} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V]
    (T : SymmetricMultilinearForm a b V) (x : Fin a × Fin b → V) :
    flattenedForm T x = T (fun i => symMonomial b V (fun j => x (i, j)))

name: OAI.Problem346.flattenedForm_constant_columns
statement:
@[simp] theorem flattenedForm_constant_columns (T : SymmetricMultilinearForm a b V)
    (v : Fin b → V) :
    flattenedForm T (fun p => v p.2) =
      T (fun _ => symMonomial b V v)

name: OAI.Problem346.flattenedForm_constant_rows
statement:
@[simp] theorem flattenedForm_constant_rows (T : SymmetricMultilinearForm a b V)
    (v : Fin a → V) :
    flattenedForm T (fun p => v p.1) =
      T (fun i => symMonomial b V (fun _ => v i))

name: OAI.Problem346.flattenedForm_factor_perm
statement:
theorem flattenedForm_factor_perm (T : SymmetricMultilinearForm a b V)
    (σ : Fin a → Equiv.Perm (Fin b)) (v : Fin a × Fin b → V) :
    flattenedForm T (fun p => v (p.1, σ p.1 p.2)) = flattenedForm T v

name: OAI.Problem346.flattenedForm_permute
statement:
theorem flattenedForm_permute (a b : ℕ) (V : Type u)
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V] (T : SymmetricMultilinearForm a b V)
    (hT : IsSymmetricMultilinearForm a b V T)
    (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin a)) (τ : Fin a → Equiv.Perm (Fin b))
    (x : Fin a × Fin b → V) :
    flattenedForm T (fun p => x (σ p.1, τ p.1 p.2)) =
      flattenedForm T x

name: OAI.Problem346.flattenedForm_permute_factors
statement:
theorem flattenedForm_permute_factors (a b : ℕ) (V : Type u)
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V] (T : SymmetricMultilinearForm a b V)
    (σ : Fin a → Equiv.Perm (Fin b)) (x : Fin a × Fin b → V) :
    flattenedForm T (fun p => x (p.1, σ p.1 p.2)) =
      flattenedForm T x

name: OAI.Problem346.flattenedForm_permute_slots
statement:
theorem flattenedForm_permute_slots (a b : ℕ) (V : Type u)
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V] (T : SymmetricMultilinearForm a b V)
    (hT : IsSymmetricMultilinearForm a b V T)
    (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin a)) (x : Fin a × Fin b → V) :
    flattenedForm T (fun p => x (σ p.1, p.2)) =
      flattenedForm T x

name: OAI.Problem346.flattenedForm_row_perm
statement:
theorem flattenedForm_row_perm (T : SymmetricMultilinearForm a b V)
    (hT : IsSymmetricMultilinearForm a b V T) (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin a))
    (v : Fin a × Fin b → V) :
    flattenedForm T (fun p => v (σ p.1, p.2)) = flattenedForm T v

name: OAI.Problem346.flattenedSymmetricForm_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem flattenedSymmetricForm_apply (T : SymmetricMultilinearForm a b V)
    (v : Fin a × Fin b → V) :
    flattenedSymmetricForm T v =
      T (fun i => symMonomial b V (fun j => v (i, j)))

name: OAI.Problem346.flattenedSymmetricForm_inner_permute
statement:
theorem flattenedSymmetricForm_inner_permute
    (T : SymmetricMultilinearForm a b V)
    (σ : Fin a → Equiv.Perm (Fin b)) (v : Fin a × Fin b → V) :
    flattenedSymmetricForm T (fun p => v (p.1, σ p.1 p.2)) =
      flattenedSymmetricForm T v

name: OAI.Problem346.flattenedSymmetricForm_outer_permute
statement:
theorem flattenedSymmetricForm_outer_permute
    (T : SymmetricMultilinearForm a b V)
    (hT : IsSymmetricMultilinearForm a b V T)
    (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin a)) (v : Fin a × Fin b → V) :
    flattenedSymmetricForm T (fun p => v (σ p.1, p.2)) =
      flattenedSymmetricForm T v

name: OAI.Problem346.firstPolynomial_blockHomogeneous
statement:
theorem firstPolynomial_blockHomogeneous {r m : ℕ}
    (T : SymmetricMultilinearForm (r+1) (r+m) V) (e : κ → V)
    (k : ℕ) (u : FirstBlock m) :
    PolynomialWeights.IsBlockHomogeneous u (firstPolynomial T e k)
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun p => firstLabel r m k p = u)).card

name: OAI.Problem346.firstLabel_derivative
statement:
theorem firstLabel_derivative
    (r m k : ℕ) (hk : k < m) (V K : Type*)
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V] [Fintype K]
    (T : SymmetricMultilinearForm (r+1) (r+m) V) (e : K → V)
    (D : Derivation ℂ (MvPolynomial (FirstBlock m × K) ℂ)
      (MvPolynomial (FirstBlock m × K) ℂ))
    (hD : ∀ q j, D (MvPolynomial.X (q,j)) =
      if q = some none then MvPolynomial.X (some (some ⟨k,hk⟩),j) else 0) :
    D (multilinearPolynomial (flattenedForm T) e
        (firstLabel r m k)) =
      ((r+m-k : ℕ) : ℂ) •
        multilinearPolynomial (flattenedForm T) e
          (firstLabel r m (k+1))

name: OAI.Problem346.flattenedForm_swap_row
statement:
theorem flattenedForm_swap_row (a b : ℕ) (V : Type*)
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V] (T : SymmetricMultilinearForm a b V)
    (i : Fin a) (j k : Fin b) (x : Fin a × Fin b → V) :
    flattenedForm T (x ∘ Equiv.swap (i,j) (i,k)) =
      flattenedForm T x

name: OAI.Problem346.flattened_derivative_eq_card_smul
statement:
theorem flattened_derivative_eq_card_smul
    (a b : ℕ) (V K B : Type*) [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V]
    [Fintype K] [DecidableEq B]
    (T : SymmetricMultilinearForm a b V) (e : K → V)
    (l : Fin a × Fin b → B) (src dst : B) (i : Fin a) (j : Fin b)
    (hj : l (i,j) = src)
    (hrow : ∀ p, l p = src → p.1 = i)
    (D : Derivation ℂ (MvPolynomial (B × K) ℂ) (MvPolynomial (B × K) ℂ))
    (hD : ∀ q k, D (MvPolynomial.X (q,k)) =
      if q = src then MvPolynomial.X (dst,k) else 0) :
    D (multilinearPolynomial (flattenedForm T) e l) =
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun p => l p = src)).card •
        multilinearPolynomial (flattenedForm T) e
          (Function.update l (i,j) dst)

name: OAI.Problem346.multilinearPolynomial_eq_slotPolynomial
statement:
theorem multilinearPolynomial_eq_slotPolynomial
    {S K B V : Type*} [Fintype S] [DecidableEq S] [Fintype K]
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V]
    (T : MultilinearMap ℂ (fun _ : S => V) ℂ) (e : K → V) (l : S → B) :
    multilinearPolynomial T e l =
      SlotPolynomial.polynomial (fun k => T (fun s => e (k s))) l

name: OAI.Problem346.firstLabel_final_form
statement:
theorem firstLabel_final_form {r m : ℕ}
    (T : SymmetricMultilinearForm (r+1) (r+m) V) (x t : V) (y : Fin m → V) :
    flattenedForm T (fun p => firstVectors x t y (firstLabel r m m p)) =
      T (Fin.cons (symPowMul r m (symMonomial r V (fun _ => t)) (symMonomial m V y))
        (fun _ => symPowMul r m (symMonomial r V (fun _ => x)) (symMonomial m V y)))

name: OAI.Problem346.firstLabel_final_monomial
statement:
@[simp] theorem firstLabel_final_monomial (r m : ℕ) (x t : V) (y : Fin m → V) :
    symMonomial (r+m) V (fun j => firstVectors x t y (firstLabel r m m (0,j))) =
      symPowMul r m (symMonomial r V (fun _ => t)) (symMonomial m V y)

name: OAI.Problem346.firstLabel_initial_form
statement:
theorem firstLabel_initial_form {r m : ℕ}
    (T : SymmetricMultilinearForm (r+1) (r+m) V) (x t : V) (y : Fin m → V) :
    flattenedForm T (fun p => firstVectors x t y (firstLabel r m 0 p)) =
      T (Fin.cons (symMonomial (r+m) V (fun _ => t))
        (fun _ => symPowMul r m (symMonomial r V (fun _ => x)) (symMonomial m V y)))

name: OAI.Problem346.firstLabel_initial_monomial
statement:
@[simp] theorem firstLabel_initial_monomial (r m : ℕ) (x t : V) (y : Fin m → V) :
    symMonomial (r+m) V (fun j => firstVectors x t y (firstLabel r m 0 (0,j))) =
      symMonomial (r+m) V (fun _ => t)

name: OAI.Problem346.firstLabel_other_monomial
statement:
@[simp] theorem firstLabel_other_monomial (r m k : ℕ) (x t : V)
    (y : Fin m → V) (i : Fin r) :
    symMonomial (r+m) V (fun j => firstVectors x t y (firstLabel r m k (i.succ,j))) =
      symPowMul r m (symMonomial r V (fun _ => x)) (symMonomial m V y)

name: OAI.Problem346.firstPolynomial_final_eq_zero
statement:
theorem firstPolynomial_final_eq_zero {r m : ℕ}
    (T : SymmetricMultilinearForm (r+1) (r+m) V) (e : κ → V)
    (h : ∀ (x t : V) (y : Fin m → V),
      T (Fin.cons (symPowMul r m (symMonomial r V (fun _ => t)) (symMonomial m V y))
        (fun _ => symPowMul r m (symMonomial r V (fun _ => x)) (symMonomial m V y))) = 0) :
    firstPolynomial T e m = 0

name: OAI.Problem346.firstPolynomial_initial_vanishing
statement:
theorem firstPolynomial_initial_vanishing {r m : ℕ}
    (T : SymmetricMultilinearForm (r+1) (r+m) V) (e : Module.Basis κ ℂ V)
    (h : firstPolynomial T e 0 = 0) (x t : V) (y : Fin m → V) :
    T (Fin.cons (symMonomial (r+m) V (fun _ => t))
      (fun _ => symPowMul r m (symMonomial r V (fun _ => x)) (symMonomial m V y))) = 0

name: OAI.Problem346.firstVectors_t
statement:
@[simp] theorem firstVectors_t {m : ℕ} (x t : V) (y : Fin m → V) :
    firstVectors x t y (some none) = t

name: OAI.Problem346.firstVectors_x
statement:
@[simp] theorem firstVectors_x {m : ℕ} (x t : V) (y : Fin m → V) :
    firstVectors x t y none = x

name: OAI.Problem346.firstVectors_y
statement:
@[simp] theorem firstVectors_y {m : ℕ} (x t : V) (y : Fin m → V) (j : Fin m) :
    firstVectors x t y (some (some j)) = y j

name: OAI.Problem346.zero_of_upward_grid
statement:
theorem zero_of_upward_grid {ι M : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Zero M]
    (r : ℕ) (F : (ι → ℕ) → M)
    (hend : F (fun _ => r) = 0)
    (hstep : ∀ (c : ι → ℕ), (∀ i, c i ≤ r) → ∀ i, c i < r →
      F (Function.update c i (c i + 1)) = 0 → F c = 0)
    (c : ι → ℕ) (hc : ∀ i, c i ≤ r) : F c = 0

name: OAI.Problem346.canonical_foulkes_howe_a_one_aux
statement:
theorem canonical_foulkes_howe_a_one_aux (V : Type u)
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V] (b : ℕ) :
    ∃ μ : SymPow b (SymPow 1 V) →ₗ[ℂ] SymPow 1 (SymPow b V),
      IsFoulkesMap 1 b V μ ∧ Function.Bijective μ ∧
      ∀ ν : SymPow b (SymPow 1 V) →ₗ[ℂ] SymPow 1 (SymPow b V),
        IsFoulkesMap 1 b V ν → ν = μ

name: OAI.Problem346.foulkesFormula_one
statement:
@[simp] theorem foulkesFormula_one (b : ℕ) (V : Type u)
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V] (v : Fin b → Fin 1 → V) :
    foulkesFormula 1 b V v =
      symMonomial 1 (SymPow b V) (fun _ => symMonomial b V (fun j => v j 0))

name: OAI.Problem346.foulkesOneEquiv_isFoulkesMap
statement:
theorem foulkesOneEquiv_isFoulkesMap (b : ℕ) (V : Type u)
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V] :
    IsFoulkesMap 1 b V (foulkesOneEquiv b V).toLinearMap

name: OAI.Problem346.multilinear_cut_endpoint
statement:
theorem multilinear_cut_endpoint (r m : ℕ)
    (T : SymmetricMultilinearForm (r+1) (r+m) V)
    (x t : V) (v : Fin r → V) :
    T (Fin.cons (symMonomial (r+m) V (fun _ => t))
      (fun i => symMonomial (r+m) V (fun j => if j.val < r then x else v i))) =
    T (Fin.cons (symMonomial (r+m) V (fun _ => t))
      (fun i => symPowMul r m (symMonomial r V (fun _ => x))
        (symMonomial m V (fun _ => v i))))

name: OAI.Problem346.multilinear_cut_endpoint_zero
statement:
theorem multilinear_cut_endpoint_zero (r m : ℕ)
    (T : SymmetricMultilinearForm (r+1) (r+m) V)
    (h : ∀ x t : V, ∀ Q : Fin r → SymPow m V,
      T (Fin.cons (symMonomial (r+m) V (fun _ => t))
        (fun i => symPowMul r m (symMonomial r V (fun _ => x)) (Q i))) = 0)
    (x t : V) (v : Fin r → V) :
    T (Fin.cons (symMonomial (r+m) V (fun _ => t))
      (fun i => symMonomial (r+m) V (fun j => if j.val < r then x else v i))) = 0

name: OAI.Problem346.symMonomialRaw_cut
statement:
theorem symMonomialRaw_cut (r m : ℕ) (x y : V) :
    symMonomialRaw (r+m) V (fun j => if j.val < r then x else y) =
      SymmetricAlgebra.ι ℂ V x ^ r * SymmetricAlgebra.ι ℂ V y ^ m

name: OAI.Problem346.symMonomial_cut
statement:
theorem symMonomial_cut (r m : ℕ) (x y : V) :
    symMonomial (r+m) V (fun j => if j.val < r then x else y) =
      symPowMul r m (symMonomial r V (fun _ => x))
        (symMonomial m V (fun _ => y))

name: OAI.Problem346.IsFoulkesMap.commutes
OAI.Problem346.IsFoulkesMap.natural
OAI.Problem346.plethysmMap_comp
statement:
@[simp] theorem plethysmMap_comp (outer inner : ℕ) (g : W →ₗ[ℂ] U) (f : V →ₗ[ℂ] W) :
    plethysmMap outer inner (g.comp f) =
      (plethysmMap outer inner g).comp (plethysmMap outer inner f)

name: OAI.Problem346.plethysmMap_equiv
statement:
@[simp] theorem plethysmMap_equiv (outer inner : ℕ) (g : V ≃ₗ[ℂ] V) :
    plethysmMap outer inner g.toLinearMap = plethysmAction outer inner g

name: OAI.Problem346.plethysmMap_foulkesFormula
statement:
theorem plethysmMap_foulkesFormula (a b : ℕ) (f : V →ₗ[ℂ] W)
    (x : Fin b → Fin a → V) :
    plethysmMap a b f (foulkesFormula a b V x) =
      foulkesFormula a b W (fun j i => f (x j i))

name: OAI.Problem346.plethysmMap_id
statement:
@[simp] theorem plethysmMap_id (outer inner : ℕ) :
    plethysmMap outer inner (LinearMap.id : V →ₗ[ℂ] V) = LinearMap.id

name: OAI.Problem346.plethysmMap_symMonomial
statement:
@[simp] theorem plethysmMap_symMonomial (outer inner : ℕ) (f : V →ₗ[ℂ] W)
    (x : Fin outer → Fin inner → V) :
    plethysmMap outer inner f
        (symMonomial outer (SymPow inner V) (fun i => symMonomial inner V (x i))) =
      symMonomial outer (SymPow inner W)
        (fun i => symMonomial inner W (fun j => f (x i j)))

name: OAI.Problem346.permanentPairingLeft_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem permanentPairingLeft_apply (n : ℕ)
    (B : X →ₗ[ℂ] Y →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ) (x : Fin n → X) (y : Fin n → Y) :
    permanentPairingLeft n B y x = permanentPairing n (fun x y => B x y) x y

name: OAI.Problem346.permanentPairingMultilinear_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem permanentPairingMultilinear_apply (n : ℕ)
    (B : X →ₗ[ℂ] Y →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ) (x : Fin n → X) (y : Fin n → Y) :
    permanentPairingMultilinear n B x y =
      permanentPairing n (fun x y => B x y) x y

name: OAI.Problem346.permanentPairingMultilinear_perm_left
statement:
theorem permanentPairingMultilinear_perm_left (n : ℕ)
    (B : X →ₗ[ℂ] Y →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ) (x : Fin n → X) (τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) :
    permanentPairingMultilinear n B (fun i => x (τ i)) =
      permanentPairingMultilinear n B x

name: OAI.Problem346.permanentPairingMultilinear_perm_right
statement:
theorem permanentPairingMultilinear_perm_right (n : ℕ)
    (B : X →ₗ[ℂ] Y →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ) (x : Fin n → X) (y : Fin n → Y)
    (τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) :
    permanentPairingMultilinear n B x (fun i => y (τ i)) =
      permanentPairingMultilinear n B x y

name: OAI.Problem346.permanentPairingRight_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem permanentPairingRight_apply (n : ℕ)
    (B : X →ₗ[ℂ] Y →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ) (x : Fin n → X) (y : Fin n → Y) :
    permanentPairingRight n B x y = permanentPairing n (fun x y => B x y) x y

name: OAI.Problem346.permanentPairing_const_left
statement:
@[simp] theorem permanentPairing_const_left {X : Type u} {Y : Type v} (n : ℕ)
    (B : X → Y → ℂ) (x : X) (y : Fin n → Y) :
    permanentPairing n B (fun _ => x) y = ∏ i, B x (y i)

name: OAI.Problem346.permanentPairing_const_right
statement:
@[simp] theorem permanentPairing_const_right {X : Type u} {Y : Type v} (n : ℕ)
    (B : X → Y → ℂ) (x : Fin n → X) (y : Y) :
    permanentPairing n B x (fun _ => y) = ∏ i, B (x i) y

name: OAI.Problem346.permanentPairing_flip
statement:
theorem permanentPairing_flip {X : Type u} {Y : Type v} (n : ℕ)
    (B : X → Y → ℂ) (x : Fin n → X) (y : Fin n → Y) :
    permanentPairing n (fun y x => B x y) y x = permanentPairing n B x y

name: OAI.Problem346.permanentPairing_natural
statement:
theorem permanentPairing_natural {X : Type u} {Y : Type v}
    {X' : Type w} {Y' : Type z} (n : ℕ)
    (B : X → Y → ℂ) (B' : X' → Y' → ℂ)
    (f : X → X') (g : Y' → Y)
    (h : ∀ x y, B' (f x) y = B x (g y))
    (x : Fin n → X) (y : Fin n → Y') :
    permanentPairing n B' (fun i => f (x i)) y =
      permanentPairing n B x (fun i => g (y i))

name: OAI.Problem346.permanentPairing_perm_left
statement:
theorem permanentPairing_perm_left {X : Type u} {Y : Type v} (n : ℕ)
    (B : X → Y → ℂ) (x : Fin n → X) (y : Fin n → Y)
    (τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) :
    permanentPairing n B (fun i => x (τ i)) y = permanentPairing n B x y

name: OAI.Problem346.permanentPairing_perm_right
statement:
theorem permanentPairing_perm_right {X : Type u} {Y : Type v} (n : ℕ)
    (B : X → Y → ℂ) (x : Fin n → X) (y : Fin n → Y)
    (τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) :
    permanentPairing n B x (fun i => y (τ i)) = permanentPairing n B x y

name: OAI.Problem346.PlethysmDual.comparison_of_dual_charts
statement:
theorem comparison_of_dual_charts (a b : ℕ) [FiniteDimensional ℂ V]
    (e : SymPow b (SymPow a (Module.Dual ℂ V)) ≃ₗ[ℂ]
      Module.Dual ℂ (SymPow b (SymPow a V)))
    (f : SymPow a (SymPow b (Module.Dual ℂ V)) ≃ₗ[ℂ]
      Module.Dual ℂ (SymPow a (SymPow b V)))
    (he : ∀ (g : V ≃ₗ[ℂ] V) x y,
      e (plethysmAction b a g.dualMap x) y = e x (plethysmAction b a g y))
    (hf : ∀ (g : V ≃ₗ[ℂ] V) x y,
      f (plethysmAction a b g.dualMap x) y = f x (plethysmAction a b g y))
    (hsurj : ∃ μ : SymPow b (SymPow a (Module.Dual ℂ V)) →ₗ[ℂ]
      SymPow a (SymPow b (Module.Dual ℂ V)),
      IsFoulkesMap a b (Module.Dual ℂ V) μ ∧ Function.Surjective μ) :
    ∃ ι : SymPow a (SymPow b V) →ₗ[ℂ] SymPow b (SymPow a V),
      IsGLEquivariantEmbedding a b V ι

name: OAI.Problem346.PlethysmDual.exists_embedding_of_dual_surjection
statement:
theorem exists_embedding_of_dual_surjection (a b : ℕ)
    [Module.IsReflexive ℂ (SymPow b (SymPow a V))]
    [Module.IsReflexive ℂ (SymPow a (SymPow b V))]
    (e : SymPow b (SymPow a (Module.Dual ℂ V)) ≃ₗ[ℂ]
      Module.Dual ℂ (SymPow b (SymPow a V)))
    (f : SymPow a (SymPow b (Module.Dual ℂ V)) ≃ₗ[ℂ]
      Module.Dual ℂ (SymPow a (SymPow b V)))
    (he : ∀ (g : V ≃ₗ[ℂ] V) x y,
      e (plethysmAction b a g.dualMap x) y = e x (plethysmAction b a g y))
    (hf : ∀ (g : V ≃ₗ[ℂ] V) x y,
      f (plethysmAction a b g.dualMap x) y = f x (plethysmAction a b g y))
    (μ : SymPow b (SymPow a (Module.Dual ℂ V)) →ₗ[ℂ]
      SymPow a (SymPow b (Module.Dual ℂ V)))
    (hμ : Function.Surjective μ)
    (hcomm : ∀ g : V ≃ₗ[ℂ] V,
      μ.comp (plethysmAction b a g.dualMap) =
        (plethysmAction a b g.dualMap).comp μ) :
    ∃ ι : SymPow a (SymPow b V) →ₗ[ℂ] SymPow b (SymPow a V),
      IsGLEquivariantEmbedding a b V ι

name: OAI.Problem346.PlethysmDual.liftDualEquiv_adjoint
statement:
theorem liftDualEquiv_adjoint (n : ℕ) (e : W ≃ₗ[ℂ] Module.Dual ℂ V)
    (d : SymPow n (Module.Dual ℂ V) ≃ₗ[ℂ] Module.Dual ℂ (SymPow n V))
    (A : V →ₗ[ℂ] V) (A' : W →ₗ[ℂ] W)
    (he : ∀ x y, e (A' x) y = e x (A y))
    (hd : ∀ x y, d (symPowMap n A.dualMap x) y = d x (symPowMap n A y))
    (x : SymPow n W) (y : SymPow n V) :
    liftDualEquiv n e d (symPowMap n A' x) y =
      liftDualEquiv n e d x (symPowMap n A y)

name: OAI.Problem346.PlethysmDual.plethysmDualEquivOf_adjoint
statement:
theorem plethysmDualEquivOf_adjoint (outer inner : ℕ)
    (e : SymPow inner (Module.Dual ℂ V) ≃ₗ[ℂ] Module.Dual ℂ (SymPow inner V))
    (d : SymPow outer (Module.Dual ℂ (SymPow inner V)) ≃ₗ[ℂ]
      Module.Dual ℂ (SymPow outer (SymPow inner V)))
    (g : V ≃ₗ[ℂ] V)
    (he : ∀ x y, e (symPowMap inner g.dualMap.toLinearMap x) y =
      e x (symPowMap inner g.toLinearMap y))
    (hd : ∀ x y,
      d (symPowMap outer (symPowMap inner g.toLinearMap).dualMap x) y =
      d x (symPowMap outer (symPowMap inner g.toLinearMap) y))
    (x : SymPow outer (SymPow inner (Module.Dual ℂ V)))
    (y : SymPow outer (SymPow inner V)) :
    plethysmDualEquivOf outer inner e d
      (plethysmAction outer inner g.dualMap x) y =
    plethysmDualEquivOf outer inner e d x (plethysmAction outer inner g y)

name: OAI.Problem346.symPowDual_injective_of_pure_evaluation
statement:
theorem symPowDual_injective_of_pure_evaluation (n : ℕ)
    (B : SymPow n (Module.Dual ℂ V) →ₗ[ℂ] Module.Dual ℂ (SymPow n V))
    (hB : ∀ (p : SymPow n (Module.Dual ℂ V)) (x : V),
      B p (symMonomial n V (fun _ => x)) =
        SymmetricAlgebra.lift (Module.Dual.eval ℂ V x) p.val) :
    Function.Injective B

name: OAI.Problem346.PairingConstruction.comparison_of_surjection
statement:
theorem comparison_of_surjection [FiniteDimensional ℂ V] (a b : ℕ)
    (hsurj : ∃ μ : SymPow b (SymPow a (Module.Dual ℂ V)) →ₗ[ℂ]
      SymPow a (SymPow b (Module.Dual ℂ V)),
      IsFoulkesMap a b (Module.Dual ℂ V) μ ∧ Function.Surjective μ) :
    ∃ ι : SymPow a (SymPow b V) →ₗ[ℂ] SymPow b (SymPow a V),
      IsGLEquivariantEmbedding a b V ι

name: OAI.Problem346.PairingConstruction.dualEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem dualEquiv_apply [FiniteDimensional ℂ V] (n : ℕ)
    (p : SymPow n (Module.Dual ℂ V)) : dualEquiv V n p = dualMap V n p

name: OAI.Problem346.PairingConstruction.dualEquiv_natural
statement:
theorem dualEquiv_natural [FiniteDimensional ℂ V] (n : ℕ) (f : V →ₗ[ℂ] V)
    (p : SymPow n (Module.Dual ℂ V)) (q : SymPow n V) :
    dualEquiv V n (symPowMap n f.dualMap p) q =
      dualEquiv V n p (symPowMap n f q)

name: OAI.Problem346.PairingConstruction.dualMap_injective
statement:
theorem dualMap_injective [FiniteDimensional ℂ V] (n : ℕ) :
    Function.Injective (dualMap V n)

name: OAI.Problem346.PairingConstruction.dualMap_monomials
statement:
@[simp] theorem dualMap_monomials (n : ℕ)
    (x : Fin n → Module.Dual ℂ V) (y : Fin n → V) :
    dualMap V n (symMonomial n (Module.Dual ℂ V) x) (symMonomial n V y) =
      permanentPairing n (fun f v => f v) x y

name: OAI.Problem346.PairingConstruction.dualMap_natural
statement:
theorem dualMap_natural (n : ℕ) (f : V →ₗ[ℂ] V)
    (p : SymPow n (Module.Dual ℂ V)) (q : SymPow n V) :
    dualMap V n (symPowMap n f.dualMap p) q =
      dualMap V n p (symPowMap n f q)

name: OAI.Problem346.PairingConstruction.dualMap_pure
statement:
theorem dualMap_pure (n : ℕ) (p : SymPow n (Module.Dual ℂ V)) (x : V) :
    dualMap V n p (symMonomial n V (fun _ => x)) =
      SymmetricAlgebra.lift (Module.Dual.eval ℂ V x) p.val

name: OAI.Problem346.PairingConstruction.dual_finrank
statement:
theorem dual_finrank (n : ℕ) [FiniteDimensional ℂ V] :
    Module.finrank ℂ (SymPow n (Module.Dual ℂ V)) =
      Module.finrank ℂ (Module.Dual ℂ (SymPow n V))

name: OAI.Problem346.PairingConstruction.leftMultilinear_apply_monomial
statement:
@[simp] theorem leftMultilinear_apply_monomial (n : ℕ)
    (B : X →ₗ[ℂ] Y →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ) (x : Fin n → X) (y : Fin n → Y) :
    leftMultilinear n B x (symMonomial n Y y) =
      permanentPairing n (fun x y => B x y) x y

name: OAI.Problem346.PairingConstruction.leftMultilinear_symmetric
statement:
theorem leftMultilinear_symmetric (n : ℕ) (B : X →ₗ[ℂ] Y →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ)
    (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (x : Fin n → X) :
    leftMultilinear n B (fun i => x (σ i)) = leftMultilinear n B x

name: OAI.Problem346.PairingConstruction.pairing_monomials
statement:
@[simp] theorem pairing_monomials (n : ℕ) (B : X →ₗ[ℂ] Y →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ)
    (x : Fin n → X) (y : Fin n → Y) :
    pairing n B (symMonomial n X x) (symMonomial n Y y) =
      permanentPairing n (fun x y => B x y) x y

name: OAI.Problem346.span_diagonal_eq_span_range_of_detection
statement:
theorem span_diagonal_eq_span_range_of_detection
    {V : Type u} {W : Type v} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V]
    [AddCommGroup W] [Module ℂ W] (n : ℕ)
    (detect : ∀ T : MultilinearMap ℂ (fun _ : Fin n => V) ℂ,
      (∀ (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (x : Fin n → V), T (fun i => x (σ i)) = T x) →
      (∀ x : V, T (fun _ => x) = 0) → T = 0)
    (m : MultilinearMap ℂ (fun _ : Fin n => V) W)
    (hsym : ∀ (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (x : Fin n → V),
      m (fun i => x (σ i)) = m x) :
    Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range (fun x : V => m (fun _ => x))) =
      Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range m)

name: OAI.Problem346.multilinear_eq_zero_of_pure_powers
statement:
theorem multilinear_eq_zero_of_pure_powers (a b : ℕ) (V : Type u)
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V] {W : Type v} [AddCommGroup W] [Module ℂ W]
    (T : MultilinearMap ℂ (fun _ : Fin a => SymPow b V) W)
    (hT : ∀ x : Fin a → V, T (fun i => symMonomial b V (fun _ => x i)) = 0) :
    T = 0

name: OAI.Problem346.span_purePowers_eq_top
statement:
theorem span_purePowers_eq_top (b : ℕ) (V : Type u)
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V] :
    Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range (fun x : V => symMonomial b V (fun _ => x))) = ⊤

name: OAI.Problem346.symmetricMultilinearForm_eq_zero_of_pure_powers
statement:
theorem symmetricMultilinearForm_eq_zero_of_pure_powers (a b : ℕ) (V : Type u)
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V]
    (T : SymmetricMultilinearForm a b V)
    (hT : ∀ x : Fin a → V, T (fun i => symMonomial b V (fun _ => x i)) = 0) :
    T = 0

name: OAI.Problem346.SecondTransfer.label_succ_row
statement:
@[simp] theorem label_succ_row {r b : ℕ} (k : Fin r → ℕ)
    (i : Fin r) (j : Fin b) :
    label k (i.succ,j) = if j.val < k i then none else some i.succ

name: OAI.Problem346.SecondTransfer.label_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem label_zero {r b : ℕ} (p : Fin (r+1) × Fin b) :
    label (fun _ : Fin r => 0) p = some p.1

name: OAI.Problem346.SecondTransfer.label_zero_row
statement:
@[simp] theorem label_zero_row {r b : ℕ} (k : Fin r → ℕ) (j : Fin b) :
    label k (0,j) = some 0

name: OAI.Problem346.SecondTransfer.destination_card
statement:
theorem destination_card {r b : ℕ} (k : Fin r → ℕ)
    (hk : ∀ i, k i ≤ b) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun p : Fin (r+1) × Fin b => label k p = none)).card =
      ∑ i, k i

name: OAI.Problem346.SecondTransfer.destination_occurrences
statement:
theorem destination_occurrences {r b : ℕ} (k : Fin r → ℕ)
    (hk : ∀ i, k i ≤ b) :
    (∑ p : Fin (r+1) × Fin b, if label k p = none then 1 else 0) = ∑ i, k i

name: OAI.Problem346.SecondTransfer.destination_occurrences_lt_source
statement:
theorem destination_occurrences_lt_source {r b : ℕ} (k : Fin r → ℕ)
    (hb : r * (r+1) ≤ b) (hk : ∀ j, k j ≤ r)
    (i : Fin r) (hi : k i < r) :
    (∑ p : Fin (r+1) × Fin b, if label k p = none then 1 else 0) <
      ∑ p : Fin (r+1) × Fin b, if label k p = some i.succ then 1 else 0

name: OAI.Problem346.SecondTransfer.label_eq_source_iff
statement:
theorem label_eq_source_iff {r b : ℕ} (k : Fin r → ℕ)
    (i : Fin r) (p : Fin (r+1) × Fin b) :
    label k p = some i.succ ↔ p.1 = i.succ ∧ k i ≤ p.2.val

name: OAI.Problem346.SecondTransfer.source_card
statement:
theorem source_card {r b : ℕ} (k : Fin r → ℕ)
    (hk : ∀ i, k i ≤ b) (i : Fin r) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun p : Fin (r+1) × Fin b => label k p = some i.succ)).card =
      b-k i

name: OAI.Problem346.SecondTransfer.source_degree_gt_destination
statement:
theorem source_degree_gt_destination {r b : ℕ} (k : Fin r → ℕ)
    (hb : r * (r+1) ≤ b) (hk : ∀ j, k j ≤ r)
    (i : Fin r) (hi : k i < r) :
    (∑ j, k j) < b - k i

name: OAI.Problem346.SecondTransfer.source_occurrences
statement:
theorem source_occurrences {r b : ℕ} (k : Fin r → ℕ)
    (hk : ∀ i, k i ≤ b) (i : Fin r) :
    (∑ p : Fin (r+1) × Fin b, if label k p = some i.succ then 1 else 0) = b-k i

name: OAI.Problem346.SecondTransfer.independent_powers_zero_of_initial_polynomial_zero
statement:
theorem independent_powers_zero_of_initial_polynomial_zero
    {κ : Type*} [Fintype κ] {r b : ℕ}
    (T : SymmetricMultilinearForm (r+1) b V) (e : Module.Basis κ ℂ V)
    (h : multilinearPolynomial (flattenedSymmetricForm T) e
      (label (fun _ : Fin r => 0)) = 0) (v : Fin (r+1) → V) :
    T (fun i => symMonomial b V (fun _ => v i)) = 0

name: OAI.Problem346.SecondTransfer.initial_eval
statement:
theorem initial_eval {r b : ℕ} (T : SymmetricMultilinearForm (r+1) b V)
    (v : Block r → V) :
    flattenedSymmetricForm T (fun p => v (label (fun _ : Fin r => 0) p)) =
      T (fun i => symMonomial b V (fun _ => v (some i)))

name: OAI.Problem346.SecondTransfer.terminal_eval
statement:
theorem terminal_eval (r m : ℕ)
    (T : SymmetricMultilinearForm (r+1) (r+m) V) (v : Block r → V) :
    flattenedSymmetricForm T (fun p => v (label (fun _ : Fin r => r) p)) =
      T (Fin.cons (symMonomial (r+m) V (fun _ => v (some 0)))
        (fun i => symPowMul r m (symMonomial r V (fun _ => v none))
          (symMonomial m V (fun _ => v (some i.succ)))))

name: OAI.Problem346.SecondTransfer.terminal_eval_zero
statement:
theorem terminal_eval_zero (r m : ℕ)
    (T : SymmetricMultilinearForm (r+1) (r+m) V)
    (h : ∀ x t : V, ∀ Q : Fin r → SymPow m V,
      T (Fin.cons (symMonomial (r+m) V (fun _ => t))
        (fun i => symPowMul r m (symMonomial r V (fun _ => x)) (Q i))) = 0)
    (v : Block r → V) :
    flattenedSymmetricForm T (fun p => v (label (fun _ : Fin r => r) p)) = 0

name: OAI.Problem346.SecondTransfer.terminal_polynomial_zero
statement:
theorem terminal_polynomial_zero {κ : Type*} [Fintype κ] (r m : ℕ)
    (T : SymmetricMultilinearForm (r+1) (r+m) V) (e : κ → V)
    (h : ∀ x t : V, ∀ Q : Fin r → SymPow m V,
      T (Fin.cons (symMonomial (r+m) V (fun _ => t))
        (fun i => symPowMul r m (symMonomial r V (fun _ => x)) (Q i))) = 0) :
    multilinearPolynomial (flattenedSymmetricForm T) e (label (fun _ : Fin r => r)) = 0

name: OAI.Problem346.SecondTransfer.invariant_update_label_eq_progress
statement:
theorem invariant_update_label_eq_progress
    {r b : ℕ} {A : Type*}
    (F : ((Fin (r+1) × Fin b) → Block r) → A)
    (hF : ∀ (l : (Fin (r+1) × Fin b) → Block r)
      (σ : Fin (r+1) → Equiv.Perm (Fin b)),
      F (fun p => l (p.1, σ p.1 p.2)) = F l)
    (k : Fin r → ℕ) (i : Fin r) (hi : k i < b)
    (j : Fin b) (hj : k i ≤ j.val) :
    F (Function.update (label k) (i.succ,j) none) =
      F (label (Function.update k i (k i+1)))

name: OAI.Problem346.SecondTransfer.update_label_eq_progress_rowSwap
statement:
theorem update_label_eq_progress_rowSwap
    {r b : ℕ} (k : Fin r → ℕ) (i : Fin r) (hi : k i < b)
    (j : Fin b) (hj : k i ≤ j.val) (p : Fin (r+1) × Fin b) :
    Function.update (label k) (i.succ, j) none p =
      label (Function.update k i (k i+1))
        (p.1, rowFactorSwap i j ⟨k i, hi⟩ p.1 p.2)

name: OAI.Problem346.SecondTransfer.polynomial_row_permute
statement:
theorem polynomial_row_permute {κ : Type*} [Fintype κ] {r b : ℕ}
    (T : SymmetricMultilinearForm (r+1) b V) (e : κ → V)
    (l : Fin (r+1) × Fin b → Block r)
    (σ : Fin (r+1) → Equiv.Perm (Fin b)) :
    multilinearPolynomial (flattenedSymmetricForm T) e
        (fun p => l (p.1, σ p.1 p.2)) =
      multilinearPolynomial (flattenedSymmetricForm T) e l

name: OAI.Problem346.lowerProductForm_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem lowerProductForm_apply (r m : ℕ)
    (T : SymmetricMultilinearForm (r+1) (r+m) V) (x t : V)
    (Q : Fin r → SymPow m V) :
    lowerProductForm r m T x t Q =
      T (Fin.cons (symMonomial (r+m) V (fun _ => t))
        (fun i => symPowMul r m (symMonomial r V (fun _ => x)) (Q i)))

name: OAI.Problem346.lowerProductForm_symmetric

theorem lowerProductForm_symmetric (r m : ℕ)
    (T : SymmetricMultilinearForm (r+1) (r+m) V)
    (hT : IsSymmetricMultilinearForm (r+1) (r+m) V T) (x t : V) :
    IsSymmetricMultilinearForm r m V (lowerProductForm r m T x t)

name: OAI.Problem346.symmetric_form_curry_comp
statement:
theorem symmetric_form_curry_comp {r b m : ℕ}
    (T : SymmetricMultilinearForm (r+1) b V)
    (hT : IsSymmetricMultilinearForm (r+1) b V T)
    (z : SymPow b V) (L : SymPow m V →ₗ[ℂ] SymPow b V) :
    IsSymmetricMultilinearForm r m V ((T.curryLeft z).compLinearMap (fun _ => L))

name: OAI.Problem346.vanishing_on_products_one
statement:
theorem vanishing_on_products_one (V : Type u) [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V]
    (b : ℕ) (T : SymmetricMultilinearForm 1 b V)
    (h : ∀ u : Fin b → V, T (fun _ => symMonomial b V u) = 0) : T = 0

name: OAI.Problem346.vanishing_induction_from_transfer_steps
statement:
theorem vanishing_induction_from_transfer_steps
    (firstTransfer : ∀ r m : ℕ, 0 < r → 0 < m → (r+1)*r ≤ r+m →
      ∀ T : SymmetricMultilinearForm (r+1) (r+m) V,
      IsSymmetricMultilinearForm (r+1) (r+m) V T →
      (∀ y : Fin (r+m) → V, T (fun _ => symMonomial (r+m) V y) = 0) →
      ∀ x t : V, ∀ y : Fin m → V,
        lowerProductForm r m T x t (fun _ => symMonomial m V y) = 0)
    (secondTransfer : ∀ r m : ℕ, 0 < r → 0 < m → (r+1)*r ≤ r+m →
      ∀ T : SymmetricMultilinearForm (r+1) (r+m) V,
      IsSymmetricMultilinearForm (r+1) (r+m) V T →
      (∀ x t : V, ∀ Q : Fin r → SymPow m V, lowerProductForm r m T x t Q = 0) →
      ∀ v : Fin (r+1) → V,
        T (fun i => symMonomial (r+m) V (fun _ => v i)) = 0)
    (purePowerExt : ∀ a b : ℕ, ∀ T : SymmetricMultilinearForm a b V,
      (∀ v : Fin a → V, T (fun i => symMonomial b V (fun _ => v i)) = 0) → T = 0) :
    ∀ a b : ℕ, 1 ≤ a → 1 ≤ b → a*(a-1) ≤ b →
      ∀ T : SymmetricMultilinearForm a b V,
      IsSymmetricMultilinearForm a b V T →
      (∀ y : Fin b → V, T (fun _ => symMonomial b V y) = 0) → T = 0

name: OAI.Problem346.canonical_surjective_unique_of_vanishing
statement:
theorem canonical_surjective_unique_of_vanishing (a b : ℕ) (V : Type*)
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V]
    (hvan : ∀ T : SymmetricMultilinearForm a b V,
      IsSymmetricMultilinearForm a b V T →
      (∀ u : Fin b → V, T (fun _ => symMonomial b V u) = 0) → T = 0) :
    ∃ μ : SymPow b (SymPow a V) →ₗ[ℂ] SymPow a (SymPow b V),
      IsFoulkesMap a b V μ ∧ Function.Surjective μ ∧
      ∀ ν : SymPow b (SymPow a V) →ₗ[ℂ] SymPow a (SymPow b V),
        IsFoulkesMap a b V ν → ν = μ

name: OAI.Problem346.canonical_foulkes_howe_a_one
statement:
theorem canonical_foulkes_howe_a_one :
    ∀ (V : Type u) [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V] [FiniteDimensional ℂ V] (b : ℕ), ∃ μ : SymPow b (SymPow 1 V) →ₗ[ℂ] SymPow 1 (SymPow b V), IsFoulkesMap 1 b V μ ∧ Function.Bijective μ ∧ ∀ ν : SymPow b (SymPow 1 V) →ₗ[ℂ] SymPow 1 (SymPow b V), IsFoulkesMap 1 b V ν → ν = μ

name: OAI.Saxl.intertwining_finrank_pos_iff
statement:
theorem intertwining_finrank_pos_iff {G : Type uG} {V : Type uV} {W : Type uW} [Group G]
    [AddCommGroup V] [AddCommGroup W] [Module ℂ V] [Module ℂ W]
    [Module.Finite ℂ V] [Module.Finite ℂ W]
    (ρ : Representation ℂ G V) (σ : Representation ℂ G W) :
    0 < Module.finrank ℂ (Representation.IntertwiningMap ρ σ) ↔
      ∃ f : Representation.IntertwiningMap ρ σ, f ≠ 0

theorem kronecker_pos_iff {n : ℕ} {α β μ : YoungDiagram}

      ∃ f : Representation.IntertwiningMap (spechtRep t)
        ((spechtRep a).tprod (spechtRep b)), f ≠ 0

name: OAI.Saxl.columnAlt_collision

lemma columnAlt_row {n : ℕ} {μ : YoungDiagram} (t : Tableau n μ) :

name: OAI.Saxl.finset_eq_of_signed_sum

name: OAI.Saxl.signC_def

name: OAI.Tachikawa.mem_projectiveFactors_iff
statement:
lemma mem_projectiveFactors_iff (f : M →ₗ[R] N) :
    f ∈ projectiveFactors (k := k) ↔
    ∃ P : ModuleCat.{0} R, Module.Finite R P ∧ Module.Projective R P ∧
      ∃ i : M →ₗ[R] P, ∃ p : P →ₗ[R] N, p.comp i = f

name: OAI.Tachikawa.projectiveFactors_eq_range_postcompose
statement:
lemma projectiveFactors_eq_range_postcompose
    [Module.Finite R P] [Module.Projective R P]
    (p : P →ₗ[R] N) (hp : Function.Surjective p) :
    projectiveFactors (k := k) (M := M) = LinearMap.range (homPostcompose p)

name: OAI.Tachikawa.projectiveFactors_eq_range_precompose
statement:
lemma projectiveFactors_eq_range_precompose [Module.Injective R R]
    [Module.Finite R P] [Module.Projective R P]
    (i : M →ₗ[R] P) (hi : Function.Injective i) :
    projectiveFactors (k := k) (M := M) (N := N) = LinearMap.range (homPrecompose i)

name: OAI.Tachikawa.projectiveFactors_postcomp
OAI.Tachikawa.projectiveFactors_precomp
OAI.Tachikawa.projective_of_finite_injective
statement:
lemma projective_of_finite_injective (t : SymmetrizingForm (k := k) (R := R))
    [Module.Injective R M] : Module.Projective R M

name: OAI.Tachikawa.CokerAt.factorThrough_spec
statement:
lemma factorThrough_spec {L M N : Type} [AddCommGroup L] [AddCommGroup M] [AddCommGroup N]
    [Module R L] [Module R M] [Module R N]
    (i : M →ₗ[R] N) (hi : Function.Injective i) (f : L →ₗ[R] N)
    (hf : ∀ x, f x ∈ LinearMap.range i) :
    i.comp (factorThrough i hi f hf) = f

name: OAI.Tachikawa.ComplexExact.adjacent
statement:
lemma ComplexExact.adjacent (hex : ComplexExact P) (i j l : ℤ)
    (hi : i = j+1) (hl : l = j-1) :
    Function.Exact (P.d i j) (P.d j l)

name: OAI.Tachikawa.TotallyAcyclic.projective_boundaries
statement:
lemma projective_boundaries {N : Type} [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N]
    [Module.Finite R N] [Module.Projective R N] (j : ℤ) (f : P.X j →ₗ[R] N)
    (hf : f.comp (P.d (j+1) j).hom = 0) :
    ∃ g : P.X (j-1) →ₗ[R] N, g.comp (P.d j (j-1)).hom = f

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.AffineGeometry.affineSpaceIsoOfAlgEquiv_hom_over
statement:
theorem affineSpaceIsoOfAlgEquiv_hom_over {σ : Type u}
    (e : A ≃ₐ[k] MvPolynomial σ k) :
    (affineSpaceIsoOfAlgEquiv e).hom ≫
      (AffineSpace σ (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A))

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.AffineGeometry.ideal_map_of_specIso_image_zeroLocus
statement:
theorem ideal_map_of_specIso_image_zeroLocus
    (I : Ideal B) (J : Ideal A) (hI : I.IsRadical) (hJ : J.IsRadical)
    (e : Spec (CommRingCat.of B) ≅ Spec (CommRingCat.of A))
    (he : e.hom ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A)) =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k B)))
    (h : e.hom '' PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (I : Set B) =
      PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (J : Set A)) :
    I.map (algEquivOfSpecIso e he).symm.toRingHom = J

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.AffineGeometry.ideal_transport_iff_scheme_transport
statement:
theorem ideal_transport_iff_scheme_transport (I J : Ideal A)
    (hI : I.IsRadical) (hJ : J.IsRadical) :
    (∃ e : A ≃ₐ[k] A, I.map e.toRingHom = J) ↔
      ∃ e : Spec (CommRingCat.of A) ≅ Spec (CommRingCat.of A),
        (e.hom ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A)) =
          Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A))) ∧
        e.hom '' PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (I : Set A) =
          PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (J : Set A)

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.AffineGeometry.nonempty_algEquiv_iff_algebraSpecIso
statement:
theorem nonempty_algEquiv_iff_algebraSpecIso :
    Nonempty (A ≃ₐ[k] B) ↔ Nonempty (algebraSpec k B ≅ algebraSpec k A)

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.AffineGeometry.quotientEmbedding_range
statement:
theorem quotientEmbedding_range (I : Ideal A) :
    Set.range (quotientEmbedding I) = PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (I : Set A)

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.AffineGeometry.ringEquivOfSpecIso_apply
statement:
theorem ringEquivOfSpecIso_apply
    (e : Spec (CommRingCat.of B) ≅ Spec (CommRingCat.of A)) (a : A) :
    ringEquivOfSpecIso e a = Spec.preimage e.hom a

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.AffineGeometry.specIsoOfAlgEquiv_algEquivOfSpecIso
statement:
theorem specIsoOfAlgEquiv_algEquivOfSpecIso
    (e : Spec (CommRingCat.of B) ≅ Spec (CommRingCat.of A))
    (he : e.hom ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A)) =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k B))) :
    specIsoOfAlgEquiv (algEquivOfSpecIso e he) = e

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.AffineGeometry.specIsoOfAlgEquiv_hom_over
statement:
theorem specIsoOfAlgEquiv_hom_over (e : A ≃ₐ[k] B) :
    (specIsoOfAlgEquiv e).hom ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A)) =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k B))

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.AffineGeometry.specIso_image_zeroLocus_of_ideal_map
statement:
theorem specIso_image_zeroLocus_of_ideal_map
    (e : A ≃ₐ[k] B) (I : Ideal A) (J : Ideal B)
    (h : I.map e.toRingHom = J) :
    (specIsoOfAlgEquiv e.symm).hom ''
        PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (I : Set A) = PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (J : Set B)

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.affineAll_C
statement:
@[simp] theorem affineAll_C (a b : k) (ha : a ≠ 0) (c : k) :

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.affineAll_X
statement:
@[simp] theorem affineAll_X (a b : k) (ha : a ≠ 0) (i : σ) :

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.affineAll_symm_X

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.exists_equiv_eq_X_of_affine
statement:
theorem exists_equiv_eq_X_of_affine
    (p : MvPolynomial σ k) (i : σ) (a b : k) (ha : a ≠ 0)
    (φ : MvPolynomial σ k ≃ₐ[k] MvPolynomial σ k)
    (hφ : φ p = C a * X i + C b) :
    ∃ ψ : MvPolynomial σ k ≃ₐ[k] MvPolynomial σ k, ψ p = X i

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.exists_equiv_eq_X_of_sub_eq_scalar_mul
statement:
theorem exists_equiv_eq_X_of_sub_eq_scalar_mul

    (φ : MvPolynomial σ k ≃ₐ[k] MvPolynomial σ k)
    (hφ : φ (p - C t) = C a * X i) :
    ∃ ψ : MvPolynomial σ k ≃ₐ[k] MvPolynomial σ k, ψ p = X i

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.isCoordinate_of_equiv_sub_eq_scalar_mul_X
statement:
theorem isCoordinate_of_equiv_sub_eq_scalar_mul_X
    {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (p : R n) (t a : ℂ) (ha : a ≠ 0)
    (φ : R n ≃ₐ[ℂ] R n)
    (hφ : φ (p - C t) = C a * X ⟨0, hn⟩) :
    IsCoordinate hn p

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.isCoordinate_sub_C_iff
statement:
theorem isCoordinate_sub_C_iff {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (p : R n) (t : ℂ) :
    IsCoordinate hn (p - C t) ↔ IsCoordinate hn p

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.IteratedQuotient.equiv_mk_mk
statement:

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.IteratedQuotient.fiberEquiv_mk_mk
statement:

      (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (Ideal.Quotient.mk (relationIdeal A H) x)) =
        Ideal.Quotient.mk (pairIdeal A H (p - algebraMap k A lam)) x

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.IteratedQuotient.fiberEquiv_symm_mk
statement:
@[simp] theorem fiberEquiv_symm_mk (H p x : A) (lam : k) :
    (fiberEquiv k A H p lam).symm
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (pairIdeal A H (p - algebraMap k A lam)) x) =
        Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (Ideal.Quotient.mk (relationIdeal A H) x)

statement:
theorem coefficients_bezout (a d b c u : R) (h : a * c - b * d = 1) :
    coeffA a d b * (c ^ 2 - b ^ 2 * (a * b + u ^ 2)) +
      coeffB a d b u * b ^ 2 = 1

theorem exists_factor_of_mem (a d b c u : R) (h : a * c - b * d = 1)

    ∃ q : R, r = v a d b u * q

statement:
theorem f₀_factor (a d b c u : R) (h : a * c - b * d = 1) :

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.Bundle.generator_bezout
statement:
theorem generator_bezout (a d b c u : R) (h : a * c - b * d = 1) :

      v a d b u

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.Bundle.g₀_factor
statement:
theorem g₀_factor (a d b c u : R) (h : a * c - b * d = 1) :

    (e : A →+* Polynomial S) (he : Function.Injective e)
    (f : A →+* Polynomial T) (hf : Function.Injective f)

    ∃ m : ℤ,

    (g : ι → A) (d : ι → ℤ)
    (hg : Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range g) = ⊤)
    (hhom : ∀ i, g i ∈ 𝒜 (d i))
    (D : Derivation k A A) (hD : D ≠ 0)
    (E : ℤ → Derivation k A A)
    (hE : ∀ m i (x : A), x ∈ 𝒜 i →
      E m x = proj 𝒜 (i + m) (D x)) :
    ∃ m : ℤ, E m ≠ 0 ∧
      (∀ n, m < n → E n = 0) ∧
      (∀ i (x : A), x ∈ 𝒜 i → ∀ j, i + m < j → proj 𝒜 j (D x) = 0)

theorem derivation_iterate_top_mul (D : Derivation k A A) (a b : A) (m n : ℕ)

    (ha : a ≠ 0) (hu : u ≠ 0)
    (hminus : a * u - d ≠ 0) (hplus : a * u + d ≠ 0)
    (hv : D (a ^ 2 * u ^ 2 - d ^ 2) = 0) :
    D a = 0 ∧ D d = 0 ∧ D u = 0

    componentLinear 𝒜 D m x =
      ∑ i ∈ (DirectSum.decompose 𝒜 x).support, proj 𝒜 (i + m) (D (proj 𝒜 i x))

theorem componentLinear_mul (D : Derivation k A A) (m : ℤ) (x y : A) :

theorem exists_nonzero_locallyNilpotent_component
    (g : ι → A) (d : ι → ℤ)
    (hg : Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range g) = ⊤)
    (hhom : ∀ i, g i ∈ 𝒜 (d i))
    (D : Derivation k A A) (hD : D ≠ 0)
    (hln : ∀ x : A, ∃ n : ℕ, (D : A → A)^[n] x = 0) :
    ∃ m : ℤ, component 𝒜 D m ≠ 0 ∧
      HasShiftLE 𝒜 D.toLinearMap m ∧
      (∀ x : A, ∃ n : ℕ, ((component 𝒜 D m : A → A)^[n] x) = 0)

    {i j : ℤ} {x y : A} (hx : x ∈ 𝒜 i) (hy : y ∈ 𝒜 j)

    ∃ m : ℤ, component 𝒜 D m ≠ 0 ∧
      (∀ z : A, ∃ n : ℕ, ((component 𝒜 D m : A → A)^[n] z) = 0) ∧

statement:
theorem exists_nonzero_locallyNilpotent_component_compatible

      proj 𝒜 i (proj ℬ j x) = proj ℬ j (proj 𝒜 i x))
    (g : ι → A) (d : ι → ℤ)
    (hg : Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range g) = ⊤)
    (hhom : ∀ i, g i ∈ 𝒜 (d i))
    (D : Derivation k A A) (hD : D ≠ 0)
    (hln : ∀ x : A, ∃ n : ℕ, (D : A → A)^[n] x = 0)
    (hpres : ∀ (r : ℤ) (z : A), z ∈ ℬ r → D z ∈ ℬ r)
    {i j : ℤ} {x y : A} (hx : x ∈ 𝒜 i) (hy : y ∈ 𝒜 j)
    (hij : i < j) (hxy : D (x + y) = 0) :
    ∃ m : ℤ, component 𝒜 D m ≠ 0 ∧
      (∀ z : A, ∃ n : ℕ, ((component 𝒜 D m : A → A)^[n] z) = 0) ∧
      (∀ (r : ℤ) (z : A), z ∈ ℬ r → component 𝒜 D m z ∈ ℬ r) ∧

statement:
theorem exists_nonzero_lnd_fixing_a_d_u

    (hD : D ≠ 0) (hln : IsLocallyNilpotent D)
    (hpres : ∀ (n : ℤ) (x : C k), x ∈ fiberPiece k n → D x ∈ fiberPiece k n)
    (hv : D (v k) = 0) :
    ∃ E : Derivation k (C k) (C k), E ≠ 0 ∧ IsLocallyNilpotent E ∧
      (∀ (n : ℤ) (x : C k), x ∈ fiberPiece k n → E x ∈ fiberPiece k n) ∧
      E (cX k 0) = 0 ∧ E (cX k 1) = 0 ∧ E (cX k 4) = 0

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.Filtration.derivation_eq_zero_of_generator_values
statement:
theorem derivation_eq_zero_of_generator_values
    (φ : MvPolynomial (Fin 5) K →ₐ[K] A) (hφ : Function.Surjective φ)
    (D : Derivation K A A) (hD : ∀ i : Fin 5, D (φ (X i)) = 0) : D = 0

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.Filtration.derivation_imagePiece_le
statement:
theorem derivation_imagePiece_le
    (φ : MvPolynomial (Fin 5) K →ₐ[K] A) (D : Derivation K A A) (m : ℤ)
    (hD : ∀ i : Fin 5, D (φ (X i)) ∈
      imagePiece φ (monomialWeight (Finsupp.single i 1) + m))
    (d : ℤ) :
    imagePiece φ d ≤ (imagePiece φ (d + m)).comap D.toLinearMap

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.Filtration.derivation_monomial_mem_imagePiece
statement:
theorem derivation_monomial_mem_imagePiece
    (φ : MvPolynomial (Fin 5) K →ₐ[K] A) (D : Derivation K A A) (m : ℤ)
    (hD : ∀ i : Fin 5, D (φ (X i)) ∈
      imagePiece φ (monomialWeight (Finsupp.single i 1) + m))
    (s : Fin 5 →₀ ℕ) (c : K) :
    D (φ (monomial s c)) ∈ imagePiece φ (monomialWeight s + m)

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.Filtration.derivation_mul_mem_imagePiece
statement:
theorem derivation_mul_mem_imagePiece
    (φ : MvPolynomial (Fin 5) K →ₐ[K] A) (D : Derivation K A A)
    {a b : A} {d e m : ℤ}
    (ha : a ∈ imagePiece φ d) (hb : b ∈ imagePiece φ e)
    (hDa : D a ∈ imagePiece φ (d + m))
    (hDb : D b ∈ imagePiece φ (e + m)) :
    D (a * b) ∈ imagePiece φ (d + e + m)

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.Filtration.derivation_pow_mem_imagePiece
statement:
theorem derivation_pow_mem_imagePiece
    (φ : MvPolynomial (Fin 5) K →ₐ[K] A) (D : Derivation K A A)
    {a : A} {d m : ℤ}
    (ha : a ∈ imagePiece φ d) (hDa : D a ∈ imagePiece φ (d + m))
    (n : ℕ) : D (a ^ n) ∈ imagePiece φ (n • d + m)

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.Filtration.derivation_source_piece_mem_imagePiece
statement:
theorem derivation_source_piece_mem_imagePiece
    (φ : MvPolynomial (Fin 5) K →ₐ[K] A) (D : Derivation K A A) (m : ℤ)
    (hD : ∀ i : Fin 5, D (φ (X i)) ∈
      imagePiece φ (monomialWeight (Finsupp.single i 1) + m))
    {q : MvPolynomial (Fin 5) K} {d : ℤ} (hq : q ∈ piece K d) :
    D (φ q) ∈ imagePiece φ (d + m)

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.Filtration.exists_attained_derivation_imagePiece_shift
statement:
theorem exists_attained_derivation_imagePiece_shift
    (φ : MvPolynomial (Fin 5) K →ₐ[K] A) (hφ : Function.Surjective φ)
    (hsep : (⨅ d : ℤ, imagePiece φ d) = ⊥)
    (D : Derivation K A A) (hD : D ≠ 0) :
    ∃ (m : ℤ) (i : Fin 5),
      D (φ (X i)) ≠ 0 ∧
      D (φ (X i)) ∈ imagePiece φ (monomialWeight (Finsupp.single i 1) + m) ∧
      D (φ (X i)) ∉ imagePiece φ (monomialWeight (Finsupp.single i 1) + m - 1) ∧
      ∀ d : ℤ, imagePiece φ d ≤ (imagePiece φ (d + m)).comap D.toLinearMap

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.Filtration.exists_attained_derivation_shift_of_nonunit
statement:
theorem exists_attained_derivation_shift_of_nonunit
    [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsDomain A]
    (φ : MvPolynomial (Fin 5) K →ₐ[K] A) (hφ : Function.Surjective φ)
    (hp : ¬ IsUnit (φ (X 0))) (D : Derivation K A A) (hD : D ≠ 0) :
    ∃ (m : ℤ) (i : Fin 5),
      φ (X i) ∈ imagePiece φ (monomialWeight (Finsupp.single i 1)) ∧
      φ (X i) ∉ imagePiece φ (monomialWeight (Finsupp.single i 1) - 1) ∧
      D (φ (X i)) ∈ imagePiece φ (monomialWeight (Finsupp.single i 1) + m) ∧
      D (φ (X i)) ∉ imagePiece φ (monomialWeight (Finsupp.single i 1) + m - 1) ∧
      ∀ d : ℤ, imagePiece φ d ≤ (imagePiece φ (d + m)).comap D.toLinearMap

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.Filtration.exists_attained_derivation_shift_with_initial_generator
statement:
theorem exists_attained_derivation_shift_with_initial_generator
    (φ : MvPolynomial (Fin 5) K →ₐ[K] A) (hφ : Function.Surjective φ)
    (hsep : (⨅ d : ℤ, imagePiece φ d) = ⊥)
    (D : Derivation K A A) (hD : D ≠ 0) :
    ∃ (m : ℤ) (i : Fin 5),
      φ (X i) ∈ imagePiece φ (monomialWeight (Finsupp.single i 1)) ∧
      φ (X i) ∉ imagePiece φ (monomialWeight (Finsupp.single i 1) - 1) ∧
      D (φ (X i)) ∈ imagePiece φ (monomialWeight (Finsupp.single i 1) + m) ∧
      D (φ (X i)) ∉ imagePiece φ (monomialWeight (Finsupp.single i 1) + m - 1) ∧
      ∀ d : ℤ, imagePiece φ d ≤ (imagePiece φ (d + m)).comap D.toLinearMap

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.Filtration.exists_derivation_imagePiece_shift
statement:
theorem exists_derivation_imagePiece_shift
    (φ : MvPolynomial (Fin 5) K →ₐ[K] A) (hφ : Function.Surjective φ)
    (D : Derivation K A A) :
    ∃ m : ℤ, ∀ d : ℤ,

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.Filtration.exists_ne_zero_generator_value
statement:

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LNDExponential.inverse_factorial_mul_choose
statement:
lemma inverse_factorial_mul_choose (i j : ℕ) :
    ((i + j).factorial : k)⁻¹ * ((i + j).choose i : k) =
      (i.factorial : k)⁻¹ * (j.factorial : k)⁻¹

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LNDExponential.iterate_add
statement:
lemma iterate_add (D : Derivation k A A) (n : ℕ) (a b : A) :

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LNDExponential.iterate_smul
statement:
lemma iterate_smul (D : Derivation k A A) (n : ℕ) (c : k) (a : A) :

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LNDExponential.polynomial_add
statement:
lemma polynomial_add (D : Derivation k A A) (hD : IsLocallyNilpotent D) (a b : A) :

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LNDExponential.polynomial_mul

lemma polynomial_mul (D : Derivation k A A) (hD : IsLocallyNilpotent D) (a b : A) :

statement:
theorem derivation_iterate_naturality
    (D : Derivation k A A) (E : Derivation k B B) (f : A →ₐ[k] B)
    (h : ∀ a, E (f a) = f (D a)) (n : ℕ) (a : A) :
    (E : B → B)^[n] (f a) = f ((D : A → A)^[n] a)

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.exponentialAction_fixed_iff
statement:
theorem exponentialAction_fixed_iff
    (D : Derivation k A A) (hD : IsLocallyNilpotent D) (a : A) :

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.exponentialAction_group_law
statement:
theorem exponentialAction_group_law
    (D : Derivation k A A) (hD : IsLocallyNilpotent D) (a : A) :
    (LNDExponential.exponential D hD a).map (LNDExponential.exponential D hD).toRingHom =
      taylor (X : A[X]) ((LNDExponential.exponential D hD a).map C)

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.exponentialAction_naturality
statement:
theorem exponentialAction_naturality
    (D : Derivation k A A) (E : Derivation k B B)
    (hD : IsLocallyNilpotent D) (hE : IsLocallyNilpotent E)
    (f : A →ₐ[k] B) (h : ∀ a, E (f a) = f (D a)) (a : A) :
    (exponentialAction E hE).toAlgHom (f a) =
      ((exponentialAction D hD).toAlgHom a).map f.toRingHom

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LaurentDescent.coeff_C_mul_T
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coeff_C_mul_T (a : A) (q i : ℤ) :
    (C a * T q : A[T;T⁻¹]).coeff i = if q = i then a else 0

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LaurentDescent.derivation_C_eq
statement:
theorem derivation_C_eq (D : Derivation k A[T;T⁻¹] A[T;T⁻¹]) (q : ℤ)
    (hq : HomogeneousOnConstants D q) (a : A) :
    D (C a) = C (descend D q hq a) * T q

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LaurentDescent.derivation_C_mul_T
statement:
theorem derivation_C_mul_T (D : Derivation k A[T;T⁻¹] A[T;T⁻¹]) (q : ℤ)
    (hq : HomogeneousOnConstants D q) (hT : D (T 1) = 0) (a : A) (j : ℤ) :
    D (C a * T j) = C (descend D q hq a) * T (q + j)

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LaurentDescent.derivation_T_eq_zero
statement:
theorem derivation_T_eq_zero (D : Derivation k A[T;T⁻¹] A[T;T⁻¹])
    (hT : D (T 1) = 0) (n : ℤ) : D (T n) = 0

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LaurentDescent.derivation_eq_zero_of_constants
statement:
theorem derivation_eq_zero_of_constants (D : Derivation k A[T;T⁻¹] A[T;T⁻¹])
    (hC : ∀ a : A, D (C a) = 0) (hT : D (T 1) = 0) : D = 0

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LaurentDescent.descend_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem descend_apply (D : Derivation k A[T;T⁻¹] A[T;T⁻¹]) (q : ℤ)
    (hq : HomogeneousOnConstants D q) (a : A) :
    descend D q hq a = (D (C a)).coeff q

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LaurentDescent.descend_invariant
OAI.StableCoordinate.LaurentDescent.descend_locallyNilpotent
statement:
theorem descend_locallyNilpotent (D : Derivation k A[T;T⁻¹] A[T;T⁻¹]) (q : ℤ)
    (hq : HomogeneousOnConstants D q) (hT : D (T 1) = 0)
    (hD : StableCoordinate.IsLocallyNilpotent D) :
    StableCoordinate.IsLocallyNilpotent (descend D q hq)

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LaurentDescent.descend_ne_zero
statement:
theorem descend_ne_zero (D : Derivation k A[T;T⁻¹] A[T;T⁻¹]) (q : ℤ)
    (hq : HomogeneousOnConstants D q) (hT : D (T 1) = 0) (hD : D ≠ 0) :
    descend D q hq ≠ 0

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LaurentDescent.exists_descended_lnd
statement:
theorem exists_descended_lnd (D : Derivation k A[T;T⁻¹] A[T;T⁻¹]) (q : ℤ)
    (hq : HomogeneousOnConstants D q) (hT : D (T 1) = 0)
    (hD : StableCoordinate.IsLocallyNilpotent D) (hne : D ≠ 0) :
    ∃ E : Derivation k A A,
      StableCoordinate.IsLocallyNilpotent E ∧ E ≠ 0 ∧
      (∀ a : A, D (C a) = C (E a) * T q) ∧
      (∀ (a : A) (j : ℤ), D (C a * T j) = 0 → E a = 0)

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LaurentDescent.homogeneousOnConstants_iff
statement:
theorem homogeneousOnConstants_iff (D : Derivation k A[T;T⁻¹] A[T;T⁻¹]) (q : ℤ) :
    HomogeneousOnConstants D q ↔
      ∀ (a : A) (i : ℤ), i ≠ q → (D (C a)).coeff i = 0

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LaurentDescent.iterate_C
statement:
theorem iterate_C (D : Derivation k A[T;T⁻¹] A[T;T⁻¹]) (q : ℤ)
    (hq : HomogeneousOnConstants D q) (hT : D (T 1) = 0) (a : A) (n : ℕ) :
    (D : A[T;T⁻¹] → A[T;T⁻¹])^[n] (C a) =
      C ((descend D q hq : A → A)^[n] a) * T ((n : ℤ) * q)

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LaurentWeightedMap.coeff_evaluate_eq_zero
statement:
theorem coeff_evaluate_eq_zero (w : σ → ℤ) (c : σ → B)
    {p : MvPolynomial σ k} {m : ℤ} (hp : p.IsWeightedHomogeneous w m)
    (j : ℤ) (hj : j ≠ -m) :
    (evaluate w c p).coeff j = 0

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LaurentWeightedMap.evaluate_X
statement:
@[simp] theorem evaluate_X (w : σ → ℤ) (c : σ → B) (i : σ) :
    evaluate w c (MvPolynomial.X i : MvPolynomial σ k) = C (c i) * T (-w i)

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LaurentWeightedMap.evaluate_homogeneous
statement:
theorem evaluate_homogeneous (w : σ → ℤ) (c : σ → B)
    {p : MvPolynomial σ k} {m : ℤ} (hp : p.IsWeightedHomogeneous w m) :
    evaluate w c p = C (MvPolynomial.aeval c p) * T (-m)

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LaurentWeightedMap.evaluate_monomial
statement:
theorem evaluate_monomial (w : σ → ℤ) (c : σ → B) (d : σ →₀ ℕ) (r : k) :
    evaluate w c (MvPolynomial.monomial d r) =
      C (MvPolynomial.aeval c (MvPolynomial.monomial d r)) * T (-Finsupp.weight w d)

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LaurentWeightedMap.map_homogeneous
statement:
theorem map_homogeneous (w : σ → ℤ) (c : σ → B)
    (φ : MvPolynomial σ k →ₐ[k] B[T;T⁻¹])
    (hφ : ∀ i : σ, φ (MvPolynomial.X i) = C (c i) * T (-w i))
    {p : MvPolynomial σ k} {m : ℤ} (hp : p.IsWeightedHomogeneous w m) :
    φ p = C (MvPolynomial.aeval c p) * T (-m)

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.FrameLift.Frame.specializePolynomial_map
statement:
theorem Frame.specializePolynomial_map (F : Frame (Polynomial R)) (θ : R →+* S) :
    (F.map (Polynomial.mapRingHom θ)).map Polynomial.constantCoeff =
      (F.map Polynomial.constantCoeff).map θ

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.FrameLift.normalizePolynomialFrame_at_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem normalizePolynomialFrame_at_zero (F : Frame (Polynomial R)) (G : Frame R)
    (h : SameBase (F.map Polynomial.constantCoeff) G) :
    (normalizePolynomialFrame F G h).map Polynomial.constantCoeff = G

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.FrameLift.normalizePolynomialFrame_sameBase
statement:
theorem normalizePolynomialFrame_sameBase (F : Frame (Polynomial R)) (G : Frame R)
    (h : SameBase (F.map Polynomial.constantCoeff) G) :
    SameBase (normalizePolynomialFrame F G h) F

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.FrameLift.normalized_bivariate_unique
statement:
theorem normalized_bivariate_unique [IsReduced R]
    {F G : Frame (Polynomial (Polynomial R))} (h : SameBase F G)
    (hzero : (F.map Polynomial.constantCoeff).map Polynomial.constantCoeff =
      (G.map Polynomial.constantCoeff).map Polynomial.constantCoeff) : F = G

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.FrameLift.normalized_univariate_lift_scaling_equivariance
statement:
theorem normalized_univariate_lift_scaling_equivariance [IsReduced R]
    (F : Frame (Polynomial R)) (F₀ : Frame R)
    (hzero : F.map Polynomial.constantCoeff = F₀)
    (θ : R →+* R) (u : Rˣ)
    (href : F₀.map θ = F₀.scale u)
    (hbase : SameBase (F.map (Polynomial.mapRingHom θ)) F) :
    F.map (Polynomial.mapRingHom θ) =
      F.scale (Units.map (Polynomial.C : R →+* Polynomial R).toMonoidHom u)

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.FrameLift.polynomial_isReduced
statement: theorem polynomial_isReduced [IsReduced R] : IsReduced (Polynomial R)

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.FrameLift.univariate_unit_eq_C_constantCoeff
statement:
theorem univariate_unit_eq_C_constantCoeff [IsReduced R]

      a * b = x ∧ d * b = z ∧ d * c = y ∧ a * c = z + 1 ∧
        a * c - b * d = 1
