name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.Ex_mono_mem
statement:
lemma Ex_mono_mem (P : Law α) {f g : α → ℝ}
    (h : ∀ x, 0 < P x → f x ≤ g x) : P.Ex f ≤ P.Ex g

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.Ex_mul
statement:
lemma Ex_mul (P : Law α) (f : α → ℝ) (c : ℝ) :
    P.Ex (fun x => f x * c) = P.Ex f * c

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.Ex_neg
statement:
lemma Ex_neg (P : Law α) (f : α → ℝ) :
    P.Ex (fun x => -f x) = -P.Ex f

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.Ex_nonneg
statement: lemma Ex_nonneg (P : Law α) {f : α → ℝ} (h : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x) : 0 ≤ P.Ex f

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.Ex_point
statement: @[simp] lemma Ex_point (x : α) (f : α → ℝ) : (point x).Ex f = f x

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.Ex_send
statement:
lemma Ex_send (P : Law α) (X : α → β) (f : β → ℝ) :
    (P.send X).Ex f = P.Ex fun x => f (X x)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.Ex_sub
statement:
lemma Ex_sub (P : Law α) (f g : α → ℝ) :
    P.Ex (fun x => f x - g x) = P.Ex f - P.Ex g

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.Ex_tensorP
statement:
lemma Ex_tensorP (P : Law α) (Q : Law β) (f : α × β → ℝ) :
    (P.tensorP Q).Ex f = P.Ex fun x => Q.Ex fun y => f (x,y)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.Ex_through
statement:
lemma Ex_through (P : Law α) (k : α → Law β) (f : β → ℝ) :
    (P.through k).Ex f = P.Ex (fun x => (k x).Ex f)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.Ex_withNext
statement:
lemma Ex_withNext (P : Law α) (k : α → Law β) (f : α × β → ℝ) :
    (P.withNext k).Ex f = P.Ex (fun x => (k x).Ex (fun y => f (x,y)))

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.after_Ex_sum
statement:
lemma after_Ex_sum (P : Law α) (W : α → β) (f : β → α → ℝ) :
    (P.send W).Ex (fun w => (P.after W w).Ex (f w)) =
      P.Ex fun x => f (W x) x

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.after_mem
statement:
lemma after_mem {P : Law α} {W : α → β} {b : β} (h : 0 < P.send W b) {x : α} :
    0 < P.after W b x ↔ W x = b ∧ 0 < P x

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.after_self_pos
statement:
lemma after_self_pos (P : Law α) (W : α → β) {x : α} (hx : 0 < P x) :
    0 < P.after W (W x) x

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.after_send_eq_of_send_pair_eq
OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.condP_mem
statement:
lemma condP_mem {P : Law α} {p : α → Prop} (hp : 0 < P.prob p) {x : α} :
    0 < P.condP p x ↔ p x ∧ 0 < P x

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.condP_pos_apply
statement:
lemma condP_pos_apply (P : Law α) (p : α → Prop) [DecidablePred p]
    (hp : 0 < P.prob p) (x : α) :
    P.condP p x = (if p x then P x else 0) / P.prob p

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.exists_Ex_le
statement: lemma exists_Ex_le (P : Law α) (f : α → ℝ) : ∃ x, 0 < P x ∧ P.Ex f ≤ f x

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.exists_le_Ex
statement: lemma exists_le_Ex (P : Law α) (f : α → ℝ) : ∃ x, 0 < P x ∧ f x ≤ P.Ex f

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.ext
statement: protected lemma ext {P Q : Law α} (h : ∀ x, P x = Q x) : P = Q

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.ext_of_Ex
statement: lemma ext_of_Ex {P Q : Law α} (h : ∀ f : α → ℝ, P.Ex f = Q.Ex f) : P = Q

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.joint_after
statement:
lemma joint_after (P : Law α) (X : α → β) (W : α → γ) (x w) :
    P.send (fun a => (X a, W a)) (x,w) = P.send W w * ((P.after W w).send X x)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.le_one
statement: lemma le_one (P : Law α) (x : α) : P x ≤ 1

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.le_send
statement: lemma le_send (P : Law α) (X : α → β) (x) : P x ≤ P.send X (X x)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.mem_le_prob
statement: lemma mem_le_prob (P : Law α) {p : α → Prop} {x} (h : p x) : P x ≤ P.prob p

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.mem_nonempty
statement: lemma mem_nonempty (P : Law α) : ∃ x, 0 < P x

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.mixture_Ex
statement:
lemma mixture_Ex (P Q : Law α) (t : ℝ) (h0 : 0 ≤ t) (h1 : t ≤ 1) (f : α → ℝ) :
    (mixture P Q t h0 h1).Ex f = t * P.Ex f + (1-t) * Q.Ex f

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.mixture_apply
statement:
lemma mixture_apply (P Q : Law α) (t : ℝ) (h0 : 0 ≤ t) (h1 : t ≤ 1) (x : α) :
    mixture P Q t h0 h1 x = t * P x + (1-t)*Q x

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.nonneg
statement: protected lemma nonneg (P : Law α) (x) : 0 ≤ P x

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.point_apply
statement:
lemma point_apply (x y : α) [DecidableEq α] :
    point x y = (if y=x then 1 else 0)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.prob_compl
statement: lemma prob_compl (P : Law α) (p : α → Prop) : P.prob (fun x => ¬ p x) = 1 - P.prob p

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.prob_eq
statement:
lemma prob_eq (P : Law α) (p : α → Prop) [DecidablePred p] :
    P.prob p = ∑ x, if p x then P x else 0

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.prob_le_one
statement: lemma prob_le_one (P : Law α) (p : α → Prop) : P.prob p ≤ 1

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.prob_mul_Ex_condP
statement:
lemma prob_mul_Ex_condP (P : Law α) (p : α → Prop) [DecidablePred p] (f : α → ℝ) :
    P.prob p * (P.condP p).Ex f = P.Ex fun x => if p x then f x else 0

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.prob_mul_condP
statement:
lemma prob_mul_condP (P : Law α) (p : α → Prop) [DecidablePred p] (x : α) :
    P.prob p * P.condP p x = if p x then P x else 0

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.prob_nonneg
statement: lemma prob_nonneg (P : Law α) (p : α → Prop) : 0 ≤ P.prob p

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.prob_pos_iff
statement:
lemma prob_pos_iff (P : Law α) (p : α → Prop) :
    0 < P.prob p ↔ ∃ x, p x ∧ 0 < P x

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.prob_single
statement: lemma prob_single (P : Law α) (x : α) : P.prob (· = x) = P x

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.proportional_apply
statement:
lemma proportional_apply (w : α → ℝ) (hw : ∀ x, 0 ≤ w x) (ht : 0 < ∑ x, w x) (x) :
    proportional w hw ht x = w x / ∑ y, w y

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.send_apply
statement: lemma send_apply (P : Law α) (X : α → β) (y) : P.send X y = P.prob (fun x => X x = y)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.send_congr_mem
statement:
lemma send_congr_mem (P : Law α) {X Y : α → β} (h : ∀ x, 0 < P x → X x = Y x) :
    P.send X = P.send Y

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.send_fst_tensorP
statement:
lemma send_fst_tensorP (P : Law α) (Q : Law β) :
    (P.tensorP Q).send Prod.fst = P

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.send_fst_withNext
statement:
lemma send_fst_withNext (P : Law α) (k : α → Law β) :
    (P.withNext k).send Prod.fst = P

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.send_id
statement: @[simp] lemma send_id (P : Law α) : P.send (fun x => x) = P

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.send_mul_after
statement:
lemma send_mul_after (P : Law α) (W : α → β) [DecidableEq β] (b : β) (x : α) :
    P.send W b * P.after W b x = if W x = b then P x else 0

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.send_pos
statement:
lemma send_pos (P : Law α) (X : α → β) {x} (h : 0 < P x) :
    0 < P.send X (X x)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.send_pos_iff
statement:
lemma send_pos_iff (P : Law α) (X : α → β) (y) :
    0 < P.send X y ↔ ∃ x, X x = y ∧ 0 < P x

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.send_send
statement:
lemma send_send (P : Law α) (X : α → β) (Y : β → γ) :
    (P.send X).send Y = P.send (fun x => Y (X x))

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.send_snd_tensorP
statement:
lemma send_snd_tensorP (P : Law α) (Q : Law β) :
    (P.tensorP Q).send Prod.snd = Q

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.send_snd_withNext
statement:
lemma send_snd_withNext (P : Law α) (k : α → Law β) :
    (P.withNext k).send Prod.snd = P.through k

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.send_tensorP
statement:
lemma send_tensorP (P : Law α) (Q : Law β) (X : α → γ) (Y : β → η) :
    (P.tensorP Q).send (fun p => (X p.1, Y p.2)) = (P.send X).tensorP (Q.send Y)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.tensorP_apply
statement:
lemma tensorP_apply (P : Law α) (Q : Law β) (a : α) (b : β) :
    P.tensorP Q (a,b) = P a * Q b

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.through_after
statement:
lemma through_after (P : Law α) (W : α → β) :
    (P.send W).through (P.after W) = P

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.through_apply
statement: lemma through_apply (P : Law α) (k : α → Law β) (y) : P.through k y = P.Ex (fun x => k x y)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.total
statement: protected lemma total (P : Law α) : ∑ x, P x = 1

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.uniform_apply
statement: lemma uniform_apply [Nonempty α] (x : α) : uniform α x = (Fintype.card α : ℝ)⁻¹

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.withNext_apply
statement:
lemma withNext_apply (P : Law α) (k : α → Law β) (a : α) (b : β) :
    P.withNext k (a,b) = P a * k a b

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.H_associate
statement:
lemma H_associate (P : Law α) (X : α → β) (Y : α → γ) (Z : α → η) :
    P.H (fun x => ((X x,Y x),Z x)) = P.H (fun x => (X x,(Y x,Z x)))

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.H_card
statement: lemma H_card (P : Law α) (X : α → β) : P.H X ≤ log (Fintype.card β : ℝ)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.H_congr_mem
statement:
lemma H_congr_mem (P : Law α) {X Y : α → β} (h : ∀ x, 0 < P x → X x = Y x) :
    P.H X = P.H Y

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.H_constant
statement: lemma H_constant (P : Law α) (b : β) : P.H (fun _ => b) = 0

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.H_le_of_determined
statement:
lemma H_le_of_determined (P : Law α) {X : α → β} {W : α → γ}
    (h : ∀ x y, W x = W y → X x = X y) : P.H X ≤ P.H W

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.H_log
statement:
lemma H_log (P : Law α) (X : α → β) :
    P.H X = P.Ex (fun x => -log (P.send X (X x)))

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.H_nonneg
statement: lemma H_nonneg (P : Law α) (X : α → β) : 0 ≤ P.H X

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.H_pair_chain
statement:
lemma H_pair_chain (P : Law α) (X : α → β) (W : α → γ) :
    P.H (fun x => (X x,W x)) = P.H W + P.Hcond X W

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.H_pair_rev
statement:
lemma H_pair_rev (P : Law α) (X : α → β) (W : α → γ) :
    P.H (fun a => (X a, W a)) = P.H (fun a => (W a, X a))

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.H_partition
statement:
lemma H_partition (P : Law α) {X : α → β} {Y : α → γ}
    (h : ∀ x y, X x = X y ↔ Y x = Y y) : P.H X = P.H Y

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.H_self
statement: lemma H_self (P : Law α) : P.H (fun x => x) = P.entropy

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.H_send
statement:
lemma H_send (P : Law α) (X : α → β) (Y : β → γ) :
    (P.send X).H Y = P.H (fun x => Y (X x))

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.H_tensorP
statement:
lemma H_tensorP (P : Law α) (Q : Law β) (X : α → γ) (Y : β → η) :
    (P.tensorP Q).H (fun x => (X x.1,Y x.2)) = P.H X + Q.H Y

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.Hcond_after
statement:
lemma Hcond_after (P : Law α) (X : α → β) (W : α → γ) :
    P.Hcond X W = (P.send W).Ex fun w => (P.after W w).H X

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.Hcond_after_cond
statement:
lemma Hcond_after_cond (P : Law α) (X : α → β) (Y : α → γ) (Z : α → η) :
    P.Hcond X (fun x => (Y x,Z x)) = (P.send Z).Ex fun z => (P.after Z z).Hcond X Y

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.Hcond_antitone
statement:
lemma Hcond_antitone (P : Law α) (X : α → β) {Y : α → γ} {Z : α → η}
    (h : ∀ a b, Y a = Y b → Z a = Z b) : P.Hcond X Y ≤ P.Hcond X Z

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.Hcond_chain
statement:
lemma Hcond_chain (P : Law α) (X : α → β) (Y : α → γ) (Z : α → η) :
    P.Hcond (fun x => (X x,Y x)) Z =
      P.Hcond X (fun x => (Y x,Z x)) + P.Hcond Y Z

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.Hcond_constant
statement:
lemma Hcond_constant (P : Law α) (X : α → β) (b : γ) :
    P.Hcond X (fun _ => b) = P.H X

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.Hcond_determined
statement:
lemma Hcond_determined (P : Law α) {X : α → β} {W : α → γ}
    (h : ∀ x y, W x = W y → X x = X y) : P.Hcond X W = 0

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.Hcond_le_H
statement:
lemma Hcond_le_H (P : Law α) (X : α → β) (W : α → γ) :
    P.Hcond X W ≤ P.H X

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.Hcond_log
statement:
lemma Hcond_log (P : Law α) (X : α → β) (W : α → γ) :
    P.Hcond X W = P.Ex (fun x => -log ((P.after W (W x)).send X (X x)))

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.Hcond_nonneg
statement:
lemma Hcond_nonneg (P : Law α) (X : α → β) (W : α → γ) :
    0 ≤ P.Hcond X W

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.Hcond_refine
statement:
lemma Hcond_refine (P : Law α) (X : α → β) (Y : α → γ) (Z : α → η) :
    P.Hcond X (fun x => (Y x,Z x)) ≤ P.Hcond X Z

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.Hcond_right_partition
statement:
lemma Hcond_right_partition (P : Law α) (X : α → β) {Y : α → γ} {Z : α → η}
    (h : ∀ a b, Y a = Y b ↔ Z a = Z b) : P.Hcond X Y = P.Hcond X Z

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.Hcond_send
statement:
lemma Hcond_send (P : Law α) (X : α → β) (Y : β → γ) (W : β → η) :
    (P.send X).Hcond Y W = P.Hcond (fun x => Y (X x)) (fun x => W (X x))

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.Hcond_subadd
statement:
lemma Hcond_subadd (P : Law α) (X : α → β) (Y : α → γ) (Z : α → η) :
    P.Hcond (fun x => (X x,Y x)) Z ≤ P.Hcond X Z + P.Hcond Y Z

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.dominated_refl
statement: lemma dominated_refl (P : Law α) : P.dominated P

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.dominated_send
statement:
lemma dominated_send {P Q : Law α} (h : P.dominated Q) (X : α → β) :
    (P.send X).dominated (Q.send X)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.entropy_formula
statement: lemma entropy_formula (P : Law α) : P.entropy = ∑ x, negMulLog (P x)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.entropy_le_cross_aux
statement:
lemma entropy_le_cross_aux (P : Law α) (q : α → ℝ)
    (h0 : ∀ x, 0 ≤ q x) (ht : ∑ x, q x ≤ 1) (h : ∀ x, 0 < P x → 0 < q x) :
    P.entropy ≤ P.crossE q

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.entropy_le_log_card
statement:
lemma entropy_le_log_card (P : Law α) :
    P.entropy ≤ log (Fintype.card α : ℝ)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.entropy_nonneg
statement: lemma entropy_nonneg (P : Law α) : 0 ≤ P.entropy

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.entropy_point
statement: lemma entropy_point (x : α) : (point x).entropy = 0

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.entropy_tensorP
statement:
lemma entropy_tensorP (P : Law α) (Q : Law β) :
    (P.tensorP Q).entropy = P.entropy + Q.entropy

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.entropy_uniform
statement:
lemma entropy_uniform [Nonempty α] :
    (uniform α).entropy = log (Fintype.card α : ℝ)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.entropy_withNext
statement:
lemma entropy_withNext (P : Law α) (k : α → Law β) :
    (P.withNext k).entropy = P.entropy + P.Ex (fun x => (k x).entropy)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.kl_nonneg
statement: lemma kl_nonneg {P Q : Law α} (h : P.dominated Q) : 0 ≤ P.kl Q

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.after_dominated
statement:
lemma after_dominated {P Q : Law α} (h : P.dominated Q) (X : α → β)
    {x : β} (hx : 0 < P.send X x) : (P.after X x).dominated (Q.after X x)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.kl_chain
statement:
lemma kl_chain {P Q : Law α} (h : P.dominated Q) (X : α → β) :
    P.kl Q = (P.send X).kl (Q.send X) +
      (P.send X).Ex (fun x => (P.after X x).kl (Q.after X x))

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.kl_data_processing
statement:
lemma kl_data_processing {P Q : Law α} (h : P.dominated Q) (X : α → β) :
    (P.send X).kl (Q.send X) ≤ P.kl Q

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.kl_ex
statement:
lemma kl_ex (P Q : Law α) :
    P.kl Q = P.Ex (fun x => log (P x) - log (Q x))

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.tv_comm
statement: lemma tv_comm (P Q : Law α) : P.tv Q = Q.tv P

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.tv_common
statement:
lemma tv_common (P Q : Law α) :
    (∑ a, min (P a) (Q a)) = 1 - P.tv Q

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.tv_data_processing
statement:
lemma tv_data_processing (P Q : Law α) (X : α → β) :
    (P.send X).tv (Q.send X) ≤ P.tv Q

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.tv_le_one
statement: lemma tv_le_one (P Q : Law α) : P.tv Q ≤ 1

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.tv_le_sqrt_kl
statement:
lemma tv_le_sqrt_kl {P Q : Law α} (h : P.dominated Q) :
    P.tv Q ≤ √(P.kl Q)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.tv_nonneg
statement: lemma tv_nonneg (P Q : Law α) : 0 ≤ P.tv Q

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.tv_sq_le_kl
statement:
lemma tv_sq_le_kl {P Q : Law α} (h : P.dominated Q) :
    (P.tv Q)^2 ≤ P.kl Q

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.H_mixture_ge
statement:
lemma H_mixture_ge (P Q : Law α) (t : ℝ) (h0 : 0 ≤ t) (h1 : t ≤ 1) (X : α → β) :
    t*(P.H X)+(1-t)*(Q.H X) ≤ (mixture P Q t h0 h1).H X

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.H_through_ge
statement:
lemma H_through_ge (P : Law α) (Q : α → Law β) (X : β → γ) :
    P.Ex (fun a => (Q a).H X) ≤ (P.through Q).H X

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.H_through_le
statement:
lemma H_through_le (P : Law α) (Q : α → Law β) (X : β → γ) :
    (P.through Q).H X ≤ P.entropy + P.Ex (fun a => (Q a).H X)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.H_withNext
statement:
lemma H_withNext (P : Law α) (Q : α → Law β) (X : α → β → γ) :
    (P.withNext Q).H (fun (z : α × β) => (z.1, X z.1 z.2)) =
      P.entropy + P.Ex (fun i => (Q i).H (X i))

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.Hcond_mixture_ge
statement:
lemma Hcond_mixture_ge (P Q : Law α) (t : ℝ) (h0 : 0 ≤ t) (h1 : t ≤ 1)
    (X : α → β) (W : α → γ) :
    t*(P.Hcond X W)+(1-t)*(Q.Hcond X W) ≤ (mixture P Q t h0 h1).Hcond X W

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.Hcond_through
statement:
lemma Hcond_through (P : Law α) (Q : α → Law β) (X : β → γ) (W : β → η) :
    P.Ex (fun a => (Q a).Hcond X W) ≤ (P.through Q).Hcond X W

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.Hcond_withNext
statement:
lemma Hcond_withNext (P : Law α) (Q : α → Law β) (X : α → β → γ) (W : α → β → η) :
    (P.withNext Q).Hcond (fun z => X z.1 z.2) (fun z => (z.1,W z.1 z.2)) =
      P.Ex fun i => (Q i).Hcond (X i) (W i)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.Hcond_withNext'
statement:
lemma Hcond_withNext' (P : Law α) (Q : α → Law β) (X : α → β → γ) :
    (P.withNext Q).Hcond (fun z => X z.1 z.2) Prod.fst =
      P.Ex fun i => (Q i).H (X i)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.coinP_Ex
statement:
lemma coinP_Ex (t : ℝ) (h0 : 0 ≤ t) (h1 : t ≤ 1) (f : Bool → ℝ) :
    (coinP t h0 h1).Ex f = t*f true+(1-t)*f false

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.coinP_entropy
statement:
lemma coinP_entropy (t : ℝ) (h0 : 0 ≤ t) (h1 : t ≤ 1) :
    (coinP t h0 h1).entropy ≤ log 2

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.entropy_le_log_size
statement:
lemma entropy_le_log_size (P : Law α) (s : Finset α)
    (h : ∀ x, 0 < P x → x ∈ s) : P.entropy ≤ log (s.card : ℝ)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.entropy_le_of_tv
statement:
theorem entropy_le_of_tv (P Q : Law α) (s : Finset α)
    (h : ∀ x, 0 < P x → x ∈ s) :
    P.entropy ≤ Q.entropy + (log 2 + P.tv Q * log (s.card:ℝ))

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.entropy_mixture_ge
statement:
lemma entropy_mixture_ge (P Q : Law α) (t : ℝ) (h0 : 0 ≤ t) (h1 : t ≤ 1) :
    t*P.entropy+(1-t)*Q.entropy ≤ (mixture P Q t h0 h1).entropy

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.entropy_mixture_le
statement:
lemma entropy_mixture_le (P Q : Law α) (t : ℝ) (h0 : 0 ≤ t) (h1 : t ≤ 1) :
    (mixture P Q t h0 h1).entropy ≤ log 2 + (t*P.entropy+(1-t)*Q.entropy)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.mixture_eq_through
statement:
lemma mixture_eq_through (P Q : Law α) (t : ℝ) (h0 : 0 ≤ t) (h1 : t ≤ 1) :
    mixture P Q t h0 h1 = (coinP t h0 h1).through (fun b => if b then P else Q)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.send_withNext
statement:
lemma send_withNext (P : Law α) (Q : α → Law β) (X : α → β → γ) :
    (P.withNext Q).send (fun (z : α × β) => (z.1, X z.1 z.2)) =
      P.withNext (fun i => (Q i).send (X i))

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.continuous_Ex
statement: lemma continuous_Ex (f : α → ℝ) : Continuous (fun P : Law α => P.Ex f)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.continuous_H
statement: lemma continuous_H (X : α → β) : Continuous (fun P : Law α => P.H X)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.continuous_Hcond
statement: lemma continuous_Hcond (X : α → β) (Z : α → γ) : Continuous (fun P : Law α => P.Hcond X Z)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.continuous_entropy
statement: lemma continuous_entropy : Continuous (fun P : Law α => P.entropy)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.continuous_pdf
statement: lemma continuous_pdf (a : α) : Continuous (fun P : Law α => P a)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.continuous_prob
statement: lemma continuous_prob (p : α → Prop) : Continuous (fun P : Law α => P.prob p)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.continuous_send
statement: lemma continuous_send (X : α → β) : Continuous (fun P : Law α => P.send X)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.continuous_send_pdf
statement: lemma continuous_send_pdf (X : α → β) (b : β) : Continuous (fun P : Law α => P.send X b)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.primal_feasible
statement:
lemma primal_feasible {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (f : Law α → ℝ) (hf : Continuous f)
    (g : Law α → E) (hg : Continuous g)
    (hfc : ∀ P Q t h0 h1, f (mixture P Q t h0 h1) ≤ t*f P+(1-t)*f Q)
    (hgc : ∀ P Q t h0 h1, g (mixture P Q t h0 h1) = t • g P+(1-t) • g Q)
    (hP : ∃ P, g P = 0)
    (C : ℝ) (hC : ∀ L : E →L[ℝ] ℝ, ∃ P, f P + L (g P) ≤ C) :
    ∃ P, f P ≤ C ∧ g P = 0

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.Ex_pack_proj
statement:
lemma Ex_pack_proj (P : ι → Law α) (i : ι) (f : α → ℝ) :
    (pack P).Ex (fun x => f (x i)) = (P i).Ex f

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.H_vec_le
statement:
lemma H_vec_le (P : Law α) (X : α → ι → β) :
    P.H X ≤ ∑ i, P.H (fun x => X x i)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.H_vec_pack
statement:
lemma H_vec_pack (P : ι → Law α) (X : ι → α → β) :
    (pack P).H (fun x i => X i (x i)) = ∑ i, (P i).H (X i)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.Hcond_vec_le
statement:
lemma Hcond_vec_le (P : Law α) (X : α → ι → β) (W : α → γ) :
    P.Hcond X W ≤ ∑ i, P.Hcond (fun x => X x i) W

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.Hcond_vec_pack
statement:
lemma Hcond_vec_pack (P : ι → Law α) (X : ι → α → β) (W : ι → α → γ) :
    (pack P).Hcond (fun x i => X i (x i)) (fun x i => W i (x i)) =
      ∑ i, (P i).Hcond (X i) (W i)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.crossE_pack
OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.entropy_coord_bound
statement:
lemma entropy_coord_bound (P : Law (ι → α)) :
    P.entropy ≤ ∑ i, P.H (fun x => x i)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.entropy_pack
statement: lemma entropy_pack (P : ι → Law α) : (pack P).entropy = ∑ i, (P i).entropy

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.ext_by_products
OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.marginalPack
statement:
lemma marginalPack (P : ι → Law α) (i : ι) :
    (pack P).send (fun x => x i) = P i

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.pack_Ex_prod
statement:
lemma pack_Ex_prod (P : ι → Law α) (f : ι → α → ℝ) :
    (pack P).Ex (fun x => ∏ i, f i (x i)) = ∏ i, (P i).Ex (f i)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.pack_apply
statement:
lemma pack_apply (P : ι → Law α) (x : ι → α) :
    pack P x = ∏ i, P i (x i)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.pack_kl
statement:
lemma pack_kl {P Q : ι → Law α} (h : ∀ i, (P i).dominated (Q i)) :
    (pack P).kl (pack Q) = ∑ i, (P i).kl (Q i)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.pack_pos
statement:
lemma pack_pos (P : ι → Law α) (x : ι → α) :
    0 < pack P x ↔ ∀ i, 0 < P i (x i)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.pack_withNext
statement:
lemma pack_withNext (P : ι → Law α) (Q : ι → α → Law β) :
    ((pack P).withNext (fun v => pack (fun i => Q i (v i)))).send
      (fun (z : (ι→α)×(ι→β)) i => (z.1 i,z.2 i)) =
      pack (fun i => (P i).withNext (Q i))

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.sendPack
statement:
lemma sendPack (P : ι → Law α) (X : ι → α → β) :
    (pack P).send (fun x i => X i (x i)) = pack (fun i => (P i).send (X i))

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.sendPack_embedding
statement:
lemma sendPack_embedding (P : ι → Law α) (s : τ → ι) (hs : Injective s) :
    (pack P).send (fun x i => x (s i)) = pack (fun i => P (s i))

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.bill_change
statement:
lemma bill_change {P : Law Ω} {X : Ω → ι → α} {q : Law α} (h : covered P X q)
    (tag : α → G) (c : G → ℝ) (U : Ω → G) (p : Law α)
    (hp : ∀ i, P.send (fun x => X x i) = p) :
    bill tag c p P X U ≤ bill tag c q P X U

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.bill_condition
statement:
lemma bill_condition (tag : α → G) (c : G → ℝ) (q : Law α)
    (P : Law Ω) (X : Ω → ι → α) (U : Ω → G) (W : Ω → A) :
    (P.send W).Ex (fun w => bill tag c q (P.after W w) X U) ≤
      bill tag c q P X U + P.H W

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.bill_cont
statement:
lemma bill_cont (tag : α → G) (c : G → ℝ) (q : Law α)
    (X : Ω → ι → α) (U : Ω → G) :
    Continuous (fun P : Law Ω => bill tag c q P X U)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.bill_mixture_le
statement:
lemma bill_mixture_le (tag : α → G) (c : G → ℝ) (q : Law α)
    (P Q : Law Ω) (X : Ω → ι → α) (U : Ω → G) (t : ℝ) (h0 : 0 ≤ t) (h1 : t ≤ 1) :
    bill tag c q (mixture P Q t h0 h1) X U ≤
      t*bill tag c q P X U + (1-t)*bill tag c q Q X U

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.bill_nonneg
statement:
lemma bill_nonneg {P : Law Ω} {X : Ω → ι → α} {q : Law α} (h : covered P X q)
    (tag : α → G) (c : G → ℝ) (hc : ∀ x, 0 ≤ c x) (U : Ω → G) :
    0 ≤ bill tag c q P X U

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.bill_send
statement:
lemma bill_send (tag : α → G) (c : G → ℝ) (q : Law α)
    (P : Law Ω) (X : Ω' → ι → α) (U : Ω' → G) (W : Ω → Ω') :
    bill tag c q (P.send W) X U = bill tag c q P (fun x => X (W x)) (fun x => U (W x))

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.bill_split
OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.bill_subfamily
statement:
lemma bill_subfamily (tag : α → G) (c : G → ℝ) (q : Law α)
    (P : Law Ω) (X : Ω → ι → α) (U : Ω → G) (h : covered P X q)
    (g : τ → ι) (hg : Injective g) :
    bill tag c q P (keep X g) U ≤ bill tag c q P X U

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.bill_through_le
statement:
lemma bill_through_le (tag : α → G) (c : G → ℝ) (q : Law α)
    (P : Law Ω) (X : Ω' → ι → α) (U : Ω' → G) (Q : Ω → Law Ω') :
    bill tag c q (P.through Q) X U ≤ P.Ex (fun a => bill tag c q (Q a) X U)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.bill_with_entropy
statement:
lemma bill_with_entropy {P : Law Ω} {X : Ω → ι → α} {q : Law α} (h : covered P X q)
    (tag : α → G) (c : G → ℝ) (U : Ω → G) :
    bill tag c q P X U =
      (P.send X).kl (pack (fun _ => q)) + (P.H (ans tag X U) - P.Hcond U X) +
        P.Ex fun a => c (U a)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.covered_after
statement:
lemma covered_after {P : Law Ω} {X : Ω → ι → α} {q : Law α} (h : covered P X q)
    (W : Ω → A) (w : A) (hw : 0 < P.send W w) : covered (P.after W w) X q

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.covered_pack
statement:
lemma covered_pack {P : Law Ω} {X : Ω → ι → α} {q : Law α} (h : covered P X q) :
    (P.send X).dominated (pack (fun _ => q))

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.covered_subfamily
statement:
lemma covered_subfamily {P : Law Ω} {X : Ω → ι → α} {q : Law α} (h : covered P X q)
    (g : τ → ι) : covered P (keep X g) q

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.kl_le_bill
statement:
lemma kl_le_bill {P : Law Ω} {X : Ω → ι → α} {q : Law α} (h : covered P X q)
    (tag : α → G) (c : G → ℝ) (_hc : ∀ x, 0 ≤ c x) (U : Ω → G) :
    (P.send X).kl (pack (fun _ => q)) + P.Ex (fun a => c (U a)) ≤ bill tag c q P X U

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.sum_crosspack
statement:
lemma sum_crosspack {P : Law Ω} {X : Ω → ι → α} {q : Law α} (h : covered P X q) :
    (P.send X).crossE (pack (fun _ => q)) = ∑ i, P.Ex fun a => -log (q (X a i))

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.sum_split'
statement:
lemma sum_split' (e : τ ⊕ κ ≃ ι) {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] (f : ι → M) :
    ∑ i, f i = ∑ i, f (e (.inl i)) + ∑ i, f (e (.inr i))

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.Emp_cont
statement: lemma Emp_cont : Continuous (fun P : Law (Sample ι α G) => Emp P)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.Emp_mixture
statement:
lemma Emp_mixture (P Q : Law (Sample ι α G)) (t : ℝ) (h0 : 0 ≤ t) (h1 : t ≤ 1) :
    Emp (mixture P Q t h0 h1) = t • Emp P + (1-t) • Emp Q

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.Emp_perm
statement:
lemma Emp_perm (P : Law (Sample ι α G)) (e : Equiv.Perm ι) :
    Emp (P.send (appPerm e)) = Emp P

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.exp_norm
statement: lemma exp_norm (a : α → ℝ) : 0 < ∑ x, exp (a x)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.noisy_avg
statement:
theorem noisy_avg (tag : α → G) (c : G → ℝ) (E : ℝ)
    (h : ∀ p : Law α, exp (-E) ≤ heatMoment ι p tag c) :
    ∃ P : Law (Sample ι α G),
      bill tag c (uniform α) P Prod.fst Prod.snd ≤ E ∧
      Emp P = fun x => Fintype.card ι * uniform α x

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.noisy_symm
statement:
theorem noisy_symm (tag : α → G) (c : G → ℝ) (E : ℝ)
    (h : ∀ p : Law α, exp (-E) ≤ heatMoment ι p tag c) :
    ∃ P : Law (Sample ι α G),
      bill tag c (uniform α) P Prod.fst Prod.snd ≤ E ∧ exch P ∧
      ∀ i : ι, P.send (fun x => x.1 i) = uniform α

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.same_marginal
statement:
lemma same_marginal {P : Law (Sample ι α G)} (hx : exch P) (i j : ι) :
    P.send (fun a => a.1 i) = P.send (fun a => a.1 j)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.trial_bill_uniform
statement:
lemma trial_bill_uniform (tag : α → G) (c : G → ℝ)
    (p : Law (ι → α)) (z : G) :
    bill tag c (uniform α) (p.send (fun x => (x,z-tot tag x))) Prod.fst Prod.snd =
      Fintype.card ι * log (Fintype.card α) - p.entropy +
      p.Ex fun x => c (z-tot tag x)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.trial_cost_with_potential
statement:
lemma trial_cost_with_potential (tag : α → G) (c : G → ℝ)
    (E : ℝ) (h : ∀ p : Law α, exp (-E) ≤ heatMoment ι p tag c)
    (a : α → ℝ) :
    ∃ P : Law (Sample ι α G),
      bill tag c (uniform α) P Prod.fst Prod.snd +
        ∑ i : ι, (P.Ex (fun x => a (x.1 i))-(uniform α).Ex a) ≤ E

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.block_cut
statement:
lemma block_cut (X : Ω → Letters n α) (j m l : ℕ) (h : j+m ≤ n) (hl : l ≤ m) :
    readBlock X j l (by omega) = prefixB (readBlock X j m h) l hl

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.block_in_prefix
statement:
lemma block_in_prefix (X : Ω → Letters n α) (j k l : ℕ) (hk : j+k ≤ l) (hl : l ≤ n) :
    readBlock X j k (hk.trans hl) = readBlock (prefixB X l hl) j k hk

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.exch_subSample
statement:
lemma exch_subSample {P : Law (Sample I α G)} (hx : exch P)
    (g : J → I) (hg : Injective g) : exch (P.send (subSample g))

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.exch_subSample_cond
statement:
lemma exch_subSample_cond {P : Law (Sample I α G)} (hx : exch P)
    (g : J → I) (hg : Injective g) (u : K → I) (hu : ∀ i, u i ∉ range g)
    (w : K → α) :
    let W := keep (fun p : Sample I α G => p.1) u
    exch ((P.after W w).send (subSample g))

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.lift_perm
statement:
lemma lift_perm (g : J → I) (hg : Injective g) (e : Equiv.Perm J) :
    ∃ f : Equiv.Perm I, (∀ i, f (g i) = g (e i)) ∧ ∀ x, x ∉ range g → f x = x

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.offset_injective
statement: lemma offset_injective (j l : ℕ) (h : j+l ≤ n) : Injective (offset j l h)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.prefix_all
statement: lemma prefix_all (X : Ω → Letters n α) : prefixB X n le_rfl = X

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.prefix_bill
statement:
lemma prefix_bill (tag : α → G) (c : G → ℝ) (q : Law α)
    (P : Law Ω) (X : Ω → Letters n α) (U : Ω → G) (h : covered P X q)
    (j m : ℕ) (hh : j+m ≤ n) :
    let W := prefixB X j (by omega)
    (P.send W).Ex (fun w => bill tag c q (P.after W w) (readBlock X j m hh) U) ≤
      bill tag c q P X U

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.prefix_last_partition
statement:
lemma prefix_last_partition (X : Ω → Letters n α) (l : ℕ) (h : l<n) (x y : Ω) :
    prefixB X (l+1) h x = prefixB X (l+1) h y ↔
      readLetter X l h x = readLetter X l h y ∧
      prefixB X l (by omega) x = prefixB X l (by omega) y

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.prefix_partition
statement:
lemma prefix_partition (X : Ω → Letters n α) (l k : ℕ) (h : l+k ≤ n) (x y : Ω) :
    prefixB X (l+k) h x = prefixB X (l+k) h y ↔
      prefixB X l (by omega) x = prefixB X l (by omega) y ∧ readBlock X l k h x = readBlock X l k h y

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.prefix_zero
statement: lemma prefix_zero (X : Ω → Letters n α) : prefixB X 0 (by omega) = fun _ => Fin.elim0

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.splitIx_left
statement:
lemma splitIx_left (l m : ℕ) (h : l+m=n) (i : Fin m) :
    splitIx l m h (.inl i) = offset l m h.le i

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.splitIx_right
statement:
lemma splitIx_right (l m : ℕ) (h : l+m=n) (i : Fin l) :
    splitIx l m h (.inr i) = offset 0 l (by omega : 0+l≤n) i

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.H_post_prefix
statement:
lemma H_post_prefix (P : Law Ω) (X : Ω → Letters n α) (j l : ℕ) (h : j+l ≤ n) :
    let W := prefixB X j (by omega)
    (P.send W).Ex (fun w => (P.after W w).H (readBlock X j l h)) =
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range l, rateH P X (j+i)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.H_prefix
statement:
lemma H_prefix (P : Law Ω) (X : Ω → Letters n α) (l : ℕ) (h : l ≤ n) :
    P.H (prefixB X l h) = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range l, rateH P X j

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.avg_block_kl
statement:
lemma avg_block_kl {P : Law (S n α G)} (hp : exch P)
    {j m} (hh : j+m ≤ n) (hj : j<n) :
    let X : S n α G → Letters n α := Prod.fst
    let W := prefixB X j hj.le
    let V := readBlock X j m hh
    (P.send W).Ex (fun w =>
      let R := P.after W w
      kl (R.send V) (pack (fun _ : Fin m => R.send (readLetter X j hj)))) =
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, (rateH P X j - rateH P X (j+i))

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.conditional_block_exch
statement:
lemma conditional_block_exch {P : Law (S n α G)} (hp : exch P)
    {j m} (hh : j+m ≤ n) (w : Letters j α) :
    exch ((P.after (prefixB Prod.fst j (by omega)) w).send (fun p =>
      (readBlock Prod.fst j m hh p,p.2)))

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.conditional_block_marg
statement:
lemma conditional_block_marg {P : Law (S n α G)} (hp : exch P)
    {j m} (hh : j+m ≤ n) (w : Letters j α) (i : Fin m) :
    let R := P.after (prefixB Prod.fst j (by omega)) w
    R.send (fun x => readBlock Prod.fst j m hh x i) =
      R.send (readLetter Prod.fst j (by have := i.isLt; omega))

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.kl_uniform
statement:
lemma kl_uniform {α : Type} [Fintype α] [Nonempty α]
    (P : Law (Letters n α)) :
    P.kl (pack (fun _ : Fin n => uniform α)) =
      n*log (Fintype.card α) - P.entropy

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.rate_antitone
statement:
lemma rate_antitone {P : Law (S n α G)} (hp : exch P) :
    Antitone (rateH P Prod.fst)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.rate_antitone_succ
statement:
lemma rate_antitone_succ {P : Law (S n α G)} (hp : exch P)
    {j} (h : j+1 < n) : rateH P Prod.fst (j+1) ≤ rateH P Prod.fst j

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.rate_bdd
statement:
lemma rate_bdd (P : Law Ω) (X : Ω → Letters n α) (j : ℕ) :
    rateH P X j ≤ log (Fintype.card α)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.rate_lt
statement:
lemma rate_lt (P : Law Ω) (X : Ω → Letters n α) {j : ℕ} (h : j < n) :
    rateH P X j = P.Hcond (readLetter X j h) (prefixB X j h.le)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.sum_deficit
statement:
lemma sum_deficit (P : Law Ω) [Nonempty α] (X : Ω → Letters n α) :
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, (log (Fintype.card α)-rateH P X j) =
      (P.send X).kl (pack (fun _ => uniform α))

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.Hcond_function
statement:
lemma Hcond_function (P : Law Ω) (X : Ω → A) (W : A → V) :
    P.Hcond X (fun x => W (X x)) = P.H X - P.H (fun x => W (X x))

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.Hcond_reduce
statement:
lemma Hcond_reduce (P : Law Ω) (X : Ω → A) (W : Ω → V) (f : A → B) :
    P.Hcond X W = P.Hcond X (fun x => (f (X x),W x)) + P.Hcond (fun x => f (X x)) W

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.opt_le_rent
statement:
lemma opt_le_rent (tag : A → G) (w : A → V) (u : E → G) (c : E → ℝ)
    (p : Law A) (P : Law Ω) (X : Ω → Fin n → A) (U : Ω → E) (h : hasRows p P X) :
    opt n p tag w u c ≤ rent tag w u c P X U

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.opt_nonneg
statement:
lemma opt_nonneg (n : ℕ) (p : Law A) (tag : A → G) (w : A → V) (u : E → G) (c : E → ℝ)
    (hc : ∀ x, 0 ≤ c x) : 0 ≤ opt n p tag w u c

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.opt_spec
statement:
lemma opt_spec (n : ℕ) (p : Law A) (tag : A → G) (w : A → V) (u : E → G) (c : E → ℝ) :
    let C (P : Law (WordSample n A E)) := rent tag w u c P Prod.fst Prod.snd
    (∃ P : Law (WordSample n A E), hasRows p P Prod.fst ∧ C P = opt n p tag w u c) ∧
    ∀ P : Law (WordSample n A E), hasRows p P Prod.fst → opt n p tag w u c ≤ C P

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.rent_antitone
statement:
lemma rent_antitone (tag : A → G) (w : A → V) (w' : A → W) (u : E → G) (c : E → ℝ)
    (p : V → W) (h : w' = p ∘ w)
    (P : Law Ω) (X : Ω → I → A) (U : Ω → E) :
    rent tag w u c P X U ≤ rent tag w' u c P X U

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.rent_cont
statement:
lemma rent_cont (tag : A → G) (w : A → V) (u : E → G) (c : E → ℝ)
    (X : Ω → I → A) (U : Ω → E) :
    Continuous (fun P : Law Ω => rent tag w u c P X U)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.rent_first
statement:
lemma rent_first {P : Law Ω} {X : Ω → I → A} {p : Law A} (h : hasRows p P X)
    (w : A → V) :
    ∑ i, P.Hcond (readP X i) (w ∘ readP X i) = Fintype.card I * p.Hcond (fun x => x) w

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.rent_nonneg
statement:
lemma rent_nonneg (tag : A → G) (w : A → V) (u : E → G) (c : E → ℝ)
    (hc : ∀ x, 0 ≤ c x) (P : Law Ω) (X : Ω → I → A) (U : Ω → E) :
    0 ≤ rent tag w u c P X U

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.rent_send
statement:
lemma rent_send (tag : A → G) (w : A → V) (u : E → G) (c : E → ℝ)
    (P : Law Ω) (X : Ω' → I → A) (U : Ω' → E) (b : Ω → Ω') :
    rent tag w u c (P.send b) X U = rent tag w u c P (fun a => X (b a)) (fun a => U (b a))

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.Arena.H_index
statement: lemma H_index (s) {i j} (hi : i ≤ j) (hj : j<d.N) : d.H j s ≤ d.H i s

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.Arena.L_index

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.Arena.budget_ascending
statement:
lemma budget_ascending (s : S) (G : S → Prop)
    (o n m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (hn : 0 < n) (hb : o+n*m ≤ d.N)
    (a b δ : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hδ : 1 < n*δ)
    (hstep : ∀ (t) (_h : d.mov s t) i (_hi : i<n), ∃ q, d.mov t q ∧
      ((G q ∧ d.topc t-d.topc q ≤ a*(d.H (o+i*m) t-d.L (o+(i+1)*m-1) q)+b) ∨
        (d.topc t-d.topc q)+a*δ ≤ a*(d.H (o+i*m) t-d.L (o+(i+1)*m-1) q))) :
    ∃ t, d.mov s t ∧ G t ∧ d.topc s-d.topc t ≤ a*(d.H o s-d.L (o+n*m-1) t)+b

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.Arena.budget_index
statement:
lemma budget_index (s : S) {i : ℕ} (hi : i < d.N)
    (u a δ η : ℝ) (hu : 0 < u) (ha : 0 < a) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hη : δ*exp (2*u/a) ≤ η) :
    ∃ t, d.mov s t ∧ d.topc s-d.topc t ≤ a*η ∧
      (d.found t ∨ u ≤ d.A i s - d.A i t ∨
        (d.topc s-d.topc t)+a*δ ≤ a*(d.H i s-d.L i t))

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.Arena.budget_macro
statement:
lemma budget_macro (s : S) (o q n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (hq : 0 < q)
    (hb : o+q*n ≤ d.N)
    (u a δ η α ε : ℝ) (hu : 0 < u) (ha : 0 < a) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hη : δ*exp (2*u/a) ≤ η) (hnδ : 1 < (n:ℝ)*δ)
    (ha' : 0 < α) (he : 0 < ε) (hb' : 2*(a/α) ≤ 1)
    (hc : (ε+η)*exp (2*(a/α)*q) ≤ 1) (hqu : 1 < (q:ℝ)*u) :
    ∃ t, d.mov s t ∧
      ((d.found t ∧ d.topc s-d.topc t ≤ α+a*(1+η)) ∨
        (d.topc s-d.topc t)+α*ε ≤ α*(d.H o s-d.L (o+q*n-1) t))

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.Arena.budget_sub
statement:
lemma budget_sub (s : S) (o n : ℕ) (hn : 0<n) (hb : o+n ≤ d.N)
    (u a δ η : ℝ) (hu : 0 < u) (ha : 0 < a) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hη : δ*exp (2*u/a) ≤ η)
    (hnδ : 1 < (n:ℝ)*δ) :
    ∃ t, d.mov s t ∧
      (d.found t ∨ u ≤ d.A (o+n-1) s - d.A o t) ∧
      d.topc s-d.topc t ≤ a*(d.H o s-d.L (o+n-1) t)+a*η

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.Arena.complete_search
statement:
lemma complete_search (s : S) (N q n : ℕ) (hn : 0<n) (hq : 0<q)
    (hN : 0<N) (hb : N*(q*n) ≤ d.N)
    (u a δ η α ε : ℝ) (hu : 0 < u) (ha : 0 < a) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hη : δ*exp (2*u/a) ≤ η) (hnδ : 1 < (n:ℝ)*δ)
    (ha' : 0 < α) (he : 0 < ε) (hb' : 2*(a/α) ≤ 1)
    (hc : (ε+η)*exp (2*(a/α)*q) ≤ 1) (hqu : 1 < (q:ℝ)*u) (ht : 1 < (N:ℝ)*ε) :
    ∃ t, d.mov s t ∧ d.found t ∧ d.topc s-d.topc t ≤ 2*α+a*(1+η)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.kl_covered
statement:
lemma kl_covered {ι : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (P : Law Ω) (X : Ω → ι → α) (q : Law α) (h : ∀ i, P.send (fun a => X a i) = q) :
    covered P X q

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.select_context
statement:
theorem select_context (tag : α → G) (c : G → ℝ) (hc : ∀ x, 0 ≤ c x)
    (T N m : ℕ) (hm0 : 0 < m) (hm : m ≤ N) (hT : 3*N ≤ T)
    (E : ℝ) (hE : 0 < E) [Nonempty α]
    (h : ∀ p : Law α, exp (-E) ≤ heatMoment (Fin T) p tag c) :
    ∃ (p : Law α) (Ψ : Law (WordSample N α G)), exch Ψ ∧
      (∀ i : Fin N, Ψ.send (fun a => a.1 i) = p) ∧
      log (Fintype.card α) - p.entropy ≤ 3*(E/N) ∧
      bill tag c p Ψ Prod.fst Prod.snd ≤ 3*E ∧
      tv (Ψ.send (prefixB Prod.fst m hm)) (iid p m) ≤ 2*m*√E/N

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.choose_tickets
statement:
lemma choose_tickets (r n : ℕ) (hr : 0 < r) (hn : 0 < n) (s : Finset (Fin n)) :
    ∃ k : Law (Ticket r n), ∀ (j : Fin r) (f : Fin n → ℝ),
      k.Ex (gain j f) = if r ≤ s.card then (∑ i ∈ s, f i)/n else 0

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.tag_test
statement:
lemma tag_test (p q : Law A) (f : A → ℝ) :
    p.Ex (fun x => (tagChance p q x).Ex (fun b : Bool => if b then f x else 0)) =
      ∑ x, min (p x) (q x) * f x

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.thin_sampler
statement:
lemma thin_sampler (r n : ℕ) (hr : 0 < r) (hn : n=2*r) (P : Law Ω) (q : Law A)
    (X : Ω → Fin n → A) (ε : ℝ)
    (hε : ∀ i, ((P.send fun x => X x i).tv q) ≤ ε) :
    ∃ (k : Ω → Law (Ticket r n)),
      let R := P.withNext k
      R.prob (fun x => x.2 = none) ≤ 2 * ε ∧
      (∀ (j : Fin r) (f : A → ℝ) (_h : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x),
        R.Ex (fun x => gain j (fun i => f (X x.1 i)) x.2) ≤ q.Ex f)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.quadratic_minkowski
statement:
lemma quadratic_minkowski (P : Law α) (f g : α → ℝ) :
    √(P.Ex fun x => (f x+g x)^2) ≤ √(P.Ex fun x => (f x)^2) + √(P.Ex fun x => (g x)^2)

statement:
lemma sq_Cx_norm (P : Law α) (f : α → ℂ) :
    ‖P.Cx f‖^2 ≤ P.Ex (fun x => ‖f x‖^2)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.sq_Ex
statement:
lemma sq_Ex (P : Law α) (f : α → ℝ) :
    (P.Ex f)^2 ≤ P.Ex (fun x => f x^2)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.sq_Ex_le
statement:
lemma sq_Ex_le (P : Law α) (f g h : α → ℝ) (hg : ∀ x, 0 ≤ g x) (hh : ∀ x, 0 ≤ h x)
    (H : ∀ x, f x^2 ≤ g x*h x) : P.Ex f^2 ≤ P.Ex g * P.Ex h

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.sq_Ex_mul
statement:
lemma sq_Ex_mul (P : Law α) (f g : α → ℝ) :

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.Hcond_compare
statement:
lemma Hcond_compare (P : Law α) (Y : α → β) (X : α → γ) (q : γ → Law β)
    (hq : ∀ i, 0 < P i → 0 < q (X i) (Y i)) :
    P.Hcond Y X ≤ P.Ex fun i => -log (q (X i) (Y i))

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.Hcond_pair_comm
statement:
lemma Hcond_pair_comm (P : Law α) (X : α → β) (Y : α → γ) (Z : α → η) :

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.after_channel
statement:
lemma after_channel (P : Law α) (f : α → β) (k : α → Law γ)
    {b : β} (h : 0 < P.send f b) :
    (P.withNext k).after (fun x => f x.1) b = (P.after f b).withNext k

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.det_channel
statement:
lemma det_channel (P : Law α) (f : α → β) (k : α → Law γ) :
    let R := P.withNext k
    let W : α × γ → β := fun i => f i.1
    (P.send f).Ex (fun i => (P.after f i).privateH k) + R.Hcond W Prod.snd =
      P.privateH k

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.privateH_const
statement:
lemma privateH_const (P : Law α) (Q : Law β) :
    P.privateH (fun _ => Q) = P.entropy

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.privateH_le
statement: lemma privateH_le (P : Law α) (k : α → Law β) : P.privateH k ≤ P.entropy

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.refine_signal
statement:
theorem refine_signal (P : Law α) (k : α → Law β) (v : α × β → Law γ)
    (q : β → Law γ) (hq : ∀ x i, 0 < q x i) :
    let R := triple P k v
    P.privateH k - R.Hcond (fun i => i.1.1) (fun i => (i.2,i.1.2)) ≤
      (P.withNext k).Ex (fun x => (v x).kl (q x.2))

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.replace_signal
statement:
theorem replace_signal (P : Law α) (k : α → Law β) (v : α → Law γ)
    (q : β → Law γ) (hq : ∀ x i, 0 < q x i) :
    P.privateH k - P.privateH v ≤
      (P.withNext k).Ex (fun x => (v x.1).kl (q x.2))

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.signal_cost
statement:
lemma signal_cost (P : Law α) (k : α → Law β) :

lemma coeff_near {ρ : ℝ → ℝ} (hρ : Measurable ρ) (h0 : ∀ x, 0 ≤ ρ x)
    (B : ℝ) (hb : ∀ x, ρ x ≤ B)

lemma restrict_affine (a : ℝ) {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) (G : Set ℝ) (hG : MeasurableSet G)
    (f : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞) (hf : Measurable f) :
    (∫⁻ x in G, f x) =
      ENNReal.ofReal s * ∫⁻ x in (fun y : ℝ => a+s*y) ⁻¹' G, f (a+s*x)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.shift_near_unit
statement:
lemma shift_near_unit {ρ : ℝ → ℝ} (hρ : Measurable ρ) (h0 : ∀ x, 0 ≤ ρ x)
    (B : ℝ) (hb : ∀ x, ρ x ≤ B)
    {u v x D : ℝ} (J : ℕ) (hx : usable ρ 0 1 J D x) (hD : 0 ≤ D)
    (hu : |u-v| ≤ 1) :
    ‖shift (modρ ρ u) 0 1 J x‖ ≤ ‖shift (modρ ρ v) 0 1 J x‖ +
      D * (2 * π) * 2

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.shift_pull
statement:
lemma shift_pull (F : ℝ → ℂ) (a s : ℝ) (hs : 0 < s) (J : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :

statement:
lemma haarLayer_average (F : ℝ → ℂ) (hf : Measurable F) (B : ℝ) (hb : ∀ x, ‖F x‖ ≤ B)

    (∫ a in origins, haarLayer F a s n x) =
      (2:ℝ)^n • ∫ t in window, kappa (t/(s*side n)) • F (x-t)

    (∫ a in origins, jump F (lft a s n k) (s*side n) x) =
      ∫ t in window, kappa (t/(s*side n)) • F (x-t)

    (hGu : G ⊆ unitInt) (Q : ℝ≥0∞) (J : ℕ)
    (H : ∀ s ∈ scales, ∀ a ∈ origins, (∫⁻ x in G, maxShift ρ a s J x) ≤ Q) :
